vi. ṭippaṇī ca 10|7|20. pañcārpeyasya nāsti ārṣeyavaraṇaviśiṣṭakarmādhikāra iti jaiminimattamam |

pūrvapakṣe tu pañcasvapi saṃvatsareṣu abhinnā ukṣāṇaḥ, tatra āditaścaturṣu saṃvatsareṣu kevalaṃ paryagnikaraṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ kartavyam|
prājāpatyā yathā ādau utsṛjya paścāt āla- bhyante tathā ukṣāṇo'pi āditaścaturṣu varṣeṣu utsṛjya pañcame varṣe ālabhyavyāḥ|
tathā ca saṃskārapratiṣedhaḥ iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt|
'satadaśa māktī- rūpākaroti' iti karmacodanā, tayā 'satadaśa pṛśnīnūṣaṇaḥ' ityasya ekavākyatvam|
tasmādekena vākyena caturviṃśat karmāṇi codyante prativarṣam|
iti caturṣu varṣeṣu, pañcame tu varṣe sarveṣāmālambhaḥ|
tatra ukṣaṇā mede tu punaḥ saṃskāro vyarthaḥ|
tathā ca saṃskārāṇāṃ darśanāt anye ukṣāṇaḥ iti pratīyate|
tathā ca karmaśeṣapratiṣedhaḥ, na saṃskārapratiṣedhaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ|
ke. pañcaśāradīye ādimeṣu caturṣu saṃvatsareṣu sata- daśokṣāṇaḥ paryagnikaraṇaprokṣaṇasamāpanayāḥ|
pañcaśāradīye ukṣaṇātsargaḥ karmaśeṣa- pratiṣedhaḥ na tu saṃskārapratiṣedhaḥ|
bhā. 1|12|13|14-56, pañcaśāradīye ukṣavākye karmaśeṣapratiṣedhāt pratisaṃvatsaraṃ bhinnānāmevo- kṣaṇāmāyanam|
pañcaśāradīye ādimeṣu caturṣu saṃvatsareṣu satadaśokṣāṇaḥ paryagnikaraṇa- prokṣaṇābhyāṃ samāpanīyāḥ|
pañcaśāradīye ukṣavākye karma- śeṣapratiṣedhāt pratisaṃvatsaraṃ bhinnānāmevokṣaṇāmāyanam|
bhāṣyam-- asti pañcaśāradīyaḥ ahīnaḥ 'māk- tīyaḥ pañcaśāradīyaḥ, yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ syāmiti, sa etena yajeta' iti|
tatra śrūyate 'vaiśākhayāmamāvāsyāyāṃ (viśākhāyuktāyāmamāvāsyāyām) satadaśa māktīstrī- vatsāḥ (trivatsāḥ) apravītāḥ (aprasūtāḥ) upā- karoti' iti|
'satadaśa pṛśnīnūṣaṇaḥ (nānāvarṇāṃ śuddhān alpaśarīrān vā), tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān, itarāḥ (trivatsāḥ) ālabhyante, pretarān (ukṣaḥ) utsṛjanti' iti|
tataḥ saṃvatsare rājīvāḥ (kamalasadṛśa- varṇāḥ) ānayanti, tāṃścaivokṣaṇaḥ, tān paryagnikṛtān, itarā ālabhyante, pretarānutsṛjanti' iti|
āśvalāyanaśraute ca 1|12|29-30) tatra seya cintā kimukṣaṇāsutsargaḥ āraṇyatvat karmaśeṣapratiṣedhaḥ, athavā prājāpatyavat saṃskārakarmapratiṣedhaḥ|
teṣāṃ ca sutyāsu prati- prasavaḥ, 'strīṇīnūṣaṇa ekasminnahani pañcottame' iti|
aya saṃskārapratiṣedhaḥ, tataste eva pañcavarṣaparyante, punaḥ punaḥ saṃskriyante |
kathaṃ pañcaśāradīyā iti? pañcaśāradīyāstathā, yathā anantarāḥ prājāpatyāḥ, saṃskārapratiṣedha ityarthe|
evaṃ ca tāṃścaivokṣaṇa ityapekṣā- vacanaṃ yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati |
prāyaścittavidhānaṃ ca, 'yadi kūṭaḥ kāṇo vā bhavet bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapet, yadi prapatet vāyavyaṃ carum, yadyavasīdeccaikataṃ carum' iti |
satadaśa pṛśnīnūṣaṇaḥ' iti pūrvāṃsu trihāyaṇīṣu yā devatā, sā atrānupajyate (ukṣasu) |
tasmāt dravyadevatāsaṃyogāt caturviṃśat karmāṇite yāni (anena vākyena vidhīyante |
tatra etat-) dvitīyaṃ vākyam 'tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān, itarā ālabhyante, pretarā- nutsṛjanti' iti|
tāsāṃ (ālabhamānujāvacanatvena lakṣaṇā) viśa- sanādi kṛtsnaṃ codakaprāptaṃ kriyate |
teṣveva saṃdehaḥ kiṃ paryagnikaraṇāntā- rītyā anaḍvāhaḥ ekavākyatāṃ gatvā codakena aṅgāni na gṛhṇanti, yathā āraṇyāḥ, uta prājāpatyāmiva prātaḥ- savanakāle saṃskārāṇāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ iti|
asmin kāle anaḍvāhā ālabhyādyo na kartavyāḥ saṃskārā iti |
karmaśeṣapratiṣedhe tu 'tāṃstān' iti ca karmāntaraṃ kalpyeta pratisaṃvatsaram |
saṃskārapratiṣedhe tu teṣā- meva (anaḍvāham) dvitīye (saṃvatsare) paryagnikaraṇānte |
idaṃ tasya śeṣatvenāpekṣyā- mahe ! etaccātra yuktam, yadayaṃ tasya śeṣaḥ syāt, nāsāvasya |
satadaśa pṛśnīmāktī- rūpākaroti, satadaśa ca pṛśnīnūṣaṇa iti cārtho na vaktavyaḥ |
tasmādekānena vākyena caturviṃśa- detāni karmāṇi codyante |
apekṣāvacanamapi teṣāmāvāt anyān tānevanāpekṣya bhavet, pṛśnīn mārutān |
ḍupū-- 'satadaśa mārutīḥ pṛśnīrūpākaroti' iti dravyadevatāsaṃyogāt yāgacodanaiyā |
yasminneva kṣaṇe trihāyaṇyaḥ saṃbadhyante, tasminneva anaḍvāho'pīti |
evaṃ parasparapekṣataḥ saṃbandho bhaviṣyati, ekavākyatvaṃ ca |
itarathā pūrvasmin vākye nirākāṅkṣīkṛtasya punarākāṅkṣā kalpanīyā |
tataḥ punaḥ saṃbandhaḥ : 'tasmāt ekena vākyena caturviṃśat karmāṇi vidhīyante' (iti bhāṣyaṃ kiñciddharamedena) |
nanu pūrvapakṣavādāpi caturviṃśat karmāṇi ekavākyatvaṃ cecchatyeva, karmaśeṣapratiṣedham (tu) necchati (kintu 'paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti' iti saṃskārapratiṣedhamicchati prājāpatyavat) |
na ca anena (bhāṣyakārīyeṇa vyākhyā- nena) saḥ (pūrvapakṣavādī) nirākriyate |
tasmāt kathametat vyākhyāyam (ekavākyatvāt iti sūtram ! ucyate-) prājāpatyeṣu yaḥ 'saṃskārapratiṣedhaḥ, saḥ 'brahma- sāmyālabhate' ityasya (pratiprasavavākyasya) sāma- rthyāt |
asmin sati anuvāde vā (saṃskāra-) pratiṣedho vā 'paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti' iti |
vākyena ) na śakyaḥ sutyākāle pratisavaḥ kartum |

tasmādetat sutyākālikaṃ karmāntaram ( tadā ca apūrva- syaiva vidhānāt ekavākyatā bhavati iti sūtrārthaḥ |
vyākhyānāntaramāha- ) api ca yasya ( mate ) saṃskāraḥ pratiṣidhyate, tasya dvitīye saṃvatsare |
tena ) tat tāvat vidhātavyam, utsargaśca ( vidhātavyaḥ ) tatra ( arthabhedāt ) vākya- bhedaḥ |
) ekatra ( vatsatarīṣu prakṛtiprāptamanvatate ( paryagnikaraṇam, ) anyatra ( anaḍutsu prāgeva paryagnikaraṇasya kṛtatvāt punaraprāpteḥ paryagnikaraṇam- ) aprāptaṃ vidhīyate |
bhāṣyam- saṃskārāṃśca prativarṣaṃ darśayati ' tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān ālabhante pretarānyuñjanti ' iti |
na, vākyabheda- prasaṅgāt, paryagnikaraṇaṃ karoti, paryagnikṛtāṃstrotsṛjantīti |

sūtrārtha- stu- pañcaśāradīyāpaśavo'pi prājāpatyavat utkṛṣyante iti |
bhāṭṭa-- pañcaśāradīyo nāma ahīnaḥ pañcāhaḥ ' yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ svāmiti, sa etena yajeta ' iti phale viniyuktaḥ |

tatra vaiśākhamāvāsyāyām ' saptadaśa mārutīstvitvā apavītā upākaroti, saptadaśa pṛśnī- rūkṣān, tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān, itarā ālabhante, pretarātsṛjanti, tataḥ saṃvatsare rājīvā ānayanti, tāṃstathaivopasthānān paryagnikṛtān ' ityādi pūrvavat |

tṛtīye caturthe ca saṃvatsare strīliṅganirdeśāt strīpañcānāṃ sāmaste- nānuṣṭhānaṃ ukṣṇāṃ ca paryagnikṛtānāmutsarjanamuktvā pañcame saṃvatsare dīkṣita eva ' ukṣastrīstrīnnhamālameta pañco- came'hani ' iti śrutam |
trivatsarāḥ, apra- vītāḥ aprasūtāḥ, pṛśnīḥ alpaśarīrāḥ, rājīvāḥ rājīvā- varṇāḥ ( rājīvaṃ kamalam ) |
atra striyo'pi gāva eveti ke cit |
atrośavākye māstāniti viparītamasya upā- karoti ityasya cātuṣpañcāttadapi vākyāntaram |
asmiṃśca vākye yathā karmabhedaḥ saṃkhyayā tathā kaustubhe nirūpitam |
atra ca ' upākaroti ' ityasya ekasyaiva bīṣu puruṣeṣu ca saṃbandhādekamevedaṃ vākyaṃ catustriśatkarmaṇāṃ vidhāyaka miti bhāṣyakāraḥ |

tatra kiṃ ukṣasu ye eva prathame saṃvatsare paryagnikṛtāḥ ukṣāṇaḥ, teṣāmeva dvitīyādisaṃvatsare paryagnikaraṇadi kṛtvā pañcame saṃvatsare teṣāmeva catussu sutyāsu trayāṇāṃ trayāṇāmalabhamḥ pañcānāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭhe'hanīve prājāpatyā- nāmiva ālabhamotkarṣaḥ ? uta prathamādivarṣeṣu anyeṣāmanye- ṣāmukṣaṇāṃ paryagnikaraṇa-ntāṅgītividhānena āraṇyapatyānī- vatvāditattatraiva samāptiḥ, pañcame varṣe tattatsutyāsu anyeṣā- mevālambhaḥ ? iti cintāyām, lāghavāt teṣāmevā- lambhotkarṣaḥ prājāpatyavat |
vacanācca paryagnikṛtānāmapi punaḥpunaḥ paryagnikaraṇadiḥ, tacchabdabalena pūrvoktānāmeva parāmarśati |
iti prāpte, prāsālamabhāvādena ' trīhvīnnham ' iti cānekāryavidhāne vākyabhedāt guṇāt karmāntaraṇyevaitāni vidhīyante, na tvatra ālabhmotkarṣaḥ |
ata eva ' pañcocame'hani ' ityatra uttame'hani pañcatvavidho avaśiṣṭānāma dvādaśānāṃ ' samaṃ syādaśrutatvāt ' iti nyāyenaiva anvahaṃ trayāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ prāpteḥ ' trīhvīnnham ' ityanuvāda ityapāstam |
ataḥ kālasaṃkhyobhayavidhiśaktakarmāntaratve- vaitāni saptadaśa vākyadvayena vidhīyante |
tataścotkarṣa- vidhyabhāvāt prathamādivarṣeṣu bhinnabhinnaivaitāni karmāṇi paryagnikaraṇāntāṅkaviśiṣṭāni devatādanānuṣṭheya vidhīyante |
pañcasaṃcharāṇi cāturmāsyeṣu vaiśvadeve parvaṇi āgneyādīni pañca havīṃṣi sarvapañceṣu saṃcaranti iti pañca- saṃcarāṇi ityucyante |
( ' āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati, saumyaṃ carum, sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālam, sārasvataṃ carum, pauṣṇaṃ carum ' iti vihitāni ādimāni pañca ) |

cāturmāsyeṣu vaiśvadeve parvaṇi ' āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati, saumyaṃ carum, sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālam, sārasvataṃ carum, pauṣṇaṃ carum ' iti pañca havīṃṣi pañcasaṃcarāṇi nāma sārthavādākyairvihitāni |
varuṇapraghāseṣu tu kevalāni havīṃṣyāmnāya tatra vaiśvadevakaṃ brāhmaṇamati- diṣṭam ' etadbrāhmaṇānyeva pañca havīṃṣi, yadbrāhmaṇāni itarāṇi ' iti |
tatra kimarthavāda- mātrasyātideśaḥ uta sārthavādakasya savidhikasya kṛtsnasya kāṇḍasyeti |
pañcasaṃchareṣu āgneyādiṣu pañcaṣu haviḥṣu varuṇapraghāseṣu arthavādāti- deśaḥ : vaiśvadevakasya kevalasya arthavādasya atideśaḥ syāt |
caturṣvapi parvasu saṃcaranti upatiṣṭhante iti saṃcarāṇi, tāni ca pañca havīṃṣi |
varuṇapraghāseṣu ' etadbrāhmaṇānyeva pañca havīṃṣi yadbrāhmaṇānītarāṇi ' iti vākyena vaiśvadevaparvagatasya sārthavādakasya savidhikasya kāṇḍasya sarvasya atideśaḥ syāt, na tu arthavādamātrasya |
eka evāyaṃ ' brāhmaṇa ' iti śabdaḥ vidhīnāṃ arthavādānāṃ ca |
sa yathā arthavādān gṛhṇāti tathā vidhīnāpi |
ekaḥ śabdo yeṣāṃ te arthavādā viṣayaśca ekaśabdāḥ, teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ aikaśabdayam |
varuṇapraghāsateṣu pañcasaṃchareṣu vaiśvadevaparvagatasya sārtha- vādasya savidhikasya sarvasya kāṇḍasyātideśaṃ darśayati liṅgam |
' triṃśadāhutayo hūyeran, vājino yajanti, āhutīnāṃ saṃpatyai triṃśattvā ' iti varuṇapraghāseṣu triṃśat- māhutīrdarśayati |
aṅgapradhānavidhiśeṣe satyeva uttara- vihāre dvāvājyabhāgau, aṣṭau havīṃṣi, nava prayājāḥ, nava anuyājāḥ, sviṣṭakṛt, vājinahomaśca iti liṅgadarśana- mupapannaṃ bhavati |
yadi vidhayo nātidiśyeran, tat nopa- padyeta |
yathā ' agniṃ manthi, prasuvo bhavanti ' puṣitāni barhīṣi bhavanti ityarthaḥ |
teṣāmati- deśena vihitānāṃ punarāmnānamanarthakaṃ syāt, yadi vidhī- nāmātideśaḥ syāt |
tasmāt vihitānāt na vidhī- nāmātideśaḥ, kintu arthavādāneva kevalanāmiti |
' agniṃ manthi, prasuvo bhavanti ' ityādayo vidhayaḥ dakṣiṇavihārānuṣṭheya- māptāvyahavirvāḥ, tasmāttat jñāpakaṃ vidhīnāmanati- deśasya |
tasmāt vidhīnāṃ ca arthavādānāṃ ca varuṇa- praghāseṣu atideśa iti siddhāntaḥ |
( pañcahotrumantraśca ' agnihotrā pañcahotrām ' ityukta- tvāt ' agnihotrā |
bhā. 9|1|11-19, pañcahotrṛcaturhotrṛmantrayoḥ darśapūrṇamāsahavirabhimarśana- karaṇabhūtayoḥ sauryāgaye vikalpaḥ |
pravṛtti- kāṇḍamukhyakramāstu atideśaviṣayā api pradhānabhūtāḥ padārthāḥ |
tasya pratipradhānamanuṣṭhānaṃ kurvataḥ kramaḥ siddha eva |
vi-- ' śrutyādibhiḥ kramasya viśeṣo vṛṣṭaya- vardhane |
' pañcamādhyāyasya prathame pāde śrutyarthapāṭhadharmaḥ kramaḥ nirūpitaḥ |
tṛtīye pañcaprayājādīnāmāvartanena aikādaśyaṃ ityādivṛddhiḥ, aḍhāmyagrahacitrayornā''vṛttiḥ ityādiḥ : vṛddhayabhāvaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- tadaivaṃ aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇyena prayojanavarge nirūpite adhunā prayogāśritaḥ kramo nirūpyate |
ekādaśo hi aṅgānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ca ekenaiva prayogavidhinā vidhāna- miti vakṣyate |

ataśca ekavidhividhitvena sarvasāhityasya vivakṣitatvāt ekena kartrā yugapat sarvakaraṇaśakteḥ avaśyaṃbhāvini kasmiṃścit krame niyāmakāni śruti- artha-paṭhana-sthāna-mukhya-pravṛttyākhyāni ṣaṭ pramāṇāni nirūpayiṣyante |
pañcamalakāraḥ pratiṣedhe śrauto yathā ' na saṃtṛṇatti ' ' dīdhito na juhoti ' |
bāla. pṛ. 40, pañcama- lakāraḥ vidhau śrauto yathā ' samidho yajati ' |
smārto yathā manuḥ ( 2|29 ) ' prāṅnāmidhardhanāt puṃso jātakarma vidhīyate |
apādānatvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ ' apādāne pañcamī ' ( pā0 2|3|28 ) iti sūtrāt |
vibhāgahetukriyānāśrayatve sati vibhāgaśrayatvaṃ iti tadarthaḥ ' dhruvamapāye'pādānam ' ( pā0 1|4|24 ) iti sūtrāt |
anyasya vibhāgaviyogadiśriyāśrayasya vibhā- gādau sati vibhāgaviyogāśrayatvena dhruvaṃ sthiraṃ vibhāga- viyogādinirūpakamiti yāvat, tadapādānamiti sūtrārthaḥ |
evaṃ ca adhaḥsaṃyogānukūlakriyāśrayatve sati tādṛśa- kriyājanyavibhāgāśrayatvāt vṛkṣasya apādānatvam |
itthaṃ ca tattadāśrayatvacchedanaphalajanakakriyānāśrayatve sati tādṛśakriyājanyaphalanirūpakatvāt tādṛśakriyāphalakaṃ iti niṣkarṣaḥ |

evaṃ caurāt vyāghrāt ( vā ) vibheti, caurāt trāyate, adhyayanāt parājayate, yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati, mātṛrnilīyate, upādhyāyādadhīte, brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante, himavato gaṅgā prabhavati ityādi bhayādihetu- cauryādīnādāneṣu ' mīmāṃsānāṃ bhavet ' ( pā0 1|4| 26 ) ' parājerasoḍhaḥ ' ( pā0 1|4|26 ) ' vārayaṇārthā- nāmīpsitaḥ ' ( pā0 1|4|27 ) ' antardhau yenādarśana- micchati ' ( pā0 1|4|28 ) ' ākhyātopayoge ' ( pā0 1|4|29 ) ' janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ ' ( pā0 1|
4|30 ) ' bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ ' ( pā0 1|4|31 ) ityādyā- nuśāsanikaṃ mukhyameva apādānatvam |
tadanāśrayatve sati tatsatkriyānirūpakatvāt ' mīmā- rthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ ' ityādyanuśāsanānāṃ apādānatvabodhakatā, na tu pañcamyā upapadavibhaktitvabodhakatā iti vaiyā- karaṇāḥ mīmāṃsāñca |
ata eva ' araṇyāt vibheti ' iti na prayogaḥ |
yadi ' vanāt vibheti ' iti prayogaḥ, tadā vana- padasya vanasthitavyāghrādau lakṣaṇā |
' madhyādavacati ' ityādī vibhāgaprayojakakriyānāśrayasya tannirūpakasya adhobhāgasya apādānatvam |
naiyāyikāstu vibhāgaśrayatvameva apādā- natvamicchantaḥ ' vyāghrāt vibheti ' ityādī lakṣaṇayā prayogaṃ kriyāntarakalpanena vā upapadavibhaktitvamicchanti |
evam ' dhāvato'śvāt patati ' ityatra aśvasya uktakriyāśrayatve- 'pi tasya vibhāgahetutvābhāvāt apādānatvopapattiḥ |
na caivam ' meghānmepo'pasarati ' ityatra meghasya kathamāpādāna- tvam, ubhayakarmajavibhāgasya aikyena tajjanakakriyā- śrayatvābhāvāt iti vācyam |
' anyonyasmāt apa- sarata : ' ityatra ubhayakarmajavibhāgasya aikye'pi tattajanaka- kriyāmādāya parasparasya tadāśrayatvopapādānāt |
' vṛkṣāt vastraṃ patati ' ityatra patanakriyādharmmādāya saṃgamanīyam |
kecittu pañcamī- janyāpādānatvabodhena dvitīyāyā asādhutvāt ityāhuḥ |
' balāhakāt vidyut vidyotate ' ityatra ' niḥsṛtya ' itya- dhyāhāreṇa upapadavibhaktiḥ |
evaṃ anyārāditaradikśabdā- ścūttarapadājāhiyukte ' ( pā0 2|3|29 ) iti sūtrāt |
' kṛṣṇādanya- stiṣṭhati, ārād vanāt, kṛṣṇāditaraḥ, ṛte kṛṣṇāt ' |
' ācūpratyayāntadakṣiṇā ( pada ) samabhi- vyāhāre ' dakṣiṇā grāmāt ' |
evaṃ vinā-pṛthagi- tyādipadasamabhivyāhāre dvitīyātṛtīyābhyāṃ vikalpitā pañcamī upapadavibhaktiḥ |
evaṃ durāntikārthakadapasamabhi- vyāhāre dvitīyāṣaṣṭhībhyāṃ vikalpitā pañcamī upapada- vibhaktiḥ |
tadarthaśca ' apādāne pañcamī ' ( pā0 2|3|28 ) iti sūtrāt apādānatvarūpaḥ |
tacca ' dhruva- mapāye'pādānam ' ( pā0 1|4|24 ) iti sūtraniruktam |
apāye vibhāge, dhruvaṃ niścalaṃ kriyānāśrayaṃ yat, tat apādānasaṃjñaṃ syāditi sūtrārthaḥ |
tathā ca kriyānāśrayatve sati kriyājanyavibhāgāśrayatvaṃ apādāna- tvam |
asti cedam ' vṛkṣāt parṇaṃ patati ' ityatra vṛkṣe patanakriyānāśrayatvāt patanakriyājanyavibhāgāśrayatvācca |
atra ca udāsīne ghaṭe parṇe ca atiprasaṅgavāraṇārtha daladvayam |
kriyānāśrayatvaṃ ca yadyapi sāmānyato na kriyāvicchedabhedapratiyogitvam |
pratiyogitāsāmānyapraveśe patanatvapi dvitvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedasatvāt ' svasmāt patati ' iti prayogāpatteḥ |

prakṛtyathaitā'vaccheda- kāvacchinnapratiyogitāpraveśe ca ' dravyāt patati ' ityasya anāpatteḥ patanatvapi dravyatvāvacchinnabhedā- bhāvāt, tathāpi prakṛtyarthatā'vacchedakāśrayatvasiddhida- vyaktitvāvacchinnapratiyogitāniveśena kriyāvicchedabheda- pratiyogitvaṃ nirvācyam |
tata patanatvapicchinnabheda- nirūpitavyaktitparṇavyaktitvāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvam udāsīne parṇe'pi, ataḥ kriyājanyavibhāgāśrayatvopā- dānam, iti na vṛkṣāt patati parṇe ' parṇāt parṇaṃ patati '

dvitīyārtho vṛttitvam, dhātvarthasya vināśānukūlavyāpārā- bhāvānukūlavyāpāraḥ, yannaśca ākhyātārthaḥ, pañcamyarthasya svanirūpakavināśāvadhisaṃt sargeḥ, dvitīyārthasya dhātvarthatā'- vacchedakībhūtavyāpārābhāvavattaḥ |
tathā ca yatrapratiyogika- vināśānukūlau bhakṣaṇādirūpau yo vyāpāraḥ, tasya govṛttiḥ yo'bhāvaḥ tadanukūlavyāpārānānukūlā kṛtiḥ devadattavṛttiḥ iti bodhaḥ paryavasitaḥ |
atra ca yavānāṃ vastutaḥ īpsita- tvāt pañcamī |
na caivaṃ gorapi īpsitatvāt pañcamyāpattiḥ, tasyāḥ īpsitatamatvena karmatvopapatteḥ |
etadarthameva hi ‘kartṛrīpsitatamam’ (pā0 1|4|49) ityatra tamabgrahaṇaṃ ityuktaṃ kaṇṭhasthe |
dhātvarthatā'vacchedakībhūtasya vināśānukū- lavyāpāradhvaṃsasya gomātravṛttitvāt tatraiva dvitīyā |
evaṃ ‘kūpadandhe vārayati’ ityatra vṛttiśca pañcamyarthaḥ, patanānu- kūlavyāpārābhāvānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ |

tathā ca kūpa- vṛtti adhaḥpradeśāvacchinnasaṃyogānukūlakriyārūpaṃ yat pat- nam, tadanukūle yaḥ andhavṛttiḥ vyāpāraḥ tadabhāvānukūlo yo vyāpāraḥ : tadanukūlā kṛtiḥ caitravṛttiḥ iti bodhaḥ paryava- sitaḥ |
evam ‘puṣpebhya ātapaṃ vārayati’ ityādāpi śuklībhāvānukūlavyāpārābhāvānukūlavyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ |
puṣpavṛttiśuklībhāvābhāvānukūlavyāpārābhāvo vā ātapaniṣṭhaḥ tadanukūla- ityādiḥ pūrvavat bodhaḥ |
‘agnimāṇavakaṃ’ vārayati’ ityādau janyatvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ; dāhānukūla- ityā- dirthātvarthaḥ |

yavebhyo gāṃ vārayati anyathā bhakṣayiṣyati, kūpadandhaṃ vārayati patiṣyati, puṣpebhya ātapaṃ vārayati śuklāṇi bhaviṣyanti, agre māṇavakaṃ vārayati dagdho bhaviṣyati iti prayojanasya bhedena vivaraṇāt |
anye tu anugamasikāḥ sarvatra saṃyogajanakavyāpārābhāvasya karmakārakavṛtteḥ anukūlau yo vyāpāraḥ sa eva dhātvarthaḥ |
tanna, ‘yavebhyo gosaṃyogaṃ vārayati, yavebhyaḥ’ karmaṇikaṃ vārayati’ ityādau anumānānupapatteḥ |
nanu ‘vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ’ (pā0 1|4|27) iti sūtre na tāvat īpsite vārayatikriyāyoge eva apādānatva- niyamaḥ |
‘sarpāt vārayati, gaṅgāsnānāt vārayati’ ityādau anīpsite'pi darśanāt |
sarpādyo hi nivārakasyāpi purovṛttitvādinā nivāryasya iṣṭa eva |
puṣpebhya ātapaṃ vārayati ityādau nivāryasya acetanatvāt nivārakagrahaṇam |
athavā dhātvarthatā'vacchedakībhūtasya vināśānukūlavyāpārābhāva rūpasya phalasya yat phalaṃ vināśādi, tatsaṃbandhitvena prasaktasya yavādeḥ tadviparīta- tvena nivārakatvenānvayaḥ |
vastutastu bahudhā etāni sarvāṇi sūtrāṇi bhāṣyakāreṇa pratyākhyātāni |

‘dhruvamapāye’ itisūtre hi na vastu eva kriyājanyo vibhāgo'bhipretaḥ, apitu tārkika'pi, yadi iyaṃ kriyā na syāt tadā karmakārakeṇa apādānasya saṃbandhaḥ syāt, kriyā tu sa nivāritaḥ iti tadabhāvo janita iti |
tataśca tatsūtreṇa yavāderapi apādānatva- siddhyā sutrāntaravaiyarthyamiti |
īpsita- tamatvādiyuktakarmasaṃjñayā paratvena apādānatvasaṃśayā bādhāt, vaiparītyena vivakṣāyāṃ iṣṭāpatteśca |
na ca vivakṣāyāṃ ubhayoḥ apādānatvāpattiḥ, vārayateḥ sakarmaka- tvena anyatarasya karmavivakṣāyā āvaśyakatvāt |
evam ‘antardhau yenādarśanamicchati’ (pā0 1|4|28) ityanena antadhau vyavadhāne sati yatkartṛkasya ātmano darśanasya abhāvamicchati, tat apādānaṃ syāt ityarthakena ‘mātuḥ’ nilīyate kṛṣṇaḥ |
atra ca pratyakṣā- bhāvecchāpūrvakaḥ pratyakṣavirodhivyāpāraḥ dhātvarthaḥ |
tathā ca mātṛvṛttisvaviṣayapratyakṣā- bhāvecchāpūrvakaḥ yaḥ pratyakṣalaukikasannikarṣābhāvānukū- lavyāpāraḥ : tadanukūlakṛtiḥ kṛṣṇavṛttiḥ |
vyutpattitvena ca pratyakṣe kṛṣṇaviṣayatvasya bodhaḥ pārthikaḥ |
evaṃ niyamapūrvakavidyāsvīkāre vaktā apādānasaṃjñaḥ syāt ityarthakena ‘ākhyātopayoge’ (pā0 1|4|29) iti sūtreṇa ‘upādhyāyādadhīte’ ityatra pañcamī |
uccāraṇakriyā- janyaśabdajanyasattvamānajātīyaśabdānāṃ upādhyāyamūlaniḥ- satvena upādhyāyasya kriyājanyavibhāgaśrayatvāt ‘dhruva- mapāye’ iti sūtreṇaiva tatsiddheḥ |
na ca evaṃvidhasya vibhāgasya mukhyavibhāgatvābhāvāt naikavidhatvaṃ apādāna- syeti vācyam |
nānāvidhānāṃ evaṃjātīyakānā- mapādānatvānāṃ vyāpakabhūtākhaṇḍopādhirūpādānatve eva tātparyāt |
ata eva evaṃvidhāḥ prayogāḥ sarve śaktā eva ityapi śakyaṃ vaktum |
uktavidhatadrūpeṇa niruḍhalakṣaṇayā bodhasiddhayarthaṃ tatt- sūtrāṇi iti matvā asmābhiḥ anyaiśca tattvasūtrāṇi vyākhyāyante |
evaṃ jāyamānasya hetuḥ apādānasaṃjñaḥ syāt ityarthakena ‘janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ’ (pā0 1|4|30) iti sūtreṇa ‘brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante’ ityatra pañcamī |
sa ca svāśrayavṛttitvasattvasaṃbandhena ākhyātārthe āśrayatve anveti |
tena ‘putrāt pramodo’ jāyate, mṛdo ghaṭo jāyate’ ityādau pañcamī |
evam ‘bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ’ (pā0 1|4|31) ityanena bhavanasya prakarṣaviśiṣṭasya yaḥ kartā, tasya yaḥ prabhavanpratiyogī, saḥ apādānasaṃjñaḥ syāt ityarthakena ‘himavato gaṅgā prabhavati’ ityatra pañcamī |

tathā ca himavatpratiyogigaṅgā- saṃyogadhvaṃsakṣaṇavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttitvargyībhāvatadvarṣadhvaṃsayogasaṃ- bhū-gaṅgā-saṃyogadhvaṃsasamakālīnatādṛśabhusaṃyogasaṃśrayatvaṃ gaṅgāvṛtti iti bodhaḥ paryavasitaḥ |
atra vaikuṇṭhasaṃyoga- dhvaṃsakṣaṇottaraṃ tādṛśabhusaṃyogasya ādyasya jāyamānatayā ‘vaikuṇṭhāt bhuvi prabhavati gaṅgā’ iti ityaprayogāpattiḥ, ataḥ avyayaheti |
kāśīsaṃyogadhvaṃsyavahitottarakṣaṇe ukta- bhugaṅgāsaṃyogānāṃ keṣāṃ cijjātyamānatvāt ‘kāśīto gaṅgā suvi prabhavati’ iti ityaprayogāpatteḥ : tādṛśasaṃyogadhvaṃsasamāna- kālīnate |

' ghaṭa: paṭo na, ghaṭasyānyonyābhāvaḥ, ghaṭasya saṃyogā- bhāvaḥ, ghaṭasya tādātmyābhāvaḥ' ityādāvapi pañcamyāpattiḥ, ' ghaṭāt vibhāgaḥ, ghaṭāt bhedaḥ paṭasya' ityādivi dharma- mātravācile'pi pañcamyāpatterdurvāratvāt |
dharmavivakṣāyā- mapi ' ghaṭasyānyonyābhāvavān ' ityādau tadāpatterdurvāra- tvācca iti vācyam |
pañcamyartho hi pratiyogitvaṃ svani- rūpakabhedādighaṭitasaṃsargeṇa asamanmate ākhyātāttānyī |
paraṃmate tu tadupasthāpite medādau eva anvayaḥ iti viśeṣaḥ |
tadiha anyādipade medāderviśiṣya medatvādinā upasthitatvāt yuktā tadyoge pañcamī |
anyonyābhāvādadipastu anyo- nyādipadavācyatādātmyābhāvatvena bodhāt na tadyoge pañcamī |
najo'pi lāghavena abhāvatvenaiva vācakatā, na tu medatvādinā anekaśaktikalpanā''patteḥ |
svarūpaāśrayaṃ klṛptamevopalabhya saṃśayacchede na kadācidapi abhūtāprāmāṇyādhyāropakalpanopapattiḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 126. ⚚ 'paṇalebhyaṃ hi na prājñaḥ krīṇāti daśabhiḥ paṇeḥ' |
yathā patañjyakhyaḥ kīṭa- viśeṣaḥ svaprītipātradīpe nijāṅgadāhakatvasade'pi tatra patanaṃ prītivaśamāpanno no jahāti, tathā sanmitrasya vyavahāraḥ |
yathā patantaṃ kathañcidbālāḥ stutyo'pi gacchantaṃ pakṣimanu- dhāvato jīvantañca vaddho'pi pakṣī gataḥ, tathā prakṛte'pi |

kiñca, prakṛtanyāyena hariharāderivabrahmatvaṃ necchati tatta- nmāhātmyaparapurāṇādiṣvitaranindā na syāt, dṛśyate ca sā, tathā ca tadanyāthānupapattyā sāmyamapi durlabhaṃ kṣetratvasya kā yameti vādinaḥ śaṅkā |
sāhassī. 135. ⚑ patantamanudhāvato baddho'pi gataḥ (pakṣī) iti nyāyaḥ |
yathā ye padamuccai gacchanti teṣāṃ pāto'pyavaśyambhāvīti viṣaye prakṛtanyāyasaṃcāra iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
vā. 1|3|49 pṛ. 221. ⚑ pateḥ (pataterdhātoḥ) arthaḥ adhaḥsaṃyogānukūla- kriyā, adhaḥsaṃyogaprayojakavibhāgānukūlakriyā vā arthaḥ |
yathā svayaṃvara kanyā anyo- syaktatvā sarvottamatvenābhimataṃ yamamīṣṭatvenādatte, na tato'nyatrābhīṣṭatvamapi kurute, tathā prakṛte'pīti |
sāhassī. 389. ⚑ patiśabdaḥ sarvatra ādhipatye prayuktaḥ ā himavata ā ca kumārīmyaḥ |
bhā. 1|3|12|133. ⚑ patitayājanaṃ lobhādaṅgīkṛtya yo yājayiṣyati, tadapekṣam 'brahmaṇā aśvamedhena yajeta' iti vidhānam, na tu tadvidhānānyāthā''nupapattyā yājanamitareṣāṃmapi vihitamiti kalpyate |
vā. 3|4|10|28 pṛ. 960. ⚑ patnī iti hi yajñasya svāminītyucyate |
bhā. 6|1|4|17 pṛ. 1362. ⚑ patnī darbhamayaṃ vāsaḥ paridhatte ahaṃtaṃ ca |
vi. 10|4|18. ⚑ patnī pāriṇavyasyeṣṭe (iti gauṇaḥ prayogaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ) |
bhā. 6|1|4|129. ⚑ patnī mahāmate darbhamayaṃ vāsaḥ paridhatte, tasya prākṛtena ahaṃta- vāsasā samuccayaḥ |
6|1|4|20, ⚑ patnayaḥ upagāyanti ' iti māhātmyikaṃ dharme saṃvatsarasatre darśayati |
mahāmate prākṛtānāṃ ṛtvijāṃ upa- gātūṇāṃ patnībhiḥ samuccayaḥ |
1|3|6|29, ⚑ patnī saṃnaddhā ' iti patnīśabdaḥ dipatnīke bahupatnīke vā prayoge nohitavyaḥ |
1|3|6|20, ⚑ patnī saṃnaddhā ' ityatra dvibahupatnīkaprayoge vikutāvāpi ekavacanasya nohaḥ |
1|3|1722, ⚑ patnyā dvitīyayā vinā yajamānena dhanasya tyāgo naivāvakalpate |
⚑ patnyāḥ niṣedhasya adhya- yanasya punaḥ prasave na kiñcidasti pramāṇam |
yadā āmayadoṣāt māṃsaṃ vratakāryaṃ upādīyate, tadā tanna dakṣiṇāgnau śrapayi-
bhā. 1|2|1|17. ⚑ patnyāḥ śmaśruṇāmabhāvāt keśanāmapi na vapanam, sāhityasya vivakṣitatvāt |
6|1|4, 9|1|6. ( sahā- dhikārādhikaraṇaṃ patnīsaṃhanananyāyaścobhayamepi patnyadhi- karaṇaśīrṣakena ucyate |
tasyā api tarhi patyā saha vibhāgo bhavedyadi śabdastu niṣedho na syāditi cet, na, 'adhanālya eva bhāryā dāsasthā sutaḥ ' |

darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ divahu- patnīke prayoge ' patnī saṃnaddhā ' ityatra ekavacanasya nohaḥ |
bhāṣyam - darśapūrṇamāsayorāmananti ' prokṣaṇīrāsā- dayedhamābarhiṣasādayaṃ, suvaṃ ca sucaśca saṃmṛḍḍhi, patnī saṃnaddhā''jyenodehi ' iti |
tatra sarvasya prayogamadhikṛtya patnīśabda uccaritaḥ ityetat pāśā- dhikaraṇenaiva ( 9|3|4 ) nirṇītam |
idaṃ tu saṃdihyate kiṃ dvipatnīke bahupatnīke ca prayoge patnīśabdaḥ |
ca prayoge patnīśabde upādīyamāne dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ca sāmarthyāt prāpnoti saṃhananasaṃjñaṃ kartum |
na cātra dvitvaṃ bahutvaṃ vā vivakṣyate, lakṣaṇatvena hi patnīśabdasya śravaṇāt |
na caikapatnīkāt prayogāt dvivahupatnīke prayoge'tideśo bhavati |
athāpi kathaṃcidekatvaṃ vivakṣyate, tathāpi dvivahupatnīke prayoge saṃpratipyabhāvā- dekavacanārthamekavacanam |
tadanekapatnīke prayoge avikaddha- mityavikāreṇa prayujyate iti |
dup-- yadi patnī prātipadikaṃ pradhānaṃ balavat, tataḥ ekadvibahupatnīkeṣu prayogeṣu patnīśabdo'sti iti tadaṃśena vibhaktirapi ekavacanaṃ triṣvapi ākṛtisaṃkhye- 'bhiprāyaṃ syāt |
atha vibhaktiḥ pradhānam, tato yatra sā svārthaṃ labhate, tatraiva paryavasyataḥ : prātipadikārthaḥ, iti dvivahupatnīke mantra eva na syāt |
ityetayoḥ pakṣayoḥ kiṃ nyāyamityetat pāśādhikaraṇe varṇitamiti yathāprāti- padikānurodhe vacanamiti |
'athāpi kathaṃcidekatvaṃ vivakṣitam' (iti bhāṣyasya ayamarthaḥ-) adyartha- mekavacanamuccāritam, na samavetasaṃkhyābhidhānārtham, dvivahutvasyānabhidhānāt |
yatra tveka eva mantraḥ, tatra patnī- nyāyaḥ; 'pavitre sthaḥ' iti yathā |
kiṃ tarhi ? samavetatvaṃ vadati na vadatīti |
atra prātipadikaṃ triṣvapi pravartate, vacanaṃ tu ekapatnīprayoge ityarthavattyāśrayaṇamuktkam, prakṛtipratyayayoḥ sahamvṛtti- niyamāt |
tasmādiha dvivacanabahuvacanaprayogamicchatā prātipadikaṃ vacanaṃ ca ubhayamapi ekapatnīprayoge'bhi- prāyeṇa āmnātaṃ iti tasya prakṛtitvam, itarayostaddhi- kṛtitvaṃ cāśritya mukhya evoho vaktavyaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- apūrve prakṛtau 'patnīm' ityasya adhikāraḥ, apradeśāt sāmānavidhyena anatideśāt pratīyata iti |
bhāṭṭa-- ata eva darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'patnīṃ saṃnaddhā' ityevamantānto mantraḥ |
ekapatnīprayoge iva dvivahu- patnīprayoge'pi avikāreṇaiva prayoktavyaḥ |
na ca liṅgenaikapatnīkaprayoge eva mantro'ṅgaṃ dvivahupatnīka- prayogayostadenātidṛśyate iti yuktam |
yatra hi upadeśā- khyaprāpakapramāṇasya ekamātraviṣayatvaṃ anyatra ca kārya- mukhenātideśataḥ prāptiḥ, tatraivoheḥ, na tu prāpaka- pramāṇasya sarvaviṣayatve |
atra ca pāśanyāyena prātipadikaliṅgasya sarvaviṣayatvopapatteścanurodhena saṃkocāccogāt nāsya prāpakapramāṇasya ekapatnīprayogamātra- viṣayatvam |
na ca ṛtupaśūnāṃ samānavidhānatvakṛtvā- cintāyām 'prāsmai' ityasya liṅgānurodhena meṣīvajaṃ saṃkocavat ihāpyekavacanena mantrasaṃkocopapattiriti vācyam |
vinā kāraṇaṃ pulliṅgasya lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇā- bhāvena tatra saṃkocopapattau prakṛte saṃkoce pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
nahyatra dvivahupatnīkaprayoge ekavacanasya lakṣaṇā, pratyekavacinnigatetyabhiprāyeṇa tadupapatteḥ |
yathaiva hi 'śuklā ghaṭāḥ' ityādau śuklasya pratyekavattitvānvayaḥ, tathaivātranāmahitasya ekasyāpi pratyekavattile- nānyave na kācit kṣatiḥ |
na caivam 'bahuṣu bahuvacanam' ityādyanuśāsanasya niyatatvatvāpattiḥ, bahutvasya śābda- bodhavivakṣāyāṃ tadupapatteḥ |
na caivam 'paśunā yajeta' ityādau dvipaśugrahaṇe'pi bādhakānāpattiḥ, prathamāti- krame kāraṇābhāvena ekavacanasya aicchikakathantarā
yaduktam, dvādaśāha a gaṇe patnīsaṃyājāntatvaṃ sarveṣāmiti, tatra|
kintu prāk ucamāt antimāt ahaḥ patnīsaṃyājāntaṃ syāt, liṅgāt|
‘patnīsaṃyājāntyānyahāni saṃtiṣṭhante, na bahi- ranugraharati, asaṃsa্থিতo hi tarhi yajñaḥ’ iti liṅgaṃ yasmi- nahani yajñaḥ na saṃsthitaḥ samāso bhavati, tasmin patnī- saṃyājāntatāṃ darśayati|
dvādaśāhahe ahargaṇe patnīsaṃyājāntatvaṃ sarveṣāmahā- miti punaḥ pūrvapakṣī āha|
‘patnīsaṃyājāntyānyahāni saṃtiṣṭhante, na bahiranu- praharati, asaṃsa্থিতo hi tarhi yajñaḥ’ iti yat liṅga- mukttam, saḥ arthavādaḥ patnīsaṃyājāntatāstyarthaḥ|
yathā dīkṣā dīkṣāviṣayakama ‘varuṇapāśābhyāṃ vā eṣoḍami- dhīyate (vadhyate) yo dīkṣitaḥ|
naktaṃ- saṃsthāpyo varuṇapāśyāmevāmevonmucyate, āmanto'hisyāye’ iti dīkṣonmocanavacanaṃ naktaṃ saṃsthāpanasya arthavādaḥ|
antye ahani tu asaṃsa্থিতtvarūpasya liṅgasya virodhāt|
kutūhale tu liṅgaśabdo'tra nyāyapara eva svīkṛtaḥ|
antye ahani nyāyavirodhāt patnīsaṃyājāntatā na pravṛttiḥ|
nyāyya bhāṣye- ‘patnīsaṃyājāntā- nyahāni saṃtiṣṭhante iti, naitaduktaṃ bhavati, śiyamavalupyate iti|
saṃtiṣṭhante nānuṣṭhīyante kartṛvyāpāra eṣu uparamatti iti|
teṣu sahakriyamāṇeṣu ahaḥsu avaśyaṃ kasmiṃścit padārthe avasthāyā avaśyaṃ aparasyāhaḥ padārthā anu- ṣṭhātavyāḥ|
aniyame prāpte patnīsaṃyājāntai saṃkhyāpyaṃ iti niyammate|
tathaiva ca pūrveṣāmapi ahatāṃ yajñapucchāntā prāsaṅgikī siddhā bhavati’ iti|
tasmāt prāguttamāt patnīsaṃyājāntatā, nyāyena prāpte liṅgadarśanamukttam ‘asaṃsa্থিতo hi tarhi yajñaḥ’ iti|
ke. patnīsaṃyājottaraṃ dvādaśāhatānāṃ daśamāti- riktānām virāmaḥ|
avaśiṣṭaṃ hāriyojanādi barhiḥ- praharaṇāntaṃ karma dvādaśo'hani patnīsaṃyājottaraṃ kartavyam|
vi. 9|1|9 patnīsaṃyājottaraṃ haviṣkṛtaḥ patnyāḥ visargaḥ na prāk|
‘agnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśamaṣṭakapālaṃ nirvapet yo darśapūrṇamāsāyājī san amāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ vā'tipātayet’ iti naimittikaṃ nimitta- sadbhāve kāryam|
paśyaṃ bahukuru'pi vaditavyaṃ bhavati, na punarukttatā mahān doṣaḥ|
arthagrahaṇāt vibhyataḥ punaḥ punaramidhīyamānaṃ bahu manyanta eva|
padaṃ antiādupanipatitaṃ vākyārthamupajanayitu- malaṃ bhavati, na durādavatiṣṭhamānam|
vyava- hitamapi hi, parāṇuvya vyavadhāyakam, ānantaryeṇa manasi viparivartamānaṃ almeva bhavati viśeṣamupajanayitum|
yathā ‘itaḥ paśyasi dhāvantaṃ dve jātaṃ vanaspatim|
tvāṃ bravīmi viśālākṣyā yā pinaṣṭi jaradravam ||
atra ‘itaḥ paśyasi’ iti śabdo buddhau bhavati|
sa dūre jātaṃ vanaspatiṃ ityete (ityevamādimiḥ) pade- vyavihitaṃ jaradravaṃ ityanena śabdena, vyavadhāyakanyapohya saṃvadhyamānaḥ saṃvadhyate|
arthānāṃ hyathatvena hetunā vyava- hitānnapi vacanāni saṃvadhyante|
yāni punaḥ artheto ālambayāni, tāni ānantarye'pi sati na parasparamena saṃvadhamarhanti|
saṃgrahaḥ : yathā hi smārakāḥ saṃbandha- darśanādayaḥ anadhikaviṣayāḥ tathaiva padamapi anadhika- viṣayatvatulyatvāt apramāṇamiti|
padamekena saṃbandhaṃ sat nirākāṅkṣaṃ bhavati, na tadapareṇāpi saṃbandhamarhati |
padaṃ gakārādyeva, sa eva śabdaḥ, nānyat vyati- riktamasti; bṛhatī. pṛ. 123|
padaṃ caturvidhaṃ rūḍhaṃ yaugikaṃ yogarūḍhaṃ yaugikarūḍhaṃ ca|
yathā ghaṭaḥ, citraguḥ, paṅkajam, maṇḍapaḥ ityādiṣveṣu |
paṅkajapadāt paṅkajanikartṛtvobhayaprakārakatvopasthitiranubhavikatvāt, anyathā paṅkajapadāt mekādibodho'pi syāt, ato yogarūḍhirādavaśyakī|
paṅkajādipadānāṃ yaugikatvameva, paṅkajapadāt avayavaśaktyā paṅkaviśeṣaka- paṅkajanikartṛtvamātraprakārakabodhena padamatvaprakārakabodhā- bhāvāt|

tatra khalevālītvāt pareṣāṃ anyeṣāṃ yūpadharmāṇāṃ joṣaṇaṃ takṣaṇaṃ uccayaṇaṃ ityevamādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ bādhaḥ syāt |
teṣu dharmeṣu kṛteṣu khalevālyāḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ kṛto bhavet |
yat kāṣṭhaṃ khale balīvarda- vāraṇapravṛtte sā khalevālī |
tasmāt khalevālyāṃ takṣaṇādayo dharmā na kartavyāḥ |
jyotiṣṭome 'āśvināgrān gṛhṇīyādāmayāvinaḥ' 'śukrāgrān gṛhṇīyādamicarataḥ' 'manvyagrān gṛhṇīyādami- caryamāṇasya' iti aindravāyavāt pare grahāḥ kāmāya śrūyante |
teṣu aindravāyavāt pare ṣu śreṣṭha agraśabdaḥ pūrvavat svakasamasthasyaiva bodhakaḥ |
yasya grahasya agratā pāṭhakramena siddhā tāmeva anūdya sasa maho phalatva vidhīyate, na tu agratā vidhīyate |
tena svakasthānasthitānāmeva āśvinādigrahāṇāṃ saptakatvārthatā syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tatra āśvinādīnāṃ na svasthānasthitānāmeva kāmārthatā, kintu teṣāṃ aindravāya- vāt prāk pratikarṣaḥ kartavyaḥ |
nityārthena agrasya nityārthā yā pāṭhasiddhā āśvinādīnāṃ agratā tataḥ tada- saṃyogāt tena āmayāvitvādinimittaphalena asaṃyogāt saṃyogābhāvāt |
tataśca svasthānasthitatvena yā kathañci- dagratā sā nityārthā |
abhicārādiphalāyāṃ ca yā agratā, sā aindravāyavāt prāk pratikarṣeṇa setsyati |
tasmāt viśiṣṭaphalārthe āśvinādīnāṃ aindravāyavāt prāk pratikarṣaḥ |
atra na pūrvavat grahavidhiḥ; kintu apratāyā eva vidhiḥ iti mantavyam |
jyotiṣṭome kāmaviśeṣāya āśvināgratā śukrāgratā manvyagratā ca śrutā |
tatra āśvinādīnāṃ aindravāyavāt prāk pratikarṣaḥ siddhānte uktaḥ |
liṅgaṃ dhārāgraheṣu sarvādidataḥ āśvinādīnāṃ pratikarṣaṃ darśayati |
'dhārayeyustam, yaṃ kāmāya gṛhṇīyaḥ, aindravāyavaṃ gṛhītvā sādayet, atha taṃ sādayet, yaṃ kāmāya gṛhṇīyaḥ' iti |
idaṃ liṅgaṃ kāmāya gṛhīte dhāryamāṇe aindravāyavasya grahaṇaṃ darśayati |
tasmāt kāmārthānāṃ grahaṇāṃ aindravāyavāt prāk pratikarṣaḥ |
ke. prakṛtiḥ arthavādaḥ 'iti ha smāha vaṭku- rvāṇṇiḥ : māghāname maha pacata' iti |
'iti ha smāha vaṭkurvāṇṇiḥ : māghān me pacata' ityādi |
prakṛtiḥ mantraḥ 'citra id rājā rājakā idantyake yake sarasvatīmanu |
atra he rājakāḥ rājānaḥ, citro nāma rājā, it iti niścaye |
sa eva sarasvatīmanu tadeśe yake anyake yasminkaṃsiñcat anyasmin deśe gavāṃ sahasram, ayutā ayutāni ca dadat it dadau eva |
'iti ha smāha vaṭkurvāṇṇiḥ : māghānme pacata, na vā eteṣāṃ havirgṛhṇanti' iti ekakartṛkavṛttāntakarūpayāṃ prakṛtau upavasathe'hani mābhakṣaṇamuktam |
'ulmukair sapta pūrvaṃ samājagmuḥ, tān ha asurā rakṣāṃsi nijaghnuḥ |
tathā ca prakṛtipurākalpasya dharmaḥ mābhakṣaṇādiḥ : manuṣyadharmaḥ : yāgakartuḥ manuṣyasya dharmaḥ syāt |
hi yasmāt dharmasya anukīrtanaṃ kathanaṃ arthāya prayojanāyaiva |
tasmāt upavasathādau mābhakṣaṇaṃ barkau- rvāṇṇiḥ anyairapi manuṣyaiḥ kartavyaṃ iti mābhapāksya vidhirayam, nārthavādaḥ : iti prathamaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |

prakṛtipurākalpoktadharmaṃ upavasathe mābhakṣaṇadau tayukte vihitamanuṣyadharmatvacca satyeva pratiṣedhāt 'tattathā na kuryāt' ityādipratiṣedhasya saphalatvāt mābhakṣaṇadau manuṣyadharmatvena vidhiraiva syāt iti pūrvapakṣe hetvantaramāha sūtram |
'kutūhale tu idaṃ sūtraṃ 'vidhī tu vedasaṃyogāt' iti sūtrottaraṃ ekonatriṃśaccena paṭhitam |
vyākhyā ca ittham- vājapeyaprakaraṇe vājasaneya- śākhāyāṃ dvividhaḥ paśukalpaḥ śrutaḥ |
paśukāle āgneya- maindrāgnendramiti trīn ṛtūn upākṛtya mārutī vaśā- mupākaroti sārasvatīṃ ca meṣīṃ sārasvataṃ ca meṣamupākṛtya sasandaśa prājāpatyān paśūn upākaroti |
paryagnikaraṇānte sārasvatyantān pūrvānālabhante, sārasvatāprabhṛtīn uttarān dhārayanti |
mādyaṃdinasya savanasya madhye ukthaparyāye brahmasāmni upākṛte sārasvatamadhīnuttarān ālabhante |
sārasvatasya vapayā prarya samavadāya prājāpatyavapāmiḥ carati |
tadya- śreṣṭhā anuyājā bhavanti, acyute sucau athaiṣāṃ havirbhiḥ pracaranti |
halati (calati) vā eṣa yajño yadaivaṃ kurvanti |
tasmāt yatraiva pūrvapāṃ vapābhiḥśreyuḥ taditareṣāṃ vapābhiḥśreyuḥ; yatraiva pūrvapāṃ havirbhiḥ tatraiva teṣāṃ havirbhiḥśreyuḥ' iti |
atra yacchabda- yukte vākye śrutasya paśukalpasya pratiṣedho bhavati |
uktukṛtūhaloko vidhiḥ kriyāścitta śata- paye 5|1|3|14-14 ityatra dṛśyate, na tu sarva eva |
vākyākṣaraparipāṭī prāyaḥ sarva eva atra dṛśyate |
prakṛtipurākalpoktaḥ upavasathe mābhojanādidharmaḥ : vṛṣṇiākulotpannavṛṣṇiākule sarvamanuṣyatāṃ dharmaḥ : vidhiḥ syāditi prathamapakṣaṃ sūtradvayena prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirudhya anyaṃ pūrvapakṣamāha |
vāṇiśabdena nirdeśāt vṛṣṇiākulotpannā- meva taddharmaḥ; sa cāsau dharmaśca taddharmaḥ : mābhakṣaṇa- rūpo dharmaḥ syāt, na tu vṛṣṇiākulotpannānām |
'pañcāvattaṃ jamadagnīnām' iti yathā jamadagni- gotrāṇāmeva pañcāvattaṃ bhavati, nānyeṣāṃ taddhat |
athavā nirdeśāt vṛṣṇigotranirdeśāt taddharmaḥ : teṣāṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ vṛṣṇigotrotpannānāmeva dharmaḥ : syāt iti śabdārthaḥ |
'mābhānaiva mahaṃ pacata' ityevamāde vāṇisayogāt vidhī tadanumitavidhau vṛṣṇiākulotpannasya sarvasyaiva manuṣyāṇāmupadeśaḥ syāt syāt mābhapāksya |
prakṛtipurākalpa- miti prathamasūtre kevalaṃ vidhipakṣa uktaḥ |

prakṛtipurākalpayoḥ : 'iti ha smāha vaṭkurvāṇṇiḥ : mābhān me pacata' ityādi mābhapākvidhiḥ; vṛṣṇigotrā- ṇāmeva vidhiḥ, manuṣyamātrāṇāṃ sa vidhiḥ iti pūrvapakṣa- tryanirāsārthaḥ vāśabdaḥ : 'āraṇyamevāśrīyāt' ityasya vidheḥ : 'iti ha smāha' ityādiḥ śeṣaḥ |

'gṛhapateravāmiṣu nirmanthya nirvapen' ityasya vidheḥ 'ulmukaiḥ sa pūrvaṃ samājagmuḥ; tān ha asurā rakṣāṃsi nijaghnuḥ' ityeṣa śeṣaḥ : tasmāt so'pyarthavādaḥ : tasmāt arthavādatvāt saḥ nityānuvādaḥ syāt, na vidhiḥ |
yathā ' iti ha smāha baṭukurvāṇiṣmāṃ pānne pacata, na vā eteṣāṃ havirgṛhṇanti' iti |
purākalpaḥ, ' ulmukair sma pūrve samājamasmān ha asurā rakṣāṃsi nijaghnuḥ ' ityevamādayaḥ |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kimete manuṣyadharmā viṣayaḥ, uta tadrotrāṇām |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? manuṣyadharmā vidhyaḥ iti |
ataḥ parairapi manuṣyaiḥ kartavya iti gamyate |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃjātīyakasya vidheḥ pratiṣedho bhavati, tattathā na kuryāditi |
tatra tu viśiṣṭagotrāṇāṃ nirdeśastaiṣāmeva dharma iti gamyate |
yathā ' pañcāvattaṃ jamadagnīnām ' iti tadrotrāṇāmeva bhavati, evamihāpīti |
etasyāḥ kriyāyā bhāvo yasmādanena puruṣeṇa kriyate tasmāt sādhuriti |
na tvatra puruṣaḥ kriyāsambandhena nirdiśyate kintu stotavya- tvena |
api ca kriyānirdeśe śrutyā vidhānam, kriyāpuruṣa- sambandhanirdeśe vākyena |
tasmāt puruṣamātrasya vidhānaṃ prāpnoti, na tadrotrāṇāmiti |
nāyaṃ tadrotrāṇāṃ vidhiḥ, na manuṣyamātrasya vā vidhiḥ, vidhiraiva veti |
vidhinā hi saṃbandha- mānayoḥ prakṛtipurākalpavacanayoranyathā vacanavyaktiḥ |
soma-- aparimitaśabdavat ihāpi nāviśeṣaḥ iti pratyavadhānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- prakṛtiḥ purākalpaḥ idaṃ dvayamapi manuṣyadharmaḥ manuṣyadharmatvena vidhyaṃ syāt |
vi-- ' māṣān me pacatetyetad vārṣiṣṇevākhileṣu vā |
' bhāṭṭa-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ' iti ha smāha baṭuku- rvāṇiṣmāṃ pānne pacata ' iti śrutam |
baṭukartṛkopākhyānaparaṃ ca vākyaṃ purākalpaḥ sūne ' ulmukaiḥ saha pūrvaṃ samājamasmuḥ, tānasurā rakṣāṃsi nijaghnuḥ ' iti |
ayaṃ ca ' gṛhapatairevāgriṣu nirmanya nirvapet ' iti nirmanthyābhisaṃsargastulyaḥ : ulmukasaṃsarginaḥ san tadvidheḥ śeṣaḥ |
parakṛtyudāharaṇe tu yadā vidhisiddhā kṛtvā- cintayā vicāryate |
vṛṣṇigotrāyadhikāradarśapūrṇamāso- ddeśena tatkartṛsaṃskārārthatayā vā māṣapākavidhiriti tadvata eva māṣapākādhikāro vaiśyanimittakasāhacaryavat |
nakṣatrā prācyatvavat vṛṣṇigotratvaṃ durbacam, yena tatkalpavidheḥ sāmānyaviṣayatvaṃ syāt |
iti prāpte, stutyupāyatveno- pāttasya vṛṣṇigotratvasya vidheyamāṣākaviśeṣaṇatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt māṣapākamātravidhānena sarvādhikāraḥ |
prakṛtipuropārūyā nārthavādakalpaḥ vidhiḥ yathā ' tāmyāmetamīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ pūrṇamāse prāyacchat ' iti |

paratantropajīvīnyetāni ( havirdhāne auṣadha- guṇakāni aiṣṭhikāni karmāṇi ) yathā'vasthitaṃ paratantra- mupajīvitumarhanti, yathā pāśukān prayājān anyakāla- nāpi paśupuroḍāśaḥ upajīvati, iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
paranimittaprāyaścittānuṣṭhānam ( paraṃ parastā- dvartamānaṃ nimittaṃ yasya prāyaścittasya, tasyānuṣṭhānamityarthaḥ) apacchedāparvārthe |
tasya ca tava ca ubhayorapi anyena paryanuyogāt |
paraprābalyanyāyaḥ ; pūrvadaurbalyanyāyaḥ ; paurvā- paryaṃnyāyaḥ ; paurvāparyabalīyastvanyāyaḥ ; apacchedanyāyaḥ ityevameva |
' paramatvamapratiṣṭhitamanumataṃ bhavati ' iti nyāyāt ihāpi yogaśāstraprasiddhā manasaḥ pañca vṛttayaḥ parigṛhyante, ' pramāṇa-viparyaya-vikalpa-nidrā-smṛtayaḥ ' nāma |
paraśabdaḥ paratra prayuktaḥ san taddharmānniviśati ityuktam |
bhā. 7|4|2|8 paraśabdaḥ paratra stutumapi na vartate |
sa yatra vijñāto bhavati, tatrānūdyate, yathā ' siṃho devadattaḥ ' iti |
yatra avijñātaḥ, tatra vidhīyate, ' yathā amī piṇḍiṇḍāḥ siṃhāḥ kriyantām ' iti |
paraśākhāvihitaṃ svaśākhāvihitena bādhyate, ayaṃ atrāsabādhaḥ ( yathā uditahomādi anuditahomādinā ) |
parisaṃkhyene paro bodhanīyaḥ ityasmiṃśce virodhā- bhāvāt apratiṣṭhitatvamuktam ( manato vṛttipañcakasya yogaśāstrasiddhasya ) |
vā. 3|4|1|28 pṛ. 960, parasvatvāpādanāt prāk dānavidhānaṃ na paryavasyati, iti pratigrahamākṣipatti |
parakīyaiḥ padārthaiḥ kalpyamāṇaiḥ na dākṣaṇāgnikau piṇḍairlepakaraṇahomī utkṛṣyate jyotiṣṭome |
parakīyasya dravyasya kratau viniyuktasya anyāyeṃ viniyogānaucityam |
yadeva bhavadabhimataṃ tryaṇukāmīkṣāmahe tadeva paramāṇumakṣamehe, tadavayavānupalambhāt tatkalpanāhetūpapatteśca |
iyamānā- vayavasya ca sthavīyasaḥ tairaiva krodīyomiḥ ( tryaṇukaiḥ ) :
ārambhasaṃbhavāt , amahato'pi ca guṇādeśākṣuṣmatvāt na mahimanuśālitā tadetuḥ |
tadekāryasamavāyasya vā tadetutve tryaṇukasya agrahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ syāt |
tadabhāvāt parasparapakṣobhayakāraṇatve vā tryaṇukasya ca guṇādeśca ekaikakāraṇaśālinoḥ acākṣuṣatā syāt |
parasparanapekṣa-kāraṇatve tu tṛtīyasyāpi prakārasya saṃbhavo durviraḥ |
bhavatu vā svabhāvaviśeṣa eva cākṣuṣatve hetvarekaḥ iti ( cākṣuṣatve ) na parimāṇato niyamopapattiḥ |
' ślokā. anumānaparicchede 183-186. paramāṇuṣu vyāpyavṛttiḥ saṃyogaḥ aṅgīkriyate |
tatta-deśāsya avacchedakatvasaṃbhavena avyāpyavṛttiyogasyāpi nānupapattiḥ iti tārkikāḥ |
tathā hyaṇukaṃ sāvayavatvārca sāvayavatvāt , ghaṭādivat iti |
nanu dvyaṇukamapi kāryadravyatvaṃ syāt , kāryadravyatvāt , ghaṭādivat , ato na nityarūpaparamāṇusiddhiḥ |
tarhi tadeva dravyaṃ kāraṇavat dṛṣṭamiti na dvyaṇukasya kāraṇatvamapi sidhyati |

tathāpi yadi kāryatvādeva kāraṇatvamanumīyeta, tarhi kāryatvādeva kāryadravyatvamapyanumīyetām , kaḥ pakṣapātahetuḥ ? naivam , dvyaṇukasyāpi kāryadravyatve tasyāpi kāryadravyatvaprasaṅgena anavasthā prasajyeta |
atha kacit kāryadravyatvaṃ nāśrīyeta, tarhi prathamasya tathā-bhāve kā pradeśaḥ ? iti sa eva paramāṇuḥ |
mapi ko doṣa iti cet , ayameva doṣaḥ, sarveṣāmava-yavināṃ svāvayavaparaṃparāyāḥ kacidapariniṣṭhitatvādanāva-yavaprasaṅgaḥ |

bhaviti cet tarhi sarpapamahīdharayorapi tulyaparimāṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ, avayavālpatvāvayavamahatvābhyāṃ hi sarvatrāvayavināṃ parimāṇatvaparamahatvevā, anantā-vayavatve tu sarpoṣo'pyanantāvayavaḥ; parvatato'pi tathaiveti tulyaparimāṇatvaparihāryameva, ato'navasthādoṣaprasaṅgena dvyaṇukasya na kāryadravyatvamapi śakyamānam |
naivam , anyataravyāptiparityāge prasakte kāryadravyatvāt-meva parityājyam , na tu kāraṇavattvamātranyāptiḥ, tasyā avaśyambhāvāt |

tathāhi, kāryaṃ kāraṇavaditi sāmānya-vyāptimīkṛtya tatkāraṇamapi kāryarūpameveti dvitīyānu-mānena sādhyate, ataḥ sāmānyānumānavirodhe tadupajīvaka-viśeṣānumānaṃ te parisājyaṃ syāt , na tumayoporapi parityāgaḥ |
bhavatu, dvyaṇukaṃ paramāṇuṃ cobhayamapi nāśrīyetām , ādyameva pratyakṣaṃ mahimaguṇātyevāvadhi-rbhaviṣyati, paramāṇusādhakānumānamapi siddhasādhanaṃ bhavatu |
tat kiṃ ādyapratyakṣaṃ sāvayava-manityam , uta niravayavaṃ nityam ? yadi sāvayava-manityam , tadā tasyāvayavatvena kāraṇatvena ca dravyā-ntarānumānaprasaṅgīkṛtaḥ paramāṇuḥ |
niravayavaṃ nityamityā-śrīyemāṇe uttarottarasāvayavanityakāryadravyasya kāraṇatvaṃ na syāt |

yadyata ghaṭādikāryadravyakāraṇaṃ piṇḍādi tattat-sāvayavamanityaṃ ca dṛṣṭam , niravayavasya cākāśāde-rdvyārambhakatvamapi na dṛṣṭaṃ ato niravayavanityenādyapratyakṣe-gottarottarakāryārambho na sidhyati |

atha satyapi tathā darśane uttarottarakāryadarśanabalāt nityamādyapratyakṣaṃ kāraṇamiti kalpyeta, tarhi paramāṇurpi nityo niravayava eva kāraṇaṃ bhavatu, dvyaṇukamapi nityadravyakāryaṃ bhavatviti tulyacarcam |

nanu asmākaṃ chedaviruddhanityavayavasya kāryadravyasamāśrayākāraṇatve kalpyamāne'pi ubhayasaṃpratipanne ādyapratyakṣe dharmamātrameva kalpanīyam , tatra tu dvyaṇuka-paramāṇurūpadharmakalpanāṃ kṛtvā tatra niravayavanityakāratva-dharmakalpanāmapi na tulyavat |
adṛṣṭasvarūpaṃ paramāṇvādikameva kalpyate, ataḥ klṛptahāniparihārāṇāklṛptakalpaneva nyāyyam , itarathā parvatadhūmasya kāraṇatvenādhikalpane lāghavamastītyanya-numānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha dhūmajātīyasyāśrite'nyasyāva-gatatvāt klṛptahāniprasaṅga iti cet , tarhiāpi dravyasya sāvayavānityatvasvabhāvasya klṛptatvāt tatparityāge klṛptahāniḥ samaiva |
ataḥ kāryadravyaṃ sama-vāyikāraṇavat ityetāvedānumānatvam , na mahatkāryadravyaṃ kāraṇavat , nāpi kriyāśrayārambhadhamiti |

kiñca kāryadravyaṃ kāraṇavaditi sāmānyāvyāptyupajīvanena ' mahatkāryadravyaṃ kāraṇavat ' , ' kāraṇamapi kāryadravyameva ' ityādi-niṣedhatvam , tathā ca sati mahatvadāvyatirekābhāvāt prayo-jakatvaṃ na saṃbhavati |
tathāhi, itarasāmagrīsaṃbhave'pi yasya vyatirekāt kāryotpādo dṛṣṭaḥ , tasyaiva dharmasya prayoja-katvam , atra tu kāryatve satyapi mahatvadādharmābhāvāt kāraṇatvatvābhāvaḥ |
kacidapi na dṛṣṭaḥ , ataḥ kāraṇaditye-tadeva prayojakam |

kiñca kāryadravyaṃ kāryadravyadharmātiīyaṃ vyāptirubhayopi vādinorvyabhicāriṇī, tava tu ādya-pratyakṣe uttarakāryārambhake vyabhicāraḥ , mama tu paramamahataḥ kāryāt tryaṇukat dvyaṇukasiddhiḥ , dvyaṇukakāryāt paramāṇusiddhiḥ |

nanu paramāṇusvarūpamevabhārambhāt , kimantargatā dvyaṇukakārambhameva ? naivam , mahataḥ kāryadravyasya alpaparimāṇakāryadravyāntaramyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti tadanusāreṇa dvyaṇukasya kāryadravyameva kāraṇamanumeyam , viśeṣyateḥ parityāgāyogyāt , paramāṇuśca nityā iti naistyaṇa-kārambhaḥ |
nanu anityāḥ paramāṇavaḥ mūrttatvāt , ghaṭā-divat , tathā sāvayavāḥ paramāṇavaḥ sarvadikkatvādvat , ghaṭādivat ityebhirniruktāḥ paramāṇuḥ kathaṃ sidhyati ? sidhyantyeva tairaiva hetubhiḥ |
eteṣāṃ hetūnāṃ pakṣadharmatvaṃ vinā hi na hetumiti eteṣāṃ pakṣavṛttā s sādhaka pramāṇaireva paramāṇo'pi siddhā bhavanti, anyathaitāṃ
tathāhi, tatra pakṣīkṛtāḥ paramāṇavaḥ siddhā asiddhā vā ? yadi siddhāḥ , tadā dharmigrāhakapramāṇatvāt bādhitaviṣayā hetavaḥ |
atha pratyakṣabādhanānmuktena hetavaḥ sādhyaṃ sādhayanti, tarhi pakṣa-bhūtaparamāṇudharmīkāreṇa cet prasaṅgaḥ , tathāpi dharmigrāhakabādha eva |
etadaprāpādanamapi nānumānalakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇam , kintu anumānasyaiva prayogabhedāmātram , sādhanadūpaṇa-lakṣaṇānyapi tānyaveti na vidhā'ntaraṃ prasaṅgāpādanamiti sarvamupapannam |
ayaṃ tu nityakāraṇavādaḥ brahmakāraṇatvapakṣe prakṛtikā raṇapakṣe ca tulyaḥ |
ataḥ paramāṇukāraṇavāde ye doṣāste sarveṣāmapi samānā ityupagamyate |
paramātmā ' tatsaviturvareṇyam ' iti savitṛma-dhiṣṭhānatvacchandavācyabrahmaparamātmāmidhāyinā gāyatryā utkṣipyamāṇena vāriṇā ijyate |
su. pṛ. 1010. paramātmā svecchayā paramātmyaṃ eva vyomādi janayati |
' indro māyābhiḥ ' ityādi śrutiṣu prapañcasya anityatvaṃ bodhayati, na mithyātvāditi iti cet |
maṇi. pṛ. 50. tathā vyomaśarīro'pi paramātmā śrutau śrutaḥ |
ityate vāriṇā nityaṃ yaḥ khaṃ brahmeti coditaḥ ||
vā. 31|17|13 pṛ. 702, ' śabdabrahmeti yaccedaṃ śāstraṃ vedākhyamucyate |
' 31|17|13 pṛ. 703. paramātmā eva vedān svārthapratipādane niyantuṃ vedākhyavedādhiṣṭhātṛ-tvena kṣetrajñavyapadeśatvāt nityajñānatvopapattiḥ |

su. pṛ. 1011, paramātmā : karmajanyaphalopabhogāya dehā-nadhiṣṭhāne'pi kāryakaraṇapratiniyamasiddhayai sarvasya jagataḥ cetanādhiṣṭhānakāraṇatvāt , paramātmano'pi ' kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata |
pṛ. 1008, paramātmanaḥ mahābhūtādhiṣṭhitasyaiva jñānecchādimattvam ' pañcadhātūn svayaṃ pañca dhādatte yugapat prabhuḥ |
apunarāvṛttyātmakaparamā- tmaprāptyavasthātvakatham 'sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāva- dāyuṣaṃ brahmalokambhi saṃpadyate na sa punarāvartate' iti, na tasyārthavādatvam|
paramāpūrva ajñātpūrve pradhānāpūrve samudāyāpūrve iti apūrvāvāntarabhedāḥ|
paramāpūrvaprayuktaṃ na bhavati agnīṣomīya- prāgbhāvavartipadārthadharmasya upāṃśutvam, kintu tatpadārtha- janyāvāntarapūrvaprayuktam|
acintyāśaktiḥparameśvaratatkartṛka- sṛṣṭipalayatvādikamapyasti iti vārtikakāraiḥ: vaidikaśiro- maṇibhiḥ prapañcitam|
ityādīni, tāni eka eva yajamāna: kuryāt, na sarve kuryu:|
'parārthānyakena kriyeran' iti nyāyasya parārthe ekasaṃskāre pravṛtti: iti mā bhūt |
api tarhi (kintu) svārthe yatra bhavati evaṃkaṣe cāhyārthe'pi karmaṇi |
tathā ca ekayaiva patnyā sidhyati nayanam |

vaijayantī. 'parārthe tvarya(rthā)sāmānyam' (9|2|14|43) iti (upakramya 'kriyeran vā' iti) vakṣyati, vinā- 'pi tādarthyena abhyuditebhyāṃ dadhipayaso: tadupakāramātra- darśanāt praṇītādharmaprāptimeveti |
'vi vā enaṃ prajayā paśubhirarthayati vardhayatyasya bhrātṛvyaṃ yasya havirnisaṃ purastāccandramā abhyudeti |

sa tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajet, ye madhyamāstānamaye dāne puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet, ye sviṣṭakṛttānandiāya pradāne dadhaścarum, ye sviṣṭakṛttānan viṣṇuṃ śipi- viṣṭāya śṛte carum' iti prajāpatyuktvā abhyudeyaidhirā- mnātā |
tatra śṛte dadhani ca praṇītādharmā: kartavyā na veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
parārthe caruṇā saha pradānārthe, śṛte dadhani ca praṇītādharmā na kartavyā: |
dadhistutayo: praṇītābhi: saha arthāsāmānyaṃ arthāsāmānyabhāvo yata: |
dadhistute tu na śrapaṇārthe kintu pradānārthe, tasmāt tayo: praṇītā- dharmā utpannadādyo na kartavyā iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
atra kaścit 'parārthena tvartha' iti tṛtīyāntaḥ pāṭha: |
kaścit 'parārthe na tvarthe' iti sasamanyata:, yathā ānandāśramīye sūtrapāṭhe |
ānandāśramīye eva tu 1|7|14 sūtrīye vārtike "'parārthe tvarthāsāmānyam' iti vakṣyati" iti mudritam |
caukhambāyāmudritāyāmetadeva vārtikam "'parārthe tvarthāsāmānyam' iti pūrvapakṣamupakramya vakṣyati iti upakramārthitakaraṇābhyupamena vyākhyeyam" iti anyena vibhūtam |
sūtre tuśabdasya vidyamānatvāt na- śabdasya pṛthagapekṣā nāsyeva |
atha 'arthāsāmānyam' iti sudhāsa: pāṭha eva svīkārya: |
tathā ca tat padaṃ bhāṣye 'nahi praṇītānāṃ dadhnaśca arthāsāmānyaṃ kiñcidasti' iti vivṛtam |
dadhistutyo: praṇītā- dharmā utpannadādya: kriyeran kartavyā: |
arthanivṛtte: arthasya caruśrapaṇasya nirvṛtte: niṣpannatvāt śrapaṇaniṣpatya- bhagamāt |
'śṛte caruṃ dadhan carum' ityuktvā jñāyate etat śṛte dadhani ca caro: śrapaṇamiti |
tasmāt parikrayeṇa ānataiḥ sarve padārthāḥ kartavyāḥ |
3|7|8|20 parikrayeṇa varadānasya ṛtvikarmatvaṃ yadi tāvat śāstrīyeṇa labhyate, tato'styeva yajamānasya kartṛkatvam |
atha na labhyate, tato laukika upāya iti |
bhā. 10|2|14|40-41, parikrayārthaṃ ca bhartrā bhṛtyena saha paṇitavyam |
yathā loke kāṣṭhavāhaprabhṛtibhyo yadīyate, tatra kāṣṭhavāhaḥ svāminā saha paṇate |
tebhyaḥ svāmī vibhajya nirdiśati idaṃ tumya- midaṃ
ke. paridhiḥ , paśunyāyena vivakṣitaikasattvatvāt eka eva saṃmārṣṭavyaḥ pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte tu sarve |
yatra ca paridhivicchideḥ (varuṇapraghāseṣu vihāradvaye ) tatra viśeṣaḥ |
vā. 211|212pṛ. 415. paridhiḥ yūpakārya saumikeṣu cāturmāsyeṣu 'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' iti vacanāt |
mā. 12|11|18. paridhiḥ 'svadhiṣṭha madhyamaḥ, aṇīyān drāghīyān dakṣiṇābhyaḥ , aṇiṣṭha hasiṣṭha uttarābhyaḥ' |
vistare tu 'madhyamaḥ svadhiṣṭhaḥ, dakṣiṇataḥ aṇīyān drāghīyān, uttarataḥ aṇiṣṭha hasiṣṭhaḥ |
atra ante madhyataḥ śabdaḥ ayukto bhāti |
na caivaṃ 'yūpāyajyamānāya' iti mantra ūhāpattiḥ, bhavante- 'pi samānatvāt |
paridhau yūpadhūpadharmamāṇāṃ viruddhānāṃ cātu- rmāsyeṣu pāśukeṣu anuṣṭhānam |
paridhau svadharmavirodhe yūpadharmā nānuṣṭheyāḥ pāśukeṣu cāturmāsyeṣu |
sa eva buddhisyo bhavati' iti buddhisyacamasādhikaraṇa- prasaṅgena caturdhākaraṇadhikaraṇasya saṃgatiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1072. ' yasya yo dharmaḥ prāyeṇa dṛṣṭaḥ, sa tasyādavya- māno'pi anumīyate ' |
yathā yaḥ parārthān prāyeṇa karoti, anyasmin parārthakaraṇe sa eva saṃbhāvyate |
bhā. 8|1|5|18, liṅgaṃ aviśiṣṭe'pi liṅgaviśeṣa- nirdeśo'nuvādabhūto bhavatyeva |
yathā śuklaḥ pumān, śuklā strī, śuklaṃ napuṃsakam |
śukla ekaḥ, śuklī dvau, śuklā bahava iti |
yadyapi śāstrādyā- nayane na vidhīyate śuklāmātrasaṃbandhamātraviśiṣṭā bhavati |
dābhyarvaṃ karaṇaṃ paravīrasi iti hotā kuryāt, atha haitaṃ vigrahaṃ kaḥ kuryāt ? 'itaramanyasteṣāṃ yato viśeṣaḥ syāt' anyo hoturupaśru eva syāt, yasyāvyāpṛtā, prādhānya- viśeṣo vā |

vā -- 'paravīrasi' 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' ityetayoḥ karaṇakriyamāṇānuvādinoḥ adhvaryuṇā hotrā ca yugapat prakṛtau prayuktayoḥ kuṇḍapāyanāmayane hautrādhvaryavayoḥ eka- kartṛkatvāddṛṣṭeḥ avaśyavadhye anyatarasmin, kattaraḥ pratigṛhyatāṃ iti sandehaḥ |
yadā hotuḥ siddhasvarūpasya ādhvaryavavidhānāt ajahatsvadharma- tayā hyavaḥ (mantraḥ) |
vahirhyo hi ārādupakāraka rūpa- tvāt kriyamāṇānuvādī, karaṇastu antaraṅga iti |
tau ca dvāvapi 'yūpāya parivīyamāṇānubrūhi' iti praiṣavaśāt etaduttarapāṭhācca praiṣaṇavahitoraśca ekākalīnī |
tatra ca 'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ' iti śrutam |
tasya ca satratvāt satre ca ānatiprayuktravaṇa- janyahotṛtvādhvaryutvāderanatyabhāvena abhāvāt 'yo hotā' ityatra hotṛdhrupadābhyāṃ tatkāryalakṣaṇayā kāryadve''pi ekakartṛkatvaṃ vidhīyate |
ataśca aupadeśikaikakartṛkatva- balena prākṛtaikakālakatvāccātra prathamataḥ karapamantraḥ paśvāderaḥ ityādyaḥ |

hotṛtvādeḥ avyavasāya- mātranimittakatvasya sthāpitatvāt satre'pi tatsaṃbandhena padadvaye karmalakṣaṇayā pramāṇābhāvāt jaghanya evādhvaryupade tallakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya ādhvaryupadāryānāṃ satre'hastvakārakatva

yadi hi sāmānyena idaṃ lakṣaṇam ( 'arthatvādekaṃ vākyam' ityādi ekavākyatā- lakṣaṇam ) kacididamapi kevalapadopadeśeyavada- mucyeta, tataḥ parisaṃkhyāvadena vaidikānāmidaṃ tāvat na bhavati ityetāvanmātraṃ gamyeta ( idaṃ pūrvapakṣe ) |
vā. 212|4|46 pṛ. 444, parisaṃkhyā vā na vyāvattyādineṣyate |
nirdoṣatvaṃ hi tatrāsyā vidhāne sati labhyate |
samānavākyapadapūrvabhāgā- vasthitaprātipadikaprāpti - sarvagrahaṇaṃmārgajñānapratyākhyānena tadadhīnātmalābhamapratayapratipādāyāḥ parisaṃkhyāyāḥ tridoṣa- tvamaparihāryam |
3|1|14 pṛ. 710. hṛdayādī- nāmeva avadānasaṃbandhitayā śrūyamāṇāṃ haviṣyena
tenāpi saha saṃbandhapramāṇābhāvāt prakaraṇe saṃbhinaśca anukalpanāt ( 1|2|24 ) prācīnaviśiṣṭapakṣācca arthavāda: iti siddhānta: |
( "samyak śruta: yathāditya: anu- vādyaśca viṣayo yathā: sā samyakśrutayathādityaviṣayā stuti: |
anya: uktāviparīta: viṣayo yasyā: sā stuti: |
samyakśrutayathādityaviṣaya: cāsau anyaviṣayā cāsau viśeṣobhayapada: karmadhāraya: |
yathā 'yathā pravīcī udīcī manuṣyāṇām ucitā, tathā prācī devānām' ityatra |

na ca guṇakāmāનાં vikṛtau apravṛttiḥ, vaṣaṭkārasya 'eṣa vai sasadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ yadvai anvāyattaḥ' itya- nāryārthatvacce sākṣādyodeśena vidhānāt parṇatā- nyāyābhāvena prakṛtivikṛtisādhāratvena upadiṣṭayā vikṛtāvipi īdṛśaguṇakāmaprāptyupapatteḥ |
parṇatāvākye anyabhicaritaliṅgopasthāpitakratu- lakṣaṇaṃ vidhau aṅgīkṛtya vākyaśeṣasya prāśastyalakṣaṇā'pi aṅgīkartavyā |
sā ca juhūḥ prakṛtāveva vihitā vikṛtiṣu sarvatrātidiśyate |
tatra juhvā tat kriyate juhūrvā tadyati naitacchabda āha |
dhruvaṃ pālāśyā juhvā tatkriyate, yatastasyāṃ satyāṃ tadvyati |
kāryakāraṇasaṃbandho nāma sa bhavati, yasminsati yadvati yasminsatyā yatra bhavati tatraiva kāryakāraṇasaṃbandhaḥ |
iha tu tadbhāve bhāvo jñātaḥ, nāmādeśābhāvaḥ |
yasya pālāśau na bhavati tasyāpaśloka-śravaṇaṃ nāstīti naivaṃjātīyakaḥ śabdo'sti |
tena na niyogato'vagamyate, tenedaṃ kriyate iti |
api ca, yasyāpi juhvaḥ pālāśau bhavati tasyāpi pāpaślokaśravaṇaṃ bhavati |
nanu evaṃ satyamihopeṇā phalaṃ na sādhyate |
na hi tatrocyate tāvataiva phalaṃ bhavatīti |
‘paryagnikṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛjati’ ityatra paryagni- karaṇāntatvasya guṇasya vidhiḥ |
aśvamedhe ‘īśānāya parasvata ālameta’ iti prakṛtya ‘paryagnikṛtānānyānutsṛjanti’ iti śrūyate |
ayaṃ āraṇyānāmālabdhavyaḥ utsargā eva, uta paryagnikaraṇāntaiḥ saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛta utsraṣṭavyāḥ iti karmaśeṣapratiṣedhaḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
paryagnikṛtānāṃ āraṇyānāṃ utsargaṃ śrute ālambhasya tādarthyaṃ tadarthaṃ vahniḥ sāraṇarūpo- tadarthatvaṃ pratyetavyam |
yathā abhicyane ‘etat khalu sākṣādannaṃ ya eṣa carurye enamupadadhāti’ iti upadhānārtha eva caruḥ upādīyate |
evamatrāpi utsargārtha eva ālambhaḥ kartavya iti |
utsargārtha ālambho vidhīyate iti pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttyartho vāśabdaḥ |
utsargārthe ālambha arthābhāvaḥ ālambha- vākyasya niṣprayojanatvaṃ syāt |
ihāntā ātithyā saṃtiṣṭhate’ iti iḍottarāṇāmaṅgānāṃ prati- ṣedhastadvat |

yathā aśvamedhe ‘īśānāya parasvata ālameta’ iti prakṛtya ‘paryagnikṛtānānyānutsṛjanti’ iti śrutam, tathā aikādaśinyāṃ ‘tvāṣṭraṃ patnīvatamālabhate’ iti prakṛtya ‘paryagnikṛtaṃ patnīvatamutsṛjati ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati’ iti śrūyate |
tatra apravṛtte aprastute yāge ‘śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati’ ityatra ‘saṃsthāpayati’ iti, ‘śeṣam’ iti ca śabdaḥ nopapadyate |

prakṛte īśānavākyaṃ yadi yāgavidhiḥ paryagnikathaṃ ca paryagnikaraṇa- duttarāṅgapratiṣedhakaṃ syāt tadaiva tulyaśrutitvāt pālī- vatavākyaṃ taduttaraparyagnikaraṇaṃ pāḥ nītavākyasya paryagnikaraṇo- ttarāṅgabhāvāt ‘ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati’ iti karmā- ntaravidhānaṃ ca upapadyate |
evaṃ ca īśānavākyaṃ yāga- vidhiḥ paryagnikaraṇavākyaṃ ca karmaśeṣapratiṣedhārtha iti siddham |
pravṛtterjñahetutvāt pratiṣedhe saṃskārāṇāmakarma syāt tatkāritatvāt yathā prayājapratiṣedhe'grahaṇa- mājyāsya |
ālambha utsargārtha eveti pūrvapakṣe doṣamāha siddhāntī |
yadi paśudravyasya utsarga eva vidhīyeta tataḥ saṃskārāṇāṃ upakaraṇādīnāmapi akarma syāt pravṛtteḥ saṃskārapravṛtterjñahetutvāt |
yāgapratiṣedhe yāgābhāve kimiti saṃskārāḥ kriyeran, teṣāṃ tatkāritatvāt yajñakāritatvāt |
pratiṣedhe saṃskārāṇāṃ pravṛtterjñahetutvāt tatkāritatvāt saṃskārāṇāmakarma syāt |
yathā upasatsu ‘aprayājāstā anuyajāḥ’ iti prayājapratiṣedhe prayājā- rthasya ājyasya agrahaṇaṃ grahaṇaṃ na kriyate, tathā yāgā- bhāve yāgārthāḥ saṃskārā api kriyeran |
tasmāt īśānavākye yāgavidhiraiva svīkartavyaḥ, saṃskārāśca kartavyāḥ |
‘paryagnikṛtānānyānutsṛjanti’ ityatra yadi yāgasya akarma syāt, tadā sarvahānaṃ sarvasya saṃskārādi- kriyāmātrasya hānaṃ tyāt |
tasmāt avacchedāt paryagnikaraṇottaraṅgāmātrasya vyavacche- dāt vihitadevatoddeśena dravyatyāgarūpasya yāgasya paryagni- karaṇāntasya ca saṃskārakāṇḍasya kriyā anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt |
) ityatra paryagnikṛtanuyādena utsargavidhiḥ utsargāṃnuvādena vā paryagnikṛtavidhiḥ iti cintyiṣyate |
paryagnikṛtānāmutsarge prājāpatyānāṃ karmo- tsargeḥ, śrutisāmānyādāraṇyavat, tasmād brahma- sāmni codanāpṛthaktvaṃ syāt |
vājapeye prājāpatyān paśūn prakṛtya śrūyate- ‘tān paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti, brahmasāmni ālabhante’ iti |
atra paryagnikṛtānāṃ prājāpatyānāṃ prajāpatidevatānāṃ paśūnāṃ utsargaṃ śrayamāṇe karmotsargaḥ karmaṇa eva utsargaḥ pratyetavyaḥ |
āraṇyavat śrutisāmānyāt, aśvamedhe yathā ‘paryagnikṛtānānyānutsṛjanti’ iti śrutiḥ tasmānnaiva prakṛtā vājapeyatā śrutiḥ |
evaṃ śrutisāmānyāt āraṇya- vat prājāpatyānāmapi karmotsargaḥ |
yasmāt pūrvaṃ karmotsargaḥ tasmāt brahmasāmni brāhmaṇācchaṃsisāmakāle codanāpṛthaktvaṃ karmāntarasya codanā syāt |
pūrvaṃ saptadaśa paśavaḥ utsraṣṭavyāḥ : brāhmaṇācchaṃsisāmakāle ca apare saptadaśa paśavaḥ ālabdhavyāḥ |
nāyaṃ karmaśeṣapratiṣedhaḥ kintu saṃskāra- pratiṣedhaḥ prāptāvasarāṇāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ tadānīṃ
bāla. pṛ. 99. paryudāsa: jyotiṣṭome puruṣārthadānapākahomānāṃ dīkṣitakartṛkatvena |
pratiṣedhe sati śāstrasya bhrānti: kalpanīyā, vikalpapatte: |
pratiṣedhā- dakriyāyāṃ ko'pyupakāro bhavatīti, vidhau kriyāyām |
sāmarthyaṃ ca yadi liṅgasaṃkhayā- dikaṃ nāpekṣate rājaśabda: tata: syāt |
tasmālliṅgasaṃkhyāviyukta: śrūyamāṇa: samāse avayavārtho gamyate, pratīte: tulyatvāt |
bhā. 10|8|1| 1-4, paryudāsa: 'na hotārṃ vṛṇīte' iti mahāpitṛyajñe |
ke. paryudāso nānāvidha: mīmāṃsābhāṣyaprakāśe sūkṣmatayā vivecita: |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|3. na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayatītyatra iti mama tu paryudāsa eva |
upaśleṣalakṣaṇayā śrutyā bhakṣayate: kartavyatāṃ tayo vidadhāti |
nakāraśca karmalyavahitatvāt na kartavya- tāvacanena saṃbadhyate |
tasmāt prayucya: anena saṃbadhyamāna: paryudāso bhavati |
subantayo: samāse sati paryudāso bhavati, nāsamāse |
ṭup. 6|1|5|19. 'na kesariṇe dadāti' iti nāyaṃ pratiṣedha: kintu paryudāsa: |
tatastena (paryudāsa-) nyāyena aśva- paryudāse sati aśvavyatiriktaṃ sarvasvaṃ deyamiti vidhi- niṣedhayo: ekavākyatālābhāt nāsti aśvasya pākṣikamapi dānam |
vi. 6|1|3. napūpadasamabhivyāhṛtadhāto: sviviruddhārthe lakṣaṇā yatra vākye, sa paryudāsa: |
vākyārtha. pṛ. 20. śrutyantarastho viśeṣa: śrutyantare anāśritaścet vikalpa: sarvatra syāt, ma
tatra vikalpaḥ (eva siddhāntatvena) abhyupagataḥ (durbalā'pi prāptiḥ tadgīnātmatvamena pratiṣedhena tulyabaleti |
nanu tatra ānarthakyāt pāṭhasya yukto mantrāṅgīkāraḥ |
ata āha - nānarthakyena (pramāṇena tatra ṛcaḥ aṅgīkāraḥ |
kutaḥ ?) ānarthakyaṃ hi parityāge kāraṇaṃ nopādāne |

tathā loke'rthaprāpte yatra pratiṣedho bhavati 'na viṣaṃ bhakṣayitavyam, na sarpāyāṅgulīdeyā, na kaṇṭakaḥ pādenādhidheyaḥ' iti, akriyaiva tasyārthasya bhavati, na vikalpaḥ ! tena manyāmahai vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ pratiṣedho balīyāniti |
yena ca nāma prāpte yujyate tattasya bādhakaṃ bhavati |
tulyo hi heturiha prāpteḥ pratiṣedhasya ca |
prāptirapi pratiṣedhe prāpte, pratiṣedho'pi prāptau prāptāyām |
na tu śabdalakṣaṇe guṇadoṣau śakyete avagantum |
apitu vākyaśeṣaḥ syādanyāyatvād vikalpasya vidhīnāmekadeśaḥ syāt |
kathaṃ tarhi ? nānuyājeṣviti naśabdo'nuyājaśabdena saha saṃbadhyate, na karotinā |
nānuyājeṣvityetāvataiva vākyam, tat sākāṅkṣaṃ pūrvavākyadeśena saṃbhatsyate |
yāvaduktaṃ syāt anuyājavarjiteṣu yajatiṣu yejyāmahaṃ karotīti |
tasmādvidhiva paryudastānuyājakaḥ, nāsti pratiṣedha iti na vikalpo bhaviṣyati |
yatra prakṛtivat kartavyaṃ tat varaṇaṃ varjayediti |
kimarthaṃ punaranuyājeṣujyāmahatvena ca naśabdaḥ saṃbadhyate iti ucyate |
yathevamavagamyate, na śakyaḥ sa vinā yejyāmāhena yajatiriti nirvartayitum |
yatrānyataradānarthakyamāpadyate, kalpetāpi tatra vikalpaḥ, yatra na kena cidapi prakāreṇārthavattā saṃbhavati |
nityo hyasya naśabdaḥ subantasaṃbandhena samāsa iti vārtikakāro bhagavān kātyāyano manyate sma |
sa hi, 'vibhāṣā' iti prakṛtya idaṃ samāsamuktavān |
athavā yejyāmahaḥ sāmānyena prāpyamāṇa evānuyājavākyena viśeṣyate (anuyājavarjaṃ yejyāmahaṃ karotīti) |
yadi samāsallakṣaṇamevā''śrīyeta, rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ iti aprayogaḥ syāt |
tasmāt rājñaḥ puruṣa ityapi sādhu, rājapuruṣa ityapi, ubhayoranubhavāt |
yatrānugamo nāsti tatrāsādhuḥ prayogaḥ, yathā gāvīti |
samāse tu na jñāyate ki dvayoḥ puṃsorata bahunā-muta striyā uta napuṃsakasyeti |
atra rājapuruṣa iti liṅgasaṃkhyā-vimukte vākye nityaṃ samāsa eva sādhuḥ |
sāmarthye ca yadi liṅgasaṃkhyādikaṃ nāpekṣate, rājaśabdavataḥ syāt |
' soma-- evamaspaṣṭo'rthalopapratyāmnānanibandhana-bādhyayoḥ nirūpaṇānantaraṃ atispaṣṭasya pratiṣedhanivandhana-bādhyasya asmin pāde prādhānyena nirūpaṇamiti pādā-ntaratvamānantaryaṃ ca |
sūtrārthastu- pradeśe codakena āryevaraṇātideśe yejyāmahasya anārabhyavidhāne ca sati 'nārbheyam', 'nānuyājeṣu' iti nañ pratiṣedhārthakaḥ |
ci-- 'na nārbheyaṃ na ca hotānaṃ nānuyājeṣvitīdaśe |
' bhāṭṭa-- tadevamarthalepāt pratyāmnānācca bādho nirūpitaḥ, pratiṣedhādīni nirūpyante |
mahāpitṛyajñe'ti-deśaprāptasya hotṛvaraṇasya pratiṣedhaḥ śrutaḥ 'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' iti |

tayā anārabhyādhītasya 'āśrāvayeti caturakṣaram, astu śrauṣaḍiti caturakṣaram, yajeti dvayakṣaram, yejyāmahaṃ iti pañcākṣaram, dvākṣaro vaṣaṭkāraḥ; eṣa vai samadaśaḥ prajāpatiyajñe'nvāyāta:' iti yajamātro-deśena vihitasya yejyāmahasya 'nānuyājeṣu yejyāmahaṃ karoti' iti pratiṣedhaḥ śrutaḥ |

tato'yaṃ kiṃ nityaṃ hotṛ-varaṇādyātmakatvaṃ utkatveti cintāyām, na tāvadayaṃ 'hotṛvaraṇavyatiriktaṃ ca yajeṣu yejyāmahaṃ kartavyaḥ' ityevaṃvidhaḥ paryudāsaḥ, anyāyābhāvāccino naḥ pradhānabhūtabhāvanā-nyasaṃbhave anyonyābhāvatvamaṅgīkṛtya guṇabhūtatvāt-ryāntyādīkāre prāmāṇābhāvāt |
tasya ca prāptisāpekṣatvāt, prāpteśca prakṛte śāstrīyatvāt, śāstraprāptasya cālyantaṃ bādhogātāgatyā grahaṇāgrahaṇavadvikalpaḥ |
sā ca prāptiḥ kaścidāgataḥ , pratiyogiprāptyai tat , yeyajāmahādirūpasya pratiyogino |
āghā ' na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet ' anuyājādiṣu prasiddhabhāve'pi yāgāntareṣu prasiddhatvāt |
sā ca pramāṇarūpaiveti yukto naṣṭayogini pratiyogiprasiddhirabhāvabodhe kāraṇam , hṛde |
saṃbhave'pi niṣedhaśāstrasya prathamālocane viśeṣa- mityapāstam , niṣedhādhikāre pratiyogimuddirayānu- |
darśanasattvena sāmānyaśāstrato bhramānupapatteḥ , vastuta- yogivṛttinnidharyeya vidheyatvāt |
na ca yasya sāmānyaśāstramātrālocane vaiyarthyāpatteḥ tatparihārārthaṃ prāptipakṣalamiti vācyam |
bhramātmakasādhanatājñānādanyājeṣu yeyajāmahādikṛtattvā, niṣedhābhāve sāmānyaśāstreṇa bhāgyā āhāvanīyaśāstreṇeva |
tatpuruṣīyakṛtatvena prasiddhayāḥ anuyājādhikaraṇakayeyajā- padahome āhāvanīyasya anuyājādiṣu yeyajāmahādau |
etadātmani tatpuruṣīyakṛtyabhāvasya tātparyagrāhakaṃ sat tasya tadatiriktaviṣayatāṃ kalpayati , |
svataḥsiddhatvena tadaṃśe vidhivaiyarthyāt , puruṣāntarīya- evaṃ niṣedhaśāstramapi sāmānyaśāstrasya tadatiriktaviṣayatve |
amāve tatprayojyatvaṃ hi nivāraṇānumeyāniṣedhatā- locane'pi padaśāstraṃ padavidhāyakatvavat niṣedhaśāstrasya |
sā ca niṣedhasya bhāvanā rūpātyārthātyeva pratiyogitātatsaṃgatena narjayabhāva- |
ato'vaśyaṃ niṣedhaśāstrasya prathamālocane'pi tadapekṣata- naivāsya tatprāptisāpekṣatvāt |
śāstrapramitayā : pratiyogitāmaṅgīkṛtya niṣedhaśāstrārthā- na yeyajāmahamātratve pratiyogilaṃ naḥ pradhānabhūtāyā- |
vadhāraṇaṃ ityaṅgīkartavyam , ataśca sāmānyaśāstrapramita- tārthātyasaṃbhave guṇabhūtatadanyasyānvāt |
tadā hi yatra ' hṛde vahnirmāsti ' ' nāntarikṣe na divi ' ityādi |
bhāve yeyajāmahābhāve'pi itarāṃśe : sādaguṇajanakatattvā- tatra niruktakṛtaireva pratiyogitvāt taduddeśyanaivābhāvamātra- |
niṣedhe tu rāgeṇa kalañjabhakṣaṇādau iṣṭasādhanatvāvagāmena rthamāpi prāptisāpekṣā , niṣedhasya tadatiriktatvena śabda- |
tanmātrasaṃkocārthādupasaṃhārāt tadanyasaṃkocārthasya paryu- deraniṣṭasādhanatvenāpi nityaṃ tallakṣaṇe aniṣṭāpattirnityaṃ |
na caivaṃ paryudāse- ca aniṣṭadveṣāt tannivṛttiriti vaiṣamyam |
'pi paryudāsanīyaprāptisāpekṣatvāt vikalpapattiḥ , tasyāḥ varaṇayeyajāmahādīnāṃ mahāpitṛyajñādiṣu na nityaṃ bādhaḥ |
nahi tadyati- iti prāpte , yata eva pratiṣedhapakṣe vikalpo'ṣṭadoṣaduṣṭaḥ , |
na ca ' na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte ' ityatra paryudāsopapattāvapi ākhyātātiriktatvānnityatvam ' na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte ' ityatra |
' nānyājeṣu ' ityatra subantasaṃbandhā- hotṛvaraṇavyatiriktatvarūpa nañarthasya ākhyātātyeva |
na ca tatrāpi ' na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte ' ityatra |
hi vaiyākaraṇarītyā samāsasya viśiṣṭārthe śaktiḥ , vākyasya nañaḥ anyānyatvasya tatpatye'pi amāvapratiyogibhūtasya |
ca pratyekaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyarūpavākyatvārthe , tadā bhinnārtha- varaṇasya kṛtisādhyatvābhāvena bhāvanānvayānanupapatteḥ |
katvena samāsavidhivinā vākyasya sādhutvānivāraṇāt eva na tasya viśeṣatvamapi , dhātvarthasya nañarthe anvayā- |
' vāvacanamanarthakaṃ svabhāvasiddhatvāt ' iti kātyāyana- lakṣaṇayā varaṇavyatiriktapadārthajātasyaiva bodhanāttattvā- |
vastutastu ubhayorapi naña ' iti prasiddhe'nyonyābhāvavatyapi śaktiḥ |
samāsavākyayoḥ viśiṣṭārthatvamakatvasya tulyatvāt samāsa- dhātvarthasya tatrānvayāvyutpatterlakṣaṇayā āvaśyakteya |
vidhinā vākyasyāsādhutvaprasaktau vikalpavidhāyakaṃ vibhāṣā- vikalpyāpekṣayā na doṣaḥ |
sūtraṃ pāṇineḥ sārthakemeti kātyāyanavacanameva nyāya- tatra ca yadyapi nañyeyajāmahapadārthyā yeyajāmahavyati- |
ata eva vibhāṣāsūtraṃ prācīnānāṃ riktājñātasya lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya anuyājodeśena tadvidhi- |
svarūpam - ' durbalo'pi vidhiḥ tadadhīnātmatvamena prati- avyavahinatvāt , tadviśeṣasya yāgāntasya sāmānyavidhi- |
paryudāsavidhiḥ : kṛtyaryaḥ ' yajatiṣu ye yajāmahaṃ vyatiriktatvenānuyājabhinnatvena ca yathākramaṃ vidheyatā |
bāla. pṛ. 90. udeyatvāt , na tu prajāpatyādinā , tadpraveśe gauravāt , |
paryudāsavidhiḥ : haṣṭārtho yathā ' yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ tasya sāmānyaśāstraikavākyatayaiva lābhāt |
karoti , nānyājeṣu ' atra vidheyeyeyajāmahau nātra padaikavākyatā |
pṛ. 21. paryudāsavidhiḥ : karoti ' ityādi vat vākyaikavākyatveva |

parvaṇi nācyeyam, adhyayanadharmā'yaṃ na prayoga- dharmaḥ, tena parvaṇi anyadhyāye'pi karmaṇi paṭhanīyā eva |

atrodaraṇe 'vācā tvā hotā0' ityādiḥ agnihotrodaramantro nāsti |

bhāvavyutpattyā kriyāparaḥ, priyate dīyate asmin ityadhi- karaṇavyutpattyā tu kālamācaṣṭe |
vi. 9|2|188, parva- śabdaḥ 'suveṇa parvaṇī juhoti' ityatra āgneyāditrika- saṃchaparaḥ |
saṃdhikālasyālpatvena sāṅgatyayogabhāvanāparyāptatvābhāvena tatparyāptaye samaṃ syāditi nyāyena tatpūrvaparabhāgayoḥ samayorākṣepāt |
'saṃdhimabhito yajeta' iti śruteśca yadaiva saṃdhiraparāhne rātrau vā patati tataḥ pūrvaṃ ghaṭikādvayamārabhya tatpaścād ghaṭikādvaye iṣṭi samāpayet |
'pūrvedyurāgnī gṛhṇāti uttaramahardevatā yajate' iti vacanena prayogya graha- kālatvāvagamāt |

'pūrvīṃ paurṇamāsīmupasadediti paiyya- mutarāmupasadediti kauṣītakaṃ yāṃ paryastamayamutsarpan' iti kauṣītakibrāhmaṇe (3|1) sūryāstamayaṃ paritaḥ ityanenāvartanātparato rātrau yadi saṃdhiḥ sopavāsāho- carā paurṇamāsī tasyāmanvādhānamityuktā tataḥ paredyuryāgaḥ ityuktaṃ bhavati |
āvartane tataḥ pūrvaṃ vā yadi saṃdhiḥ sottarā'pi nopavāsāhā, kintu pūrvaityuktā saṃdhidhana eva ityapi vyatiṣṭhate |
tena saṃdhimabhitaḥ ityasya vidu- duṣṭimadhye yathā saṃdhiḥ pattā tathā tantraṃ prākamedityarthaḥ |
āvartane yadā saṃdhiḥ parvapratipadobhedādīni pratipadya- praviśyāṃ yadi ceṣṭiḥ samāpyate ityādīni ca gobhila. gārgyādivacanāni etamevārthaṃ vivṛṇvanti |
yathā 'abhityakāyā- miva dhānumayāṃ lodrumaṃ sānumataḥ praphullam' iti raghuvaṃśe |

yadi hi vivakṣitaṃ bhavet na ‘ekām’ iti brūyāt, gāṃ ityekavacanasya vivakṣitatvāt |
tathā ‘avī dve’ ‘dhenū dve’ ityatrāpi ‘dve’ iti vacanaṃ jñāpakam |
‘śrīn lalāmān’ ityatrāpi ‘śrīn’ iti vacanaṃ liṅgam ‘lalāmān’ iti bahutvacanamavivakṣitamiti |
bhāṣyam- evaṃ cet paśyasi, avivakṣitā saṃkhyāyeti |
yathā ‘paśumānāya’ ityukte eka evānīyate, ‘paśū’ iti dvau, ‘paśūn’ iti bahavaḥ ānīyante |
tasmāt yajñasya aṅgabhūtaḥ saṃkhyā iti śabdāt gamyate |
na ca śabdāt gamyamānaṃ ṛte kāraṇāt avivakṣitaṃ bhavati |
satyaṃ pratīyate, na tu ayaṃ śabdārthaḥ |
śabdavatpūlabhyate tadāgame hi tad dṛśyate tasya jñānaṃ yathā'nyeṣāṃ |
naitadasti, na yaśe saṃkhyā śabdena śrūyate iti |
yasya cāgame yadupajāyate sa tasyārtha iti gamyate |
tena jñāyate, aśva- śabdasya aśvo'rthaḥ; gośabdasya gauriti |
prātipadikārtho hi ākhyātavācyena saṃbadhyate vibhaktya- rtho'pi |
paśau hi saṃkhyāyāṃ vidhīyamānāyāṃ eka ākhyātaśabdo na śaknuyāt ākhyātārthe vidhātuṃ saṃkhyāsaṃbandhaṃ ca |
ṭup-- vibhaktirhi liṅgasaṃkhyāprātipadikānāṃ ( trayāṇāmapi ) śrutyaiva kriyārthatāmāha |
kriyā sādhyā, sādhanaṃ tatparicchedakāni ca liṅgasaṃkhyādīni apekṣate ( kriyāmapi sarvāṇi kārakāṇi apekṣante ) ataḥ sarva- viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭā kriyāaiva vidhīyate |
tatra ( vidhi- ) pratyayaḥ pūrve viśeṣaṇe vyāpriyate anyathā''nupapattyā ( kathamanupapattistadāha-- ) nahi agrahītaviśeṣaṇā viśiṣṭa- buddhiḥ iti |
( astu nāma vākyena kriyārthatvam, tathāpi na doṣaḥ śrutivākyayorivirodhādyāha-- ) paśveka- tvayoḥ upaśleṣalakṣaṇayā ( upapadalakṣaṇayā ) śrutyā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāva evāvagamyate, na tu tādarthyam |
bhāṣyam-- kimiti ? ( kiṃ liṅgam ? ) 'karṇā yāmyāḥ, avalitā raudrāḥ, namo rūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ, teṣāmaindrāgno daśamaḥ' iti ( karṇāḥ chinnakarṇāḥ |
namo rūpā nīlavarṇāḥ parjanyadevatākā iti śabdārthaḥ |
) yadi tritvaṃ vivakṣitam, tadā aindrāgno daśamo bhavati |
tathā 'kṛṣṇā bhaumāḥ, dhūmā āntarikṣāḥ, bṛhanto divyāḥ, śabalā vaidyutāḥ, siddhāstārakāḥ' iti prakṛtyāha 'ardhamāsānāṃ vaitadrūpam, yat pañcadaśinaḥ' iti |
itarathā godakṣiṇasaṃbandho vihito gamyate' ( iti parihārabhāṣyamanubhāṣya vyācaṣṭe-- ) 'gāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt' iti tāvat śrūyeta, ( tataḥ ) aśvādīnāṃ parisaṃkhyā syāt |
( codayati-- ) saṃkhyaiva vidhīyate, na tu gauḥ; iti cet, tatra ( saṃkhyāvidhāne hi sati go- saṃkhyayoḥ saṃbandho vidhātavyaḥ |
tadvidhāne ca kriyāmananu- praveśaḥ, tatra atyantaṃ vākyaṃ syāt ( nātra śrutileśaḥ kaścidityarthaḥ ) |
tasmāt 'yat dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt, tat gām' itīdaṃ vacanavyatikarṣāt śrutyanugrahāya |
( codaka āha-- ) etadapi ( samādhānam ) yadā tadā ( na yuktamityarthaḥ |
) kasmāt ? kriyāyāmeva saṃkhyā na vidhīyate, yena gosaṃkhyayoḥ saṃbandho vidhātavyaḥ ( syāt |
saṃkhyā hi vidhīyamānā saṃkhyaiya- dvāreṇa ( kriyāyāḥ ) sādhanaṃ bhavati |
tatra bahūni saṃkhyayāni, sā na jñāyate kasya paricchedaketi |
( codaka āha-- ) aśvādīnāmutpattau ( dakṣiṇatvivācye ekatva- ) saṃkhyā vidyate ( ataḥ paunaruktyāt ) tatra na niveśyate |
( ekadeśī āha-- ) gavāmapi dvādaśaśataṃ vidyate ( atastatra tadvirodhārthaṃ niveśyate |
codaka āha ) codakena cet ( codakena gavāṃ dvādaśaśataprāptiḥ, naimittika- sya nityavicāratvāt aupadeśikena ekatvena pratyā- mnāyate iti cet ityarthaḥ |
ekadeśī āha-- ) itarathāpi ( aśvādīnām ) codakenaiva ( ekatvaprāptiḥ |
codakaḥ-- ) svāmiprāyaṃ sphorayati-- ) teṣām ( aśvādīnām ) ekatvayuktānām ( codakādeva prāpteḥ ) anarthikā ( aupa- deśikī ekatvasaṃkhyā ) iti cet |
( aupadeśikī saṃkhyā ) pratyakṣatvāt śīghram ( anyasyāmaprātāyāṃ ) prāpyati ( iti nānarthakā |
( iha- mekadeśisamādhānāt nātīva hṛdayaṅgamamiti anyathā samā- dhatte-- ) athavā ( yadi ) gauraiva kevalā ( dakṣiṇāyāṃ ) prāpnoti, tadā govidhānamayuktam ( syāt ānarthakyāt |
na letadasti ) prāpnuvanti hi anyānyapi ( aśvādi- dravyāṇi ) |
tasmāt nāstīdam 'gaunaṃ vidhīyate, saṃkhyaiva vidhīyate' iti |
anyeṣām ( aśvādīnām ) tanni- vṛttyarthamāha 'ekāṃ gām' iti |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ ca kṛtvā samānaśrutikaṃ liṅgam vivakṣitaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tatredaṃ darśanamupapadyate 'vasante prātarāgneyī kṛṣṇagrīvāmālabhete, grīṣme mādhyaṃdine siṃdhī- maindrīm, śaradyaparāhṇe śvetāṃ vārhaspatyām' iti |
tathā 'aśvaḥ ṛṣabho vṛṣṇiraśvaḥ puruṣaḥ' iti, 'te prājāpatyāḥ' iti |
śā-- upādeyabhūtapadārthavibhaktimahitetvatvā- dikā saṃkhyā kriyāṅgaṃ avivakṣitā, uta yathāṅgaṃ vivakṣitā iti saṃśayaḥ |
kriyāyai nīyate saṃkhyā na padavvaṃ padādvevet |
soma-- yathā 'spyena uddanti' ityādiśrutyā uddana- nādyarthānāṃ yathāyudhavākyena na yajñārthatvam, tathā atrāpi paśutvathā paśvarthasya ekatvasya na yajñārthatvamiti pratyava- sthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
nāstyasti vā, saScaḥ svapade śrutyā paśvekatāgateḥ |
yogaḥ kratau paśau ceti krame yāgāṅgatocitā |

bhāṭṭa-- 'paśunā yajeta' ityādau yatra upādeya- paśvādigatā saṃkhyā vibhaktyupāttā, sā kiṃ vivakṣitā na veti cintāyām 'sattvapradhānāni nāmāni' iti smṛtyā prātipadikārthapadeḥ vibhaktyupāttasaṃkhyāviśeṣava- rūpatasamākhyayā vibhaktyupāttasaṃkhyayāḥ prātipadikārtha prati paśvetyatā yogyatārūpaliṅgena ca viśeṣaṇatvāvagamāt vākyīyakriyānvayānanupapatteḥ tadbhāve'pi kriyāyā avai- guṇyāt na vivakṣitā saṃkhyā |
na ca ekatvādeḥ paśva- nye'pi tadviśeṣaṇatvena paśoḥ kārakānvayadvārā kriyā- saṃbandhāt lohitoṣṇīṣādivat paśuviśeṣasyāpi vivakṣo- papattiḥ |
saṃkhyākaratvayoḥ vibhaktyā yugapadupādānena saṃkhyāyāḥ prathamataḥ paśvanvayamidhāya paścāt viśiṣṭasya paśoḥ kārakānvayābhidhāne viramyavyāpārāpatteḥ |

na ca tavayā'pi saṃkhyāyāḥ padaśrutyādyavagāhīkārāta yuga- padanyadvayādvovasya viruddhatvāt prathamataḥ śuddhasya paśoḥ kārakānvayameḍīkṛtya paścāt saṃkhyāyāḥ paśvanvayā- ṅgīkāre tavāpi viramyavyāpārāpattiḥ |
tathāpi bhāvanā'nvitakārakaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatva asammata- padasthale bhāvanā'nyavyutpatyabhāvena avivakṣopapatteḥ |
itarathā āruṇyasyāpi ānuśāsanikamatvalakṣaṇayā ekahāyanī pratyeva viśeṣaṇatvopapattau prathamataḥ kriyā'nvaya- mī. ko. 313
atra ca lauhityādeḥ bhāvanā'nvitakārakaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣa- ṇatve'pi samastapadatvāt na kṣatiḥ |
vāravantīyadāsye kvacāśabdoktabhāvanāyāmeva anvaya iti na kā cit kṣatiḥ |
ata eva somaprayādīnāmepi na prāthamiko dhātvarthānvayaḥ |
kiñca na pratyayārthasya ekatvasya prakṛtyarthaṃ paśuṃ prati prakāratā, pratyayārthaprādhānyabhaṅgāpatteḥ |
apitu paśoriva karaṇatvaṃ pratīca ekatvaṃ pratyapi prakāratā |
ataśca ekatvasya karaṇatvat vidheyabhāvanāyā- maprakāratvāt avivakṣā |
iti prāpte, paśoḥ karaṇatve evānvayo na tu ekatve'pi, pramāṇābhāvāt |

ataśca paśoḥ taddvārā bhāvanā'nvayatvaṃ saṃkhyāyā api balīyasyā samānābhidhānaśrutyā ādheyatvena sāmānādhikaraṇyena vā prayamataḥ kārakanvasyaiva aṅgīkārāta, paścācca paśutvā- dinā ādheyatvasaṃbandhena

syāt so'māvāsyāmiṣṭvā vatsānapākuryāt ' ... ' ye madhyamāḥ syustānasya dātre puroḍāśamaṣṭakapālaṃ kuryāt, ye tviṣṭhāstānindrāya pradāne darśane carum, ye'gniṣṭhā- stān viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śṛte carum ' iti|
asmin apūrva karmaṇi dadhipayasoḥ praṇītādharmā eva kāryāḥ, na tu vatsāpākaraṇadayaḥ pradeyadharmāḥ |
tathā 'maitraṃ śvetamālabheta vāruṇaṃ kṛṣṇamapāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca saṃghāvakāyamam' |
paśugaṇasya prakṛtiḥ ekādaśinī, ekādaśinyāḥ prakṛtiḥ savanīyapaśuḥ, sava
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome paśugrīṣomīya: 'yo dīkṣito yadagnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
santi ca paśudharmā: upakāraṇam, upanayanam, akṣaṇyā bandhaḥ, yūpe niyojanaṃ nayanaṃ saṃjñapanaṃ viśasanaṃ ityevamādayaḥ |
te kiṃ sarveṣāṃ agnīṣomīya- savanīyānubandhyānām, uta agnīṣomīyasya savanīyasya ca, uta agnīṣomīyasyeveti |
tulya: sarveṣāṃ paśu- vidhi: syāt, yadi prakaraṇe viśeṣo na bhavet |
katham, tena vapā- pracāreṇotkṛṣṭasya kāla eṣa vidhīyate |
prātaḥsavane vapāpracāre codite sati paścālmbho'pi tatraiva prāpnoti |
tatra kālāniyame prāpte 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā' iti kālamātraṃ vidhīyate |
itarathā paripyāṇasya kāle vidhīyeta upakaraṇasya ca |
vā-- idānīṃ katarat savanīyānāmutpāttitvākyaṃ ityeta- tparijñānādhādhikāraṇasiddhiḥ |
tat pūrvapakṣavādī āha, iti cet savanīyaprakaraṇābhāvaṃ manyase, tadyuktam |
' 'vapayā prātaḥsavane pracaranti' ityanenaiva vacanena utkṛṣṭe pradhāne, pradhānadeśatvāddvāṇāṃ upakaraṇādyapi utkṛṣṭeṣu, kāla- niyame prāpte sati, āśvinagrahaṇatastvaṃ vidhīyate |
parivyāṇopakaraṇayoḥ kālavidhānāt dravya- devatāyuktasya ca yāgasya vidhye |
nanu ca atideśa- prātameva paripyāṇam, tasminneva kāle vidhīyamāne anūyeta |
satyamatideśena prāptam, na tu tadānīṃ kriyate |
evaṃ tarhi sādhā- raṇyādeva prāptaṃ vidyamānamanūyeta |
tannāma anyataḥ prāptamanūyate, yat tādṛṣyena prāptaṃ pratyabhijñāyate |
na ca pūrvairdhuḥ kṛtasya āśvinagrahaṇottarakālaṃ vartamānatvena anuvādo bhavati |
na ca pūrvairdhṛtasya paryagni- kṛtādiṣviva īdṛśena śabdena anuvādaḥ |
evaṃ tarhi asmādvākyāt prāptamanūyatām 'sa āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā upaniṣkramya yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti |
yadetat aprākṛtaṃ savanīyaparivyāṇam, etasya śuddhasya śravaṇāt racanāyāśca prākṛtaparivyāṇivadhana- tvāt, yenakenacit vāsaḥprabhṛtinā karaṇe sati trivṛttvānuvādo na prāpnoti |
'itarathā hi parivyāṇasya kālo vidhīyeta' yatsarvatravidhitvena upāttaṃ trivṛt dravyam, kāle vidhīyeta |
'upakaraṇasya ca' iti upakaraṇakālo dravyadevatāviśiṣṭaṃ ca karma vidhīyeta ityarthaḥ |
tasmāt asya guṇārthatvāt asti pūrvairdhuḥ savanīyānāṃ prakaraṇamiti |
guṇārthe etasmin vākyaṃ bhidyeta, na vidhānārtham |
nahi vapā- pracāreṇa utkṛṣṭasya kālavidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
vā-- (atrocyate,) yadā hi pūrvairdhuḥ sāṅgānāṃ savanīyānāmamnām, tadā tatraiva
tatra taddvāreṇa taditiḥ sulabhaḥ iti viśiṣṭavidhāna- nyāyaḥ |
yatra punaḥ svaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭā kriyā vidhīyate, vākyāntaraprāptasya kriyāntarasya viśeṣaṇam, tatra avasthā- vartīno vidhipratyayaḥ |
devatāviśiṣṭe hi yāgo vidhīyamānaḥ svaviśeṣaṇameva ākṣeptuṃ samarthaḥ, nāvidhīya- mānapariṣyāṇaviśeṣaṇam |
tena apūrvakarmavidhiṣvapi eta- dvivekavyam, katarat tadviśeṣaṇam, katarat anyaviśeṣaṇa- miti |
tatrāvaśyaṃ siddhāntavādinā ubhayoḥ pariṣyāṇayoḥ sādhāraṇau raśanā iti parihāro vaktavyaḥ |
yadyat etasya yūpasya pariṣyāṇam, tasyatasya eṣā vākyena vijñāyate |
athavā yat 'tribhṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya upākaroti' iti pūrvaiḥ prātaṃ upakāraṇasya pariṣyāṇāntarmanūya āśvinagrahaṇāntaryaṃ vidhīyate |
avaśyaṃ tāvat savanīyānāmeke- notpattiḥ, ekena ca guṇo vidhātāvyaḥ |
tatra pūrvaidhu- stanasya tāvat na kaścit utpattivākyatve hetursti |
yadyapi evaṃ tathāpi vikalpasyamucya- saṃbhavāt kena cidviśeṣeṇa anyatarasminnāśrayatve viśeṣo- 'bhidhīyate |
purastāt etadeva sthitam, yathā 'upā- deyo guṇaḥ tirohitakarmānuvādena śakyo vidhātum, nānu- pādeyaḥ' |
sa hi kuṇḍapāyināmayane homasyeva balāt karmāttaratvamāpādayati |
tadiha vicāryate kimete dharmāḥ śyāmāmpi paśūnāṃ sādhāraṇyeṇa vidhīyante, kivā sava- nīyasyaiva, atha agnīṣomīyasavanīyayoḥ, uta agnī- ṣomīyasyaiveti |

tadarthaṃ ca ki agnīṣomīyasya sthānaṃ jyotiṣṭomena prakaraṇena savanīyāvantaraprakaraṇena vā viruddhaye te neti ; tatsiddhayarthaṃ ca kiṃ savanīyānāṃ aupa- vasathye'hni prakaraṇamasti nāstīti cintanīyam |
tato'pi etadvivektavyam, kiṃ aupavasathye'hni savanīyotpattiḥ, uta saule'hnīti |
'nanu prakaraṇāt sthānaṃ durbalaṃ tat kathaṃ tataḥ |
kīrtyante sava- nīyo'tra saumye tveṣa vidhīyate |
na tu yatra guṇārthena śravaṇaṃ tatra vidyate |
vidhirastu daikṣa eveti sūtre vidhi- rudāhṛtaḥ |
soma--'prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe savanīyānubandhayoḥ tataḥ daityapuroḍāśasya apravṛttiḥ |
siddhānte tu agnīṣomīyasya prakṛtitvāt tatra ca puroḍāśasya dāśamikanyāyena saṃnipātvāt, saṃnipātena ca vikṛtiṣu ūhena pravṛtteḥ, savanīyādau tattvevatākapaśupuroḍāśapravṛttiḥ |
bhāṭṭa--jyotiṣṭome krayasaṃnidhau agnīṣomīyaḥ paśu- rāmnātaḥ, 'sa eṣa aupavasathye'hni savanīyaḥ' itya- smādvacanāt caturthe'hni anuṣṭhīyate |
savanīyaśca paśuḥ saule- 'hni samāmnātaḥ : 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti' iti |

tadiha kiṃ paśudharmāṇāṃ paśu- trayasādhāraṇyam, uta savanīyamātratvam, uta savanīyā- gnīṣomīyabhayārthatvam, uta agnīṣomīyamātrārthatvameva iti cintāṃ mahāprakaraṇatvāt jyotiṣṭomavandanāṃ dharmāṇāṃ paśudharmatvena sākṣāt saṃbandhayogyatā ānarthakyatadannyāyena ( 3|1|9 ) paśuyāgādārā janakatvātgateḥ, teṣāṃ ca madhye kasya cit viśiṣṭa prakaraṇabādhabalavatpramāṇābhāvena aviśeṣāt sarvārthatvaṃ ityāha : ( pakṣaḥ ) |
dvitīyastu satyapi jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇasya paśudharmāgrahāttve savanīyā- vāntaraprakaraṇena tadāha : tasya hi aupavasathye ahnayaiva utpattiḥ |
'āgneyaḥ paśurāmiśe ālabhyaḥ, aindrāma ukthye dvitīyaḥ ; aindro vṛṣṇaḥ ṣoḍaśini tṛtīyaḥ, sārasvatī medhyatirātre caturthī' ityetairvacanaiḥ |
tasya klṛptopakāraprākṛtāṅgasaṃbandhe'pi ape- kṣitānāṃ paśudharmāṇāṃ saṃnihitatvena prākṛtāṅgasaṃbaddhatvena na avāntaraprakaraṇopapattiḥ |
aindrādyādideśanāṃ tu saṃsthādhikaraṇanyāyena ( 3|6|16 ) samānavidhānatvābhāvā- deva na paśudharmāgrāhakatvaśaṅkā |
astu vā teṣāmapi avāntaraprakaraṇatvāt dharmagrāhakatvam, naitāvatā sarvārthatvam |
na saule'hani tadvidhiḥ, savanīyoddeśena tasya āśvina- grahagrahaṇakālatvamātravidhāyakatvāt |
yūpaparibyāṇasya 'trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti sāmānyavidhinā 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā upaniṣkramya yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti paribyāṇavidhinā vā prāptatvena anuvādāt |

dūrasthakramānuvādena kālavidhiśakyaḥ, aupavasathye ahani vihitānāmapi krupaśunām 'vapayā prātaḥ- savane caranti, puroḍāśena mādhyaṃdine, aṅgaistṛtīya- savane' ityanena utkarṣavidhānāt saule'hani anuṣṭhīya- mānatayā upasthityapatteḥ |
tena yathaiva krayasaṃnidhau āmnātasya agnīṣomīyasya aupavasathye ahani anuṣṭhīya- mānatvenaiva dharmagrāhakatvaṃ siddhānte, tadvadihāpi iti na doṣaḥ |
na ca evamapi ka savanīyavidhiḥ ityatra vinigamanāvirahaḥ, dharmabāhulyasya niyāmakatvāt |
tasya hi krayasaṃnidhau vidhiśāstreṇa klṛptopakāraprākṛtāṅgaiḥ nirākāṅkṣīkṛtasya aupavasathye ahani utkṛṣyasya āyopa- sthitisamātratvena sthānam |
ata eva itikartavyatā- tvena ayogyasaṃbandhayorvākyayoḥ saṃnidhiḥ |

yadyapi cātra paśudharmāṇāṃ śrutyādiviniyukta- tvāt na prakaraṇasya sthānasya vā viniyojakatvasaṃbhāvanā, tathāpi apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇatātparyagrāhakatve eva vini- yojakatvavyavahāro bhāktaḥ iti draṣṭavyam |
na caivamapi prakaraṇena sthānabādhāpattiḥ, agnīṣomīyasya paśudharmā- kāṅkṣāyāmeva atideśakalpanāt aupadeśikasthānasyaiva viniyojakatvakalpanaucityāt |
