anyathā pravalopa- deśikapramāṇena prakṛtyarthatvāt dharmāṇāṃ kāpi vikṛtyathai- tvānupapatteḥ |
indrādeḥ upāyāntareṇāpi smṛtisaṃbhavāt na liṅgādeḥ śrutikalpakamiti viśeṣaḥ |
iti prāpte, na savanīyasya avāntaraprakaraṇam, saule ahani utpatteḥ, anyathā dūrasthakramānuvādena kāla- rūpānupādeyaguṇavidhānānupapatteḥ |
na ca prātaḥ savane utkṛ- ṣṭādeva upasthitiḥ, ānuṣṭhānikopasthiteḥ aṅgagrāhaka- tve'pi prakaraṇāntarapratikatvasya kāpi adarśanāt |
astu vā tat, tathāpi vapyāsāmātrasya prātaḥsavane utkṛṣṭe'pi upākaraṇotkarṣe pramāṇābhāvāt upasthityanu- papatteḥ |
yadyapi ca upākarotinā yāga eva lakṣyate, tathāpi śakyārthasyopākaraṇasya āśvinagrahaṇottarakālasya
yadyapi ca vapāpracārottara- bhāvipadārthānāṃ tadāyutkarṣanayena ( 5|1|12 ) utkarṣaḥ saṃbhāvyate, tathāpi na tatpūrvabhāvināmupākaraṇādīnāmutkarṣe pramāṇamasti |
vastutastu pūrvairvaidikaraṇanyāyena apūrva- tvāt taduttarabhāvināmapi notkarṣaḥ |

vastutastu 'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau śakyārthasya ghoṣā- nvayaprāptāve'pi lakṣaṇādarśanāt tayoścaratkālatvaprāpya- bhāve'pi upālokarotinā vapyāsanālakṣaṇopapatteḥ paśvanapakramo- payogiṣūpākaraṇe sarvapādadvitīyayūpaparibyāṇasya āśvina- grahaṇottarakālavicita eva taduttarabhāvipāgasyāpi āśvinagrahaṇottarakālatvasiddheḥ |
tatrāpi itarasya sarvasya dvitīyayūpaparibyāṇādeḥ vākyāntaraprāptatvāt kālaviśiṣṭaṃ śuddhameva vā dravyadevatāviśiṣṭaṃ karmaiva vidhīyate |
tataśca anenaiva vākyena āgneyasavanīyasya etatsamānajātīyasya vākyāntaraiḥ aindrādīnāṃ vidhānāt aupavasathye ahani teṣāṃ punaḥ śravaṇamanuvādamātram |

tathāpi 'yathā vai matsyo'drivaditi janamavadhute, evamete'praśamamānā janamavadhanvante', ityarthavādakṛtasaṃtatakaraṇanimittakanindopa- pādakaitacchadāpekṣitapaśusamarpaṇārthe nindotītadopari- hārārthaṃ ca 'vapayā prātaḥsavane caranti' ityādinā vapāpracārodeśena prātaḥsavanādikālavidhiḥ |
nyaṇḍaśaḥ kālamedenānuṣṭhāne hi madhye smṛtyarthe avakāśalābhāt doṣaparihāraḥ |
yadyapi ca atrāpi kālavidhānaṃ dūrasthakramānu- vādena aśakyaṃ tathāpi arthavāda eva tadupapatteḥ na kaściddoṣaḥ |
yattu pravāraviprakarṣasya upādeyasya guṇasya sattvāt na doṣa iti mūloktaṃ samādhānam, tat vipra- karṣasya aśābdasya vidheyatvābhāvāt upekṣitam |
na ca jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe sthānabādhaḥ, paśudharmāṇāṃ śrutyādibhiḥ paśusaṃskāratayā viniyuktānāṃ ayogyatā jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe agrahaṇāt |
ato yatraiva śrutaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, yathā 'vājapeyasya' ( 3|1|9 ) ityādi, tatraiva ānarthakyatadannyāyaḥ, na tu atra |
evaṃ satyapi yadi tasyāpi paśoḥ viśiṣya pramāṇāntaraṃ apūrvasādhana-
tvopasthāpakaṃ na syāt tato mahāprakaraṇaparigṛhītānāmeṣāṃ ānarthakyatadaṅganyāyena (3|1|9) bhavet sarvapārthatvam, na tu etadasti, sthānena agnīṣomīyarthatvāt |
tena siddhamamīpomīye upadeśaḥ, anyatra tu atideśa iti |
' paśudharmādhikaraṇe (3|6|18-27) kramasya prakaraṇavirodhaparihāreṇa paśudharmāṃ daikṣārthatve vakṣyamāṇaḥ anuṣṭhānadeśalakṣaṇo'pi kramaḥ viniyogahetutvena sujñeyo bhaviṣyati |
bhā. 10|3|18-22. paśuniyojanaṃ yūpadharmaḥ cāturmāsyeṣu (paśumatasu) paridhau kartavyaḥ |
praiṣe ca 'yūpayājya- mānāya' ityeva brūyāt na tu 'paridhye'jyamānāya' iti |
paśupuroḍāśaḥ dāśapūrṇamāsikāt amīpomīyāt puroḍāśāt vidhyantaṃ gṛhṇāti |
paśupuroḍāśaḥ devatāsaṃskārārthaḥ ityuktam 'api vā śeṣabhūtatvāt' (10|1|9|23) ityatra |
bhā. 12|1|2|19, paśupuroḍāśaḥ paśutantramadhye utpannaḥ paśutantraṃ gṛhṇāti |
12|1|7|15. paśu- puroḍāśaḥ śāstrātideśāt sāmānavidhyācca paśudharmāṇāṃ madhye amīṣomasaṃskārārthaḥ devatantre na prāpnoti |
vā. 3|8|16|131. paśupuroḍāśaḥ savanīye paśau api kartavyaḥ, devatāsaṃskārārthatvāt |
bhā. 10|1|9|20, sautrāmaṇyāṃ āśvina-sārasvata-sutrāmadevatākeṣu paśuṣu aindra-vāruṇa-sāvitrāḥ paśupuroḍāśāḥ |
10|1|9|22. paśupuroḍāśasya amīṣomīyādisaṃbandhanaḥ śrapaṇaṃ śālāmukhīye kartavyaṃ, na tu śāmitre |
('na tau paśau karoti' iti tu paśau niṣedho na paśupuroḍāśe) |
vi. 5|1|1|15. paśupuroḍāśājñe'ḍābhakṣaṇottarameva piṣṭalepaphalī- karaṇahomau, na tu anuyājaiḥ sahotkarṣaḥ |
su. pṛ. 779. paśupuroḍāśajñasvikṛṣṭuyāge tyāge nigameṣu ca kevalasvaivāgrerabhidhānam |
tantrisamavāye codanātaḥ samānānāmaikatanatrya- matulyeṣu tu bhedo vidhivikramatādarthyāt, tādarthya śrutikālanirdeśāt |
bhāṣyam- amīṣomīye paśau puroḍāśaḥ 'amīṣo- mīyasya vapāya pracaryāmīṣomīya paśupuroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' kiṃ tasya pṛthaktvena aṅgāni kartavyāni, uta yāni paśau kṛtāni tasyāpyupakurvantīti |
teṣāṃ samavāye ekadeśakālakartṛtve, codanātaḥ samānānāṃ ekavākyacoditānāṃ ekatantratvaṃ bhavati |
yāni tu codanāto na tulyāni nānāvākyaiścoditāni, teṣu tu bhedaḥ syāt tantrasya |
yathā atraiva 'amīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta', 'amīṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' iti |
vidhividhānaṃ tadaṅgānāṃ prayogaḥ, tasya prakramaḥ tadarthā pravṛttiḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ paśvarthatvaṃ vidhiprakramasya ? tādarthya śrutikālanirdeśāt |
paśoravarasare yo vidhiprakramaḥ sa kevalaḥ paśvartho vijñāyate puroḍāśasyā- prāptatvāt |
'yadekādaśaprayājān yajati paśumeva tat prayajati, yadekādaśānuyājān yajati paśumeva tadanuyajati' iti |
evakārakaraṇāt avadhāraṇaṃ vijñāyate, paśumeva, na puroḍāśamiti |
(agnī- ṣomīye paśau) 'amīṣomīyasya vapāya pracaryāmīṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' iti (śrūyate) |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ tasya (paśukebhyaḥ aṅgebhyaḥ) pṛthagjñāni kartavyāni, uta yāni paśoḥ (arthena kṛtāni) aṅgāni, tāni (eva) tasyāpi upakurvanti prasaṅgena iti |
tataḥ etatsandehārthaṃ prasaṅgo'sti nāsti iti vicāryate |
kutaḥ ? (uttaratvena sūtraṃ yojayati -) tantrisamavāye (sādhāraṇa dharmagrāma- santram |
sa yeṣām, te tantriṇaḥ, teṣām - ) pradhānānāṃ (amīṣomīyādīnāṃ paśupuroḍāśādīnāṃ ca) samavāye (ekadeśakālakartṛtve sati) codanātaḥ samānānāmaika- tantratvam |
yāni ekacodanayā codyante (ekayā pradhāna- codanayā saha codyante,) teṣāṃ samānatantratvam |
yāni punaḥ (pradhāna-) coda- nāto bhidyante, teṣāṃ bheda eva yathā darśapūrṇamāsasya ca |
tasmāt dviprākālatvāt karmaṇāṃ tṛtīyaḥ prakāro nāsti |
paśu-) puroḍāśāḥ (dāśapūrṇamāsikāt) amīṣomīyāt (puroḍāśāt) vidhyantaṃ gṛhṇāti, paśurapi sānāyāt |
atra pari- codyate, citraite : anudāharaṇam (tantritvena bahuyāgā- bhāvāt) |
katham ? 'dadhi madhu ghṛtaṃ dhānā udakaṃ taṇḍulāḥ, tat saṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyam' iti (atra) tat ityeka- vacanāntaṃ sarvanāma saṃsṛṣṭaśabdena saṃbadhyate ekavacanā- naiva |
yadi dadhyādibhiḥ saṃbadhyeta, bahuvacanāntaṃ syāt (tāni iti) vīpsā vā (tattat iti), na ca vīpsā śrūyate, na bahuvacanam |
nirdiṣṭasya hi pratinideśakaṃ sarvanāma (bhavati), nirdiṣṭāni (ceha) dadhyādīni prathamatayā vibhaktyā |
atastāntyeva śabdapāttāni (sākāṅkṣāṇi) parivartamānāni sarvanāmā pratinirdiśyante, na tu kena cit śabdena (dadhyādi-) saṃsarmo nirdiṣṭaḥ yaḥ sarva- nāmā pratinirdiśyeta (tasmāt teṣāmeva nirdeśaḥ) |
atha yadyantaṃ dadhyādisaṃbandhe bahuvacanaṃ prāpnoti vīpsā veti |
sarvanāmāprātipadikasya (hi) nirdiṣṭaprati- nideśakatve śaktiḥ, vacanasya tu ekārthapratipādakatvam |
tatra prathamaupanipātāt, liṅgasaṃkhyayośca tadarthatvāt (prātipadikārthatvāt) yathāśrutaṃ prātipadikaṃ gṛhṇīmaḥ |
prāyaścittaṃ tarhi kartavyam ? kriyate, 'ayāścāgne' iti sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhoti' iti |
dup-- atha yaduktam, dravyasaṃkhyākālabhedāt na prasajyate iti, taducyate |
sarvaiḥ kathambhāvaḥ upakāra- mākāṅkṣati, taṃ tu codakaḥ sādṛśyena utpādayati prāpayati ca |
te ca (upakārāḥ) śāstrāntareṇa na saṃbhavanti, iti śāstrāṇāmutpattiṃ prāptiṃ ca karoti (śāstragrahaṇaṃ padārthā- nāmapi upalakṣaṇam) |
prayoga- vacanastu pāśukrena prayogavacanena upasaṃgṛhītatvāt na praya- gupasaṃgṛhāti upakārān |
na cedupasaṃgṛhṇāti, te padārthā evātra (puroḍāśe) na santi (na kartavyā ityarthaḥ) |
na ca saṃkhyābhedena dravyabhedena vā apūrvāntaraṃ bhavati |
kiṃ tarhi ? prākṛtau saṃkhyā (pañcasvarūpā) prākṛtaṃ ca dravyaṃ (kevala- mājyam) apanīyate |
evaṃ kālabhedo'pi na doṣa ityāha-) prayājopakārā ādau ye utpadyante, te ca āphalanirvṛtteḥ (phalabhūta- paśvapūrvanirvṛttiparyantam) vidyante |
bhāṣyam-- ekeṣāṃ cārthināṃ aśakyatvāt bhedena kriyā |
nahi arthaḥ kṛtaḥ san kartuṃ śakyate |
na ca nirvartitaḥ śakyo nirvartitum, yathā kṛtaḥ kartum |
yathā sarvasādhāraṇāt auvājyāt upāṃśuyājārtha- mupāyāti pariśiṣṭamanyadevatāthaṃ bhavati |
tathā vrataṃ yad gṛhītam, na tat punarrlubdhaṃ śakyate grahītum |
bhāṣyam-- ekābhi paśoḥ puroḍāśaśca darśayati 'madhye'merāyajāhutīrjuhoti, puroḍāśāhutīḥ paśāhutīśca' iti |
tasmāt pāśukaṃ tantraṃ puro- ḍāśe prasajyate iti |

śā - sakṛdanuṣṭhitamapi, aṅgaṃ bahūnāṃ pradhānāmeka- deśakālakartṛtvāt na śaknoti upakartum ityetat tantralakṣaṇokta- mupajīvya kimayyamānāviśeṣatvādeva vā evaṃ bhavati, uta 'ase idamanuṣṭhānam, nāsai' ityevaṃ gṛhyamāṇe'pi viśeṣe anyārthamapi anuṣṭhitamapi aṅgamansyapi deśā- dyamede śaknotyupakartum, na tādarthyena punaranuṣṭhātavyamiti cintyate |
aiṣṭikaḥ sa pāśaiva vitato dṛśyate yadā |

soma - sūtrārthastu- sādhāraṇāṅgagrāmabhājāṃ samavāye ekadeśakālakartṛttve sati yāni ekacodanācoditāni āgneyādīni teṣāmeva aikatvaṃ syāt, bhinnacodanā- coditeṣu paśupuroḍāśādiṣu aṅgānuṣṭhānasa śrutyā agnīṣomīyapraṇayanānantaralakṣaṇākālanirdeśena paśvarthatvāt puroḍāśārthaṃ tantramedeḥ syāt iti |

nirvapati' iti śrute agnīṣomīyapaśuyāgāṅgabhūte darśikāgnīṣomīyayāgakṛtike paśupuroḍāśayāge kiṃ pāśukāni prayājādīnyaṅgāni prasajyante, uta bhedenānuṣṭhīyante iti cintāyām, na tāvat pauroḍāśikaṃ codakaṃ prayogavidhiṃ ca prayājādye'pi abhyupagamya kevalamanuṣṭhānaprasaṅga evamabhyupagantuṃ śakyaḥ |
prayogavidhinā vapāpacārāccottarakālaviśeṣāṅgapuroḍāśayāga- prayogavidhau tataḥ pūrvakṛtaprayājādīnāṃ akālakṛtatvena upakārakatvānupapatteḥ |

yadi tu nāyaṃ kālavidhiḥ, apitu paśupuroḍāśamāsādyasakṛdanuṣṭhānasādeśyāt vākyādeva vā paśvaṅgatvāt tatrayogeṇa : pāle'nuṣṭhānasiddheḥ ayaṃ kramavidhiraiva ityucyate, tathāpi puroḍāśāyārthaṃ pradhāna- vidhinaivānuṣṭhāpitānāṃ prākṛtānāmaṅgānāṃ atrākaraṇe vaiguṇyā- pattirnivāryeta |
yatra hi paśvaṅgānāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ ca na vailakṣaṇyam, tatra sakṛtkaraṇe vaiguṇyābhāve'pi tantratvavai- ghāpatteḥ na prasaṅgāpattiḥ |
yatra vailakṣaṇyam, yathā paśau ekādaśa prayājāḥ tiṣṭhanti ca paśau pṛṣadājyenānūyājāḥ |
ekādaśa vaikṛtayājyāntarayuktāḥ, puroḍāśe tu prayājāḥ pañca havirāsādanottarakālīnāḥ, anūyājāśca śuddhājyena trayaḥ ityādi |
tatra tritvādisaṃkhyāyāḥ codakenāṅgavatprāptau prayogavidhinā cānuṣṭhāpane kathaṃ puṣkalasyānuṣṭhāne vaiguṇyānāpattiḥ ? |
ato'vaśyaṃ prasaṅgavādinā tadeśe śāstrasyaiva vyāpāraḥ iti abhyupagantavyam |
tathātve puroḍāśadeśapravṛttapuruṣakṛtau prayājādyanukūlyā prayājādeḥ kārakatvābhāvena puroḍāśatvānavāpatyā codakavaiyarthyāt |

atha puroḍāśayāgānukūlabhāvanāyāmeva prayājādeḥ itikartavyatātvenānanyātadaṅgatvamityucyate, tathāpi anu- ṣṭhānābhāve'pi aṅgacodanākāditadeśādisattve kṛraṇeṣu ava- ghātātideśāpatyā prābhākaramatapraveśāpatteḥ |
atha upakāra- pṛṣṭhabhāvena padārthānāmatideśāt upakāralope iva anyata upakāralabhe'pi na padārthātideśaḥ |
upakārasya siddha- tvena janakāpekṣā'bhāve tadeśe atideśakalpane pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
ata eva puroḍāśātideśena prayājādijanyo vijātīyopakāra eva atidiśyate, na tu tajjanakaprayājā- dikamapi |
ataśca padyarthaṃ kriyamāṇaprayājādibhereva tādṛśavijātīyopakārasya labdhatvāt tenaiva puroḍāśayāge- 'pi yogyatājananarūpopapatteḥ prasaṅgāvirodhaḥ |
iti cet, tathā'pi paśvyāgādeśena anuṣṭhita- prayājādyaṅgānāṃ paśvupakāraṃ pratyaiva phalopadhāyakatayā puroḍāśayāgopakārakatvānupapatteḥ |
anyathā svargoddeśena anuṣṭhitadarśapūrṇamāsādiḥ punarutpatyādye'pi utpattyā- patteḥ |

ata paśvarthe kriyamāṇaprayājādyaṅgaiḥ puroḍāśopa- kārakatvānupapatteḥ tadarthaṃ medenānuṣṭheyāni prayājādīni ; na ca 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati ' ityādinā aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇaprayājādyuddeśena ekādaśatvādividhānāt sakṛtkṛtaiva taiḥ tantreṇa ubhayopakāropapattiḥ |

'ekādaśa prayājān yajati, paśumeva tat prayajati' 'ekā- daśānūyājān yajati, paśumeva tadanuyajati' ityādinā ekādaśatvādīnāṃ paśvapūrvasādhanībhūtaprayājārthatvagamanena gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatayā tantratvānupapattiḥ |
nahi ekaṃ kāraṇaṃ yugapat krameṇa vā ekameva kāryaṃ janayati ityatra niyāmakam asti, ekasyaiva ghaṭasya yugapat krameṇa vā rūparasasaṃyogādyutpādakatvadarśanāt |
ekasmāt kāraṇāt yugapat ekakāryatā'vacchedakatva- cchinnasya ekarūpatveti |
ata eva 'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' ityādau arthavādāpācakāmatadvānurodhena pravṛttaprayojakamānāviṣa- yatvasyaiva uddeśyatā'vacchedakatvena sthāpitatvāt tadava- cchinnasyaiva yugapadutpattiḥ |
na tarhi krameṇa tasyotpattiprasaṅgaḥ, pūrvotpannakāryaṇa apūrvasya nāśe uttarotpattau āpādakābhāvāt |
na caivaṃ ihāpi prātha- mikena puroḍāśaparamparāpūrve
hi saṃskārapakṣe vyudvacanamarthavādaḥ evamitarasmin pakṣe arthavādo bhaviṣyati |
yathaiva ekena kapālena yujye upamānyeṣu anyeṣāṃ kapālānāṃ na kiñciddīyate, evamanyayā devatayā paśu- puroḍāśayāge nirvartamāne na kiñcit paśudevatāyā hīyate |
ahīne tu vyudvaśabde uccarite na śabdārtho gṛhyata iti |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ saṃ- pratipadyadevatākeṣu graheṣu tadvacanaṃ bhavati puroḍāśavacanam |
' naitāṃ paśūnāṃ puroḍāśā vidyante ahupuroḍāśā hyete paśavaḥ ' iti |
grahā eṣāṃ puroḍāśāḥ ' grahapuroḍāśā hyete ' iti |
kiṃ teṣāṃ puroḍāśāḥ sāmānyam ? yadete devatāsaṃskārārthāḥ |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ śrūyate ' naitasya paśorgrahaṃ gṛhṇanti puroḍāśāvane paśuḥ ' iti paśupuroḍāśavattuhetukaṃ mahābhāve śruvan grahapuroḍāśayoḥ ekārthatāṃ darśayati |
evaṃ hyāmnāyate-- ' agnibhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ paśāva ālabhyante, kāmā vā agnayaḥ, āgneyāḥ puroḍāśā bhavanti, āgneyā hi paśavaḥ ' iti |
paśudevatāhetukān puroḍāśān śruvan devatāsaṃskārārthatāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ darśayati |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ guṇabhūtayordharmaḥ pradhānabhūtayo- ramīṣamayordharmaḥ syāditi |
pradhānabhūtavapi prākṛtaṃ kāryaṃ yāganirvṛttiṃ kurvāṇo dvāra- bhūto iti dharmayoriṣyate śṛtavat |
yathā ' śṛte carum ' ' dadhiśrutam ' iti pradānārthe dadhiśte praṇītākāryaṃ kurvāte iti dharmayoriṣyate |
sa vyarthaḥ syādubhayoḥ śrutibhūtatvād vipratipattau tādarthyād vikāratvam |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ aindavāruṇasāvitrāṇāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ sautrāmaṇīkaraṇatvāt utkarṣaḥ prāpnoti |
ato viprati- padyadevatākeṣu chidrāpidhānārthatayā prakaraṇādutkarṣo na bhaviṣyati |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ tarhi anena prakāreṇa prakaraṇādanu- tkarṣaḥ |
tatra sautrāmaṇyāṃ saṃpratipadyadevatākā eva codakena puroḍāśāḥ prāptāḥ |
katham ? ekadeśā hi teṣā- mime varṇāntarasahitā uccāritā iti gamyate |
yathā ca sarasvatīdevatāke nigade ' sarasvatī devanido nirvahaya prajāṃ viśvasya bṛsasya māyinaḥ ' |
kimarthaṃ punarevaṃ kalpyate ? yato devatāntarāṇi paśudevatāsaṃskārārtheṣu yāgeṣu pratyāyyamānāni anarthakāni bhaveyuḥ |
bhāṣyam-- saṃskārapakṣe eva vāśabdo yuktiṃ vyāva- rtayati, na pakṣam |
tatra hi codakena paśudevatā prāpnoti puroḍāśaśca |
tadubhayamapi abhyasyate yāge na saṃbhavati iti arthādabhyasyate yāgaḥ |
tadyathā pañcānāṃ prayājānāṃ codakena prāptānāmekādaśasaṃkhyā vidhīyate |
sā ca antareṇābhyāsaṃ nāvakalpate iti abhyasyante prayājāḥ |
ṭup-- asyā ( sautrāmaṇyām ) codakena paśudevatā ( paśupuroḍāśayāge ) prāpnoti, paśupuroḍāśaśca |
tatra paśudevatāyā dravyāntaram ( grahaḥ ) vidhīyate, paśupuro- ḍāśasya ca devatā'ntaram ( indrādi ) vidhīyate |
asyāṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ ( pradhānabhūtāḥ ) paśuyāgā ānnāyante, devatāsaṃskāradvāreṇa ca ( teṣu codakena ) puroḍāśāḥ prāpnuvanti |
yo aho devatāsaṃbaddhaḥ, sa paśupuroḍāśayāgena na saṃbadhyate |
kathamavidhānam ? ( uttaram-- ) atra ( vikṛtau ) upa- kārā atidiśyante ( na padārthāḥ ) yatra ( tu teṣām ) prakaraṇam, tatra viparivṛttiḥ |
astu ( nāma puroḍāśayāgasya iha-- ) prakaraṇaṃ viparivṛttiśca, tathāpi ( grahadevatāsaṃbandhe ) na saṃbadhyate ( pramāṇābhāvāt ) naitat somayajinā tulyam |
tatra ( ' somena yajeta ' iti ) somaviśiṣṭo yāgo vidhīyate ( aindrāyāgādīni ca ) grahaṇāni somayāga- dravyasya saṃskārakāṇi |
tāni ( ca sarvāṇi ) grahaṇāni prakaraṇe gṛhyante |
iha ( tu paśu- ) puroḍāśasya grahadevatāyā vā na kaścit saṃskāraḥ ( kriyate ) |
tatra nimitte ( candramyudaye sati devatā- ) vibhāge vidhīyate, yāgastu vidhīyate eva |
na tu iha tathā ( vibhāgavacanam ), yena abhyuditeṣṭyā tulyaṃ syāt |
yadi tasminneva yāge kena cit prakāreṇa niveśaḥ syāt, tathā yāgāntaraṃ na kalpyeta ( na tu saṃbhati niveśaḥ ) |
yadi ca pratyakṣe yāge sati ānu- māniko na labhyeta ( tataḥ ) dīkṣaṇīyādīni adharmakāṇi bhaveyuḥ |

yadi ca ( sautrāmaṇyām ) eko yāgaḥ, tathā ( sati ) eka eva vidhīyate : ( codyate-- ) dve chātra dvaye ( asyārthe-- ) yāgamede'pi samānatantra- tvāt prayājādayaḥ sakṛdeva kartavyāḥ, dravyasaṃskārāṇāmeva tu āvṛttiḥ |
te caikasmin yāge dravyabhedāt āvartante eva iti kā'tra aniṣṭāpattiḥ iti ) |
tatra ekasya ( eva dravyasya ) saṃskāraḥ prāpnoti, dvitīyasya ( tu dravyasya ) codaka eva na ( prāpnoti |
kiñca-- ) ekasya ( eva ) ca pradānaṃ bhavati, dvitīyaṃ tu prokṣaṇā- divat adṛṣṭārthaṃ ( prāpnoti ) devatostu yadi ( ekana ) niveśaḥ ( syāt ) vikalpena syāt |
( yattu prayājavat sa eva yāgo'bhyastaḥ devatāntareṇa yujyate iti, tadapi na tulyamityāha-- ) prayājānuvādena ca saṃkhyā vidhīyate, ( ataḥ ) tatra yāgāntarasyaiva nāsti |
[ ānandaśramasya dup- ṭīkāpāṭhastu tantratvena na saṃgata: iti na svīkṛta: ] |
śā-- agnīṣomīye paśau paśupuroḍāśaḥ kiṃ paśo- rādādupakārakaḥ, uta paśudevatāsaṃskāra iti saṃdeha ārā- dupakāraka iti prāptam |
' soma-- pūrvavadihāpi devatā'ntaratvāt asaṃskāra- katvaṃ ityukteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- 'upakārī saṃskṛtitvā puroḍāśaḥ paśūditaḥ (paśau uditaḥ uktaḥ) |

' bhāṭṭa-- daikṣe 'agnīṣomīyasya vapayā pracaryāgnī- ṣomīyaṃ paśupuroḍāśam nirvapati' iti śrutaḥ paśupuro- ḍāśago'pi noddeśena paśudevatāsaṃskāraḥ, ubhayatra taddhitāntanirdeśāviśeṣeṇa ubhayorāpi ārādupakārakatvāva-
su. pṛ. 60. paśuyāgeṣu manotāmantra: agnidevatya eva, na tatra paśudevatayā ūha: |
paśuyāgādine'pi agnihotrahoma: sāyanata: nauttaravedike, daivāt paśukarmaṇa: utkarṣe tu auttaravedike eva |
saṃkalpa: 3|2|24. mīko. pṛ. 86 agni-hotrahoma: ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
paśuyajñaprakramādhikaraṇe ( paśusomādhikaraṇe 2|2|6|17-20 ) nyāyopabṛṃhitacanasya nyāyaviruddha-vacanata: prābalyaṃ bhāṣyakāraireva varṇitam |
yathā paśau bhinnakāleṣu api eka-deśeṣu ' vapā prāta:savane caranti, puroḍāśaṃ mādhya-ndine, aṅgaistṛtīyasavane ' iti na ajñānāmāhṛtirbhavati tadvat |
yathā paśau sāsadasthe śrūyamāṇe na dāśapaurṇamāsikī tatra pravṛttipratiṣidhyate, vācanika-tvāt sāsadasyasya |
paśuvikṛtiṣu ' dyāvāpṛthivyā dhenumālabheta, mārutaṃ vatsam, aindravṛṣabham ' ityatra gotvajātimanta: evaite paśava:, na tu ajatvajātīyā: |
anekajananakriyānuyogipratiyogina: mātā ca putraśca pitā ca dhenu-vatsa-ṛṣabhaśabdena grāhyā: |
paśuśabdaṃ ākṛtivacanaṃ śṛṅgiṇa pucchavati lomaśe catuṣpadi dravyaviśeṣe upacaranti |
paśuśīrṣopadhāne yat-tanmālabhyate tatpurupārtha-miṣṭakā na nirmātavyā:, kintu siktābhi: pūrayitavyam |
saṃkalpa: 1|1|15. mīko. pṛ. 360 ' abhyaryugaṇastyanaiva ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |

' paśusavanīyeṣu vikalpa: syāt ' ityatra dvādaśe uktam - savanīyapaśau maitrāvaruṇakartṛkāt ' abhimaya hotāramabhyuṇītāya sutāsutī yajamāna: ' ityagnīṣomī-yāt anatidiṣṭāt ( atidiṣṭāt ) sūkvākapreṣāt tannirṇaya savanīyahavirjñānāṃ maitrāvaruṇarahitāyāṃ pravajjīpa-kāritve mantrata: kartṛtvaśca viśeṣagrahaṇamasti iti |
paśusavanīyeṣu savanīye paśau savanīya puroḍāśeṣu ca prasaṅge vikalpa: syāt |
pañca prayājā ekādaśa prayājā vā kāryā iti bhāva: |
vastutastu vaikṛtā eva te sarve na saṃśaya: |
kuto vaikṛtā: sarve ? ubhayo: paśupuroḍāśayo: aśrutibhūtatvāt ajñānāṃ aśrute: aśravaṇāt |
tasmāt paśau savanīyapuroḍāśaśca ityubhayormadhye kasya prasaṅga: kasya prasaṅgī ityatra vikalpa: iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
paśuṃka vā, tasya vaiśeṣikānnāt, tadarthakaṃ vikalpa: syāt |
pāśukaṃ tantraṃ savanīyapuroḍāśeṣu prasajyate, na vikalpa: |
tasya paśo: vaiśeṣika: dharma: āmnāta: sūkvākapraiṣa: |
vikalpe tu sati tat vaiśeṣikadharmārnāma anarthakaṃ syāt |
tasmāt pāśukaṃ tantraṃ puroḍāśeṣu prasajyate iti siddhānta: |
itaśca pāśukaṃ tantraṃ puroḍāśeṣu prasajyate ityāha |
paśo: tantrasya viprakarṣa: śrūyate - ' vapā prāta:savane caranti, puroḍāśaṃ mādhyandine savane, aṅgaistṛtīyasavane ' iti |
asaṃśayaṃ pāśukaṃ tantraṃ puroḍāśeṣu prasajyate, na vikalpa: iti siddhānta: |
' agnīṣomīyaṃ paśu-mālabhate ', ' somena yajeta ' iti ālabhanaṃ yāgaśca apūrva karma vidhīyate ||
dravyasaṃyogodyodanā paśusomayo: prakaraṇe hyana-rthako dravyasaṃyogo nahi tasya guṇārthena |
bhāṣyam - jyotiṣṭome śrūyate - ' yo dīkṣito yadagnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate ' iti |
tanedamāmantritaṃ ' hṛdaya-syāgre'vadyati atha jihvāyā atha vakṣasa: ' iti |
tathā ' somena yajeta ' iti, tathā ' aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti ', ' maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhṇāti ', ' āśvinaṃ gṛhṇāti ' ityevamādi |
tatra saṃśaya:, kimavayavatigṛhṇātitādicoditānāṃ karmaṇāmeva ālabhanatijatī samudāyasya anuvaditārau, atha apūrvayo: karmaṇorvidhitārau iti |
kuta: ? ye ime ālabhatiyajatibhyāṃ karmaṇī vidhīyete-yātāmiti cintyate, pūrvameva te avayavatigṛhṇātibhyāva-gamyate |
hṛdayādīstu paśuśabdena anuvadati, somaśabdena ca rasam |
yajeta svargakāmo vasante vasante iti phalguṇasaṃknyartha: |
api ca ' daśa-tānadhvaryu: prāta:savane mahān gṛhṇāti tṛtīyo hūyate ' iti ca krama: |
yadi ca apūrvau yāgau vidhīyete, tatra aindravāyavādibhirdevatā vidhīyeran, tā ekāryā: sato vikalpyeran, yathā ' khādirai badhnāti ', ' pālāśai badhnāti ', ' rohitake badhnāti ' iti |
atha punarasmin samudāyavacane yajato samyagetadavaklṛptaṃ bhavati |
kuta: ? somaśabda: kṣīriṇyāṃ latāyāṃ prasiddho na rase |
tathā śṛṅgiṇa pucchavati lomaśe catuṣpadi dravyaviśeṣe paśuśabda ākṛtivacanamupacaranti |
na ca evamākṛtikadravya: prakṛtā yāgā vicintye, yeṣā-mimau samudāyasyānuvaditārau bhaveyātām |
paśuagnīṣomīyo bhavati ityetadavadyate, nāyaṃ prakṛto hṛdayādi: paśuriti |
tatra yadi laukikasya paśorgrahaṇam, tato mukhya: paśuśabda: |
atha aindravāyavādiṣu prakṛteṣu yāgeṣu latā vidhīyete |
na sā śakyā vākyena aindravāyavī śātum |
tasmāt dravyasaṃyogavacana: prakṛteṣu yāgeṣvapi satva vidhātuṃ anu-vadituṃ vā na śaknuvan anarthaka: syāt |
dvau cātra śabdau samudāyyānuvadatvena āśaṅkyate paśu-śabda: tadagnīṣomasaṃvanyānumitaśca yaji: |
īdṛśaṃ hi eta-dvākyaṃ śrutānumitaikadeśanibandhanam, yat ' agnīṣomīyeṇa paśunā yajeta ' iti |
tatra kiṃ hṛdayādīnāṃ paśuśabda: anuvāda: avayavatinumitānāṃ yāgānāṃ ca yaji:; uta apūrva: paśu: yāgaśca vidhīyate, tatra itare guṇavidhaya: iti saṃdihyate |
tathā aindravāyavādivākyai: dravyadevatā-saṃbandhanimitā yāgā: tadattra somarasa: kiṃ yajatiloma-śabdābhyāmanūdyate kivā dravyayuktaṃ karma vidhīyate iti |
anayo: yāgaparyāyatvātvāt tatsaṃbandhanu-mitātāṃ tadākhyātātpratyayavihitatvāt vā ityetatpradarśanāyarthe tadvābhyam |
kathaṃ tarhi ? tadākṣitasya saṃsparśanasya ālabhatinuvāda: tad-
dvāreṇaiva ca pratyayadānaṃ devatāsaṃyogāt, tāvatāṃ ca yāgānā- |
tinā kathaṃ yāgavidhānam, kathaṃ vā hṛdayādyanuvādaḥ paśu- manumānam, uta paśusaṃyuktaḥ eko yāgo'numīyate iti |
'yathaiva paśusāmānye tathā some'pi ayameva yāgo yadyetadeśena dravyagrahaṇa- |
' hṛdayādibhiḥ prakṛtidravye apekṣite tatra paurṇamāsīvadeva samudāyānuvādatvam |
tu devatāyāṃ cihitāyāṃ yāgo vidhīyatāṃ nāma |
'sānāyyaṃ vā tadabhayatvāt ' ityanenaiva nyāyena aya- nahi aindravāyavaṃ ityādidravyadeva
bhāṣyam— evaṃ tāvat prakṛteṣu satsvapi nānuvādau ityuktam |
athedānīṃ prakṛtā eva yāgā na santītyucyate |
ataḥ ‘aindra- vāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti’ iti indrāvāyubhyāṃ saṃkalpayati iti etāvaduktaṃ bhavati |
tatra yāgāmantareṇa saṃkalpayati ityetanna yujyate iti yāgaḥ kalpyeta |
sa evāmnāto yāgo yasmin sati saṃkalpo''vakalpyate |
prakṛtānāṃ yāgānā- mabhāvāt na samudāyaśabdo yajatiḥ |
vā— naiva etau samudāyānuvādau, ‘codanā vā'prakṛta- tvāt’ (2|4|10) ityetasādeva hetoḥ |
kathaṃ prakṛtā na sambhavanti ? yataḥ avadyatigṛhṇātyaḥ na yāgānāṃ kṣānāt |
tanmātraparyavasāyini vākye niṣpannakatvāt na aśrutayāgakalpanaṃ śakyam |
evaṃ hi sa kalpyamānaḥ kalpyeta, ‘devatoddeśena gṛhītaṃ dravyaṃ na yāvat yāgena saṃbadhyate na tāvat tadarthatvaṃ kṛtyaṃ bhavati’ iti |
tata evaiṣa anyathānupapattyā yāgaṃ kalpayitumārabhate, tadaiva saṃnihitaḥ pratyakṣo yajiḥ |
aviśeṣāt sarvān dravyadevatāsaṃyogān upapādayitumupasthitam yāgāntarakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ nirupyate |
yaduktaṃ āgneyādivat nāparikalpite yajñī vākyāntarā- pekṣeta |
puṇyāpāraḥ pratīyate iti prāk tadanumānāt aparipūrṇaṃ vākyam |
iha tu ‘aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti’ iti grahaṇabhāvanāyāṃ puruṣo niyujyate |
tatra prāgpi yajya- numānāt asti vidheyaiḥ iti samāptye vākyam |
idaṃ tu anyat, yat tataḥ paramapi kiñcideṣyate |
sarvameva hi vākyaṃ svārthe paryavasyate arthāntarāpekṣāṃ na jahāti, na ca tāvatā tadasamāptaṃ bhavati |
yā tu asau apekṣā, sā vākyāntareṇa pūryyate ityavagamāt na vākyāntarasaṃnadhaṃ na sahate |
tena yajyanumānavelāyāṃ prati- vākyam ‘somena yajeta’ ityasyopasthānaṃ na virudhyate |

‘āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ’ iti tu bhavateḥ apuruṣavyāpārā- tmakatvāt prāk yajeḥ na kiñcit vihitaṃ na kiñcit pratiṣiddham, iti asamāpte vākye, vākyāntare cāna- pekṣite yajiḥ anumīyamānaḥ na vākyāntaragataḥ saṃbadhyate iti vaiṣamyam |
atha yaduktaṃ utpattiśiṣṭayoḥ paśusomayoḥ na vākyāntaragatā vikārapattiryuktā iti, tatra brūmaḥ |
’ yaccauta- tsikī paśusomau parityajya atyantātiriktaṃ kiñcit dravyaṃ vidhīyate; tato virodhaḥ syāt |
iha tu paśuneva hṛdayā- didvāreṇa yāgaḥ sādhyate, somena ca rasadvāreṇa |
paśusomau hi yāga- sādhanatvena codyamānau itikartavyatāmākāṅkṣataḥ |
tatra ca rasahṛdayādibhistadvāreṇa ityevaṃ kathambhāvaḥ pūryyate |
tatya prākara- ṇikaiḥ krayādibhyaiva prāptatvāt iha dravyasaṃyogo'narthaka iti |
nahi te vidhayaḥ somasa paśorvā codakāḥ |
tena coditasya dravyasya yathākatha- ñcit upādānena yāgasādhanatve prasakte krayādipadena abhi- ṣavādisaṃskṛtena ca sādhyatayamiti vidhīyate |
na ca mantravarṇasyānyāvihitacchrāgaprāpaṇasāmarthyam, paśucodanā- vihitasya tu saṃdehapyanyatramātramupayujyate |
na cāvadyatiḥ ekāntena yāgamanumāpayati, vinā'pi tena khaṇḍanamātrayā loke vede copapatteḥ |
dravyadevatāsaṃyogastu na kathañcit yāgādinā sthita ityanumānavaiṣamyam |
na ca sānāyyā- vadyatiḥ prakṛtau coditaḥ; atastathaivatvāt, yatastaddharma- prāptirapi syāt |
na cāsya yāgadravyatvaṃ itikartavyatā, yena tadatidiśyeta |
nanu ' aindrāvayaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti vākyameva viniyojakamupalabhyate |
ataśca ' maitrāvaruṇam ' ityasya pūrvanirapekṣameva devatāvidhi- sāmarthyaṃ vijñāyate |

tada dṛṣṭārthaṃ vinā tena, yadi vā'''sa na sidhyati !! ' yadi hi prathamaṃ yāgena saṃbaddhāḥ salo devatāḥ niryāpāvāhanādiṣviva grahaṇeṣu punaḥ śreyaren, yadi vā tāmirvinā grahaṇameva na nirvarteta tatastatra śravaṇaṃ dṛṣṭārthaṃ anā- gatamūtitvena kalpeta |
na tu indrāvādyaiḥ prathamaṃ jyotiṣṭome śrutāḥ |
tatra evaṃ satyapi yat devatāyuktaṃ grahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti śrūyate, tatra adṛṣṭāte na kiñcit prayojanamasti |
bhāvalakṣaṇavyaktatvābhāvāt viśvajidādiṣviva 'avyaktasu tu somasya' iti nyāyāpravṛttiḥ |
paśudāharaṇe tu pūrvapakṣe yāgamedāt vikṛtiṣu ekathaiva yāgasya itikrtavyatāprasaṅgeḥ hṛdayādinā tu ekena yāgaḥ, siddhānte sarvaiḥ |
yadā pūrvapakṣe 'sārasvataṃ meṣam' 'aindra- mṛṣabham' ityādiṣu viśasanādikamakṛtyā śrutemasādi- jātīyana dravyeṇa avikṛtenaiva yāgaḥ kartavyaḥ |

vikṛtiṣu viśasanādīnāmanupadiṣṭatvāt abhiśavādividhibhiścotpatti- śiṣṭā latā na rasīkartuṃ śakyate ityādigranthena paraṃparā- ''śravaṇe śrutivirodhasyophalatva tannyāyena meṣavṛṣabhādi- ṣvapi śrutemasāditāyasādhanatvavirodhaprasaṅgena viśasanā- dīnāṃ codakataḥ prāptyasaṃbhavāt |
siddhānte tu prakṛtāviba vikṛtāvipi paraṃparā''śravaṇe'pi śrutadravyasya avirodhāt codakānusārāt hṛdayādibhi
✱ paścādājñātaṃ pūrvaprātena bādhyate yathā adhvara- kalpayāṃ āmāvāsyavadvādaśakalapālasya aindrāgnadhikāratvāt āmāvāsyatantreṇa sarasvatyā ājyabhāgāyāṃ prāptaṃ paurṇa- māsatanram |
✱ paśya mṛgo dhāvati' ityādī paśya ityasya karmaṇyanyaṃ vinā śābdabodhajanakatvāt yukto dhāvana- bhāvanāyāḥ karmatvena tasyāmanyaḥ |
✱ pākaḥ anvāhāryasthānā- panne vāsasi nānuṣṭheyaḥ āgrayaṇe |
mīko. pṛ. 1475 'kṛṣṇeṣu musyapākāsaṃbhavāt' ityatra draṣṭa- vyam |
✱ pākaḥ kṛṣṇalacarau 'ghṛte śrapayati' iti pratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt adṛṣṭārthaḥ kartavyaḥ |
kiṃ prāptam ? pūrvo mantraḥ uttaraṃ ( mantra pāṭhena pratyakṣa- ṇaiva ) upasthāpayati |
( yathā ) ' samidho yajati ' iti samāpyamānaḥ tanūnapātamupasthāpayati |
tathāhi, ) ' samidho yajati ' ityanena padārtho vihitaḥ |
saḥ anuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ yena vākyena vihitaḥ , tat vākyaṃ smārayati |

tena vākyena smṛtena anuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ sa padārthaḥ smāritaḥ san anu- ṣṭhīyate , ( anuṣṭhitaścau jhaṭityeva ) dvitīyaṃ padārthaṃ na smārayati ( arthānāṃ granthānapekṣatvena paurvāparyasya anava- klaptatvāt ) |
kiṃ tarhi ? anuṣṭhānottarakālaṃ yo'sau kṛtaḥ padārthaḥ , tamālocayati |
sa cālocyamānaḥ yena ( samidho yajatītyanena ) brāhmaṇakhaṇḍena vihitaḥ , tat smārayati |
tacca ( smṛtam ) syāduccaraṃ brāhmaṇa- khaṇḍam ( tanūnapātaṃ yajati ityetat brāhmaṇakhaṇḍa- kam ) smārayati |
tat brāhmaṇaṃ punaḥ padārthaṃ vidadhāti ( punaḥ śabdaḥ tu -śabdārthakaḥ ) |
mantraḥ punaḥ ( antaḥkratu prayojyamānaḥ ) parisamāpyamānaḥ uttaraṃ mantraṃ paryupasthāpayati |
sa ca ( uttaro mantraḥ ) paryupasthāpya- mānaḥ uttaraṃ padārthaṃ paryupasthāpyanaiva paryupatiṣṭhate |
tasmāt tatra ( ālocanā- ) apekṣā'bhāvāt nāsti viprakarṣaḥ |
' utpattideśaḥ : saḥ ' iti ( sūtrāṃśasya ayamarthaḥ -- ) pūrvaḥ padārtho vihitaḥ , uttaraḥ padārtho vihitaḥ iti vidyamānānāṃ yaḥ kramaḥ , tena arthavān brāhmaṇapāṭhakramaḥ , nānuṣṭhānakrameṇeti |
' tasmāt mantrakrameṇai- vānuṣṭhānam , tadabhāve tu vidhirapi smārakaḥ iti tatraiva tatkramasya prāmāṇyam |
soma-- prathamāvagatatvāt yathā pūrvatra pāṭhakramasya prābalyamevaṃ ihāpīti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |

sūtrā- rthastu --- mantrabrāhmaṇakramavirodhe mantrapāṭhakramaḥ padārthakramaḥ syāt prayogasāmarthyāt mantrasya prayojyapadārthasāraṇe sāmarthyāt , brāhmaṇapāṭhastu utpattideśaḥ iti na prayoga- kāle smṛtyupayuktaḥ iti |
vi-- ' amīṣomīya āgneyāt pūrvo no vā , 'stu pūrvatā |

' bhāṭṭa-- pāṭhayostu mantrabrāhmaṇagatayormantrapāṭho balī- yān , na tu brāhmaṇapāṭhaḥ , tasyotpattiviniyogavidhivigata- tvena prabho'pasthitatve'pi pāṭhasya smārakakramavidhaiva kramaniyāmakatvokteḥ , mantrasattve ca tasyaiva smārakatvā vidhānopayuktasyāsamarthasya ca vidheḥ smārakatvābhāvāt mantrapāṭhakramaḥ eva balīyān |
tena yājyā'nuvākyādi- mantrapāṭhakramāt āgneyasya prathamānuṣṭhānam , paścācca upāṃśuyājottaramamīṣomīyasya |
na tu brāhmaṇapāṭhakramā- dagnīṣomīyasya prathamam , paścādupaśuyājottaramāgneyasya |
11. pāṭhe ānumāniko vidhiḥ pratyakṣeṇa vidhinā bādhyate |
bhā. 8|4|5|6. pāṭhādhikaraṇe brāhmaṇasya smārakatvaṃ vidhāyakatvaṃ cetyubhayārthatvaṃ vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 666. pāṭhādīnāṃ kramāpekṣāyāṃ niyamakatā tatraiva , yatra ekaprayogavidhiparigrahaḥ anekeṣām |
bhāṭṭa. 5|3|22. pāṭhopasthitasya kramasya viniyojakavākya- kalpanā advagate prayogavidhinā prayogavidhānam |
bhāṭṭa. 5|1|4, pāṭhakramaḥ arthakramena bādhyate ' agnihotraṃ juhoti , yavāgūṃ pacati ' ityādi |
pāṭhakramaḥ kāmyā- nuṣṭhāne na niyāmakaḥ , kintu yathākāmamanuṣṭhānam |
pāṭhakramaḥ nodakāśritatvā- dbalīyān , mukhyapravṛttikramo tu prayogavacanamāśritatvāt durbalaḥ |
ṭup. 5|1|20|18 , pāṭhakramaḥ pratyakṣaḥ , mukhyakramastu ānumānikaḥ ; tena pāṭhakramo mukhyakramāt balavān |
tena darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ājyanirvāpaḥ pūrvaṃ na kāryaḥ , agnīṣomīyanirvāpa eva ājyāt pūrvaṃ kāryaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pūrvamauṣadhadharmāḥ samā- mnātāḥ , tat ājyasya |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimagnīṣomīya- dharmāṇāṃ mukhyakrameṇa pūrvamājyasya dharmāḥ kartavyāḥ , uta yathāpāṭhamiti |
sahatvasya punarupasaṃgrāhakaḥ prayogavacanaḥ svakrameṇa padārthe saṃnikṛṣyamāṇe na bādhito bhaviṣyati |
ṭup-- ( iha tāvat pūrvādhikaraṇapādādarūpeṇa siddhāntamabhidhātuṃ mukhyapāṭhayorbalābalaṃ cintyate ) |
pūrveṇa nyāyena tathaiva ( mukhyakrameṇa anuṣṭhāne ) prāpte apavāda ārabhyate |
kalpanā ca vilambate ityāha - ) saha padārthāḥ kartavyāḥ iti padārtheṣu ayaṃ dharmaḥ : sahatvaṃ nāma ( apekṣitaḥ ) |
sahatvaṃ ( ca ) avabodhayan anyathā'nupapattyā kramamanumāpayati pradhānasattve ( pradhānasattvasiddhayartham ) |
tatra ( agneṣu ) yat aśrutakramānumānam , tat pratyakṣena ( pāṭha- ) krameṇa bādhyate |
( bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe - ) mukhyakrame prayogavacanena ekavākyatā sūkṣmā , aśrutaḥ kramaḥ kalpyate ityarthaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- prakṛtau yathākramaṃ yathāpāṭhakramaḥ nirvāpakramaḥ pratīyate , pāṭhakramasya svaśabdatvāt aṅgavagamakābdadharmatayā pratyakṣena jhaṭitya- vagamāditi |
teṣāṃ cāyādhikaraṇoktakrameṇa pāradaurbalyaṃ draṣṭavyam , na tu sūtra- krameṇa |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : āgneyopāṃśuyājāmīṣomīya rūpamukhyakramāt ājyasyopāṃśuyājasyaiva prathamaṃ nirvāpaḥ , paścādagnīṣomīya- dravyasya |
tatra pāṭhasya smārakavākyavṛttitvena pratyakṣatvāt śīghraupasthiteśca bala- vattvam |
mukhyakramastu mukhyayoreva prathamaṃ kenāpi pramāṇe- nāvagamya tadapekṣayā tatsāhityasattve kalpyamāno vilambita iti durbalaḥ |
11. naimittiko hi pāṭhakrama: itaṃ pāṭhakramaṃ bādhilā niviśate |
dup. 4|3|16|139, pūrva: padārtha: samāpyamāna: uttaraṃ buddhau abhiniyasyeti ityaṃ pāṭhakrama: bādhyate |
5|1|6|13, yatra ānupūrvyeṇa padārthā vidhīyante sa pāṭhakrama: |
5|1|129 pṛ.1289. pāṭhakrameṇa eva ṛca: āgamayitavyā: āgamena saṃkhyāpūre, ekaviṃśa triṇave trayaviṃśe cātirātre |
yathā- sāvitrahoma-uvāsabharaṇāyapūrvapadārthān vidhāya dīkṣaṇīyā- ''daya: prākṛtā: saguṇā: śrutā: |
tatra prākṛtena dīkṣaṇīyā- prācīnana padena upasthitānāṃ dīkṣaṇīyādīnāṃ sthānena prāganuṣṭhāne tata: prāk pāṭha
prayogavidhiparigraho yathā tatsatkāmyakarmaṇām, tatra na pāṭho niyāmakaḥ |
tatra tu svādhyāyatvasiddhayartha etropa- yujyate iti draṣṭavyam |
pāṭhakrama- nyāyānusāreṇa prayojakapradhānaprakṛtyatihārā prathamahaviḥ- śeṣasyaiva prāk smṛtiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1542. pāṭhasādṛśyaṃ dvividham- yathāsaṃkhyapāṭhaḥ saṃnidhi- pāṭhaśceti |
mīmāṃsā. pāṇinā nā''rṣānuśāsanaṃ kṛtam, kiṃ tarhi ? yathā lekhe'vasthito'styathāstitvasya śabdaśāsanaṃ kṛtam |
vā. 6|1|6|22 pṛ. 1374. pāṇinīkātyāyanapatañjalayo vyākartāraḥ manvā- disamānāḥ |
su. pṛ. 131. 'pālīvatamutsṛjanti' iti na karmāntaram, pūrva- syaiva utsṛjātidandena avacchedo vidhīyate |
2|3|8|19. pālīvataṃ grahaṃ āgra- yaṇāt upāṃśupātreṇa gṛhṇāti |
bhā. 3|2|1|33. pālīvatasya paśoḥ paryagnikaraṇāntaṃ guṇaḥ 'paryagni- kṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛjanti' iti |
tyāgaṃ pālīvataṃ vidhāya - 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛ- jati' iti tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ tvāṣṭrasya paryagnikṛtasyaiva utsargo vidhīyate, uta tasyādyāgāntaramiti |
ātmalambhanādipayo- pratyudāharaṇatvena yasmidamabhidhānaṃ nirākṛtyante prakṛto- dāharaṇe'pi yasmidamabhidhānaṃ nirākriyate |
atrāyaṃ pūrva- pakṣiṇo'bhisaṃdhiḥ- yadyapi 'tyāgaṃ pālīvatamālabheta' iti yāgaṃ vidhāya taṃ prakṛtya śrūyate 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛ- jati' iti, tathāpi pūrvatra guṇavidhānāt karmāntara-
tathāhi, na tāvat pūrvasmin yāge vikalpena pālīvataśabdo'pyekatā vidhīyate, utpattiśiṣṭadevatā''varodhāt |

tena vākyadhavākyavat patnīvacchabdābhidheyadravya- devatānvayārthasaṃkrānta'yaṃ vidhiḥ kalpitayajñiṣṭhadaprati- pārtha yāgāntarameva dravyadevatāviśiṣṭaṃ devatāguṇasāmānvena paryagnayāgaprakṛtikam, amīṣomīyaprakṛtikameva vā vidhāti iti |
tatra yadyapyanye guṇā na vidhīyante, tathāpi paryagnikaraṇānti aṅgānyeva atrā vidhāsyante |

tathāhi, kāmyabhāvākāṅkṣī tyājyayogavacanaḥ prakṛtau klṛptopakāraka- pyaṅghāni apekṣamāṇaḥ paryagnikṛtaśabdopanītānyeva tadantāni aṅgāni aupadeśikāni gṛhītvā caritārthā natideśa- labhyāni aṅgāntarāṇyapekṣate |
nanu 'idāntā ātithyā saṃtiṣṭhate' ityādidavva nātra paryagnikaraṇāntipratipādaka- śabdo'sti |
tacca paryagnikaraṇaṃ pūrvaviṣṇu kṛteṣveva prakṛtau nirvṛttam, tena paryagniśabdo'tra prakṛtacodanāprātipādita- meva aṅkakalāpamupanayati |
sa evātra utsṛjatyākhyāttvartanā vidhinā utsargatanvādena vidhīyate, naivotsargaḥ |
vidhi- pratyayasaṃnidhiviśeṣeṇa bhāṣyakāreṇoktam 'utsargo vidhī- yate' iti |
na ca vācyam 'atideśato'pi prāptyataḥ' kiṃ vidhinā' iti |
na caivaṃ sati parisaṃkhyā, atideśaprāpteḥ prāgeva vidhiprāpteḥ |
nāpi vācyam 'yattustyajati tatparyagnikṛta- mityetāvatteva vākyasamāptau punaḥ pālīvata miti viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭānuvādāt vākyabhedaḥ syāt' iti |
yato noddeśya- viśeṣaṇaṃ pālīvataśabdādyaiḥ, cinā'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ prakaraṇādeva paryagnikaraṇavidheḥ : tvāṣṭrasaṃbhavāt |

anuvādyasya ca yadyapi anyatrayojanaṃ nāsti, tathāpi miśritadvitāntapadābhidheyadevatāyoḥ samuccaye ekenāpi tadantāntena padena tadabhidhānaṃ śakyam, natvekāditvānta- padābhidheyayoḥ samuccitadevatāyoramīṣomayoranyatarapadeneti
ataḥ prakaraṇapratyayabhijñāte tyādyayāga evaṃ paryagnikaraṇāntā''kṛti- vidhānamiti siddham |
nanvevaṃ sati gṛhamedhīyena sahāsya ko viśeṣaḥ ? ucyate, atra devatā'bhidhānaṃ nirākṛtya guṇavidhitva- vyutpādanena sa eva nyāyaḥ sthirīkriyate iti nānupapannaṃ kiñcit |
sūtraṃ tu pālīvate patnīvadupadavākye pūrvavallādupadeśenaiva prākṛtadharmavattva- saṃbhavāt paryagnikaraṇajñāptikārijñānāmavacchedaḥ phalaṃ vidherityarthaḥ |
tvāṣṭraṃ pālīvataṃ vidhāya - 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛ- janti' ityucyate |

atra kiṃ tvāṣṭrasya paryagnikṛtasya eṣa utsargo vidhīyate uta tasyādyāgāntaram, utsṛtirapi yajerabhidhānaṃ na vā, utsṛjatiḥ guṇavidhiḥ, uta karmā- ntaraṃ iti vicāre yāgāntaramiti pūrvapakṣe siddhānta- māha |
pālīvate 'paryagni- kṛtaṃ pālīvatam' iti vākye na karmā'ntaravidhiḥ |
kintu pūrvatvāt prakṛtapratyayabhijñānāt paryagnikaraṇāntāṅga- kalāpavidhānena uttarāṅgānāmavacchedaḥ |
tasmāt pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ avacchedaḥ paryagnikaraṇāntāṅga- kalāpena parisamāptiḥ utsṛjātivākyenoktā iti siddhāntaḥ |
agniṣṭome prātaḥsavane aindrāvāyavamaitrāvaruṇāḥ dvivedayā grahāḥ santi |
'catuḥsrayo dhārābhyaḥ āgra- yaṇaṃ gṛhṇāti' 'āgrayaṇasyudisravya dvitīyāṃ dhārāṃ karoti' 'ādityasyāḥ tṛtīyām' 'ādityagrahaṇāt
tadetat sāgrayaṇāt pālīvatagraha- grahaṇamātrāt 'āgrayaṇāt pālīvataṃ gṛhṇāti' iti |
aya tasmin pālīvate hute taccheṣe bhakṣayamāṇe bhakṣamantre kathaṃ devatānardeśaḥ kartavyaḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
pūrvavat pūrvādhikaraṇasiddhāntayā pālīvate somabhakṣe sarveṣāṃ devatānāmulakṣaṇaṃ kartavyam 'vārindravāyumitrā- varuṇā''dityapatnīvatpatyasa' iti paṭhanīyam |
punara- bhyujītātā'syaiva unnayanena mitrāvaruṇādidevatā''ntardhatayā tatsaṃsthāpi aindraśeṣasya mitrāvaruṇādidevatā''ntara- saṃndhābhāvāt na pūrvadevatā''panīyaḥ |

'āgra- yaṇāt pālīvataṃ gṛhṇāti' iti pālīvate tu dvidevatyā- diśeṣasaṃkhvāt āgrayaṇāt gṛhyamāṇasya saṃsṛṣṭarūpeṇaiva pālīvadrūpadevatā''ntardhatayā grahaṇamāt pūrvaśeṣaḥ pūrvadevatā- saṃndhādapanītaḥ syāt |
'paryagnikṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛjanti' ityatra patnīvacchabdasya paśutvalakṣaṇatvāt tadyudanādaraḥ : 'pālīvate'nupūrvatvā- davacchedaḥ' : (2|3|8|19) ityatroktaḥ |
pālīvate paśau 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati' iti vākyena karmāntaravidhānam ||
bhāṣyam-- 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛjati' iti prakṛtya śrūyate 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimājyaṃ pūrvasmin (karmaṇi) pratinidhī- bhūtam, athavā ājyadravyakaṃ pūrvasāt karmāntaraṃ vidhī- yate iti |
tat ājyena saṃsthāpayati iti paśoḥ kārya ājyaṃ śrutaṃ bha- vīti |
dravyotsargavacane pratyakṣe, śeṣaśabde vā aparicchede puna- rasamāntaṃ pūrvakarma iti |
tena manyāmahai yat pūrvaṃ paśunā ārabdham, tat utsṛṣṭaṃ paśau ājyena pari- samāpyate iti |
apūrvasyātra-karmaṇa udyamanasya ārambha eva vaktavyo bhavati |
yatastu anabhidhāya ārambhaṃ pari- samāptirevocyate, tato'gacchāmaḥ pūrvasyaiva parisamāptiḥ, nāpūrvaṃ karma codyate iti |
nanvetaṃ dravyotsargaṃ śeṣavacane vā aparicchede pūrvakarmaṇaḥ asamāptirāśaṅkitā bhavati |
avaśyaṃ kaścit dhātuḥ saṃpūrvo bhāvanāvacanasya prayogyaḥ iti |
tatrā- viruddhe bhāvanāyāmunnīyamānāyā arthaprāptaḥ saṃsthāpayatiḥ ālambhatira prayujyate, śeṣaśabdeśca sādṛśyat prayujyate |
tasmāt yathā anye nirvapalādayaḥ karmāntaravidhāne bhavanti, evaṃ tairaviśiṣṭatvāt saṃsthāpayatirapi bhavitumarhatīti |
anijyāṃ ca vanaspateḥ prasiddhāṃ tena darśayati |
katham ? ‘yat tvaṣṭāraṃ ca vanaspatiṃ (tiṃ cāvā) māvāhayasi, atha vaitau yakṣyasi, tvāṣṭrī navamī prayājejyā, vānaspatyā daśamī |
atraivaitau idhai vidyāt’ iti addhāntareṇa anugrahaṃ bruvan vanaspatijyā abhāvaṃ darśayati |
śeṣaparisamāptau satyām ‘vanaspatiṃ juhoti’ iti vanaspatijyā kriyate |
atha parisamāptaṃ pūrve karma, tato hyamā syāt, tatra amāvardarśanamupapadyate |
bhāṣyam--atha yaduktam ‘saṃsthāpayati iti cā- pūrve nopapadyate’ iti, tat parihartavyam |
tadapi pūrva pālīvatamiti samānadevatvāt, samāptisāhacaryaṃ jñāyate |
sa eṣa sāhacaryāt saṃsthāpayati iti śabdaḥ avakalpate iti |
tatra ca yāgāntaravidhitve eva tasya liṅgatvamupapadyate iti tasya yāgāntaravidhitva- samarthanāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu--‘ājyena śeṣaṃ (saṃ)sthāpayati’ ityatra ājyaṃ pratinidhiḥ syāt paśudravyasya utsṛṣṭena karmaṇo dravyopadeśatvāditi |
tatra hi ‘parya- miṃkṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛjati’ ityuktvā ‘ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati’ iti śrutam |
tatkaraṇe ca viśasanādipadārthalope'pi anyā'lope pramāṇābhāvāt śeṣaṃ yat sviṣṭakṛttyājādi-, tat ājyena saṃsthāpayati iti vidhīyate |
yadyapi ca prayājādau ājyaṃ prāptameva, tathāpi sviṣṭakṛtprasthāpidādau ājyavidhirna virudhyate |
na ca visasanābhāvādeva vyaṅgasaṃbhavāt ‘yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi’ ityanenaiva sviṣṭakṛttyājya āprāptiḥ śakyatvā, nāśādinnimittābhāvena tadaprāpteḥ |
nahi atra karmāntare kiñcit pramāṇamasti, pratyuta śeṣasaṃsthāpadyoranupapattiḥ |
iti prāpte, ‘yat tvaṣṭāraṃ ca vanaspatiṃ (ca) āvā- hayasi atha vaitau yakṣyasi’ iti pṛṣṭhe ‘tvāṣṭrī navamī prayājejyā, vānaspatyā daśamī, atraivaitau idhai vidyāt |
iti vanaspatiyāgasya ajñāntareṇa anugrahavacane abhāvā- vagateḥ, tasya ca apūrvatvamantareṇa anupapatteḥ na pūrva- vākye pradhānakartṛmevātravidhiḥ |
yadyapi cākriyamāṇasya vana- spatiyāgasya devatā'vāhanamapi naiva prāpyate, tathāpi siddhavannirdeśādanyā'nupapattaiva āvāhanavidhivikalpanā |
tvaṣṭustu pradhānadevatātvādevāvāhanā'virodhaḥ, prakṣepabhāvā- bhiprāpeṇa ca navamyā anugrahahoktiḥ |
ataśca pūrvakarmaṇi śeṣābhāvena ājyavidhānānupapatteḥ guṇāt karmāntaramevedaṃ ājyadravyakaṃ anuṣakkartṛtvādevatyaṃ upāṃśuyājaprakṛtikamitam |
śeṣasaṃsthāyādau tu pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ asamāptaprāyatayā kathañcit anuvākaviti |
vidhiviṣayasya niḥsandigdhasya pālīvatapadasya devatā- paratvopapatteḥ yāgānāmupalakaṃ iti pālīvatatvādhikaraṇa- pūrvapakṣanyāyasvarūpam |
pālīvatagrahasya yājyā mantraḥ : ‘aimireme sarayaṃ yāhyahaṃ-o’ iti |
bhā. 3|2|1|37. pālīvata- grahasya homamantraḥ ‘amā'gne patnīvāhanaṃ sarjudaivena tvaṣṭā somaṃ piba svāhā’ iti |
pālīvatagrahabhakṣaṇe pūrvadevatā indrādayo nopalakṣaṇīyāḥ, kintu ‘patnī- vatītyasya’ ityeva paṭhanīyam |
pālīvatayāge sākṣāt paśurevāṅgama, na tu hṛdayādīni ‘paryagnikṛtaṃ pālīvatamutsṛjanti’ iti utsargavidhānāt |
pātraṃ anujāyāryagrahadhāraṇārthe prayājājyapātrā- dvidhaṃ agnīṣomīye paśau |
5|2|8|16. pātraṃ prayājaśeṣa- dhāraṇārthaṃ ca vājapeyagataprājāpatyapātrā''mi- dhāraṇārthaṃ na kartavyam |
4|1|14. pātraṃ vāraṇavaikṣakatā- dijanyaṃ daśapūrṇamāsādi sarvayajñeṣu viniyujyate |
vi. 3|1|12. pavitraṃ hi somāḥ, na tasmin bhakṣite pātraṃ vyapadyate |
bhā. 3|5| 7|22. pātrāṇi ‘āhitāgnimagnibhirdahanti yajña- pātraiśca’ iti yajñapātrāṇāṃ pratipattiḥ |
iti punaḥ punaḥ prayogāntareṣu tānyeva prayoktavyāni |
vi. 1|1|13. pātrāṇi ekasmin prayoge prayuktānyapi punaḥ prayogāntare prayogā- narhāṇi na bhavanti |
tānyeva pātrāṇi prakṣālya punaḥ punarmṛdyāṇi, na tu icchayā medaḥ |
1|1|13. pātrāṇi tu dadedagniṃ yajamāne yathā mṛte’ ayaṃ kriyāpratinidhiniyamavidhiḥ |
bāḻa. pṛ. 23. pātrāṇi satre sādhāraṇāni pṛthageva kartavyāni |
su. pṛ. 1063. pātrāṇāṃ yajinānāmādhānamārabhyaiva thāva:maraṇaṃ dhāraṇaṃ kartavyam |
11|3|14. pātre ekasmin bahubhi: somabhakṣaṇe hotu: prathama bhakṣa: |
some yāni darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtīni karmāṇi yathā savanīya: paśu:, savanīyā: puroḍāśā:, saumyaśca: iti, teṣāṃ homa: dāśikai: pātrai: kartavya: |
pātreṣu ca vedyā- miva prasaṅga: syāt |
yathā saumikyā vedyā dāśikyā prasaṅga:, tathā saumikai: pātrai: dāśikapātrāṇāṃ prasaṅga: |
same yāni darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtīni karmāṇi, teṣāṃ home darśapūrṇamāsikāni pātrāṇi prayoktuṃ nyāyyāni |
prayuktatvāt saumikatvāt prāk ādhyāsādanāntasya prākṛtasya tantrasya prakāntatvāt 'atha yadgṛhītvā ājyāni somamāsāda- yeyu: apaghnanti yajamānam' iti vākyena |
aprayukte yadi dāśikaṃ pātraṃ prayuktaṃ na syāt tadā saumikai: pātrai: dāśikānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ prasaṅga: syāt |
tāni tu atra prayuktyeva pūrva iti dāśikaireva savanīyapuroḍāśādi- homa: syāt iti siddhānta: |
ke. pātreṣu dāśaurṇamāsikeṣu savanīyapuroḍāśasaumya- caruhomayo: saumikai: pātrairna prasaṅga: |
evaṃ jñātvā pātrāpātravicāra: kartavya iti bhāva: |
776. pātranyāyena dhanānyupetyā samārgasrucāṃ bhedena kartuṃ śakyatvāt na prasaṅgopapatti: (pātrabhedanyāya evāyam |

kau. 2|1|5|12 pṛ. 85, na ca evamapi pātranyāyena havirāsādanarūpasya kāryasya pṛthaggantavyatvāt na prasaṅgopapatti:, kartṛpracārārthamanuṣṭhitenaiva saumikavedikaraṇena adṛṣṭaviśeṣāvacchinnāhavanīyapraṇayadeśa- rūpāyā vede: siddhatvāt aiṣṭikavedikaraṇena prasaṅgopa- pādanāt |
agnīṣomīye paśau anuyājārthasya pṛṣadājyasya dhāraṇārthe pātraṃ bhinnam |
tatra saṃdeha: kiṃ prayājānuyājānāmekaṃ pātraṃ ājyasya pṛṣadājyasya ca dhāraṇārtham, uta bhidyate |
pṛṣati gṛhyamāṇe prayājānāṃ vaiguṇyam, śuddhe anuyājānām |
na ca ekasmin pātre viviktaṃ śakyaṃ kartum |
api ca ākārabhedāt upabhṛta: upabhṛtaṃ vihanyeta |
athocyeta pṛṣadājyamapi ājyameva iti miśratvaṃ na doṣāyeti |
prakṛtau upavanāvekṣaṇayo: prayojanametat yat ājyasya apareṇa dravyeṇasaṃsarga: |
evaṃ cet anupapannam, yat prayājā: pṛṣadājyena ijyeranniti |
api ca evaṃ sati avaśyaṃ havi: kā cinmātrā apanīyate |
na ca śakyaṃ prayājakāryaṃ avasite anuyājārthe grahītum |
ṭup-- (pūrvapakṣamāha--) prakṛtau upabhṛta: ekatvam ('aṣṭāvupabhṛti gṛhṇāti' ityādipadyagatatvāt) niva- kṣitamiti (heto:) tatraiva pṛṣadājyagrahaṇaṃ prāpnoti kālāntare |
tatra yathā satyapi pradhānakālatve aṅgānāṃ kartṛtvādiprakarṣa:, na tu viprakarṣadoṣāt kartṛntaranupā- dīyate, evamājyapṛṣadājyayorbheda'pi naiva pātrāntaramupā- deyam |
(tadekatvānugrahāthai tu viprakarṣaṃ evāṅgīkartavya iti) evaṃ prāpte, brūma: |
yathaiva hi prakṛtau ekapātrā vivakṣitā evamekakālatā |
iha tu (yatra dravyabhedāt ubhayānugrahasaṃbhava: ) ekakālaṃ vivakṣitam (naika pātratvam ) |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? prayājājyaṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ mantra- brāhmaṇapāṭhakramāt anuyājājyagrahaṇamupasthāpayati |
(evaṃ tāvat vivakṣitamapi pātraikatvamiha bādhyate iti siddhāntitam |

mātāntaramāha-) athavā, 'aṣṭāvupabhṛti gṛhṇāti' iti asaṃkhyotpannasya (caturgṛhītadravyasya kevalam) vākyantareṇa ( yadupabhṛti, prayājānuyājemyastāt' ityanena ) prayājānuyājārthatā kṛtā, na tu upabhṛt ( prayājānuyājāṅgatvena ) vidhīyate (natarāṃ tadekatvam) |
arthalavdhā sā (yatrakacana pātre grahītavye sati juhumuyo: ājyāntaradhāraṇe vyāptatvāt anyāpṛtā upabhṛt anucyate ) |
(pūrvapakṣe prayājahomānantaraṃ pṛṣadājyagrahaṇam, siddhānte tu prākṛte eva sthāne iti) |
śā-- kiṃ kālabhedena tasyāmevopabhṛti prayājājyaṃ anuyājapṛṣadājyaṃ ca dvayaṃ grahītavyam, uta ekakāle pātrabhedeneti cintyate |
tata: ekasminneva pātre prayājājyaṃ prathamaṃ gṛhītvā prayājeṣu huteṣu paścāt pṛṣadājyaṃ grahītavyam |
' tathā ca ājyagrahaṇakāle eva pātrāntaramupādāya pṛṣadājyaṃ grahītavyam |
soma-- pūrvatra ulūpalaikvatat iha upabhṛtaikyaṃ iti pratyavasthānatā saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu- vikāre paśau anuyājānārthabhedāt dravyabhedāt pātrabheda: syāditi |
bhāṭṭa- deśe paśau anuyājānām 'pṛṣadājyenānu- yājān yajati' iti pṛṣadājyaṃ śrutam |
prakṛtau ca upabhṛti ekasminneva pātre prayājājyaṃ caturgṛhīta gṛhītamasīt |
atrāpi tathaiva grahaṇe prayājājyasya dadhihasaṃyogena utpannavikṣepaṇayo: aṣṭadhā- yatvaprasaṅgena aprākṛtakāryakāritāpatte: samānayanavelāyāṃ prayājājyasya nyūnatvāpatteśca |

ato'vaśyaṃ pātraikalamanugṛhya kramo bādhyatāṃ viparītāṃ vā iti cintāyām, pātraikyasya śrutatvāt padārthatvācca bādhānupapatte: kramasyaiva mantrapāṭha- kalpatvena dravyatvena ca daurbalyatayā śiṣṭākopādhikaraṇa- nyāyena (1|3|15-6) bādha: |
na ca prakṛtau tayo: klṛptakalpatvādanā valāble- 'pi vikṛtau atideśena prāptastayo: samatvāt na balābala- miti śakyam |
klṛptakalpatvayādirūpabalavattvasya vikṛtau asaṃbhave'pi padārthatadguṇatvādidakṛtabalavattvasya vikṛtau niyāmakatvopapatte: |
saṃbhavati vikṛtau nāmāntarasattve prākṛtasyāpi balābalasya śabdadaśāttve catu:saṃkhyā- muṣṭihaviṣprāyajadhanyatvasya niyāmakatā |

iti prāpte, pātraikyasya padārthatve'pi anujñeyapadārthamātratrikramasya taddharmatvābhāvāt, pratyuta sākṣādgrahaṇāṅgabhūtakramakalā- dyapekṣayā grahaṇabhūtapātrādyaikatvasya aṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyena daurbalyata tadeva upabhṛtadvayaṃ saṃpādya śuddhaṃ dadhisaṃskṛtaṃ ca caturgṛhītadvayaṃ grāhyam |
bhāṣ. 5|2|7. pātryām ‘syonaṃ te sadanam’ ityādipūrvā- dharupamantreṇa ājyena puroḍāśasya sadanaṃ kṛtvā ‘tasmin sīda’ iti mantreṇa puroḍāśasādanaṃ kāryam|
vi. 3|3|8. pāthiktādīnāṃ naimittikānāṃ yāgānāṃ pādakramo na niyāmakaḥ; kintu yathānimittamanuṣṭhānam|
5|3|12. pāthiktīṣṭivaiśvānaredirghā darśapūrṇamāsasya vā svakāle ākaraṇe prāyaścittaṃ vikalpena|
vi. 9|2|6 varṇakaṃ 4. pādavyavasthā ṛkṣu aparyavasite'rthe vṛttaśabdena |
tadabhāve'pi, yadyapi samudāyavacanoḍayam, na ca vaikṛte- pyamasti samudāyaḥ, tathāpi parvaṇahomau bhavetāmeva |
samu- dāyo vā asaṃnihito'pi yakṣyate sauryādyupakārārthena |
yathā 'agnima āvaha' iti saṃnihitaḥ asaṃnihito vā abhiyāṃgāhvena āvāhate |
ādhikārikaṃ hīdaṃ vacanaṃ adhikāre bhavam, yasyādhikārastasya guṇaṃ vidadhātīti |
evaṃ yatra sā devatā nāsti, tatra tadartho homo na kariṣyate |
(ke-50-55 iti ṣaṭ sūtrāṇi bhāṣye ekādhi- karaṇatvena vyākhyāya uttare dve (56-57) sūtre adhikārāntaratvena vyākhyāte |
vārtikakāreṇa tu tat dupayitvā prakṛtādhikaraṇaprayojanapratipādanaparatvena te sūtre vyākhyāte |
tacca vārtikaṃ atra vā adhikaraṇe niveśyaṃ uttarasmin bhāṣyakārīyādhikaraṇe vā niveśyaṃ iti saṃkaṭe patitā vayam |
parantu 'parvaṇahomayornatasyaiva' ityuttarādhikaraṇe eva niveśitamasmābhiriti tatraiva draṣṭavyam |
) śa— 'suveṇa parvaṇau juhoti' iti taddhitaśrutyā parvadevatyau homau hi vikṛtiṣu atidiśyete, neti saṃśayaḥ |
( tadarthaṃ ca kimārādupakārakau homau, uta saṃskārārthau iti, tadarthaṃ ca kiṃ parvaśabdaḥ kālavacanaḥ, uta āgneyādisamudāyaparaḥ iti cintā |
sa ca dīyate asmin ityadhikaraṇavyutpattyā kāle'pi mukhyaḥ, bhāva- vyutpattyā karmaṇyapi |
soma— sūtrārthastu- parvaṇahomayorvikṛtiṣu apra- vṛttiḥ, parvaśabdasya karmasamudāyārthaparatvāt |
vi— 'sauryādau pārvaṇau homau sto na vā, kāla- devakī |
' ( 'ṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vadhaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe' ityādiḥ pūrṇamāsāgataparvahomamantraḥ |
'amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā dhenuriva bhūya āpyāyamānā' ityādiḥ darśagataparvaṇa- homamantraḥ |
) bhāṭṭa— darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'suveṇa parvaṇau homau juhoti' iti śrutam |
tatra saṃvyābhiḥ karmadayaṃ suparva- devatāviśiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate |
na ca haviḥsamabhivyāhārāt nāyaṃ devatātādvitaḥ ; saṃcadhasāmāyavācina eva yogyatayā devatāparatvopapatteḥ |
tadidaṃ homadayaṃ vikṛtāvātidiśyate na veti cintāyām, prayājavadatideśasaṃbhavaḥ |
na ca parvaśabdavācyakarmasamudāyasyaiva devatābhūtasya uddeśyārthe saṃskārāt, tasya ca vikṛtau abhāvāt atideśaḥ, parvaśabdasya kāle mukhyatayā karmaṇo lakṣaṇāṅgīkāre pramāṇābhāvāt |
ato'tra kālasyaiva devatātvāt, tasya cāsaṃskāryatvāt ārādupakārakayoranayoryukta evātideśaḥ |

yadi tu kālasyāpi karmāṅgatvopayogāt smṛtibalena sarvādī smṛta- syāpi punarākālikatvasaṃbhāvanānimittakaśraddhāparihārāya karmadeva smaraṇopapatteḥ sāmavāyikatvalābhāya kālasaṃskāra- katvamabhipreta, tathāpi vikṛtau tatkālīnāyāmatideśe bādhakābhāvāt |

astu vā parvaśabdasya puṇatādeinavācitvāt adhikaraṇavyutpattyā kālavācitvavat bhāṣyavyutpattyā karmavācitvasyāpi saṃbhavatvāt prakaraṇātkarmapara- tvameva, tathāpi parvaśabdavācyasyāpi āgneyādisamudāyasya vikṛtatvāpi devatātvasaṃbhavādādupakārakayoḥ anayoratideśe na kiñcidbādhakam |

yadi tu saṃnipatyopakārakatvalābhāthaṃ devatāsaṃskāratvamabhipreta, tathāpi parvatvasya dānatvāpa- ryāyasya pratyekamāgneyādivṛttitvā samudāyavṛttitvābhāvā- dapūrvasādhanatvena rūpeṇa āgneyādīnāṃ pratyekamevadevatvalā- gateḥ havirbhirśanamantravat vikṛtāvātideśopapattiḥ |
na ca tatra śabdata eva haviṣāpyuddeśyatvāvagateḥ uddeśyāsāhityasya tvāccittvatvāt yukto'tideśaḥ |
prakṛte tu taddhitaśabdena devatātvena eteṣāmupādānāt sāhityaviṣayopapatteḥ |

satyapi vaiguṇyanyāyenoddeśyavācakapadāntarakalpanāyā āgne- yādīnāṃ pratyekamuddeśyatve upādeyatādaśāyāṃ vivakṣita- sāhityānāmāgneyādīnāmeva devatātvāvagamāt, vikṛtau ca teṣāmanupayogitvena saṃskāryatvā'nupapatterdevatāsaṃskārakayoḥ parvaṇahomayornatideśaḥ iti vācyam |
itarathā svāhākārapaśu- puroḍāśādāvapi agnīṣomatyādineva devatātvāpatteḥ saurya- savanīyādau teṣāmatideśānāpattiḥ |

vastutastu viśiṣṭavidhau gauravāpatteḥ, haviḥsamabhivyāhārābhāvena ca devatātādvita- tvānniścayāt parvaṇau bhavo parvasaṃskārakau ca ityevamapi taddhitopapatteryatastathā tadavadhāraṇādyogāt nāyaṃ devatā- taddhitaḥ |
mantravarṇādeva tu kramāvagatāṅgatatvāt devatā- prāptisiddheḥ parvaṇamidaṃ nāmetyameva |
ata eva yājñikānāṃ 'ṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vadhaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe' 'amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā' iti mantragatapūrṇamāsāmāvāsyāśabdayoreva tyāgavelāyāmuddeśaḥ, na tu parvaśabdasya |

evaṃ ca tatra- tpūrṇamāsāmāvāsyāśabdayoḥ kāle prayogābhāvāt mantrārtha- paryālocanayā karmaparatvāvagateḥ aikaikasya āgneyādi- trikasaṃskārakatve'pi pūrvoktarītyā paśupuroḍāśādivat sauryādāvatideśe bādhakābhāvāt |
nabuddeśyāṃśasya prayojaka- sattve paramuddeśyadevatopajīvitvāgāśe svarūpeṇa āgneyā- devaitattvaṃ saṃbhavati |
ato yenaiva apūrvasādhanaviśeṣa- rūpeṇa uddeśyāṃśaṃ prati saṃskāryatā, tenaiva rūpeṇa, tyāgāṃśaṃ prati devatātvamiti yukta eva paśupuroḍāśāderiva parvaṇa- homorapi atideśaḥ |

evaṃ vaiguṇyeḍapi yenaiva rūpeṇa apūrvasādhanaviśeṣatvāt pūrṇamāsā uddeśyatā, tenaiva rūpeṇa uttarakālapratiyogitvaṃ dṛṣṭārthatvāt, na tu samu- ditāmevatvādilepeti uddeśyatā''vacchedakakoṭi sāhitya- syāmeyatayā avivakṣitatvāt yukta eva vaiguṇyasyāpi vikṛtāvātideśaḥ |
astu vā tatroddeśyatā''vacchedakakoṭau sāhityādyavivakṣayāyāmyuttarakālapratiyogitve upādeyatvāt 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvā' itivat vivakṣā |
ataśca saume vikṛtyuttaratvaprasaṅgatvat sauryādāvapi paurṇamāsyuttaratvā- bhāvāt nātideśaprasaṅgaḥ |
anyārambhaṇīyāyāṃ tu sāhityā- derivakṣā darśapūrṇamāsātvasya uddeśyatā''vacchedakakoṭi- praviṣṭatvābhāvāditi yuktastathā atideśaḥ |
prakṛte parvaṇa- homayostu āśrayikarmatvena paraprayuktadevatopajīvitvāt svarūpeṇa āgneyādīnāṃ devatātvānupapatteryukta evatideśaḥ |
yattu samudāyaparvaprayuktatvān parvaṇahomayoraḥ, vikṛtau na sauryādau tadabhāvādanatideśa iti |
atha tasya prayojakatā na samudāyaparvatvena, apitu utsaparvaṇapūrvaparvatveneti teṣāṃ sauryādāvatideśaḥ, tataḥ parvaṇahomayorapi tulyam |

iti prāpte, satyamevam, tathāpi keṣāmapi yājñikānāṃ vikṛtau parvaṇahomānanuṣṭhānāt, ācārasyaiva prakṛtau sāhi- tyasya āgneyāderdevatātvacchedakakoṭi vivakṣā, na tu tasya ca vikṛtau abhāvādanatideśaḥ parvaṇahomādīnām |
ata eva nātideśaḥ tattaddhitārthupadeśenāpyanyathāśruti- kalpanā, gauravāpatteḥ |
atra prathamavākyena ekamardharcaṃ kṛtvā ana- ntaravākyatrayeṇa uttarārdharcaṃ kṛtvā homakāle mantrau prayoktavyau |
pratimantraṃ ca homārthamekaikaṃ svāhāntaṃ vākyaṃ brāhmaṇena saṃyojitam |
pārśvikabodha: yādṛśopapadadyasamabhivyāhāre ā- gopālāṅganaṃ tadarthayo: yādṛśo'nyo''vagamyate tādṛśasyaiva tadarthayo: anyānvayasyaiva pārśvikabodhaviṣayatvam |
ata eva aṇaikahāyanasthale paricchedaparicchedakabhāva eva pārśvikabodhaviṣaya: |
vipratipattau vikalpaḥ syāt samatvād, guṇe tanyāyakalpyaikadeśatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- asti paśudvitīyemīyaḥ 'yo dīkṣito yadaśrīpobhīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatra pāśaikatvābhidhāyī ('aditiḥ pāśāṃ pramumoktvetam' taisaṃ. 3|1|1|19 ) pāśabahutvābhidhāyī ca ('aditiḥ pāśān pramumokte- tān' maisaṃ. 1|2|1|08, kāsaṃ. 3|045 ) mantrau samāmnātau |
tayoḥ kimekatvābhidhāyī prakaraṇe niviśate, bahutvābhidhāyī prakaraṇādutkṛṣyate, uta ubhayatrāpi prakaraṇa- mabhiniviśate iti |
kutaḥ ? bahunā hi sa pāśānāṃ mocakaḥ |
na ca prakaraṇe bahavaḥ pāśāḥ santi ! tasmāt prakaraṇe asaṃśrayamāno yatra bahuvaḥ pāśāstatra nīyate |
yathā 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarvatī iti dvayoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt' iti
yatra tu eka eva mantraḥ tatra patnīnyāyaḥ 'pavitre sthaḥ' iti yathā |
abhigrathne meghapataye meghapatibhyāṃ ityatra patiśabdo yajamānapara eva, na devataparaḥ; na ca tasyaikatvena dvivacanānupapattiḥ, pāśanyāyena tadupapatteḥ; iti prāpte |
bhāṭṭa. 9|3|122, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'patnī saṃnahya' ityekavacanānto mantraḥ dvivupalīkaprayogayoḥ avikāreṇaiva prayoktavyaḥ |
'patnī saṃnahya' ityatra sādhāraṇaṃ tūpadeśe sarvaprayogasamavetāyatayā patnīpade prātipadikaṃ karmakārakavibhaktiśca ityubhayameva pāśanyāye
bhāṣyam-- aya yān śabdān āryā na kasima- ścidarthe ācaranti, mlecchāstu kasimaścit prayuñjate, yathā pika-nema-sata-tāmarasādiśabdāḥ|
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ nigamaniruktavyākaraṇavaśena dhātuto'rthaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ, uta yatra mlecchā ācaranti sa śabdārtha iti|

avirodhe durbalasyāpi ādyatvāt yadevālyantaṃ pramāṇabhāsameva mṛgatṛṣṇājñānavat bhavati tat sarvadaiva parihartavyam, yat punarvalavadvirodhāpekṣameva pramāṇaṃ bhavati, tat virodhābhāvāt pramāṇamevetyavadhāraṇīyam |
' aṣṭakādiṣu hi adṛṣṭārtheṣu samulakeṣu sarvamāmeṣu gavādipadasvarūpa- tadarthajñāneṣu ca satyaṃ āryāṇāmetaratvābhiyuktatve vidheye |
pikādiṣu tu āryatvenaiva avagatasvarūpamātra- vācakatveṣu vācyaviśeṣajñānarahitatvena āryeṣu nirvyāpārī- bhūteṣu padavat |
6|8|18. piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ darśapaurṇamāsepi kāryaḥ darśavikāreṣu ca nātideśo'sya |
somayāge darśapaurṇamāsorastasyaiva ' darśaṃ pitṛyajñottaratvasya asambhavameva prathamaṃ nirūpyatām |
ata eva ' prātaragnihotraṃ hutvā''nyāmadhānīyaṃ praṇayati ' iti vihitaṃ praṇayanamapi pitṛyajñāṅgeṣva |
idhyadravye ante pareyuḥ karmāpagame eva tadapanayena pitṛyajñāsyābhāvapatteḥ |
na vā aiṣṭikānāmiva saumikapraṇayanopakāryatvam, tasya darśāntratvāt |
praṇayanasya pitṛyajñāṅgatve tu tadapavarge darśārthaṃ punaḥ praṇayanasaṃbandhāt, hutvā iti kañcāpratyayasya pūrvakālamātraparatvena aparāhṇe eva praṇetumucitatvāt, vacanādapakarṣo vā |

iti prāpte, pūrvāparāhṇakālavihitayoḥ anvādhānapitṛyajñayoḥ kālāti-kramāyogāt praṇayanasyāpale karaṇe prātaragnihotraṃ hutvetyasya anatiprayojanakatvāpatteḥ, pitṛyajñasyāpavarge'pi dārśikapraṇayanena prasaṅgādupakārasiddheḥ, praṇayanavidhyanantaraṃ dārśikanekapadāryavidhānadarśanena ca klṛptavyavasthāsaṃdigdhatvāt darśa-tantraprakramottarameva svakāle pitṛyajñaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 4|4|8. piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ yadi paurṇamāsyāmācaraṃ tadā anantarāyāmāvāsyāyāṃ kartavyaḥ, kuṇḍapāyināyane ' māsaṃ darśapaurṇamāsyāṃ yajeta ' ityatra na kartavyaḥ |
oṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ sinīvālīkuhūḥ saṃnipāte uttarasmin dina kāryaḥ ||
yadā sinīvālī kuhūśceti dve api krameṇāpatataḥ tadā'pi pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyena pūrvasminneva parvaṇi pitṛyajñe prāpte, parasminnevatyucyate |

' yadahareva purastāt dṛśyate tadahardadyāt ' iti yat pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvayuḥ ' iti 'aparāhṇe dadāti ' iti vacanasyaikavākyatayā laghasya candrā-darśanāparāhvaviśeṣaṇapaṭhitavyaviśiṣṭāmāvāsyākālasya tatraiva lābhāt |
candradarśane ' amāvāsyāyāmaparāhe piṇḍapitṛ-yajñena caranti ' ityekasminneva vākye viśiṣṭakālavidhiḥ, pratīkṣāśivāttayā upādeyatvācca na viśeṣaṇayoravivakṣitate tu bhāṣye sthitam |
na ca pūrvadine candradarśanābhāvādeva paradināparāhṇe amāvāsyāyāḥ abhāvādanyataraparityāgā-vaśyaktve yatpūrvedyuriti vacanānusāraṇa candradarśanasyaiva hānaṃ yuktamiti vācyam |
' yā tithiṃ samanuprāpyaṃ yāti divākaraḥ ' iti smṛtyā paradine amāvāsyāyāḥ pūrṇatokteḥ |

nanu ' piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṣīṇe rājani śasyate ' iti smṛtyantareṇa candradarśanapadyasya candrakṣayopalakṣakatvena vyākhyānāt candrakṣayasya ca ' aṣṭamyaṣṭau caturdaśyāḥ kṣīṇo bhavati candramāḥ |

' iti smṛtyā caturdaśīyuktāmāvāsyāyā-mevopalambhāt sinīvālyāmeva pitṛyajñaḥ, ata eva ' yada-hastvaiva candramā na dṛśyate tāmamāvāsyāṃ kurvīta ' ityādi-vacanairanvādhānasyāpi kāle candradarśanasya viśeṣaṇatayā tulyanyāyena paradine tadaṅgatvena prasakte ' pakṣāntaṃ karma nirvarya vaiśvadevaṃ ca sāgnikaḥ |
' ityādinā anvādhānapitṛyajña-śrāddhānāṃ ekakartavyatvāvidhānāt anvādhānavākyasthacandrā-darśanapadaṃ candrakṣayopalakṣakamevetyuktaṃ karmapradīpe iti cettu, na |
tatra yāgaṃ na kurvīta devāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ |
' iti vacanena sāyaṃ candradarśanaviśiṣṭapratipadi pradhānagāmineṣā-dubhayoropi candradarśanasyāvaśyakatve hyakālakriyamāṇayoḥ aṅgapradhānayostadasaṃbhave aṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyena anvādhāne
ata eva ' tadaiva dṛṣṭvā upavasanti ' iti śrutiḥ dṛśyamāne'pi kadā ciditi gobhilaśca |

pitṛyajñasya tu ' yadahareva purastāt paścācca dṛśyate ' iti śrutyantareṇa kuhāmeva viśeṣa vidhānātra smṛtyā kṣīṇacandropalakṣakatvena vyākhyā yuktā, apitu amāvāsyāpadasyaiva sūryācandramasoḥ saṃnikarṣaparatvaṃ pañca-daśādhyāyādhikaraṇasiddhaṃ sūtroktaṃ yuktam |
na ca ' yadahaḥ paścāccandramā abhyudeti imau lokānamijayati ' ityādi śrutibhiḥ candradarśanadine yāganiṣedhasmṛterapi bādho-'stu iti vācyam |
candradarśanadinaṃ praśastamapi tada-darśanāt praśastatarā hīnameveti rītyā jatilagāvedhuka-stuteḥ kṣīravidhiṣopatavacca candradarśanadine yāgavidhi-śeṣatvenāpi asyārthavādasyopapatteḥ |
oṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñe anāhitāgninā atipraṇīta aupāsanā vā upastheyaḥ ||
' yadantarikṣam ' ( - pṛthivīmṛtaṃ dyāṃ yanmātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā jihaṃsima ) iti mantreṇa gārhapatyasyopasthānaṃ pitṛyajñe vihitam |
tacca āhitāgnikartṛkāt prakṛtitaḥ anāhitā-gnikartṛkatvau prāptaṃ iti tadarthaṃ gārhapatya upapādanīyaḥ |

iti prāpte, saṃskāraviśeṣaviśiṣṭasyaiva gārhapatyatvāt tādṛśasyotpādane ca anāhitāgnibhaṅgāt prakṛtau arthātmaka bhedasya codakena anatideśāt āyatanamātrameve'pi gārhapatya-dakṣiṇāgnyoramedāt ' yasminneva pradīyate tamevopatiṣṭheta ' iti vacanācca atipraṇītāmeḥ aupāsanāmevopasthānam |

yattu śrūyate ' apyanāhitāgninā kārya-meva, idaṃ cinme kṛtam, idamaviśāt, idaṃ cicchaktavāma, pitaraścimā''vedayanti ' iti, tadanāhitāgninā'pi eta-tkartavyam, kiṃ punarāhitāgninā, ityevamarthādatvenāpi upapannam |
iti prāpte, avadhāraṇāryatvena apiśabdena kartavyameveti spaṣṭavidhinā ca anāhitāgnerapi adhikārā-vagateḥ itarāṃśa eva tadarthavādaḥ |

tasminneva mantre ' agnirmā tasmādenalo gārhapatyaḥ ' iti gārhapatyaśabdasya asambhavetātharvale'pi mantrānugrāhāvikaraṇe prayoge homādhikaraṇatvena saṃskārya-tvāt gārhapatyapadaṃ apanīya āvaśyakapadaprakṣepe ūhe vā prāpte, gārhapatyaśabdamātraṃ luptyate, tanmātrasya ana-nivartanavacanatvāt |
upatiṣṭheta ityādyanena mantrasya karaṇatvena prāpteḥ, prākṛtasya tasya gārhapatyapadavinirmuk-syaiva samavetārthatvāt |
ata eva ' na devatā'miśabdakriyam ' iti bhāṣyo nyāyaḥ saṃgacchate |
īdṛśapadaghaṭitamantrasya lopa iti yājñikapakṣaḥ kācitkastu cintya eva |
piṇḍapitṛyajñe viśeṣaṇāṃ anyato'siddheḥ teṣāma-bhāve ca vicchedatvānupapatteḥ tadiśeṣābhidhāyiṇḍakalpanā ( tadiśeṣāḥ viniyogādhikāraprayogāḥ ) |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 380 piṇḍapitṛyajñe ' samūlaṃ barhirbhavati ' iti darśāṇāṃ samūlatvamukam |
tatsatve ca ' yat paruṣi ditaṃ tad devānāma, yadantarā tanmanuṣyāṇām ' ityanuvādaḥ |
bhāṣyam— asti āmāvāsye karmaṇi pitṛyajñaḥ ‘amāvāsyāyāmaparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti’ iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kimāmāvāsyasya karmaṇaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñaṃ 'ṅgam, utānaṅgamiti |
amāvāsyāyā ekavākyatvāt śakyaḥ svargaḥ kalpayitu- miti |
svarge kalpye na lakṣaṇā, na śrutiḥ |
evaṃ cāmananti, ‘yatpitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyuḥ karoti, pitṛbhya etadyajñaṃ niṣkrīya yajamāno devebhyaḥ pratanute’ iti |
svaśabdābhihitena kālenainasya saṃbandhaḥ, na karmaṇā lakṣiteneti |
atra kāle evāyaṃ mukhyaḥ śabdo na karmaṇi |
kasmāt ? anuvāde hi lakṣaṇā nyāyyā, na vidhau |
ekasmin kāle dve karmaṇī parasparaṇāsaṃbandhe iti |
tasya aparāhnaḥ kālaḥ (vidhīyate) ityanena dvāreṇa sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ kīdṛśamapi syāt ( na syādityarthaḥ :) |
tasmāt (kālavacanatvāt) amāvāsyāśabdārye (kāle) nimitte phalāya karma vidhīyate |
‘catvāro vai mahāyajñāḥ agnihotram, darśapūrṇamāsau, jyotiṣṭomaḥ, piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ’ iti mahāyajñaistulyavat praśaṃsyate |
‘paurṇamāsīmeva yajeta bhrātṛvya- vān nāmāvāsyām, hatvā bhrātṛvyamamāvāsyā yajeta, piṇḍapitṛyajñenāmāvāsyāṃ prīṇāti’ iti |
yadi paurṇamāsyāmādhānam, tato'nantarāmāvāsyāyāṃ na kriyate, yathā pūrvapakṣaḥ |
ślokamyudāharanti ‘ādhānaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ced vṛtte darśa kariṣyate |
yadyapi tatra (karmakālyoḥ) sādhāraṇaḥ amāvāsyāśabdaḥ, tathāpi aparāhnasāmānādhi- karaṇyalipsayā kālavācitvamavasīyate |
soma— pūrvatra (ṣaṭcitritasya) arthavādopanīta- tvāt phalasya astu naimittikatvam |
prakṛte tu atyantā- nupasthitaṃ phalaṃ kalpanīyaṃ ityayuktaṃ iti vaipamyena pratyava- sthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
prayojanam— pūrvapakṣe darśavikāreṣu prabhṛtiḥ, siddhānte tu na pravṛttiḥ |
vi— ‘ṛtvaṅgaṃ syānna vā piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ, kratau hi saḥ |
bhāṭṭa— anārabhya śrutam ‘amāvāsyāyāmaparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti’ iti |
tatrāyaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajño darśaiyajñam, amāvāsyāpadena karmavācinā ‘tatra jyān juhuyāt’ itivat vākyādvājñātpratīteḥ |
yadyapi cāyaṃ kāle'pi mukhyaḥ, tathāpi phalakalpanāyāmiva karmaparatva- meva yuktam |
vastutastu yadyapi kāla eva mukhyaḥ karmaṇi tayogāttrilakṣaṇayā, prakṛte ca kālapara eva, aparāhna- sāmānādhikaraṇyāt, tathāpi pitṛyajñaḥ pūrvaidyuḥ kriyate |
iti vākye darśitopavedyuḥ vaimṛdha- nyāyena darśaidhupasthitatvāttvaṅgam |
iti prāpte, amā- vāsyāśabdasya karmavācitvaṃ bhavedeva nirākṛtam |
pūrvedyurvākyamapi iṣṭeranupasthitatvāt tatpati- yogikakāla vidyate, api tu tithiddhe pūrvedyuḥ kālam ‘yayā'staṃ savitā yāti pitarastāmupāsate’ iti prāpta- manūdya devatāmātram |
ke cittu candradarśanāt pūrvedyu- riti vyākhyāya khaṇḍaparvaṇi paredyuḥ pitṛyajñamanutiṣṭhanti |
evaṃ ca ‘paurṇamāsīmeva yajeta bhrātṛvyavānnāmāvāsyām, hatvā bhrātṛvyamamāvāsyā yajeta, piṇḍapitṛyajñenāmāvāsyāṃ prīṇāti’ iti daśa- grathameva'pi piṇḍapitṛyajñadarśanaṃ saṃgacchate |
etadanenaiva ca ‘pitṛbhya eva tadyajñaṃ niṣkrīya yajamānaḥ pratanute’ ityādipiṇḍapitṛyajñārthavāde yajñopasthitatvāpi na kṣatiḥ |
’ iti manuvacanam (manu. 3|122), tat śrāddhaṃ kṛṣṇa- pakṣaśrāddhaṃ daśan amāvāsyā vinā āhitāgnerbhavati anāhitāgneriva tityanteriti vyākhyeyam |
na tu darśanena darśaidhe vinā śrāddhaṃ pitṛyajño na bhavatītyevamyam, darśapade lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |
vastutastu akaraṇe saptahotroma- rūpaprāyaścittasya āpastambādibhiḥ smaraṇāt jyotiṣṭomā-
prayojanaṃ darśabhāve'pi karaṇam, tadadhikareṣu ca nātideśaḥ |
yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa paurṇamāsyāmādhāne kṛte agnimāvāsyāyāṃ darśaidhatvāt pūrvapakṣe akaraṇamityuktam, tat dvādaśa- rātriṣu pavamāneṣṭiṣu ādhānātttaradine paurṇamāsakāla- bhāve ca bodhyam |

yadā tu taduttaradine kālasattvaṃ paurṇa- māsasya, tadā ādhānadine eva seṣṭi sānnāyyamaṇīyaṃ paurṇamāsasyādhānaṃ kṛtvā śrūyate paurṇamāsanevā agnidarśaidhaṣṭayaiva pitṛyajñānuṣṭhāne na kaścidvirodhaḥ |
‘amāvāsyāyāmaparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti’ ityatrānārabhyādhītavākye śrutaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ ṛtvarthaḥ : puruṣārtho vā iti saṃśaye karma- vācyamāvāsyāśabdasamabhivyāhārāt tadaṅgatvam |
yadyapi kālasyāpi sādhāraṇo'yaṃ śabdaḥ, tathāpi phalakalpanāpari- hārāya karmavācyeva |
kālakarmasādhāraṇo'pi amāvāsyāśabdaḥ aparāhnaśabda- samānādhikṛtaḥ iti kālapara eva |
na ca sādhāraṇyam, kāle rūḍhatvāt, karmaṇi ca tatsaṃbandhena lākṣaṇikatvāt |
pitṛyajñe eva dakṣiṇāgnau śrapitasyāpi haviṣaḥ āhava- nīye eva homataḥ, gārhapatye śrapitasyāpi tathā darśanāt |
‘yādahavanīye juhoti’ iti vākyasya bādhe mānābhāvāt ‘dakṣiṇāgneratyulkaṃ dhūpādyata uddharati’ iti vacanāntareṇa paṇītāgnerapi sattvāt, tasya ca pakṣī atipraṇītavat dṛṣṭārthatvāya tatraiva vā homaḥ |
iti prāpte, ‘yasmin śrapayati tasmin juhoti’ iti vacanenaiva siddhāntaḥ, praṇītasya tu āyatanādibhiḥ sāraṇena tato bhinnatvāt |
ata eva tasyādyarthatvamapi na duṣyati, ‘ye rūpāṇi
praṃtisujhamānāḥ ' iti mantre tasya rakṣopanahanārthala- śravaṇāt |
saṃkarṣa. 1|2|11. § piṇyākyācanārthaṃ gatasya khārikātailadāt- svābhyupagama iti nyāyaḥ |
sāhasī. 709. § pitā pitāmahaḥ somaṃ na pibet iti (bhāṣyam |
pituḥ pitāmahasya vā asomapatvaṃ nityapaśoranimittatve- nocyamānaṃ sāhityāvintyasya siddham |
vā. 3|6|12 ra pṛ. 696. pitā vārṣake putramupajīvati |
tathā ca ' vṛddhau ca mātāpitarau sādhvī bhāryā sutaḥ śiśuḥ |
ke. ' pitrā pitaraṃ vā saṃjānīte ' iyaṃ karmaṇi tṛtīyā kārakavibhaktirūpā viniyogakrī śrutiḥ |
pitā yathā stanandhanyaṃ bālamanuṣya vartate, tathā viduṣā ajño jano'- nusartavyaḥ |
na caitat nyāyyaṃ yat pitrādīnāṃ paricārakatvam |
tadyathā sa eva kaṃ citpati pitā bhavati, kaṃ citpati putro bhavati |
evaṃ prakṛte'pi codhyamiti ' tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya ' (pā01|1| 66) iti sūtrabhāṣye spaṣṭam |
sāhasī. 607. pitṛmātṛmāludayaḥ tattvatsaṃbandhaviśeṣavācaka- śabdena yathā tṛpyanti na tathā svanāmagrahaṇe, pratyuta kupyanta eva |
ayaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ kiṃ amāvāsyasya karmaṇaḥ aṅgam, uta neti vicāre amāvāsyāyāgaṃ piṇḍa- pitṛyajñaḥ iti utsūtre siddhāntayati |
pitṛyajñaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ amāvāsyāyāgasya anaṅgama, na aṅgaṃ syāt |
svaḥ svīyaḥ kālo yasyāsau svakālaḥ; svakālatvāt |
amāvāsyāyāgakālo'pi yadyapi saiva tithiḥ; tathāpi ekasmin kāle dve ete karmaṇī parasparaṃ asaṃbaddhe |
piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ svapradhāna eva, na amāvāsyāyā aṅgaṃ iti siddhānte hetvantaraparaṃ sūtram |
itarmehāyathaiḥ tulya- miva piṇḍapitṛyajñasya prasaṅkhyānaṃ parigaṇanaṃ kṛtam ' catvāro vai mahāyajñā agnihotram, darśapūrṇamāsau, jyotiṣṭomaḥ, piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ; ' iti |
piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ svapradhāna eva nāmāvāsyāyāgasyāṅgaṃ iti siddhānte tṛtīyahetupratipādanārthaṃ sūtram |
pratiṣiddhe- 'pi āmāvāsye karmaṇi piṇḍapitṛyajñānuṣṭhānasya darśanāt piṇḍapitṛyajño nāmāvāsyāṅgam |
kiñca yadā paurṇamāsyā- mādhānaṃ tadā avyavahitayāmāvāsyāyāṃ tithau amā- vāsyāyāgo na bhavati, piṇḍapitṛyajñastu bhavati |
pitṛyajñe atideśaprāptasya hotṛvaraṇasya ' na hotāraṃ bruṇīte ' iti niṣedhaḥ śrūyate |
atra nañaḥ paryudāsārtha- tve'pi vikalpaḥ aparihāryaḥ |
kiñca anyata eva tadanye prāpteḥ ; tadanyamātrakoccāratve ca paryudāsaupasaṃhārayoramedāpatteḥ na paryudāsatvavyadhitvantopapattiḥ |

tatra prāptisāpekṣasyāpi surāpānādiniṣedhavat viśeṣaniṣṭatvāt balavattvaṃ syāt ityādakṣaya viśeṣaniṣedhena niṣedhena ātmalābhāyogātte : sāmānyarūpasyāpi vidheḥ svaviṣa- yādapanetumaśakyatvāt anapanītasya ca śāstrasya atyanta- bādhāyāgāt vikalpo duṣpari
nahi snigdhasya snehanaṃ śakyaṃ kartuṃ piṣṭasya vā |
sakṛdeva upalāyāḥ prakarṣaṇākarṣaṇe kṛtvā utsṛjyeta yadeṣāṃ |
diṣu āśiṣṭo yaḥ piṣṭalepaḥ, tamuddhṛtya juhvaṃ caturgṛhīte |
bhakṣaṇottarameva jyotiṣṭome, na tu anuyājaiḥ sahotkarṣaḥ |
puṃdaivatve hautrakāṇḍe brīdetyatvāt paścāt paṭhite, citrayāge |
āryā evaṃ paraṃ ghaṭaśabdaṃ prayuñjate, na mlecchā iti śakyaṃ |
prāyaścittaṃ na bhavati, siddhānte tu bhavati iti |
pakṣe, siddhānte tu pilvavṛkṣadaṇḍa eva ityāha |
oṣadhayo mlāyante athaite modamānā ivottiṣṭhanti' itya- |
naiva yavaśabdasya dīrghavṛkṣaviśiṣṭe śaktiḥ, priyaṅguṣu tu |
śam ( yasmāt bhāṣyodāharaṇāni na yuktāni tasmāt |
evaṃ ca amedhasādhako hetuḥ gomayapāyasīyanyāyavadābhāstāṃ pīlupatraphalanyāya- dāmāstāṃ ca bhajet iti vaide |
ke. puṇḍarīka iti pauṇḍarīka iti vāhīnaviśeṣaḥ ekādaśarātraḥ |
yo'mīnādhāya bhāgyajyāni putrajyāni vā jīyeta sa punarādadhīta' |
putralipsayā devaṃ bhajantyāḥ bhartā'pi naṣṭaḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
yathā ke cit vādinaḥ śaṅkante nanu pratyaga- bhinnemeva advitīyaṃ brahma iti siddhānto bhavatāmiti |
'īśvaraḥ sarva evaite' ityuktvā tu prakṛtanyāyena jīve- śāmidaṃ sādhayituṃ pravṛttairmarcādiḥ sarvavādisaṃmate'me'pi nāśitaḥ syāt iti vadanti iti |

sarvaidhamaseḥ saha adhvaryuḥ ādau hotṛyājyā hutvā tatasteṣāṃ madhye hotrādīnāṃ madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasān anyatra viniyujya avaśiṣṭa- camaseṣu saśeṣeṣveva punaḥ somamabhyanyatai taiḥ krameṇa maitrā- varuṇapādikātipayahotrakyāsyābhirhute |
teṣāṃ hotṛvaṣaṭkāre anuvaṣaṭkāre ca caturbhirmadhyātaḥ kāriṇāṃ camasaiḥ hutvā hotrāṇāṃ camasaiḥ sakṛt sakṛt vaṣaṭkāre eva hutvā punaḥ saśeṣeṣveva pātreṣu somaḥ anyunnītaḥ |
evaṃ hi tatra adhvaryuḥ saṃpreṣyati 'madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasā- dharvayo vaṣaṭkṛte'nuvaṣaṭkṛte juhuta |
hotrāṇāṃ camasā- dharvayaḥ sakṛdutvā amyunīyopāvartadhvam' iti |

bhā. 3|2|12|130. punarabhyunnīteṣu adhvaṣaṭkāre maitrā- varuṇaḥ 'mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe' iti mitrāvaruṇau, brāhmaṇā- cchaṃsī 'indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayam' iti indram, potā 'masto yasya hi kṣaye' iti marutaḥ, neṣṭā 'ame patnī- rihāvaha' iti tvaṣṭāraṃ patnīśca, āmīdhraḥ 'uśannāya vaśānnāya' iti agniṃ yajati |
puna- rabhyunnīteṣu camaseṣu prasthitadevatāyāḥ indrasya mitrāvaruṇā- dīnāṃ ceti sarveṣāmupalakṣaṇaṃ bhakṣamanyatra kartavyam |
apare ca maitrāvaruṇādīnām ṛtvijāṃ ca camasāḥ |
teṣu cendroddeśena vaṣaṭkāramātre hute ardhāvaśiṣṭe ca droṇakalaśān mitrāvaruṇā- yuddeśena gṛhītaḥ somarasa'bhyunnītaḥ |
tena ca mitrāvaru- ṇādyā devatāḥ bhaḍiṣyante |
tāni ca mitrāvaruṇādyuddeśena kriyamāṇāni pradānāni indradānavikṛtibhūtānīti pūrva- nyāyenaiva siddham |
teṣāṃ ṣaṭcamasānāṃ śeṣabhakṣaṇamantre saṃdehaḥ kiṃ 'mitrāvaruṇapītasya' ityuhaḥ kartavyaḥ uta 'indramitrāvaruṇapītasya' iti |
indroddeśena hutaśeṣaṣvatsu camaseṣu devatāntarārthe droṇakalaśādānītaḥ somarasaḥ punarabhyunnīta ityucyate |
sati taccheṣatvadyūhena sarva evendramitrāvaruṇādaya upa- lakṣaṇīyā iti |

yadyapi camasendrasyopatvamasti, tathāpi mitrāvaruṇoddeśena prakṣiptarasasaṃgatitaikatāpo rasaḥ kṛtsna eva mitrāvaruṇārthaśrāvaṇaprayāśrāvaṇasāmyapanītendra- saṃbandhaḥ pradānakāle mitrāvaruṇārtha eva jātaḥ |
tena pūrva- ndrasaṃbandhasthāpanītattvāt prakṛtau cāpanītadevatāsaṃbandhasya- palakṣaṇatvāt nendra upalakṣaṇayitavyaḥ, kintu mitrāvaruṇāveva |
pūrvaśeṣasya mitrāvaruṇādyuttaradevatā'rthatvena agrahaṇāt unnayanakāle abhyunītāmātrasya kariṣyamāṇārthatvāva- dhāraṇācca |
pūrvadevatāyā indrasya anapāyaḥ syāt apāyo bādho na syāt |
tasmāt punarabhyunītasomabhakṣamantre indra- mitrāvaruṇapītasya iti sarveśāmupalakṣaṇaṃ kāryam |
somasya bhakṣaṇamasya dvayordevatyoḥ śeṣatvāt śeṣopalakṣa- ṇārthaṃ kīrtanārthe prakathanaṃ ityevaṃ prakathanavācaḥ karoterarthaṃ (lakṣaṇaśabde ) lyuṭprayogaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome hotraka- camasabhakṣamantreṣu mitrāvaruṇādibhiḥ saha indro'pi upa- lakṣaṇīyaḥ ||
santi punarabhyunītāḥ somāḥ, śukrāmantripracāre eva savanamukhyāḥ |
teṣāṃ hotṛvaṣaṭkāre anuvaṣaṭkāre ca caturbhirmantraiḥ kāriṇāṃ camasaiḥ hutvā hotṛkāṇāṃ camasaiḥ sakṛtsakṛt vaṣaṭkāre eva hutvā punaḥ saśeṣeṣveva pātreṣu somo'bhyunītaḥ |
evaṃ hi tatrādhvaryuḥ saṃpreṣyati 'mavyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasā- dharyavo vaṣaṭkṛte'nuvaṣaṭkṛte juhuta |
hotṛkāṇāṃ camasā- dharyavaḥ sakṛttvā śukrāmbhyunīya upāvartadhvam' iti |

maitrāvaruṇo mitrā- varuṇau 'mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe' iti, brāhmaṇācchaṃsī indram 'indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayam' iti, potā marutaḥ 'maruto yasya hi kṣaye' iti, neṣṭā tvaṣṭāraṃ palīśca 'agne patnīrihā- ''vaha' iti, āgnīdhro'gnim 'ukṣāṇāya (ukṣā ahnaṃ yasya tasmai ) vaśāñcāya' iti |
tatra tairmantraiḥ pūrvasmin vaṣaṭkāre indra iha |
(śeṣāstatrendrasya mitrāvaruṇādīnāṃ ca upa- kiṃ prasthitadevatāyāśca indrasya mitrāvaruṇādīnāṃ ca upa-
prakṛtau yasyai hutaṃ taccheṣaḥ tatpīta ityuktam |
vā-- evaṃ pūrvapakṣe evādhikaraṇe kṛtvācintyā ūhaviṣayatvaṃ cintayati |
huteṣu camaseṣu saśeṣeṣveva abhyu- nītāḥ somāḥ punarabhyunītā ityucyante |
teṣāṃ tu yathā punarabhyunītatvam, yathā ca ūhacintāviṣayatā, tathā vibhajya darśayati |
teṣāṃ ye madhya- taḥkāriṇāṃ brahmādīnāṃ (brahma-hotṛ-udgātṛ-yajamānānāṃ) catvāraḥ, te hotuḥ vaṣaṭkārānuvaṣaṭkārayoḥ dvirdviḥ hutam |
hotrakacamasaistu (maitrāvaruṇa-brāhmaṇācchaṃsi- potṛ-neṣṭṛ-acchāvāka-āgnīdhrāḥ hotṛkāḥ :) sakṛt vaṣa- ṭkāre eva hutam |
kathamava- gamyate ? tat sarvaṃ preṣeṇa darśayati (bhāṣyakāraḥ) |
tatra dvitīye home hotṛkāḥ nānā devatā yajanti |
tatra yadā ete camasāḥ hutvā bhakṣaṇārthamānīyante, tadā dvau dvau dṛśyate pūrvahomeṣvaindraḥ, uttaraśca mitrāvaruṇādidevatyaḥ |

tasya upalakṣaṇe kriyamāṇe sandehaḥ kiṃ prasthitadevatā atikrānto'pi indraḥ upalakṣayitavyaḥ uttaraśca mitrāvaruṇādyāḥ ('indramitrāvaruṇapītasya' ityevam, uta mitrāvaruṇadaya eva (atra punaḥ 'indraśabdo'pi mudrita ānandāśramādau, sa cāpyuktaḥ :) kevalā iti |
kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? kiṃ devatāntarasaṃcāreṇa pūrvadevatāsaṃbhavaḥ apanītaḥ, uta neti |
yadi apanītaḥ, tataḥ kevala- mitrāvaruṇopalakṣaṇam, atha anapanītaḥ, tataḥ indro'pi upalakṣaṇīyaḥ |
punarādhīta ', 'yo'gnimādhāya bhāgyavayāni pumayāni vā jīyeta sa punarādhīta' iti |
bhā. 10|3|15|30. punarādhāne dakṣiṇā 'punarlūtaṃ vāso dakṣiṇā punastūpe'naḍ‌vān' iti |
10|3|130. puna- rādhāne naimittike śrutayā dakṣiṇayā sāmānyavihitāyā: ekādaśadakṣiṇāyā: bādha: |
agnihotre śrūyate 'yasyobhābhyamī anugatau agni- nimlocet yasya vā''myadiyāt punarādheyema tasya prāyaścitta: ' iti |
idaṃ prāyaścittaṃ punarādheyaṃ odana- vat pañcaśarāvavat anyatarasyāpi agneranugamane syāt na kevalaṃ ubhayoreva iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
śrutyarthastu yasya āhitāgne: ubhau gārhapatyāhavanīyau agnī anugatau śāntau amilasya, śāntau: sato: ityartha: |
yasya ca śāntau amilasya udiyāt udayaṃ prāpnuyāt āditya:, tasya prāyaścittaṃ punarādhānam, iti |
pūrvapakṣa sūtre prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
ubhayo: dravyotpatti: ubhayo: dravyayo: gārhapatyāhavanīyayo: upatti: prāyaścittam |
tathā ca ubhayoranugamane eva adhānena ubhayostatpatti: prāyaścittam |
atra ubhayo: iti padasya samāsaikedeśe dravyaśabde anvaya: |
atra ubhayo: gārhapatyāhavanīyayo: anugamane eva dravyotpatti: dravyasya agne: ādhānane utpatti: prāya- ścittam |
anyatarasya vināśa ādhāna kṛte tu dvayoranyo- tpattirvicchidyate ekatamasya sattvāt |
tasmāt naimittikaṃ punarādheyaṃ samudāyānugamane eva, na tu anyatarasthānu- gamane |
punarādheyamodanavat ityatra 'yasyobhābhyamī anugatau abhinamlocedabhyādidhā punarādheyaṃ tasya prāya- ścittam' ityatra vidheyasāmarthyāt nimittaviśeṣaṇami- sāhityavivakṣā labhyate ityuktam |
arthāgrahaṇāstu vimyata: punarabhidhīyamānaṃ bahu manyante eva |
sārthovacanaṃ bahuśo'pi uyamānaṃ nyāyameva, asādhostu sakṛdapi anyāyamam |
āha, sakṛdvacane śatasya punarvācane na prayojanamastīti |
punarjanma asmin dehe svargasya bhoktumaśakyatvāt aśrutā'pi anyadehalāpti: arthāpattyā kalpyate |
bṛhadyarthatayorādhārabhūte pragāye prathamā yā bṛhatī 'ami tvā śūra' iti, tasyā: 'īśānamindra tathyuṣa:' iti caturtha: pāda:, taṃ punargṛhītvā uttarāyā ṛca: pūrvārdhena pragayate |
pumān devadatta: ' iti puṃstvābhinnaliṅgavān devadatta: iti bodha: |
maṇi. pṛ. 124. pumān strī napuṃsakamiti dravyaviśeṣā hyete |
bhā. 3|16|12 pṛ. 681, pumāṃso dravya- vantaḥ, na striya: iti pūrvapakṣa: |
6|1|16. striya: puṃso- 'tiriktā: tasmādateko bahvījāyā vindate naikā bahūna patīn' iti yūpaikādaśinyām |
asmin samāhāre puṃliṅge- naiva ūha: kartavya: iti niyamyate |
(pumān jīva: viṣaya: ghaṭādi: etau yathā minnau, tadvat jīveśvarāvapi minnau ityatra eṣa nyāya: ) |
'ṛtvigmyo vācaṃ vibhajati hotaryaja potaryaja neṣṭa- ryaja brahan yaja acchāvāka yaja' iti praiparūpāyā vāco vibhāgaṃ vidhāya śrūyate 'tāṃ puro'vyuryavibhajati maitrā- varuṇa: paścāt' iti |
atra pura:paścācchandī deśavādī kālavādī vā, ubhayatrāpi niruddhatvāt |
tena ekasminneva deśe sthitvā adhvaryumaitrāvaruṇau pūrvaparakālabhedena praipān vibhajya dhyātāmekasmin vā kāle prākpratyadeśabhedena
iti vikalpe prāpte, deśavāda evāyam, āha- vanīyaṃ gacchatīti prakṛtya etadāmānāt |
bhā. 12|4|2|4. puro'nuvākyā ('agne naya supathā' iti ) manotā ca kṛṣṇagrīvayo: paśavo: āvartate kālabhedāt saumyena vyākhyāyāt |
vā. 3|3|2|143 pṛ. 1107, puronu- vākyāṃ prathamaṃ prayuṅkte ' iti yājyādharma: |
jyotiṣṭome phalaviśeṣāya śrutānāṃ āśvinādigrahāṇāṃ pratikarṣa ukta: |
sa pratikarṣa: aindravāyavyasya purastāt, na tu sarvādidataḥ yata: kutaścidvā |
eṣo'grasya deśo vijñātau yat upādanvantyāmābhyāmpurastādaindravāyavyasya iti ! tasmāt aindravāyavyāt purastāt pratikarṣa iti siddhānta: |
jyotiṣṭome phalaviśeṣārthe śrūyamāṇā āśvinādyatā: aindravāyavyatayā tulyadharmatvāt |
tatra dhārāsaṃyoge dṛśyate tasmāt dhārābhyanudiśya etadagratā vidhīyate |
jyotiṣṭome phalaviśeṣārthe āśvinanugrāyatā vidhī- yate, sā ca āśvinādyatā aindravāyavyāt prāk grahaṇe,
puruṣārthaikasiddhitvāt tasyatvādhikāraḥ syāt (6|2|12) iti pañcādhikārānvayena satriṇaḥ pratyekaṃ kṛtsnaṃ phalaṃ labhante |
sateṣu ekaprayoganivāhaṃkaṃ saptadaśasaptadaśabhiḥ kartṛtvaṃ vyāsajyavṛtti syāt |
tathā sati saṃpūrṇa sarveṣāṃ militvā ekameva syāt na tu pratyekaṃ saṃpūrṇa iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe siddhāntamāha |
tatastasya pratyekam adhikāraḥ ṛddhi- phalasāmyaṃ kātsyena syāt na tu sarveṣāṃ mekaṃ vyāsajyavṛtti phalam |
saktṛtvaṃ ca pratyekaṃ itarasāpekṣaṃ na vyāsajyavṛtti |
phalamapi ca pratyekameva saṃpūrṇaṃ na vyāsajyavṛtti |
apicotpattisaṃyogāt yathā syāt sarvadarśanaṃ tathā bhāvo'vibhāge syāt |
satre saptadaśānāṃ yajamānānāmeva ṛtvikatvena pratyekaṃ satrakartṛtvaṃ itarasāpekṣaṃ pṛthakpṛthageva |
apica naitadiruddham, yadekaṃ karma bahubhiḥ kriyate iti, utpattisaṃyogāt |
'ṛddhikāmāḥ' satramāsīran' iti utpattivākye bahuvacanena satra- karmaṇā sākaṃ anekeṣāṃ kartṛtvena saṃyoga uktaḥ |
utpatti- śiṣṭatvādeva ekasya karmaṇaḥ anekakartṛtve'pi na virodhaḥ |
yathā loke rathalāṅgala- divahanarūpasya karmaṇaḥ avibhāge ekatve'pi satvānāṃ aśvabalīvardādīnāṃ bahūnāṃ prāṇināṃ kartṛtvena darśanaṃ syāt, tathā bhāvo'vibhāge syāt |
tathā satvavat satrarūpasya karmaṇaḥ avibhāge ekatve'pi bahūnāṃ kartṛṇāṃ bhāvaḥ astitvaṃ syāt, na virodhaḥ kaścit |
sudhāyaṃ tu 'apicotpatti...tathā bhāvavibhāge syāt' iti pāṭhaḥ |

vyākhyā ceyam- (pṛ. 962- 963) 'ṛddhikāmāḥ satramāsīran' iti kamidasthena bahuvacanena ṛddhikāmabahutvokteḥ pratyekaṃ ṛddhikāmatvāva- gamāt pratyekaṃ adhikāratvāt ākhyātasthena bahuvacanena kartṛbahutvokteḥ pratyekaṃ kartṛtvavagamādapi pratyekaṃ adhikāraḥ iti utpattau aniścitakartṛsatve karmaṇi kartṛnṛtvasaṃyogāt ityavacanenokte, pratyekakartṛtve karmantaranarthakyaṃ ādāhṛtya yathā satvasya dravyaṇvadeḥ yugapat bahubhirdarśanaṃ nānyatarā- narthakyāpādakaṃ tathā bhāvasya karmaṇaḥ vibhāge pṛthakarta- nye'pi na karmantarānarthakyam |
bhāṭṭa. 3|4|8. puruṣārthatvaṃ phalasya kāma- padopādānādeva gamyate |
itikrtavyatātvena anvitatvaṃ kartavyatvaṃ taccinnatvaṃ ca karaṇaphalatvapuruṣārthatva iti śāstradīpikāyām |
svayaṃprārthitatvaṃ ca śāstrānadhīnasādhanatā- jñānajanyatvāviṣayatvam (svargasya deśaviśeṣarūpatvapakṣe), śāstrādhīnasādhanatājñānājanyatvāviṣayatvam (sukhaviśeṣa- rūpatve) |
puruṣārthabhyastaṃ ca vidhyātmake vede puruṣa- pravartanasaukaryādiṣyate |
' puruṣārthasiddhaye hi sarvaiḥ prayāsaḥ iti tatprayāsasya vastu baliyo bhavati |
