sudhā- kāmyasya nityabādhakatve ayameva mukhyo nyāyaḥ: 'naimittike tu prakṛtau 0' (2|6|3|10) iti tṛtīyā- dhikaraṇe vakṣyamāṇaḥ |
kāmyaṃ nityasya bādhakam' iti nyāyāt (vā. 1|4| 11|22) kāmyo guṇaḥ |
puruṣakalpena vā vikṛtau kartṛniyamaḥ syāt, yajñasya tadguṇatvādbhāvāditarān pratyetasmin vidhikālmyat |
pūrvādhikaraṇe saptadaśakartṛsamudāyamuddiśya yat satrakarma vihitaṃ tatra brāhmaṇaviśeṣaprāṇamevādhikāraḥ ityuktam |
atra tu tato vailakṣaṇyaṃ iti sūcanārthaṃ vāśabdaḥ |
yatra tu puruṣa- kalpena vidhiḥ na samudāyakalpena, ekaikaṃ puruṣamuddiśya yaḥ karmavidhiḥ tatra ityarthaḥ |
evaṃ puruṣakalpena puruṣa- viśeṣakartṛkatvena vidhīyamānāyāṃ vikṛtau adhvarakalpā āgrayaṇa paśuḥ ityevamādau kartṛniyamaḥ syāt, vaiśya eva kartā niyamyate |
itānan prati abhāvāt sāmidhenīsādṛśyasya ca vaiśyabhinna brāhmaṇa- kṣatriyān prati abhāvāt |
sāmidhenīsādṛśyavidheḥ kṛtsnatā saṃbhavati, vaiśya eva etatkarma kṛtsnaṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ |
tasmāt adhvarakalpādiṣu yeṣu yāgeṣu saptadaśa sāmidhenyo vihitāḥ teṣu yāgeṣu vaiśyasyaivādhikāraḥ na brāhmaṇasya rājanyasya vā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yeṣu yāgeṣu saptadaśa sāmidhenya uktāḥ teṣu vaiśyasyaivā- dhikāro nānyasyeti pūrvapakṣe hetvantaramāha |
'saptadaśo vai vaiśyaḥ' iti saptadaśatvāt vaiśyasya saptadaśa- sāmidhenīkeṣu yāgeṣu adhikāraḥ |
yathā 'vaiśyo vaiśyastomamena yajeta' iti vaiśyastomasya ijyāviśeṣaḥ yāgaviśeṣaḥ vaiśyasyaiva evaṃ sāmadavamapi tasyaiva |
na vā saṃyogapṛthaktvāt, guṇasyejyāpradhānatvāt- saṃyuktā hi codanā |
na vaiśyasyaivādhikāraḥ, kintu adhvarakalpādau trayāṇāmapi varṇānāmadhikāraḥ |
'saptadaśa vaiśyasya' ityekaṃ vākyaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ vaiśya- nimittakaṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ saptadaśatvaṃ vidhatte |
'saptadaśān brūyāt' iti tu vākyāntaraṃ varṇānāṃ api adhvara- kalpādivikṛtyardhatayā codakaprāptāptadaśatvena sāmadasyaṃ vidhatte |
guṇasya tu sāmadasyasya ijyāpradhānatvāt, na kartṛpradhānaḥ |
hi yasmāt codanā vikṛtiṣu sāmidhenīsādṛśyavadvidhaye : vaiśyena asaṃ- yuktā |
sāmadasyavidhiḥ ijyayā saṃyuktaḥ, na puruṣeṇa vaiśyādinā ityarthaḥ |
tasmāt sāmidhenīsādṛśyavattveṣu ijyāsu trayāṇāmapi varṇānāmadhikāro na vaiśyamātrasya iti siddhāntaḥ |
adhvarakalpā''grayaṇādiṣu saptadaśasāmidhenīkeṣu yāgeṣu vaiśyasyaivādhikāraḥ iti pakṣaṃ bruvatā pūrvapakṣiṇā vaiśyastoma- dṛṣṭāntaḥ pradarśitaḥ |
ijyāyāṃ ijyāviśeṣe vaiśyastome tu 'vaiśyo vaiśyastomamena yajeta' itistomayā viśeṣeṇa niya- myeta vaiśya eveti yuktam |
adhvara- kalpā''diṣu tu na tathā iti trayāṇāmapyadhikāraḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
yathā puruṣāt keśa- lomāni saṃbhavanti, tathā akṣarātsaṃbhavatīti viśvamiti śārīrikabhāṣye'bhihitam |
puruṣapraṇītāni yāni vākyāni tāni puruṣa- vivakṣādhīnavacanatvāt saṃbhavamadādiprāmāṇyatarapramāṇā- ntaragamyāni bhavanti |
yadvā vaikava kathayati 'anyaparaṃ mamedamabhipretaṃ pramādena vā, tasādetanmātramiha na grahītavyam' iti |
yadvā pramāṇāntaravaśena anyathā'rthe avadhārite vaktunapekṣā: śrotāra eva abhiprāyantaraṃ pramādaṃ vā adhyavasanti |
bhā. 6|1|1 pṛ. 1346. puruṣaprayatnasya phaloddeśyakasya vijātīyasya aprāptatvena vidheyatā |
'kacit svecchayā artheṣu svārtha: pravartate, kacidanyaprerita: 'ācāryaprerito'haṃ gāṃ ānayāmi, na svecchayā' ityādivyavahāradarśanāt |
yadyapi ācāryādi- api anicchantaṃ na śaknoti pravartayitum, tathāpi svārasikecchārahitamapi śiṣyādikaṃ svapravartanābalena icchāmupatyā pravartayati iti sarvāsākṣikam |
tasmāt śabdaśravaṇānantaramāvinā pravṛttau ācāryāde: pravartanā- jñāpanena pravartakatvamavasīyate |
puruṣabhedā uccāraṇabhedāśca yathāyogaṃ udāttādibhede: ṣaḍmṛdutvādibhedaiścetān dhvaniviśeṣān utpādya caritārthā: |
artho hi na kāraṇaṃ vacanasya, vaktu- buddhistu kāraṇameva |
ṛju. pṛ. 24. puruṣavacanāt vijñāta''yamanartha: iti niścayo bhavati |
'puruṣaśīrṣamupadhāti' (cayane) iti vacana- sāmarthyāt śavaśirasā sparśanaṃ smṛtiviprathitaṣiddhamapi kriyate |
puruṣasaṃskārā: puruṣaṃ prati phalapratigrahaṇasamarthe kurvanti, na yāgānivṛttisamartham |
3|1|14|24. puroḍāśa: tateṣu kapāleṣu adha:pākāryamadhidhīyate, upari ca aṅgārā abhyuhyante |
brāhmaṇasya ādhānaṃ somapūrvaṃ vā iṣṭipūrve veti vikalpa ukta: |
'yadevādya: paurṇamāsaṃ havi: tattarhi anunipetat' ityanena ekameva havi: somādūrdhvamutkṛṣyate iti ca pūrvasūtre uktam |
idānīṃ kiṃ tadekaṃ havi: iti praśnasyottaramāha |
tadekaṃ havi: agnīṣomīya: puroḍāśa eva syāt |

kevalasyāgne: kevalasya vā somasya pūrvaṃ anirdeśe nirdeśabhāve sati tayukte abhiyukte some devatābhāvāt devatāyā: devatatvasya vyāsajyavṛtte: bhāvāt agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśa eva tadekaṃ havi: somādūrdhvaṃ utkṛṣyate iti siddhānta: |
idaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvādhikaraṇaśeṣatvena vyākhyātuṃ yuktaṃ śakyaṃ ceti matvā asmābhistathā vyākhyātam |
paurṇamāsagatasya ekasyaiva haviṣa: utkarṣa: somāt iti pūrvamuktam |
'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatā' iti agne: pūrvamuktatvāt 'yadevādya: paurṇamāsaṃ havi:' iti ada:śabdena āgneyo'pi grahītuṃ śakya: |
tathā ca āgneyasyaiva haviṣa: somādutkarṣo'stu iti |
tathā kevalasyāgne: anirdeśe sati, tayukte some devatābhāvāt devatatvasya uktatvāt agnīṣomīya: puroḍāśa eva somādūrdhvaṃ utkṛṣyate: iti (siddhāntasūtramidam |
brāhmaṇasya ādhānaṃ somādūrdhvaṃ ekaṃ havi:, tacca agnīṣomīya: puroḍāśa: utkṛṣyata: ityuktam |
parantu tat ājyamapi syāt, na puroḍāśa eva |
taddhi agnīṣomīyaṃ vā prājāpatyaṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ vā |
yadyapi yajamāna: somāt prāk agnīṣomīyo yat na śaknoti tathāpi prajāpati yakṣyati viṣṇuṃ vā |
tasmāt ājyasya agnīṣomīyatvena somādūrdhvamutkarṣe'pi prājā- patyatvena vaiṣṇavatvena vā somāt prāgapi saṃbhavatvāt upāṃśu- yājājyasya notkarṣa: kintu puroḍāśasyaiva |
'āgneyaṃ caturtha karoti' iti caturthakaraṇe yathā āgneya- śabdena aindrāgna: puroḍāśo na gṛhyate, tasya miśradevata- tvāt |
ke. (vi. 10|1|9 ). puroḍāśa: na sviṣṭakṛdyāga- prayojya:, kintu āgneyāgaprayukta: |
bhā. 10|7|16|51-57. puroḍāśa: yāge śrūyate na home |
samasta puroḍāśasya devatā prati utkṛṣtvāt vināpi prakṣepāt asatvanyavahāra upapadyate niravadānācca śeṣa- siddhi: |
vā. 3|4|14|1 pṛ. 183. puroḍāśa: vāruṇyā niṣkāsena bādhyate |
puroḍāśau kṣāyata: ' ityatra ekasya bahūnāṃ vā kṣāme'pi prāyaścittam, na dvayoreva kṣāme |
bhā. 12|1|2|18. puroḍāśa: savanīyā: māṃsamayā: ṣaṭtriṃśattvasaṅkhyeya kartavye śakyanāmānye |
vi. 3|8|23. 'puroḍāśaṃ caturtha karoti' ityasya 'āgneyaṃ caturtha karoti' iti kṛtyai: upasaṃhāravidhi: |
bāla. pṛ. 17. 'puroḍāśaṃ caturtha karoti' iti darśapūrṇamāsayo: puroḍāśaśabda: jātiśabda: eva, na saṃskāraśabda: |
bhā. 1|4|7|10. 'puroḍāśaṃ paryagni karoti' iti paryagniprakaraṇaṃ guṇakarma, na pradhānakarma |
2|1| 4|9-12, 'puroḍāśaṃ paryagni karoti' iti savāneva puroḍāśān, na tu ekameva |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: 'puroḍāśabhyāmevāsomayājinaṃ yāja- yet yāvattau āgneyaścaindrāgnaśca, sānāsyena tu somayāji- nam' iti śrūyate |
atra puroḍāśabhyāṃ iti vākyāt adhikṛtānāṃ asomayājinaṃ puroḍāśayo: upadeśa: pratīyate |
tacchrutitvāt tasya asomayājina eva 'asomayājinaṃ yājayet' iti śravaṇāt |
vaiśyastomavat yathā 'vaiśyo vaiśyastomena yajeta' ityanena vaiśyasya vaiśyastome adhikāra: tadvat |
tasmāt 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' ityasya 'puroḍāśabhyāmevāsoma- yājinaṃ yājayet' iti vākyaśeṣa: |
asomayājitvaṃ hi anityam, somayāgottaraṃ tasya somayājitvatvāt |
tathā ca anityasya asomayājina: sataḥ nitya- darśapūrṇamāsādhikāre na saṃbhavati |
tasmāt eta- smāt heto: avākyaśeṣatvaṃ yat pūrvapakṣaṇā vākya- śeṣatvamuktaṃ tanna saṃbhavati |
kintu asomayājina: svargakāmasya prākṛtāgneyandradharmā karmāntarabhūto āgne- yaindrāgmī vidhīyate adhikau |
‘puroḍāśābhyāmevā somayājinam’ iti ‘darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ yajeta’ ityasya vākyaśeṣaḥ iti pakṣaṃ prakārā- ntareṇa dṛśyate |
sati ca vākyaśeṣatve ekadeśena darśapūrṇamāsaikadeśabhūtabhyāṃ puroḍāśābhyāṃ asoma- yājinaḥ saṃbandho vaktavyaḥ, sa ca nopapadyate |
athavā sati ca vākyaśeṣatve ekadeśena puroḍāśābhyāṃ kartuḥ asomayājinaḥ saṃbandhaḥ upapadyate |
sa hi na kasya cidekadeśaḥ, svatantratvāt |
kintu kartuḥ aṅgakartuḥ yāja- yituḥ ṛtvijaḥ : ‘puroḍāśābhyāṃ asomayājinaṃ yāja- yet’ ayaṃ vidhiḥ syāt |
tasya guṇārthatvāt guṇabhūtasya aṅgasya anuṣṭhānārthatvāt pradhānakarturyajamānasya guṇabhūta eva ṛtvik |
prāpte ca yājane arthaprāpte sati tadanuvādaḥ upadeśārtho na bhavati |
karmaṇostu prakaraṇe tannyāyatvāt guṇānāṃ liṅgena kālaśāsanaṃ syāt |
dinā pūrvādhena tu pātnyāmājyena sadanaṃ kartavyam |
vi. 3|18, puroḍāśasya pūrvasiddhasyaiva śakalaṃ aindrayāyapātre nidheyaṃ jyotiṣṭome |
3|8|18. puroḍāśasya śrapaṇe 'yaḥ śrutaḥ sa devaḥ ' ityanena vidhistasya yathocitapākasya stutaye 'yo vidagdhaḥ sa nairṛtaḥ; yo'śrutaḥ sa rudraḥ ' ityanyatra |
itare punaḥ puroḍāśāḥ asaṃkhyeyaṃ paśoḥ prātaḥsavanīyānāṃ vā tantramadhye patitāḥ |
bhā. 12|2| 12|32, puroḍāśe abhyūhaḥ (sāṅgarabhamāropaḥ ) kriyate darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'vedena bhasmanā ajñānaratnamu- hati ' iti |
puroḍāśakalpanyāyena nirvāpavākye agnihotra- sambandhitvaśravaṇāt tatprayuktatvāvagateḥ na nirvāpaḥ agni- hotrahavaṇyāḥ prayojakaḥ |
ata eva 'agnihotrahavaṇyā agnihotraṃ juhoti' ityatra 'paridhīn paridadhāti' iti- vat puroḍāśakalpanyāyābhāvāt agnihotrasya prayojaka- tvāvagateḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 10|2|26. 'paridhīn saṃmārṣṭi' ityatra paridhiṣadena paridhīyate anena iti vyutpattyā agniparidhānopalakṣitadravyābhidhānāt puro- ḍāśakalpanyāyena pālāśaprayojakatvāt noktā.prayojana- siddhiḥ |
ka. 2|1|5|2 pṛ. 85. 'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' ityatra na paridhau yūpādharmāḥ, satyāpi paridheḥ paśuniyojanaṃ prati samabhyā aṅgatve puroḍāśakalpanyāyena agniparidhānayūpa
'puroḍāśena mā mātā prahelakaṃ dadāti' ityadau yathā |
tena agniṣṭome pravargye rauhiṇau puroḍāśau tūṣṇīṃ kartavyau |
soma. 1|4|8. puroḍāśaśabdaḥ dhānā- diṣu bhāktaḥ saṃnihiteṣu prayukto jyotiṣṭome |

sārasvate satre 'ye puroḍāśinaḥ te upavasanti' ityatra |
bhā. 2|4|18 pṛ. 634. puroruk sautrāmaṇyāṃ surāgraheṣu ekā 'ekā puroruk ekā yājyā' iti |

su. pṛ. 655. purohitaḥ ekasya rājñaḥ eka eva upādeyatvena śrūyate 'purohitaṃ karoti' iti |

yathā padmapatraṃ jalena liptaṃ na bhavati, tatsamakakṣayāmatavattyalam |
bahūnāṃ śunāṃ madhye ekasya prahārārthaṃ prakṣitena puthena lyuḍena itare'pi śvāno nirā- kriyante |
tathā sāṃkhyavādinākaraṇayuktyā itare'pi vādino nirastā bhavanti |
'ekayokteti vacanāt puṣpavanta iti puṣpavāniti vā sūryaścandro vā na vaktavyaḥ |
akārā- ntapakṣe 'ava rakṣaṇe', 'jṛviśimyā jhan' 406 ityauṇā- dikasatreṇa bāhulakāccapratyaye 'ṣoḍantaḥ' (pā. 7|1|3) ityantādeśe avanta iti siddham |
puṣpasya prakāśayanto rakṣakau ādhārau iti yāvat |
ata eva prakṛtanyāye'pi puṣpavantābhyāṃ kṛta upakāraḥ |

yathā puṣpavantābhyāṃ svasvasahāyādanyebhyo maṅgala- digbhyo dvau dvau rāśī dattvā svāpāśrva caikako rāśiḥ sthāpitaḥ , evamudārāśayāḥ paropakāratayā bahubhyo bahu dattvā kaścidaviśeṣāpi saṃtuṣya sarveopari virājante |
su. pṛ. 750. pūjā pūjanīyaṃ prati guṇabhūtā loke dṛśyate |
ṭup. 9|1| 419 pṛ. 1655. pūjāyāḥ prītyutpādanatvātmaka- tvena karotyarthatvam |
su. pṛ. 750. pūjyānāṃ pratyakṣanāmagrahaṇamayuktam 'parokṣapriyā iva hi devāḥ' |
bhāṣyam— idamamananti 'yadi somaṃ na vindeta pūtikānabhiṣuṇuyāt' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimayamabhāve nimitte vidhiḥ, uta pratinidhinīyama iti |
kutaḥ ? vinaṣṭe hi sādhane sādhya- siddhayarthaṃ sādhanantaramupādīyate, śrutyā'bhāvāt |
sadṛśe prāpte, bahuṣu vā asadṛśeṣu pūtikā alpasadṛśā niyamyante |
soma— prakrānte'pi prayoge vacanāt dravyāntara- mañjamiti pratyavasānāt saṃgataḥ |
sūtrārthastu— manda- sadṛśatvāt anyathyamapi pūtikadravyaṃ vacanāt pratinidhiḥ syāt vacanasyābhāve'pi itarasya mukhyabhāvāt tatsāmānyena pratinidhiriti |
' bhāṭṭa— 'yadi somaṃ na vindeta pūtikānabhiṣuṇu- yāt' ityādi ki somābhāve pūtikatvena rūpeṇa pūtikānāṃ vidhānam, uta pratinidhidhiyā pūtikagatasomāvayavānāṃ niyamaḥ |
iti cintāyām, pratinidhidhiyeme pūtika- padasya tadgatasomāvayave lakṣaṇā''patteḥ abhāve vidhirevā- yam |
abhāve vidhipakṣe'pi pratinidhinīyamasya arthasiddhatvāt lāghavasya asannate'pi satvāt |
kiñca, somā- bhāve susadṛśasyāsyaiva prāpteḥ mandasadṛśānāṃ pūtikānāṃ pakṣaprāptyabhāvādeva niyamaviṣayatvānupapattiḥ |
ataḥ pūtikatvena rūpeṇa pūtikānāmapi somābhāve vihitatvāt tadapacāre pūtikasadṛśamupādeyam |
tayāle pūtikatvasya tadavacchinnavayasyestada- vayavāntarāṇāṃ ca somāvayavavijātīyānāṃ kalpatvakalpanā- gauravāpatteḥ |

evaṃ ca pūtī kācāre somapūtīkobhayasadṛśaṃ grāhyam |

tataḥ sā tulyaviṣayatvaniścitvā pūrvamāvacitvā nātmānaṃ adhikatāpekṣaṃ ca sarvatvam |
1|2|1|16. pūrṇāhute- labhate iti mṛgatṛṣṇikādiviva mithyātvaṃ kalpyanteva ragnisaṃskārakatvam |

saṃgrahaḥ . , śekhara: pṛ. 2535 ' pāṭhayormantrabrāhmaṇagatayorme-paṭhato valī- pari0 62 ca.

sa ca ' pūrvajanma 0 ' iti tata ekādhikān ' iti (5|5|2) tatra ' abhighāryā nyāyena pūrvajitakarmarūpaṃ devaṃ vā bhavatu anyathā, sarvathā anabhighāryā iti mīmāṃsante brahmavādinaḥ ' ityuktvā dharmadharmyoranyamevameva na pratyakṣatvam |
sanā. gha. pra. ' abhighāryā eva ' iti uktam |
tathā ādhāne ' hotavya- pṛ. 70. magnihotraṃ na vā iti mīmāṃsante brahmavādinaḥ ' iti oṃ pūrvadevatānupalakṣaṇādhikaraṇam |
pālīva- vicārya ' tūṣṇīmena hotavyam ' iti uktam |
pūrvaḥ pūrvādhikaraṇadāhyaḥ vākyaiḥ tulyakālatvāt tulya- ' pālīvate tu pūrvavat |
' abhighāryā bhāṣyam-- asti pālīvato grahaḥ, ' yadupaśupānena eva ' iti vidhiḥ itarat sarva arthavādaḥ |
tathā ' tūṣṇīṃ āyaprayāt pālīvataṃ gṛhṇāti ' iti |
dvidevatyānāṃ hotavyam ' iti vidhiḥ itarat sarvamarthavāda iti |
oṃ pūrvat paraṃ balīyaḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
atha hute pālīvate tacceṣṭe madhyamāme bhavati saṃdehaḥ saṃgrahaḥ |
kiṃ tāvat pūrvasmin pakṣasi gavāmayane vyanīkā niviśate |
teṣāmapi hi asau śeṣaḥ, sā niviśamānā āye dve ahanī varjayitvā bhavati, yathā prasiddhadevatā yā iti |
dvidevatyānāṃ aindrā- 10|5|2|8 pṛ. 1609. pūrvayoḥ varṇayoḥ vāyavādīnāṃ śeṣā ādityasyālyāṃ nikṣiṣyante |
tato'pi (viprakṣatriyayoḥ ) vedādhyāyinaṃ hatvā ' iti brahmaṇaḥ punaḥ āyaprayātsyāmāgacchanti |
tataśca pālīvatagrahaṇaṃ dvādaśāhāni ' iti sāmānyavidheḥ puruṣārthaḥ upasaṃhāra- śrūyate ' upāṃśupātreṇa pālīvatamāyaprayāt gṛhṇāti ' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 17. tasya hutaśeṣe bhakṣyamāṇe pūrvadeva ' indrāvāyupalīvatītyasya ' ' pūrvābādhena notpattiruttarasya hi setsyati ' evamāpulakṣaṇaṃ kartavyamiti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
nādeḥ pravṛttipuruṣaviṣayatayā vihitasya sadopāsādi- bhāṣyam-- apanīyate hi sa śeṣaḥ iha, na yathā- bodhakavacanasaṃkocatayā saṃkucitavākyārthasya yathāvada- pūrvavat |
tatra hi pātralakṣaṇatvena saṃkītyate, na somo nuṣṭhānena sidhyatyeva yathoktaphalasaṃpādakatvamiti bodhya- grāhyatvena |
iha tu ' āyaprayāt gṛhṇāti ' iti miti |
sādṛṣṭī. 6|4. sthālyasaḥ : somo nirdiśyate hotṛ yajamānadevatāṃ prati |
nanu sthālyāṃ āyaprayāt : anāgrayaṇaśca, tatra yaḥ tasmādāgra- bhā. 12|1|2|13|33. yaṇād gṛhyate, sa pālīvataḥ |
yo'paiti āgrayaṇaḥ anāgrayaṇo vā, sa sarvaḥ pālīvataḥ |
yo hi indrārthasya somasyāvayavaḥ śeṣaḥ, sa indrapītaḥ iti prakṛtau ucyate |
nanu ihāpi samudāya eva āsīt tadaivataḥ, tasyaivāvayavaḥ |
āha, pūrvadevatāpītasyāsau avayava āsīt tena bhūtapūrvagatyā bhaviṣyati |
apica indra- devatyaḥ tatra indrapīta ityuktam |
tatra yadyapi tāvat parakīya eva saṃkalpaḥ |
kimuta yadā so''pi saṃkalpanīyaḥ śruta eva |
' yadā hi 'āgrayaṇaṃ pālīvataṃ karoti' iti śrūyate, tataḥ saṃnihito''pi anāgrayaṇatvāt śāstrabalena śeṣaḥ katha- ścit saṃkalpyadāpanīyate |
atra punaḥ 'āgrayaṇāt gṛhṇāti' iti śrūyate, na āgrayaṇasya āgrayaṇaṃ iti vā |
tadyathā 'vṛkṣāt parṇaṃ patati' ityukte kaṅkakurarādipatna- mapi pratīyate, vṛkṣasya apādānamātropakṣīṇatvāt |
samānadeśādyośca saṃpātāgrayaṇayoḥ ya ekā- paiti, sa eva āgrayaṇadapetaḥ |
yat tanmiśrāt anāgrayaṇādapi apaiti, na tatpratiṣedhe vidhau vā upayujyate |
nahi anāgrayaṇāt apetaḥ na pālīvata iti vacanamasti |
yadi vā ayamarthaḥ syāt, tato yo''pi āgrayaṇaḥ tato''paiti, so''pi āgrayaṇānāgrayaṇapetatvāt apālī- vataḥ prāpnoti |
tassāt āgrayaṇadapeta ityasyākhyātvāt apramāṇakatvāt avaśyamevāśrayitavyaṃ āgrayaṇāttā- vadapetaḥ iti |
tacca saṃpātasyāpi aviśiṣṭaṃ iti upapannaṃ devatāsambandhitvam |
na ca pūrvadevatātvamapananīya uttarasaṃtraṇo''vakalpate ityupapannaṃ pūrṇakabhojanavadanupa- lakṣaṇam |
'nanu yo'sau pūrvadevatā'rthaḥ : tasyaivāyaṃ bhavayavaḥ : ' iti ( bhāṣyam ) bhūtapūrvagatyabhiprāyam |
ācāryastu svayamevainaṃ abhyupagamyāmīti manvānaḥ pariharati tāvat 'nahi hutasyāvayavo dṛśyate' iti |
nahi hutadanyat tasya devatāyā vidyate, tasyāpanītatvāt ityabhiprāyaḥ |
teṣāṃ homānantaraṃ tadīyāḥ śeṣāḥ : ādityasthālī prāpya tṛtīyasavane ādityasthālīta āgrayaṇasthālīṃ prāpnuvanti |
takṣaṇe dvidevāḥ ki sārdhaṃ pālīvatena te |
' bhāṭṭa-- dvidevatyānāmaindrāvayādīnāṃ śeṣā āditya- sthālyāṃ āgatya tato'pi āgrayaṇasthālīmāgacchanti |
tasmin bhakṣyamāṇe dvidevatyā api upalakṣaṇīyāḥ pūrvavat āgrayaṇasyaiva palī- vadevatāsambandhāt |
iti prāpte, 'pālīvatamāgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti' ityapādānatvaśravaṇāt tasmādapetasya pālīvata- tvam, na tu āgrayaṇasyaiva |
āgrayaṇavacca anāgrayaṇamapi saṃspṛṣṭatvāt tasmādapeta iti dvidevatyāpi devatā''ntara- saṃvandhāpayat, bhūtapūrvāgatyā ca prakṛtau anupalakṣaṇāt nopalakṣaṇīyāḥ ( indravāyvādyaḥ ) |
maṇḍana— 'pālīvate tu prayadena pūrvam ( deva- tām ) |
anyonyasāpekṣajñānotpādakatvātsāvat pūrvapadajanyajñāna- virodhino jñānasya uttareṇa padenātpāditasya bādhakalānupa- patteḥ nātra pūrvadevailvanyāyaḥ saṃbhavati |
6|5|159. mīko. pṛ. 499 pūrvanimitto hi uttaraśabdaḥ uttaranimittaśca pūrvaśabdaḥ |
( pūrvamasti asya uttarasya, sa pūrvavān uttaraḥ |
'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' iti jāteṣṭiḥ śrūyate |

tatra 'yaddvādaśakapālo bhavati gāyatryenaṃ brahmavarcasena punāti, yadnavapālaḥ : triṣṭuvaitasmiṃstejo dadhāti, yaddśakapāle triṣṭuvaivāsinn annādyaṃ dadhāti, yaddvādaśakapālo jagatyaivāsinn paśchan dadhāti |
yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati, pūta eva tejasvī annāda indriyāvī paśumān bhavati' iti aṣṭakapālādayaḥ : ekā- daśakapālaparyantāḥ kapālavikalpāḥ śrūyante |
te aṣṭatvā- dayaḥ kiṃ guṇavidhayaḥ, utārthavādāḥ : iti vicāre pūrva- pakṣamāha |
agnyādayo guṇāḥ pūrvavantaḥ : prāpakaśāstravantaḥ mantrādinā prāptāḥ |
ataḥ teṣāṃ agnihotrādiśabdāḥ avidhānāthāḥ : vidhānāthāḥ na bhavanti |
prakṛte tu samā- naye aṣṭakapālādiśabdasamūhe tatsāmarthyaṃ guṇavidhāna- sāmarthyaṃ syāt |

atra sudhā— ye vaiśvadevadiśabdāḥ pūrvavantaḥ : vākyā- ntareṇa guṇaviśiṣṭe karmaṇi pūrvamutpanne tadviruddhaguṇāttarā- bhidhāyinaḥ, te svākyasyena guṇena nirākāṅkṣe karmaṇi tadviruddhaguṇāttarābhidhānāśakteḥ avidhānāthāḥ |

aṣṭā- kapālādiśabdānāṃ tu samāmnāyatvāt sahoccāraṇatvāt ekavākyagatatvāt utpatyupapattivaśiṣṭenavagamāt vaiśvadevaśabdasya pūrvapakṣe sāmarthyaṃ tadeṣāmasti, yastu utpattiśiṣṭena utpannaśiṣṭasya bādhastokaḥ, so''tra nāsti iti sūtrārthaḥ |
guṇasya tu vidhānārthe''tadguṇāḥ prayoge syu- ranarthakā na hi taṃ pratyarthavattā''sti |
guṇasya aṣṭatvādeḥ vidhānārthe vākye svīkṛte sati atadguṇāḥ vaiśvānarayāgasya guṇā na bhavanti aṣṭatvādyaḥ |
tassāt te prayoge vaiśvānarānuṣṭhāne anarthakāḥ syuḥ |
hi yasmāt taṃ puroḍāśaṃ prati yāgaṃ prati vā arthavattā nahi asti |
taccepoḥ teṣāṃ aṣṭa- tvādīnāṃ avihitatvāt śeṣaḥ stāvaka vākyaśeṣo nopa- padyate iti cet |
vidhānārthe vidhīyate iti vidhānaṃ karmaṇi lyuṭ, vidhirvidhīyate dvādaśakapāle stutyarthena |
sudhīyāṃ tu 'tatsāmīpyācca śaknuvanti aṣṭādiśabdāḥ tadekadeśapratītiṃ kartum' iti vārtikā- nusāreṇa avibhāgācchaḥ sāmīpyācca ityuktam |
'yadaṣṭakapālaḥ' ityādibhiḥ sārvavākaiḥ pratyekaṃ vihitānāṃ yathāsaṃkhyene pūta evetyādibhiḥ phala- saṃbandhaḥ kriyate |
ānarthakyātkāraṇaṃ, karturhi kāraṇāni, guṇārtho hi vidhīyate |
atra brahmavarcasādiphalatvena aṣṭakapālādīnāṃ yāgānāṃ viṣayaḥ syuḥ, na tu dvādaśakapālasya avaculya stutiḥ iti 'kāraṇaṃ syāt' iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣiṇā ukte siddhāntī āha |
aṣṭakapālādivākyoktena phalena 'yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati' ityādinā upasaṃhṛtavāni |
tasmāt aṣṭatvādi kaṃ putratadbrahmavarcasādiphale akāraṇaṃ kāraṇatvena vidhānāīm |
katham ? kartuḥ pituḥ hi yasmāt tāni kāraṇāni putrāputratvarūpaphalakāraṇāni bhavanti |
hi tasmāt aṣṭā- kapālādiśabdaḥ na nāmadheyam, na karmaṇi guṇavidhiḥ, nāpi phaleṣu guṇavidhiḥ, kintu guṇārthaḥ guṇena stutirūpeṇa arthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya saḥ vaiśvānarayāga eva vidhīyate |
tasāt aṣṭakapālatvādikaṃ avyutpannānuvādaḥ arthavādaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte, yadaṣṭā- kapālo bhavati gāyatryaivaiṃ brahmavarcasena punāti, yacca- kapālastriṣṭubhāsiṃstejo dadhāti, yadaśakapāle virājaivā- smin annādyaṃ dadhāti, yadekādaśakapālastriṣṭumaivāsi- nnindriyaṃ dadhāti, yadvādaśakapāle jagatyaivāsin paśūn dadhāti |
yasmin jāta etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati, pūta eva (sa) tejasvyāda indriyāvī paśumān bhavati' iti kapālavikalpāḥ śrūyante |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimaṣṭatvādyo guṇavidhayaḥ, utārthavādā iti |

atra prabhākareṇa saṃgatilobhāt itthamādhikaraṇamupavarṇitam- 'yadaṣṭakapāle bhavati' ityādināṃ vihitasmārakatvābhāvāt na mantratve- nānanvayaḥ, bhāvārthasāmānyādhikaraṇyamātraṃ nāmadheyatvena, aṣṭatvādiguṇānvayayogyabhāvārthasaṃnidheḥ nāpi guṇavidhi- tvena |
na ca vaiśvānarayāge guṇavidhānam, tasya dvādaśa- saṃkhyā'vacchedena saṃkhyāntaravidhānasaṃbhavāt |
iti sarvathā vidhitvābhāvāt aprāmāṇyameva 'yadaṣṭā- kapālo bhavati' ityādinām |
guṇavidhi- pratiyogikaṃ nāmadheyatvaṃ nirūpya, prasaṅgena guṇavidhi- tvapratiyogikaṃ arthavādatvaṃ nirūpyate |
'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' ityatra dravyadevatāviśiṣṭakarmavidhānāt dvādaśa- kapālavidhānaṃ tāvat vyavasthitameva |
nāpi tadannantara- śrutānāṃ aṣṭakapālādināmekādaśakapālaparyantānāṃ anyā gatirasti |
yatto na tāvat nāmadheyena asya gatiḥ, dvādaśakapāle karmaṇi aṣṭakapālanāmnaḥ pravṛttinimittā-
nāpi arthavādatvena, dvādaśakapālasya aṣṭā- kapālatvena stutyasaṃbhavāt |
nanu dvādaśakapāle aṣṭā- kapālaḥ antargata eva, ato nāmadheyatvamarthavādatvaṃ vā bhaviṣyatīti |
nahi yāvataḥ saṃkhyayānepekṣya dvādaśasaṃkhyālocyate, tāvat evāpekṣya aṣṭasaṃkhyā'pyucyate |
nahi saṃkhyā sattamātreṇa saṃjñeyamevacchinnati, kintu saṃkhyā'ntaravyacchedena, iti na dvādaśasaṃkhyāyāṃ aṣṭatvādisaṃkhyā'ntargatiḥ |
na cāṣṭakapālādiśabdena adhiṣṭhānāni abhidhīyante, yena yathākathaṃcidapi nāmadheyatvamarthavādatvaṃ vā bhavet |
astu vā mahāsaṃkhyāyā avāntarasaṃkhyā, tathāpi 'aṣṭasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ puro- ḍāśo'ṣṭakapālaḥ' iti saṃskṛtadvito'yam |
na ca dvādaśakapālavākye aṣṭatvasya dvādaśasaṃkhyāpūrakatveṣṭava- nirapekṣasya puroḍāśasaṃskārārthapālaviśeṣaṇatvamavagatam, kintu catuṣṭvāpekṣasyaiva tat |
yadapi aṣṭakapālatve'pi aṣṭatvasya catuṣṭvāpekṣasyaivāpādanamabhimatam, na ca tat saṃbhavati, sāpekṣatvena samastadravyotpattisaṃbhavāt |

atha catuṣṭvanirapekṣasya dvādaśakapālāntargatasya puro- ḍāśasaṃskārārthapālaviśeṣaṇatvamucyate, tathā sati dvādaśa- kapālavākye tathābhūtasyāṣṭatvasya prātmānaṃ nāmadheyatvam, nāpyaryavādatvam, kiṃ tarhi ? guṇavidhitvameva |
na ca prakṛtasya vaiśvānarayāgasya utpattiśiṣṭadvādaśadravyatvāt kathaṃ tatrāṣṭatvādiguṇavidhānamiti vācyam |
yasyaiva tu dvādaśakapālasya vihitatvāt punarvidhānaṃ na saṃbhavati tasyaivānte kīrtanamanuvādārthameveti |
ataḥ pūrva- vanto ye vihitapūrvamarthamamidadhati te avidhānārthāḥ, ataḥ aṣṭatvādisāmāmnāye tatsāmarthya vidhānasāmarthyameveti |
evaṃ prāpte, abhidhīyate- guṇasya tu vidhānārthe tadguṇāḥ prayoge syu- ranararthakāḥ, nahi taṃ pratyarthavattā'sti ||
bhavedevaṃ yadi utpattiśiṣṭadvādaśatvā- varuddhe vaiśvānarayāge arthavādayo vidhātuṃ śakyeran |
na ca ekavākyatvavaśena sarveṣāmevotpattiśiṣṭatvāt na dvādaśa- tvena avarodha iti vācyam |
'athaikatvādekaṃ vākyaṃ sākāṅkṣa cedvibhāge syāt' (2|1|14|146) iti khalu eka- vākyatvalakṣaṇam |
nāpi vibhajya- mānasākāṅkṣatvam, parasparavirodhādeva anyonyākāṅkṣayā abhāvāt |
ato na tāvat dvādaśakapālavaiśvānarayāge guṇavidhānaṃ saṃbhavati |
nāpi viparītanatavaiśvānarapadanānuṣṭheya 'aṣṭakapālo vaiśvānaro bhavati' iti guṇaviśiṣṭayāgā- ntaravidhānam, viparītānuṣṭheyadopādeva |
asti ca arthavādatvenaiva atra gatiriti vaktavyam |
nanu evaṃ tarhi prakṛtaṃ vaiśvānarayāgamāśritya yathāsaṃkhyaṃ pūtatvādiphale aṣṭatvādyo vidhīyantām, 'gāyatryaivaiṃ brahmavarcasena punāti' ityasya (ityādeḥ) arthavādatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |

'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' ityupakramya ante ca 'yad dvādaśakapālo bhavati, yasmin jāta etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati' ityupakramopa- saṃhārayoḥ dvādaśakapālakīrtanāt dvādaśakapālavidhānaparameka- midaṃ vākyamavagamyate |
tatrāpi yadi 'godohanena paśu- kāmasya' itivadaṣṭakapālādau kāmanopatvena phalasaṃbandhaḥ sphuṭataramavagamyate, tadā vākyabhedaḥ svīkriyatāpi,
ananyanyāyasvarūpaṃ tu 'tad (samudāya) dvitvā- nusāriṇau darśapūrṇamāsaśabdau tadipyata bhavataḥ' iti |

yāgaviśeṣaṇāṃ phalavattvāt phalavattvasyaiva prādhānyāparaparyāyamukhyalakṣaṇatvāt saṃnihitasya phalasaṃyu- kasya aṅgatvakāraṇabhāgāttvāt aśrutanyāyaphalatvakalpane ca gauravāpatteḥ ādhārādīnāṃ aṅgataiva yuktā iti sūtrārtheḥ |
pṛthaktvanimittā hi 'ayājyā vai nigadā ṛcaiva yajantīti' vyapadeśā bhavanti |
yathā pṛthivyāmoṣadhayaḥ nādhikaraṇyena rūḍhyā yogāpahārāt te'pi grahaviśeṣā saṃbhavantīti, tathā prakṛte'pi |
saṃkarṣa. 3|3|17. yadetat mṛdārabdhaṃ dravyāntaraṃ pṛthivīgolakaṃ nāma, pṛṣiprāṇagrahāṇāṃ anārabhyādhītānāmapi (saiṣā mahābhūmiḥ) viśvajiti sarvasvadāne na deyā |
bhā. dvādaśāhe prāyaṇīyodayanīyayoḥ daśame'hani ca 6|12|3, kṣetrāṇāmīśitāro manuṣyā dṛśyante, na niveśaḥ ||

6|12|3. pṛthivīgolakatrailokyabhramaṇādinā vā purāṇe- anārabhyādhītānāṃ pṛṣiprāṇagrahāṇāmaṃśadatvādināmiva kena kenāpi guṇavādena bhūminnāmeva satāṃ dṛṣṭiśvāt prakṛtau niveśe prāpte, 'prāyaṇīyodayanīyayoḥ daśame'hani yathaiva vayamupari devān paśyāmaḥ evamadhedeśasya upari- ca gṛhyante' iti vacanāt
tadevaṃ jyotiṣṭome vikṛtau (gavāmayane pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe) api ekena sādhitavyaṃ codanānugrahāya |
bhā. 10|6|15, bṛhadrathatare pṛṣṭhe (prathamādivacanam) prakaraṇasya tulyatvāt samānadharmī |
pṛṣṭhāni iti 'pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' itivihitakarmanāmadheyaṃ avayavaprasiddhyā, sarvaśanāt pṛṣṭhāni |
'tāsāṃ vāyuḥ pṛṣṭhe vyarvata' iti yasmādāpa pṛṣṭhe spṛṣṭe rathaṃtarādīni jātāni, tasmāttāni pṛṣṭhāni ityevādāt vijñātam |
pṛṣṭhāni māhendrastotrādīni catvāryeva jyotiṣṭome, na sarvāṇi ṣaḍapi |
bhā. 7|3|16, pṛṣṭhāni viśvajiti pavamāne rathaṃtaram, ābhaṃbhe bṛhat, vairūpaṃ hotuḥ, vairājaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya, raivataṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ ; śākvaramacchāvākasya |
tatra pṛthivīsamudrādidhyānādyo hikāradayo vā pṛṣṭhadharmā na kartavyāḥ, kintu tairanairupasthānaṃ kartavyam |
bhīko. pṛ. 38 'agnicayane pṛṣṭhairupatiṣṭhate' ityatra cayane lakṣaṇayā abhidhānameva prakṛtādhikarmakaṃ dhātunā vidhīyate tatraiva pṛṣṭhadārthasya karaṇavam |
'ami tvā śūra nonumaḥ' iti ādyā, tatra rathaṃtaraṃ sāma |
'kayā naścitra ābhuvat' iti tṛtīyā, tatra vāmadevyam |
'taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣaham' iti caturthī, tatra naudhasam |
'abhi pra vaḥ surādhasam' iti pañcamī, tatra dyetam |
'pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' iti stotraṃ pradhānakarma, na guṇakarma |
mā. 2|1|5|13-29, pṛṣṭhasya ekasya pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ niveśaḥ anyeṣāṃ parisāmākāryaṃ |
tat kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ kasyāṃ yonī geyaṃ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
pṛṣṭhayai pṛṣṭhastotrārthaṃ yat rathaṃtaradanyat kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ śrūyate tat 'abhi tvā śūra' iti rathaṃtarayonau syāt, tadyoni-pūrvaktvāt jyotiṣṭome yā rathaṃtarayonarbhavati saiva yoniḥ |
nanu vaiśyastomasya jyotiṣṭomapūrvakatvāt bṛhato yonavāpi kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ syāt |
bṛhatsāmnaḥ ṛgbhyaḥ kaṇvarathaṃ-tarasya ṛcāṃ pravibhaktatvāt bhinnatvāt |
tasmāt vaiśyastome kaṇvarathaṃtaraṃ-sāma rathaṃtarayonau geyaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
kaṇvarathaṃtare rathaṃtaraśabdaḥ rathaṃtaradhameṣu satsu yūpavat upapadyate |
yathā yasmin kāṣṭhe yūpadharmāḥ santi tasmin yūpaśabdaḥ pravartate tadvat |
kaṇvarathaṃtaraśabdastu na tathā kintu rūḍho'yaṃ śabdaḥ |

'ukthyo vairūpasāmā, ṣoḍaśī vairājasāmā' ityādiṣu 'pṛṣṭhārthe vā prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogāt' (10|6|6|16) ityanena nyāyena vairūpādeḥ pṛṣṭhasādhanatva-dyotanāthatvena sāmnaḥ pṛṣṭhalakṣaṇārthatvāt dūrāpāstā sāmanatāpekṣayā |
dharaṇigatānekadravyapratyanīkrīkṣaṇe punaḥ punaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuṭilīkriyate iti tatsāmāmyena pṛṣṭha-koṭābhidhānam |
pṛṣṭhakoṭaḥ pṛṣṭhasya ākoṭaḥ vakratvaṃ asmin vyāpāre sa pṛṣṭhakoṭaḥ |
kaḥ punaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśaḥ ? ūrdhvaṃ mādhyaṃdinapavamānāt prāk maitrāvaruṇasāmnaḥ, idamantarālaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśaḥ |
pṛṣṭhadharmāḥ sāmānyadharmā hikāradayaḥ, viśeṣadharmāḥ 'rathaṃtare prastuyamāne pṛthivīṃ manasā dhyāyet, bṛhati samudram' ityemādayaḥ |
(upāsyai, prayujo vāno) prākṛtayoḥ naimittikoḥ saṃsavādi vikṛtau nānuṣṭhānam |
pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ agnicayanato rathaṃtarādisamopeta-mantropalakṣakaḥ, na stotradharmāt atidiśati |
saptadaśāni (saptadaśastoma-kāni) pṛṣṭhāni iti pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ nāmadheyam, na guṇa-vidhiḥ |
pṛṣṭhaśamanīyeḥ (udavasānīyeḥ) satrasamāptyanantaraṃ satrimaikenaiva ṛtvigantarasaṃpādanena kartavyaḥ, na saṃhatya |
pṛṣṭhaśamanīye kartṛtvaṃ na satriyā-meva yajamānatvena, kintu ayajamānā ṛtvijaḥ kartāraḥ |
tatra satriyāmapi ṛtvikatvena kevalena parikraye na doṣaḥ |
pṛṣṭhaśamanīye satriyo'nye ṛtvijaḥ, na tu te eva |
bhāṣyam-- antarā cintāntarasya sūtraṃ tāvat varṇa-yiṣyāmaḥ |
asminnevodāharaṇe eṣo'rthaḥ sāṃśayikaḥ : kiṃ te eva satriṇaḥ ṛtvijaḥ ? utānye vā varītavyā iti |
kutaḥ ? samānakartṛkatā hi gamyate 'udasāya yajeran' iti |
ye eva udavasattāraḥ, te eva yaṣṭāraḥ iti bhavati pratyayaḥ |
yathaiva vacana-prāmāṇyāt codakaprāptāmekakartṛkāṃ bādhitā bahukartṛkatā bhavati, evaṃ codakaprāptānanyān ṛtvijo bādhitā vacanaprāmāṇyāt te eva bhavitumarhantīti |
nahi pṛṣṭha-śamanīye ye satrādudavasattāraḥ, te kartāro vidhīyante |
na cānanye hīne viguṇātā cit bhavati |
api cātra yāvati kartṛpriyāya kriyāphalam, tāvati te eva kartāraḥ |
na ca ṛtvijaḥ prati yāgasya kartṛbhiprāyaṃ kriyāphalam |
dupū— ye eva udavasāne kartāraḥ, te eva udava- sānīye vidhīyante |
(yadi tu anye'pi kartāraḥ pṛṣṭha- śamanīye bhaveyuḥ, tataḥ ) sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt |
pradhānamātre hi (samānakartṛ- katva—) vacanaṃ (bhavati 'yajeran' iti) nahi viśeṣaṇaṃ śrūyate pṛṣṭhaśamanīyeḥ kāryaḥ iti |
vi— 'tatratvijaḥ satriyaḥ kimanve vā syur, vyarthayuktiḥ |
bhāṭṭa— anaṅgatve aṅgattve'pi vā udavasānasamāna- kartṛkatvānurodhāt yajamānaireva ārtvijyaṃ kartavyam |

na ca tasya pradhānamātre'bhiprāyatvena upapattiḥ, sāṅge samāna- kartṛtvaśravaṇena 'apsu adhvaryuṃ caranti' ityādī adriḥ āhavanīyāderiva aupadeśikena yajamānakartṛ- katvena aṅgeṣvapi ṛtvikartṛkatvāt, dakṣiṇādānasya adṛṣṭārthatvenāpi upapatteśca |
iti prāpte, prayojakakartṛttve- nāpi prakṛtāviha yajamānakartṛkatvopapatteḥ aṅge'nya- ṛtve'pi vā sauryādāviva atideśaprāptaṛtvigāce pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
teṣāṃ tu vacanād dviyajñavat sahaprayogaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam— idamevodāharaṇam 'satrādavasāya pṛṣṭha- śamanīyena jyotiṣṭomena sahasadakṣiṇena yajeran' iti |
tatraiṣo'rthaḥ samadhigataḥ na satrāṅge pṛṣṭhaśamanīye iti |
athedānīmidaṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ saṃhatya taistat kartavyam, uta ekaikeneti |
kutaḥ ? upādeyatvena vāge codyamānasya bahutvasya śravaṇāt |
sa cedekena kriyeta, bahutvasaṃyuktḥ prayogo na syāt |
dviyajñavat yathā 'etena rājapurohitī sājyuyakāmo yajeyātām' iti |
yadyapi rājapurohitī lakṣaṇatvena śrūyate, evamapi yajeyātāmiti yāgaḥ upādeyatvena |
dupū— (pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena) yajeran ityupādeyatvena śrutatvāt bahutvasya vivakṣā |
tathaiva sthitānāṃ ca (udavasānīya—) yāgo vidhīyate (ataḥ ) sa (api apara—) nirapekṣāṇāmeva |
yadyapi udavasāne nirapekṣāḥ, tathāpi yāge sāpekṣāḥ (bhavanti) dviyajña- vat |
(yathā) (rājapurohitī phalaṃ prati pradhānabhūtau (parasparanirapekṣau) yāgaṃ prati (tu) guṇabhūtau (sāpekṣau) |
katham ? (uttaram—) yāgo hi vidhīyamānaḥ kartāra- mākāṅkṣati |
kathaṃ tarhi anuṣṭhānamata āha—) kartṛgāmini (upagrahaviśeṣāt) kriyāphale, arthāta kriyā kariṣyati |
yadi ca rājapurohitī dvivacana- viśeṣaṇārthamuccāyātām, tathā sati yāgaṃ pradhānabhūtaṃ na kaścit kuryāt |
(avasāya iti padamanekṣya yajeran iti padālocana- velāyām) bahutvavacanaṃ vidhīyate |
(tadaśena ca) sāpekṣāśca kartāraḥ (yāge udavasāne kartāro bhavanti ) |
ye ca udavasānalakṣitastathā yāga ityekaikasyāpi yāgo vihito bhavati |
bahu- saṃyuktaḥ prayogaḥ ekaikena na śakyate kartumiti |
yathaivodavasāne teṣāmasaṃhatānāṃ bahutvavacanam, evaṃ yāge'pi asaṃhatānā- meva bhaviṣyati |
nanvidānīmevoktamudavasātānāṃ yāgaḥ, te ca bahava iti |
paripūrṇe hi padaṃ padāntarāmākāṅkṣati, tato vākyaṃ bhavati |
ayaṃ ca yāgaḥ prāgeva bahutvavacanena saṃśraddhaḥ |
na tasyāmava- sthāyāṃ vākyena udavasātāraḥ prāptāḥ |
yatra kena cit prakāreṇānuvādaḥ saṃbhavati, tatrānuvādo vā syāt, vidhivaiti |
yadyapi apūrvatvādvaya vidhi- jyāyānanuvādāt, tathā'pi atrānuvāda eva bahutvasya bhavitumarhati |
tathāhi yāgasaṃbandho bahūnāṃ na kṛto bhavati |
tatra dṛṣṭameva prayojanam, itarasmin pakṣe bahutvasya yāgasaṃbandhve'dṛṣṭaṃ kalpanīyaṃ syāt |
yatra ktvā'ntaḥ śabdo bhavati, tatra dvau prayogau gamyete |
tadāśrayaḥ prayogaḥ, kartāraśca, tadvā ca saṃkhyā, evaṃ sarvametadatrāpi vidhīyamāne prāpta- mevānuvate |
dviyajñe satreṣu ca dhātvartho vidhīyate, prayogo'pi, kartāraḥ, tadvā ca saṃkhyeta, sarvameva tatrā- prāptam |
nahi rājapurohitī ityeva śaknoti prayogaṃ vadi- tuma, tatra ca kartṛtvam, tadvā saṃkhyām |
dupū— itaretaranirapekṣā udavasāne kartāraḥ, arthaṃ- prāptatvāt udavasānasya, abhāvatvāt |
nanu rājapurohitavat (ekatra nirapekṣāḥ itaratra sāpekṣā bhavanti ) ityuktam |
yajeran iti ca śrūyaiva (padāntaramapekṣya) bahutvaṃ gamyate |
ye ca pūrvasmin prayoge kartāraḥ, ta evottarasmin (ityapi tata eva gamyate) |
pūrvasmiṃśca tyāge (satrāgaprayoge udava- sānākhye) itaretaranirapekṣāḥ (te) tādṛśā eva uttara- smin (prayoge |
ki tarhi vidhīyate ityata āha—) kriyāviśeṣaḥ |
soma- ṛtvignādhavatat ekakartṛkatvasyāpi atrādha- ityarthite: saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu- teṣāṃ satriṇāṃ saha- prayoga: syāt, yajeran iti bahutvavacanāt |
yathā 'rājapurohito yajetātām' iti dvitvavacanāt dviyye sahaprayoga: , tadvat iti |
4. bhāṭṭa-- anaṅgattve'pi sahetyaiva karaṇam, ākhyāto- pāttasya bahutvasya upādeyakartṛgāmittvena satravākye iva vivakṣitatvāt |
kathañcit prātatve'pi saṃhatya prayoga- siddhayarthaṃ 'sṛṣṭīrupadadhāti', 'somena yajeta' ityādi- vat viśiṣṭavidhyaṅgīkāreṇa prayojanasiddhayarthaṃ vidhyupa- patteśca |
...sthityāduttaram ) na pṛṣṭhaśamanīye saṃhatya prayoga: , bahutvasya prāteratvena avi- dheyatvāt |
udvasāne hi anekeṣāṃ satrakartṛṇāṃ kartṛtvaṃ prāptameva |
katvāpratyayasya hi pūrvakālatvavat samānakartṛkatvamapi anuśāsanabalāt vācyam |

na ca avyayakṛtvena asya (katva: ) bhāva- śakttvāt katvāpratyayabhūtakriyāyā: uttarakriyāyāmanvaye pūrvakālatvavat samānakartṛkatvayo: saṃsargalatvena bodhopapatte: na tayo: tathāriktā śakti: iti vācyam |
kiñca katvāpratyayabhūtadhārthasyaiva uttarakriyāsaṃbandha: katvā ca saṃsargatātparyagrāhaka: ityucyate, athavā katvā'rtha- bhāva eva niṣkaubhyasaṃsargeṇa uttarakriyāyāmanveti, iti vivektavyam |

tatra na tāvat ādya: , katvājñānatvenaiva tātparyagrāhakatve ayyītasaṃketasyāpi tātparyagrahāpatte: , tātparyagrāhakatvaprakārakajñānatvena tatte ātmaśrayāpatte: , ekatvādisādhakadvitīyā''de: karmatvādidisaṃsargatātparyagrāhaka- tvenaiva upapattau prātipadikārthasya karmatvādidisaṃsargeṇa kriyāyāmanvayāpatte: : karmatvādau dvitīyā''de: śakyanā- pattiśca |
ata eva nānya: , saṃkhyāyā eva sasamānādhi- karaṇakarmatvādidisaṃsargeṇa kriyā'nvayāpatte: |
astu vā tat, tathāpi na doṣa: |
ekena padena anekeṣāmupādāne pratīyamānakartṛsāhityamapi na tāvat uddeśyatvena vivakṣitam, nimittaviśeṣaṇatvāt, satre saṃhatya kartṛtve'pi tatyāge sāhityaṃ vinaiva kartṛtvācca |

yo hi saṃyogadirūpo nyāyasajyavṛttidharma:, tadabhāva- pratyekavaccitveva, kimuta yadā satre bahutvacanārudhatāt pratyeka- meva kartṛtvam, kartṛṇāṃ paraṃ samuccaya:, tadā tatyāge sāhityābhāve ka: saṃdeha: ? ākhyātopāttasaṃbahutvāvagata- sāhityaṃ tu bahutvasyāvivakṣitatve avivakṣitameva |

ṣaṣṭhasya tu trayastriṃśe dve savane ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanam |
ke. pauṇḍarīke aśvasahasraṃ iti tu pratyakṣopadeśāt sāmānyaprāptiniṣedhāt na doṣo vijñāyate (tena tatra na vāruṇeṣṭiḥ dātṛḥ ) |
pauṇḍarīke aśvasahasraṃ satyā-pādametena ekādaśahani, bhāṭṭoktamānavasūtrānusāreṇa vā daśame'hani agniṣṭome, avaśiṣṭeṣu ahaḥsu ca gavāṃ daśa sahasrāṇi iti vibhajya dakṣiṇā dātavyā |
tathā ca satyāṣāḍhaḥ 'annahaṃ daśa sahasrāṇi dadyāt |
mānavaṃ ca 'annahaṃ vihṛtāni sahasrāṇi dadāti, caturthame'gniṣṭomam' iti |
mānave sūtrāntare ca caturthame'gniṣṭomaḥ pāṭhakrameṇa daśama uktaḥ |
ke. pauṇḍarīke gavāyatasya aśvasahasrasya ca dakṣiṇāyāḥ pratyahaṃ vibhajya veyormadhye uttarasyāṃ diśi nayanam |
asti tu prakṛtau 'mādhyaṃdine savane dakṣiṇā nīyante' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ sarvāsāṃ kāryasya pratyahaṃ nayanam, uta sakṛnnayanam, athavā pravibhajya nayanamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? pratyahaṃ sarvāsāṃ saṃskāraḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? prakṛtau hi sakalā dakṣiṇāstasmin kāle saṃskṛtāḥ |
śeṣabhūtasya yaḥ saṃskāraḥ, sa tenenāhā prayujyate iti |
bhāṣyam-- na caitadasti, pratyahaṃ sarvasaṃskāra iti |
ekasminnapi cāhani tatsaṃskārasaṃskṛtāḥ dīyamānāsu kṛtaśraddhanārtha iti bhūyaḥ saṃskāreṇa prayojanaṃ nāsti |
utpattau dakṣiṇānāṃ viśiṣṭakālasaṃbandhaḥ śrūyate 'tasmāttisṛbhirloke mādhyaṃdine savane dakṣiṇā nīyante' iti |
tatra ca agamyamānaviśeṣatvādyasya mādhyaṃdine savane na saṃskaryeran, tasyaiva saṃskāralepaḥ syāt, prayogabhedāt |
na cānyatra saṃskriyamāṇā anyatra saṃskṛtā bhavanti |
bhāṣyam-- na caitadasti, samastānāṃ pratyahaṃ saṃskāra iti |
dvādaśāhe pratyahaṃ nayanādisaṃskāro vacanāt 'pratyahaṃ 'annahaṃ daśasahasraṃ dadāti' iti |
tasmāt pari-krayaikatve'pi sati vacanāt bhedena saṃskāra iti |
śā-- prakṛtau mādhyaṃdine savane dakṣiṇā nayanaṃ śrutam |

pauṇḍarīke ca ayutaṃ gavāṃ aśvasahasraṃ ca mādhyaṃdine savane pratyahaṃ netavyam, uta ekasminnahani, athavā vibhajya pratyahaṃ gavāṃ sahasraṃ netavyaṃ aśvasahasraṃ tu ekādaśe ahani niyamiti saṃśayaḥ |
soma-- pūrvavat pratyahaṃ kṛtsnanayanaṃ na bādhanīya-mityupatānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- pratyahaṃ sarvāsāṃ nayanaṃ syāt, sarveṣaḥsa kṛtsnadakṣiṇāyāḥ śeṣatvāt, mūlaprakṛtau jyotiṣṭome mādhyaṃdine dakṣiṇāyāḥ nayanasya dṛṣṭatvāt iti |
vi-- 'sakṛt kiṃ pratyahaṃ vā'sya nayanaṃ tatra cottame |
dakṣaṇādravyasya kiṃ sakṛt nayanaṃ pratyahaṃ vā nayanaṃ ityekaḥ saṃśayaḥ |
tatra ca uttame dvitīye pakṣe pratyahaṃ sarvasya nayanaṃ vibhaktasya vā nayanaṃ iti dvitīyaḥ saṃśayaḥ |
saṃskāra- siddhitaḥ sakṛt nayanaṃ ityekaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
codakamāpteḥ pratyahaṃ nayanam, tadā'pi pratimādhyādine tadekatvāt sarvaṃ neyaṃ iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
dvādaśāhavat pratyahaṃ vibhajya nayanaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
[ bhāṭṭe idamadhikaraṇaṃ satadaśo evāntārbhāvita iti 'pauṇḍarīke gavāyutasya aśvasahasrasya ca sakṛt dānam ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
' 19. oṃ pauṇḍarīke gavāyutasya aśvasahasrasya ca sakṛt dānam ||
ahīne dakṣiṇāśākhaṃ guṇatvātpratyahaṃ karma, bhedaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- asti pauṇḍarīka ekādaśarātraḥ 'pauṇḍa- rīkeṇaikādaśarātreṇa svārājakāmo yajeta' iti |
tatra saṃdihyate kiṃ pratyahamayutasahasraṃ ca dātavyam, utaika- mevāyutaṃ aśvasahasraṃ ca sakṛditi |
kiṃ prāptam ? ahīne dakṣiṇāśākhaṃ pratyahaṃ miyeta |
samudāyaśabdena samudāyiṣya- hāni upalakṣya dakṣiṇā guṇo vidhīyamānaḥ pratipradhānaṃ bhidyeta |
yathā gaṇāyāṃ snānaṃ upalepanaṃ vā vidhīyamānaṃ gaṇināṃ bhavati |
bhāṣyam-- na caitadasti, pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇābheda iti |
anātiśca sāṅga- ṛtunirvṛttaye kṛteti, antarā na tathā prayojanamastīti na bhūyaḥ kriyate |
yattu aṅgabhūyastvena phalabhūyastvamiti, tat aṅgatve praśate bhavati, nānyathā |
atha yaduktaṃ pratikarmāvasāyī codakaḥ pratikarma prāpayatīti, pratyakṣavacanāt samudāyāṅgī- karaṇena ca dakṣiṇānāṃ vidhānamiti codako bādhita iti na doṣaḥ |
kutaḥ ? pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ prāsānāmanyaṃ viśeṣa ucyamānaḥ pratyahameva bhavitumarhatīti |
pṛṣadājya- vat yathā 'pṛṣadājyenānuyājān yajati' iti pṛṣattā guṇo vidhīyamānaḥ pratyanuyājaṃ bhidyate, evamatrāpi draṣṭavyamiti |
jyotiṣṭomesya dakṣiṇāḥ, sarvāsāṃmekakarmatvāt, prakṛtitvat, tasmāt tāsāṃ vikāraḥ syāt |
katham ? jyotiṣṭome hi dakṣiṇāḥ sāṅgaṃ karmarāśamaṅgīkṛtya dīyante |
tathābhūtānāṃ tāsāṃ samudāyānantaryānāṃ prāsānāmanyaṃ viśeṣa ucyate |
sahasra- mayutamiti viśeṣa ucyamāno yā iha dakṣiṇā dīyante tāsāmayaṃ vikāra iti gamyati, ekatvamāntaraṃ vārayati |
yattu anuyājadaviti, yuktam, yadanuyājeṣu dravyasya meda iti |
tadāgānāṃ medādasya kriyamāṇaṃ nānyasyopa- karotīti micyate |
dvādaśāhahe tu vacanāt pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇābheda- stataprakṛtitvāt, paredhu tāsāṃ saṃkhyāvikāraḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? dvādaśāhe hi pratyahaṃ vacanam, 'anvahaṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dadāti' iti |
tasmāt pauṇḍarīke pratyahaṃ codakaprāptyā prasaktānāṃ dakṣiṇānāmanyaṃ viśeṣa ucyamāna- stathaiva karmāvayavasaṃjñakānāṃ vikāra iti gamyate |
kutaḥ ? parikriyā- vibhāgāt samastā dakṣiṇā vikriyeran |
kṛtsnaṃ hi ṛtu- maṅgīkṛtya dakṣiṇā vidhīyante |
tacca kurvāṇasya sahāyyānupādānasyāyaṃ viśeṣa ucyate pari- krayaḥ |
api ca, pauṇḍarīkaśabdayogena parikriyāviśeṣa ucyamānastacchabda- vācyasyaiva bhavatīti gamyate |
bhāṣyam-- yaduktaṃ dvādaśāhaprakṛtitvātpauṇḍarīkasya, tatra ca dvādaśāhe dakṣiṇābhedāt tathābhūtāyā eveha viśeṣa ucyate iti, tat parihartavyam |
medastu vacanāt sutyāsaṃbandhaprayojano dakṣiṇāsaṃskāraprayojanaśca, na tasmin kriyamāṇe parikrayaikatvaṃ bhidyate iti |
śā-- tatra ( pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ ) 'dakṣiṇā hyaharaha- tvāt pratyahaṃ medameti |
' soma-- satrāt bhinne ahīne arthāt anyakartṛke siddhe tatra dakṣiṇāyāḥ pratipradhānaṃ medenānuṣṭhānacinta- nāt |
sūtrārthastu-- ahīne pauṇḍarīkādau pratyahaṃ pradhānamedāt dakṣiṇāyā api medaḥ syāt, tasyāḥ guṇatvāditi |
ādyo bhavet, prayogo'ṅgī tadekyena sakṛd bhavet ||
bhāṭṭa-- ( bhāṣye 17-18 adhikaraṇe ekīkṛtya vyākhyā draṣṭavyā ) |

tatra kiṃ pratyahamaśvasahasraṃ gavāṃ cāyutaṃ deyam, utaikameva vibhajya deyaṃ iti cintāyām, satyapi jyotiṣṭome dakṣiṇāyāḥ ahīnātmake dvādaśāhe tathaiva prātāvāpi ca tatra 'anvahaṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dadāti' ityanena tattadaharahastvena dvādaśaśatavidhānācca dakṣiṇāyāḥ kṛtsnaprayogadāttattvam, ataśca tattalakṣaṇānnabhavet iyaṃ dakṣiṇā aheṣu prasaṅgādupakarotīti na tato'nyā dīyate |
ataśca pauṇḍarīke'pi pratisutyamatideśena medenaiva dakṣiṇāprāptau aśvasahasramutaṃ ca vidhīyamānaṃ medenaiva dvādaśaśatavat prāpnoti |

vastutastu jyotiṣṭome'pi prayogāṅkarnatvarthatayā sāṅgapradhānārthatvena prātāyā api dakṣiṇāyāḥ 'dakṣiṇā somasya' iti vacanena pradhāna- mātrārthatvāvasāyāt dvādaśāheḍapi pratikarmāvasāyābhi- środakabhedena gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatayā savanīyādivatpradhāna- mātrārthe dakṣiṇāprāpteḥ : 'anvahaṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dadāti' ityayaṃ vidhirna pradhānārthatvabodhakaḥ ; kintu dvādaśaśātātiriktā- śrādiparisaṃkhyārtha eva |
ataśca pūrvavadeva prakṛtito'pi prati- sutyaṃ medenaiva dakṣiṇāprāpteḥ : tatrāśvasahasraṃ vidhīyamānaṃ medenaiva prāpnoti |
iti prāpte, jyotiṣṭome pradhāna- mātrārthayā api dakṣiṇāyāḥ pradhānaprayogaikatrānatidreva pradhānārthatvam, na tu sākṣāt |
ata eva nāṅgeṣu pṛthak tasyāḥ karaṇam |
evaṃ satyāpi pradhānamātrārthatve : prayo- janaṃ aṅgavikāreṣvanatideśaḥ |
ataśca dvādaśāhe'pi prati- karmāvasāyābhiḥ codakastvadaharmātratvena prāpyamāṇamapi dvādaśaśataṃ tattadahaḥprayogaikatraitadeva prāpyate |
ataśca vinigamanāvirāhadekameva dvādaśaśatamādavante vā dīyamānaṃ sarvapradhānānāṃ saṃpadyate |
śatam' ityanena prāsāyā dakṣiṇāyāḥ punastadaṅgatvena vidhī vaiyarthyāpatteḥ, sakṛtkriyāmātratvena prasaktāyāḥ 'anvaham' ityanena āvṛtticinteḥ |
itarathā aśvā- diparisaṃkhyārthatve anvahaṃ ityasya ānarthakyāpatteḥ |
sā cāvṛttiḥ na dvādaśaśatasya, tatsattulāmātraupakāraka- tayā ekasminnahani dīyamānasya tasya prayogenyena sulāntaropakārakatvāvaśyambhāvāt |
apitu tattatprayo- gītaratranirūpaṇaprāptatvāyā dvādaśaśata rūpasādhanasyaiva tatpṛṣṭhabhāvena prāptasya bādhamadhikṛtya sutyāsamastasya- dvādaśaśatasamudāyasyaiva dakṣiṇātvakalpanāyā |
sā'pi ca dakṣiṇā sarveṣāmevāhā tattatprayogīyakartanasiddhā aṅgaṃ sat tantreṇa sarveṣāmupakārikā |
pratyahaṃ tu tadavayavarūpaṃ dvādaśa- śataṃ vibhajya vacanādīyata iti vibhāgā'pi tadaṅgaṃ prakṛtau |
tadiha pauṇḍarīke'pi tatsthāne vihitamayuta- sahasrasahasramāpi tattadayogīyakartanasiddhā tantre- ṇaivābhyam |
atideśaprāptavayavibhāgavaśa eva avayavaśo vibhajya pratyahaṃ deyam |

ata eva 'saṃpūrṇamayutamasahasraṃ ca pratyahaṃ mārthadinasadhane netavyam, athavā ekasmin kasmiṃścihani' iti pūrvapakṣadvayaṃ mūloktaṃ (18169 sūtra- bhāṣye) upekṣitam, atideśaprāptavibhāgabhāve pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
sa ca vibhāgaḥ na (tantratve) pāryasārthatayā 'pratyahaṃ gavāṃ sahasraṃ aśva- sahasraṃ tvekādaśahāni' ityevarūpaḥ |
mānavasūtre 'anvahaṃ vihatāni sahasrāṇi dadāti catuṣṭome'śvasahasram' iti aśvasahasrasya daśame'hani vidhānāt |
evaṃ hi pauṇḍarīke ahaḥklaptiḥ tenoktā, 'ekādaśarātreṇa pauṇḍarīkeṇa yajeta pāramedhyakāmo'bhyāsayajñaḥ' padahaḥ tryacchandomā- anuṣṭumo'gniṣṭomo viśvajittirātraḥ' iti |
ato daśame- 'hani aśvasahasraṃ dattvā avaśiṣṭeṣu gavāṃ sahasrāṇīti vibhāgaḥ |
kintu taduccāraṇecchānyavākyatvaṃ tadartha- dhījanyavākyatvaṃ sajātīyoccāraṇānapekṣajātīyatvaṃ vā |
su. pṛ. 532. pauruṣeyatvaṃ vākyasya nāma pramāṇānta- rāpekṣasvārthapratītāthyaparatayā prayogaḥ, na varṇādi- kāryatā |
ṛju. pṛ. 34. pauruṣeyavacāsāṃ pramāṇāntarapratītāthyaparatvena pramāṇāntaratvāt vākyabhedadayo doṣā eva na bhavanti |
anāsavākye tu mūlabhūtavaktṛjñāne samyak- jñānatvaṃ durghaṭa bhavati tatra aprāmāṇyameva ityaparaḥ svabhāvaḥ |
vā. 3|1|7|4 pṛ. 855. paurauḍā- śikamiti samākhyāte kāṇḍe sānāyyakrame 'śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe' iti śundhanāyau mantraḥ samāmnātaḥ |
sa kramasya baliyastvāt sānāyyapātrāṇāṃ śundhane vini- yoktavyaḥ, na tu samākhyānena puroḍāśapātrāṇāṃ śundhane |

bhā. 3|1|7|4 pṛ. 855. paurauḍāśikamiti samākhyāte darśapūrṇamāsakāṇḍe paṭhita mantraḥ sādhāraṇa prakaraṇe vartamānaḥ krameṇa ca anumantīlaliṅgena avini- yujyamānaḥ puroḍāśasyaiva vā prāpyayāt prāpnuyan śrutyā sānāyyārthasālā'ṅgatvena vidhīyate 'iṣe tveti śālāṃ chinatti' iti |
vā. 3|1|7|4 pṛ. 836. paurauḍāśikānāṃ prokṣaṇādīnāṃ saumikapadārthapūrvabhāvitvaṃ jyotiṣṭome sutyā- yām |
tata etat parīkṣyam, kiṃ prasaṅgena codako bādhyate, uta prayoga- vacana iti |
yadi codako bādhyate, tato na kartavyau |
kiṃ punaratra yuktam ? codako bādhyata iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? ānu- mānikaścodakaḥ, pratyakṣaḥ prayogavacanaḥ; pratyakṣaṃ cānu- mānādbalīyaḥ |
durbalasya ca bādho nyāyyo na ca balī- yasaḥ |
codakena hi tau prāpye- yātām, sa ceha bādhitatvātsyāstīti |
yasya svasya tantrasya kāryaṃ paratantrāpatte, tasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt |
yasya tu na kiñcitsvakīyaṃ kāryamāpadyate, tatyatiṣedho na yuktaḥ |
yathā devadatte yasyadacanamāsādya devadattayānaṃ nivartate, na vastrālkāraḥ |
na ceha ājyabhāgayoḥ kāryaṃ kiñcit pāśukamaṅgamāpadyate |
( bhāṣyakārīyamudāharaṇaṃ pradarśanārthamiti darśayangrāha— ) asyaiva ( paśupuroḍāśasya yat paśau avidyamānam ) ājyabhāganivāpaprokṣaṇādi ( tat ) kartavyaṃ na

tata: ( tasidvyartham ) idamāha ( bhāṣyam ) kiṃ prayogavacanena codako bādhyate, uta prayogavacanacchedenate ( neme kartarī tṛtīye, kintu saha- prayoge, kiṃ prayogavacanena sahita eva puroḍāśāyāga:, na tu sa luppate codakastu luppate, athavā viparyaya iti ) |
tatra ānumānikatvāt codako bādhyate, na tu prayogavacana:, tasya pratyakṣatvāt |
siddhāntastu ( pāśukena prayogavacanena pauro- ḍāśikasa ) prayogavacanasya ekadeśo bādhyate ( na samastasya bādha: ) |
tatra ) upaśabda: samīpa- vacana:, sam-śabda: sākalyavacana:, grahaṇaśabdo gṛhṇāti- vacana: ( anuṣṭhānavacana: ) |
itare tu ( dvivacanamidam ) asya samīpasakalye ( mudrite rale ca pāṭha: , samīpakaraṇasākalyakaraṇe iti likhita- ḍupa-pāṭha: ) |
( tatra bādhyamaṃśaṃ darśayati - ) viśeṣaṇaṃ ca anyathā''nupapattyā gṛhyate |
itarā ( ahaṃ ( prayogavacana: ) sākalyasāmīpyaviśiṣṭe na mavāmi ' iti ( ityevamāt ) sāmīpyaṃ sākalyaṃ ca karoti ( na śrutvā ) |
iha ca pāśukena prayogavacanena keṣāṃ cit ( prayājādīnām ) ajñānāṃ sāmīpyaṃ kṛtam |
yeṣāṃ tu ājya- bhāganirvāpavahananādīnāṃ na kṛtaṃ ( paśūnā sāmī- pyam , ) teṣāmanyathā''nupapattyā sāmīpyaṃ karotyeva |
tasmāt ( prayājādiviṣaya: ) sāmīpyakaraṇaikadeśo bādhyate prasaṅgena tasya ( prayogavacanasya ) |
atha yaduktam , ānumānikatvāt codakasya ( durbalasya ) bādha: iti, tanna |
kuta: ? ) yadi codaka: utpattīprātī na karoti, ( tata: ) kasya sāmīpyakaraṇam , kasya vā sākalyenopasaṃgraha: |
tathāhi , ) yadi codaka: ādhārādīni patnīsaṃyāntāni ( ajñānā ) paśupuroḍāśasya kalpayati saṃbandhitvena ( ādhārādibhya- nupakārānityartha: ) tat uttarakālaṃ prayogavacana: samīpe karoti |
tacca samīpakaraṇaṃ pāśukena ( prayogavacanena ) kṛtam, iti ( kṛtvā na svayaṃ karoti iti - ) prasaṅghasya ātmalābha: ( bhavet nānyathā |

kathamityata āha - ) yadi ca tasya ( puroḍāśasya ) ajñānāmutpattiprātī na sta:, tathā sati anutpannānāṃ ( ajñānābhāvāt pāśukena codakena puroḍāśāttvātsiddhe: ) prayogavacanasya samīpakaraṇaśakti- reva nāsti |
samīpakaraṇābhāvāt ( ca ) anyena kṛtaṃ sāmīpyamiti naivopapadyate anākāṅkṣitatvāt |
tena prayogavacanaika- deśo ya: prayājādiviṣaya: , sa bādhyate, ajñānnereṣu so'pi na bādhyate |

prābhā- karāstu ājyabhāgādāviha prayājādiṣvapi pauroḍāśika- prayogavacanasya vyāpāramaṅgīkṛtya tadeśo'pi prayojakatvāt bādha:, prayojakaikasvabhāvatvāt vidhe: parakīyatantramadhye vidhānamātreṇa tasya tatsvabhāvānapāyāt svayaṃyojako'pi vidhi: tantramadhye vidhānata: paraprayuktimupajīvati iti na pṛthaganuṣṭhānam |
na tu etāvatā vidhe: prayojakatvābhāva:, tathā sati prasaṅghina: puroḍāśādividhe: aprayojakasya vājinādividhe: viśeṣeṇa na syāt ityāha |
sūtrā- rthastu - jaiminerācāryasya mate kartavyamājyabhāgādi yata: yasya svatantra sthāne paratantramāpadyate, tasya pratiṣedha: |
ājyabhāgādestu sthāne na kiñcit pāśukramāpatati iti |
vi - ' ājyabhāgau puroḍāśe na sta: vā, 'sya codaka: |
tatastato na tau, mevaṃ prayogaśāstrasya lopanāt |

bhāṭṭa - yāni tvaṅgāni ājyabhāgāvāghātādīni paśau na vidyante, tāni kiṃ puroḍāśe kartavyāni na veti cintāyām, puroḍāśabhāvanāyā: itikartavyatāpekṣāyāṃ saṃnihitapāśukodakaprāptitajjanyaupakārāmeva upasthita- tvena svāpūrvajananānukūlayogyatājanakatvamātrakalpanāyā iti- kartavyatākāṅkṣāśānte: na puroḍāśavidhinā svatantrāti- deśakalpanena gauravāt |

ataśca yathaiva gṛhamedhīye klṛpto- pakāraājyabhāgābhāveva nirākāṅkṣatvāt atideśakalpanam, tathā prakṛte'pi klṛptaireva upakārāt nirākāṅkṣatvāt atideśakalpanānupapatte:, nājyabhāgādīnāmaṅgatve pramāṇa- masti |
ata eva prayojyabhāgāt puroḍāśaprayoga- tridherapi pradhānamātre eva vyāpāra:, na tu ajñānāṃ, tajjanyaupakārārtha vā, ityapi lāghavam |
na ca evamapi ekādaśakapālasaṃpādakasaṃnipatyopakārakāpekṣayaiva ati- deśakalpanam, tathātve gṛhamedhīye'pi tadāpatte: |
vastutastu anauvāsā'dhikaraṇanyāyena ( 7|1|129 ) lokasiddhaikādaśakapālasya grahaṇāt na prayogamadhye tat- raṇāvaśyakatā |
gṛhamedhīyarostu vācanikānāmeva kati- payānāṃ saṃnipatyopakārāṇāṃ pāṭhāt prayogamadhye karaṇaṃ iti viśeṣa: |

iti prāpte, pāśukāṅgopakārāṇāṃ puroḍāśāpūrva- jananānukūlayogyatāṃ prati tattadajyātīyāpatvenaiva vastuto janakatve'pi tatkāryakāraṇabhāvabodhakapada ( kalpanāma ) na tāvat puroḍāśāgapradhānabhūtaparvaṇisaṃbandhvaṅgasyopa- kārai: yogyatāṃ bhāvayet ityevihā kalpanā, tathātve apūrvāṇāmapi upajādājanyapātrāṇāṃ etadyogyatājanaka- tvāpatte: |
jyautiṣṭomikāṅgajanyā- pūrvāṇāmapi savanīyopakārajanakatvā tatrāpi daikṣāti- deśanāpatte: |
parapūrvaparvasaṃbandhvaṅgasyopakāratvasya puro- ḍāśajanyapūrve bādhitatayā yūpadijanyopakāre ca ati- prasaktatvena tādṛśapadasya kalpayitumaśakyatvācca |
niruktayogyatāṃ bhāvayet ityeva kalpanā vācya, tada varaṃ svasāhacaryopasthitāmī- pomīyapuroḍāśasaṃbandhapañcajanyaupakārai: niruktayogyatāṃ
tena ca sarvopakāreṇa prāpteṣu tatsaṃba- bhāvena padārthatideśavelāyāṃ ya evopakāro nānyato labhyate tadeśe padārthatideśasya tatprayogavidhiśeṣa āvaśyakatvāt yuktameva ājyabhāgādīnām |
ye tūkārā anyato labdhā: , tadviṣaye atideśaprayojanābhāvāt nātideśa: |

yadyapi ca nopakārasya prayagātideśo gauravāt , atideśalakṣaṇasya anyāteśca, tathāpi ekenaivātideśena prākṛtopakāradvārā padārthānāṃ vikalpatvena bodhyatā upakārasyāpi vikṛtisaṃbandhavādhamāt sidhyati tasyāpi atideśaviṣayatvam |
evaṃ ca prasaṅgha- sthale atideśena prākṛtopakāradvārā anyata upakāralābhe eva padārthavidhānāt tadabhāve upakārasaṃbandhasiddhāvapi padārthavidhāyābhāvāt nātideśa: |
ata eva sarvatra prakṛtau vikṛtau vā aṅgavidhiṣu evaṃ vākyārtha: - 'anyata upakārā- lābhe anenāṅgena yogyatāṃ saṃpādayat ' iti |
ata eva prakṛte'pi daivāt vitatavikṛtiprayogamadhye'nuṣṭhāne prasaṅghena upakāralābhāt na prayājādyanuṣṭhānam |
paśupuroḍāśe'pi ca daikṣe nityatayā yathāśakti ekādaśaprayājānuṣṭhānenāpi kriyamāṇe, puroḍāśārthameva pañcaprayājānuṣṭhānam , tadā ca padorapi prasaṅghitvam , anyata upakāralambhā- viśiṣṭatvāt |
ato yatra anyata upakāralābha: , tajjanakapadārtho na vā atideśa:, na vā prayogavidhi: , itarāṃśe tu ubhayaṃ iti siddham |
na caivaṃ aprayojye'pi prayogavidhitvābhāvāt prasaṅghe tato viśeṣaṇāpatti: , anyata upakāralābhe prasaṅghasthale prayogavidhisattvena tato bhedāt |
vastutastu caturtho'pyaprayojyalābhe eva aprayojyatvam , tadvidhameva ucitavidhaprasaṅghatvaṃ iti nāmadeśakā |
aprayo- jyatvasyāpyameva tu prasaṅghatvaṃ iti dhyeyam |

yattu codaka- prayogavidhayo: ubhayo: sattve'pi prayojanābhāvāt ananu- ṣṭhānamiti prābhākaramatam , tatra vidhinā vihitasya guṇaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasya prayājāde: ananuṣṭhāne vihitaguṇā- bhāvena prayojanalāmānupapatte: upekṣitam |
yattu asminnadhikaraṇe mūle prayogavidhividhīkṛtya codakalopena pūrvapakṣakaraṇam , codakāṅgīkāreṇa prayogavidhitrāmātratvena ca siddhāntakaraṇam , tattu niryuktikatvāt prayojanābhāvācca upekṣitam |
3. prakṛtau asat na prayujyate, sat tu prayujyate eva |
yadā tu nimittaniścaya: caturthakaraṇakāle tadā devatā''vāhane pauroḍāśikayāgabhāganyāyena (12|1|27) kartavyamityuktaṃ tantraratne |
pauroḍāśikakarmārthe haviṣkṛdāhāne vāgvisarga: kartavya: amīṣomīye paśau |
pauroḍāśikaśabda: mantrābrāhmaṇayo: apaṭhitatvāt avaidika: na aṅgāṅgibhāva: |
sa ca śabdasya avaidikatve'pi anādisaṃjñatvāt vidyamānasmṛti mūlatvācca pramāṇam |
pauroḍāśikasamākhyātātbrāhmaṇānātāṃ prayājādīnāṃ samākhyāyā puroḍāśamātrārthatve prāpte prakaraṇāt sāmānyātpāṃśuyājārthatvamapi siddham |
paurṇamāsahavi:śabdena amīṣomīyapuroḍāśasya grahaṇaṃ tasyaiva brāhmaṇasya somādutkarṣa: |
upāṃśuyājasyāpi amīṣomīyaṃ brāhmaṇena somāt prāṅ kartavyam |
parantu prājāpatyaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ vā kartavyameveti na tasyotkarṣa: |
amāvāsyā āgneya:, aindraṃ dadhi, aindraṃ paya: iti trayāṇāṃ yāgānāṃ samudāya: |
ci. 2|2|3, paurṇamāsī na darśavikāra:, na vā darśa: paurṇamāsī-vikāra: |
bhā. 10|8|18|62. paurṇamāsī somāt prāk agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśarahitā kevalamaiyapuroḍāśayuktā bhavati |
tatra ca upāṃśuyājo'pi vaiṣṇava: prājāpatyo vā kartavya: |
( 'agnīṣomīyena yajeta paurṇamāsīm' 'amāvāsyāmāmicaran' iti prākaraṇikaṃ vākyadvayam ) prathamavākye tu prakṛta eva amīṣomīye yāga: |
aveṣṭivat pṛthakphalasya vidhīyate, dvitīyavidhiśrutau atīva lāghavāt |
iti prāpte, samudāyavācipaurṇamāsīpadavaiyarthyāpatte: uktarītyā caturtha eva vidhiprakāro yukta: |
'paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'amāvāsyāṃ yajate' ityetau śabdau prakṛtānāṃ karmaṇāmanuvāditārau |
bhā. 4|2|4|10-13. paurṇamāsyāmagnisahitasya (somasya) coditatvāt kevalasya (somasya) prakāśanaṃ mahendrādhikaraṇe nirākṛtam |
'purastāt paurṇamāsyāścaturgrahe dīkṣeran' iti gavāmayana sane śrutā yā paurṇamāsī sā kasya māsasya ityatra aniyama: |
aviśeṣāt viśeṣasya anuktatvāt iti eka: pūrvapakṣa: |
na aniyama: kintu caitrī paurṇamāsī syāt citrānakṣatrayuktā caitramāsa-gatā |
uktavākyadanantaraṃ 'ṛtumukhaṃ caivā paurṇamāsī saṃvatsarasya, yā caitrī paurṇamāsī' iti śrūyate |
saṃdigdhepu vākyaśeṣāt iti nyāyena sā paurṇamāsī caitrīti niścīyate iti dvitīya: pūrvapakṣa: |
māghyā: paurṇamāsyā: purastāt caturahe dīkṣitasya ekādaśyāṃ māghakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ kraya: śakyate kartum |
yasmin kāle bhavanti satriṇaḥ sa ārtaḥ kālaḥ |
tathā ‘vyastaṃ vā ete saṃvatsarasyābhidadhante, ya ekādaśyāṃ dīkṣante’ iti |
māghānte śaile sati avabhṛthamagamane apāmabhinandanaṃ na syāt |
etebhyo liṅgebhyo jñāyate māghyāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ purastāccaturdaśe gavāyamanasya dīkṣā, na caitryāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ purastāt iti |
ke. paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ vā aindrāgnādayo vikṛtayaḥ kartavyāḥ, ‘ya iṣṭyā paśunā saumena vā yakṣyamāṇaḥ sa paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ vā yajeta’ iti vacanāt |
tatra ca prajāpatiḥ viṣṇuḥ abhīṣomo ca vikalpena devatā |
paurṇamāsyāṃ caturdaśa ahutayo hūyante, trayodaśā amāvāsyāyām |
( pañca prayājāḥ dvau ājyabhāgau āgneyāgnīṣomīyau puroḍāśau upāṃśuyājaḥ sviṣṭakṛt trayodaśayājā iti caturdaśa |
amāvāsyāyāmupāṃśuyājā- bhāvāt āgneyaḥ aindraṃ sāṃnāyyaṃ iti trayodaśa ) |
paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta’ iti kālasya niyamavidhiḥ, nānuvādaḥ |
paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta’ iti kālavidhāne anekeṣāṃ pradhānānāṃ sāṅgatyāva- gamāt tannirvahāya padārthaniyamaḥ |
paurṇamāsyā yajeta’ ityādinā darśapūrṇamāsakarmaṇā saha kālasya saṃbandho
vi. 2|3|123, paurṇamāsyāṃ vatsāpākaraṇāyāḥ śākhāyā abhāvānna śākhā- cchedo na kartavyaḥ |
añjareṣu kapālopadhānārthaṃ kasya cit kāṣṭhasyopādānaṃ kāryam |
paurṇamāsyāṃ sūkta- vākyasya prayoge paurṇamāsīdevatāyā niṣkarpa amāvāsyā- devatānāmanvayaḥ |
paurṇamāsyāṃ somārtā prāk ekapuroḍāśāyāṃ syātāmapi upāṃśuyājaḥ syādeva |
bāla. pṛ. 19. paurṇamāsyātipāte prāyaścitaṃ kṛtvā yatra kevalaṃ darśo'nuṣṭhīyate, tatra darśajñatayā vaimṛdho na kāryaḥ |
paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇaṃ vinā ijyādhikaraṇasya ( 4|4|11 ) pūrvapakṣa eva syāt iti ijyādhikaraṇasya paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇaprayojanatvena ārambhaḥ |

su. pṛ. 732. vārttikadhikaraṇasya paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇenopasaktyam, vidvadvākye karmāntaratvāvedakapramāṇābhāvāt tatra mantra- viniyojakatvānupattāvapi āgneyādiṣu tadupapatteḥ nānayoḥ ( vārttikī paurṇamāsyāmanuṣyate, dhṛvantī amāvāsyāyāṃ ) vyavasthā'rthatvaṃ ityadhikāśaṅkyotthānāt |
paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇasya ca upāṃśuyāja- ( 2|2|4 ) ādhārāgnihotra- ( 2|2|5 ), paśusomādhikaraṇāni ( 2|2|6 ) apavādaḥ |
su. pṛ. 827. paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe ( 2|2|3 ) anekaguṇavidhāne vākya- bhedāpatteḥ samudāyānuvādatvasiddhirāśrīyate |
paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe eva prāpte karmaṇi anekaguṇavidhānāsaṃbhavena guṇanimittakabhedo vyutpāditaḥ |
paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe ‘guṇastu śrutisaṃyo- gāt’ codanā vā guṇānāṃ yugapacchāstrāt’ iti sūtrābhyāṃ pramāṇāntaramākarmaṇi anekaguṇavidhānaṃ prasaṅganirākaraṇam |
āgneyavākye āgneyadravyaṃ paurṇamāsya- māvākyātmakamirtyuktaṃ kaustubhe paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe |
āgneyavākye tāvat prāptakarmā- nuvādena dravyadevatārūpānaikaguṇavidhānāt vākyabhedāpatteḥ paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe prasaṅgāduktena vākyabhedāpādakena guṇenaiva karmavihitatvamivādyam |
kau. 2|2|122 pṛ. 266. darśapūrṇamāsanāmannaḥ prasiddhārthakatvaṃ upāditaṃ paurṇa- māsyādhikaraṇe |
na kevalaṃ avādha- pakṣapātitvena vākyena tayoḥ ( liṅkakramayoḥ ) abhāvaḥ; apitu niyamavidhilāghavādharopeṇāpi ityuktaṃ paurṇamāsyādhi- karaṇe |
kau. 3|1|123 pṛ. 212, ‘ya iṣṭyā’ ityādau yatra prayogo'pi prāptastatra karmānuvādena kālā- yaṃśe viniyogavidhirityevamuktaṃ paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe |

yatrānekāryavidhivyāpāraṃ vinā viśeṣaṇavaiśiṣṭyasyāsiddhiḥ, tatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasambandha- siddhayarthaṃ viśiṣṭavidhānārthaṃ ca vidhāyakapratyayasya vyāpāra- bhedāt vidhyāvṛttyā vākyabhedaḥ, yathā paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe vidvadvākyavihitakarmaṇi āgneyādivākyairguṇavidhike |
yatrāpūrvabhāvanāsattvāt tatra vidhi- phalasya viśeṣaṇe evaikasmin sattvāt sādhyatvena ca vidhyantareṇa viśeṣaṇānāṃ vidhānāt āvṛttiḥ iti spaṣṭaṃ paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe |

kau. 2|2|156 pṛ. 199, yatra tu kārakatvasaṃbandhena vṛttiḥ yathā āgneyaḥ ityādi tatra prāthamikakriyā'nvayaṃ vinā kārakatvayogāt vṛtteśca pārthikasaṃbandhatvenāpi nirvāhopapatteḥ nādāveva aṣṭakapāla- saṃbandhaḥ |
2|2|125 pṛ. 38, vārttikīvṛdhanyatyoḥ kālakṛtavyavasthā- pakṣaḥ paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe eva nirākṛtaḥ |
3|1|123 pṛ. 211, vārttikīvṛdhanyatīmantrāṇāṃ vyavasthā ca karmakṛtā ( na tu kālakṛtā ) ityuktameva paurṇamāsyādhi- karaṇe |
( darśapūrṇamāsa-) samudāyasya phalasādhanatvamyupagame paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇe tannirāsādaro'pi viracyate |
vākyāntareṇa codite karmaṇi guṇānāṃ karmārtha- tvāt paraspararyātvābhāvena parasparavaiśiṣṭyābhāve sati ekaguṇaviśiṣṭaguṇāntaravidhisaṃbhavāt tasyatasya guṇasya kartavyatvamupadiṣṭaye |
darśau pūrṇamāse ca trikatrayatrikasya ekaprayogatā- siddhiḥ : ekādaśotkā paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇavārttikopa- pāditā upapannā |
paurṇamāsyāyaśabdanyāyena ( paurṇamāsī- nyāyena 2|2|3 ) ācārāgnihotraśabdayoḥ pratyekarūpa- vācitvāvadhāraṇāt pratyekarūpasya karmatvaṃ vācyam |
tattvaṃ tu ṛtunakṣatrādirevā- nādaro nañjudrayabalāt ( ‘nartu pṛcchennakṣatram’ ) |
paurṇamāsīkālaḥ vaikalpikī viśvavādiḥ devatā ca upāṃśuyāje |

bhāṣyam- evaṃ hi samāmananti 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭā- kapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' 'tāva- ṛtāmagrīṣomāvājyasyeva nāvupāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan iti. tābhyāmetamagrīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ paurṇamāse prāyacchat, aindraṃ dadhyamāvāsyāyām, aindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyām' iti|
tathā 'evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ 'ya evaṃ vidvānnāmāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ sarvāpyetāni samapradhānāni uta āgneyādīni payo'ntāni pradhānāni, āghārādīni ārādupakārakāṇya- jñāni |

tathā ya evaṃ vidvānityevaṃ saṃyuktā prakṛtānāṃ karmaṇāmanuvāditāro athavā 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate, ya evaṃ vidvānnāmāvāsyāṃ yajate' ityapūrvayoḥ karmaṇorvidhātārā, tatrete guṇavidhayaḥ iti |
prakaraṇaṃ tu paurṇamāsyām, prakṛtānāmāgneyādīnāṃ anu- vaditārau paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsaṃyutau |
ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīsaṃjñakaṃ yāgaṃ yajate iti na sarve yāgā ucyante |
atha nu prakṛtānā- manuvāditāre, tataḥ saṃnihitauḥ paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsaṃyuktā yāgā iti gamyate rūpam |
kathaṃ punarekavacanānto bahūnāṃ vācako bhaviṣyatīti yathucyate, samudāyaśabdatayā avakalpyate |
bhavati hi bahunāmekavacanāntaḥ- śabdaḥ samudāyāpekṣo yathā yūthaṃ vanaṃ kulaṃ paripaṭhaditi |
yadā āgneyādīnāṃ samudāya- vacanāvetī, tadā darśapūrṇamāsaśabdenaivābhidhīyante |
tata eṣāṃ phalasaṃbandhaḥ, phalasaṃbandhihetu āghārādīni ārādupakārakāṇīti |
vā- samastān darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇayāgavidhīnudāhṛtya kiṃ sarveṣāṃ pradhānatvam, uta keṣāṃcideva iti bhāṣyakāreṇa vicāraḥ prastutaḥ |

abhyāsalakṣaṇābhedāntaramidānīṃ saṃkhyā- nimittaṃ medamavicārya kathaṃ kathaṃ lakṣaṇānaupayikyarthe cintyate ? ke cidāhuḥ, ayamapi lakṣaṇārtha eva 'anantaraṃ pradhānāpradhānāni parīkṣyante' iti (bhāṣya-) vacanāt (bhā. 2|2|1|1 pṛ. 371) |
ayaṃ tu karmaṇāmaṅgāṅgibhāvo na kathaṃcit saṃdhyate |
mahatā prayatnena ayaṃ caturthe sādhayiṣyate 'darśapūrṇamāsayorijyāḥ' ityatrādhikaraṇe |
'ya evaṃ vidvān' ityevaṃ saṃyuktā prakṛtānuvādau, athavā apūrvakarmavidhī 'tatrete guṇavidhayaḥ' ityādi sarvaṃ (bhāṣyoktam) yathopanyastenādhikaraṇā- yena na saṃgacchate |
atha tu etadeva vicāryate, tataḥ pūrvaṃ nopayastavyam |
' 'śabdāntarādamāvāsyācca medāvadyucyate, samapradhānatvamapi etāmyāmeva pratipādyate' ityapūrvā yuktiḥ |
na vā ādhikaraṇādyaśarīrasya viviktāḥ pakṣahetavo dṛśyante, yena tantreṇa vicāradvayamidaṃ prastutaṃ ityavastheyam |
iha abhyāsalakṣaṇābhedā- tisrajñāpavādārthe adhikaraṇe ārabhyamāṇe yathodāhṛtānāṃ madhye dve evodāharaṇe 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvānnāmāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti |

tatra saṃdehaḥ kimeto yajatiśabdau apūrvayoḥ karmaṇo- vidhāyakau, uta paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāśabdābhyāṃ svāmidheya- kālaviśeṣayuktakarmapratipādakābhyāṃ viśeṣyābhyāṃ prakṛtāneva kāścit yāgān anuvadataḥ iti |
tatra itareṣāmāgneyādīnāṃ guṇāt, prayājādīnāmabhyāsāt, āghārādīnāṃ śabdāntara- tvāt siddhe mede adhikaraṇapakṣadvayaprayojanabhūtasamapradhāna-
tadiha paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyā- saṃyuktaravirdhātvatvam, tadabhidheyakarmabhedaḥ, samastāghārādīnāṃ samaprādhānyam, ityetat trayaṃ uttarottaraphalatvena avinābhāvasaṃbandhaāt ekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tathā tayoranuvādatvam, tadvācakakarmabhedaḥ, āgneyādīn prati āghārādīnāmabhedatvam, iti tenaiva prakāreṇa aparaḥ trikaḥ |
tritayasyatritayasya ca svāvinābhāvāt ekasiddhaiva itaradvayasiddharbhavati iti pakṣadvaye'pi yadeva sādhitam, tenaiva iṣṭasiddhiṃ matvā phalabhūtastutīyaḥ tṛtīyo''śa upanyastaḥ |
tatra cārtha- gṛhītāpi medābhedau vispaṣṭīkaraṇārthaṃ punarante darśitau |
kutaḥ ? eṣā hi ācāryasya śailī iti ke cit (phalgudvārā upanyāso bhāṣyakṛtprakriyā iti) |

(svamatena liṅgadarśanasāreṇa evaṃ kṛtamiti pariharati-) athavā yat liṅgadarśanaṃ vakṣyati 'vikṛtau prayājādayo dṛśyante' iti (caturthasūtre), tat sākṣāt medanirākaraṇāya asamarthaṃ samapradhānabhāvaṃ nirākariṣyati |
tannirākaraṇe ca sati avinābhāvāt vidhibhedāvapi nirākṛtāveva bhavataḥ, iti tadupajīvanayā ityamupanyāsaḥ |

ekaḥ samaprādhānya- dvāreṇa āgneyādīnāṃ karmavidhitve satyeva paurṇamāsyā- māvāsyāsaṃyukteyoḥ tadyatiriktakarmavidhividhānāt, aparaḥ punaḥ tayoreva karmavidhitvaṃ itareṣāṃ tu guṇavidhānārthaṃ ityevam |
prathamaṃ tāvat vyatirekapakṣaṃ parigṛhṇāti 'śabdā- ntaratvāt amāvāsyasya samapradhānāni' iti |
yadyapi caito hetu sākṣāt samapradhānatvena na saṃgacchete, tathāpi tatpratijñānana yo'rthāt medaḥ pratiśātaḥ, tena saṃbandhā- dekavākyatvam |
etaduktaṃ bhavati- 'ayāgebhyaḥ śabdā- ntaratvāt, yāgebhyaśca abhyāsāt medaḥ, tataśca sama- pradhānāni' iti |
na ca eṣā saṃjñā keṣu cit prakṛteṣu prasiddhā |
vartamānā- pradeśe'pi ca sati prayogavacanārthavādapañcamalakārādī- nāmanyatena 'samidho yajati' ityādi vidhiḥ |
na ca śālā''ntarīya- vat vidhivikalpaḥ, śāstrā''ntarāṇāṃ puruṣāntare prati prati- pādanena arthavattvāt |
na ca kasya cidanyasya vidheḥ stutiḥ saṃbhavati, ekavākyatvābhāvāt |
' 'sarvasmai vā etada yajñāya gṛhyate' iti sarvārthatvāt yathaiva upāṃśuyājasya śrauvājya- dravyatvam, evamanayorapi yāgayoḥ |
tathā ājya- bhāgayoḥ krame catalo'nuvākyāḥ paśyante dve āgneyyau, dve saumyau |
te balīyasā vākyena avacchidya anayoḥ karmorvidhīyate 'vātranī paurṇamāsyāmanūcyate, vadhnavatī amāvāsyāyām' iti |
tena anuvākyādvayasya tulyārthatayā vikalpyamānasya anu- rūpā yājyā'pi kalpayitavyā |
(āgneyyanuvākyāpakṣe yājyā'pi āgneyī, saumīpakṣe saumī kalpyā iti ekaḥ pari
tasya sarvatraiva kālasya adhikaraṇatvāt na karmaṇaḥ |
yattu kiṃ kālasya mantrasaṃbandhena iti, yadi tādarthyalakṣaṇa evaikaḥ saṃbandho bhavet, sa cātra asāmimukhyattve, tat evaṃ yujyate vaktum |
iha tu ājyabhāgau prati tādarthyaṃ vyavasthāsthite, saṃkare ca prāte kālabhedena prayujyamānayormantrayoḥ vyavasthā- mātraṃ kriyate |
ājyabhāgau ca prajñātaupamī- devatyau tadabhidhānasamarthamantrākāṅkṣātvadatyanena mantrān gṛhṇītaḥ |
kvikaḥ parasparasahitaścakaurṇamāsyā yuktaḥ ekayā cāmā- vāsyayeti |
yasmin chaṇe eko yāgaḥ ārabhya kriyamāṇaḥ samāptimanubhavati, tasminneva itare, ityavadhāraṇāt trikasyatrikasya tantreṇa prayogaḥ siddho bhavati |
autpa- ttikakālānurodhe tu medena aṅgaviyuktānāṃ ca prayogaḥ syāt, ityasti viśeṣaḥ |

nanu ca evaṃ sati samudāya- dvayasya itaretarayuktasya karaṇāt nāṅgasāhityavat na parasparatadvikṣā'pi (parasparatadikṣā na iti na iti dvau nañau prakṛtamarthe draḍhayataḥ ) iti yathaiva ajñānāṃ tatkālavijñānam, evaṃ paurṇamāsyā amāvāsyā ākṣitā, amāvāsyā ca paurṇamāsī ityubhayoranyatra prasaṅgaḥ, na vā utpattikāvyaśilpakālavirodhaḥ, tatrāpyanuṣṭhānāt |
nahi yaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ amāvāsyāṃ karoti, tena amāvāsyāthā- mamāvāsyā na kṛtā bhavati, tathā paurṇamāsī |
na ca utpattivākyena kālāntaraṃ niṣiddham, svakālapratipādana- mātropakṣayāt |
'kāle yasya na vijñātaḥ svarūpaṃ ca na naśyati |
tasya kālaḥ paro- pādhirucyamāno na duṣyati ||

' amāvāsyā hi utpattikālanirākāṅkṣā paurṇamāsīsāhityalyaṃ paurṇa- māsīkālaṃ na pratīcchati, evaṃ paurṇamāsī amāvāsyā- kālam, iti etayoḥ samudāyayoḥ kālāntaraṇe sati otpattikarūpavisaṃvādāt adṛṣṭatvamapūrṇamāsatvaṃ ca syāt |
ajñānāṃ tu aniścitakālatvena sākāṅkṣatvāt utpattisaṃvādābhāvāt avigrahaḥ sāhityapakṣe'lyam |
' nanu durasthāni upa- kartuṃ na śaknuvanti |
( apara āha - ) śaṃnikṛṣṭasya- rūpakartavyaṃ ityevedā kṛtaḥ ? sarvatra vacanānusāraṇa upa- kārānupakārāśau vijñāyate |
tatra saṃnikarṣavacanābhāve viprakṛṣṭaṃ nopakarotī iti na kiñcit pramāṇam |
nanu ca anyenaiva vākyena eṣa tantraprayogaḥ sidhyati 'ya iṣṭyā paśunā somena' ityādīnāṃ tatrāpi karaṇavibhaktinirdeśāt iṣṭeḥ khasamudāyasyāṅgasahitāyāḥ kālaṃ prati upādānāt īdṛśī vivakṣā labhyate |
satyaṃ labhyate, na tu iṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ sidhyati |
na tāvat trikamityeva- manyāhak ceṣṭitaṃ bhavet ||
tatra pratyekaṃ yāgatvena iṣṭiśabdapravṛtteḥ ekaikasyāmamāvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā prayogaḥ, iti na samyakprayogasiddhiḥ |

atha samastanā- māgeyādīnāṃ kathañcit rūḍheḥ 'pravṛttatvādidheḥ some pravṛttiḥ' itivat grahaṇam, evamapi prayogavacanaikatvāt samudāya- dvayasyāpi paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ vā anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt, tatra sa eva utpattiśaṅkāvirodhaḥ |
tadanurodhena vyava- sthitavikalpāśrayaṇamiti cet, evamapi yathoktatyanu- rodhātyatyekānuṣṭhānaprasaṅgaḥ |
tathā ajñānāṃ medena paurṇamāsya- māvāsye prati upādānābhāvāt yatrakatraṇa ekatra pradeśe anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt |
tasmāt na ( ya iṣṭyā iti - ) eta- dvākyaṃ tābhyāṃ ( paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyābhyāṃ ) tulyā- rthamiti prakṛtau akṣiptikatvatvāt vikṛtīyeva svakāla- tāyai gacchati |
nanu anena tantraprayogaḥ sidhyet 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti deśasthānāpadeyatvātsāhitya- vivakṣopapatteḥ |
tena sarvairāsevyo grāhyo, na bahavaḥ samāḥ ||
itya ataretara- yogavaśāt yadaiva ekaḥ samena yāgo yujyate, tadaiva itaro'pi iti tantratvamucyate |
tathā sati ṣaṇṇāmapi yugapadupādānāt tathaiva prayogasakteḥ sa eva virodhaḥ |
yadi punaḥ utpattikāvyanurodhena pravartate, tataḥ pratyekaṃ kālasaṃyuktānāṃ samaṃ prati sāhityaṃ saṃpādanīyaṃ iti bhraṣṭatve paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsu prayogaḥ samāptayet |
ajñānāṃ ca tāvat kālāt anukalpyamāṇāni prayoktavyāni iti yatrakacana antarāle kriyeran |
atha tu yāvatā utpattikāle virudhyate, tāvanmātra parihāya yogapadyena
samasaṃbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ ityavadhāryeta, tata ekasyāmeva paurṇa- māsyāmamāvāsyāṃ vā trikayoḥ prayujyamānayoḥ yasyakasya cit samīpe ajñānī prayujyeran |
sarvo hi asau pradhāna- kālaḥ, pradhānakālahavirbhāvaśca saṃbhāvayitavyo nātyanta- sāmīpyam, aśakyatvāt |
anenaiva phalavākyamapi pratyuktam, phalasyāpi deśadeva anupādeyatvāt |
sarvān itare- taryuktān sāṅgāna prati tantratve siddhe na prayogatantratva- siddhiḥ, viprakṛṣṭakālaireva hi ekaṃ phalaṃ sādhyate |
atho- cyeta, phalaṃ bhavat bhāvyadeta: itthaṃ iti sāṅghāni pradhā- nāni yugapatphalabhavankāle'nuṣṭhātavyāni śrūyante, tataśca na viprakṛṣṭānīti |

tataśca utpattikālalocanena yāvantaṃ prayogakālaṃ aṅgapradhānāni vyāpyuvanti tāvaneva phalabhavanakālaḥ, tāgaheva tadvidhayaṃ yogapadyam, iti sarvathā dhaṭasu paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsu dvayorvā sāṅgānāṃ cāpavargaḥ |
ekasamudāyasamīpe vā aṅga- prayogaḥ ardhamāsāntarāle vā yatrakacit iti prasaṅgāt, naitadvākyalyam : trikasyatrikasya sāṅghasya svakāle prayogaḥ vākyāntarāt sidhyatīti |
nanu evaṃ sati utpattau kālayogaḥ anarthakaḥ |
kathamanarthakaḥ ? paśya, 'yathupattau na vidhyeta yāgānāṃ kālasaṃgatiḥ |
tadabhāve tu naiva jñāyeta kā paurṇamāsī kā amā- vāsyeti |
tadajñānāt alabhyārthadarśapūrṇamāsapadāviśeṣita- prakṛtayāgāmātragrahaṇāt sarvāṇi samapradhānāni ityedeva syāt |
ata eva vā upāśuyājasya anutpattivākyamapi sat paurṇamāsīsaṃyuktamudāhṛtam |
bhāṣyam - yadi ca sarvāṇi samapradhānānibhaviṣyan- na vikṛtau prayājā dṛśyantām |
dṛśyante tu 'prayāje- prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti |
vā - yadi caite karmāntare syātām, tata ādhārā- dīni samapradhānāni syuḥ |

tataśca 'karmaṇastvapravṛtti- tvāt phalanīyamakartṛsamudāyānyatvasyeddhanatvāt' itya- nena nyāyena āgneyādivat prayājādīnāṃ karaṇāṃśopanipātāt vihitakaraṇyā vikṛtibhāvatayā kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣayā tatpurupasamāsārthanāmagrahaṇāt prāptaprayājānuvādena kṛṣṇala- vidhānaṃ nopayeta |
yadetat paurṇamāsīnāṃ karma, tasya etad rūpamabhidhaivatā, puroḍāśo dravyamiti |
vā - paurṇamāsīmityekatvaṃ prātipadikārthagatameva bhaviṣyati, na tallakṣitasamudāyagatam |
pratyakṣaśrutaśca yaji- rdravyadevatāsaṃbandhatvāt kleśonānāmubhayato na bhaviṣyati |
so''pi vā anekastadapūrvamapyanekam, samudāyānuvādatvāt vidhitvaṃ guṇavattvam |
prayājādidarśanamapi 'yatra nityānuvāda- vacanāni syuḥ' ityevaṃ viśiṣṭavidhānena vā prakṛtitva- prayājaguṇavidhinā vā supariharaṃ manyamānaḥ |
etāveva karmavidhī, śeṣā guṇavidhayaḥ ityupatāparihāramāha - aṣṭākapālādivākyeṣu paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāśabdayoḥ karma- vacanatvāt vākyasiddhameva rūpavattvamiti |
codanā vā guṇānāṃ yugapacchāstrodite hi tadarthatvāt tasyatyopadiśyeta |
na ca śabdāntareṇa codite karmaṇi aneko guṇaḥ parasparasaṃbandhe cāsati śakyate vidhātum |
katham ? yadi tāvat ‘paurṇamāsyāmaṣṭā- kapāle bhavati’ iti saṃbandho vivakṣitaḥ, na tadā aya- marthaḥ aṣṭākapālaḥ sattayā abhisaṃbadhyate iti |
tadānīṃ ‘āgneyaḥ’ ityayaṃ asyāntikā- dapi upanipatitaḥ bhavatisaṃbandhabhāvāt nānena saṃbandha- marhati ‘aṣṭākapāla āgneyo bhavati’ iti |
atha ‘āgneyaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ bhavati’ iti vivakṣyate, tadā āgneyapuroḍāśayoḥ asaṃbandha eva
tatraiva rūpa- bhavati iti nāyaṃ puruṣavyāpāraḥ |
tatra yadyapi pratyakṣe labhyamāne na yuktaṃ |
dravyaṃ kathañcillabhyeta devatā ānumānikakalpanam, tathāpi atra apa
prasiddhatvāt, dvivacanasya ca svādhyāyasyasamudāyatva-saṃdehaḥ kiṃ viṣṇuvādikānāṃ prakṛtānāṃ yāgānāṃ samu- samudāyidhitvasattvena ca bahutvalakṣaṇārthatvāt |
lakṣaṇā- dāyanuvādakam, uta apūrvasya yāgasya iti |
idānī- tātparyagrāhakamaiva ca śakyasaṃbandhaghaṭakasamudāyasiddhadvārā madhikaraṇatrayeṇa paurṇamāsīdhikaraṇoktasamudāyānuvāde kartavye vidvadvākyadvayam |
anyathā hi vidvadvākyābhāve āgneya- sarvatmanā paurṇamāsīdhikaraṇasiddhāntopajīvanāt upāṃśu- dravyasyaiva ekavākyopādānāt kāladvaya- yājapūrvapakṣasya antaramārabham |
yathā paurṇamāsīkaraṇe rūpavadādīnāṃ kapālaḥ' ityatra āgneyadravyasiddhiḥ |
tathā kaustume eva saṃnidhisamāmnātasya vidvadvākyayugalasya rūpābhāvāt āgne- prapañcitam |
atra tu antarāla- vākyasya vidhitvena gatisaṃbhavādaiṣamyam |
ataḥ anta- ralavākyasyaiva ... viśvādivākyānāṃ tu arthavādatvam |
ataḥ sarvathā viśvādivākyānāṃ vidhitvābhāvāt antarālavākyasya karmavidhāyakatvam, na tu arthavādatvamiti siddham |
prayojanam - pūrvapakṣe vaiṣṇavādikarmānuṣṭhānam, siddhānte tu ekasyaiveti |
sūtraṃ tu antarāyākye karma codanā viśvādivākyānāmivaikenaiva karmaṇāprabhakta- tvāditi |
atra ke cit 'tāvatamātramaupamāsājyeva nāpuṃṣā paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan
iti nyāyena paścādvādhividhiranurodhena arthavādābhyāṃ ubhayoḥ saṃprati- pannārthatvāt ānarthakyaparihāraḥ |
iti nyāyena prathamolabhyanā api kartā- bhoktṛtvādidhiyaḥ uttareṇa brahmātmajñānena bādhyatvam |
upa- deśasāhasī padya pra. 2 ślo. 3 rāmatīrtha |
iti nyāyena śruterava prāmāṇyaṃ śāstropakrame uktam |
ityanena ( nyāyena ) utpannamapi arthavādāt mukhyaveda- jñānaṃ bādhitvā viśuddhajñānameva gṛhyata |
vā. 3|1|12 pṛ. 806, sākṣāt ( āghāne ) prāptā'rthaḥ ( uccaistvaṃ ) śīghratamavagamyate |
prayogavacanagrahaṇottara- kālaṃ tu paścāttatra eva pradhānadharmaḥ ( upāṃśutvaṃ ) paurvā- parya0 |
iti nyāyasya anyonyānapekṣabuddhijanyaviṣaya- tvāt sāpekṣe liṅgādau aprāptiḥ |

yasmin jyotiyomaprayoge vahiṣpavamānārthaṃ pipī- likāpad‌vat anvārabhya gacchatāṃ ṛtvijāṃ madhye udgātaḥ pratihartṛśca apacchede kena cit krameṇa jāte yo'pacchedaḥ pūrva jātaḥ tannimittakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kartavyam, nottaranimittakaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntamāha |
apacchedayoḥ paurvāparye sati pūrvadaurbalyaṃ pūrvasya uttarapekṣayā durbalatvaṃ jñeyam |
tena uttarā- pa-chedanimittakaṃ yat prāyaścittaṃ tat kartavyam |
prakṛti- vat prakṛtigataṃ pūrvaṃ bhavati vikṛtigataṃ ca uttaram |
tatra prakṛtigataṃ avādhilā vikṛtigataṃ pravartituṃ nehe |
tatra vaikṛtaṃ ekādaśatvaṃ prākṛtaṃ pakṣatvaṃ bādhitvaiva pravartate, nānyathā |
tadvat apacchede'pi uttarāpacchedanimittaka- meva prāyaścittaṃ kartavyaṃ bhavati na pūrvāpacchedanimittakam |
yatra paurvāparyaṃ dvayaṃ prāptaṃ tatra dvayoranuṣṭhāne na virodhaprasaṅgaḥ tatra nāyaṃ nyāyaḥ |
yathā uttarādhikaraṇe ke. paurvāparye pūrvaniviṣṭasya bādhanam |
' vā. 3|6|13|10 pṛ. 1033. nityanaimittakayoḥ; nityakāmyayoḥ, prākṛtavaikṛta- yośca paurvāparyanaimittikanyāyena pūrvabādhaḥ |
1|1|1 brasū. pṛ. 9. ādye prayoge kevaladvarāpacchede, dvitīyaprayoge ca kevalapratīhartyapacchede paurvāparyanyāyapravṛttiḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 117. paurvāparyapratyāsattimātrat yathāsaṃkhyakramaḥ balīya- yān |
kāmye yājyākāṇḍe paurvāparyapratyāsattikrameṇa aindrāmamantragatalayoḥ iṣṭidvaye'pi aniyamena prāpnuvatoḥ yathāsaṃkhyakrameṇa atyantadeśasāmyena pratyāsannatvāt viniyogo bhavati |
vā. 3|3|7|14 pṛ. 840. paurvāparyavalīyastvaṃ tatra nāma pratīyate |

' ye hi bhinna- vākyagatāḥ parasparanirapekṣāḥ virodhino'rthāḥ śrūyante, teṣāṃ pūrvasya uttarapadamapardenaiva labdhātmakatvāt uttarasya pūrvopa- mardena vinā ātmalābhānupapatteḥ paurvāparyavalīyastvanyāyo bhavati |
yatra tu ekavākyatayā parasparapekṣāṇāṃ śravaṇam, na tatra etadbhavati |
pūrvapratīte ca uttaramātmānuguṇaṃ adhikaṃ vā ākāṅkṣati |
ataśca anadhikaṃ anuguṇaṃ vā, tada- napekṣitatvāt naiva tasmin vākye'sti |
na cāvidha- mānena pūrvabādhaḥ śakyate iti pūrvavalīyastvaṃ bhavati |

śrutyādikalpanādvārā'pi liṅgādīnāṃ prāmāṇya- virodhe'pi smṛtitat‌ dvituyādyantarabhūtatvādyogene śrutyādikalpanasya durvārasya uktakalpanāpekṣatvena śrutyā- dibhyaḥ paścāt pravṛtteḥ kalpyaśrutyādyapekṣatve'pi ca virodha- śrutyādyanapekṣaśrutatvāt paurvāparyavalīyastvanyāyena eva ( 6|1|19 ) vaiparītyaṃ yuktamityeva |
su. pṛ. 1198. pauṣkalaṃ nāma sāma ' pavasva madhumattamaḥ ' ( 692-93 ) iti kakup-satobṛhatīrūpakadvayātmaka- sūkte tṛtīye savane ārambhapavamāne |
pauṣkalaṃ ca tṛce na geyaṃ kiṃtu ekasyāmeva ṛci ' kakubhi ' ityekavacanena viśeṣavidhānāt ( iti siddhānte uktam ) |
vi. 9|16 varṇakaṃ 3. pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ kevalapaśudevatve, na tu somāpauṣṇadau dvaidevatve |
bhāṣyam-- pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ prakṛtau śrūyamāṇaṃ vikṛtau ityuktam ( pūrvādhikaraṇe ) |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ carau, paśau, puroḍāśe ca, uta carāveveti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? tat sarvatra syāt carau paśau puroḍāśe ca |
carau vā'rthakaṃ puroḍāśe'rthavipratiṣedhāt paśau na syāt |
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? ' hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati ' iti hṛdayādava- dhiṣyate |
yadyapi punastadākṛtikaḥ kriyate, tathāpi asyotpādanapradeśaṃ prati muhuḥ |
tasmāt carau pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatītyevam vacanam |
yadi kaścidetat laukikapiṣṭopādānenāpi puroḍāśasiddhernaikāntana arthākṣa iti, taṃ prati ucyate |
tasya prakṛtau peṣaṇaṃ sādhanamāsīt atastena pūrvataraprāptena uktaṃ puroḍāśe peṣaṇam |
na ca hṛdayādeḥ piṣṭasya jñāyeta katareṇa pradeśenaida paśoruktamiti |
tasmāt carāvapratiṣiddhaṃ anarthaprāptaṃ ca peṣaṇamiti tatraiva vidhīyate |
nanu ' adantako hi ' iti hetvaviśeṣāt paśupuroḍāśe'pi prāpteḥ |
dravyadānasya pradhānaprakramatvāt nāntarā peṣaṇena vyavadhānaṃ yuktam |
upanītamātrameva ca peṣaṇaṃ puroḍāśe anuvādādavadyate, carau ca nivarta- mānaṃ pratiprasavatvena, paśau punaranyathāprāptividhevena |
na caitāni ekasyaiva vākyasyaitāni rūpāṇi vijñāyante |
bhāṣyam-- iti cetpaśyati bhavān, arthaviprati- peṣāt paśarthamiti |
piṣyamāṇo hi piṣṭatvaṃ yadāgūryā satvā khalvivā |
yadi viśadasiddhinimittaṃ syāt, na piṣṭasiddhe prayujyeta|
tatrāpi hi prayujyate, 'piṣṭaka- caruḥ sādhyate' iti|
tena piṣṭe odane viśadaudane ca prayogakāro bhavanti caracarati|
'odanapiṣṭaka- caruprayuktasya caraśabdasya anekārthatvamanvāyīti ubhaya- sāmānyavacanatvaṃ vijñāyate|
etāvān samādhiḥ avi- śeṣe'pi na puroḍāśārthatvaṃ prayojanam|
śā— sarvatra syāt iti prāpte, ucyate|
peṣaṇaṃ tena na tayorvidhāryatvaṃ carau punaḥ|
vi— 'carau paśau puroḍāśecarāvevota peṣaṇam, viśeṣādarśanādetat sarveṣvapi vidhīyate|
na paśau pāriśeṣyeṇa carāveva hi peṣaṇam|
' 19. bhāṭṭa— tat peṣaṇaṃ pūṣadevatye carau paśau puroḍāśe ca syāt, uta carāveveti cintāyām, aviśeṣādantakatveṣu sarvatra|
iti prāpte, puroḍāśe tāvat pākāt pūrvaṃ peṣaṇasya prāptādeva vidhānaṃ vyartham, taduttaraṃ tu puroḍāśapadavācyākṛti- vināśāpattiḥ|
na ca ubhayatra acadānottarakālaṃ peṣaṇavidhiḥ, atyantāprāptapeṣaṇa-
kiṃ ekadevatye pauṣṇe etat bhavati, uta dvidevatye'pīti|
kiṃ dvidevatye udā- haraṇam ? rājasūye uttare trisaṃyukte 'saumāpauṣṇa ekādaśa- kapālaḥ, aindrāpauṣṇaścaḥ (pauṣṇaścaḥ) śyāvo (mo ?) dakṣiṇā' iti|
kiṃ prāptam ? ekadevatyasya peṣaṇamiti, kevalasaṃyogāt yathā caturdhā- karaṇe|
idānīṃ kimantya- sahite devatayā aindrāpauṣṇe carau peṣaṇaṃ bhavati, uta ekasminneva iti saṃdehe caturdhākaraṇe'pītyāyāt siddhāntenaiva tāvat upakramate|
tatra yadi pūṣṇo bhāgaḥ piṣyeta, apiha itarasya syāt|
athāvirodhaṃ manyamānā aparasyāpi bhāge piṃṣyuḥ, bhāgasaṃmohaḥ syāt|
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? anyasya bhāgo'nyasmai avadīyate|
kutaḥ ? 'piṣyādarthaṃ samastaṃ vā dvidevatye carau bhavān|
' arthapeṣaṇe hi piṣṭo'śaḥ śīghrataraṃ sidhyati, itarakṣīreṇa|
tatra piṣṭapākānantaramu- dvāsane sati itarasya āmatvaṃ bhavet|
tatākapratīkṣaṇāde'pi vā piṣṭasya vilayanāt acaratvaṃ syāt|

atha taṇḍulān pūrve prakṣipya paścāt piṣṭe nikṣipeta, tato yogapadyaṃ gamyamānaṃ bādhyeta (piṣṭataṇḍulabhāgayordvayorapi ekayagāsādhanatvena ekahaviṣtvāt kṛtsnasya ca haviṣpaḥ nikṣepasyāpi yogapadyamiha atideśāt gamyamānaṃ bādhyeta --su. pṛ. 1329)|
pūṣānurodhena tu aindrā'pi bhāge piṣyamāṇe bhāgasaṃkarāt anyadīye bhāge anyasmai dīyamāne vaiguṇyaṃ prāpnoti|
nanu caitat sarvaṃ dvideva- tyeṣu bhavato'pi samānam|
' sa cāṅgīkṛtaḥ, miśrasya havipo miśradevatodeśena yugapaddāne virodhā- bhāvāt|
na ca tat dvidevatye tathāvasthita ityapravṛttireva|
havirantareṣvapi ca dvidevatyeṣu evaṃ prakāratvameveti devatā guṇabhūtā|
na ca guṇānurodhena pradhānamāvartanīyamiti sakṛdānābhyupagamāt sarvasmin saha kriyamāṇe saṃkaradoṣā- nāśrayaṇam|
bhavatā punarasmadabhyupagamena dvidevatye peṣaṇaṃ vaktumaśakyatvāt avaśyaṃ devatānimittatvamabhyupagantavyam|
tataśca devatayoḥ prādhānyādekaikā svābhāgasaṃkīrṇaṃ prārthyate iti tathaiva dānamanujñeyam|
yāvadantulannabhāgāvivekaṃ haviḥ, tāvat kiyān kasya bhāgaḥ|
kalpite tu viveke vacanādate punarekīkaraṇapatterasaṃkīrṇa- dānaṃ prāpnoti|
tatrānyasya bhāgāt anyasmai avadīyamāne vaiguṇyaṃ bhavati|
carumiti yāgaṃ prati upādīyamānatvena vivakṣitaikatvasaṃkhyeya prāptakṛta- medāśrayaṇe śāstrabādhaprasaṅgāt|
ato na kathañcidapi pratiṣiddhadharmakaṃ dvidevatye peṣaṇaṃ bhavatīti na kartavyam|
sa ca dvidevatye'pi bhāge piṣyamāṇe pratipadyamāḥ kuto bhavati|
tatra hi tadvito nirapekṣya bhavati, na sa- dvitīyasya|
indrapīta iti samāso'pi nirapekṣasya, na sadvitīyasya|
iha tu pratiṣadhaśabdasya bhāgaśabdena saha avyayadāthau bahuvrīhiḥ samāsaḥ|
na tu atra dvidevatye kaścidekajātīyako doṣaḥ |
tasmādeka- devatye dvidevatye'pi vā carau asya bhāgaḥ peṣaṇya eva |
vā— saddhite'pi vā pūrṇaṃ syādeva peṣaṇam |
kutaḥ ? 'haviṣo yadi pauṣṇasya tathāgāñjasya vā bhavet |
anuktatvād dvidevatye na bhavet peṣaṇaṃ tataḥ |
