' puṣpasadbhāvanimittametat peṣaṇaṃ na ca tat viśeṣitavastuninimittam |
vyāsañjitatvācca [ vyāsañjita- tvācca ] devatatvasya dvidevatye puṣpaviśiṣṭatā na syāt, na tu pūṣā tadbhāgo vā nāstīti |
yathā manotāyāṃ vakṣyati (bhāṣyaṃ pṛ. 1939) 'tatrāgniḥ adevatā, na tu asamavetaḥ' iti |
tena asyāpi atra pūṣṇo devatatve samavāyamātreṇa upalakṣaṇatvāt dvayordevatenāpi laj- mānasya 'samaṃ syādaśrutatvāt' ityanena arthe pūṣṇo bhāga iti gamyate |
tasya peṣaṇe kriyamāṇe yadi tāvat kāṃsyabhojināyena amuṣye'pi ityevaṃ itarabhāgapeṣaṇa- mapi kriyate,
yathaiva aindrāgnasya puroḍāśasya grahaṇaṃ ca āgneyendrāgnīśabdābhyāmubhayagrahaṇam, tathaindrāpauṣṇadeḥ pūṣabhāgatvena |
yadyapi ca evaṃvidhaśabdo- ccāraṇādiha samāsopālambho nāsti, tathāpyartha eva bhāga- śabdagrāhyo na vidyate ityapravṛttiḥ |
yadyapi ca dvayo- rarthayordevatātvaṃ pratipadyamānayoḥ samudāyaprasiddhayarthatvena avayavau upayujyete, tathāpi saṃkalpasya anyatareṇāvyapadeśā- danupalakṣaṇatvaṃ siddham |
bhāṣyam— yaduktam, adantako hīti devatādharma darśayatīti |
vā — yattu 'adantako hī' iti heturnidarśanāt devatādharmatvamiti |
bhāṣyam — athāparaṃ yatkārāṇamuktam, nemapiṣṭamiti dvidevatve peṣaṇaṃ darśayati, 'ardha piṣṭaṃ bhavatyardhamapi' dvidevatvatvāt ' iti devatādharma darśayatīti |
asati punaḥ pakṣāntare uccāraṇaparatvenakāryaparijihīrṣayā ane- kārtha vākyamabhyupagantavyaṃ bhavati |
aviśiṣṭavidhi cāpekṣya viśiṣṭavidhidurbalatve bhavati na tu atrāśāvāsti |
upādānaṃ ca yajñasya bhāga- śabdena vidyate |
yāgasya tattve bhāgo- kterna yāgāntaragāmi tat |

bhāṭṭa — yatra anyasahitaḥ pūṣā devatā yathā rāja- sūye 'aindrāpauṣṇaścaḥ' iti tatrāpi peṣaṇam, uta yatra kevala eva devatā tatraiva iti cintāyām, 'adantako hi saḥ' ityarthavādānusārāt peṣaṇasya pūṣasvarūpatvā- vagateḥ, tatsvarūpasya ca anyasahita'pi sattvāt yuktameva peṣaṇam |
ata eva 'somāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapedemapiṣṭaṃ paśukāmaḥ' iti nemapadavācyārthapiṣṭatvānna'pi saṃ- gacchate |
yadi tu navamādhyāyanena pūṣarūpe ānarthakyāt apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā āvaśyakatvamāśādyeta, tadā- 'stu pūrvoktavidhayā pūṣapraviṣṭasaṃjñanayayāgānāmitareva tātparyagrāhikāyāḥ sattvāt sā'pi pūṣapade |
parantu artha- vādānusāreṇāt pūṣādhiṣṭhānakadevatāprayogātpūrvatvala- pāyā etalliṅgakārāt dvidevatve'pi peṣaṇamarhasya |
yathā caivaṃ sati pākasaṃpattistathā yatitvatyaṃ antarāyakaraṇena vā kramika- nikṣepeṇa vā pātrabhedena vā |

iti prāpte, ānarthakyapari- hārāya apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā āvaśyakatvāt, adhi- ṣṭhānadvāratvakalpanāt ca pūṣṇo devatātvopasthitimanta- reṇānupapatteḥ, tadupasthitau ca taddārakatvamātrakalpanāyaiva ānarthakyaparihārāt, dvidevatve ca caturdhākaraṇādyadhi- karaṇanyāyena kevalasya pūṣṇo devatātvābhāvāt, yatra kevala eva pūṣā tatraiva peṣaṇam |

na ca apūrvasādhanabhūta- devatātvasyaiva prakāratayā pūṣapadena tasya pūṣopari bhāne svarūpasaṃbandhasyaiva saṃsargavidhayā vicakṣaṇena paryāptairivakṣaṇāt, tasya ca dvidevatve'pi ekasmin pūṣṇa sattaiva tasyāpyadveyatvopapatteḥ kathaṃ na peṣaṇamiti vācyam |
anyathā eko dvitvasamayāvān itivat 'eko dvitvavān' 'eko dvau' ityādiśabda- bodhāpatteḥ |
pauṣṇapeṣaṇādhikaraṇam naiva prakāratvāt, tasya ca pūṣṇa kevalle bādhāt, pūṣamātravṛttidevatātvasya prakāratvena tatraiva peṣaṇādi |
nemapiṣṭa- tvasyāpi ca tathaiva vidheyatvāt viśiṣṭabhāvanā- vidhānena avākyabhedāt āgamaktavyam |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ samāmananti 'tasmātpūṣā praviṣṭhabhāgo- 'dantako hi saḥ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ prakṛtau uta vikṛtau |
ayaṃ ca vicāraḥ pūrvokta- saṃtardananyāyenaiva gatārthaḥ |
yato hi darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pūṣā nāma devatā samasti |
na ca lakṣaṇāyā darśapūrṇa- māsadevatā'nena pratipādyate, 'adantako hi' iti hetu- vannigadasamavāyāt |
na hyagnyādīnāmadantatvaṃ vede purāṇe vā kvacittītam |
asti ca vikṛtau tasya tasya haviṣaḥ pūṣā devatā |
tadarthaṃ pūrvanyāyasiddho'pyatha uttaravicārārtha saṃkīryata iti mantavyam |
tautā. pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ vikṛtau pratīyatāccodanāt prakṛtau |
darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'tasmāt pūṣā praviṣṭhabhāgo'dantako hi saḥ' iti pauṣṇaṃ pūṣadevatākaṃ peṣaṇamabhihitam |
ke. pauṣṇaṃ śyāmaḥ aikādaśineṣu caturthaḥ paśuḥ aśvamedhe jyotiṣṭome ca |
vi. 8|17, pauṣṇaṃ śyāmamālametājñakāmaḥ ityasya padyoḥ puroḍāśe 'pūṣā praviṣṭhabhāgo'dantako hi' iti pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ kartavyam |
darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe śrutasya pauṣpeṣaṇasya pauṣṇe yāge utkarṣaḥ |
bhāṣyam — darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ samāmananti 'tasmā- tpūṣā praviṣṭhabhāgo'dantako hi saḥ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ prakṛtau, uta vikṛtāviti |
nanu prakṛtau pūṣaṇaṃ na kasyaciddhaviṣo devatā samāmanantīti |
yatra pauṣṇaṃ havirasti, tatra tasya peṣaṇaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyam |
brūyāt yadi anyatrāpi pūṣpaḥ pūṣā na syāt |
pauṣṇaṃ peṣaṇaṃ vikṛtau na prakṛtau iti |
vā — saṃtardananyāyenaiva vākyaprakaraṇavirodhe sati vikṛtyarthaṃ siddhamuttaravicārārthaṃ prārabhyate |

soma — prakaraṇānusāreṇa darśapūrṇamāsayorniveśaḥ iti pūrvapakṣasya mandatvāt nedamadhikaraṇāntaram, kintu kiṃ sarvatra niveśaḥ, uta carāveva kariṣyamāṇavicārasya vākyaprakaraṇavirodhe'virodhacintāprastāve sākṣātsaṃgatatvā- bhāvāt tasya prāsaṅgikatvasiddhayarthaṃ peṣaṇasya vākyenotkarṣaḥ iti prāsitāmātranena sūtreṇa kriyate |
18. bhāṭṭa — darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'pūṣā praviṣṭhabhāgo- 'dantako hi saḥ' iti śrutam |
tatra kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsayo- reva aṅgatvena kamāntaravidhiḥ, uta pūṣadevatāyāge peṣaṇa-

mātrāvidhiḥ iti cintāyām, na tāvat bhāgaśabdalakṣita- yāgoddeśena peyaṇavidhiḥ, ekaprasaratābhaṅgāpatteḥ, upapadena viśeṣaṇe vākyabhedācca, phalaprayatnādravyopasarjanasya peyaṇasya yāgānvayānupapatteśca |
ata eva na pūṣpadameva śakyārthasya lakṣitapadadevatāyāgasya vodeṣyatāparam, pūṣṇāḥ agnimicaritakratusaṃbandhābhāvena kratūpasthitau pramāṇā- bhāvācca |
iti prāpte, prapiṣṭhābhāgapadena tāvat bhāgo bhajanīyaṃ sevyamasyeti vyutpattyā sevanāsaṃbhave'pi saṃbandha- mātraṃ devatvādipyavahārapramāṇakaṃ prapiṣṭapūṣṇoḥ pratīyate |
tacca yāgaṃ vinā anupapannamiti yāgamanumāpayati itye- tāvat ubhayoravivādam |
tatra ca viśeṣaṇamātravidhistaṃbhe viśiṣṭavidyādityasya anyāyatatvāt pramāṇābhāve na apūrvayāgāntarānumitiḥ |
evamihāpi yo viddhāniti vedanakriyāviśeṣitakartṛyogo yacchabdo vedanakriyāvidhānameva pratibadhnāti, na yāgakriyā- vidhānamiti |
tathā evaṃśabdepi evaṃ viddhāniti vedana- kriyāparāmarśaka eva, na yāgakriyāparāmarśaḥ |
na ca adhikārāpekṣitasamudāyākaraṇe anuvādasyārthavattvaṃ rājasūyavat phalavākyenaiva samudāyakaraṇa- saṃbhavāt |
na caivaṃ sati 'rājasūyena' itivat 'darśapūrṇa- māsena' ityevacanaprayogaprasaṅgaḥ |
ataḥ samidādivat vidhyāsādeva paurṇamāsyādyāganāmā- vacchinnamevaitat karmadvayaṃ vidhīyate |
na ca pravṛttyanimittā- bhāvāt na nāmadheyam |

agnihotrādīnāmiva vidhyāsamāna- devasaṃbandhanirokṣaṇe 'paurṇamāsyā paurṇamāsā yajeta' 'amāvāsyāyāmāmāvāsyayā yajeta' iti vākyadvaya- vidhāsyamānakālasaṃbandhapravṛttinimittanirīkṣaṇena karmadvaye nāmadheyatvopapatteḥ |
na ca asiddhe nāmni kathaṃ tadullekhena kālavidhiḥ ; anyonyāśrayāditi vācyam |
yataḥ 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' itivatsamānādhikaraṇyenaiva nāmatve siddhe tadullekhena mādhikālavidhinā pravṛttinimittamātraṃ nirṇīyate iti nānupāpannam |
na ca avyaktacodanātsāmānyene saumikadravya- devatātvena rūpavattvam, yato nirapekṣo hi vidhiḥ sāpekṣeṇopajīvyate |
atra ca somavidheḥ dīkṣaṇīyādyaṅga- dvāreṇa darśapūrṇamāsavidhyupajīvitena karmāpekṣatvam |
tadyadi darśapūrṇamāsavidherapi tadupajīvanam, tadā itaretarāśrayā- pattiḥ |
maivam, 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate, yad dhruvāyāmājyam' iti prakaraṇa- śrutyā'dravyasya dhruvāvākyāt dravyaṃ tāvadasti |
na ca ekena vākyena ājyasya dhruvāsaṃbandhavidhāne yāgasaṃbandha- vidhāne ca vākyabhedaḥ ; 'yad dhruvāyāmājyam' ityasya dhruvāsaṃbandhamanūdya yāgasaṃbandhamātravidhānāt |
tat yadi ājyadhruvāsaṃbandhabodhakaṃ vākyāntaraṃ śatamasti, tadā tatpāsā'nuvādena anuvāda eva |
atha nāsti, tadā eta- darthavādānyāt'nupapattikalpitavākyalabhyasyaivānuvāda iti nānupapannam |

'vātrghnī pūrṇamāse'nucyate, dhruvantī amāvāsyāyām' ityeta- dvākyābhyāmeva vātrghnīśabdābhidheyamubhayadravyaṃ dhruvantīśabdā- bhidheyaṃ ca ṛgvayaṃ ājyabhāgakramapaṭhitamapi vākyatvena kramaṃ bādhitvā etatkarmasaṃbandhatvena vidhīyate |
tatra ca ekaikasmin karmaṇi yuga- padviniyuktamantradvayena yugapaddevatādvayasamarpaṇāt devatayoḥ ekaikasmin karmaṇi samuccaya eva |
tena ājyabhāge eva kāla- vyavasthā'tha vākyadvayaṃ yathāsiddhāntameva bhaviṣyati |
paurṇa- māsyāṃ yāvājyabhāgau, tau dhruvapadadvayamantrakau, amā- vāsyāyāṃ yāvājyabhāgau, tau dhruvantyapadadvayamantrakāviti |
ājyabhāgayoḥ paurṇamāsyāmāvāsā- kālaprāptau na tadvyavasthātvamiti mantravidhāyakatvameveti |
ājyabhāgayostu 'yasyai- kasyaciddevatāyai havirnirvāpam ājyasyaiva no purastādyajat' iti purākalpasvarūpeṇa vākyena agnīṣomalībhāṃ atrāpi tayordevatātvam |
atra yadyapi sākṣādagnīṣomayoḥ śravaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpi 'tāvatatrāgnīṣomāvājyasyaiva no' ityatra nauśabdena tadupādānavyavasthitatvādātrāpi nauśabdena tayo- revopādānamiti |
yājyānumantraṇakramaprāptān atrādhitva anuvākyāyugalamātrasya vākyena anyatra viniyuktatvāt |
athavā āmeyādivākyaireva viddhāyaktyopakramakarmadvaya- saṃbandhena guṇavidhānāt rūpalābho bhaviṣyati |
'puroḍāśaṃ saṃyunakti,' 'puroḍāśaṃ paryagni karoti' ityādisaṃskāravākyaparyāloca- nena puroḍāśādidravyāptau agnyādidevatāmātravidhānāt |
yathā 'vāsasā krīṇāti' ityanena ucyate ṛṣe aruṇādivākyena anekaguṇavidhāne |
atra tu ekaineva āmeyādipadena anāghṛtena agnidevatāviśiṣṭa- puroḍāśādidravyopasthānāt pratyayena ca ekadevatā- vidhānāt nāṣṭilakṣaṇo vākyabhedaḥ |
yatra tu pṛthakpadena dravyadevatopādānam, yathā 'tāvatatrāgnīṣomāvājyasyaiva nāpuṃṣāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' ityasya purākalparūpatvena avidhāyakatvāt (?) |
ekatra āmeyādi- vākyavihitena ṣaṭ karmāṇi viddhāyaktyayugalavihitaṃ ca karmadvayaṃ ityaṣṭau karmāṇi |
tadevaṃ pūrvapakṣe'pi darśapūrṇamāsopapadasya kasmiṃścit karmaṇi prasiddhatvāt yajestu yāgamātraviṣayatvena prasiddhatvāt yajisāmānādhikaraṇyena yajimātratvam |
tathā sati prakṛtayāganāmā- meva phale vidhānāt rājasūyavat sarveṣāmeva prayājānu- yājānāmpi samapradhānatvameveti |
nanvevaṃ sati pradhānasya anatideśāt kathaṃ vikṛtau prayājātideśaḥ ? vacanādi- tyucyate 'prayāje prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' ityādi |

atha kasmādevāve viddhāyaktyayugalavihite paurṇamāsya- māvāsyāyāṃ. aphale tadoravidhānam ? evaṃ tarhi samudāyānāmevapi tayoramyabhijñānāt siddhānte'pi kathaṃ phale vidhānam ? atha siddhānte na saṃjñādvāreṇa samudāya- dravyopasthāpyam, kiṃ tarhi ? kāladvāreṇa |
evaṃ tarhi eta- tkarmadvaye'pi aviśiṣṭam, 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta, amāvāsyāyāmāmāvāsyā yajeta' iti vākya- dvayena kālavidhānasyoktatvāt |
tena anayoreva phala- vākyena viniyogāt kathaṃ samaprādhānyamiti |
kālasaṃyogasya āmeyādināmapi paṇṇāmaviśiṣṭena kasya yāgadravyasya grahaṇamiti nirṇayamaśakyatvāt |
na ca vācyaṃ dvikarmapase tāvadayaṃ parihāro na saṃbhavatyeva |
aṣṭakarmapakṣe'pi evaṃ sati kāladvāreṇa ajñānāmeva karmaṇāṃ phale viniyogo na bhaviṣyatīti prajājādibhiḥ saha samaprādhānyamiti |
tadihāpi kālavacano darśapūrṇa- māsaśabdo lakṣitalakṣaṇayā kālayoginau yāgān upasthāpa- yitumarhati |
tena upapadasyāprasiddhatvāt prasiddhārthayaji- sāmānādhikaraṇyena yajyarthatvameva nirṇīyate |
siddhānte tu samudāyānuvādatveva phalavākyasyopapadaprasiddhaprayojanatvāt yugapat samudāyasyaiva phalavidhānam |
na ceha tathā sama- stīti pūrvapakṣe'pi samaprādhānyameveti |
bhavedevaṃ vidhyābhyāsataḥ karmabhedaḥ, yadi viddhāyaktyayugalasya kartṛyuktyacchabdasya evaṃśabdyogena anuvādakaṃ na bhavet |
yattu vedana- kartṛyogo yacchabdo na yāgakartṛyogotyucyata |
( tanna ) avyabhicāreṇa vedanakartṛttvasya prāptatvena yacchabdaviśe- ṣaṇīyatvāt |
'yo dīkṣitaḥ' ityama tu dīkṣitādīkṣita- yorapi yāgakartṛtvāviśeṣāt 'yo dīkṣitaḥ' ityaviśeṣa- ṇam |
na ceha vedanarahitasya acetanasya yāgakartṛttva- mastīti yo vedanakartā sa yajeteti viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāt yāgakartṛviśeṣaṇameva yacchabdaḥ |
tadu- ktam -- 'kriyāpadekayogitve yacchabdo na ruje- dvidhiyam |
tatra bhavatu tāvat yathākathañcit dravyalābhaḥ, devatābhastu na kathañcidapi saṃbhavati |
na ca māntravarṇikadevatāprāptiḥ, yājyānuvākyāmantrayoḥ ājyabhāgakramapaṭhitatvena tadarthalā- bhāvāt |
na ca vākyena kramaṃ bādhitvā karmadvayasaṃbandho mantrasya kriyate, 'vātrghnī pūrṇamāse'nucyate dhruvantī amāvāsyāyām' iti mukhyakālavacanayoḥ karmaparatvā-
nāpi kāladvāreṇa lakṣaṇayā karmaparatvam, ājyabhāgayoreva paurṇamāsyā- vāskālayogena mantravyavasthāpakatayā mukhyārthopapattau kramabādhena lakṣaṇikatvasvīkārāsambhavāt |
na cājyabhāgayoḥ paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyākālasya prāptatvāt na mantravyavasthā- pakatvaṃ vacanasyeti vācyam |
yataḥ siddhānte tāvat prayogadvayena sāṅgatyaiva paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyākālo labhya eva |

tathā pūrvapakṣe'pi sarveṣāṃ samprādhānyena sahacaritānāṃ madhye aṣṭānāṃ kālasaṃbandhasya śrutatvāt itareṣāmapi kālasaṃbandhe kalpyamāne prayogavidhivataḥ tatkālasyaiva buddhau vipariṇateḥ tatkālasaṃbandhameva kalpayati |
tatra paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyā- kālayoḥ vinigamanāpramāṇābhāvāt icchāvaśādanuṣṭhāne sati bhavati vyavasthā'thaitadvacanam |
yadā paurṇamāsyājyābhāgau tadā vāryantī anuṣṭhye, yadā amāvāsyāyāgau tadā vṛṣantī anuṣṭhye |
kiñca nāmavācchinnaṃ hi karma- dvayametat vighātavyam |
nāpi kāla- vidhipare vākye vidhisāmānyābhāvakālasaṃbandhanirīkṣaṇena nāmadheyatvamiti vācyam |
na ca kālavidhipare vākyadvaye siddhāntādyadyotapannaṃ karma pratīyate |
tena yathābhūtasya nāma- saṃbandho na tathābhūtasya kālasaṃbandhaḥ, yathābhūtasya kāla- saṃbandho na tathābhūtasya nāmasaṃbandha iti |
agnihotrādau tu yathābhūtasya utpattiḥ tathābhūtasyaiva 'yadyame ca prajā- pataye na sāyaṃ juhoti' ityutpattivākyagatahomasvarūpavā- gamāt vaiṣamyāditi nānupanyam |
nanvevaṃ tarhi āgneyādivākyaireva devatāmātrāvidhānāt rūpabhāvo bhavati |
maivam, prāpte karmaṇi dravyadevatārūpā- nekaguṇavidhāne vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
na ca saṃskāravākya- paryālocanena dravyaprāptau devatāvidhānāt vākyabheda iti vācyam |
anyathā 'dravyāṇāṃ karmasaṃyoge guṇatvenābhisaṃbandhaḥ' iti nyāyena pradhānakarmatvāpatteḥ |
kiñca bhavatu tāvat dravya- prāptiḥ, tathāpi āgneyapadapāttāgnidhāne aṣṭakapāla- padopāttāṣṭakatvavidhāne ca vākyabhedaḥ |
tena yaduktaṃ tadvidhānaikapadopāttadevatāviśiṣṭadravyavidhānāt vākyabheda iti, tadapi nirastam |
tathā ca sūtram - 'codanā vā guṇānāṃ yugapacchā- codite hi tadarthatvātsatyadoṣopadiṣṭayet' |
nanu siddhānte ca ekena vākyena dravyadevatāsaṃbandha- kālayogānāṃ vidhāne vākyabhedaḥ samāna eva |
na caivaṃ sati viśeṣaṇānāṃvidhānam, viśiṣṭavidhānyā'nu- papattitvādvidhimivaiva viśeṣaṇavidhānāt |
prāpte karmaṇi nāneko vidhātuṃ śakyate guṇaḥ |
nanu yathā viśiṣṭavidhirviśeṣaṇavidhisāpekṣaḥ tathā viśeṣaṇavidhipi viśeṣyalābhāya viśiṣṭavidhisāpekṣa eva ityanyonyāśrayāt viśiṣṭavidhipi na saṃbhavati |

tāni ca viśeṣaṇāni viśiṣṭavidhivakye eva padapratipāditāni, kintu vidhi- pratipāditā viśiṣṭapiyaṇī kartavyatā na viśeṣaṇānāṃ kartavyatāmānāsā paryavasyatīti viśeṣaṇakartavyatāpekṣāṃ sarvasiddhā eva viśeṣaṇavidhayaḥ śrutārthāpatyā kalpyante |
yathā vā dravyadharyeyutpattau vyaktau vyavahāradarśanāt prathamaṃ vyaktyatvamavagamyate |
tatra ākṛtyarthatvaṃ prāganva- gatamapi sattāmātraprayogi paścāt tu ānanvayyami- cārābhyāṃ vyaktyavacchetvāt ākṛtyaivatvaṃ niścīyate, na cetaretarāśrayatvam, tathaihāpi |
phalavākye hi 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyām' iti vacanāt dvayoḥ karaṇatvamupa- jātam |
na ca tat karmasvarūpamapekṣam, teṣāṃ bahutvāt |
nāpi rājasūyavat phalāpekṣam, tathā sati 'rājasūyena' itivat ekavacanatvaprasaṅgāt |
yattu 'supāṃ supo bhavanti' iti bahuvacanatvane ekavacanatvamasmin vākye dvivacanamityuktam, agalyā hi arthasādhutvāsaṃbhavāt prayogasādhutvamātraṃ tathā āśritam |
iha tu vidvadvākya- yugalapāditāsamudāyādityaśravaṇena arthasādhutvasaṃbandhe sati na prayogasādhutvamātramāśrayaṇam |

tathāhi, trayāṇāmāgneyāgnī- ṣomīyopāṃśuyājānāṃ ekapaurṇamāsīkālasaṃbandhāt, tathā trayāṇāmagneye aindra dadhi aindra paya ityeṣāmākāmāvāsyā- kālasaṃbandhāt, trayāṇāṃyāgānāmekaikakālasaṃbandhānāṃ vidva- dvākyayugalena phalavākyāpekṣadvisiddhayarthaṃ samudāyānu- vādaḥ prayojanavaneveti |

nanu paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyānāmavācchinnasamudāyasya darśapūrṇamāsaśabdābhyāmupādānam ? atra pūrṇamāsaśabdena tadvikāraḥ paurṇamāsīśabdo lakṣyate, evaṃ tarhi darśaśabdena viruddhalakṣaṇayaiva adarśanāt candramasaḥ amāvāsyā prati- pādyate |
tadā kimaparāddhaṃ 'supāṃ supo bhavanti' ityanuśāsanatvena ekavacanasthāne dvivacanaṃ bahuvacanasya veti |
samudāyānuvādavākyadvayasya ananyaprayojana- sādhyena vidhinā phalavākyagatadvivacanāntadarśapūrṇamāsapada- mī. ko. 333
prabhṛtisiddhayarthameva adhyāpitatvāt kleśonāpi tadupādānaṃ na doṣāya |
pūrvapakṣe tu naivaṃvidhaṃ kiñcidasti nimittamiti vaiṣamyam |
evaṃ ca ṣaṇṇāmeva phalasaṃbandhena vihitatvāt itareṣāmādhārādīnāṃ phalavatsannidhinyāyena tadaṅgatvameva bhavatīti siddhāntasya prayojanam |
sūtraṃ tu - prakṛte iti prakaraṇam, tena āgneyādi- karmaṃ abhīdhīyate |
tenāyamarthaḥ - - asmin vākyadvaye prakṛtameva karma pratipādyam, na tatpūrvakama- dvayam |

'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' 'tāvanatrāmīpomau ājyasyaiva nau upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' 'upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' 'tābhyā- metamamīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ paurṇamāse prāyacchat' 'aindraṃ dadhyāmāvāsyāyām' 'aindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyām' iti kāla- sayuktāni vākyāni śrūyante |
tathā 'āghārāmāghārayati' 'ājyabhāgau yajati' 'sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati' 'patnīsaṃ- yājān yajati' 'samidhayajurjuhoti' iti akālasaṃyuktāni vākyāni |
tatsannidhau ca 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvānmāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti śrūyate |
kiṃ sarvā- pyetāni sampradhānāni, uta āgneyādīni payo'ntāni pradhānāni, ādhārādīni samidhayajurādīni ārādupa- kārakāṇi aṅgāni iti vicāraḥ |
tathā 'ya evaṃ vidvān' iti vidvadvākyadvayaṃ prakṛtānāṃ karmaṇāmanuvādakam, uta apūrvayoḥ karmaṇorvidhāyakam, itare ca guṇavidhayaḥ iti vicāraḥ |
tatra siddhāntāha - 'paurṇamāsyām' iti amā- vāsyāyā api upalakṣaṇam |
paurṇamāsīśabdeghaṭe amā- vāsyāśabdaghaṭite ca vidvadvākye prakaraṇasthameva āgne- yādikarmājātaṃ anucyate, na tu apūrvaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate |
rūpāvacanāt rūpasya yāgasvarūpasya dravyadevatāsya avacanāt anirūpaṇāt avijñānāt |
anuvādapade tu saṃnihitā āgneyādayo yāgāḥ paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāsaṃyuktāḥ iti
tasmāt samudāyaśabdādevāgneyādiyāga- tadarthatvāt guṇārthatvāt tasyatasya guṇasya vidheye punaḥpunaḥ samudāyau paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyādyāvau bodhyataḥ |
tasmāt samudāyau darśapūrṇamāsaśabdābhyāṃ abhidhīyete, phalasaṃbandhaśca āgneyādivākye na guṇavidhiḥ |
saṃśriyante āgneyaṃ prathamam, aindre (dadhipayasī) uttare' āgneyādīnāṃ ādhārādīnāṃ ca samprādhānyābhāve iti trayāṇāṃ umatvāparaparyāyaprādhānyavyapadeśo'pi tadvat siddhānte

vikṛtisaṃnidhipaṭhitopamānāṃ tu svasaṃnidhipaṭhitatvaviśiṣṭa- vikṛtibhāvanākathambhāvākāṅkṣāprakaraṇasattve'pi na tat aṅgatvam, upahomebhyaḥ kalpopakārakatvena pūrvānvitaiḥ prākṛtāhaiḥ kathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāḥ śāntatvena upahoma- viniyogodbhāvyatvahitapūrva niruktaprakaraṇābhāvāt |
apitu saṃnidhipuruṣānavadhāt vikṛtyākāṅkṣāmutpādya tata evā- ṅgatvam |
na ca evamutpādyākāṅkṣāyāṃ prakaraṇalakṣaṇāti- vyāptiḥ, tasyā api sthānakalpaprakaraṇatvena lakṣyatvāt |
upahomeṣu prākaraṇikāṅgatvavyavahārāpattistu liṅgavini- yojanamantreṣu śrautāṅgatvāpattitvat klaptaniruktakathambhāvā- kāṅkṣāyā eva tadvyavahāraniyāmakatvena nirākāryā iti bodhyam |
navyāstu avagataphalatvadhvaṃsanihitavākyapramitapadārtha- vṛtti yat pūrvapramāṇānavagatājñātaviṣaye itikartavyatā- svaprakārakāpekṣam, tat prakaraṇam |
asti ca darśapūrṇa- māsādau prayājādiviṣaye tat |
samidhāgasya prakaraṇatā tanūnapādāṅgatvavāraṇāya avagataphalasaṃbandheti padārtha- viśeṣaṇam |
aṅgasya pūrvapramāṇānavagatājñātatvetikartavyatāyāśca na prokṣa- ṇādīnāṃ śrutiliṅgābhyaḥ avagatamahīlādyabhāvānāṃ prakara- ṇāt daśādhyāye'pyāhaḥ |

'vāmadevayaṃ gāyati' ityādi pramāṇāntareṇa anavagatājñātasāmaviṣaye avagataphalasaṃba- ndhasya stotrasya svasādhanībhūtaṛgakṣaramivyathya apekṣā- sattvāt prakaraṇe aṅgatvasattve'pi tadādyarthatva itikarta- vyatātvena iti viśeṣaṇam |
tasya ṛgakṣarābhivyaktyartha sāmāpekṣāyāmapi siddhasāmāpekṣāyāṃ itikartavyatātvaprakāraka- svābhāvāt ityāhuḥ |

atra samidhāgadau tanūnapā- dāṅgatvasya, prokṣaṇādīnāṃ prakaraṇatā darśapūrṇamāsādyaṅgatva- ca ukkarītyā vāraṇasaṃbhavāt avagataphalasaṃbandheti, pūrva- pramāṇānavagatājñātatveti ca viśeṣaṇa sūtrasyāsaṃyuktatvarūpa- viśeṣaṇavat viniyogaprayojakaprakaraṇaśarīre prakaraṇavini- yojyaviṣayaviśeṣodhanārthameva |
astu vā tanūnapādādau śarīre avagatasaṃbandhatveti viśeṣaṇam |
darśapūrṇamāsādau prokṣa- ṇādiprakaraṇatvavyavahārāya tu sarvānubhavasiddhatvāt taddāraka- viśeṣaṇopādānaṃ tu anucitameva |

astu vā godohanādau prayājādiprakaraṇatvavyavahārābhāvāt pūrvapramāṇānavagatājñāta- keti svapūrvapravṛttapramāṇānavagatājñātatvakatham, na tu prakaraṇapūrvaudiṣṭaśrutiliṅgākhyānavatajñātāketyarthakam, darśapūrṇamāsādī prokṣaṇādiprakaraṇatvavyavahārānāpatteḥ |
go- dohanabhāvanākathambhāvākāṅkṣātaḥ pūrvapravṛttadarśapūrṇamāsa- bhāvanākathambhāvākāṅkṣāsvarūpaprakaraṇena prayājādīnāṃ aṅgatā- 'vagamācca na godohanādiṣu tatprakaraṇatvavyavahāraḥ |
tanūnapādādiṣu samidādivini- yojakaprakaraṇasattve'pi samidādīnāmamurītyā tadaṅgatvasya vārayituṃ śakyatvāt iti tattvam |
vaiśiṣṭyaṃ ca svāśrayabhāvanāsaṃnihitabhāvanā- śritatvasaṃbandhena, na tu ekapṛṣṭhāvagatatvādinā |
uktasaṃbandhena (prakaraṇotsaṃvandhena) yadīphalākāṅkṣāviśiṣṭā nirṇīta- (anirṇīta-) tadanaṅgatvagatā (tvagatā) yā katha- mbhāvākāṅkṣā, sā tadviniyojaka- (kaṃ) prakaraṇaṃ iti (tu) niṣkarṣaḥ |
atra pañcamyāḥ (pañcabhya- ntayoḥ) sāmānādhikaraṇyāt kathambhāvākāṅkṣaiva prakaraṇa- mityavasīyate |
asaṃyuktapadaṃ ca phalākāṅgatvasthāpakam, na tu saṃnipātinivāraṇam (na tu saṃnipātinivāraṇārtham) " ityāhuḥ : [bhāṭṭālaṅkāraḥ] |

tathāhi, viniyogaphalamedhāpakaraṇasya vā idaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tattvarūpa- yogyatva vā nādyaḥ ? svāśrayabhāvanāsaṃnihitabhāvanā- ''śritatvasaṃbandhena prayājādibhāvanayīphalakāṅkṣāviśi- ṣṭāyāṃ śrutabhāvyatvena nirṇītapāyājanatvaprakṣaṇādi- bhāvanāgatakathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ prayājaviniyogarūpaphalanupa- dhāyakāyāṃ ativyāpteḥ; pradhānakathambhāvākāṅkṣāsvarūpaprakaraṇena phalavattve avagataṃ tanūnapāyāgīyakathambhāvākāṅkṣodayāt nirṇītānaṅgatvakatanūnapādāgatayāṃ tasyāṃ uktasaṃbandhena
su. pṛ. 111. prakaraṇa pramāṇā- karaṇyasaṃbandhena atītadhūmaparāmarśavaiśiṣṭyasya uktasaṃbandhena |
bādhitvā vākyena (agnyādheyaprakaraṇe samāmnātāni kathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ sattve bādhakābhāvāt |
3|1|21|22. prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā vākyena dvādaśopa- vahitottaratvasaṃbandhasyāpi niveśavat atra samānakālīna- |
mahāprakaraṇaṃ pradhānasya vyartham, aṅkathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāḥ uktasaṃbandhena atīta- |
3|12. prakaraṇaṃ yatra prākṛtājñānavādena vidhiḥ kathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāḥ pradhānaviniyogarūpayogyaprakaraṇatve- |
saṃdaṃśo vā tatraiva vikṛtau viniyojakam, anyatra tu 'pi pradhānaphalākāṅkṣāsvarūpasahakārivirahāt tanūnapāga- |
bāla. pṛ. 119. prakaraṇaṃ yugapat sarvāṅga- kathambhāvākāṅkṣāḥ samidhāgaviniyogaprakaraṇatve'pi |
bhāṭṭa. 10|7|9 pṛ. 823. prakaraṇa vākyena samidhāgaphalākāṅkṣāsahakārivirahādeva aṅgatvaprasaṅga- |
paśurgrabhīpomīyo vākyena, śaknuhite tadanaṅgatvaniveśasya ca vyarthatvāt ! tadubhayaniveśe- |
vākyaṃ tu sahakāritvakalpanāyāḥ āvaśyakatātvāt iti dik |
liṅgaśrutī dve eva kalpayitvā viniyojakaṃ iti śrīmo- etasya ca prakaraṇasya ākāṅkṣātvena svataḥ |
prakaraṇaṃ śrutasya dravyasya bādhane nāhi samartham |
prakaraṇaṃ saṃnihitasya phalavataḥ avagatajñātākapadārtha- bhāṣikapadānāpi svārthopasthititdārā tanniṣṭhāśrutapadāntara- |
brāhmaṇājñātānāṃ prayājādīnāṃ samākhyāprāptamapi kevalaiṣa- 'samidho yajati, itthaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti |
yāgāttvaṃ dūrīkṛtya prakaraṇena sāṃnāyyāpāṃyājādyarthatvamapi ata eva darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇamātena 'saṃsthāpya paurṇamāsīṃ |
videvanadayo dharmāṃ abhiṣecanīyasaṃnidhau paṭhitā api nāmiṣecanīyasyāṅgaṃ kintu prakaraṇāt rājasūyāṅgam |
ka ṇikā, pṛ. 316. nanu prakaraṇaṃ vākyasya śrutervā na bādhakam |
tasmin ānarthakyenāviśakte prakaraṇavatā prayogavacanena aparipantha prokṣaṇādi vidhāyiṣyate |
bhā. 9|1|9|12. nahi utpattivākye asati karmaṇāṃ prakaraṇam, phalasaṃcandhottara- kālatvena kathambhāvātmakasya prakaraṇasya prayogavākyādhīna- prasṛtatvāt |
vā. 2|1|5|15 pṛ. 499. pratyakṣa- śrutivihitā anyanyāya: (vaiśvadevaparva- gatānām ), viśvedevā vākyena, prakaraṇāt tainaiva āmeyā- neti gamyate |
( prakaraṇāt idaṃ kalpanīyaṃ tenaiva āmeyā- dinā yāgena vaiśvadevena yajeta nānyeneti |
vā. ) na cāyaṃ viṣamaśiṣṭo vikalpo bhavitumarhati |
nahi prakaraṇaṃ śrutasya dravyasya bādhane samartham |
prakaraṇasya śrutiliṅgavākyaiḥ saha virodhāvirodhau saṃpra- dhāryate (3|3|8 ityataḥ 3|6|6 ityantam) |
vā. 3|3|8|15 pṛ. 862. prakaraṇayorvirodhe ( śeṣa- tvetve) abhikramaṇādeḥ mahāprakaraṇāt darśapūrṇamāsāṅgatva- prasaktau prayājāṅgatvaṃ avāntaraprakaraṇāt |
śeṣatvatve tu yatrānekasamudāye mahāprakaraṇāt ekadharmāptiḥ avāntara- prakaraṇāt tadviruddhadharmāṇāṃ tādṛśasthalam |
kau. 3|3| 7|14 pṛ. 363. prakaraṇayorvirodhe avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ mahāprakaraṇāt balīyaḥ |
tatra hi pratyāsatteḥ ananubhūte mahāprakaraṇasaṃsarge pūrvataraṃ vākyasthānīyaḥ saṃbandho'vakalpate |
3| 6|7|18 pṛ. 1043. prakaraṇe arthatve sañjāte na nirākāṅkṣāṇāṃ ākāṅkṣā śakyā upādāyitum |

bhā. 3|3|7|14 pṛ. 853. 'prakaraṇe ca saṃbhavaprakaraṇau na kalpyate vidhānārthakyaṃ hi tat' iti oṣṭhyamarādhi- karaṇasthe sūtre bhāṣyakṛtā 'yo vidagdhaḥ sa nairṛtaḥ' iti darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇādhītaṃ vākyamudāhṛtya viṣaye yatra nairṛtaḥ tatra vidagdhatā nīyate, tatra sati prakaraṇaṃ vācyeta iti kriyāvidhinirastaḥ |
iti kriyāvidhirūpo- 'yamarthavādaḥ 'yo vidagdhaḥ sa nairṛtaḥ' ityādi |
bāla. pṛ. 55. prakaraṇe hi svārthaparipūrṇānāṅgākhyānāṃ upakāropakārakatvākāṅkṣāmānaṃ dṛśyate |
yathā kā nāmeyaṃ nadī, ko nāmāyaṃ parvataḥ, kimidaṃ phalamiti |
yadasaṃyuktaṃ śrutyā liṅgena vākyena vā, tat prakaraṇāt, itikartavyatā'sthitatvāt |
yadidatikartavyatā''kāṅkṣinaḥ saṃnidhau pūrṇasamarthamupa- nipatati yat vacanaṃ tat praktena sahaikāvaśyatā yāti |
darśapūrṇamāsau prakṛtya śrūyate - 'samidho yajati', 'tanūnapātaṃ yajati', 'iḍo yajati', 'barhi- ryajati' 'svāhākāraṃ yajati' |
tāni tatraiva prakaraṇa- sāmarthyāt viniyujyante, nāmnihotre jyotiṣṭome vā |
vā - evaṃ tāvat śrutiliṅgavākyāni pradhānajñeya- saṃkīrṇaviviktiviṣayāṇi pratyāhāram (udāharaṇe udā- haraṇe) vyākhyātāni |

tatra vidhiviniyogābhidhānā- tmikāyāḥ śruteḥ (vidyārthī viniyoktṛī abhidhātrī iti nirūpāyāḥ śruteḥ), viniyogasāmarthyamasya ca liṅgasya, kevaladaprayogabhāvāt padāntarasaṃnidheḥ avaśyaṃ bhāvita- tvāt vākyaṃ antargataprāyameva iti na sākṣāt grahaṇena sūtritam |
athavā 'vedo vā prāyadarśanāt' iti upakramopasaṃhārasarvathaiva vedadharmāvadhāraṇāt ida- meva vākyaviniyogasūtraṃ iti pūrvāntargatamātreṇa vākyasya viniyojakatvaṃ vyākhyāsyam |
yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa 'aruṇayā' ityādihyattu, śakyaṃ tatrāpi aindrīvat tṛtīyāśrutireva viniyojakatve vaktum |
atha kriyāmātra- sa saṃśraye śrutā viśeṣasaṃbandho vākyena ityabhiprāyaḥ |
tatrāpi hi aindrayā iti upa- sthātavyamātrāpekṣatvāt 'gārhapatyam' iti ca sādhana- mātrāpekṣatvāt viśeṣasaṃbandho vākyenaiva |
tasmāt ubha- yatrāpi tadantargataḥ śakyā darśayitum, iti ubhayoḥ śrutivākyayoḥ |
idānīṃ balābalacintā pratyāsannā, iti uttaratrāyapi trīṇi pramāṇāni svarūpeṇa viniyogasāmarthyena ca darśayati |
tatra prakaraṇaṃ viniyogā- śānasaṃśayaviṣayasāmānyatamena upanyasyati sma |
katham ? ityetatsāmarthyākāṅkṣāyāṃ avicchinnāyāṃ aśrutaprayojanāni karmāṇi pacyante 'samidho yajati' 'tanūnapātaṃ yajati' ityevamādīni |
na ca darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ siddhamupakāraṃ svapadasvavākyasvaprakaraṇāntareṣu pratya- kṣādipañcakena (pratyakṣānumānopamānaśabdalulabdhaiḥ) |
tathā prayājādīnāṃ avaśyaṃ cobhayenāpi kutaścit bhavitavyam |
yadi tu kena citprakāreṇa nāvagamiṣyāmaḥ, tato nāstītyavagamiśyāmaḥ |
yathāyathā hi saṃnikṛṣṭaṃ na labhyate, tathā tathā viprakṛṣṭe vedaśaktiḥ saṃcarati |
tadiha upakārakatvalakṣaṇapramāṇaṃ saṃnikṛṣṭamalabdhavā viprakṛṣṭamapi anujñāt ityubhāyākāṅkṣāvaśenaiva vijñāyate 'yaṃ darśapūrṇamāso upakārakāṅkṣataḥ, sa nūnamebhiḥ prayā- jādibhiḥ kriyate |
yaccānyat kalpyate, tasyānyena saha saṃvandha nirākāṅkṣībhūtasya neha saṃvandhākāṅkṣā vidyate |
ubhayākāṅkṣā lakṣaṇasaṃbandhābhāve hi anyatarākāṅkṣalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandho gṛhyate, na saṃbhave |
asaṃyuktagrahaṇaṃ kimartham ? śrutiliṅgavākyaiḥ saṃyuktānāṃ dvitvavahutvayuktapratipāditapañcādiṣvadattve'pi prakaraṇā- viniyoganivṛttyartham |
avirodhisaṃyuktānāṃ 'vrīhīn prokṣati' 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' 'aruṇayā krīṇāti' ityeva- mādīnāṃ prakaraṇaśrutīhiḥkrayaiḥ saṃvadhyamānānāṃ prakaraṇa- mī. kau. 334
śā-- (nanu 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti vākyasya 'svargakāmasya yāgaviṣayakaṃ kāryam' ityarthaḥ |
tataśca yāgaviṣayaiva kṛtiḥ śabdārthaḥ; na tu yāgakaraṇikā svargakṛtiḥ |
ataḥ uktaruītyā ākāṅkṣopapādānamayuktam, iti prābhākarānusāreṇa āśaṅkya nirasyati-) nanu 'yajeta' iti yāgaviṣayaiva kṛtiḥ śabdenocyate |
svargo hyatra sādhyatayā saṃbadhyate, na yāgaḥ |
nahi evaṃ saṃbhavati svargaṃ kuryāta yāgamiti |
atha yāgaviṣayayā kṛtyā svargaṃ kuryāditi, syādevaṃ yadi pratyayena kṛtitvamupapadyeta syāt |
atha viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viṣayatvam, satyaṃ viśeṣaṇatvameva yāgaḥ; 'kena saṃcyaneti nirūpayāmaḥ |
na tāvat nīlotpaladivat tādṛśyena, yāgabhāvanayo- bhedāt |
ataḥ kārakatvena somādivat yāgasya kriyā- viśeṣaṇatvam |
tena yāgakaraṇikā svargakṛtireva śabdārthaḥ; na tu yāgānuṣṭhānam |
evaṃ ca nāmnā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ saṃbhavati, nānyathā |
tatra tadākāṅkṣā'nuvṛttau 'samidho yajati' iti vacanāt evaṃ jñāyate 'ayamasau vyāpāraḥ, yena yāgāt svargo bhavati' iti |
saṃbhavati ca samidādibhiḥ yāgaviṣayatvamadṛ- dvāram, avaghātādīnāṃ tu dṛṣṭadvāram |
anuṣṭhitaśca yāgaḥ asattvācca phalaṃ sādhayituṃ kṣamaḥ; ityarthāt yāgānuṣṭhānaṃ gamyate, na śabdāt |
kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa (vyāpāreṇa) yāgāt svargo bhavatīti, tatrāha 'samidho yajati, vrīhīnavahanti' ityādi |
tadamartho bhavati, samidādibhiḥ adṛṣṭadvāram, avaghātādibhiḥ dravyadevatāsaṃskāradvāram, dravyadevatena ca
yena yāgāt svargo bhavati, yāgaḥ phalārambhasābhimukho bhavati |
(prābhākaraḥ-) nanu evaṃ samidādibhiḥ adṛṣṭaṃ kuryāt ityatrāpi kriyāviśeṣaparijñānāt ākāṅkṣā syāt |
(tatrāha-) bhavanmate vā pitṛyajñasya sādhikārasya kimiti saumikadharmātideśo na bhavati ? vācanikakālatvātprasaṅgāt iti cet, ihāpi samānam |

api ca satī apyākāṅkṣā (nivartate ityuttareṇānvayo'sya), vācanikena jauhavādyādidravya- tatsaṃskāraiśca, mānnavarṇikyā ca devatayā, vedivirhavya- dharmādibhiḥ tatsaṃskāraiśca aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇeḥ ; 'abhi- gha
tatra saṃdihyate agnihotre niyatayośca darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ māso vidhīyate kālaḥ, atha niyatāt agnihotrāt nityābhyāṃ ca darśa- pūrṇamāsābhyāṃ karmāntaraṃ iti |
pañcasu bhedapramāṇeṣu parya- vasiteṣu idānīmavasaraprāptaḥ prakaraṇāntaraniścayaḥ karma- bhedaḥ pratipādyate |
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ - pūrvapakṣeṇa :- agni- hotradarśapūrṇamāsābhroḥ prasiddhatvāt samabhivyāhṛtasya juhoteryajateśca tadarthatve secanavat prakaraṇāntare śrutatvena arthāntaraviṣayatvam |
tena yatra lokaprasiddhā- rthasya pratyabhijñāyamānasya vede nārthāntaratvam, tatra vede eva prakaraṇāntaramātreṇa arthāntaramiti |
kuta etat ? taduktam ' agnihotrādiśabdena pūrvaṃ karmabodhitam |
ataḥ pūrvasminneva karmaṇi juhoti- yajatipāmanudite vākyena prakaraṇaṃ bādhilā māsākhyo guṇo vidhīyate |
na ca yāvajjīvaśrutivirodhāt māsa- rūpaḥ kālo vidhātuṃ na śakyate iti vācyam |
athavā yāvajjīvā- dhikāre'pi samarthasamarthaviṣayatā'pi vyavasthitavikalpe- naiva upapatteḥ |
atraike siddhāntamevamupavarṇayanti ' upasadbhicaritvā māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' iti vākyamidam |
atra upasa- duttarakatvaṃ kartṛbahutvaṃ māsaśrutyaneke guṇāḥ śrūyante |
na ca prāpte karmaṇi anekaguṇavidhānaṃ saṃbhavatīti anekaguṇaviśiṣṭakarmāntara- vidhānamevaitat |
na caivaṃ sati guṇādeva bhedaḥ, na prakara- ṇāntarāditi vācyam |
yadatra nāmno buddhisaṃnidhāpakatvam, tat pratipakṣabhūtanānekaṣṭe- nirastam |
niraste ca tasmin pratipakṣabhūta prakaraṇāntara- meva bhedakamiti |
na ca ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyām ' ityatra anekaguṇabhāvāt nāyaṃ siddhāntastthāpīti vācyam |
tena ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyām ' ityatrāpi anuṣaṅgeṇa upasadanyatvādivadeva māsamupa- sadbhicaritvā'gnihotraṃ juhoti, māsamupasadbhicaritvā darśa- pūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta iti |
na ca vācyaṃ evaṃ sati guṇadapi bhedasiddheḥ kiṃ prakaraṇāntareṇeti |
asti cānekaguṇaśrutāve- 'pi ' phalaṃ cākarmasaṃnidhau ' ityatra aprakṛtatvamātreṇa karma- bhedadarśanam |
tadetadākṣipyatam, evaṃ sati guṇasyaiva bhedatvā- patteḥ |
tathāhi ' āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavati ' ityādiṣu prāpte karmaṇi anekaguṇavidhānasyaiva karmabhedakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam, na tu buddhicchedakatvam |
tadatra pratīyamānādṛṣṭasāmarthyapari- tyāgena dṛṣṭasāmarthyakalpanā buddhicchede'gnihotrāpekṣāmaneka- guṇavidhānaṃ vyavasthāpyāmānaṃ anāśrayatāmeva manasi paraṃ śobhate |
kiñca yatra prakaraṇasaṃnihite'pi karmaṇi aneka- guṇavidhānasya bhedakatvam |
tatra jaghanyanāmadheyamātropanīte karmaṇi guṇasya buddhicchedamātrahetutvaṃ na karmabhedakamiti hāsyāspadameva |
kiñca kathaṃ ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ' ityatra anuṣaṅgeṇopasattvaṃ - ākāṅkṣayā abhāvāt |
na copasatśiṣyapaurṇamāsyāmāsyakālanirā- kāṅkṣe karmaṇi māsālpyakālasaṃbandhāt māsapadākāṅkṣayā saṃbandhaḥ |
nanu māsādittiādītyāyakālakāṅkṣānivartakatvena ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ' ityanyopapatteḥ anuṣaṅgābhāvena anekaguṇavidhānābhāvāt nodāharaṇatvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsāvākyasyeti |
na ca praveśāsaṃbhavo'pi, kriyā- dvayayogāt, kyāśrutyā upasaddinayogāt, juhotinā ca māsavidhānāditi |

kiñca bhāṣyakāraśrutamapi ekaguṇaphala- manādṛtya ' māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' ityetāvanamātramudāhṛta- tvāt, tadapi nākalitaṃ bhāṣyaṃ nidrājñateti yatkiñcideta- diti yathātārkikameva siddhānto'bhidhīyate |
sarvatra dvividhaḥ laghu karmaṇaḥ saṃbandhī guṇo bhavati upādeyo'nupādeyaśca |
siddhayacchadogradoṣeyadharmatantratayā vidhiyogyatvāt dūrasthakarmānuvādenāpi yatra karma tatrāyaṃ kartavyaḥ ityeṣā vacanavyaktiḥ |
anupādeyasya svatantrasya yathāsiddhasya itara- saṃbandhārthaṃ yacchabdenopādenāt uddeśyatvam |
tenaivā vacana- vyaktiḥ yatra, tatra karma kartavyamiti |

' sa cāyamanupādeyaṃ prati karmavidhiḥ deśakāle prati prayojyatvena tayoḥ prayogācchedakatvāt prayogavacchedakatvenaiva, yathā saṃkāyai vrīhyādau avaghātādi viniyujyate, yathā vā svarge darśapūrṇamāsādi, tatrośrukkī- dhitatvena karmaṇa eva tatra viniyuktāt |
nimittasya tu vidhimātrāttvanino ! niyojaviśeṣaṇatāmātram, na tu karmaṇa- satra viniyogaḥ; kāryatvena anāśrayaṇāt, kintu tasmin sati kartavyamityetāvanmātram |
tena yatraiva tatra karmeti sagamapi nādhikaraṇāparā, kintu upādeyānuṣṭhānasyānupādeya- tantratāparaiva, phalanimittayorvibhimārāt |

tadetayoḥ prayoga- viniyogayoḥ karmetyapekṣāyāṃ yadi tathābhūtasyaiva utpattiḥ prayogaviniyoge'pekṣā, tadaivaktavyā mahāprakaraṇe saṃnihitā samasta, tadā tadevotpannaṃ karma prayujyate vini- yujyate cetyakarmāntaratvam |
yathā ' same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta, paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta ' ityevamādi |
yadā tu yathābhūtautpattiḥ saṃnihitā nāsti, tadā tasyaivotpa- ratvāt karmāntaratvam |
na ceha kuṇḍapāyināmayane tādṛśahomayāgotpattiḥ saṃnihitā samasti, iti karmāntaratva- meveti |
na ca vācyaṃ atrāpyagni- hotrādināmevotpannatvena karmāntaratvamiti |
yato juhotītyatra asattvabhūtaḥ pūrvāparībhāvo dhātvarthaḥ pratīyate |
na ca nāmasamabhivyāhṛtasya ākhyātasya guṇa- bhūtanāmapāratantryabhāvaḥ, anupādeyakālānurodhena prakṛtānu- pasthāpakatvāditi |
kiñca, nahi ekaprasaryeṇāmākhyātāyoḥ ekenopasthāpanāt apareṇa prayogaviniyogayoryatara- vidhānamiti prayojanabhedaḥ saṃbhavati, kintvekakāryatvameva |
tatrāpi hi ākhyātasya vākyārthībhūtabhāvanā'bhidhānena prādhānyāt nāmnāstatparatantratvameva |
tadatra vidhyākhyāta- samabhivyāhṛtasya nāmno yathāvidhyaiva arthātāvadavaśyaṃ varṇa- nīyaḥ |
na ca tasyaiva sakṛccaritasya utpatyarthatvamapīti utpatticidhi- kalpanāyā karmāntaram |
' paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta ' ityādau punarapatteḥ prakaraṇapratibhijñānāt nāmapadasya prayogaikyaparatvena ubhayaparatvābhāvācca doṣa iti |
yatra tu prakaraṇāntare'pi ' atirātrayajñavidyaḥ ', prāṇīya- mahaḥ, catvāro'bhipravāḥ, ṣaḍahāḥ ' iyāyabhidhāya ' ṛddhi- kāmāḥ satramāsīran ' iti śrūyate, tatra atirātraśabdadānāṃ pūrvakarmaparatvam |
atra sarvatra sarvasya viniyojaka- khyātakatvātpañcasya pūrvopasthitakarmaṇo viniyojakatva- mityupasthāpakaviniyojakaśabdabhedāt karmāntaratvam |
yadi tu tatrāpi anuṣaṅgabhūtayajatidhātvarthaḥ śrūyeta, tadā asa- ttvabhūtatvāt tasyātirātrādināmabhiḥ pratyabhijñānāmāvā- ttatrāpi syādeva karmāntaram |
tatra āsīran upeyuḥ ityatra anuṣṭhiturūpyagamyamānakarmāntaram, tathāpi tu bhāvanā- pasthāpakatvāt prakaraṇāntareṇa bhāvanā bhinnaiva |
sā ca nāmopasthāpitapūrvakarmaiva viśeṣitā phalasaṃba- ndhiniti nirṇīyate |
' sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau ', ' sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ ' ityatra anāramyādhītatve'pi anupādeya prati upādeya'pi na karmāntaram |
evaṃ hi śrūyate - ' ekasme vā anyā iṣṭayaḥ kāmyāyāhiyante, sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau, ekasmai vā anye yajñakratavaḥ kāmyāyāhiyante sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ ' iti |
atra ca anyaśabdārthasyaiva pūrvāvagataprati- yogyantaranirūpaṇīyatvāt bhāviviniyogadarśanena darśapūrṇa- māsajyotiṣṭomāpekṣa evāyanyamapyada iti ninrīyate |
na hi anyo brāhmaṇa ityukte pratiyogī śuddhaḥ prakāśate |
tadatrāpi anyā iṣyaḥ anye yajñakratava iti pūrvāvagatopādānāt, pūrvāvagatapratiyogi- nirūpaṇīya evāyamanyapadārthaḥ |

tena anyaśabdabalenaiva darśapūrṇamāsajyotiraṣṭomayostathaivopasthitatvāt ' sarvebhyo darśa- pūrṇamāsau', 'sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ' ityetayoḥ tattatkratu- phalaviniyogaparatve'pi upanyantarakṣepaparatvābhāvāt na karmāntara- tvamiti |
'ya iṣṭyā paśunā somenārādhanena vā yajeta, so'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā' ityatrāpi yacchabdopadhayajinaiva pūrvotpannatvasthāpanādeva karmāntara-tvam |
'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvā somena yajeta' ityatra tu svayameva vārtikakārapādaiḥ jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe śrūyate ityabhidhānāt prakaraṇāntareṇa medo nādāhanīyaḥ (?) |
evaṃkṛte nākhyātakālīnapūrvakarmāvagatiḥ kuta''pi nāma- dheyaṃ bādhitamutsate |
agnihotrā- dināmadheyaṃ tu nāmnā taddharmitādṛśaṃ bhāvinuyoga- nirīkṣaṇena gauṇamevādhyayanacihninā svīkṛtamiti na kiñcidanupapannamiti |
prayojanam- pūrvapakṣe prakṛtibhūtasyaiva agnihotrasya prakṛtayośca darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ māsamanuṣṭhānam |

nanu aviparivartamānakratvantaroddeśena na kāle vidhātuṃ śakyate 'prakaraṇāntare prayojanānyatvam' iti nyāyāt satyam, iha tu 'eṣa vāva prathamo yaśo yajñānām' iti yajñaśabdena viparivartamānā yathāḥ agni- ṣṭomottarakāle vidhīyate ityadoṣaḥ |
yadi gṛhamedhīye darśapūrṇamāsiko vidhyanto na syāt tathā sati 'prakaraṇāntare' ityanena nyāyena karmāntaraṃ syāt |
prakaraṇāntare śrūyamāṇaṃ vākyaṃ yasya prakaraṇe, tasya vācakaṃ bhavitumarhati |
2|3|11|24 pṛ. 616) iti vārtikoktarītyā bhāvanābhedotpā- danamiti pāṭhaḥ |

yajeta iti pratyayābhihitatvārtha- bhāvanoddeśena vividhiśrāvayavatvādviśabdārthaviśiṣṭakāla- vidheḥ prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇe vyutpāditatvena ('ya iṣṭyā paśunā somena vā yajeta so'māvāsyāyām' iti iṣṭyādipadānāmanuvādatvāt |
varuṇapraghāseṣu avabhathaḥ saumikā- davabhūtāt karmāntaram, tṛpāśe arthakarma, niṣkāśāśe ca pratipattiḥ, ityuktaṃ kaustubhe prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇe |
aṣṭraprathamāhe viśvajiti prakaraṇāntarādhi- karaṇopanyāyena karmāntare nāmātideśena ekādaśakāṇḍa- paṭhitaviśvajito dharmaḥ sarvastaṃ dakṣiṇa |
prakaraṇāntarā- dhikaraṇe (2|3|11|24) pañcavidhaṃ anupādeyamuktaṃ deśaḥ, kālaḥ, phalam, nimittam, saṃskāraśceti |
'anu- pādeyasaṃnidhiścāsya asaṃnidhiḥ prakaraṇāntaram' iti prakaraṇāntaralakṣaṇamuktaṃ sarvagrantheṣu |
tatra hi prakaraṇāntareṇa bheda ukto vārtike prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇe |
śāstradīpikāyāmapi saptame 'tathā'vabhṛthaḥ somāt' ityādhikaraṇe (7|3|4|13-16) uktaṃ 'yanti' ityanena prakaraṇāntarāyena karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti |
atra bhaṭṭasomeśvaraḥ samādadhe- 'asyevoktalakṣaṇaṃ tatra vāruṇīniṣkāsena tṛpāṇāṃ ca bhūtopayogitvena

taduktaṃ tena ' tṛtī- yayā tupaniṣkāsasya (tupaśabdo nāsti su.) sādhanatva- kāvapi niṣkāsasya vāruṇyāmiṣādoṣatvāt (vāruṇyāmiṣā- yāgopayuktatve'pyaśeṣatvāt iti su.) tupāṇāṃ ca ameyā- diyāgaśeṣatvāt (āgneyāyāgadravyatvāt iti su.) ' yat kiñcit somaliptaṃ syāt (syācchabdo nāsti su.) tenādhvaryū yanti' itivat ' prayājaśeṣeṇa havīṃṣyabhi- ghārayati' itivat ' pratipādyatvarūpasaṃskāratyāvirodhaḥ ' iti (su. pṛ. 954) |
ekādaśe hi (11|2|15|63-65) asminneva vākye savanīyayattra pracāraviprakarṣa pūrvapakṣaṃ vidhāvantareṇa nirasya, pratipattiḥ |
iti pūrvapakṣāntaraṃ tupaniṣkāsasyasaṃskārasyo- ddeśāt vākyabhedārtenirāsya arthakarmatvamevoktam |
nātra asaṃnidhiriva svarūpataḥ anupādeyasaṃnidhiḥ pravedayaḥ, kintu tatkāryaṃ vidheḥ upapadyārthasaṃkramāsaṃbhavaḥ |
sa ca yathā anupādeya- saṃnidhinā bhavati, evaṃ upādeyasaṃnidhinā'pi bhavati |
tasmāt ' vigheḥ upapadyārthasaṃkramāsaṃbhavena 'sahakṛtaḥ asaṃsiddhiḥ prakaraṇāntaram ' iti prakaraṇāntara- lakṣaṇamabhipretam |
ata eva ' viśvajitā yajeta ' ityādi yatra upapadārtho vidheyo nāstyeva nāmadheyamātra- śravaṇāt, tatrāpi upapadārthasaṃkramāsaṃbhavasahakṛtāt asaṃnidhereva bhedaḥ ityavadheyam |
ata eva ujjidādau, nāgneya caivamādīnāṃ bhedaḥ, iti saṃnidhāveva nāmnā bheda uktaḥ |

apramatṛtīye ca (adhi. 2) janakasamrātrāprakaraṇānnāte ' catvāri trivṛnti ahani agniṣṭomamuktvā ' iti vākye catuḥsaṃsthā-trivṛttva-rūpānopādeyaguṇa- śravaṇe tupaniṣkāsavākyavat prakaraṇāntarāyeneva medo- 'bhyupagataḥ |

ata eva ca prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇe ' māsa- magnihotraṃ juhoti' ityādau ' anupādeyaguṇe vā ' iti vākye ' upasannidhiśritvā ' iti guṇāntaropādānāt svarūpataḥ sannapi vākyabhedaḥ siddhāntasiddhayanupayogitvāt upādeyaguṇadvayayuktavākyābhiprāyeṇa eva siddhāntahetutayā ukto bhāṣye |
ācāryaśca (pārthasārathibhiḥ) māsādi- vākyeveva tasya siddhāntasiddhayanupayogo dūṣitaḥ, na sārthatrikaḥ iti dhyeyam |
bhāṣyam- kuṇḍapāyināmayane śrūyate ' māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ' ityevanādi |
tatra saṃdihyate kiṃ niyate'gnihotre niyatayośca darśapūrṇa- māsayormāso vidhīyate kālaḥ, atha kiṃ niyatāgnihotrāt niyatābhyāṃ ca darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ karmāntaravidhānamiti |
kathaṃ kālavidhi- sarūpatā ? yat agnihotraṃ juhotīti viditam, māsamiti tyaviditam |
prakaraṇāntare śrūyamāṇaṃ vākyaṃ yasya prakaraṇe tasya vācakaṃ bhavitumarhati |
katham ? upasannidhiśritvā iti iṣṭvā ityuktvā idamabhidhīyate |
tathā guṇavidhānāye asmin vākye anekaguṇavidhānāt vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
asmin pakṣe punaḥ atannamagnihotraśabdaḥ, na karmaṃ viśeṣayati |
vā-gataṃ guṇalakṣaṇabhedaprasaṅgāt kidṛśo guṇaḥ pūrvatrāsaṃbhavan bhinatti kīdṛśo vā tatraiva saṃbhavatīti |
idānīṃ paryavasiteṣu pañcasu bhedakāraṇe prakaraṇāntaralakṣaṇe bhedaḥ pralapyate |
' yathaiva valayaṃ pāṭaliputre vā agnihotrādi- śabda uccāryamāṇo nārthāntaraṃ pratipādayati, evaṃ prakaraṇā- ntare'pi |
na ca prāptavidhānaṃ teṣu na saṃbhavati |
yo vai teṣāṃ kāmyaprayogaḥ, tasya anavagatakālaviśeṣatvāt māsaparimāṇavidhānamiya- doṣaḥ |
athavā dīkṣitatvanimittena pratiṣiddhānāmpi māsaparimataḥ prati- prasavaḥ |
athavā tānyevāgnihotrādīni atra paryupasthāpya somayāgasahitāni satraprayogavacanena phale vidhīyante |
nahi kevalabhojyī devadattaḥ anyaiḥ saha paṅktyāṃ bhuñjānaḥ anyatvaṃ pratipadyate |
na ca phalāntarasaṃbandhaḥ karmāntaratvena vinā na ghaṭate ityuktaṃ athaitadadhikaraṇa (2|3|2) |
pradhānamapi hi aparipūṇaṃ karaṇāṃśe svaśabdena vidhīyamānaṃ na virudhyate |
' yadi hi māsaḥ śuddho vidhīyeta, tataḥ pūrvakamanuvāde buddhibhedapi, na cetadasti |
upasaduttaratvena śravaṇāt vidyamānābhi- rūpasadbhiḥ śakyaḥ kālo lakṣayitum |
na ca naiyamike tāḥ svārthāḥ parārthā vā vidyante |
yadi tu tāḥ taduttarakālaṃ māsaśca vidhīyeran, evaṃ sati anekakāryavighānāt vākya- bhedaḥ syāt |
etasmādeva hetoḥ dīkṣitadānahomapāka- pratiṣedhena pratiṣiddhasya pratiprasavarūpeṇa vā satraikadeśatvena vā ayaṃ vidhiḥ pratyuktaḥ |
yadi vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt karmāntaratvam, evaṃ tarhi sa eva bhedahetuḥ prāpnoti, na prakaraṇāntaram |
athavā guṇādeva anekātmakatvena pūrvatrā- saṃbhavāt bheda iti prakaraṇāntaranavākāśaḥ |
' 'māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajate' ityādiṣu hi kevalamāsasaṃbandha- vidhānānna vākyabhedaḥ prāpnotīti akarmāntaratvaprasaṅgaḥ |
tatraiva hyakṛtā- rthānāmanuṣaṅgo na ceha saḥ |
' 'tatrānuṣaṅgo yuktaḥ, yatra tena vinā na kiñciduktaṃ bhavati |
yathā atraiva 'māsaṃ vaiśvadevena' ityādiṣu yāvat 'yajate' iti nānuṣajyate, tāvat na kiñciduktaṃ ityadhyamanuṣaktavyam |
iha punaḥ darśapūrṇamāsādivākyani tāvat svapadenaiva nirākāṅkṣī- bhūtāni |
tatra na kaścidapi heturāsti, yenā- nuṣajyeta |
tatra tu punaḥ paritvā ityasya vidhānāt yāvadanuṣaṅgaṃ upasadādimanuṣaṅgaṃ prāpnoti |
atha agni- hotrasyaiva purastāt kṛtābhiḥ sarvānuṣaṅgārthasaṃpadān ityu- cyeta, tathā sati śabdoccāraṇamapi evameva avasthita agnihotrādīnāṃ pāṭhakramānurodhena upakariṣyati iti nārthaḥ anuṣaṅgeṇa |
iti evaṃ varṇanīyam 'upādeyo guṇo yatra bhavet prakaraṇāntare |
' iha tāvat naiva prakaraṇāntarasadvāt bhedaḥ avaśyamante |
apari- vartamānahi pūrvakarmaṇi kenāpi prakāreṇa uttarasya bhedaḥ pratīyate |
na tu prakaraṇāntaraṃ sadapi kiñcidupa- karoti |
sarvatra ca vicchinnaprakaraṇasya karmaṇaḥ saṃbandhe dviprakāraṃ śrūyate upādeyamanupādeyaṃ ca |
tatra yadupādeyaṃ yathā āhavanīyapratipadādi, tat pradeśāntarasyedenāpi śakyaṃ vidhātum |
yattu anupādeyaṃ deśakālanimittaphala- saṃskārātmakam, tasya pradeśāntaravasthitasya karma prati vidhaścaureṣā vacanaktirbhavati 'tatraiva karma kartavyam'
paroddeśena ca karma vidhīyamānaṃ yadi anyena tadrūpameva vākyenopasthāpyate, tataḥ tadeva iti akarmā- ntaratvaṃ durbhavati |
atha tu īṣadapi tirodhānāt nopa- tiṣṭheta, tataḥ paraṃ vidhīyamānatvenaiva vihitādanyatvabuddhiḥ sthitā na śakyā abhedetumapi karmāntaratvaṃ bhavati |
tatropadeśati 'abhidheyaṃ padārthaṃ prati mayā etat karma vidhīyate, tacca svarūpeṇa anutpannaṃ na śakyaṃ vidhātuṃ iti balādupasthāpyate |
tat yadi kaścit evaṃvidhaṃ śaknoti utpādayitum, tat utpādayatu, yāvadahamapi atra vidhiṃ karomi, atha notpādayati, tato mayaiva utpādite mā kaścit paścādāgatya mamāparādhaṃ maṃta iti |
ayameva vā pāṭhaḥ syāt ] yadi kaścit tathāvidhamupa- nayati, tataḥ asāvapi tadeva deśādau vidhatte |
atha nopanayati, tataḥ sa evotpādayati iti nirūpyate |
tadiha māsatvāt dūrasthahomānuvādena na śakyate vidhātum |
nahi kaścit homānurodhena atraiva māsaṃ saṃpādayituṃ samarthaḥ |
tena atyantaṃ svatantramanupādeyaṃ māsa- meva prati homādiṣu vidhīyamāneṣu dūrasthaiḥ utpatti- vidhibhiḥ |
na cotpannasya punarutpattiḥ saṃbhavati, iti apūrvavidhānaṃ vijñāyate |
nanu ca agnihotrādipadena uttisahacāriṇā tatkarmopattau apanīyamānāyāṃ māsasaṃbandhamātryāpto'yaṃ vidhiḥ |
' yatra vākyāntaratamapi saṃnidhāna- mātrādeva pratyabhijñāyamānaṃ na midyate, tatra svavākyagatena nāmnā upanīyamānaṃ na pratyabhijñāyate, iti kuta etat ? ucyate |
' saṃnidhānena hi yāgeva deśādāveva karma avagamyate, tāhageva upatiṣṭhate iti na bhidyate |

nāmadheyaṃ punaḥ āditassāvat ākhyātaparatvatvāt naiva medābhedayoḥ vyāpriyate (nāmnaḥ pūrvakamopāpakatvasya pūrvakarmavācitvanimittakatvāt ākhyātasya ca pūrvakarmaviṣayatvaṃ vinā tatparatvasya nāmnaḥ : pūrvakarmavācitvānavadhāraṇāt pūrvakarmopasthāpakatvānupapatteḥ notpattipratibandhakatvamityāśayaḥ |
tasmiṃśca ākhyāta- pravṛttipratīkṣaṇi avasthite 'māsaṃ juhoti' 'māsaṃ yajate' iti gṛhautayajatipadāmātrasaṃgatau ālocyamānāyāṃ anyasya juhotyādeḥ |
' sāmānyavācipadena hi sarvanāmadheyāni dhātvarthānāṃ nāmadheyatvena avasthitāni, na bhāvanāyāḥ |
tena bhāvanā'nyatvānatvapariśeṣavelāyāṃ satyapi dhātva- rthatve bhāvanā tāvat ananyapramāṇatvāt ākhyāta- pratyayāntareṇa anupanīyamānā na kathañcit pratyabhijñāyate ityupapannaṃ prayojanalampam |
na ca tādṛśasyaiva dravyabhūtaliṅga- saṃkhyāyogāyāmidhāyibhiḥ agnihotrādipadaiḥ |
abhīdhāya- mānatvaṃ iti apratyabhijñānāt so'pi bhidyate |

nopā- dāsyate, bhāvanā vā tāvadanukāratvamātnā (asattvabhūta- dhātvarthānuraktātmanā) na vivakṣyate, tatra tadeva karma ekena vacanena paryupasthāpya apareṇa phale vidhīyate ityava- gāmāt kāmakamakarmāntaraṃ bhavatu |
' 'caturāhe'piplāvāḥ ṣaḍahāḥ pṛṣṭyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ' ityādiṣu, yathā ca varuṇapraghāseṣu 'ava- bhṛthaṃ yanti' iti |

yadā tu prakaraṇāntaraphalatvādi- saṃbaṃddhaṃ vidhitvaṃ utpattimi saṃsṛjya yāvat balīyasā utpattividhipariparityāgyā viprakarṣati anivāryamāṇaṃ bhidyate iti niścīyate, tadā evamādiṣvapi bheda evelavagamyate |
paryāyatvena tu 'bhidyate bhāvanāmātraṃ dhātvartho nā- yajiśruteḥ |
bhāṣyakāraḥ - 'upasandhiśśrutvā' iti tallakṣitakālameva anupādeyarūpaṃ bhedahetutvena darśayati iti draṣṭavyam |

'athocyeta upasado'pi vidhīyante' ityādi (bhāṣyaṃ) ca abhyāsādhikaraṇavat ('na ca yat samilaṃsaṃndhena kriyate' iti abhyāsādhikaraṇabhāṣyam (pṛ. 472) samidādipadasya devatā'nabhidhāyitvāt guṇeṣudhupamedābhāve'pi abhyupetavādatvena yathā samarthitaṃ tadvat ityanyaiḥ) |
soma--prayojanaṃ - pūrvapakṣe prasiddhāmihotre yāvajjīvādi kāleḥ māsasya vikalpaḥ, kuṇḍapāyināmayane agnihotrānuṣṭhānaṃ ca |
vidhāyakatvādyogāt na tatpātopāṃśuyānuvādaḥ saṃbhavati ityukte anupādeyantarālakālānyāt prakaraṇāntaranyāye- nāpi karmavidhitvābhidhānam|
su. pṛ. 753. kecittu prakaraṇāntanyāyena ( āgneyadravyasya ) bhedaṃ samarthayante |
tathāhi yadi aniviśamānatvena anupādeyatve'pi guṇasyaiva bhedakatā, tataḥ ' māsammihotraṃ ' ityatrāpi tasyaiva bhedakatvopapatteḥ kṛtaṃ prakaraṇāntareṇa |
ataḥ anupādeyatvā- vacchinnaṃ prati tāvat prakaraṇāntarasyaiva bhedakatā iti svīkartavyam |
na ca evamapi asaṃnidhayatvāt kathaṃ tasya bhedakatā ? bhedodhakatādaśāyāṃ tatpratiyogikarmo- pasthityabhāvaprasasya asaṃnidheḥ māsāgnihotravat ihāpi tulyatvāt ityāhuḥ |
kau. 2|3|13 pṛ. 166. gavāmayanaprakaraṇe ' prāyaṇīyamaharbhavati ' ityatra vini- gamanāvirāheva karmāntaratvam |
bhāṣyakāraprakaraṇa- ntaranyāyena medoktistu aprāptopadeyaguṇābhāvaviśiṣṭā- saṃnidhimātreṇa vyākhyeyā |
2|3|1124 pṛ. 83, doṣādhikāre ' vatsamālabheta ' atra siddhānte dāśapaurṇa- māsikepālabhām ayamālambhaḥ saṃskāryakarpānapādeyaguṇa- yogāt prakaraṇāntarāyena karmāntaramiti sidhyati |
2| 3|6|17. na ca prakaraṇāntarāyena karmāntaratvaśaṅkā ( ' ya etenāniṣṭvā''dhanve yajate ' ityatra ) |
' eṣa vāva ' ityanenārthavādena udbhidādīnāṃ yajñāntarāṇāṃ saṃnihitatvāt |
bhāṭṭa. 5|3|14. na ca siddhānte- 'pi prakaraṇāntarāyena prasiddhaṣaḍapekṣā karmāntaratvāt na ṣaḍahāvṛttiḥ, kintu karmāntareṣviva teṣu ṣaḍahaviṣyanta- mātrasyaivāvṛttiḥ iti vācyam |
nanu athaiṣa jyotiḥ ' ityādau athaśabdānurodhena vakṣyamāṇaparāmarśi- tvasyāpi upapatteḥ asaṃnidhistvena tatsahakṛtaphalarūpānu- pādeyaguṇasya prakaraṇāntarāyena bhedakatvopapattiḥ |
kau. 2|8|8|21 pṛ. 248, prakṛte ( dākṣāyaṇa- yajñavākye ) pūrvabuddhicchidekābhāvāt prakaraṇasya copa- sthāpakasya satvāt na prakaraṇāntarāyena bhedaḥ |
2|3|18 pṛ. 39. phalasya anupādeyatvena karma uddiśya upādātumaśakyatvāt phalārthasya vidhāyakasya phaladeśena karmopādāyaktvāt prakaraṇāntarāyena karma- svarūpaviṣayatvāt |
su. pṛ. 820. yatra vedāntare evaṃ viniyogaḥ vedāntare ca ākhyātāsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vinā vasante jyotiṣṭomaḥ ityevaṃrūpeṇa kāladeśācanayaḥ
tatrāpi prayogavidhitvāt tannibandhana eva svara iti bodhyam |
kau. 3|3|10 pṛ. 326. ' yanti ' ityanena tu ( varuṇapraghāseṣu ) vāruṇyā niṣkā- sena tudhaiścāvabhṛthaṃ yanti ' ) prakaraṇāntarāyena karmā- ntaraṃ vidhīyate |

śā. 7|3|4. savanīyasya saṃnidhau ' āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā upaniṣkramya yūpaṃ parivyayati ' iti śrutena vacanena paśuyajñasādhāraṇayūpapariṣvaṇā- pekṣayā yūpapariṣvāntaraṃ savanīyajñatayā prakaraṇāntarāyena abhyāsādvā yūpadādharyopajakatvaṃ vidhīyate |
bhāṭṭa. 4|4|9. sūtreṇāyapaloḥ utpattiśiṣṭatvābhāvena balīyastvānu- papatteḥ, sāyaṃ ca prātaśca juhoti ityasya anupādeyakāla- saṃśravāt prakaraṇāntarāyena pūrvapakṣe karmavidhitvāvagamaḥ |
su. pṛ. 431. some dīkṣāyāṃ rātrau jāgaraṇam |
dākṣikājagaraṇasya hṛdārthatvena prasaṅgānupapatteḥ tasyāpya- hārthatve'pi prakaraṇāntarāyena vijātīyayoḥ jāgaraṇayoḥ ekāhaṣṭajanakatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 12|1|8. ' hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati ' ityādi prakaraṇāntarāyena svatantra- mevāvadānaṃ hṛdayādyudeśena vidhīyate ( idaṃ pūrvapakṣe ) |
kau. 2|2|16 pṛ. 208. etaya ( udayasānīyā ) punarādheyasaṃmitayā iṣṭyā agnihotraṃ juhoti ' iti vacanaṃ tu prakaraṇāntarāyena somājñatayā udba- sānīyeṣṭyatayaiva vā karmāntaravidhāyakamiti |
bhāṭṭa. 6|1|3. na ca prakaraṇāntarāyāt yajñāntarāṇāmiha kālavidhinaṃ saṃbhavatīti śakyam |
( ' eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānām ' ityatra ) ' yajñānām ' iti śabdena yajñāntarāṇāmapi vipari- vartamānatvena aviparivartamānatvalakṣaṇa-prakaraṇāntarā- bhāvāditi |
nanu prasiddhapṛṣṭhaśabdābhidheyastvidhānemevāstu, kimiti lakṣaṇayā sahasrakarmavidhiriti ityāśaṅkaya prakaraṇāntarāyāt
7|3|14. bṛhaspatisavaḥ vājapeyaprakaraṇe śrutastatra prakaraṇāntarāyāt karmāntarameva vidhīyate |
satyapi upeyasāṃkarye ( abhyāsādhikaraṇa- nyāyasvarūpāt prakaraṇāntarādhikaraṇa- ) nyāyasvarūpasya asāṃkaryam |
abhyāse hi upādeyatāmantrīkṛtya pāri- śeṣyeṇa dhātvarthe vidheyatvāpādanameva vyāpāraḥ |
prakaraṇā- ntarasthale tu na pāriśeṣyeṇa vidheyatvāpādanaṃ vyāpāraḥ |
apitu satyapi vidheyāntare svāpādito- pādeyasāmānādhikaraṇyalābhārthe dhātvarthe'pi vidheyatā- ''pādanam |
jyotiṣṭome udayanīyaḥ na karmāntaram, saṃnidhi- satvena prakaraṇāntarāyābhāvāt |
bhāṭṭa. 11|2|15. prakaraṇāntarāyābhāve'pi anupādeyantyasya akarmavidhitvāpādakatvaṃ darśayitu- māha ... |

yāvajjīvavadasya nimittaparatvāt avacchedakatva- lakṣaṇānāpādeyatvopapatteḥ anupādeyaguṇānvayasya bhedaka- tvābhedakatvasya vicārāt karmaviparyutteḥ prakaraṇāntara- nyāyāyoge'pi anupādeyatvanimittabhedacintā''nantaraṃ buddhisyatvopapatteḥ prakaraṇāntaracintā''pi saṃgatiḥ saṃ- bhavati |
su. pṛ. 969. saṃjñāṃ vinā prakṛtabuddhicchedābhāve prakaraṇāntara- nyāyāviṣayatvāt bhedakatvaṃ na saṃbhavati |
su. pṛ. 820. paryudasanīyatvena upasthitatvāt agnihotrasya prakaraṇā- ntaranyāyāsaṃbhavena karmāntaratvopapatteḥ tasyaiva ava- bhṛthottaraṃ karaṇaprasaktau avadhyantaramādhane lāghavam |
bhāṭṭa. 10|8|7. anupādeyantyasya vidheyasyaiva prakaraṇāntara- nyāyopayogitvena, prakṛte ( vāyavyaṃ śvetam , īśāmāla- meta ityādī ) tadabhāvenābhedakatvam |
anupādeyānāṃ deśādīnāṃ karmasaṃnidhau vidyamānānāṃ karmabhedakatvaṃ nāsti |
bhāṣyam-- asti aveṣṭiḥ ' āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ puroḍāśo bhavati ' ityevamādiḥ |
tāṃ prati saṃndehaḥ kiṃ ' etayā''cāryakāṃ yājayet ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ karmāntarameveṣṭeḥ, uta aveṣṭireveti |
kiṃ prāptam ? karmā- ntaramiti uktana nyāyena |
saṃnidhau phalārthena punaḥśrutiḥ aveṣṭereva, na karmāntaramiti |
etayā ityeṣa śabdo na śaknoti aveṣṭyā vibhaktaṃ yāgamanyaṃ vaktum |
kiṃ prayojanam ? yadi aveṣṭiḥ āgne- yādīni havīṃṣi, atha karmāntaraṃ anyahaviṣko yāga iti |
' same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ' ' paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta ' ' yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ' ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta ' ' śeṣāt sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati ' iti |
sarvatra pūrvādhikaraṇena deśādīni prati vidhīyamānatvāt karmā- ntaratvaṃ prāptam |
āha ca, ' vihitasya vidhirnāstī- tyanuvādaḥ prasajyate |
na ca uddeśyānāṃ uddeśayaiḥ saṃbhavaḥ avaklapate |
deśādyudeśena tu vidhīyamānānāṃ karmaṇāṃ svarūpānuvādakalpane yugapadvidhyanuvādadoṣāt ayuktam |
tatra satyāṃ gatāvekasamatāṃ tad dvayaṃ bhavet |
' avagatyā hi tenaivotpattiḥ tenaiva ca viniyogaḥ kriyate |
satyāṃ tu gatau viniyojakasya utpattividhyārthatvānupapādāt anyenaiva utpāditānāṃ ca viparivartamānānāṃ viniyoga-
nopādānaṃ vidheyatve prāpya- māviśate hi te ||
’ yadyapi deśādīni anupādeya- svabhāvatvāt uddiśyante, tathāpi aprāptatvāt teṣāmeva jñāyate vidheyatvam |
upādīyamānasya ca karmaṇaḥ tādṛśa- syaiva anyena paryupasthāpanāt anuvādatvam |
asannidhāne tu aparyupasthāpanāt vidhiḥ nopādānamātrāt itya- virodhaḥ |
karmāntare'pi kila eta- cchandakatvāt sādṛśyapratyāt āgneyādīnyeva havīṃṣi iti kathaṃ anyahaviṣko yāga iti |
jyoti- ṣṭome etacchandasya pratyayamānamukhyatvopapattau satyāṃ sādṛśyalakṣaṇānupapatteḥ |
tasmāt suvyaktaṃ karmāntare anyahaviṣko yāga iti (bhāṣye) |
dravya- ntare tu calāyaiva bhedakāraṇāni śabdāntara-saṃjñā-guṇa- phalāni udāhṛtāni |
punaḥśrutisaṃkhyoḥ śabdāntare eva antarbhāvāt prakaraṇāntarasya ca phalacatuṣṭayagrahaṇādityatvāt |
na hi pañcakṛtvo'bhyasto yajatiḥ śabdāntaratvaṃ pratipadyate |
nāpi ekeṣveva tantro- ccāritāḥ saptadaśa prājāpatyaśabdāḥ sambhavanti, śabda- pratyabhijñānāt |
vakṣyati ca evaṃjātīya- kānāmekatvam ‘api vā'vyatirekādūpaśabdādvibhāgādvā’ iti |
prakaraṇāntara- syācca vinā phalādīnāṃ bhedakatvaṃ uktamapi na dṛṣṭaṃ ‘saṃnidhau tvavibhāgāt’ ‘tatsannidheguṇānāṃ punaḥśrutiḥ’ ityādī |
tena pratyabhijñānanimittatvāt phalānugrahadhīḥ prakaraṇāntara- meva bhedakāraṇaṃ bhavadapi upekṣitam |
phalaṃ ca prakaraṇānta- rāntarbhūtatvena na nirīkṣitam |

yadyapi ‘ekaṃ vā saṃyoga- rūpacodanākhyā'viśeṣāt’ iti etattveturviparyyayatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ (ekatvahetuṃ ca tat viparītyatathyaṃ ca iti vigrahaḥ :) asya jñāpakaṃ ityuktam, tadapi prastute'dhikaraṇe anye- ṣāmasaṃbhavāt iti nālocitam |
tatrāpi tu siddhānte saṃjñā-śabdāntarayoḥ guṇasaṃkhyayośca bhedo vaktavyaḥ san noktaḥ ityabhidhīyate |
’ saṃjñā hi dravyarūpā- pañcāpi kriyābhidhānāṃ vicchedamātrāt bhinnati |
saṃkhyā'pi yugapat anekautpadyamānasametā pūrvasaṃbhava- daguṇāntarāt bhidyate iti |
upādeyaṃ, tathā ca syāt vidheyaṃ, tena bhidyate ||
gamyate tena tasyaiva phalādyarthā punaḥ- śrutiḥ |
salaṃ karma vidhātavyaṃ tathāpi tu na bhidyate |
utpattividhibhede hi bhedo nāsti ca so''tra naḥ ||
’ deśakālanimittaphalasaṃskārāṇāṃ saṃnidhau pūrvādhikaraṇa- pratyudāharaṇārthaṃ idamadhikaraṇaṃ iti pratyudāharaṇatvamantara- saṃgatiḥ |
soma--prayojanam-paurṇamāsyādivākyeṣu karmāntara- vidhau karmādhikyaṃ pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte tu tadabhāvaḥ |

etayā iti vākyasya karmāntaravidhāyakatve tasmin karmaṇi ‘avyaktāsu tu somasya’ iti saumikadharmaprāpteḥ : annādya- kāmena somahaviṣko yāgaḥ karttavyaḥ : pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte āgneyādihaviṣkā eveti vārtike vyaktam |
darśapūrṇamāsāprakaraṇe ‘paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta’ ‘same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta’ iti caturṇām |
sviṣṭakṛtaṃ prakalya ‘śeṣāt sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati’ iti śeṣarūpasaṃskārasya |
atra sarvatra saṃnidhānāt svaviṣayavṛttividheyatvapratibhavāt prāptasyaiva karmaṇaḥ kāladeśaviśiṣṭaprayogamātraṃ vidhiṃlakṣaṇāya anu- manyate, na tu karmotpattimiṣa vidhyate |
yatra tu prayogo'pi prāptaḥ ‘ya iṣṭyā’ ityādī, tatra prāptaprayogānuvādena kālādimātrāvidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
nimittasthale tu mitho nimittanaimittakayoḥ aṅgāśritatvasaṃbhavāt prāptasyāpi karmaṇaḥ nimittasaṃchānumitapāpakṣayārthatvena viniyoga- vidhiḥ iti vakṣyate |
phalasaṃskārayostu taduddeśena prāpta- karmaviniyogavidhiḥ spaṣṭa eva |
’ ❖ prakaraṇāntaralakṣaṇa anupādeya-saṃnidhisacivaḥ asaṃnidhiḥ iti ke cit |
tatra ‘vāṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣṭaiścābhavyaṃ yanti’ ityatra anyataḥ |
kintu vidheḥ upapadārthasaṃkramāsaṃbhavena sahakṛtaḥ asaṃnidhiḥ iti |
nātra asaṃnidhiva svarūpataḥ anupādeyasaṃnidhiḥ praveśyaḥ, kintu tatkāryaṃ vidheḥ upapadārthasaṃkramāsaṃbhavaḥ |
sa yathā anupādeyasaṃnidhinā bhavati, evamupādeyasaṃnidhinā'pi bhavati |
baudhāyanaśraute tu ( 12|27 ) ‘madhyame ( upasadahani ) upasadāvantareṇa tvāṣṭram aṣṭakapālam’ iti viśeṣaḥ |
atha tānīmāni havīṃṣi kiṃ upasadā mantratvena vidhīyante, kāla- mātraṃ vā vidhīyate iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
prakaraṇasya upasadāṃ saumyacarvādīnāṃ ca prakaraṇasya na vibhāgaḥ |
prakaraṇasya avibhāge sati saumyādayaḥ upasadaṅgaṃ syāt upasatsaṃyogasya śrutatvāt |
hi yasmāt ubhayaṃ upasadṅgatvaṃ kālaviśiṣṭaśrutyabhayaṃ vipratiṣiddhaṃ viruddhameva |
adhiyā iti śabdena pūrvapakṣanirāsaṃ dyotayitvā siddhāntamāha |
na imāni havīṃṣi upasadṅgatvena vihi- tāni, kintu tadanuprānasya upasadāṃ purastāt antarā upa- riṣṭāditi kālamātramukte syāt |
imāni saṃsupā haviḥṣu aṣṭamādiśabdāntānāṃ trīṇi havīṃṣi upasatsu tadādadā karttavyāni iti tatrocyate |
itarasmāt kālābhidhānāt eṣāṃ haviṣāṃ viśeṣasya medakatva dharmasya adarśanāt darśaneśca abhāvat |
itarat kālābhidhānaṃ tu ‘āgne- mārutādūrdhvaṃ anuyājaiścaranti’ ityādi |
tasmāt karmāntare kālasaṃyoga uktaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. ❖ prakaraṇāntarasya etadeva prayojanaṃ kathaṃ nāma tadaṅgaṃ viśayeta iti |
yadi aprakaraṇādītasyāpi karmāṅgatvaṃ syāt, tataḥ prakaraṇāntaramayekaṃ bhavet |
❖ prakaraṇagamyā pavamānahaviṣāṃ ādhānādyatāṃ bādhitvā ‘yadāhavanīye juhoti’ iti vākyena agnya- yaitā vijñāyate |
vā. 3|1|2|22 pṛ. 737. ❖ prakaraṇapuritānāmepi krameṇa punastadarmaprāpti- rbhavati |
yadyapi pāśvadyaṃ prakaraṇe śrūyate tathāpyanārabhya śrutasyāpi sāpta- daśyasya pūrvādhikaraṇoktanyāyena prakṛtyathaitvāt sāmidhenya- nuvacanādekādaśatvena sāptadaśyasyobhayavikalpa eveti|
tena viśeṣeṇa sāmānyasya bādhāt kuto vikalpaḥ? |
tena yāvatkaraṇena viśeṣasaṃbandhaṃ na kriyate, tāvadvākyadvayena tulyabalena sāptadaśyasyobhayoḥ prakṛtau vikalpa e
upahomāḥ pūrvaṃ paścāt nārihomāḥ iti yuktaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
bādarāyaṇastu ācāryaḥ ante nārihomānte upa- homān āha |
tathā ca pradhānottaraṃ nārihomāḥ tata upahomāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

nakṣatreṣṭhiṣu prakṛtiprāptā nārihomāḥ pūrvaṃ kartavyāḥ tataḥ tattannakṣatreṣṭhitā upahomāḥ iti siddhāntaṃ anyārthaḥ vākyaśeṣo'pi darśayati ' adhvarasya pūrvamayāgeḥ upādhi hyetat karma yadādikam ' iti |
abhricayane ṣaḍ dīkṣā- ''hutayaḥ adhvarasa somasya karmabhūtāḥ pūrvaṃ kartavyāḥ, atha agreḥ saṃbandhanyaḥ ' ākṛtirmagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā ' ityādayaḥ kartavyāḥ |
yat āgnīkaṃ agni saṃbandhi karma tat upādhi aupādhikaṃ abhricayane nimitte sati kriyate iti vākya- śeṣārthaḥ |
tathā ca nakṣatreṣṭhiṣu codakaprāptāt pūrvapaṭhitamiva nārihomātmakaṃ karma pūrvaṃ kartavyamiti jñāyate |
prakṛteḥ pradhānasya mahāprakaraṇam, asaṃdigdhabhūta- kam ( yathā darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ ), vikṛtestu saṃdagdhabhūti- kam |
prakṛteḥ phalasya svagādiḥ niyamasya tāyyajī- vikatvādeḥ; kartuḥ svargakāmādeḥ; samudāyasya āgneyādi- paṭṭakasya vikṛtau nātideśaḥ |
na kevalayāḥ ( sutiṣṭhādipratyaya rahitāyāḥ ) prakṛteḥ prayogaḥ, apabhraṃśatvaprasaṅgāt |
ihāpi ' yasya khādiraḥ suvo bhavati ' ityevamādi vistaraḥ; ' yasyaivaṃrūpāḥ śucaḥ ' iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
3|6|1|2. prakṛtau anuyājottarakālo ( piṣṭa- lepaphalīkaraṇahomau ) dakṣiṇāmiko dṛṣṭau, tathāpi anu- yājotkarṣe noktavyate |
prakṛtau abhimarśadvayaṃ ' caturhotrā paurṇamāsīmabhimaret pañcahotrā- 'māvāsyāyām ' iti |
vi. 10|1|4. prakṛtau upadiṣṭapadārthaviṣayo bhāvābhāvavikalpo yathā agnihotre dadhyadhiśrayaṇatadabhāvayoḥ vikalpaḥ ' na dadhi adhiśrayet, adhiśrayet ityeke ' iti bahuvaca- ( kauṣītaki ) brāhmaṇāt |
bāla. pṛ. 162, prakṛtau upadiṣṭapadārthaviṣaye bhāvavikalpo yathā māsāgnihotraprakṛtau nityāgnihotre payaādiśraddhayaṇā |
pṛ. 162, prakṛtau upadiṣṭapadārthaviṣayaḥ samuccayaḥ ( soma- ) kraye gavāruṇyādīnām, krayāṇāṃ ca jyotiṣṭome |
prakṛtā- veva vikāralayaḥ ' iti nyāyānugṛhītaśrutyā bhūteṣu viddha- ttvāvilayaḥ |
prakṛtau aupa- deśikena bhāvena aupadeśikasya bhāvaḥ syāt |
bāla. pṛ. 133, prakṛtau aupadeśikayoḥ bhāvābhāvayoḥ bādhyabādhakatvaṃ yathā agnihotre ' na dadhi adhiśrayet, adhiśrayedityeke ' iti |
prakṛtau aupadhadharmāṇāṃ prathamamanuṣṭheyatvāt adhvarakalpayā hārhaspatyadharmā eva prathamamanuṣṭheyāḥ |
kiñca āgneyasya prathamabhāvino vikṛtiḥ : vārhaspatyaśca : upāṃśuyājasya paścādbhāvino vikṛtiḥ : sārasvatamājyam |
ataḥ antaraṅga- tvāt caturtharmā eva pūrvabhāvinaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ aupadhadharmāḥ nirvāpaghātādayaḥ pūrva- māmnātāḥ, tata ājyasya utpannavādayaḥ |
evaṃ sati kiṃ pūrvaṃ ājyasya dharmāḥ kartavyāḥ, uta yathāpāṭhaṃ iti vicāre mukhyakramānusāreṇa upāṃśuyājasya dharmāḥ pūrvaṃ kartavyā iti prāptaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena nirākṛtya siddhānta- māha |
prakṛtau pūrṇamāsayāge ajñānāmanuṣṭhānaṃ yathākramam, yathā pāṭhakramaḥ tathā pratīyeta, tathā anuṣṭhātavyaḥ; pūrva- magnīṣomīyapuroḍāśasya paścāt upāṃśuyājasyeti |
svaśabdatvāt svaḥ svīyaḥ aṅkramaviṣayakaḥ śabdaḥ yasya tādṛśatvāt |
tathā ca pāṭhakrameṇa prakṛtyaiva mukhyakramasya vācaḥ iti bhāvaḥ |
prakṛtau dharmā yadvārā kṛtāḥ, tadvārāva vikṛtau nānyadvārā |
prakṛtau padārthasya smaraṇe sarvatra upāyatvamutkarṣa prasaktam - brāhmaṇa-pada-mantra-sūtropradadhār |
prakṛtau pratyakṣo vidhyantaḥ vikṛtau tu ānumānikaḥ |

prakṛtau yatra pāṭhādipramāṇakaḥ kramaḥ tatra tatpa- dārthānantaraṃ tatpadārthaḥ kārya iti viśiṣṭeva vākya- kalpanam, mukhyakrame tu lāghavāt dharmagrāhakapramāṇalavdha ādyapradhānadharmāt uttarapradhānadharmā anuṣṭheyāḥ ityeva kalpanam, na tu viśiṣṭya na vā āgneyādipraveśaḥ |

bhāṭṭa. 5|1|1|0 prakṛtau yathoktittavacanamaryādāṃ tathottarasyāṃ tato tatprakṛtitvādyarthe cākāryatvāt ' ( 9|3| 112 ) ityadhikaraṇe ' agraye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi ' ' brīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānaḥ ' iti brīhīmaśraddhau dravyadevatā'- ntarayuktāyāṃ vikṛtau ūhau anūhau vā iti nirṇayārthaṃ ( saṃdiggha pūrvapakṣayitvā ityuttarānvayaḥ |

) ki artha- prakāśanavat śabdarūpamapi vivakṣitaṃ na vā iti saṃdihya śabdasvarūpānādare samāmnānānarthakyaāpattau autpattika- samāmnāyāvagataśabdasvarūpamatikramya arthānāṃ vacanaṃ abhidhānaṃ prakṛtanvayi itikṛtvā uttarasyāmapi tatau vikṛtivistāre tathābhūtaṃ avikṛtameva śabdarūpaṃ prayokta- vyam, prakṛtitveṣṭasyaiva śabdarūpasya prakṛtivacchabdena viniyuktatvāt iti ' prakṛtau yathoktittavacanamaryādāṃ tathottarasyāṃ tatau tatprakṛtitvāt ' iti sūtrāvayavena pūrvapakṣayitvā karmasamavetārthaprakāśanoddeśena vihitānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ pradhānavaśartitvena prakṛtau itikṛtvā ca artha- prakāśananirapekṣasvarūpādāvarāyogāt, vaikṛte ca sūryanīvārā- dyarthe agnimīḍādisādhanānāṃ prakāśanarupakāryābhāvāt tatsamanarthakatvādopādāne vikṛtau mantroccāraṇaṃ yuktaṃ iti 'athe ca akāryatvāt ' ityuttaravayavena siddhāntayiṣyate |
prakṛtau yathoktittavacanamaryādāṃ tathottarasyāṃ tatau tatprakṛtitvādyarthe cākāryatvāt |
' aindramekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmaḥ ' ityā- mnātam, prakṛtau ca ' agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi ' iti nirvāpa- mantraḥ |
sa kiṃ aindrāme avi- kāreṇa prayoktavyaḥ, uta ' indrāmibhyāṃ juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi ' ityeva prayogya iti vicāraḥ |
tathā ' indrāya marutvate naivāramekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet ' ityāmnātam |
prakṛtau ca ' syonaṃ te... brīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānaḥ ' iti mantraḥ paṭhyate |
sa kiṃ marutvatīyai avikāreṇa prayoktavyaḥ, uta ' nīvārāṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānaḥ ' iti ūhena prayoktavyaḥ iti vicāraḥ |
yathā prakṛtau arthānāṃ agnimīḍādīnāṃ utpattivacanaṃ utpattau vacanaṃ śabdapāṭhaḥ |
tathā uttarasyāṃ tatau vistāre vikṛtau syāt |
yathā prakṛtau paṭhitaṃ tathaiva vikṛtāvi paṭhanīyaṃ vikārakṛtvā |
nirvāpamantrasya akāryatvāt avidyamānaṃ kāryaṃ yasya saḥ akāryaḥ |
tasmāt agnipade vrīhipade ūhaḥ kartavyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'na mātā vardhate na pitā, na bhrātā, na sakhā' iti agnigṛhaviśeṣayaṃ niṣedhavacanaṃ paśugaṇaviṣayakam |
pratyakṣaṃ ca mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhrātaraṃ vā vartamānaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
mātarau mātaḥ pitarau pitaraḥ bhrātarau bhrātaraḥ iti śabdabuddhiṃ pratiṣedhati |
tasmāt nirvāpamantre, 'vrīhīṇāṃ megha' ityādī ca ūho bhavatīti siddhāntaḥ |
kiṃca 'viśeṣayāṃ devānāṃ ukṣāṇāṃ vapānāṃ medaso'nubrūhi' iti uhitānāṃ padānāmuccāraṇaṃ ūhe liṅgam |
[ ita uttaraṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūtraṃ antarāgarbhitatvāt anyatra gṛhītam, nātra |
eke ācāryāḥ avikāraṃ vikārasya ūhasya abhāvaṃ manyante |
prākṛtamantre ūho na kartavyo vikṛtau ityatra liṅgaṃ dṛśyate |
āgneye vaikṛte paśau 'agnaye chāgasya vapāyā medaso'nubrūhi' iti paṭhyate |
vidhānaṃ tu vidyate, tena ūhaḥ siddho bhavati |
kiñca, agnīṣomīye paśau śrūyate 'yadyekaṃ yūpaspṛśet eṣa te vāyo iti brūyāt, yadi dvau etau te vāyu iti, yadi bahūn ete te vāyava iti' |
yadi ūho bhavet etadapi na vidhyātavyam, prāptatvāt |
vidhānaṃ tu vidyate, tasmāt nohaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
vikṛtau ūho na kartavyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vāśabdo vyāvartayati |
tat tatra asmin arthe ūhaḥ kartavya ityatra hetuḥ uktaḥ ' arthe cākārya- tvāt ' ( 1|3|11 ) iti |
ūho nāstītyatra pūrvapakṣiṇā yat liṅgamuktam 'agnaye chāgasya vapāyā medaso'nubrūhi' iti vidhānamiti, tat mantrikīrṣārthasya tasya padasamudāyasya mantralakīrṣayā |
ubhābhāve pūrvapakṣiṇā yadaparaṃ liṅgamuktam 'eṣa te vāyo etau te vāyu ete te vāyavaḥ' iti, sa niyamaḥ kriyate |
anyathā yūpasparśasya ubhayabhāgitvaṃ syāt ani- yamena sarvairmantraiḥ saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
tasmāt 'yadi ekaṃ yūpam, yadi dvau, yadi bahūn' iti tatratatra mantra- viśeṣasya niyamaḥ kriyate |
tasmāt nirvāpamantrādau vikṛtau ūhaḥ kartavyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
' prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt ' ( 'advirukta- tvāt ' ityapi pāṭhaḥ |
3|6|12 ) ityadhikaraṇe dviruktatvadoṣāpattiḥ kālavaiṣamyaṃ ceti siddhānta- hetudvayamuktam |

tat anyonyavyabhicārāt ' samadaśo vai prajāpatirvyadhe'nyāyataḥ ' iti tadadhikaraṇānte eva vārtikakṛdukte pratyudāharaṇe prākṛtadharmātkṣaṇanapekṣatvāt prāptikālavaiṣamyādiṣyupadeśātideśābhyāṃ dviru- ktāprasaṅgaḥ astyeva |
tathā phalacamase somasāmānavidhye ucyamāne vikṛtitvasya ubhayavādisiddhatvena dviruktatvā- vanāyogāt, nityavidheḥ prathamaṃ pravṛtteḥ, naimittikeṣṭivat paścāt pravṛtteḥ prāptikālavaiṣamyastyeva |
tena 'naimitti- kamatulyatvādasamānavidhānaṃ syāt ' iti somadharmasāmāna- vidhyādhikaraṇe ( 3|6|136 ) 'apica naimittikaḥ
phalacamasaḥ na somadharmān grahīṣyati tatra dharmāḥ sādhāraṇāḥ santo dviruktā ityucceran ' iti granthena sāmānavidhye dviruktatāprasaṅgābhidhānaṃ bhāṣyakārīyaṃ upekṣyameveti |
nanu 'sasadaśo vai prajāpatiḥ' ityatra dviruktatvaprasaṅge sati sāmānavidhyāyogāt kathaṃ pratyudāharaṇaṃ vārtika- kṛtā uktam |
tadarthaśāstrādāviva atrānartha- kyaparihāraḥ 'prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt' ityadhikaraṇapūrva- pakṣaprayojanena kāryaḥ |
atraśca prāptikālavaiṣamyameva atra mukhyo hetuḥ siddhāntavide |
kimatideśābhyupagamana dviruktatāsamānārthatvaṃ parihartavyam, kiṃvā atideśena prāpyamānasyāpi parṇatā''deḥ pūrvapakṣaprayojanarūpāya |
śrutiviśeṣaprāpyatve'pyanarthakyaṃ iti saṃdeha eva dupariharaḥ syāt |
abhyupagato hi tatra śataśaḥ atideśādimantrapramāṇāntaraprāpyamānasyāpi arthasya punarvidhiḥ prayojanaviśeṣeṇa agrekṣyadā 'tamuktena' ityādinā |
gavāmayane ca ādyorahoḥ aindrāvāyavātrā- vidhinā bhāgadharmatvāt prāpyamānāyāḥ aindrāvāyavātrā |
evaṃ āmnātārthatvādena vidhita ākṣeptyamānasyāpi prāpta- stasya |
tasmāt prāptikālavaiṣamyameva saṃśayāpanayāya upāsyam 'prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt' ityatra iti niṣkarṣaḥ |
atha etadadhikaraṇaprayojanaṃ na susthe ityato'bhi dhīyate |
yadyapi 'ko'rthaḥ sāmānavidhye ced guṇakāma- pravartanam' iti anyatroktam, tathāpi tat cayanādi- kriyāyāmeva yujyate tadāśritaguṇakāmasaṃbhavāt |
parṇatā- ''dijātestu akriyātvena tadāśritaguṇakāmo na saṃbha- vati |
tat 'pūrvapakṣe parṇatvā- dīnāmupadiṣṭatvāviśeṣeṇa talope prakṛtau tau prāya- ścittasāmyam, siddhānte tu upadiṣṭatidiśayorlepe prāya- ścittaviśeṣaḥ' iti bhavadevaḥ |
nahi upa- diṣṭatidiśayorbhede prāyaścittaviśeṣaḥ kāpi āmnāto dṛśyate |
vākya- pādāye ( 1|3|1 ) 'uccairmantrāḥ kriyate' ityādisvastha 'yadi ṛkto yaśca ārtamimāt bhūḥ svāheti gārhapatye juhuyāt' ityādinemittikaprāyaścittasya ca vedadharmatva- muktam |
tato dvitīyādhikaraṇe utpattivedanibandhanamidamubhayaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe siddhānte viniyogavidhivinibandhanamubhayaṃ ṛgvedādinā yat vidhyujyate tatrauccaistvādi, tasyaiva cātau prāyaścittamiti |

tataśca yājurvedikāt jyotiṣṭomāt tadvikṛtau, sāmavedike śyene vā dīkṣaṇīyādīdyaḥ sāṅgaviśiṣṭā atidiśyāḥ, tāsvapi yā juhūḥ, tatrāpi parṇatā atratyapūrvapakṣe yājurvedikāvidhiviniyuktā, iti tadabhede yājurvedikāṅgeprāyaścittaṃ kāryam, siddhānte tu tasyāḥ prakṛtau yājurvedikāvidhiviniyuktā'pi śyene sāma- vaidikātideśaviniyuktātsāmavaidikāṅgeprāyaścittam |

avadānādidiśau dvādidavat, viśvajidādau phalapadavat, sauryādau atideśāvat, ūhāde- rapi śrutārthāpattirūpasya 'arthādā kalpanekaideśatvāt' ( 1|4|14|25 ) iti vedadeśatvokteḥ vedatvamapya- game'pi mantro brāhmaṇaṃ ityuktaṃ dvairādyaṃ pratyakaveda- syaiva, na kalpasya iti prasaṅgāt vaktuṃ etadadhikaraṇam ( 2|1|134 ) iti |
' prakṛtau vā0 ' tava dviruktatvāt, adviruktatvā mama iti sūtram |
3|6|12, # kimāhavanī- yādayaḥ prakṛtyarthāḥ, āhosvit sarvārthāḥ iti saṃśaye 'tat prakṛtyartha yathā'nyenāramyavādāḥ ' ' prakṛtau vā0 ' iti pūrvapakṣe |
3|1|139, pratiṣedhaḥ prātimātrāpekṣitatvāt upadeśamatideśaṃ vā anādṛtya ubhayathāpi ( prakṛtau vikṛtau ca ) pravartate |
śakyaṃ tu iha vaktum ' prakṛtau vā0 ' iti |
3|1|13 33 pṛ. 878-879, sa ca ( pravargyaḥ ) ' prakṛtau vā0 ' ityevaṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ gacchati |
oṃ prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt iti nyāyaḥ anā- ramyādhītānām |
sāhasī. 864. 'prakṛtau vā0' iti nyāyena sarvaprāṇinadravyaka- yāgamaprakṛtibhūtāmīmāṃsiyapaṃ citrāpadam |
kau. 1|4|3|3 pṛ. 174. anāramyādhītatve'pi avyabhi- caritakratvanvayāmiḥ upasatdiḥ vākyakṛtenānvayena kratva- nvayaṃ prāptasya 'prakṛtau vā0' iti nyāyena jyotiṣṭome gamanam |
su. pṛ. 1310. 'purastādupasadāṃ pravaryaṃ prayukti' iti vākyādeva 'prakṛtau vā0' iti nyāyena pravaryasya prakṛtiprāptāsiddhiḥ |
soma. 3|1|12. pravaryasya niṣedhapakṣe'pi 'prakṛtau vā0' ityanena vikṛtiviṣayatvāt prakṛti- mātraviṣayatvāgataḥ |
su. pṛ. 1317. prāṇipagāmākāṅkṣantī citratva- strītve 'prakṛtau vā0' ityanena sarvaprāṇiyāga- paramaprakṛtimīmāṃsiyaṃ gacchataḥ |
vā. 1|4| 2|3 pṛ. 328. vidhiliti sarvapṛṣṭhe grahītavyāḥ (atigrāhyāḥ) apyagniṣṭome ' ityatra vartamāno'gni- ṣṭomaśabdaḥ 'prakṛtau vā0' iti nyāyena prakṛtiṣṭoma- paraḥ |

saṃkarṣa. 1|3|2. vaidikasya guṇavidherviṣayā- pekṣāyāṃ vaidikatvasāmānye buddhisattvāt vaidikayoraiva ālambhanirvārpayorviṣayatvāvagateḥ 'prakṛtau vā0' ityanena nyāyena prākṛtālambhanirvārpayaiva avadhāryate |
su. pṛ. 125. agniṣṭomaśabdasya 'prakṛtau vā0' iti nyāyāt jyotiṣṭome eva pracuraprayogā tadupasthāpa- katvopapattiḥ |

kau. 2|3|1|22 pṛ. 68. anā- ramyādhītatvāt pravaryasya prakṛtau vihitasya sataḥ ati- deśena vikṛtāvapi upasadāṃ prāptisiddheḥ adṛṣṭaphalatvābha 'prakṛtau vā0' iti nyāyāt jyotiṣṭome evopasadā saha vidhānaṃ yuktam |

kalpataruḥ 3|1|4|29 vas. pṛ. 787. yasya sāmānyāt kratuśeṣatvamavagatam, tasya kiṃ kratuśeṣatvaṃ ityapekṣāyām 'prakṛtau vā0' iti nyāyāt prakṛtyarthatvaṃ syāt, ādhānasya tu agnimātrāśa- tayā kratuśeṣatvameva nāsti iti nāsya prakṛtigāmitvam |
nāt nātra ('citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' ityādī) 'prakṛtau vā0' iti nyāyaprāptiḥ |
atideśāt pūrva- mupadeśapravṛttau atideśasyaiva akalpanena dviruktatvābhāvāt |
kau. 1|4|3|3 pṛ. 175. prakṛtau vikṛtau ubhaya- minne ca karmaṇi samānavidhāno niṣedho yathā 'śūdrānītaḥ krayakītaiḥ karma kurvan patatyadhaḥ' |
bāla. pṛ. 35, prakṛtau vaikalpiko'yaṃḥ bṛhadrathaṃtarayoḥ aṣṭārdhayoḥ anyatarasya kvacit vikṛtau niyamaḥ, ayaṃ niyamavidhiḥ adṛṣṭārthaḥ |
pṛ. 24, prakṛtau vairūpyalakṣaṇavākyabhedaḥ vājapeyaguṇavidhipakṣe yatra karmakaratvarūpam, uddeśyalopā- deyatvarūpam, guṇapradhānatvarūpam, vidheyatvānuvādatvarūpaṃ ceti |
pṛ. 189. (darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ) svāhā- kārasya arthavattvaṃ nāriṣṭhahomeṣu pārvaṇahomayot 'pūrṇa- māsāya surāghase svāhā' iti |
prakṛtyoḥ pradhānapraśno yathā- kāmyenāgnihotreṇa nityāgnihotrasya prasaṅgaḥ |
tāni kiṃ paurṇamāsyā ārambhe dhārayitavyāni, uta anyādheya- mārabhya iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
na paurṇamāsīmābhya dhāraṇaṃ kintu agnyādheyādārabhya tāni dhārayet |
evaṃ sati maraṇasya animittatvāt aniyatatvāt prāk paurṇamāsyāḥ maraṇe'pi aviprati- ṣedhāt śarīrasaṃskāralopābhāvena vipratiṣedhābhāvāt |
bāla. pṛ. 35. prakṛti- gatānāṃ kāryakṛdrmāṇāmeva vikṛtau atideśaḥ |
ci. 3|8|17. prakṛtigatānāṃ guṇāmānāṃ vikṛtau nāti- deśaḥ |
8|1|14|23-25. prakṛtigatapratipattiniṣedho yathā 'agnihotra- havaṇyaśca lehaḥ' iti phale niṣedhaḥ |

bāla. pṛ. 36. prakṛtigatapratipattivyatiriktadṛṣṭārthasaṃni- pātikakriyāniṣedho yathā agnihotrame hote 'agni- mupatiṣṭhate' iti vidhāya 'tasmānnopatiṣṭhate' iti śata- pathe dṛṣṭārthāmisaṃskārasaṃnipātyupasthānaniṣedhaḥ |
prakṛtigatasaṃnipatyopakārakārtha-kriyāniṣedho yathā 'madhuparke ca some ca apsu prāṇāhutīṣu ca |
bāla. pṛ. 36. prakṛtigatasāmidhenyādisamudāyasya ekedeśa eva vikṛtau vihite adhikānāṃ lopaḥ kartavyaḥ |
10|1|12|36-46. prakṛtito'pi anūyājottarasya aprāpteḥ puro- ḍāśāyajñe'ḍābhyottarameva piṣṭalepīkaraṇahomī |
prakṛtidvaṣṭapaurṇamāsyeva niyāmakāntarābhāve niyā- makatvāṅgīkārāt sākamedhasya savanīyasya prathamapākaraṇam, taduttaraṃ daikasya, taduttaramanuṣṭheyasya |
bhāṭṭa. 5|1|16. 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ' ityanuśāsanaṃ saṃbandhasāmānyābhiprāyam |
kau. 1|4|16 pṛ. 219, 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ' ityanuśāsanena pratyayānāṃ niyamena prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvāvagateḥ
vastuto ghātvarthāvacchinnabhāvanābhidhāne'pi ghātvartha- cchedasya pramāṇāntaraprāptatvāt viśeṣyamātre vidhilopa- patteḥ |
2|1|2|1 pṛ. 138. 'prakṛti- pratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ' ityācāryopadeśāt kartā śabdārthaḥ karma cetyavagamyate |
katari śap, karmaṇi yak iti pratyayārthaṃ kataraṃ karma ca samānamanyācāryāḥ |
nācārya- vacanāt sūtrakāravacanāt vā śabdārtho bhavati |
anuṣṭheyā ca kriyā pratītā satī kārakāṇi pratyayārthāti ityavagatametat |
yadyapi kartā śabdārthaḥ ityevamācāryā vadeyuḥ, tathāpi svaviṣayādanyatra vadanto nādartavyā bhaveyuḥ |
te tu naiva tathā vadanti (anyastadabhiprāyo varṇanīyaḥ ityarthaḥ) |
vā. pṛ. 922. 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ' iti smṛtayanusārāt dhātorapi bhāvādyorpattiḥ |
prakṛtiḥ svārthaparyārthaviśeṣaṇatvenopanayati iti pratyayena saha tadarthamādheyatvaḥ |
sa coktasiddhayarthaṃ viśiṣṭe evārthe pratyayo yat prayujyate, tat pūrvataravijñātaprakṛtyarthaviśeṣa- paṇāt |
dadhihomasaṃsargasya atra 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇaśāsanatvena padārthavidhayā bhāne'pi saṃsargamaryādayā tasya tattātparyakatvābhāvāt na paryavasana- tvam |

kau. 1|4|16|29 pṛ. 295, nahi atra ('somena yajeta' ityādī) saṃsargaḥ anyasaṃsargatvat saṃsargavidhayā bhāsate 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ' iti sāhityarūpasaṃsargo anuśāsanaivavyapattiḥ |
api tu padārthavidhayaiva śaktyā niruḍhalakṣaṇayā vā |
2|1|2|1 pṛ. 6. yattu 'prakṛtipratyayau pratya- yārtha saha brūtaḥ' iti, tat karmanimitteṣu nāmapadeṣu pācako lāvaka ityevamādiṣu |
ākhyāte tu na kartā, na kriyā pradhānataḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? bhāvapradhānamākhyātam |
bhā. 1|1|1|24. 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ' tayostu pratyayaḥ prādhānyena' iti śābdikāḥ |
pṛ. 566, 'prakṛtipratyayau saha brūtaḥ' tayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ prādhānyena' iti smṛtyeva prakṛtinirūpitapratyayārtha- prādhānyasya suvarthasādhāraṇyena siddhiḥ |
rahasya. pṛ. 38. 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ tayostu pratyayaḥ prādhānyena' iti smṛtyā pratyayārthasya prādhānyataḥ (viśeṣatvāt - iti pāṭhaḥ |
) kathaṃ pratyayārthasya nyāyyasya viśeṣatā iti na vācyam |
'bhāvapradhānamākhyātama' iti niruktasmṛtyā bhāvaśabdāvacchinnasyāsya prādhānyā- vagateḥ ; tasya ca 'dhātavarthaḥ kevalaḥ śuddho bhāva ityabhi- dhīyate' iti vaiyākaraṇasmṛtyā dhātuvācyatvāvagateḥ |
viśeṣasmṛtyuparodhena sāmānyarūpaḥ pratyayārthaprādhānya- smṛteḥ suvādiṣvityanena vyākhyānāt |
vastutastu neyaṃ pratyayārthaprādhānyasmṛtiḥ pratyayārthatvāvacchedena prādhānya- niyāmikā, liṅgasaṃkhyādeḥ pratyayārthatve'pi prādhānyānaṅgī- kārāt |
nāpi pradhānasya sataḥ pratyayārthatvaniyamaparā, 'sattvapradhānāni nāmāni' iti smṛtyā liṅgasaṃkhyādīn prati pradhānasyāpi prātipadikārthasya pratyayārthatvābhāvāt |
kintu yatraiva pramāṇāntareṇa suvarthasya karaṇatvādeḥ prātipadikārthaṃ prati prādhānyaṃ prasiddham, tadanuvādāmātreyaṃ smṛtiḥ |
iti nānayā vyāpārasya dhātavarthatve'pi viśeṣatāpattiḥ pratibandhaḥ |

kau. 2|2|16 pṛ. 96, prātipadikārthaḥ pradhānabhūte kāraka rūpe pratyayārthe anveti, 'prakṛtipratyayau pratya- yārtha saha brūtaḥ tayostu pratyayaḥ prādhānyena' iti smṛtyā pratyayārthasya prakṛtyartha prati prādhānyavattvāt |
sāmānyasmṛtipīyaṃ pramāṇāntarānusāri kārakatvādidhayaiva na tu saṃkhyādiṣayā'pi, anyathā prātipadikārthasya sattvasamānatvā''nupapatteḥ |
2|1|2|15 pṛ. 30. 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ, tayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ prādhānyena' iti ācāryāṇāṃ pratyayārtha- prādhānyopadeśaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1417, 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ, tayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ prādhānyena' iti pratyayārthaprādhānyasmṛtiḥ |

pṛ. 1014, 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ tayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ prādhānyena' iti pratyayārthaprādhānyasmṛteśca kartṛsaṃjñayādeḥ pratyayārthasya prādhā- nyābhāvāt pratyayārthaḥ pradhānameva iti niyamopadeśe'pi pratyayārtha eva pradhānaṃ iti niyamopapattiḥ |

pṛ. 566, 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ, tayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ prādhānyena' iti sāmānyasmṛteḥ 'bhāvapradhānamākhyātam' iti viśeṣasmṛtyā bāghāt bhāvanāyā eva prādhānyāt pratyayārthatā yuktā |

(iti cet ucyate) dhātavarthāti- riktāyāḥ bhāvanāyāḥ svarūpeṇaiva siddhatvāt prādhānyapratyayārtha- tayoḥ durottaratvāt ' dhātavarthaḥ kevalaḥ śuddho bhāva ityabhidhīyate' iti bhāvaśabdasya svatantradhātavarthavācitva- mabhyupagamya kartṛviśiṣṭhadhātvādimānaṃ yuktam, na tu bhāva- prādhānyaparaiyaṃ smṛtiḥ |
iti pṛ 547, 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ, tayoḥ pratyayārthaḥ prādhānyena' iti saraṇaṃ ākhyātasye'pi apavādābhāvāttvartham |
pṛ. 1371. ākhyātavācyaiva bhāvanā, na dhātuvācya, prādhānyena pratīyamānasya vyāpārasya dhātavarthatvāt |
'prakṛti- pratyayau pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ, tayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyam' iti nyāyaviddhatvāt |
iti śabde prakṛti- pratyayorapi anvitābhidhānasya nirastatvāttunānvaye svāyai pratyayo vadati ityāśaṅkā |
su. pṛ. 707-708. 'prakṛtipratyayau saha brūtaḥ tayoḥ pratyayaḥ prādhānyena' ityuktatvena pradhānārthavācakapratyayasya prādhānyam |
41-42, 'prakṛtipratyayau saha brūtaḥ tayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyam' iti pratyayārthaprādhānyabodhakasmṛteḥ ' bhāva- pradhānamākhyātaṃ' iti viśeṣasmṛtyā bādhaḥ |
'prakṛtipratyayau saha brūtaḥ' ityanuśāsanamapi kārakatvarūpānvayasya padārthavidhayā bhānaniyamaparam, na tu saṃbandhasāmānyāt |
kau. 1|4|18 pṛ. 223. prakṛtipratyayayoḥ anyonyatirekābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ artha- pratyāyanaśaktyavagamaḥ |
su. pṛ. 684. prakṛti- pratyayayoḥ kevalayoḥ prayogāsaṃbhavaḥ |
vā. 2|2|11 pṛ. 463. prakṛtipratyayayoḥ paurvāparyyaniyamāt śuddha- pratyayārthānupalabdheḥ dhātavarthasya anurañjakatā sarvatrāviśiṣṭā |
vā. 2|2|11 pṛ. 463, prakṛtipratyayayoḥ śakti- bhedāt pūrvābhihite'pi (viśeṣaṇe) pratyayena viśeṣdhyā- bhidhānaṃ avidagdham |
