1|2|21 pṛ. 777, prakṛtipratyayayoḥ svāyābhidhāne smṛteracārācca nitya- vivakṣitakramatvena pūrvaprayuktaprakṛtyartheṣu pratipattṛṣu pratyayārthāḥ saṃnipatantaḥ kṛtānubandhameva svārtha vadati, tasmāna kadācit pratyayārthaḥ śuddho labhyate |
2|2|11 pṛ. 465, prakṛtipratyayayoḥ svārthayoriva nairantyāt antarāle saṃbandho'vagamyamāno bhavati |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 13. prakṛtipratyayānyatvākhyānasmṛteḥ 'padāvadhāraṇe- pāyān bahunicchanti sūryaḥ |
su. pṛ. 813. prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānya- miti nyāyaḥ ||
yathā aupagavo vāpaka ityādau hi pratyayārthasya apatyakartrādirūpasya prādhānyaṃ yātītyādi- kriyānvayāt, evamanyatrāpi bodhyam |
sāhasī. 60. prakṛtipratyayayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyāt prāti- padikaṃ gauṇamityapacyate |
vā. 3|4|10. prakṛti- pratyayārthayorbhinnārthatve'pi sataḥ pratyayoccāraṇaṃ ( pratyayoccāraṇāt prāk ) prakṛteḥ syāt na kiñcit pratyayārthaṃ bhavet |
bāla. pṛ. 181. prakṛtipradhānena aṅgasya pratyaṅgo yathā kāmyena amāvāsyāśrāddhena yātrādyaṅgabhūtādyaiḥ |

bāla. pṛ. 150, prakṛtipradhānasya svāṅgīkṛtyā saha prādhānyatantraṃ yathā 'yasyobhayaṃ havirātimācchet aindraṃ pañcaśarāvamodanaṃ nirvapet' atra sāṃnāyyayāgāṅgabhūtayā āgneyayāgavikṛti- bhūtayā iṣṭyā saha sāṃnāyyayāgasya tantram |
bāla. pṛ. 126. prakṛtirūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma agnihotradarśapūrṇamāsādi |
bāla. pṛ. 85. prakṛtiliṅgena ca vidhyantaviśeṣa uktaḥ 'yasya liṅgamarthasaṃyogāt' ( 8|1|2 ) iti |
ke. prakṛtiliṅgayoreva uhya yathā 'agnaye juhvam' iti prakṛtau |
bāla. pṛ. 127. 'prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogāt' ( 10|4|1|9-2 ) ityadhikaraṇe nakṣatreṣṭhau upadiṣṭānāmupahomānāṃ atideśānāṃ nāriṣṭhahomānāṃ ca samuccayaḥ uktaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 177. prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogāt karma saṃskāraṃ vikṛtāvidhikaṃ syāt |
nakṣatreṣṭhiṣu 'agnaye svāhā kṛttikābhyaḥ svāhā' ityādaya upahomā vihitāḥ |
tatra vikṛtau kṛttikādīṣṭau saṃskāraṃ saṃskriyate adṛṣṭaviśeṣaviśiṣṭaṃ kriyate anena tat nāriṣṭhahomakaṃ karma adhikaṃ syāt |
kutaḥ ? prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogāt prakṛteḥ liṅgena kāryeṇa saṃyogābhāvāt |
tathā ca prākṛtakāryeṣvapāka-śabdasaṃyogābhāvādupahomādi lakṣaṇaṃ. karma saṃskāra adṛṣṭārtha prākṛtādadhikaṃ syāt, na tu vācyaḥ : iti siddhāntaḥ |
atha dvitīye varṇake idaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvapakṣasūtratvena vyākhyeyam |
sūtrākṣarārthastu sa eva, kevalaṃ udāharaṇa-tuṣāriṇaḥ śabdā bhinnāḥ |
tathayā, bhāṣyam- ida-māmnāyate 'somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet kṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ abhicaran' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ kuśamayaṃ nivartate neti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ubhayasya pramāṇavagatatvāt codakena kuśanām 'śaramayaṃ barhiḥ' iti viśeṣavākyena ca śarāṇāṃ samuccayaḥ |
prakṛtau ca 'upāvartadhvamiti darbhābhyāṃ stotramupākaroti' iti śrutam |
atra ubhayamubhayasya nivartakaṃ ghoṣo mantrasya nivartakaḥ rayo dharmayoḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ : sūtrākṣarārthaḥ sa eva |
nanu śaramāredavacādau 'śaramayaṃ barhirbhavati' iti śarāḥ kuśān nivartayanti evaṃ nakṣamedhiṣu upahomāḥ nāriṣṭhomān nivartayanti, iti cet, tatra dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyamāha |

śareṣu codanāliṅgasaṃyoge codanāyāṃ prākṛtavidhau avyabhicaritaṃ yat liṅgaṃ veditkaraṇasādhanavahiḥ śabdaḥ tatsaṃyoge 'śara-mayaṃ barhiḥ' ityatra iti prakṛtisannidhānātkṛtividhivighaṭaka-śabdasannidhānāt tādhikāraḥ prākṛtakuśavikāraḥ śaraḥ pratīyate |
upahomeṣu tu nāsti codanāliṅgaṃ iti na upahomaḥ prākṛtanāriṣṭhomādyaḥ |
viśeṣastu asti hi tatra prakṛtiliṅgena barhiḥśabdena saṃyogaḥ |
prakṛtau ca 'upā-vartadhvamiti darbhābhyāṃ stotramupākaroti' iti śrutam |
tatra ubhayaṃ ubhayasya na nivartakaṃ kintu rathasaṃbandhī ghoṣaḥ mantrasya dharmayoḥ nivartakaḥ |
na ghoṣaśūnyo ratho vā rathabhinnasya ghoṣo vā |
evaṃ dvitīye tṛtīye ca varṇake idaṃ sūtraṃ siddhāntasūtrameva, na prathama-varṇake iva śaṅkā nirāsadvārā siddhāntopapādakam |
oṃ prakṛtiliṅgavacanānāṃ ūhaḥ yathā 'āpo devīḥ śuddhāḥ sva' iti prokṣaṇīṣu prakṛtau, ghṛte prokṣaṇe tu 'ghṛtaṃ deva śuddhamasi' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 127. oṃ prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogeḥ pratyakṣadarśanena bhavati |
yathā 'yadi pṛṣṭayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate, madhu āśayate ghṛtaṃ vā' iti |
vikāreṇa vā yathā 'nairṛtaḥ caraḥ matvāva-pūtānām' iti |
svaśabdena vā bhavati, yathā 'paricau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' iti |
pratiṣedhena vā bhavati, yathā 'na girāgiroti brūyāt, airaṃ kṛtvādeyam' iti |
anyena vā yena avagamyate prākṛtaṃ kāryaṃ abhinirvartayantīti |
bhā. 10|4|1|1 pṛ. 1907. oṃ prakṛtivacanayoreva ūho yathā 'agnaye juṣṭam' iti prakṛtau 'viśvebhyo devebhyo juṣṭam' iti vaiśvadeve caro |
bāla. pṛ. 127. oṃ prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati iti nyāyaḥ |
yathā paramātmasadṛśa eva tadavatārā iti bodhyamityanyatra vistaraḥ |
atra subodhinau- 'yathānyanyāyaṃ prakṛtivat kartavyaṃ iti nyāyasiddham' iti |
pratipādyasthāne tu gaurava pariharadbhiḥ vṛttikāraiḥ sarvasāmānyaḥ śabdaḥ parigṛhītaḥ 'prakṛtivat' iti |
bhā. 8|2|1|2 pṛ. 1585. oṃ prakṛtivadvikṛtiḥ kartavyā iti nyāyaḥ |
tathāhi 'ūhaḥ khalvapi' iti bhāṣyapratīkamādāya 'iha yasmin yāge
itikartavyatopadiṣṭā yāgāntareṇopajīvyate sā prakṛtiḥ, yenopajīvyate sā vikṛtiḥ |
'prakṛtivikṛtiḥ kartavyā' iti mīmāṃsakairapyasya nyāye prakṛtipratyayādīnāmahaṃ vaiyākaraṇaḥ samyag vijānāti |
sāhasī. 994. oṃ ukthayādayaḥ abhiṣṭomasya vikṛtayaḥ; viśeṣastvatra pratyakṣopadeśena saṃpāditatvāt |
avaśiṣṭaṃ tu sarvamanuṣṭheyaṃ 'prakṛtivat vikṛtiḥ kartavyā' iti nyāyenaiva saṃpādyate |
su. pṛ. 57. oṃ jagataḥ brahmopādānatvameva na kuladharmatayoktam, kintu prakṛtivikārābhedanyāyena advaitasiddhaye |
tathāhi 'yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati' iti pratijñāya mṛdādidṛṣṭāntaiḥ kāryakāraṇābhedapratipādanaparaiḥ pratijñāpā sampadyate |
mṛdādeḥ sakāśāt ghaṭādeḥ vikārasya vyatirekaḥ tāttviko bhedaḥ na bhavati iti so'yaṃ nyāyaḥ rītiḥ anyatrāpi |
prakṛteḥ mṛdādeḥ sakāśāt ghaṭādivikāraḥ yathā tattvato bhinno na bhavati eva-manyatrāpi |
ke. oṃ prakṛtivikārābhāve bhedaṃ vinā na yujyate |
su. pṛ. 409. oṃ nahi 'dadhyatra' ityatra prakṛtivikāra-bhāvaḥ |
na ca sādṛśyamātraṃ dṛṣṭvā prakṛtivikṛtirvocyate, nahi dadhipiṭhakaṃ dṛṣṭvā kunda-piṭhakaṃ ca prakṛtivikārabhāvo'vagamyate |
bhā. 2|1|6|16. oṃ prakṛtivikārabhāvābhāvena (puroḍāśapālena iti śabde ) tādarthyasāmāyogaḥ |
māṭṭa. 4|2|1|1. oṃ prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ pradhānatantraṃ śraute mṛgyam |
smārte tu amāvāsyāvyatīpātaśrāddhādīnāṃ ekadinakartavyatāpasau iti hemādriṇā uktam |
bāla. pṛ. 148. oṃ prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ samānatantratve vikṛtitantreṇa prakṛteḥ prasaṅgasiddhiḥ |
apūrva ca prakṛtau samānatantrā cedanityatvādanarthakaṃ hi syāt |
bhāṣyam- yadā prakṛtivikṛtyā samānatantrā, tadā kiṃ prākṛtaṃ tantraṃ kartavyam, uta vaikṛtam ? nanu naiva prakṛtivikṛtyā samānatantrā'sti |
kiṃ prāptam ? yadi pūrva prakṛtiḥ prayujyate tat prākṛtam, atha vikṛtistato vaikṛtam |
apūrvaṃ ca vaikṛtaṃ tantraṃ prakṛtau prayujyate, samāna-tantrā cet, anityatvādicchete |
anityā vikṛtiḥ kāme votpanne nimitte vā asāvāgacchati |
yadi na vādhyeta, anarthakaṃ syātkṛtaṃ vidhānam |
yasya cikīrṣā pratyupasthitā tasya pūrvaṃ prayogaḥ |
yasya ca pūrva kriyā, tattaṃtraṃ pūrva yathā kartavyam, tatpūrvape uktam |
śā- prakṛtiḥ yāvajjīvaṃ parṇaparvani prayujyate, vikṛtayo'pi kāmena nimittena vā parvaṇyevāpatanti |
tatra prakṛtivikṛtīḥ tantreṇa prayogaṃ kṛtvā cintyate |
kāmena nimittena vā patantī vikṛtireva autsargikīṃ nitya-cikīrṣāṃ bādhitvā niviśate iti vaikṛtameva tantraṃ prakṛtau prasyajyate iti (siddhāntaḥ) |
soma-- yāsāṃ vikṛtīnāṃ parvakālatvaṃ tā atra viṣayaḥ |
yathā paśoḥ parvaṣaṭkantvāt tantratvaṃ evamihāpi ityutthitaḥ : saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- vikṛtiḥ prakṛtyā samānatantrā cet apūrvaṃ vaikṛtaṃ prasajyeta, vikṛteḥ tadarthaṃ vinā niveśāsaṃbhavāt, anyā vaikṛtaviśeṣānmāna-manarthakaṃ syāt iti |
' bhāṭṭa-- yāstāvat kāmyā nityā vā vikṛtayastāsāṃ 'ya iṣṭyā' ityanena parvakālavidhānāt parvaṇi sadya- ḥkālasatā: kṛtvā prakṛterapavidhānamiti naiva tatra tantra- prasaṅgavicāra: |
yatrāpi pavinanāśādinimittakeṣṭyādau niyamanaiva prakṛtiprayogamadhye nimittapātaḥ tatra tasyā eva prajvalitamapyanyavivādam |
tatra prāyaśo naiva sāmadasyādi, yadyapi vā bhavettathāpi tasya niravakāśatvāt taddeśo prakṛte- reva prasaṅgitvaṃ prayājādyaṃśe tu vikṛtiriti dhyeyam |
yatra tu prayogamadhye gṛhadāhādi, tatra prakṛteraiva tantritvam, sāsadasyāde: prayogabahirbhūtanimittapātaḥ satvātkā- tvāt |
yatra tu prakṛtyupakramelāyāmeva yasyā iṣṭerniyato nimittapātaḥ, tadāpi vastuto vikṛtiṃ sadyaskālaṃ kṛtdaiva
prajāpati- vratānāṃ phalena saṃbandha: 'etāvatā haṃsayukto bhavati' iti |
tadutsarge karmāṇi puruṣārthāya, śāstrasyānati- śaṅkayatvāt ca dravyaṃ cikīryate tenārthenābhi- sambandhāt kriyāyāṃ puruṣaśruti: |
tatra saṃdeha: kiṃ karmāṇi prajāpativratāni, uta puruṣārthānīti |
kuta: ? evaṃ hi phalaṃ na kalpa- yitavyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |
nanu śrūyate evaitāṃ phalam 'etā- vatā haṃsayukto bhavati' iti |
naitat phalaparaṃ vacanam, vartamānapadeśa evaiṣa śabda iti |
tena yatra āditya īkṣitavya: prāpta: tatrāyaṃ pratiṣedha: |
udayata astaṃ yatra niyamo vā syāt kaścit karmābhṛta: |
arthaprāptena kartrā saṃbandho ya: sa vidhitsita: |
na ca evamādi- bhirdravyasya kaścit ucca upakāra: sādhyate |
tasmāt tena puruṣārthena abhisaṃyogāt kriyāyāmevajātīyakāyāṃ puruṣa: śrūyate |
atha yaduktam, yatra ādityasyekṣaṇaṃ prāptam, tatra ucyato'staṃ yatra pratiṣedha iti |
tathā śruti- ranugṛhyeta, itarathā niyamo lakṣyeta |
kintu iha niyama: śabdena śrūyate, tasya vratamiti, tena niyama eva: 'noyanmāditya īkṣitavya:' iti |
apica, 'etāvatā haṃsayukto bhavati' iti puruṣaśraddho doṣa: kīyate, na karmasaṃbandha: |
golakṣaṇānyapi evameva kartrīkaraṇya: kartavyā ityeva- mādīni |

(yadi prītya- vibhaktatvāt dravyārjanasya puruṣārthatve'pi phalakalpanā- 'bhāvāt puruṣārthatā prītyutsarge, tarhi prajāpativratānāṃ aprakaraṇānāmāpi phalakalpanābhāyāt kṛtyatvamastu ityevaṃ prastūyate |
tatra pratiṣedhatvādeva tāvat kṛtyatvaṃ yuktaṃ ityetat pratipādayan pratiṣedhatvaṃ samarthayate-- ) 'noyanta- mādityamīkṣeta' iti |

(yathā ucyata: ādityasya prāpyakarmatayā saṃbandha:, yathā ca īkṣitādhātaḥ karaṇatayā saṃbandha: īkṣaṇena ādityaṃ prāpnu- yāt iti, evaṃ naño'pi tenaina saṃbandha: 'na prāpnuyāt udyantāmādityaṃ īkṣaṇena' iti) evam (pratyayasaṃbandhe sati) śrutiścāni padāni bhavanti, na lakṣaṇācchāni |
yadā tu nañ-dhātupadayo: (nañupapadayo: iti vā. pāṭha: ) saṃbandha:, tadā svārtha hitvā vastvantaraṃ lakṣayanti |
evaṃ ca phalaṃ na kalpayi- tavyam |
yadyapi naiṣa pratiṣedha: (kintu anīkṣaṇaṃ nāma antaḥkaraṇasaṃkalparūpaṃ niyamyate), tathāpi phalakalpanā- bhayāt kṛtyatve: (evāyam) niyama: |
(nanu) 'etā- vatā haṃsayukto (mukto iti kacit pāṭha: ) bhavati' iti (anena enonivarhaṇasya phalasya śravaṇāt na phalaṃ kalpanīyam, ata āha--) phalārthavādo'yam (na phalavidhi: ) |
'tasya vratam' iti hi prakṛtya 'noyanta- mādityamīkṣeta' iti (vacanam) |
tat viśeṣamākāṅkṣamāṇaṃ anena viśeṣyate 'tat idaṃ karma' ( 'noyantamādityamīkṣeta' ityādi) iti |
evaṃ ca vākyabhedāt dvi: ahaṣṭaṃ kalpyeta (pūrvatra kalpa- yitvā punaratra kalpyeta ) |
ataḥ (assāt ) virodhāt na (nañ) kartavya- tāvacchanena saṃbadhyate |
(sūtre--) 'śāstrasya anatiśaṅkayatvāt' iti kṛtyathai- 'pi tulyatvāt (nāyaṃ hetu: puruṣārthaikāntika: iti-) kasya cit āśaṅkā syāt iti tannirvartyartham (sūtre uktam ) 'na ca dravyaṃ cikīryate' iti |
(tata vyācaṣṭe -) na ca ṛtvartha dravyaṃ saṃskriyate vikriyate vā (pradarśanametat prātinivṛttyorapi ), yena sāmarthyāt tatsaṃndhena praṇāḍyā ṛtvarthatā syāt |
(kiṃ punaretāni kāmyāni, atha nityāni iti vicāryate |
tatra kaścit tāvadāha-) phalārthinā kāryāṇi ityevamartha upadeśa eṣām (vidhjidādivat |
tannirā- karoti -) na (na phalārthinā kāryāṇi ityevamartha upa- deśa: |
kiṃ tarhi ityāha-) nityatvena saṃdhyopāsanādi- vaditi |

nanu īkṣaṇābhāva: anīkṣaṇam (tasya ) abhā- vatvāt bhāva eva tu atra lakṣaṇayā vidhīyate saṃkalpa- rūpa: iti pratipādayan lakṣaṇānimittaṃ saṃbandhaṃ darśayati- sarvatra-) pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā (kartavyāyām ) mānasaṃ vyāpāramaṅgīkṛtya pravarttate nivarttate vā |
(atrāpi anīkṣaṇaṃ kurvāṇa: ) ādityasya anīkṣaṇaṃ kartavyamiti manasā saṃkalpayati |
sparśādī- nāmabhāvaścādanāmāpi tadabhāvāvinābhāvāt na teṣāṃ kartavyatā (lakṣaṇāt ) |
( 'apica puruṣaprayatna: kṛti: ' ityādibhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -) ṛtvarthatve (sati ) vidhāyaka: karmotpatti- mātraniṣṭha eva bhavet (utpattigrahaṇaṃ viniyogasyāpyupa- lakṣaṇam ) |
evaṃ ca (sati ) yadevāsya tādarthyaprati- pādakatvam (prayogapratipādakatvamityartha: ) tadeva hīyeta, prayogavacanena kṛtatvāt |
tasmāt sa pakṣo mahītavya:, yatra vidhāyaka: arthavān |
yathaivam, imānyapi puruṣā- rthāni syu: ; 'samidho yajati, tatūpātaṃ yajati' 'nāṣṭatvaṃ vadet' ityevamādīni |
atrāpi puruṣayalasaṃkīrtanam, atrāpi na dravyaṃ cikīryate iti |
na tatra śrutyādikaṃ kiñcit kāraṇaṃ gṛhyate, yena karmaṇāmbhabhūtatānīti gamyate |
iha tu samidādīnāṃ prakaraṇaṃ nāma kāraṇaṃ gṛhyate |

bhāṣyam-- loke'pi niṣpannakāryādiṣu prayojanavatsu yadasaṃvṛktaṃ phalena śrūyate, tat tadarthaṃ vijñāyate iti manyamānā upavāsaṃ japaṃ copadiśya kṛtito manyante, na ṛtave, idamasya prayojanavato''jñamiti |
tathā ca apare'pi manyamānā na duruktaṃ manyante |
tasmāt samidādīni karmāṇi, na prajāpativratānīti siddham |
śā-- 'pratiṣedhe śruti: śabda:, paryudāse tu lakṣaṇā |
pratiṣedhaśca san prāptiṃ mārgamāṇa: kratuṃ vrajet |
sākṣā- dapekṣitaṃ tasya phalameva na tu kratuḥ |
soma-- dravyārjanavat pratyakṣeṇa prītyanavagamāt kratvarthatvameva iti pratyayasthāt saṃgatiḥ |
phalakalpanā- bhayāt kratvarthatvasya viśvajit- rātrisatra- hiraṇyamaraṇā- dāvapi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt teṣāmapi etadadhikaraṇaviṣayatva- mityāhuḥ |

sūtrārthastu- tasyāḥ prītestatsamapi dravyārja- nādivat prītyanupalambhe'pi prajāpativratādīni puruṣārthāni śāstrasya anatiśāyitvāt śāstreṇa puruṣārthatve bodhya- māne prītyamāvaprayuktatvākhyāyāḥ anavakāśāt iti yāvat |
śāstrasya kratvarthatve'pi upapattimāha-asya āha- na ceti |
na evam karmabhiḥ kratusaṃbandhaṃ dravyaṃ cikīrṣate kratvarthadravyasaṃbandho naiṣāmiti yāvat, yena taddvārā kratvarthatā syāt |
ataḥ tenāyyena puruṣārthena saṃbandhat īkṣaṇādikriyāyāṃ puruṣasya kartṛtvena śeṣitvena vā śrutiriti |
' bhāṭṭa-- 'tasya vratam' ityupakramya snātatpura- skāreṇa 'nekṣetodyantamādityaṃ nāstaṃ yantaṃ kadācana |
nopa- raktaṃ na vāristhaṃ na madhyaṃ nabhaso gatam ||

tatrāpi bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ pratiṣedhatve paryudāsatve ca ubhayathā'pi phalakalpanāyā kratvarthatva- māśaṅkya anārṣyādhītatvāt śrutyābhāvena kratvarthatvā- nupapatteḥ paryudāsatamaṅgīkṛtya puruṣārthatvaṃ siddhāntitam |
siddhānte ārthavādikaphalaprayuktatvāt prati- ṣedhapakṣe ca tadabhāvādyāpyasaṃgatiḥ |
tatra nañaḥ pradhānā- nyasya lakṣaṇādibhiyā anupapatteḥ paryudāsatvāyogyāt rāgaprāptodyadādityekṣaṇabhāvanāyāḥ pratiṣedha evāyaṃ paryu- pārthaḥ : kalpakṣamaṇādipratiṣedhavata |
ataśca niṣedhena īkṣa- ṇasya aniṣṭasādhanatvāt phalāntarākāṅkṣā'bhāvāt 'naitāvatā haṃsā yukte bhavati' ityādyarthavādikāpyathaphala- kalpanā''nupapatteḥ : nārthevādikaphalaprayuktatvam |
' tīrthayātrā gātaḥ ' iti tu uktvā kānicil tīrthāni anukrāntāni |
yatra tu kevalaḥ prayujyate tatra tīrthamātra- meva brūte, yathā ' tīrthaṃ jñāti, tīrthameva hi samānānāṃ bhavati ' iti |
api ca saṃbhavati śrutyarthaṃ lakṣaṇā'rthaḥ agrāhyaḥ |
bhāṣyam--tatrāha, yaduktam ' avācyaṃ hītarat ' iti, tasya kaḥ parihāraḥ ? ucyate |
parisaṃkhyā'rthaṃ vā syāt ' dvayoḥ praṇayanti, na caturṣu ' iti |
guṇārtham , arthavādārthaṃ vā ' tasmāt dvāmyeti ' iti |
tatra pari- saṃkhyāyāṃ tāvat trayo doṣāḥ |
arthavādasya prayojana- muttarasminnadhikaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ ' madhyamaryādā gārhapatyāt ' (25) iti |
(atralā ḍupaṭīkā mīko. pṛ. 1688 ' cāturmāsyeṣu abhripraṇayanam ' iti bindau saṃgṛhītā ubhayādhikaraṇasādhāraṇatvāt, iti tatraiva draṣṭavyā |
soma--nirmanyādīnāmanatideśakaratve'pi praṇayati- śabdasya atideśakaratvaṃ bhaviṣyati ityuktānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārtha--saumikaṃ saumikasadṛśaṃ praṇayanam , itarat prākṛtaṃ codakaprāptaṃ tu avaktavyamiti |
vi--' saumikaṃ prākṛtaṃ vā syād dvayoḥ praṇayanaṃ śrutam , āyo'prāptatvato, maivamanāmatvena vādagīḥ |
bhāṭṭa--cāturmāsyeṣu vaiśvadeva- varuṇapraghāsa- sākamedha- śunāsīrīyākhyāni catvāri parvāṇi |
tatra ' dvayoḥ praṇayanti, dvāmyeti ' iti śrutam |
tatra bhāṣyakāraḥ saptabhiḥ sūtraiḥ adhikaraṇadvayaṃ evaṃ vyākhyau (tatra caturbhiḥ sūtraiḥ ādyamadhikaraṇaṃ trimisu dvitīyam)
tatra āye tāvat saumikaṃ sadharmakaṃ praṇayanamidam , uta prākṛtaṃ adhvaryuṃ gārhapatyādānīyamiti |
iti cintā- yām , prākṛtasya codakena prāptatvena vidhivaiyarthyāpatteḥ vacanārthatvāya praṇayatirayaṃ saumikapraṇayanaparaḥ : tadvidhā- nārthaḥ |
ata eva tatra uttaravedeḥ sattvena tatprāptau ' na vaiśvadeve uttaravedimupavapati, na śunāsīrīye ' iti tadyudāsato'pi saṃgacchate |

yat ' upātra vapanti ' iti uttaravedeḥ utpattivākyam, yacca ' uttaravedyāmagniṃ nidadhāti ' iti tasyāḥ viniyogavākyam, tat madhya- mayoḥ parvaṇoḥ prākṛtapraṇayanakāle eva uttaravedimātra- vidhāyakam |
iti prāpte, na praṇayatiḥ saumikapraṇayanasyaiva viśiṣya upasthāpakaḥ |
ataḥ tatraivātideśaprāpteḥ pūrvaśrutyā vidhiḥ anuvāda eva vā |
tatprayojanaṃ ca yadyapi netarayoḥ parisaṃkhyā vaidoṣyāpatteḥ, praṇayanābhāve itaraparvaṇoḥ agnyabhāve yāgānupapatteśca |
etadabhāve hi caturṣvapi prākṛtapraṇayanaprāptau deśāpekṣayā uttaravedividhānaṃ caturṣu api prāpnuyāt |
etatsattve tu parvadvayavṛttipraṇayanasyaiva viśiṣyopadeśena upasthitatvāt tatraiva uttaravediḥ tadīyā- gnividhānameva ca dvāraṃ iti sthiṣyati |

praṇayanādhikaraṇe ' upātra vapanti ' iti vacana- pradhāsāvāntaraprakaraṇātamapi ' na vaiśvadeve uttaravedi- mupavapati, na śunāsīrīye ' iti paryudāsavākyatvāt balā- deva avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā cāturmāsyānāmeva ' atra iti vādaḥ ityuktam |
cāla. pṛ. 12, vikṛtestu avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ saṃdaṃśodbhūtakaṃ saptame praṇayanādhikaraṇe vaॅṃṣaṇapraghāsānāmuktam |
praṇavavidhānaṃ sāmidhenīṣu anye ṛgakṣare eva teḥ sthāne |
' sāmidhenīṣu praṇavavidhānaṃ ṛgakṣarasthāne eva ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
praṇavaśabdavācyasya oṅkārasyaiva sāmidhenīṣu vidhānam, na tu ' praṇava ' iti śabdasya |
praṇāda'pi ca yena kriyate, tat kāraṇaṃ bhavati yathā ' gomayaiḥ pacati, tuṣapakā bhavanti ' iti |
praṇītāḥ nāma haviḥśrapaṇārthamutpannāḥ utpavanādi- dharmasaṃskṛtā āpaḥ |
' praṇītāḥ praṇeyan vācaṃ yacchati tāṃ sahaviṣkṛtā visṛjati ' iti asmin deśe ye padārthasteṣāṃ dharmo vāgyamaḥ, na pradhānāpūrvasya |
haviḥsaṃyanottaraṃ avaśiṣṭānāṃ nāśa ninayanaṃ ninyate, na tadarthaṃ punarapāṃ praṇayanaṃ kartavyam |
praṇītānāṃ apāṃ vākyena piṇḍa- saṃyanasādhanatvāgame'pi ānuṣaṅgikapātrasādhanatvasyāpi sattvāt sauryādicarī abhyuditeṣṭau ca praṇītādharmopapattiḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : ' praṇītāḥ praṇeyan vācaṃ yacchati, tāṃ sahaviṣkṛtā visṛjati ' iti śrutam |
praṇītā- praṇayanāt prāk vāk yantavyā ' haviṣkṛdehi ' iti preṣoccāraṇaparyantamiti tadarthaḥ |
tadetadāha praṇītādi praṇītā ārabhya haviṣkṛtparyantaṃ yat vāgyamanamuktam, tat tathā upāṃśutva- vat deśasaṃbaddhaṃ syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
' praṇītāḥ praṇeyan vācaṃ yacchati tāṃ sahaviṣkṛtā visṛjate ' ityuktaṃ vāgyamanaṃ na deśaprayuktaṃ yajñaprayuktam , paramāpūrvaprayuktamityarthaḥ |
yajñasya aśritatvāt nātra saṃbandhī yajñaśabdaḥ śrūyate |
praṇītādharmoḥ ijyārthe dadhani payasi ca pāke upakurvanti |
bhā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 716. praṇītā- dharmāḥ : utpavanādayaḥ, sānāyyārthamutpavayoḥ : dadhipayasoḥ abhyudayeyāṃ candradevaṃ nimīttikṛtya śrapaṇahetutvāt kartavyāḥ |
mīko. pṛ. 509 ' abhyuditeṣṭau dadhipayasoḥ ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
bhāṣyam-- nanu idānīmevoktam ' yajñaṃ tanviṣyantī adhvaryujamānau vācaṃ yacchataḥ ' iti |
(yathā ' praṇītāḥ praṇeyan vācaṃ yacchati tāṃ sahaviṣkṛtā visṛjati ' iti |
asmin deśe ye padārthāḥ teṣāṃ dharmo vāgyamaḥ, na pradhānāpūrvasya--iti 24 sūtre bhāṣyam ) |
dup-- athavā nāsiddho dṛṣṭānto bhavati iti dṛṣṭāntasiddhaye adhikaraṇaṃ prakriyate |
na asamānavidhānaḥ pratinidhiḥ; kintu tadvat śrutadravyat pratinidhirāpi samānavidhānaḥ syāt |
athavā pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktaṃ tadvat iti tadeva niṣidhyate ' na tadvat ' iti |
pratinidhiḥ tadvat phalamamavat asamānavidhāno na bhavati |
' puroḍāśaniṣpattirūpasya prayojanasya vrīhīṇāṃ nīvārāṇāṃ ca ekameva ' iti suno- dhinyāṃ vyākhyātam |
prayujyate vidhīyate aneneti prayojanaṃ karaṇe lyuṭ |
nirvāpāpāvatvāt dharmaḥ vrīhisvedena dravya- manuṣṭha vihitaḥ iti prayojanaśabdena vrīhisvedo bodhyate |
nīvāreṣvapi hi vrīhipadavācyasya vrīhilasya āśrayabhūtāḥ kecidavayavāḥ nīvāreṣvapi vartante eva |
iti nīvāro'pi vrīhipadocya evaiti ubhayoḥ samānavidhānatvam |
vrīhiṣu yadā nirvāpādayo vidhīyante, tadā nīvāreṣapi te arthāt vidhīyante evetyarthaḥ |
śruteḥ vrīhibhiḥ pratinidhi- bhūtānāṃ nīvārāṇāṃ prakṛtivikāratvāt nāsti aśākha- lakṣaṇatvāt śāstralakṣitatvābhāvāt śāstrokṣitatvābhāvāt |
pratinidhirna bhavati devatāyāḥ agreḥ śabdasya ( mantrasya ) kriyāyāḥ ( prayājādeḥ ) cāpacāre |
teṣu svāminpacārthe saṃdehaḥ kimantyaḥ pratinidhirbhavati neti |
yo'rthī svatyāgena ṛtvijaḥ parikrīyate, yaśca svaṃ pradeyaṃ tyajati sa svāmī |
yadi sa pratinidhī- yate, svāminā yat kartavyaṃ tat sarvaṃ kuryāt |
tat sarvaṃ kurvan svāmyeva syāt pratinidhiḥ |
ya utsargaṃ karoti, sa phalavān bhavati |
yadā prati- nidhīyamānaḥ ( pratinidhirāprīyamānaḥ ) iti tantraratne pāṭhaḥ |
dakṣiṇādānaṃ haviṣpradānaṃ ca karoti, tadā sa eva phalasaṃbandhāt svāmī syāt |
yadā dravyaparityāgaṃ kṛtvā anyatra ( laukike kārye ) vyāpṛto bhavati, tatra yāni kravyayāni ( ājyāvekṣaṇādīni ) teṣu adhvaryudeva prati- nidhilena karoti ( iti nānyaḥ pratinidhirbhavatiḥ ) |
puruṣasaṃskārāṇāṃ ca ( ṛtvigbaraṇādīnāṃ ) kṛtyatvāt ( vinā'pi yajamānena ) na vaiguṇyam ( avyaryunā tada- nuṣṭhānasaṃbhavāt ) |
yāni ca brahmacaryādīni phalapratigrahaṇa- yogyatayāḥ kāraṇāni, tāni bahiravasthitena ( yajamānena ) kriyamāṇāni kratopakārakāṇyaiva |
tasmādekatra ( ājyā- vekṣaṇādau avyartvādeḥ ) vidyamānatvāt, itaratra ( brahma- caryādau ) asaṃbhavāt anupapannaḥ ( yajamānasya ) prati- nidhiḥ |
mṛte tu ( yajamāne ) naiva pratinidhirāśaṅkā- 'sti ( pratinidhirātusaṃbhavāt ) |
patnī cenna, tasyāḥ patihīnāyā agnyābhāve adhikārābhāvāt |
( patnyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ kimasti pratinidhiḥ , uta neti ? nāyamasmādhikaraṇasya viṣayaḥ |
tatrāpi hi yadā tāvat ' bhāryāye pūrvamāriṇye datvā''gnīnyakarmaṇi ' ityayaṃ pakṣaḥ samādhīyate, tadā agnyābhāve anadhikāraḥ siddhaḥ |
yadā tu nāmryāḥ patnyai dattāḥ, tadā'pi ācāraprāmāṇyāt nāpatnīkasya darśapūrṇamāsādyanuṣṭhānam |
' tadāhuḥ aplīko'pi agnihotra- māharet ' iti vacanāt |
na tu dampatibhyāṃ parasparamapi karaṇam, tadvākye phalasya karmayogitvāt karmaprayoktṛtvāt pratinidhiha- yajamānatvadehedayetā'vacchedakoṭipraviṣṭatvāt |
svāminaḥ tathā na pratinidhiḥ ryādīnāmaśaktatvādau tu avyaryudvārānevopāyeti na iti |
vi-- ' na svāmino'sti pratinidhirvā, dravyadasti maṇḍana-- ' na svāminaḥ pratinidhiḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- mṛte tāvadyajamāne patnyāṃ vā nānyatareṇā- pratinidhiḥ pradhānaparyantamukhyālame sati na grāhyaḥ |
yajamāne mṛte patnyā anyabhāvā- śeṣakāryalopastu tatra soḍhavyaḥ |
alpavrīhihame iḍā''di- devanadhikārāt patnyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ yajamānasyāpi |
' jāyāye lopaḥ kāryaḥ; parantu pradhānagayapattā vrīhaya āvaśyaka pūrvamāriṇye datvā''gnīnyakarmaṇi ' iti pakṣe tāva- eva |
6|3|22, parantu tasya vidhurādhānapakṣe anauttaravedikakarmaṇāṃ patnīvyatirekeṇaiva karmakartṛtvameva, na phalasvāmitvam |
yadā tu nāmīnāṃ tasya anuṣṭhāne svāmidharmatvaṃ bhavatyeva |
prati- patnyai dānam, tadā'pi ' tadāhurapatnīko'pyagnihotramā- nidhirmukhyatvena samānavidhānaḥ |
na tu tayoḥ prakṛtivikāra- haret ' iti vacanāt patnīvyatirekeṇaiva agnihotramā- bhāvaḥ |
yadā tu kasya cit bhāve yaḥ tatsadṛśa upādīyate saḥ |

karmaṇo madhye'nyatarasya mṛtiḥ, tadā dāhāt pūrvameva pratinidhirmukhyakāryasamartho labhyate, śrutaṃ dravyaṃ ca na tatsamāpane vakṣyamāṇītyā proṣitādivedavānuṣṭhānamiti na mukhyakāryasamartham, tadā pratinidhirgrāhyo na mukhyam |

pratinidhirmukhyakāryasamarthaḥ saṃskārāvama- vā anyatarādhikārakarmasu yadyapi svāminaḥ kālā- rthaśca labhyate, śrutadravyaṃ ca na saṃskārasamarthaṃ parantu mukhya- divat prayogavicchidyaviṣayatvāt tattadekatvādideva na kāryasamarthaṃ labhyate, tadā mukhyameva grāhyam, na prati- pratinidhiprasaktiḥ, tathāpi ' saṃdhyāmidaṃ ciraṃ homama- nidhiḥ |
pratinidhiḥ saṃskṛto- sagotreṇa kārayet ' ityādivacanabalāt śiṣṭācārācca anu- 'pi |
pradhānasaṃbandhāt prāk mukhyalāme, mukhyaṃ saṃskṛtya matidvārā kartṛntareṇāpyanuṣṭhānam, svatyagāmātraṃ tu sati grāhyam, saṃskṛto'pi pratinidhistyājyaḥ |
no cettadapi tainaiva ' agraye idaṃ na caraṃ paśuniyojanāt prāk khadiralābhe khadiraḥ saṃskṛtya madīyayajamānasya ' ityevaṃ kāryam |
pratinidhiḥ sākṣāt darśādiṣu tyāgaghaṭitaṃ karma anyatareṇa kāryam, dvayorapi śruto'pi mukhyena samānavidhānaḥ yathā pūtikāḥ somena |
ata eva tyāgo'pi tādṛśasthale śravaṇaṃ tu niyamārtham |
pratinidhiḥ ' mama yajamānasya ca na ' ityādi rūpaḥ |
pratinidhiḥ adhyaryuṇaiva, asati bādhe sāmānyasamānakhyā tayā tattrāte |
patnyāstu pravāse'gnicchede hareyuḥ ādāraśaṃ phālgunāni cābhiśṛṇuyāt ' ( ādārāḥ eva |
patnīpadārthānāṃ ca sāmānyasamānakhyā'nu rodhena yaja- svalpameva prayojanaṃ yeṣāṃ ārdradūrvāṅkurādīnāṃ tṛṇānāṃ tāni mānasyāprāpteḥ |
evaṃ phalisaṃskāre'pi ānīyamāne phalā- phālgunāni ' iti sāyaṇabhāṣyam |
atasteṣāmaśaktyādī lopa pūrṇimāmāse yeṣāṃ parṇādibhirvṛddhiḥ : tādṛśā vrīhīviśeṣāḥ
ādārastu pūtikā eva syuḥ avāntaro vā medaḥ syāttayoḥ |
ke. abhāve hi śrutasyākalpaḥ prati- nidhiḥ |
bhā. 6|3|16|35, mukhya dravyaṃ saṃskāra- samarthamapi pradhānakāryasamarthaṃ labdhaṃ cet sarvasamartho'pi pratinidhirbhavaḥ; kintu mukhyameva grāhyam |
(vrīhīṇāmapacāre nīvārāḥ pratinidhiḥ :) 6|3| 1|127. mukhyāpacāre pratinidhi gṛhīte punarmukhya- lāme pratinidhi tyaktvā mukhyameva grāhyam |
pratinidhinā pradhānakāryaṃ niṣpādyate tato mukhyadravyalābhe'pi pratinidhinaiva samāpanam ||
bhāṣyam-- atha agnihotrādiṣu karmasu śrutadravyā- pacāre pratinidhi upātte kṛteṣu keṣucit saṃskāreṣu yadi tadeva śrutamupalabhyeta, kiṃ śruta
vā— yadi aśāstralakṣaṇatvāttvānāṃ kāryāpatti- rnāsti, pūtīkānāṃ tarhi śāstralakṣaṇatveniyatasya phala- camavaktavyāpattiprasaṅgaḥ |
tataḥ syāt kāryavartitvaṃ na tvevaṃ sā pravartate ||
’ soma- nāśe hi pratinidhyapekṣāyāṃ satyāṃ pūtīkā vidhīyante na yāgasādhanāpekṣāyām |
ato'yaṃ pratinidhirniyama eva bhavati, yat saktūnmīmāṃsāsaṃbhave vikalān somadharmā- nutpādayet tat pūtīkagatamiti |
vakṣyati hi ‘niyamārthaiḥ kaciddhiḥ’ ‘taccityaṃ taccīkarṣā hi’ iti ca |
sakalavyāptyaviṇe hi karmāṇā vaikalyādiha na pravartante |
nityasya hi karmaṇo'vaśyaṃ prakramāt prakāntasya ca sarvasāvayavasamāpanīyatvāt kiñcit dharmavaikalpe'pi avagaiṣyābhyabhyanujñā yujyate |
yathā tu kāmyānāṃ pratinidhiḥ prakramo nāsti, tathā guṇakāmaina pravartitavyam |
yadi tu prakrānte kasiṃścidguṇakāmalpe dravyanāśe sati prati- nidhīyate tatastasyāvayavasyasamāpanīyatvāt vikāra prati- nidhinā vā tulyatvaṃ samānamityanuhāveva prayojanam |
soma— prayojanam— ‘somaṃ te krīṇāmi’ ityādiḥ pūrvatat ūhāt |
nāsti naimittikatvena, tulyaḥ pratinidhistvaḥ’ abhibhavakayādibhiḥ somapūtīkaustulyatā |
bhāṭṭa— yatra tu pūtīkādau tattvena abhāve vidhiḥ, tatra sakalājñayuktsomajanyayāgaprayogasaṃbhave paścādeva tatpravṛtteḥ na samānavidhānatvam |
teṣāṃ mandasadṛśatvena pañce'pi aprāpteḥ, pūtīkapade avayavalakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt |
na ca niyamavidhi- lāghavānurodhena tadgīkāraḥ, tasya phalamuttvena niṣpāda- sthapatyādhikaraṇanyāyena akiñcitkaratvāt |
iti prāpte, pūtīkapadārthasya hi pūtīkatvasya nātra karaṇatvaṃ śrutam, dvitīyāntatvāt |

ataśca niyamavidhilāghavānurodhena tayā na pūtīkatvasya sākṣātsādhanatvaṃ lakṣyate, api tu avayavaniṣṭhasādhanatānāntarīyakrapayojakatvameva iti na pūtīkapade avayavalakṣaṇā, sahaśaniyāmakanyāyapravṛtteḥ pūrva- meva na asya vidheḥ pravṛtteḥ niyamavidhilopapattiḥ |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ nīvārāḥ samānavidhānāḥ, uta neti |
kā atulyatā ? brīhīṇāṃ vihitā na nīvārāṇām, ityatulyatā |
kutaḥ ? brīhihaṃ hi brīhidharmāṇāṃ brīhivyaktau nimittam |
na ca brīhitvasya sthāne nīvāratvaṃ bhavatīti śrūyate |
kathaṃ tarhi nīvāreṣu dharmā bhavantīti ? ucyate |
yā brīhitvena paricchinnā brīhivyaktayaḥ, nīvāreṣu tāḥ santi |
tāsāṃ ca vyaktīnāṃ yāṃ brīhitānāṃ tulya eṣa vidhiḥ |
vā— yadi nīvārāḥ svaina mahimnā karmasādhanaṃ bhaveyuḥ, tataḥ kāryāpatyā dharmāḥ saṃvadhyeran |
na tu teṣāṃ sādhanatve kiñcit pramāṇamasti |
katipayā dṛśyante tadupāditvāt puruṣaḥ pravartamāno nānta- rīyakatvāttvamapāde, na kamījñatayā |
brīhidharmāḥ punarbrīhiśabdena pratyekameva coditā iti samānavidhānāḥ |
nahi nīcārebhyo brīhibuddhiḥ vyāvarttate iti vakṣyati ‘sāmānyaṃ taccīkarṣā hi’ iti |
bhāṣyam— itaśca na pratinidhiḥ śrutena saha prakṛtikāryabhāvaḥ |
na cāyaitattadavagantuṃ śakyate brīhi- tvasya sthāne nīvāratvaṃ bhavatīti |
tasmānna pratinidhiḥ śrutena saha prakṛtikāryabhāvo bhavatīti |
na ca tada- karaṇāt kaścidoṣaḥ syāt |
ye tu brīhidharmāḥ pradhānacodanayā sakaladharmāva brīhi- codanayā vikala āśritāḥ, te arthāntaratvābhāvācca kāryāpannāḥ |
soma— prayojanam— nāya guṇakāmapravṛttya- rūpaṃ saṃbhavati, yathā kāmyasya karmaṇaḥ pratinidhiprakramo nāsti, tathā guṇakāmānāmapi pratinidhiprakramāsaṃbha- vāt |

tasmāt mukhyāśrayeṇa pravartamānānāṃ guṇākāmāṃnāṃ pratinidhau pravṛttyasaṃbhavāt ‘brīhīṇāṃ megha’ ityādiḥ ūhā- nuhāveva prayojanamiti vārttike vyaktam (uttarādhikaraṇa- vārttike vyaktam, na tu atrādhikaraṇe) |
’ bhāṭṭa— nīdrāyābhye bhāve nīvārādisādṛśyapratitiḥ api saṃskāravidhitaḥ pūrvaṃ sādhanatvagamāt asamānavidhāna- tvam, sakalājñayukttrīhijanyayāgaprayogasaṃbhave karmaśāstreṇa tadākṣepāt |

iti prāpte, satyaṃ uttarakālaṃ tadākṣepeḥ, tathāpi brīhisādhyālocanavelāyāmeva brīhitvajāteryāga- sādhanatve avagate tadanyathā''nupapattyā tadavacchidyateḥ tadārambhakībhūtayavacanāṃ ca sādhanatvamākṣipyate |
ataśca jātikyatyavayavasādhanatānāṃ pūrvamevāvagatatvānāṃ sarvāsā- masaṃbhave katipayagrahaṇasya uttarakālapratītikatve'pi svarūpeṇa pūrvāgataiḥ samānavidhānatvopapattiḥ |
nahi nīvāratvena rūpeṇa teṣāmupādānam, yena tadrūpeṇa sādhanatvabodhasya auttarakālikatvāt asamānavidhānatvāpattiḥ, apitu brīhārambhakāvayavavasamājanādātīya—katipayavayavatvena |
atasteṣāṃ brīhyavayavaniṣṭhasādhanatāsaṃpattyai avarjanīya- tayā upādāne'pi avayavasādhanatāyāḥ saṃskāravidhisyaḥ pūrvameva pramitatvāt samānavidhānatvopapattiḥ |
saṃskāravidhisu hi prakṛtāpasadhanabhūtapadeprakṛtitvatvāvayavaniṣṭhasādhanatāyā syaiva uddeśyatvā''cchedakatvāt avayavaniṣṭhasādhanatāyā avayavaniṣṭhasādhanatāmede'pi na virodhaḥ |
evaṃ ca yatra na avayavapratisādahatvena pratinidhiḥ, tatra na samānavidhā- natvam, na vā kāryāpatyā hi dharmaprāptiḥ |
tadya avaghāta- pratinidhitayā navanarluchanādeḥ karaṇe nakheṣu prokṣaṇādeḥ, yupādāvastaraṇarhirvaitulyalaukikatartyopādānena api caritārthatvāt |
phalamatrase tu ‘tamasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet’ ityādiśabdagataliṅgādeva atideśakalpanāmiti viśeṣaḥ |
prayojanam— ‘brīhīṇāṃ megha’ iti mantrasya pūrvapakṣe lopaḥ |
’ 15. pratinidhau kadare saṃskṛte paśuniyojane kṛte tataḥ khadiralema'pi punaḥ khadire niyojanaṃ na kāryam |
brīhīṇāmapacare nīvāreṣu pratinidhistvena upādīya- māneṣu ‘brīhīṇāṃ megha sumanastmānaḥ’ iti mantraḥ ūhena pravartate anūhena veti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
prati- nidhau nīvārādirūpe prayukte sati ūho na ityanuvartate |
caśabdaḥ dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ patnīvat agniho iva iti |
aśabdatvaṃ uhita- śabdaśūnyatvaṃ anāmnānāt vā syāt itarasya abhāvādvā syāt |
yadi mantre vrīhiśabdasya āmnānaṃ na syāt, yadi vā itarasya pratinidhibhūtasya nīvāradravyasya abhāvaḥ syāt tadā aśabdatvaṃ syāt |
prayoge ca vrīhayo na santi, nīvārāśca gṛhītāḥ |
tasmāt nīvārāṇāṃ abhidhānasiddhaye vrīhi- śabdasthāne nīvāraśabdaḥ uhitavyo bhavati 'nīvārāṇāṃ megha sumanasyānaḥ' iti |
vrīhīsthāne pratinidhi- tvena nīvāradravye gṛhīte 'vrīhīṇāṃ megha' ityatra 'nīvā- rāṇāṃ megha' iti ūho naiva kartavyaḥ |
katham ? nīvārāṇāṃ tādarthyāt vrīhyarthatvāt nīvāradravyaṃ tadākhyaṃ vrīhyākhyameva saṃskārāḥ |
evaṃ ca nīvārāḥ saṃskāraiḥ avi- śiṣṭāḥ |
tasmāt pratinidhibhūtā nīvārāḥ vrīhiśabdenaiva vaktavyā bhavanti |
vrīhito viśeṣaḥ nīvārairasti ityasya tattvam 'sāmānyaṃ taccikīrṣā hi' ityatra ( 6|1|127 ) uktam |
nīvāreṣu tasmāt nīvāreṣu pratinidhitvena gṛhīteṣu 'nīvārāṇāṃ megha' iti nohaḥ |
ke. pratinidhi śrute'pi pūtīkādau krayāmiṣavādayo mukhyadharmāḥ kartavyāḥ |
3|6|15. pratinidhi saṃskāra- yogyaṃ labdhe'pi saṃskārayogyasya mukhyasyāpi lābhe mukhyasyaiva upādānam |
pratinidhī saṃskārasamarthe labdhuṃ śakye'pi saṃskārāsama- rtho'pi pradhānasamarthaśca mukhya evopādeyaḥ |
mukhya- dravyopacāre pratinidhī gṛhyate dravyamedo bhavati tathāpi na yāgabhedaḥ |
śrute dravye upātte apa- carite pratinidhimupādāya prayogaḥ prāptaḥ |
yadā so'pi vinaṣṭaḥ pratinidhihataḥ, tadā kiṃ pratinidhisadṛśamupādeya- mutopāttasya vinaṣṭasyeti |
kiṃ prāptam ? pratinidhihite vinaṣṭe tatsadṛśamupādeyaṃ pūrveṇa nyāyena iti |
yathaivāsau pūrvaḥ pratinidhiḥ śruta- cikīrṣayā, na pratinidhicikīrṣayā |
soma-- pūtīkānāṃ pratinidhiṣvapi tadapacāre pūtīkasadṛśopādānameva na tu somasadṛśopādānamiti pūrvādhikaraṇaprayojanākṣepāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- pratinidhī apacarite na tatsadṛśaḥ pratinidhiḥ, prati- nidhyupacāre'pi śrutāvayavalipsayā dravyāntarādānasya tulyatvāditi |
vi-- 'pratinidhyupacāre tu tena mukhyena vā samam |
' yaḥ sadṛśasya grahaḥ, sa mukhyena dṛk sadṛk sadṛśaḥ, na tu pratinidhinā sadṛśaḥ |
' pratinidhiḥ pratinidhiḥ pratinidhinā sadṛśaḥ na mataḥ |
pratinidhiṣpāḍanyāye sthite samuccayasyaiva ( vartamāhanīyayoḥ ) yuktatvāt katha- midamadhikaraṇamārabhyate ? ucyate |
10|8|8|126 pṛ. 2069. pratinidhītvaṃ na bhavati vaikalpikasya dravyasya |
( yathā khādirapacāre pālāśādirna pratinidhiḥ vrīhyapacāre vā yathā na pratinidhiḥ ) |
6|1|1127. haviṣaḥ kṛtsnanāśe doṣe vā ājyasya pratinidhi- tvam |
bhāṣyam-- atha yat pratiṣiddham, 'ayajñiyā vai varakāḥ kodravāḥ, ayajñiyā vai māṣā' iti |
aviśeṣeṇa hatacchrutye, na yajñārhā māṣā varakāḥ kodravā- śreti |
varakādeḥ śrutadravyacikīrṣayā upādānam, na teṣāmaktvena vidhānam |
arthāt yatra yajñasādhanaṃ ( natvam ) prāptam, tat tatra pratiṣidhyate ( asmallite tu 'arthāt ye yatra yajñasādhanaṃ prāptāḥ ; te tatra pratiṣidhyante' iti bahu- vacanāntaḥ pāṭhaḥ |
) soma-- iha tatkāryakaratvasya pratyakṣatvāt astu pratinidhimānamiti pratyakṣanāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- pratiṣiddhaṃ māṣādikamapi na pratinidhiṣyam, yasmādaviśeṣeṇa yajñasambandhamātre niṣedhaśrutiḥ iti |
' bhāṭṭa-- anārabhyaśrutena 'ayajñiyā vai māṣā varakāḥ kodravāḥ' ityanena māṣādīnāṃ yajñasvarūpaniṣedhāt yatra sākṣāt teṣāṃ vidhānam, tatraiva vikalpārthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
athavā yatra dhānyatvādina sāmānyadharmeṇa vidhānam, tatra svecchāprāptamāṣādyapratiṣedho 'barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyam' itivat |
ataśca karmaśāstrāvarodhena māṣādīnāṃ pratinidhitve sādhanatve'pi aṣṭatvābhāvāt tatra na pratiṣedhaḥ |
vakṣyamāṇayuktyā dravyaśāstrāvarodhena māṣādī- rūpasahapratinidhitve vrīhyādyavattvādine teṣāṃ grahaṇāt avarjanīyatayā māṣādyupādānādadravyābhāvena na pratiṣedhaḥ |
iti prāpte, 'ayajñiyāḥ' ityanārhapratyayena sādhanatvamātraniṣedho viśeṣavihitā- tirikte sarvatra māṣādipratiṣedhamevadhatteḥ na prati- nidheyāḥ |
atra ca lakṣaṇyā yajñoddeśena māṣaniṣedhavidhānāt naika- prasratābhaṅgaḥ |
pratinidhiṣpādita'pi karmaṇi darśapūrṇamāsā- dināmadheyaṃ yājñikaiḥ prayuktamamedāpādakam |
su. pṛ. 344. pratinidhiṣpāditakarmaviṣayasyāpi 'apīvā- 'vyatirekāt' ( 6|1|12 ) iti nyāyasya vidhva- tarvihitaiṣvapi tulyatvaṃ ca cinmanvate |
teṣu śrutyapacāre bhavati saṃdehaḥ kiṃ prati- nidhimupādāya prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ, uta tadantaṃ karma utsraṣṭa- vyamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? śiṣyasya abhāve anāgamaḥ anyasya |
yad vrīhiyaguṇaṃ śrutaṃ phalavat tannicāraguṇaṃ kriya- māṇamaphalakaṃ bhavati |
vi— 'dravye pratinidhirnāsti vidyate vā, na vidyate |
bhāṭṭa-- kāmye ārambhoccam, nitye tataḥ pūrvamapi, śrutadravyālabhe dvyantaraṃ pratinidhiṃ na vā iti cintāyām, aśaktau aṅgadānena prayoge'pi aṅgagrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
tathāhi, na tāvat dravyādiśāstram, tasya vrīhitvādyavacchinnavidhāyakatvena nīvārādyavidhāyakatvāt |
nāpi karmaśāstraṃ tadākṣepakama, dravyākṣepeṇa dvyantarāsādhāraṇakṣepatvena vrīhādi- vidhānāt dvyantarāsādhāraṇatve'patteḥ |
nahi vrīhiśāstraṃ śabdato niyamavidhiḥ, api tu ākṣepapratibandhadvārā phalataḥ |

ataśca yathaiva agni-viyayoḥ svavidhiprayuktayo- reva lābhāt ākṣepapratibhavena aśaktasya śrudadevau na tadākṣepaḥ, api tu agni-vidhayoḥ adhikāraviśeṣaṇa- tvamaṅgīkṛtya tadat adhikāraḥ; evaṃ dravyāṃśe'pi pradhāna- vidhinā ākṣepāt vrīhādiśrutadravyataḥ eva adhi- kāritvakalpane na dvyantaropadānamiti prayogotsarga eva yuktaḥ |
iti prāpte, dravyākṣepeṇa dvyantarāsādhāraṇya ākṣepapratibandhe'pi vrīhādīnāṃ agni-vidhayoriva svatantra- prayogavidhitvetyatvāt |
prajāyāditva pradhānavidhivaiva teṣāmadhikāriviśeṣaṇatvānupapattau nimittatvalāt aśaktau tyāgenāpi pradhānakartavyatā''davagateḥ; tasya ca dvyantara- mantareṇa ayogāt yuktaṃ tadākṣepatvam |
agni-vidha- yostu svatantraprayogavidhisiddhayoḥ etatyogavidhiviṣaya- tvābhāvena yathāśakyupapattiviṣayatvābhāvāt yuktaṃ adhi- kāriviśeṣaṇatvamiti vaiṣamyam |

na ca evamapi dravyasyo- ttivākye śrutasya nimittānvayāt pūrvameva yāgādā- nyathāt paścādagyamānanimitte eva dravyāvaccheda- kalpanāt dravyāvacchinnajīvanādareva nimittatvāvagateḥ kathaṃ dvyantareṇa yāga iti vācyam |
viśiṣṭavidhau nimittā- nyathāt pūrvaṃ bhāvanāmanvitasyāpi dravyasya viśeṣaṇavidhau yāgāṅgatābodhadaśāyāṃ yāgataphalavattvajñānārthaṃ kāma-yāva- jīvavākyābhyāṃ ekavākyatvāṅgīkāreṇa nimittapāpakṣayā-
nyottarameva dravyasya yāgājñābodhena prajājāditvat tatrāpi yathāśaktyupapadyopapatteḥ |
atastadā karmaśāstreṇa sadṛśa- sādhāraṇyena dvyantarākṣepāt yuktaḥ pratinidhiḥ |
tasya ca aṅgatvābhāve'pi upakārakatvamātreṇa grahaṇaṃ bodhyam |
evaṃ ca karmacodanayā yatkiṃcidravyaprāptau yuktyantareṇa sadṛśya, vacanena ca pūrvikānāṃ niyamaḥ iti vakṣyate |
tatkāryāpanne (janapadapuraparipālanakaṣṭoddharaṇa- rūparājakāryāpanne) pratinidhinyāyena brāhmaṇādau rāja- śabda iti draṣṭavyam |
pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇāta prati, tilebhyaḥ prativacchati māṣān |
jīvananimittakāmahotrādau nimittasya pratikṣaṇaṃ bhedāt pratinimittaṃ naimittikāvṛttyā saṃtānasyānuṣṭhānapratīteḥ tadanu- rodhena aśaktvājñatvaḥ vakṣyate |

'yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvato vāruṇān catuṣkapālān' ityatra na ca yāvattvācchabdābhyāṃ kriyā- dravyasya saṃbandhamātratāvatau śeṣitvapakṣe ārādupakārakatvena tantratvāpatteḥ tāvacchabdārthaprāpyabhāvena vidheyatvaprasaṅgāt, nimittatvapakṣe ca pratinimittaṃ naimittikāvṛttyanayena tāvacchabdārthasya prāptatvena avidheyatvāt vidhilāghavānu- rodhena nimittatvāvagatiḥ siddhānte'pi sulbhā iti vācyam |
vā. āvṛttiprasaktau kālekyena tantratvaprāpteḥ tāvacchabdasya pratiprasavavidhitvāttvasambhavāt |
'vasantavasante jyotiṣṭumā yajeta' ityatra guṇabhūta- kālānurodhena pradhānāvṛtteḥ aprāptatvā vīpsā'rthasyāpi vidheyatve vākyabhedāt |
'pratinimittaṃ' iti nyāya- prāptatvā''rtinuvādatvāt tadākhyāsyā eva saptamyāḥ nimittaparatvāt |
ke. pratipatta (vahiṣvamanāgatā) saṃsava-gosava -apacityādau ubhayasadbhi na upavatī, na agriyavatī, kintu anyaiva |
pratipadoḥ ('yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ, ete asugram' ityetayoḥ jyotiṣṭomāt) kulāyādau utkarṣaḥ, na tu jyotiṣṭome eva niveśaḥ |
pratipadoḥ pṛṣṭhagatayoḥ upavatyavayavayoḥ naimittikoḥ prākṛtayoḥ saṃsadāvikṛtau nānuṣṭhānam |
pratipadidhānasya dvitvabahutvayuktasya śrutvā dvivahu- yajamānakatvantarasaṃyutasya jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe viniyoga- nivṛttiḥ |
(karma bādhitvā api prathamaṃ lakṣaṇāni saṃgṛhyante, anantaraṃ udāharaṇadīni |
vi. 3|4|12, prati- pattiḥ iṣṭa-(yajña) śiṣṭasya saṃskāraḥ |
pratipattiḥ; nāma karma bhūtayopabhogadravyasaṃskārārthaṃ dṛṣṭārthaṃ saṃnipatyopakārakaṃ kṛtyaṃ pravṛttitirūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma |
sā ca pratipattiḥ trividhā- pradhānottarakālā, pradhānapūrva- kālā, pradhānasamakālā ceti |
vāla. pṛ. 82. prati- pattiḥ nāma saṃskārarūpo dṛṣṭo'rthaḥ |

tatkṣa rājanirmālyādīnāṃ pareṇa śirasā dhāraṇapustakare kṛte rājaḥ svātmani ati- śayabuddheḥ mānasapratyakṣasiddhatvāt ihāpi (vidhānāprāsane- 'pi) niṣpannasyāpi kāryasya (kaṇḍuyanasya) tadīya- dravyapratipattyā saṃbhavatiśayaḥ |
vi. 10|2|9. pratipatte- lakṣaṇamuktam 'utpattau yena saṃyuktaṃ tadarthaṃ tat śrutihetu- lāt tasyārthāntaragame śeṣatvāt pratipattiḥ syāt |
ke. pratipattiḥ agnipomīye paṣṭhau ekādaśādiṣu ca guḍhairupayajanam |
bhā. 12|4| 418. pratipattiḥ atiriktasya, na tu atirekayitavyaṃ iti śāstramasti |
4|1| 2|8|20-22. mī. ko. 699 'avabhṛthe ṛjīṣādi- nayanam' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
na caivaṃ nikāyasya saṃskārakalpake ( arthakarmalapso'nyaḥ :) 'pratipatti' ityekādaśādhikaraṇasūtravirodhaḥ, tasya tupāṃśe pratipattinirākaraṇārthatvenāpi upapatteḥ |
kau. 2|3|1|24. pṛ. 85. pratipattiḥ iyamekadeśasya, ekadeśasya ca homaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome 'puroḍāśaśakalamaindrāvayava pātre nidadhāti, dānā āśritānāṃ pātre, yasyāṃ maitrāvaruṇapātre' iti |
ke. (bhā. 12|4|18) prati- pattiḥ cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyāḥ prāsanam |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 259. vacanāntareṇa śeṣabhāve avagate anyatra saṃyoge bhavati pratipattiḥ; yathā sviṣṭakṛt |
dupu. 4|2|15|4. kṛtārthapratipattayaḥ śeṣakāryāṇi svayameva na akṛtaprayojanamapi dravyaṃ prayu-ñjate |
su. pṛ. 1692. pratipatteḥ prayogamadhye vidhānābhāve sayānantare pratipattividhānādeva kalpyate |
vinā'pi pratipattiṃ karma saphalaṃ sādhayati, parantu anyayāpratipattau duṣyati’ iti |
tataśca karmaṇaḥ svakārya-janane pratiparyanvekṣaṇāt na phalajanakatvavirodhaḥ |
soma. 11|1|13. na ca pratipattermantro'nya na mavati |
pratipattistu dṛṣṭārthatvena sutarāṃ prayojanavatī niyamādṛṣṭasiddhayarthaṃ ca apekṣate vaidikāni sādhanāni |

vā. 3|5|15. pratipattīnāṃ pratipādaprayojakatvayogarūpanyāyena yathā pratipādyo-tpattiprayojakatvābhāvaḥ sidhyati, evaṃ pratipādyasya śāstrataḥ kṛtsnabheme prāpte tadāraṇaprayojakatvamapi sidhyatyeva |
bhā. 8|4|127. pratipattiniyamaḥ gudasya dṛṣṭārthaḥ: agnīṣomīye paśau |
yatra svarūpaṃ paricchidyate tat saṃvedamityucyate, tataḥ svarūpaparicchedaḥ saṃvedana-mucyate |
svarūpagrahaṇaṃ hi, pratyakṣaṃ vihāya anyadato nāsti iti svarūpagrahaṇaṃ pratyakṣam |
tat kutaḥ ? naiva hi prathame'dhyāye sūtrakāreṇa kiñcana lakṣaṇe pramāṇādeḥ svarūpamupavarṇitam |
tatrāma lakṣaṇamucyate, yena tadvyatiriktatveḥ tasya svarūpaṃ vyāvṛttākāraṃ nirūpyate |
pratyakṣa-mapi dharma prati animittatvena upanyastam, na lakṣaṇatvena iti vyākhyātam |
na ca śabdo'pi kaścit dharmapramāṇa-bhūto lakṣitaḥ, asminevādhikaraṇe tasya lakṣaṇatvāt |
yadi ca vṛttikāreṇa sarveṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pradarśitam, na tada adhyāyārthatvena upasaṃhartuṃ yuktam, sūtrādhyāyārthādhyāyārtha-madhyāyamapyupalena samāsaḥ |
) kathaṃ ca samasta-lakṣaṇavyatirikte evāye sūtrāṇi kṣīyan |
athiva vṛttikāreṇa yo'pi uktaḥ (pramāṇa) ghaṭakaḥ pratyakṣapūrvakaḥ aparīkṣyatayā, so'pi naiva lakṣaṇagocaraḥ |
lakṣaṇasiddhā-rthāni hi tāni aparīkṣyatvenoktāni, na prathamādhyāya-viṣayatvena upasaṃhāramarhanti |
tasmāt yat prathamādhyāye vṛttam, tadālocya etadadhyāyaṃ neyam |
tatra pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ tāvat codanālakṣaṇaśraya (śravaṇam iti yuktam ) |
ataḥ avacāritālakṣaṇaśabdasahacaryāt pramāṇaśabdaḥ ‘pratipādyate’ ityevaṃ vyutpādya dharmaviṣayaḥ eva vyākhyāyeyaḥ |
satyapi prameyamātravācitve asmin śāstre jijñāsyatvena dharmaḥ prameyaḥ prakāntaḥ; iti sa eva gṛhyate |
( pūrvaṃ pramāṇaśabdasya karmavyutpattiḥ- ) athavā karaṇeva pramāṇam, tasyaiva lakṣaṇamuktam |
yadyapi ca sarvapramāṇatāṃ tanoktam, tathāpi dharmapramāṇasya codanātvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ityetāvadeva uktaṃ manyate |
na cāvaśyaṃ sarvamainaiva lakṣite lakṣaṇatvam, viśeṣarūpāṇāmanyena sarvalakṣaṇabhāvāprasaṅgāt |
athapi aucityakasūtreṇa viśeṣo'-pyuka eva yena āgamaviśeṣo gamyate |
athavā upanyastasya codanātmakasya pramāṇasya lakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇya-kāraṇamityupasaṃhāraḥ |
tathā yadyapi ‘vicitedaṃ rūpam, idamarthavādasya, idaṃ mantrasya’ ityevaṃ noktam, tathāpi dharma prati upayogibhānāt tattvaṃ nirṇītam |
śrutimutvaṃ vijñānasya smṛtiprāmāṇye tattvam, nāmadheyasya codanāntargatatvāt pramāṇatvam, saṃdigghārthanirṇaye vākyaśeṣasāmarthyatoḥ prāmāṇyaṃ ityevaṃ samastamadhyāyaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇamācaṣṭe |
‘tatra prasastavyam’ iti ( bhāṣyam ) asmin-prāmāṇyo hi medādipratipādanam ‘aviśeṣadhanārthakaṃ hi syāt’ ( 2|1|12 ) iti kriyamāṇaṃ sahate |
nanu pradhānā-pradhānacintā tṛtīyacaturthayorviṣayaḥ : kathametropanpasthe ? ( atra ) kecidāhuḥ- ‘iha dravyakarmaṇoḥ, uttaratra tu karmaṇāmeva guṇapradhānatvavicārāt apaunaruktyam’ iti |
tena evaṃ vācyam- ‘lakṣaṇārtho'tra tattvena bhedaḥ’ śabdabhedādibhiḥ |
karmabhedastāvat autsargikau lakṣaṇārthaḥ; tadapavādatvena abhedaḥ; tadupaniṣādatve tu apūrvamedā-medī |
tatra pratikarmabhedaṃ apūrvabhedaprasaktī tṛtīyasiddhaḥ pradhānāpradhānavicāraḥ punarapavādatvena ārapsyate |
niyamapūrvam, tat kriyākṛtaṃ na bhavati iti na tayā vyapadiśyate |
tena yatraiva dravyadāni prati kriyāṇāṃ pradhāna- svam, tatraiva tadbhedanimittāpūrvabhedasiddheḥ |
asya ca vivekārthaṃ yat guṇapradhānalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate, tadapavādārtham 'dharmamātre tu' 'stutaśastrayoḥ' iti cādhikaraṇadvayaṃ prastauti |
tataśca ākhyātādvaividhye vicārite prasaṅgāt tṛtīyaṃ prakāraṃ abhidhāyakatvaṃ pratipādayituṃ mantraprastāvaḥ |
tataḥ śabdāntarābhyāsābhyāṃ bhedamuktvā paurṇamāsyādhikaraṇena abhyāsāpavādaḥ kariṣyate, samudāyānuvādatvāt |
tatra ca ṣaṭkātiriktabhedakāraṇavyudāsaḥ, saṃjñā'bhyāsaguṇaprakriyāṇāṃ ca āśaṅkānivṛttiḥ ityetāvān bhedalakṣaṇārthaḥ |
eva eva kāryaḥ avaśyaṃ vaktavyaḥ ajñā- dvitvādyavadhāraṇārtham |
' prāk tāvat pramāṇalakṣaṇata vedārthavicāramātratvāt kasya cidabhedalakṣaṇadeḥ prastāvaḥ, ityuttarakālamārambhaḥ |
tatrāpi śeṣaśeṣitvaṃ prayojanāpra- jakaratvaṃ karmaśca bhinnānāṃ bhavatīti na bhedalakṣaṇāt prāgā- rabhyate |
tathā adhikāraḥ karmasvarūpe'vadhārite tadyogyatayā śakyo nirūpayitumiti patrāpi lakṣaṇāni pratīyate |
(dvitīyādhyāyatātparyam -) bhāṣyam-- tadiha ṣaḍvidhaḥ karmabhedo vakṣyate, śabdāntaram, abhyāsaḥ, saṃkhyā, guṇaḥ, prakriyā, nāma- dheyamiti |
vakṣyamāṇamanusaṃkīrtyate, pradarśitamucyamānaṃ sukhaṃ grāhayiṣyate iti, śrutuśca buddhiḥ samādhīyate |
vakṣyamāṇasūtrakramānurodhānāmarthe saṃkhyāntare paṭhitavye sat anādisattve paṭhitam |
athavā karaṇe bhedaśabdaṃ vyutpādya sāmānādhikaraṇyenaiva śabdāntarādīni vyākhyāsyeti |
saṃjñāśabdāntarayoḥ saṃkhyā- guṇayośca adhīnatvaṃ svasthāne vakṣyāmaḥ |
' yathā idamadhikaraṇaṃ prakṛtānuniṣpādyapūrva- bhedānumārasiddhayarthaṃ upoddhātatvena bhaviṣyati |
(anu- sarati iti kartari ghañ vyutpādya prakṛtau yaḥ anuniṣpādya- pūrvabhedaḥ medānusārī karmabhedaḥ, tassidarthamiti yojyam |
) katarassāt padāt phalena saṃbadhyamānāt apūrvabhedābhedau anugantavyau iti |
(anena ca 'nāmārthasya phalabhāvanā- karaṇatvaṃ dhātvarthasya vā' ityadhikaraṇārthaḥ sūcitaḥ |
codanā ca kriyāyā abhi- dhāyakaṃ vākyam |
tatra kiṃ padenapadena dharmaḥ, uta sarvaireka eveti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? pratipadaṃ dharma iti |
yadā ekassātpūrvam, tadā anyat tadarthaṃ bhaviṣyati, evama- līyasī aṣṭamānumānaprasaktyaiva bhaviṣyati |
vā-- yadā niravayavaṃ vākyavākyārthau syātām, 'tataḥ kiṃ pratipadaṃ dharmaḥ ?' ityādiḥ asaṃbaddha eva vicāraḥ syāt |
dharmaḥ prati- padaṃ vācyaḥḥ kathamāśaṅkyate tadā ||
' yadi hi dharmasvarūpamabhidhīyeta, tataḥ 'kiṃ padenapadena' ucyate iti vicāro yujyate, lākṣaṇikaṃ tvayuktaḥ |
' na cātra yo dharmaḥ sa kiṃ padenapadenocyate ityevaṃ vicāryate |
kiṃ tarhi ? yaḥ padenapadenocyate, sa kiṃ phalasaṃbandhottarakālaṃ vākyārthatvena gamyamāno dharmo bhavati, athetapadārthāt- gṛhītaḥ |
tathā ca sarverekasya dharmatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ bhavati |
na tu sarveṣāmekaḥ kaściddharmo'sti, yaḥ sarvai- reka ityevāmāśrayeta |
yacca phalapadena saha saṃbadhyate tasyārtha dharmapūrvasādhanaṃ ca manyante |
tena kiṃ sarvāṇi padāni phalena saṃbadhyante kiṃvā ekamiti vicāraḥ |
' yadi hi viśeṣo gamyeta 'idaṃ phala- saṃbandhayogaṃ idaṃ na' iti, tataḥ kiñcideva saṃbadhyeta |
anavagamyamāne tu sarvāṇi padāni phalena saṃbadhyante |

yadi ca ekaṃ phalasaṃbandham itarāṇi ca tatsaṃbandhīni iti kalpyate tato vājapeyādhikaraṇanyāyena ekasya phala prati upādānavidhānaguṇābhāvāt itarat pratyudeśānuvādaprādhānyāt vairūpyanimittavākyabhedaprasaṅgaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ tu phalaṃ prati upādīmānānāṃ aikarūpyāt tantrasaṃbandhopapattiḥ |
sarvaśca sati saṃbheve guṇamatitadvya pradhānenaiva nityaṃ saṃbadhyate |
tatra kiṃ sannivat pratyekaṃ kṛtsnaṃ phalaṃ sādhayati, atha darśāpūrṇamāsavatasaha |
tathā kiṃ vikalpena samuccayena vā ityādi yatheṣṭaṃ kalpanī- yam |
tatra phalabhūmagarīyastvāt ekaśabdopādānābhāvāt sannivat pratyekaṃ sādhanaśaktatvagamāt sarvebhyaḥ pṛthak phala- miti pakṣaḥ |
athavā aruṇā''dinyāyena ekavākyo- pādānāt saṃhatānāṃ phalam |
athavā ekanirākāṅkṣatvāt na tadānīmeva itarasaṃbandhopapattiḥ, tasmāt vikalpa iti |
tadalpatopapattau ca na yuktā bahu- kalpanā ||
' yadi hi phalasaṃbandhamātrārthasāvyeva vākyaṃ bhavet, tataḥ kadācidapi sarvāṇi phalena saṃbadhyeran |
iha tu tāvanmātreṇa asiddheḥ apūrvamanyat kalpayitavyam |
yo hi anekāni apūrvāṇi kalpayati, kalpayatyasau ekam |
tacet kalpitam, artha- vattvād vākyasya kṣīṇā anyathā'nupapattiḥ |
tasmādekameva phalasaṃbandhaṃ, tasmācca apūrvaṃ itarat phaladupakāri ityevavyadīvyate |

na cātra virodho bhaviṣyati, nāmadheyatvena parihārāt, agnyā vā 'daśāpavitreṇa grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' itivat matvarthalakṣaṇayā''- śrayaṇāt arthākṣiptasādhyāṃśadvāreṇa vā dhātvartheḥ ātmīya- karaṇagrahasiddheḥ |
evaṃ sthite kataradekaṃ saṃtrayatāmiti sarvathā anekā- dṛṣṭakalpanāparihārāt aniyamaprāptau ucyate 'pradhānaṃ phalasaṃbandhi tatsaṃbandhyuṣyiṣyate |
' na hi ekasmin vākye tadeva kadācit phalasaṃbandhāt pradhānam, kadācit phala- vadupakārāt aṅgaṃ yujyate, niyatarūpatvād dvāntibhāvasya |
tasmāt niyogeneva ākhyātapadāt nāmapadādvā apūrva- pratītiḥ |
śā-- yāvatkiñcit ahārthaṃ vidhānaṃ kalpyaṃ puru- ṣārthaṃ kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ vā dravyopapadaṃ vā nāmopapadaṃ vā guṇopapadaṃ vā-- tā tat sarvamudāharaṇam |
(prābhākaramatamupa- nyasya nirasyati--) ke cittu adhikāracodanā evo- dāharanti |
tāsu ca sarvāsu viruddhatrikadvayāpatyā nāme- vopapadam |
yadyapi tāvadadhikāracodanā evodā- haraṇam, tathāpi tāsu sarvāsu na nāmaivopapadam |
yadeva hi yaugika-vākyabheda-tatpratya-tadvyapadeśayuktam, tadeva nāmadheyam, itaracca adhikāravāgatamapi guṇārthameva |
yathā 'yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeteti sa cahuhotāraṃ juhu- yāt' iti cahuhotraśabdo mantravacanaḥ, na nāmadheyam |
tathā 'yathenamārtvijayāt sutaṃ santāṃ nihareran āmīgre juhuyāt daśahotāraṃ caturgṛhītenājyena' iti naimittikā- dhikāragataṃ ājyam na nāmadheyam |
na ca viruddhatrika- dvayāpattiḥ, matvarthalakṣaṇayā viśiṣṭavidhisaṃbhavāt |
varaṃ ca matvarthalakṣaṇā aprasiddhārthakalpanātaḥ, itarathā hi 'somena
na cātra karaṇībhāvāttayornārthyabhātva- bhāvi viniyogavidhisādhya-phalabhāvanākaraṇatvātsānuguṇatayā bhreyoḥ sahabhāvaḥ samasta |
nāmārthasya karaṇatvaṃ dhātvarthaniṣpādaka- bhūtenaiva dhātvarthena dhyenādināṃbhāve vinaiva matvarthalakṣaṇā svenaiva |
evaṃ sati viniyogadaśāyāṃ gṛhīta- nāmārthasya svarūpataḥ sāhityam, kāryatvastu bhaviṣyati |

dhyenādhikārakartavya yāgādeḥ dhātvarthasya karaṇatvāt tathāhi, yasminneva kāle nāmārthena dhātvartho janyate, karaṇasya karaṇāttarāṇyāsaṃbhavāt pūrvapratītasaṃbandhadhānānurodhena tadaiva tatsāhityamapūrvārntata janitam, atastadadvāreṇa matvarthalakṣaṇā na doṣamāvahati |
etacca śabdā- ekasmādeva dhyenāto yāgāt yāgato vā dhyenādapūrva- vagatakaraṇatvānyā'nupapattyā kalpyamānaṃ na doṣamāvaha- miti siddham |
tadapūtalopapattau tu na yuktā bahu- karaṇatvaṃ śrautaṃ bhavet, kintu bhāvanākāṅkṣayā tat kalpa- kalpanā ||
tatra dhātvarthasya saṃnikṛṣṭasya karaṇatvaṃ phalabhāvanā- saṃbandhāt kalpanīyam |
nāmārthasya ca klṛptakaraṇabhāvasya bhāvāryādhikaraṇapravṛtteḥ ekasmādapūrva iti nirṇayā- viprakṛṣṭasya phalabhāvanāsaṃbandhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ |
ku. 21|1|2 pṛ. 121. pratipadādhikaraṇasya ubhayakaraṇatvena samuccayasiddhayarthamavaśyamevāpūrvārntata kalpa- 'tāni dhyeyam' 2|1|2|6 apavādaḥ |
na caikasya kalpane'tastatra vākya- pṛ. 2. pratipadādhikaraṇasya siddhāntaḥ (nyāyasvarūpameva nyo na saṃbhavati, itaranāgrāhakatavenetarānanyayopapatteḥ |
idam ) 'kriyākāraka saṃbandhavagamanānusāreṇa ekasmādeva tena yadi saṃnikarṣalomena dhātvarthaḥ karaṇam, tadā nāmā- apūrvam, na tu sarvebhyaḥ' iti |
viprakṛṣṭasyāpi nāmārthasya karaṇatvam, tadā dhātvarthasya ku. 2|1|2|1. tadvyāpāratvenaiva samanvayānna karaṇatvamapi kalpanīyam |

pratipadādhikaraṇokta anekādṛṣṭakalpanāprasaṅga- na caivaṃ dhātvarthasya phalabhāvanāyām, nāmārthasya ca dhātvarthe sthānivāraṇārthaṃ somādeḥ phalasaṃbandhaḥ ('somena vidhānādājapeyaukatve'pyanupapannaḥ |
kau. 2|1|3 pṛ. 8. matvarthalakṣaṇā āśrīyate, tadā lakṣaṇaiva doṣa iti anyānvite śaktiḥ ityatra pratipadādhikaraṇagataṃ varamapūrvadavyakalpaneveti |
śāstraprakāśikā (bṛhadāraṇyaka- sāreṇaiva bhavantī matvarthalakṣaṇā yadyapūrvakalpanāto jyāyasī bhāṣyavārtikaṭīkā) saṃgraha 611. na bhavet |

pratipadādhikaraṇanyāyasya svarūpam 'apūrvatvā- utpattiśca na dhātvarthasvarūpamātram, viniyogavasthāyā- dṛṣṭatvāt ekakalpyatayaiva upapanne vākye nānekalpyanaṃ upa- mapi dhātvarthasvarūpajñānāviśeṣāt, kintu bhāvanāsādhya- pattimat' iti |

tatra yadyapi utpattividherupa- tatra hi tat niyāmakam, yatra tatpadyate pūrva kāryabhūtatvāt dhātvarthasya na svāsvadhā bhāvanā sādhyatvena parvyasyati, tathāpi asyāsāhityasya sādhanatvātsaṃbhavāt varṇakaṃ 2 pṛ. 134. vikalpena anekeṣu prāptiḥ, yathā pratipadādhikaraṇa- siddhāntarītyā yāgasomayoḥ |
pratipaśuyūpadarśanāt liṅgāt paśugaṇeṣu aikā- pratipradhānaṃ guṇa āvartanīya iti nyāyaḥ |
8|1|8|15. sāhasī. 868. pratipādyaprayojakatvāyogarūpanyāyena prati- grahmiti dvitīyā grahasyodeśyatayā prayojanavacayā pastīnāṃ pratipādyotpattiprayojakatvābhāvaḥ sidhyati |
'prati- pṛ. 109. pradhānaṃ guṇā āvartanīyaḥ' iti nyāyena yāvanto grahāḥ santi te saṃmārjanīyāḥ |
na hotat pratipūraṇaṃ pūrvasthā- pratipradhānaṃ guṇo bhidyate, na ca pradhānaṃ pratiguṇaṃ vadānasya saṃskārakam, adṛṣṭārthatvaprasaṅgāt |
vā. 3|1|1|12. prāpteṣu pañcādyeṣu prājeṣu ekaikādaśasaṃkhyā yuktā, prayājanudidhya saṃkhyāguṇe vihite sati 'pratipradhānaṃ pratipradhānamaṅgāvṛttaḥ iti lokasiddho nyāyaḥ guṇasyābhyupetatvāt' |

bhā. 10|1|1|13. pṛ. 1198. 'yajñasya saṃtatiriti... tvā yajñasya na ca (vaiśvadevasya annasaṃskāratve) 'pratipradhānaṃ iti gārhapatyatā saṃtatamuparparājanī stuṇāti ā āhava- guṇāvṛttaḥ' iti nyāyāt pratipākaṃ tadāvṛttiḥ syāt nīyāt, tūṣṇīṃ dakṣiṇā tūṣṇīmuttaram |
tatastu ṛtvijāṃ prādhānye sati pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttyā sarveṣā- 'pratipradhānamaṅgāvṛttaḥ' iti mantrāvṛttau prāptāyām mapi ṛtvijāṃ hiraṇyamālityādirseskāraḥ anyapyetavyaḥ |
vi. 4|8|15. indrasya, cayane tadaṅgabhūte- vaijayantī. śeṣāt sviṣṭakṛte'vadyati |
yadi śeṣa- ndradevatve avahitamantrake home ca |

samuccayaneva ubha- kāryāṇāṃ haviḥ pradhānaṃ syāt, tadā pratipradhānaṃ iti nyāya- yājñatvam, pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛtteyuktetvena vikalpasyā- prāptiḥ, tadeva na śeṣakārya prati aṅgatvān haviḥ iti prasaktatvāt |

kau. 3|1|7|4 pṛ. 350. cenna, haviḥ pradhānatvena saṃskārarūpakāraṇasya avi- ṛcāṃ pradhānatvāt pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttyetyata sāma- śeṣāt sarvebhyaḥ avadānaṃ pratipradhānamaṅgāvṛttiḥ iti pratyucaṃ parisamāpanīyaṃ iti siddham |
kastūri. 3|4|19|48-49. na ca 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti hautro mantraḥ ekādaśināṃ |
kaścana virodhaḥ, yat indramupalipta anena mantrena ('kadā ekādaśavāraṃ prayoktavyaḥ 'pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛtteḥ' iti prāpte, cana starīsi' ) gārhapatyamapi |
nanu ayameva virodhaḥ kriyamāṇānuvādimantrasya adṛṣṭārthatvena tatraiva |
upa- parirarti' iti āvartyamantraparaḥ tasya karaṇātvāt |
syemedāt pratipradhānamāvartante guṇāḥ iti nyāyāt saṃkalpa. 4|1|4|9. pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttyāḥ |

pṛ. 844. indragārhapatyayoḥ pradhānatvāviśeṣāt 1|1|1|14 sūtram. ekādaśatvādidaṃsaṃkhyā prati- upasthānasya ca guṇatvāt 'pratipradhānaṃ guṇaḥ' iti pradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttyanyāyena pṛthakjādyāditvat ekaikasmin nyāyena upasthānāvṛttyā śrutiliṅgayoḥ samuccayaḥ iti prayājādī pratyekaṃmisaṃvetyata ekaikaḥ ekādaśavāra- dvitīyaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 5|1|1. darśapūrṇa- mī. ko. 342 māsayoḥ avaghātamantraḥ pratiprahāraṃ āvarteta navetiḥ
cintāyāṃ somādivat prathamataḥ bhāvanā'nvitasyāpi mantrasya avaghātāṅgatvenapāyāt pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttikanyāyena badāgacchet ādyaiḥ; iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
na caivamapi dvitīyā tṛtīyā prādhānyāt pratipradhānaṃ guṇā- vṛttikanyāyena caturṣu muṣṭiṣu catvāro nirvāpā vihitāḥ saṃpannā iti mukhyanusamaya eveti vācyam |

na ca pūrvapadasya abhripadasāmānyādhikaraṇyenahāpyaparatvāt pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttikanyāyena pratidhāraṇaṃ mantrāvṛttiḥ, bodhā- yanena asya gārhapatyādhāne viniyuktatayā pūrvapadasya kriyāviśeṣaṇatvamaṅgīkṛtya prathamāndhādhānavidhiparatvāt |

'maitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānvāha ca' atra maitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣānuvacanena vidhīya- mānaḥ sarvatra ( kevalapreṣu kevalanuvacaneṣu preṣasahitānu- vacaneṣu ca ) syāt na tu maiṣānuvacaneṣveva uddeśya- viśeṣaṇasya sāhityasyāvivakṣitatvāt |

caśandasyāpi maiṣānuvacanarūpadharmayoḥ ekādhikaraṇyarūpadharmasāhityaparatvena preṣānuvacanatvarūpadharmayoḥ ekādhikaraṇyarūpasāhitya- bodhakatvābhāvāt, tasya ca pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛtti- nyāyenaiva asamante'pi siddhe'nuvādatvāt |
ataśca sarvatraiva samāmnāyaprāptamantratvāt vākyāt maitrāvaruṇa- niveśaḥ |
viśeṣeṇa sāmānyāpavāde avagate pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttikanyāyena mantrā- vṛttisvīkāre'pi na kaściddoṣaḥ |
sāman: ṛksarābhivyaktyarthatvenaiva prāptatvāt ṛcāṃ prādhānyāvagateḥ pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttikanyāyena pratyekameva śeyaṃ sāma |
hiraṇyaśakalaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ pratyekaṃ kartavyam, pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttikanyāyāt |
pradhānabhūtānāmapi ṛcāṃ ārthikaṃ sāmasādhanatvaṃ asyeveti tadvatasya tritvasya yuktameva sāmāṅgatvam |
ekasminneva prayoge ( satreṣu ) pratipradhānāvṛtti- nyāyena pratyekaṃ phalāvaśyambhāvaḥ |
( satre ) brahmādīnāṃ yajamānatvenaiva pratipradhānāvṛtti- nyāyena dīkṣāyāḥ tattatsaṃskārakatvaprāptiḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 5|1| 1, 'ya etenāniṣṭvā'thānthena yajate gatapatyameva tadumavati' ityatra vākyaśeṣasya kratuviśeṣopasthāpakatve'pi vidhau pratipradhānāvṛttikanyāyena sarvavidhivyapatteḥ sandehā- bhāvaḥ |
5|1|15 somasya tadaṅgasāttve pratipradhānā- vṛttikanyāyena tattadabhyāsāpūrvasādhanībhūtasyaprakṛtitvena vihi- tasya daśamuṣṭiparimitasya somasya caturmuṣṭiparimitahi- mevattvaṃ bhedaḥ prāpnuyāt |
kau. 214|18 pṛ. 222. pratipradhānāvṛttikanyāyāt kāmyasya yāvadicchayā āvṛttau kālasyāpi akṣatvena hetunā vīṇā'pi āvartyamānatayā sthitatvāt vyutpatti'narthakatvāt ... |
su. pṛ. 909, agnicaye paśvekādaśinīvidhānā- deva avihitā'pi yūpaikādaśinī pratipradhānāvṛtti- nyāyāt bhaviṣyati ityāśaṅkā |
ṛtvi- gdeśena hi ete guṇāḥ lohitoṣṇīṣatvādayaḥ vidhīya- mānāḥ, pratipradhānāvṛttikanyāyāt sarveṣāṃ bhavanto na śakyāḥ samālavyā bāṣitum |
mūla-nāmi-gulphapradeśapāvanāyeṣu 'citpatistva punātu' ityādimantreṣu 'acchidreṇa pavitreṇa' ityādi- śeṣo'pi anupūjyate pratipradhānāvṛttikanyāyāt |
apivā karmapṛthaktvāt teṣāṃ tantravidhānāt sāṅgānāmupadeśaḥ syāt ( 1|2|14|16 ) iti ekā- daśavakṣyamāṇapratipradhānāvṛttikanyāyābhāve'pi ... |
pratipradhānaguṇāvṛttikanyāyena pratyekamuddeśeṣu arthasiddhasya ekatvasya anuvādakameka- vacanam |
vāla. pṛ. 99. pratiprasavaḥ prasaktaprāptasya kāraṇā- ntareṇa nivṛttiprasaktau vidhiḥ |

hṛdayāvadānaṃ pratiprasavavidhinā apūrvavidhiḥ bādhyate, yathā kartṛtvaṃ pratiprasthātuḥ iti pakṣe pratiprasthātaḥ asti bhaktaḥ 'pūpā pratiprabhāgaḥ' iti preṣaṇasya carau pratiprasavakena iti śāstradīpikā |
tatpakṣe'pi nāsti iti bhāṭṭa- paśau puroḍāśe ca apūrvavidhiḥ bāla. pṛ. 144, dīpikā |
śrapayati' iti śrapaṇapratiprasavasya ghṛtaniyamasya caikatra vapāyāḥ śrapaṇamavyoḥ karma pratiprasthātā karoti |
vākye kartumaśakyatvāt pūrveṇottareṇa vā utpattitvātprāpta- tasmāt agnihomīye paśau pratiprasthātuḥ śeṣabhakṣaḥ syāt |
naudakāt khādirādereva prāpyā pratiprasavanyāyena somā- abhakṣo vā karmabhedāt tasyāḥ sarvapradānatvāt |
pṛ. 213... pratiprasthātā aṅgasyāpi ( paśau ) adhvaryuḥ vāśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣavyāvartakaḥ |
sa hi avadānaṃ karoti, 'dakṣiṇato nidhāya syāt |
karmabhedāt pratiprasthātā avadyati' iti ( cet ucyate ) yasyāṃ pratiprasthātā vapāṃ śrapayati, vapāśrapaṇaṃ ca nādhvaryukarma |
śākhāyāmetannāsti tatraiṣā ( pratiprasthātuḥ ) makṣaḥ asti pratiprasthātureva hi tat karma vihitam |
vapāyāḥ sarvapradānatvāt sarvaiva vapā agnī pradīyate, nāsti adhīṃ cāyaṃ mukhyadakṣiṇāyā arthaṃ ṣaḍ gāḥ labhate |

karmaśabdaśca 'pratiprasthātā adhvaryuṃ dīkṣayitvā adhino dīkṣayati, pradānaśabdaṃ gṛhītvā tena sarvāṃśadasya samānādhikaraṇa- brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, prastotāramudāttuḥ, maitrāvaruṇaṃ hyagṛhīstu naiva saṃbhavati |
pratiprasthātā avadyannapi nādhvaryukarmāṇi vartate iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. iti ( paśau ) nāsya adhveṣu bhakṣaḥ syāt |
mīko. pṛ. 113 'agnīṣomīye paśau 'uttare'au payomahān juhoti, dakṣiṇe'au surāgrahān |
pratiprasthātādayaḥ adhvaryubhinnā adhvaryupuruṣāḥ ( manthī grahaviśeṣo jyotiṣṭome ) |
sā ca vapā sarvaiva hutā iti pratiprasthātṛmaitrāvaruṇādayo hotakāḥ |
prasthātā maitrāvaruṇaḥ brāhmaṇācchaṃsī potā neṣṭā acchā- 7|8 ) |
pratiprasthātā adhvaryuḥ pṛthak cāturmāsyagata- vākaḥ āgnīdhraḥ iti ) |
pratiprasthātā mantrāḥ adhvaryoḥ pṛthaguccāraṇīyāḥ iti pratibhā'sya aniśrāyakatvānna mānam |
(vyabhicārāt arthaniścayātmaka anekāntaphaliṅgaprasūtaṃ saṃvedanaṃ pratibhā iti kecit |
vayaṃ (ekadeśinaḥ) tu sāmyasādhanetikartavyatācchalāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratipattau anukūlaṃ tatatipattyā kārye anuṣṭhāna- lakṣaṇe kartavye sahakāriṇī kartavyamiti praśnā pratibhā- madhyagībhamahi |
'pratibhātaśca (pañcamyāstasin ) paśyanti sarvaṃ prajñāvataṃ dhiyaḥ' iti nyāyaḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 126. pratiyogini śrute aśrutapratiyogikalpanā'nupa- pattiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1191. prativacanakāryaṃ 'upahataḥ' iti mantraḥ, 'upa- hyasva' iti prabhakāryaṃ somabhakṣe, jyotiṣṭome |
varakāḥ kodravā māṣāḥ iti pratiṣiddhaṃ dravyaṃ na prati- nidhittena grāhyam |
hi yasmāt aviśeṣeṇa māṣatvā- dinā sāmānyanaiva tacchrutiḥ niṣedhaśrutiḥ 'ayajñiyā vai varakāḥ kodravāḥ' 'ayajñiyā vai māṣāḥ' iti |
yathā devatā''dīnāṃ na kaścit pratinidhiḥ tathā māṣādikaṃ na kalpyāpi pratinidhiriti siddhāntaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 31. pratiṣedho dvividhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ kalpyaśca |
kalpyo'pi sasadhā smṛtikalpyaḥ, ācārakalpyaḥ, niṣedhakalpyaḥ, arthavādakalpyaḥ, mantra- kalpyaḥ, prāyaścittakalpyaḥ, daṇḍakalpyaśceti |
tatra smṛti- kalpyo yathā 'sagotrā na pariṇeyā' ityādi |
ācāra- kalpyo yathā harivāsaraparibhāṣite kāle pāraṇā niṣedhaḥ |
artha- vādakalpyo dvividhaḥ svatantrārthavādakalpyaḥ, vidhyantaraśeṣā- rthavādakalpyaśca |
ādya yathā smārtaḥ 'mithyā- 'miśaṃsane doṣo dviḥsamo bhūtavādinaḥ |
mithyā'miśaṃsa- doṣaṃ ca samādatte mṛṣā vadan ||
' dvitīyo yathā agnihotraprakaraṇe 'tasmādvāsaṃ jāta daśarātrīn dahanti' iti |
jātaṃ vatsaṃ anulakṣyīkṛtya tadanantaraṃ daśarātraṃ gaurna dohyā iti siddhavatkīrtanā'''nupapattyā niṣedhaḥ kalpyate, 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' iti vidhivat iti |
vidhyantaraśeṣārthavāda- kalpyo yathā 'tasmādāraṇyamevāśrīyāt' iti vidhiśeṣeṇa 'na vā ete māṣān havirgṛhṇanti' ityanena māṣaniṣedhaḥ kalpyate, 'upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti vidhivat |
mantrakalpyo'pi niṣedho vidhivat dvidhā, mantragatasyaiva nañuccarvartamānāpadeśasya niṣedhatvakalpanāt, niṣedhayukta- vākyāntarakalpanācca |
prāyaścittakalpyo yathā 'tadāhyaṃ āhitāgniryādi sūtakādi prābhīyāt, kā tatra prāyaścittamiti, so'gneye tantumate'ṣṭākapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirdhapet' iti |
daṇḍakalpyo yathā karmapradīpe 'yajña- nīye'hi somaśraddhāruṇyāṃ diśi dṛśyate |
tatra vyāhṛti- mirhutvā daṇḍaṃ dadyād dvijātaye ||
atra ca pūrvadine anvādhāne daṇḍa- vidhereva kalpyaḥ, tena tu niṣedhaḥ kalpyate iti |
niṣedhaḥ : smṛtyādikalpyo'pi yathāsaṃbhavaṃ jātivyakti- guṇakriyāviṣayatvena caturvidhaḥ |
) guṇaniṣedho yathā marīciḥ 'kaṅkakāni ca sarvāṇi virasani tathaiva ca |
kriyāniṣedho yathā vṛddhamanuḥ 'ṛtukāle niyukko vā naiva gacchet striyaṃ kvacit |
yathā hi bhojanā- śritaṃ prāḍmukhatvaṃ vidhīyate na bhojanam, evamatrāpi bhakṣaṇāśritaṃ masurādyeva niṣidhyate na bhakṣaṇam |
puruṣa- dhāryo dravyaniṣedho yathā 'ucchiṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayet' iti |
puruṣārtho guṇaniṣedho yathā 'śuklaṃ na bhakṣayet' iti |
puruṣārthaḥ kriyā- niṣedho yathā smārtaḥ, manuḥ 'surā vai malamannānāṃ pāpmā ca malamyucyate |
tasmād brāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśyaśca na surāṃ pibet ||
taduktaṃ vijñāneśvareṇa 'rogiṇyādiṣu tu dṛṣṭavirodha eva' iti |
dvitīyo yathā śrāddhe vihita- syāpi māṃsasya niṣedhaḥ |
puruṣārthastu smārtādiniṣedhaḥ eka- vidha eva puruṣārthamātraviṣayaka iti |
puruṣārthamātraviṣayakaḥ puruṣārthaniṣedho dvividhaḥ : rāga- prāptaviṣayakaḥ vidhiprāptaviṣayakaśca |
ādyo yathā udā- hṛto mānavaḥ surāniṣedhaḥ |
dvitīyo yathā ṣaṣṭhe 'tasyā yāvaduktam 0' ityadhikaraṇe (6|1|6|24) striyā adhyayananiṣedhaḥ iti |
pratyakṣo niṣedhaḥ śrautaḥ : so'pi caturvidhaḥ : jātiniṣedhaḥ, vyaktiniṣedhaḥ, guṇaniṣedhaḥ, kriyāniṣedhaśceti |
tatra jāti- niṣedho yathā 'tasmād bahiṣpi rajataṃ na deyam' iti |
kartṛniṣedha eva cāyam, na kriyāniṣedhaḥ, tathānye vihitakriyāniṣedhāt tenaiva vikalpasiddho daśame 'tadu same''nayet' iti prati- prasavalena vikalpo'trikalpyatvāt |
guṇaniṣedhaḥ śrauto yathā ṣaṣṭhe saptamapāde (adhi0 10) āghāne 'ekā deyā . dvādaśa deyāḥ' ityādi vidhāya 'aparimitaṃ deyam' iti |
tatra pūrvapakṣet ayaṃ pūrvoktasarvasaṃkhyāprati- ṣedha iti |
kriyāniṣedhaḥ śrauto yathā 'nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti |
tatra puruṣārtho jātiniṣedho yathā anārabhyāmnātaḥ 'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayenna laśunaṃ na gṛñjanam' iti |
dravyaniṣedhaḥ pratyakṣo yathā 'na malvadāsā saha saṃvadet' iti, malvadāsaḥ śabdasya yaugikatvāt |
guṇaniṣedhaḥ puruṣārthaḥ pratyakṣo yathā 'raja- skhalāteṣu na sarveṇa pātreṇa pibet' iti parimāṇa- niṣedhaḥ |
puruṣārtho śrautaḥ : kriyāniṣedho yathā 'na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni' iti nañjuṭīkāyāyāṃ vārtikakṛtoktaḥ |
pratyakṣa niṣedhaḥ : sarvo'pi aṣṭārtha eva, dṛṣṭārthastu nāstyeva |
śrauto niṣedhaḥ ṛtvarthaḥ : trividhaḥ : puruṣārthamātraviṣayakaḥ ṛtvarthamātraviṣayakaḥ ubhayaviṣayakaśca |
vidhiprāpta- puruṣārthamātraviṣayaḥ kratvartho niṣedho yathā 'dīkṣito na dadāti na juhoti' iti |
kratvarthamātraviṣayaḥ yatho- dāhṛta eva 'nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti |
kratvarthapuruṣārthobhayaviṣayaḥ kratvarthaḥ śrauto niṣedho yathā darśapūrṇamāsāṅgaṃ 'nānṛtaṃ vadet' iti |

pratiṣedho'pi dvividhamihārthaṃ 'iti saṃkalpya yaverījānasya yattat vrīhi- saṃkalpyarūpamanṛtaṃ kratvarthaṃ prasajyeta tadiṣyo'pi bhavati, bhavati ca puruṣārtharāgaprāptānṛtavadanaviṣaye'pi ityuktaṃ tṛtīye 'akarma kratusaṃyuktaṃ saṃyoganniyānuvādaḥ syāt' |
ityarthamātra- viṣayastu puruṣārtho niṣedho nāstyeva, udāharaṇasaṃbha- vāt |
sa hi anāramyādhīto'pi na puruṣārthaḥ, phala- kalpanāprasaṅgāt |
puruṣārthamātraviṣayaḥ puruṣārthaḥ śrautaniṣedho'pi dvividhaḥ rāgaprāptaviṣayo vidhiprāptaviṣayaśca |
ādyo yathā 'na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni' iti |
pratiṣedhaḥ punarapi ṣoḍhā sāmānyapratiṣedhaḥ, viśeṣa- pratiṣedhaḥ, pratiprasavaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, abhyanujñāsvarūpaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, upasaṃhārarūpaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, vyavasthāsvarūpaḥ pratiṣedhaśceti |
tatrādyo yathā 'na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni' iti |
tṛtīyo yathā 'na hiṃsyāt' ityasya 'gāṃ na hanyāt' ityasya vā 'gauranubandhaḥ' iti bādhe prasakte punaḥ kalau pratiprasavaḥ 'akṣatā gopaśuśca' iti |
abhyanujñārūpaḥ pratiṣedho yathā 'eṣa panyā etatkarma' iti aitareye dvitīyāraṇyake 'tasmāt kāla eva dadyāt kāle na dadyāt' iti |

atra kāle dāridyādyavasthā rūpe na dadyāt iti na dāne doṣaḥ pratipādyate, nahi bhojanamātraparyāpta- vato'pi atithyādyāgamane tasmai tadadatvā svayamaśanaṃ kurvato'pi doṣo yujyate, tadyātve 'saktuprasthasya vo viprā na yajñaḥ sahaśo mataḥ |
upasaṃhārarūpaḥ pratiṣedho yathā 'mṛtānugamanaṃ nāsti brāhmaṇa brahmaśāsanāt |
kratvartho- dāharaṇaṃ tu hemādrau paiṭhīnasiḥ 'ghṛtāktanālikāpotīka- kusumbhāśmantakāśceti śākānāmānamakṣyāḥ' |
vyavasthitaḥ pratiṣedho'pi sattadhā, deśataḥ, kālataḥ, kartṛtaḥ, karmataḥ, nimittataḥ, saṃskārataḥ, phalataśceti |
tatra deśato vyavasthito niṣedho yathā 'kṛṣṇapakṣadikaṃ māsaṃ nāṅgīkurvanti ke cana |
kālato vyavasthito niṣedho yathā 'sāyaṃprātardvijātināśanaṃ śruti- coditam |
kartṛto vyavasthito niṣedho yathā 'nāsomayājī saṃnayet' iti |
karmato vyavasthito niṣedho yathā kātīyasūtre 'prajā- kāmasya navasaptadaśāhorātrirātro nāma prathamaḥ, jyeṣṭhasya jyeṣṭhineyasya viṣuvānnāma dvitīyaḥ |

bhrātṛvyato gaurnāma tṛtīyaḥ, svargakāmasya amāyāvino vā ājurnāma caturthaḥ, ṛddhikāmasya jyotiṣṭomātirātro nāma pañcamaḥ, paśukāmasya viśvajittirātro nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ, brahmavarcasakāmasya triṣṭuti- rātro nāma saptamaḥ, vīryakāmasya pañcadaśāhorātro nāma aṣṭamaḥ, annādyakāmasya saptadaśāhorātro nāma navamaḥ, pratiṣṭhākāmasya ekaviṃśatirātro nāma daśamaḥ, asoryāmāti- rātro nāma ekādaśaḥ, ... abhijittirātro nāma bhrātṛ- vyavato dvādaśaḥ, sarvastomārātro nāma bubhuṣataḥ trayodaśaḥ, iti trayodaśarātrān vakṣyamāṇān 'trayodaśātirātrāḥ' ityupakramya 'teṣāṃ catvāro ṣoḍaśikāḥ prathamāḥ' iti sūtreṇa caturvidhe vyavasthitaḥ ṣoḍaśiniṣedhaḥ kṛta iti |
' iti, rāhoḥ sūtakādanyatra anyasūtake smārta- karmaparityāgaḥ ityapi arthāśrayāt |
nanu asyārthāntaraṃ pūrvamuktaṃ (bāla. pṛ. 16 paṃ. 3-4), satyam, tathāpi arthadvayabodhakatvamantaragatavākyatvena tātparyagrahāt asyobhayarthatvātpirodhāt hemādriṇā tathā vyākhyātam |

saṃskārato vyavasthito niṣedho yathā āśvalāyanasūtre 'hoṣyaddhamaiṣu 'paristīrya' iti sarvatra paristaraṇaṃ vidhāya 'kṛtākṛtamājyahomeṣu paristaraṇam' iti akṛtaśabdena niṣedhaḥ anyatra vyavasthā uktaḥ |

phalato vyavasthito niṣedho yathā 'yo brāhmaṇāyāvagureta taṃ śatena yātayāta, yo nihanyeta sahasreṇa, yo lohitaṃ kuryāt yāvataḥ praskanna pāṃsūn saṃgṛhṇīyāt tāvataḥ saṃvatsarān suvarṇaṃ lokaṃ na praṃjānīyāt tasmānna brāhmaṇayāvagureta, na hanyāt, na lohitaṃ kuryāt' iti |
niṣedhyaphalānyeva hi niṣedha- phalāni, teṣu cātra niṣedhā vyavasthāḥ |
tathā kratvarthapuruṣārthabhedayorapi sāmānyādipadvidhaniṣedheṣu saṃbhavāt yathāsaṃbhavaṃ kratvartha- puruṣārthodāharaṇānyapi kvacit kāni ciduktāni |
kratvarthakriyāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti pratiṣedhabhedaḥ śrautaḥ snātau vā yaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ so'pi kratvarthakriyāyā ṣoḍaśa- vidhatvāt ṣoḍaśavidhaḥ |
tathāhi prakṛtau vikṛtau aprakṛti- vikṛtātmake ca karmaṇi samānavidhāno niṣedho yathā 'śṛdanītaḥ krayakītaḥ karma kurvan patatyayaḥ' |
ādyo yathā 'na tau pacau karoti' iti ājyabhāga- niṣedhaḥ |

vaikṛtopadiṣṭārādupakārakaviṣayo niṣedho yathā kātīyasūtre agnīpomīye paśau 'svāhā devebhyaḥ' 'devebhyaḥ svāhā' iti mantrābhyāṃ paripaśavye āhutī ārādupakārike saṃjñapanapūrvapālakayorvidhāya 'na caite juhoti' iti niṣiddhe |
apūrvakarmaṇi upadiṣṭārādupa- kārakakriyāniṣedho yathā agnyādheye vāravantīyādisāma- gānaṃ niṣidhyate 'na brahmā sāmāni gāyati' |

atra brahmaṇaḥ sāmagānasyāprāpteḥ anuvādamātratvāt sāma- gānāniṣedhāt nityaṃ sāmagānaṃ ityāśaṅkya anuvāda- mātrasya ānarthakyāt sāmagānaniṣedha evāyam, brahma- śabdastu brāhmaṇaparo'nuvādaḥ ityuktaṃ daśame (10|8|
apūrvakarmagato'pi evameva trividhaḥ, vikṛtigato'pi evameva trividhaḥ |
sa tu trividho'pi vikṛtigato niṣedhaḥ punardvividhaḥ : upadiṣṭaviṣayaḥ atidiṣṭaviṣayaśca |
teṣāṃ tu dvāda- śānāṃ udāharaṇāni dvādaśa ucyante |
tatra (1) prakṛti- gatasaṃnipatyadṛṣṭārthakriyāniṣedho yathā 'madhuparke ca some ca apsu prāṇāhutīṣu ca |
nocchiṣṭo bhavati dvijaḥ' iti some puṃstvadravyatvena adṛṣṭārthasya saṃnipātina ācamanasya niṣedhaḥ |

(2) prakṛtigatapratipattivyatiriktadṛṣṭārtha- saṃnipātikakriyāniṣedho yathā agnīṣomīye hute 'ami- mupasthitva' iti vidhāya 'tasmātnopasthitva' iti śata- pathe dṛṣṭārthamiṃsaṃskārasaṃnipātyupasthānaniṣedhaḥ |
(3) prakṛtigatapratipattiniṣedho yathā 'agnihotrahavaṇavyā lehaḥ' iti kalau niṣedhaḥ |
(4) aprakṛtivikṛtātmā- kakarmagatasaṃnipatyadṛṣṭārthakriyāniṣedho yathā kātīyasūtre 'ṛtunakṣatrasaṃbhārasāmapanacatuṣpādyājyāraṇyempūpūrṇā- nvārambhaṇasarpādīn vā kuryāt' iti vapananiṣedha ādhāne |
ntoktakātīyasūtragata eva rātrau padārthasaṇārthatvena dṛṣṭasya saṃnipātino jāgaraṇasya niṣedhaḥ |

(6) aprakṛtikavikṛtyātmakakarmagatapratipattiniṣedho yathā 'āhi- tāgnimagnimidaṃ dahanti yajñapātraiśca ' ityādhānakṛtyasaṃskāraḥ taccharīrapratipattirūpo vihitaḥ, tasya ātmahante niṣedhe bhaviṣyottare 'svecchayā maraṇaṃ viprāt' ityādinā ātmahatyādīnuktvā 'na teṣāṃ snānasaṃskārai' iti saṃskārādhānaṃ dāho niṣiddhaḥ |
(7) vikṛtigatopa- diṣṭaśrāddhārthasaṃpātikriyāniṣedho yathā atirātre ṣoḍaśi- grahaṇaniṣedhaḥ |
(8) vikṛtigatapadārthapratipatti- riktasaṃpātikriyāniṣedho yathā śatapathīyaḥ pūrvoktaḥ agnīṣomīyapaśu vihitasyāgnimanyanasya niṣedhaḥ 'nāgniṃ manyet' iti |

(9) vikṛtigatopadiṣṭapratipatti- niṣedho yathā bhāgavadānāni 'klomaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, plīhaṃ yaja- mānāya, purītamadhyamardhave' ityādīni, 'tāni anāramya- vihitāni agnīṣomīyamāyātāni ' iti karkasyeḥ, punaḥ stenoktam 'śālāntare agnīṣomīyapratiṣedhāt vikāra- paśūnupagacchanti' iti, tena niruḍhe upadeśadeva prāptāni, teṣāṃ niruḍhe eva niṣedhaḥ, 'śatāpe klomalīhavyanī- purītaṃ cecchan' iti ata eva tatra vikalpaḥ iti |

(10) vikṛtigatātidiṣṭaśrāddhasaṃpātikriyāniṣedho yathā vājasaneyamitye pūrṇimāsvikṛtilena darvi- homasyeṣvāpi tryambakahomameṣu śatapathe śrūyate 'te vā akāḥ syuḥ' 'tasmādanakkā eva syuḥ' iti ca, so'yaṃ prāk- tasyā'nyasya niṣedhaḥ |
ata eva tanmūlakaṃ kātīyasūtraṃ 'akkā na' iti |
(11) atidiṣṭaśrāddhasaṃpāti- pātiniṣedho yathā 'pyati vā etadaho'kṣaraṃ yadenadūhati, tasyānaivaṃ nohet' ityūhaniṣedhāt prākṛtayājyānuvākyā- vūhaniṣedhaḥ |
(12) vikṛtigatātidiṣṭapratipatti- niṣedho yathā śatapathe piṇyākam 'tāmupahuyaivajaghnanti, na prāśnanti' iti manyasa iḍopāhānānantaraṃ avaghrāṇaṃ vidhāya prāśanaṃ niṣiddham |
pratiṣedhaḥ punaḥ pratyekaṃ pañcavidhaḥ : liṅleṭkṛtkṛtyārtha- pañcalakārabhedāt |
śrautaḥ pratiṣedhe kṛlyo yathā 'tasmād barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyam' iti |
śrautaḥ pratiṣedhe pañcalakāro yathā 'na saṃtanatti' 'dīkṣito na juhoti' ityādi |
śrautaḥ pratiṣedhe tavaipratyayo yathā 'tasmād brāhmaṇe na mlecchitavai' iti |
na hi yadyarthaṃ karmaṇi yau niyamapratiṣedhau tāveva kevalaṃ tadarthau bhavataḥ |
' ataśca padārthontarāśritāvapi niyamapratiṣedhau svaprayojanā- kāṅkṣāvelāyāṃ saṃnihitapuruṣapradhānau vijñāyete |
1|3| 27 pṛ. 184. pratiṣedho nityānuvādaḥ asati prasaṅge 'nāntarikṣe na divi' ityādiḥ |

vā. 3|4|1|13 pṛ. 911. 'pratiṣedhaḥ pradeśeḍanā- ramyavidhāne ca prāptapratiṣedhatvāt vikalpaḥ syāt' (10|8|1|12) iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣayitvā 'arthaprāpta- diti cet' (2) ityanena arthaprāptasurāpānādiniṣedhe vikalpānapatticchalaprāptapratiṣedhe'pi anāpattimāśaṅkya 'na tulyahetutvāt' (3) ityanena vaiṣamyaṃ vakṣyati |
pratiṣedhaḥ pradeśe'nārabhyavidhāne ca prāpta- pratiṣedhatvāt vikalpaḥ syāt |
codakena upadiṣṭe varaṇe, 'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte nārṣeyam' iti mahāpitṛyajñe pratiṣedhaḥ śrūyate |
tathā anārabhyavidhānena prāpte yeyajāmahatve 'nānuyājeṣu yeyajāmahasya ca karoti' iti pratiṣedhaḥ śrūyate |
so'yaṃ pradeśo codakenopadeśo anārabhyavidhāne ca śrūya- māṇaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ vikalpaḥ syāt vikalpitaḥ syāt prāpta- pratiṣedhatvāt |
tasmāt sākamedheṣu mahāpitṛyajñe hotātrya- varaṇasya anuyājeṣu yeyajāmahasya ca vikalpaḥ syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yathā loke arthaprāpte yatra pratiṣedho bhavati, 'na viṣaṃ bhakṣayitavyam' ityādau tasyārthasya akriyeva bhavati, na vikalpaḥ |
tena manyāmahai vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ pratiṣedho balīyān iti |
tasmādakriyeva anuyājeṣu yeyajāmahasya mahāpitṛyajñe ca hotrādyevaraṇasya |
tulya- hetutvameva vivṛṇoti, ubhayaṃ prāptimiva pratiṣedhaṃ śabda- lakṣaṇam |
'yeyajāmahaṃ karoti' 'nānuyājeṣu' iti śabda eva ubhayalakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇam |
tasmāt mahāpitṛ- yajñe hotrādyevaraṇasya anuyājeṣu ca yeyajāmahasya vikalpa eveti |
nānuyājeṣu iti na-śabdaḥ vākyaśeṣaḥ vākyasya vākyaikadeśasya anuyājaśabdasya śeṣaḥ syāt, na tu karotiśabdasya śeṣaḥ |
tathā ca atralo nañ na pratiṣedhārthakaḥ kintu paryudāsārthakaḥ anyonyābhāvācce |
nañ karotinā anvaye sati vidhipratiṣedhābhyāṃ vikalpaḥ svīkāryaḥ syāt |
evam 'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' ityatrāpi hotrimaṃ ṛtvijaṃ vṛṇīte ityarthaḥ |
tasmāt vikalpaprasaṅgo mā bhūt iti tatratyanañsahitamanuyājādipadaṃ vidhīnāṃ karoti, vṛṇīte ityādīnāṃ ekadeśaḥ syāt |
evaṃ ca atralo nañ na niṣedhārthakaḥ kintu paryudāsārthakaḥ iti pratiṣedhābhāvāt na vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ |
'pratiṣedhaḥ pradeśe anārabhyavidhāne ca prāptaprati- ṣiddhatvāt vikalpaḥ syāt' |
yasya śāstrādate prātinasti, tasya prāptamanujñāya pratiṣedhāsaṃbhavāt avaśyaṃ prati- ṣedhenaiva tadiṣyo'pi vidhiraṅgīkartavyaḥ |
tasmāt dvirutpādyate deśayośca prātikālavaipamyāt prakṛtyathaiva varamiti ( iti sūtrārthaḥ) |
vā. 3|1|123 pṛ. 809, nanu atyantadurbale'pi vidhiḥ tadadhīnatāmalabdhena pratiṣedhena tulyabalo bhavati iti 'pratiṣedhaḥ pradeśe'nārabhya- vidhāne ca' ityatra vakṣyate |
satyam, yasya śāstra- mantareṇa aprāptistatra, tatraitadevam |
yat punaḥ arthaprāptaṃ niṣidhyate, tatra vidhyanyanujñayaiva labdhā- tmānaḥ pratiṣedhā balīyāṃso bhavanti iti tatraiva vakṣyate 'arthaprāptaditi cet' iti |

bhā. 6|7| 1|2|40. yasya ca pratiṣedhaḥ tasya nimitte prāyaścittaṃ brahmaṇa iva (yasya puruṣasya pratiṣedho'sti tasya pratiṣedhā- tikramaṇarūpe nimitte sati pratikārāpekṣayā prāyaścittavidhānaṃ brahmaṇuriva yujyate) |
yena ca nāma prāpte yadyucyate, tattasya bādhakaṃ bhavati |
bhā. 10|8|1|2. vidhipratiṣedhau arthabhāvāmeva sākṣāt viṣayīkurutaḥ, tadvārā tu tadi- śeṣanāni kārakāṇi |
bāla, pṛ. 74. pratiṣedhena prakṛtiliṅgasyo yathā 'na girāgiriti brūyāt, airaṃ kṛlodreyam' iti |
girāpadasya pratipattimānasya yat kāryaṃ lakṣyate, tatra irāpadaṃ vidhīyate |
jyotiṣṭome avabhṛthya ūrdhvaṃ ā udavasanīyāyāḥ iṣṭeḥ atipradhānānāmapi agnihotrahomānāṃ pratihomo na
pratiṣedhāt 'etayā prayukteyasaṃmitayeṣṭyā abhihotraṃ hotavyam' iti prāgudavasānīyāyāḥ homasya pratiṣedhāt |
iṣṭaviparītaṃ cāniṣṭam, yadyadā yasyeṣṭam, tadviparītaṃ tadā tasyāniṣṭaṃ bhavati |
śā. 3|4|8 pṛ. 265. pratiṣedhasya artha- vādaśūnyasya śrutārthaparayā arthavādakalpakatvam |
su. pṛ. 41. pratiṣedhasya nindayā avinābhāvāt anyatara- darśanena anyataradanmāya vākyaṃ pūrayitavyam |
ke. 10|8|12|50. pratiṣedhasya puruṣārthatvaṃ nāma puruṣaniṣṭha- pratyayajanakakriyāviṣayatvam |
bhā. 10|8|13. pratiṣedheṣvakarmatvāt kriyā syāt prati- ṣeddhānāṃ vibhaktatvātkarmaṇām |

pratiṣedheṣu siddhāntaḥ pratiṣedhatvena abhihiteṣu 'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet, na laśunam' ityādivākyeṣu akarmatvāt bhakṣaṇavirodhakalpavidhiraparatvāt kriyā syāt phalamānarahitapuruṣeṇa bhakṣaṇamanuṣṭheyaṃ syāt |
akarmaṇāṃ bhakṣaṇavicchedasaṅkalpakarmapratipādakānāṃ paryudāsa- rūpāṇāṃ pratiṣiddhānāṃ ca vibhaktatvāt parasparaṃ bhinnatvāt |
'nañpadasamabhivyāhṛtadhātoḥ khavirāddhaye lakṣaṇa yatra vākye sa paryudāsaḥ pravartakaṃ vākyam, pratiṣedhaśca nivartakaṃ vākyamiti |
pratiṣedheṣu nañsamabhivyāhṛtavākyeṣu pratiṣiddhānāṃ varṇanīyānāṃ kalañjabhakṣaṇādīnāṃ phalamānarahitānāṃ kriyā syāt |
akarmatvāt karmaṇi pratyayārthabhāvanāyāṃ nañaḥ vyavahitatvena anvayāsaṃbhavāt |
tathā ca bhakṣaṇābhāva- saṃkalpa eva vidhīyate |
athavā akarsaṇāṃ bhakṣa- ṇādyabhāvānāṃ vidhisaṃbandhasya vibhaktatvāt vyāhatatvāt iti vyākhyeyam |
tathā ca nañsamabhivyāhṛtadhātuviśiṣṭo bhakṣaṇādyabhāvasaṃkalpaḥ svargāthinā anuṣṭheyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
śāstrāṇāṃ tvarthavatvena puruṣārtho vidhīyate, tayorasamavāyitvāt, tādarthye vidhyātikramaḥ |
'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet' ityatra kalañjabhakṣaṇavirodha- saṃkalpo vidhīyate |
phalakāmanānarāhitena tu kalañjabhakṣaṇaṃ icchayā kartavyaṃ iti sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣe prāpte tuśabdena taṃ nirasyan siddhāntamāha |

prājāpatyeteṣu tāvat 'tasya vratam' 'nekṣetodyantādityam' 'etāvatā hainsā vimukto bhavati' iti trayāṇāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ vākyānāṃ arthavatvena sakalārthe puruṣārthaḥ puruṣasya arthaḥ phalaṃ yasmāt iti vyutpattyā phalasādhanaḥ īkṣaṇavirodhenīkṣaṇa- saṃkalpo vidhīyate, iti yuktaṃ tatra paryudāsāśrayaṇam |
prakṛte tu tayoḥ prājāpatyavratatvat prathamaśrutivākyayoḥ asamavāyitvāt abhāvāt tādarthye tādarthyāya śāstrārtha- lābhāya vidhyātikramaḥ vidheḥ vidhīyamānasya atikramaṇaḥ niṣedhaḥ syāt |
ke. pratiṣedhārtho nañaśabdaḥ 'nātirātre gṛhṇāti ṣoḍa- śinam' ityatra |
jyotiṣṭome śaśvantā prāyaṇīyā, iḍāntā ātithyā coktā |
tatra dvau śaṃyuvākau patnīsaṃjñeyyaḥ prāguttaraṃ ca evaṃ dve iḍe pradhānottarā patnīsaṃjñayottarā ceti |
pratiṣedhārtha- vatvāt, tadaiva hi patnīsaṃjñānāṃ anujñājānāṃ ca prati- pedhasya arthavatvaṃ sāphalyaṃ saṃbhavati, na pūrvatrāvidāntatve |
śaśvantā iḍāntā ityanena tu uttarasya śaśvidyasya parastāt
tasmāt uttarasyāṃ śaśvidyāyāṃ śaśvidāntatvamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
cakāraḥ pūrvādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣahetuḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ : patnyanuyājapratiṣedhāna- thaikvavat pratiṣedhārthatvāt iti |
pūrvasya śaśvidyasya grahaṇaṃ nottarasya śaśvantā iḍāntā iti vacanāt prāpteḥ prathamo- pasthitatvāt, prathamatyāge kāraṇabhāvāt |
pūrvasya śaśvi- dasya agrahaṇe tu atikramaṇaḥ syāt prāptasya samāsiniyā- makasya atikramaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt |
pratiṣedhasya tvarāyuktatvāt tasya ca nānyadeśa- tvam |
athāsurā yajamānya tato yaśvastvare tameva kṛtvā tvaritamādriyante' iti, 'ātithyaṃ niravapan, tadiḍāntamāsīt, athāsurā yajamānya, tato yaśvastvare iti, tadiḍāntameva kṛtvā tvaritamādriyante' iti |
tasmāt tasya patnīsaṃjñājādipratiṣedhasya nānyadeśatvaṃ nottaradeśatvam, kintu prāgadeśatvameva |
sā'pi ca nivṛtti- hetuḥ nivartitudharmarūpā 'ahamenaṃ nivartayāmi' iti, nivartayituḥ mānasapratyayeyathā pravartanāt |
sā'pi ca nyunotamasamadhipatyena tredhā lokeṣu dharmeḥ, vede ca puruṣā- bhāvāt tadīyāśayaviśeṣarūpatathāsaṃbhavatvāt liḍādereva nivartakatvāt tadgarbhabhūtā caturthī api vidhā aṅgīkāryā |
saiva ca pratiṣedhaḥ niṣedhaḥ iti gīyate |
loke tu tad- bhayavyavahāro vidhivyavahāratva bhakta eva |
tatra tu etā- vāna viśeṣaḥ, na nivartanāyāṃ vidhinimantraṇeti pravarta- nāyāṃ śaktigrāhakamanuśāsanamasti |

tathāpi anādau saṃsāre nanupahitaliṅaśravaṇātnuvidhāyinī prayogyadṛṣṭanivṛtti dṛṣṭvā āvāpodvāpābhyāṃ nanupahitaliṅādeḥ nivṛttāveva śaktigrahe prasakte 'guruṇā nivartakena nivartito'haṃ nivarte' ityādi gurau nivartakatvavyavahārānyā''nupapattyā pravartanāyāmiva pravartakatvānyā''nupapattyā tadvyāpārabhūtayā nivartanāyāṃ śaktigraho bhavati vyutpitsoḥ |
vidhinā yujyate yatra na hyatrātra pivediti |

nañtikāyāṃ (vā. 13|137 pṛ. 212 paṃ. 8-10) tu 'pratiṣedhavidhiraparo hi vidhāyakaḥ' ityādi 'pratyayārthalakṣaṇo vākyamedamasaṅgaḥ' ityante granthe vidhāyakapadena liṅa eva pratiṣedhārthatā ityapi uktaḥ |
tathā ca niṣedhyaliṅavivakṣāyāṃ tasyaivāvṛttiruktā na nañaḥ |
'yeṣāṃ tu' iti granthe tu pūrvamatamapi uktam |
