tatra nañāde- ramāvaviṣayāyāḥ liṅādeśa pravartanāviṣayāḥ śaktaiḥ tyāgasyāviśeṣe'pi tathā nañādeḥ nivartanāvācitvapakṣe tatsamamihyāhataliṅādeḥ rāgādiprāptapravartanānuvādakatvasya liṅādeśe nivartanāvācitvapakṣe nañādeḥ tatkalībhūtārthapravṛ- tyabhāvātnuvādakatvasyāviśeṣe'pi 'amānonāḥ pratiṣedhe' ityavyayacatuṣṭaye śaktinatuṣṭayaṃ kalpyaṃ ityādyapakṣe lāghavam |

liṅloṭapañcamalakārāṇāṃ tanyādīnāṃ ca anekeṣāṃ kṛtyānāṃ catuṣṭayādhikyaśakti kalpanāpattyā gauravāt na pratyayaśakti- kalpanāpakṣo yukta iti nañi śakteḥ vārtikakṛtā dvirabhi- dhānena tatrādaraṃ sūcayatā dhvanitamiti |
bhā. 10|4|10|20, pratiṣṭhākāmasya ekaviṃśati- manubrūyāt sāmidhenīḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
pratihomā nānuṣṭheyāḥ avabhyutkarṣe- ekaviṃśatirātraḥ kātīya uktaḥ ! bāla. pṛ. 34. 'pi dīkṣāyā anuṣṭhitatvāt homādiniṣedhānuvarjanāt |
pratihomā nānuṣṭheyāḥ udavasānīyo- pratisamādheyājñavalkyasyādhikāraḥ agnihotrā- tkarṣe'pi |
mīko. pṛ. 282 sānīyotkarṣe'pi pratihomānāṃ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
bāla. pṛ. 131. pratyakṣaiḥ śrutādibhiḥ atideśaprāptāḥ śrutādayaḥ bādhyante |
1|1|4. pratyakṣa indriyasya karaṇatvaṃ tatsaṃbaṃdhasya ca vyāpāratvam |
vā. 2|1|6 pṛ. 488. pratyakṣasya viruddhayā sthūlyā anumitā smṛtirbādhyate |
ata evāha 'ācā- rāsu smṛtiṃ jñātvā śrutikalpam |
tena dhanta- ritaṃ teṣāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ viprakṛpyate |
' vi. vārtikamate 1315 varṇakaṃ 2. pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ yat kartavyaṃ nirṇīyate, tat ārabdhaṃ sat samāpanīyameveti na niyamaḥ |
asamāpane dṛṣṭāniṣṭapratyakṣe tu tat samāpanīyameva iti tu pratyakṣānu- mānābha
‘prodgātṛṇāṃ’ ityādeśu tadvacanatvāt bhakṣa- vācakatvāt tena vacanena camasānāṃ kartuḥ hotravyatvādeḥ anirdeśaḥ na nirdeśaḥ, na niṣkarṣaḥ, na bādhaḥ; ekasya vākyasya vidhiniṣedhobhayaparatvābhāvāt |
‘camasāṃ- śramādhyāye prayacchati, tānu sa vaṣṭukṛtai harati’ iti vacane, camase anyeṣāṃ camasināṃ darśanāt |
ekasya hi vaṣṭukṛtaiḥ eka eva camasa upahartavyaḥ |
tasmāt camaseṣu aneke bhakṣa- yitāraḥ iti jñāyate |
anyadarśanāt ityatra anyeṣāṃ darśanāt iti samāsaḥ |
ke. pratyakṣopadeśāt śīghrabuddhijanakatayā kalpyāti- deśāt prabalatvam |
na tāvat ‘indriyajanyaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣam’ iti lakṣaṇam |
na ceśvarapratyakṣe anyātiḥ īśvarajñānasya anu- mitivilakṣaṇatvavat pratyakṣavilakṣaṇatvāt iti jīrṇāḥ |
na ca savikalpakapratyakṣe viśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyapratyakṣe cānyātiḥ, tayornirvikalpakajñānakaraṇakatvāt iti vācyam |
vyāpāravadasādhāraṇakāraṇasya karaṇatayā tajjanyatve sati tajjanyajanakasya vyāpāratayā ca nirvikalpakādeḥ kāraṇatve'pi akaraṇatvāt |
sarvatra pratyakṣe indriyasya karaṇatvāt tatsaṃbandhasya vyāpāratvācca tāhaśānamānumititvādīnāṃ pratyakṣe abhāvāt lakṣaṇa- saṃgatiḥ |
tacca pratyakṣaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ savikalpakaṃ ceti dvedhā |
tacca dravyapratyakṣe sama- vāyena, guṇakriyājātipratyakṣe samavāyaghaṭitasāmānādhi- karaṇyena, guṇakriyājātipratyakṣe tu ekārthasamavetasama- vāyena |
cākṣuṣe ca udbhūtarūpam, udbhūtānabhibhūta- rūpālokasaṃyogaśca hetuḥ |
‘kālādicākṣuṣe mahalodbhūta- rūpādīnāṃ na hetutā’ iti ke cit |
sparśane ca udbhūtasparśaḥ, na tu rūpamapi |
evaṃ ca bahirindriyajanyadravyapratyakṣatvaṃ na udbhūtarūpa- kāryatvā'vacchedakam, kintu cākṣuṣatvādisatireva iti lāghavam |
ke cittu kriyā na pratyakṣā, kintu vibhāgo- tsarasaṃyogābhyāmanumeyā |
maṇi. pṛ. 19-21. pratyakṣato dṛṣṭasaṃbandhamanumānaṃ yathā- dhūmākṛti- darśanāt anyākṛtivijānan iti |
yatra viśeṣayoreva saṃbandho gṛhyate, tat viśeṣaviṣayaṃ dṛṣṭasaṃbandhaṃ ityucyate |
pratyakṣaśravaṇavaccamiṣṭakānāṃ iṣṭakāvāciśruta- śabdavinivṛtta mantreṣveva ityuktameva bhūmādhikaraṇe ( 2|4|17 ) |
yasya vastuno yadasādhāraṇaṃ svarūpam, tenaiva rūpeṇa yā vyavahārayati, sā sākṣātpratītiḥ |
jātyā- diviśiṣṭasya savikalpakasya sādhāraṇākāraviṣayatvāt pratyakṣatvaṃ na syāditi cet na, asādhāraṇākārasyāpi viṣayīkārāt |
anumāne tu sādhāraṇabhūta- vyāpakākāreṇa saṃbandhapratīterna sākṣāttvam |

viśiṣṭajñānasya viśeṣaṇa- jñānavyavahitatvāt prayamimanasya pūrvajñānavyavahitatvāt tayoḥ pratyakṣatvaṃ na syāditi cet, anvayahitaṃ nāma svaviṣayāntargatajñānāntarāvyavahitaṃ abhipretam, tena samañjasaṃ lakṣaṇam |
evaṃ vā- sākṣāt svakālakalitavastu- sattvāvodhakatvam, yatkālīnaṃ jñānaṃ tatkālasaṃbandhivastu-
pratyabhijñāyāṃ tu svakālasaṃbandhvastviviṣaya- tvamapyastīti na doṣaḥ |
vartamānamānumānasya pratyakṣatvaṃ syāditi cet, na tasyāpi svakālakalitatvam, kintu vyāptikālākalitameva |
anumānasya tu vyāptikālā- kaśite śaktiḥ kṛtā, itarathā bhūtānumāne bhaviṣyadumāne vā śakyantarakalpanā syāditi na doṣaḥ |

pravi. pṛ. 26. pratyakṣavacanena ekasmin kāle sājñānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prayogavidhinā pradhānasāhityavat ajñeyapi sāhityava- gamāt ekaikajñena sarvapradhānānāṃ yugapadupākartavyamityarthā- vagamaḥ, iti padārthānāṃ samanyayāt |
udāharaṇaṃ prājāpatya- paśūnāmekamupākaraṇarayamahaṃ sarvapaśūnāṃ kṛtvā niyojanaṃ kāryaṃ iti padārthānusamayaḥ |
ke. pratyakṣavacane sati anyathā'nupapattipakṣe sati arthāpattilampaśrutya- parigrahaḥ |

1 dhātvartha- mātravidhiḥ, 2 saguṇadhālyarthavidhiḥ, 3 kiñciduddeśyaka- dhātvarthavidhiḥ, 4 kiñciduddeśyakaviśiṣṭadhātvarthavidhiḥ, 5 dhātvarthādiyarkaḥ anyavidhiḥ, 6 dhātvarthe anyayoḥ saṃbandhavidhiḥ, 7 dhātvarthāvṛtaprakṛtyena anyayoḥ saṃbandha- vidhiḥ, 8 dhātvartha muktvā anyayoreva saṃbandhavidhiśreti |
pratyakṣeṇa puroḍāśa tantramadhye vidhāne bahūnyapi devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi puroḍāśadhamaiḥ prasaṅgasiddhāni |
vi. 213|2. pratyakṣavidhisiddhātvāt labhyate nānumānikam ( ‘kaḥ’ iti ānandāśramīye pāṭhaḥ |
vā. 213|14 pṛ. 589 ) iti nyāyavirodhāt ‘somena yajeta’ iti pratyakṣayāgavidhau sati aindravāyavādivākyeṣu dravya- devatāsa
yāgaṃ hi phale vidadhat pratyayaḥ na vimṛjyate |
na ca anutpattiparaḥ san utpattiṃ kalpayiṣyati |
pratyaya : (jñānaṃ) samīcīnaḥ ka : punarasau 1 nāmajātyādiyogena ucyate yaḥ |
ṛju . pratyaya : (liṅādiḥ) : svārthe bhāvanāyāṃ puruṣaṃ pravartayati |
... tasmācca kadācit yāge pratyaya upanipatati tvevāntyai (pratyayārtho bhāvanā na yāgaṃ bhāvanāyāṃ svīkaroti satyapyantarye ityarthaḥ) |
kāraka abhidadhat pratyayaḥ śaktimātreṇa abhidadhyāt, na dravyarūpeṇa, tasyākārakatvāt |
pṛ. 239 (idaṃ vākyaṃ anekapratyeṣu bahuvāraṃ samāyāti, tacca 'prakṛtipratyayau' iti praṣṭake draṣṭavyam) |
tat ekatvam āsannate kārake prathamaṃ saṃbandho bhavati |
pratyayena viśeṣeṇābhidhānaṃ aviruddham, pūrvābhihite'pi viśeṣaṇe, prakṛtipratyayayoḥ śaktibhedāt |
pratyayena hi śrutvā dhātvarthasya sattā ucyate |

pratyayasya atyantābhāvāpekṣayā prātipadikasya ajaha- tsvārthalakṣaṇaiva yuktā, ajahatsvārthalakṣaṇayā mukhyārthasya parityāgābhāvena kāṃsyabhojinyāyena tasyā eva nyāyatvāt (yathā 'prodgātpumān' ityatra) |
kevalaprakṛtipratyayayogāsaṃbhavaḥ avaśyaṃ tāvat dhātusaṃbandhārtha pratyayaḥ punarāvartanīyaḥ |
vā. 2|2|11 pṛ. 463, prakṛtipratyayayoḥ svārthavṛttayoraiva nairuttyāt antarāle saṃbandho'vagamyamāno bhavati |
pratyaye vairūpyalakṣaṇo vākyabhedaḥ; 'graham' ityekatvasaṃ saṃmārge grahaṃ vā prati guṇatve, dvitīyāvibhaktyā lakṣye grahāpekṣayā prādhānyaṃ iti |
'sattvapradhā- nāni nāmāni' iti yāskasmṛteḥ : (1|1) prātipadi- kāryasya prādhānyāt pradhānatvānvayasya abhyarhitatvāt padaśrutyā (paśuṃ) paśyanvaya eva saṃkhyāyāḥ; na tu pratyayaśrutyā kārakānvayaḥ |
na ca pratyayārthaprādhānyamapi śābdikaiḥ saryate iti vācyam |
evaṃ ca saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyayaśruti- gamyakārakānvayasyāpi parityājyatve sati vākyamādāya yajñāṅgatvaṃ durāpetam |
na ca ekatvasya paśyanvaye paśoḥ kārakānvayadaśāyāmekatvaviśiṣṭasyaiva tasyānyāt ekatva- syāpi yajñāṅgatvaṃ śaṅkhanīyam |

viramyavyāpārāyogena pratyayena prathamamekatvasya paśusaṃbandhaṃ bodhayitvā tadanantara- mekatvaviśiṣṭasya tasya kārakānvayabodhanāyogāt yugapadeva saṃkhyākārakakāmyāṃ payoranvayena saṃkhyāviśiṣṭasyaiva kārakā- nyā'nupapattyā kevalasyaiva paśoḥ kārakānvayāt |
yadi prātipadikārthasya prādhānyam, tadā tasya kārakeṇa vaśīkaraṇabhāvāt kārakasya tadguṇabhāve sati kṛdantābhihitasya kārakasya kriyā'nvayo na bhavet |
ato na prātipadikārthaḥ pradhānam, kintu pratyayārtha eva |
tatrāpi vākyasya kriyāpradhānatvāt tadarthatvācca kārakasya tasyaiva prādhānyam, na saṃkhyā- ''deḥ |
yatra tu 'gauḥ śuklaḥ' ityādī na kriyā'nvayaḥ tada- bhiprāyaṃ yāskasmaraṇam |
na caivaṃ pratyayaśrutyā saṃkhyā'va- ruddhe kārake durbalayā padaśrutyā paśoranvayo na syāditi vācyam |
'ekasaṃkhyene kārakeṇa yaṣṭavyam' ityukte kiṃjātīyaṃ tat iti viśeṣāpekṣāsattvena anuguṇatayā durbalapramāṇakasyāpi paśoḥ anvayāvirodhāt |
pratyayena kārakasaṃkhyayoḥ pṛthagabhidhānamāśritya ekapadopāttaprāti- padikāpekṣayā ekapratyayopāttakārakasya saṃnihitataratvāt
vastutastu saṃkhyākārakayoḥ na pṛthagabhidhānam, kintu saṃkhyā'nvitameva kārakaṃmabhidhīyate |
tataśca abhidhāna- daśāyāmeva kārakānvitatvāt saṃkhyāyāḥ, na paścāt prātipadikānvayaprasaktiḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 109, anukūlavyāpāraḥ pratyayārthaḥ iti maṇḍanaḥ |
pṛ. 109, ākhyātasya yalo vācyaḥ iti naiyāyikāḥ |
107, ākhyātatvena yatnatvena vā pratyayavācyo yatno bhāvanā iti siddhāntaḥ |
prakṛtipratyayayoḥ svārthavidhāne smṛte- rācārācca nityaviśiṣṭatvameva pūrvaprayuktarūpakartavyatve pratipattṛṣu pratyayārthaḥ saṃnipatan kṛtānubandhameva svārthe vadati |
tasmāt na kadācit pratyayārthaḥ śuddho labhyate |
vā. 2|2|11 pṛ. 465, pratyayārthaḥ samāno- 'pi dhātubhedena bhidyate |
' 2|2|12 pṛ. 468, pratyayārtha saha brūtaḥ prakṛtipratyayau sadā |
pratyayārthena hi itikrtavyatā ākāṅkṣyate kartavyaṃ kathayatīti |
pratyayārthena hi itikrtavyatā saṃbadhyate na yāgena |
yāgastu pūrvāparībhūtaḥ itikrtavyatāṃ gṛhṇāti, na niṣpannarūpaḥ |
( 'pratyayārthena hi itikrtavyatā ākāṅkṣyate kartavyaṃ kathayati, na yajiḥ kīdṛśa iti iti bhāṣyaṃ 9|1| 1|1 pṛ. 1639 ityatra) |
) ' tayostu pratyayasya prādhānyena ' iti smṛtyā prādhānyasya anuśāsitatvāt 'vrīhivahanti' itivat prādhānye avagate yāgasya śrutyaiva tadaṅgopapattiḥ |
anekakārakapadāpattayoḥ kāraka- vibhaktyā kriyā'nvayāvagateḥ kriyā'nvayāt prāk viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvāpatteḥ pratyekaṃ vidhivyāpārāt vidhāyakapratyayāvṛttiḥ syāt |
guṇastu lope kṛte 'pratyayaḥ prāpnoti' iti nyāyena anityaḥ |
pratyayalope pratyayalakṣaṇam' iti nyāyena lupte'pi pratyaye yatra kāryaṃ bhavati, tatra na saṃnipātalakṣaṇa- nyāyāvatāraḥ |
pratyayo viśvāsaḥ asya saṃjātaḥ iti 'tadasya saṃjātaṃ tārakādibhya itac' (pā 5|2| 36) iti saṃjātārthe smṛteḥ itacpratyayāntena pratyayita- śabdena niścitasatyavattvamukm |
pratya- yitasya (puruṣasya) hi vacanamavyabhicāri pramāṇa- ntarapūrvakamupalabhyamānaviṣayam |
pratyartha cāmisaṃyogān karmato abhisaṃbandha - sasmāt karmopadeśaḥ syāt |
' (6|1|13) ityanena arthamānaṃ svargādi pratīya lakṣaṇakṛtya uddiśya tadabhi- mukhyena taccanatayā karmaṇaḥ samīhitasvargānvayavagateḥ
iti vadatā phalasya uddeśyatvādapi tādarthyaṃ karmetividhiḥ iti vakṣyate |
tathayā devadattasyadattaviṣṇumitrā bhojyatāmiti, na cocyate pratyeka miti, pratyekaṃ ca sujiḥ parisamāpyate |
sāhasī. 966. pratyavayavaṃ vākyaparisamāptiḥ iti nyāyena ‘sarvāṇi havīṃṣi’ iti sarvaśabdaḥ prāptānuvādaḥ havirnāśamātrasya nimittatvam |
ratna. 10|5|25|85. pratyavāyaḥ ‘avādhite tu vijñāne yo'nyo na kriyate tathā |
dup. 6|3|12 pṛ. 1409. pratyahaṃ sarvasaṃskāraḥ prakṛtivat sarvāsāṃ sarva- śeṣatvāt |
ekādaśarātre pauṇḍarīke ahīne pratyahaṃ ahaniahani sarvasaṃskāraḥ sarvāsāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ saṃskāraḥ syāt |
prakṛti- vat prakṛtau dvādaśāha yayā pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇāsaṃskāraḥ kriyate |
sarvāsāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ sarvaśeṣatvāt sarveśā- mahā śeṣabhūtatvāt |
tasmāt pratyahaṃ nayanādisaṃskāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pauṇḍarīke pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ saṃskāro na kartavyaḥ, kintu sakṛdeva syāt |
syāt pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇāsaṃskāraḥ pauṇḍarīke utpattau dakṣiṇāsaṃskārotpattividhī kālabhedāt kālaviśeṣasambandhasya śrūyamāṇatvāt |
‘tasmāt triṣu loke mādhyāṃdine savane dakṣiṇā nīyante’ iti |
pauṇḍarīke pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇā vibhajya vibhaktānāṃ tadine deyānāṃ tadine nayanādiḥ saṃskāraḥ kartavyaḥ |
vacanāt dvādaśāhavat, yathā dvādaśāhe ‘anvahaṃ dvādaśaśataṃ dadāti’ iti vacanāt pratyahaṃ nayanādiḥ saṃskāraḥ kriyate |
tadvat dvādaśāhavikāre pauṇḍarīke'pi pariklyaikatve'pi vacanāt vibhajya medena pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇā- saṃskāraḥ iti |
maṇi. pṛ. 13. pratyāmnāne prākṛtaṃ bādhyate āramyādhītena anā- ramyādhītena ca |
prathamaṃ anugrahītavyaṃ virodhābhāvāt, paścāttaṃ tu virodhāt lakṣaṇayā kalpanīyam |
ityanena nyāyena avāte phale nottara- karmānuṣṭhānayojanamasti |
atastatra yo laghustulya guru kalpamātiṣṭheta, tasya phalabhūyastvaṃ na bhavitumarhati |
bhā. 1|1| 8|43. āṣāḍhasya tu (adhike) prathame evāṣāḍhe varuṇapraghāsāḥ, ‘prathamaṃ vā niyamyeta’ iti nyāyāt |
iti śruti prāpte daśapeye jyotiṣṭomādhikāre daśatvānuvādaḥ |
vi. 3|4|20. prathamādhyāyatṛtīyapāde smṛti mūlavicāraḥ prakara- ṇārthe |

su. pṛ. 370. prathamādhyāyatrayapratipādita hi pramāṇavivekavidhi- arthavāda-mantra-smṛti-guṇavidhi-nāmadheya- vākyaśeṣā- rthakṛtasaṃdigdhavidhinirṇayavibhāgaḥ pratyeka bhedādilakṣaṇeṣu medenopayokṣyate |
pṛ. 649. prathamaārambhena hi padārtheḥ kriyamāṇaḥ uttaraṃ padārthamabhiniyacchati |
idaṃ praṇayanaṃ prathamottamayoḥ prathamacaturthayoḥ parvaṇoḥ syāt |
‘na vaiśvadeve uttaravedimupavanti, na śunāsīrīye’ iti uttaravedeḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
tasmāt uttaravediprati- ṣedhāt tayoḥ parvaṇoḥ praṇayanam |
‘idaṃ saumikaṃ praṇayanaṃ itipakṣe prayojanasūtram’ iti vārtikam |
pūrvapakṣe sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasya siddhānta- māha |
‘tasmāt dvābhyāṃ yanti’ , ‘ūrū vā etau yajñasya yadruṇapraghāsāśca sāka- medhāśca’ iti gatipratipādakena arthavādena madhyamayoreva praṇayanasya jñāpitatvāt |
pūrvasūtre uttaravedipratiṣedhāt iti yoḍayaṃ auttara- vedikaḥ pratiṣedha uktaḥ, saḥ ‘upātra vapanti’ iti anārabhyavādasya anārabhyavidheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
atra cāturmāsyeṣu upavanti agni iti anārabhyavādasyarthaḥ |
yadai kasmāt karta- vyāni bhaveyuḥ, kiṃ tadā yataḥ kutaścit prathamāditi |
vā-- yāthākāmyamityasya buddhisāmānyādhikaraṇyena strīvivakṣāyāṃ ‘piṇḍrādīnāṃmva’ iti dīṣi kṛte ‘hala- staddhitasya’ iti vyayakāre lupte yāthākāmī bhavati |
vā— śeṣanimittakaṃ hi vihitāvaśyakartavyanimittaṃ ca śeṣakāryaṃ prathamasya tāvat pāṭhakramānusārat pūrvamā- patati |
na ca tadā kaścidvirodha iti kiyate |
tasmiṃśca kṛte nivṛttavyāpārā codanā na nimittabhavatīti virodhā- dakaraṇam |

soma— mukhyena pradhānānuṣṭhānamaye eva śeṣakāryārtha śeṣaḥ sthāpyaḥ iti buddheḥ śeṣasthāpananimittabhūtāyāḥ sattvena tasyāṃ satyāṃ śeṣasthāpanādavaśyambhāvāt tata evā''kāṅkṣā- śāntyanantarameva sthāpanam |
bhāṣyakārapakṣe tu yadyapi śeṣakāryavaśeṇa śeṣasthāpanābhāvena śeṣasthāpanasya naimittika- tvābhāvāt nimittavighāto nāstīti śeṣakāryasamaye sarveṣāṃ
sarvathā prathamā'rthasya bhāvanāyāṃ dvitīyā''disādhāraṇyena bheda- saṃbandhena prakāratā iti siddham |
etena caitrādernāmārthasya prathamā'rthasya vā ākhyātopāttakartrādau abhedānvaya iti vaiyākaraṇamatamapi apāstam |

yattu ' stokaṃ pacati ' ityādī nāmārthasya stokasya pāke abhedānvayārthaṃ abhedasaṃbandhena nirarthakasupsamabhivyāhṛta- nāmārthaprakārakaśābdatvāvacchinnaṃ prati niruktanāmasamabhi- vyāhṛtapadajanyopasthitiḥ kāryaṃ iti kāryakāraṇabhāvasya āvaśyakatvāt tenaiva caitrādeḥ yogyatayā kartrādau abhedā- nvayopapattiriti |
stridhnaṃ prati liṅgānvayipadajanyopasthiteḥ bhāvanāviśeṣya- tāsaṃbandhena kāraṇatve'pi pramāṇāntaranyāmihitatvādupa- sthitirūpakāraṇāntaravaśeṇa viśeṣalopapatteḥ iti dik |
rahasya. pṛ. 57-67. prathamā''dīnāṃ tisṛṇāmupasadāṃ svasthānādyathā abhicayane ṣaḍupasadaḥ |
sā paraṃ kartṛtvaprakārikā kartṛtvaviśeṣā vā ityanyadetat |

kiñca satyapi saṃkhyā- bhāvanobhayasādhāranyena uktavidhaprathamā''dapadajanyopasthiteḥ kāraṇatve bhavanmate prathamātṛtīyādiprayojakaṃ kim ? na tāvat kartrādyabhidhāne tatprayojake, tasya tasyā'naṅgī- kārāt |
na caivamapi prakāratayā karaṇatvādyavivakṣāyāṃ bhava- nmate karaṇatvādiṃsargeṇa kāṣṭhādīnāṃ bhāvanā'nyathāpatteḥ 'caitraḥ kāṣṭhāni sthālī odanaḥ pacati' iti prayogā''- pattiḥ |
parasme teṣāṃ dhātvarthe ananvāt, tatra ca abheda- saṃbandhenaiva nāmārthānyāt na tathā prayogapattiḥ |
teṣā- mapi 'dadhi paśyati' ityādivāt kāṣṭhakaraṇatvalakṣaṇā prayogāpattirnivāryaiva |
mavamate tu sarvasya ākhyātāthai evānvayāt tatra ca nāmārthasyāpi caitrādeḥ bhedasaṃbandhena anyathā''ṅgīkārāt kāṣṭhādīnāmapi anvayopapattiḥ iti vācyam |

etādṛśaprayogāpattibhayadeva mayā''pi svabodha- katvādyabhihitakārakavacanānāmabhinnanāmārthasya tadatliṅga- saṃkhyādevā kriyāsaṃbandhe subantātliṅgasaṃbandhāvyatirikta- dvitīyādivibhaktyupasthityarthādarthaṃ tantraṃ iti niyamasya kalpanāt |
atra nāmārtha- syāpi caitrādeḥ 'caitraḥ pacati' ityādau sākṣādeva kriyānvayāt minetyantam |
'pācakamānaya' ityādau kṛdādyabhihitakārakavacanādi''pi pācakādisya ānayanānu- kūlakṛtau anvaye dvitīyopasthāpitakarmatvadvāratvasya āva- śyakatvāt svabodhakatvetyuktam |
pācaka pade ityādivāpi lakṣaṇayā bhāvanābodhasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt tatra kāṣṭhādīnā- manvaye karaṇatvādibodhakadvitīyādi āvaśyakam |
ata eva etannibhyānurodhenaiva kaustubhādau prātipadikārthasya subu- pāttaliṅgasaṃbandhasya sākṣāt bhāvanānvayaḥ nā''ṅgīkṛtaḥ |
ataḥ pacatikalpaṃ ityādau prātipadikārthamātravivakṣāyāṃ prathamā ityāhuḥ |
evamapi īṣadasamāseḥ kalpapratyayavācyāyāḥ bhāvanāyā saha bhedasaṃbandhavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhyāpatterdurvāratvāt |
ataḥ anyathā vyākaraṇasya vṛttibodhakatve'pi prakṛte tātparyagrāhakatvāmātraparaṃtā iti yuktamutpaśyāmaḥ |
ke cittu pacatikalpaṃ ityādau tiṣṭhati ityadhyāhārāt pākabhāvanā''vṛttiḥ īṣadasamāsiḥ tiṣṭhati' ityarthaḥ |
asmiṃśca pakṣe pacati iti tiṣṭho''pi kalpapratyayārthena medasaṃbandhena anveti ekapadopāttatvāt |
ataśca kalpa- pratyayasya vācyatve''pi tasya tiṣṭhati ityatraivānvayāt prathamopapattiḥ ityāhuḥ |
evaṃ cāsminte sarvama prāyāyojakatvarūpalābhaḥ sulabhaḥ, na tu bhavanmate iti siddham |
rahasya. pṛ. 30-35 prathā pṛthutā, kapāleṣvavasthāpitasya puroḍāśasya hastasaṃghaṭṭane sarveṣu kapāleṣu prasāraṇam |
idaṃ caro vādhitam, puroḍāśe tat kartavyam |
tatra āśvinādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ sādanaṃ ca aindravāyavāt prāk ityuktam, aya sādanavat pradānaṃ cāpi aindravāyavāt prāk kartavyam |
āśvinaṃ hutvā tata aindravāyavo hotavya iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
vi. 5|4|2, pradānaṃ vacanāt kṛṣṇalānāṃ anadanīyā- nāmapi kriyate |
pradānāni japo homo mātṛhomādayastathā ' dharmā eva |
vā. 11|3|17 pṛ. 205. pradānāni hi vivarcante (jyotiṣṭomāt ukthyādiṣu saṃsthāsu) |
na cākṛtvāvadānaṃ avatta- homasaṃbhavaḥ iti avadānaṃ na vidhātavyam |
caturavattavākye 'yaccaturavattam' ityanacca tatsaṃskāratayā homavidhiḥ iti pakṣe avattaviśiṣṭahomavidhipakṣaṃ ca daśame vakṣyati |
na tu upastaraṇaṃ avadānaṃ abhighāraṇaṃ homaḥ iti pratyekaṃ pṛthak padārthaḥ |
vi. 5|2|4. pradānāntena avadānādinā (homāntena) anusamayaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āgneyādau |
ke. pradānopakramā pradānārthameva kriyate avadānā- bhighāraṇādayaḥ |
bhā. 5|4|2-4. pradānadarśanaṃ śrapaṇe taddharma bhojanārthatvāt saṃsargācca madhuparkavat |
agniṣṭome 'ādityaḥ prāyaṇīyaḥ payasi caruḥ' iti śrāmnāyate |
tatra payasi pradānārthāḥ payodharmāḥ kartavyā na veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
śrapaṇe, caroḥ payasā saha śrapaṇe sati pradānasya yāgasya darśanena caroriva payaso'pi syāt |
payaḥ taddharma pradānasya dharmaḥ yasmin tat taddharma pradāna- dharmakaṃ syāt |
'ayujuṣā vatsānapākaroti, apavitravati gāṃ dohayati' iti vatsāpākaraṇe yajurmantrasya niṣedhaḥ |
tadvat bhojanārthala- saṃsargo pūrvokto hetu yathā pradānadharmasādhako tadvat prati- ṣedho'pi pradeyadharmasādhakaḥ iti |
tatrapratiṣedhe payasaḥ pratiṣedhe ca tathābhūtasya payasā saṃsṛṣṭasyāpi varjanāt yathā vā 'taile pīte pānīyaṃ na peyam' iti pratiṣedhe pānīya- miśritamapi na pīyate |
tasmānmādhyandine caroḥ pradeyatve tatsaṃsṛṣṭasya payaso'pi pradeyatvaṃ syāt |
payasaḥ apra- deyatve vā carorapi apradeyatvaṃ syāt |
payaḥ adharme avidyamānāḥ dharmā asya iti adharma |
apradānāt payasaḥ prāyaṇīyai svātantryeṇa pradānaṃ nāsti |
praṇītā- sthāne payaḥ kriyate arthāt caruśrapaṇārtha payaḥ |
āpaḥ praṇītā api piṣṭasaṃyavanārthā eta bhavanti paurṇamāsādī |
yadyapi pradeyena caraṇā saha payasaḥ saṃsargo'sti, tathāpi carupayasoḥ atulyatvam |
pratyakṣataḥ adhikaraṇatvena payaḥ śrūyate, pradeyatvena caruḥ |
vidyamāno'pi saṃsargaḥ pradeyatvena tulyatvābhāvāt asaṃ sarge eva |
pūrvapakṣe 'saṃskārapratiṣedhaśca' iti sūtreṇa yat liṅga- muktam, tatrottaramāha siddhāntī |
'ayujuṣā vatsānapā- karoti' 'apavitravati gāṃ dohayati' iti paraḥ pareṇa sūtreṇa uktaḥ : saṃskārapratiṣedhaḥ nityānuvādaḥ syāt |
keṣāñcit 'yajuṣā vatsānapākaroti', 'pavitravatyā gāṃ dogdhi' iti yat vihitam, tasya pratiṣedho'yaṃ 'ayujuṣā vatsānapākaroti' 'apavitravati gāṃ dogdhi' iti |
varjane guṇabhāvitvāt taduktapratiṣedhāt syāt kāraṇāt kevalaśanam |
pūrvapakṣe yat sāmānyatodṛṣṭamuktam 'tatpratiṣedhe ca tathābhūtasya varjanāt' iti, tannirāsārthamāha siddhāntī |

loke prāyaśaḥ payaso bhojanādau guṇabhāvitvāt guṇabhūta- tvāt apradhānatvāt 'payo na sevanīyam' iti varjane vihite uktapratiṣedhāt pūrvapakṣiṇā uktasya payaḥsaṃsiktasya payaḥsaṃsṛṣṭasyāpi pratiṣedho bhavati iti tat payaḥ sarvathā varjyate |
vā. 3|1|21 pṛ. 656, pradhānāni hi phalaṃ prati vidhīyante neti- kartavyatāyām, atasteṣāṃ phale vivakṣitaṃ sāhitye neti- kartavyatāyām |
' agniṃ citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta ' ' vājapeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yajeta ' iti śrutam |
tatra sautrāmaṇī citamātre tantramadheva utta sakāle evaṃ vājapeyamadhye eva bṛhaspatisaveḥ kartavyaḥ utta sakāle vasantau iti vicāre pūrvapakṣayati |
ajñānāṃ pradhānena saha abhisaṃyogāt aṅgapradhānayornityasaṃbandhāt ajñānāṃ mukhyakālatvam |
mukhyasya kāla eva kāle yeṣāṃ tāni mukhyakālāni ajñānāṃ |
mukhyasya yaḥ kālaḥ sa eva aṅgānāṃ iti |
tasmāt agnicayanadau asamāte eva sautrāmaṇī kartavyam |
apavṛtte tu codanā tatsāmānyāt sakāle syāt |
apa- vṛtte samāpte sāmidhenyau kratau vājapeye vā codanā |
citvā iti cayanasya pūrvakālatvavacanena cayanasya sāṅghasya samāptyuttarakālaṃ sautrāmaṇyāḥ, evaṃ iṣṭvā ityanenāpi sāṅghavājapeyasamāptyanantarameva bṛhaspatisavena codanā vidhirbhavati |
bṛhaspatisavesya ca jyoti- ṣṭomavikāratvāt vasantaḥ sakālāḥ |
ke. sarvaśca sati saṃbhave guṇamatilaṅghya pradhānenaiva nityaṃ saṃdhyate |
gārhapatyam ' ityatra yathā na kevalayā śrutyā virodhaḥ naivaṃ vākyenāpi, tasyāpi gārhapatyasamīpe ityevamupapatteḥ |
ata- aubhayavirodhasattve'pi ' pradhānena vyapadeśā bhavanti ' iti nyāyena śrutiliṅgavirodhādedāraṇatvam |
bhā. 11|4|6 | 26-29. mīko. pṛ. 2204 ' dvādaśāhe sulākālīnānām ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
' pradhānairupakāni kuryānajñānāṃ kathana ' vā. 3|1| 212 pṛ. 656. pradhānaiḥ saha ajñānāmekadeśakāla- kartṛtvam |
tatra anumatyādiṣu iṣṭeṣu ārambhaṇīyā na kartavyā |
anya- saṃyuktāt pradhānāt somādidhuktāt anumatyadigāt pradhānabhūtāt nivartata ārambhaṇīyeti |
sarvārambhāt sarvārambhārthena tatra jyotiṣṭomaḥ samāmnāyate ' agniṣṭomaṃ prathamamāharati ' iti |
tenaiva anumatyadīnāṃ ārambhārthe siddhe na punaḥ ārambhaṇīyā bhavitumarhati |
tasmāt anumatyadyartha annā- rambhaṇīyā na kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. pradhānasāṅghasya ca dharmavirodhe pradhānadharmasyaivānu- grahaḥ |
' indrāya tvā vadhumate gṛhṇāmi ' ityendramantrāsādhyasyā somagrahaṇasyā mantrābhāve dhyānādinā'pi smṛtasya anuṣṭhānāpatteḥ |
na aṅgabhūta- mantrānurodhena pradhānasya somagrahaṇamātrasyokto yuktāḥ iti tṛtīye ' liṅgaviśeṣanirdeśāt ' ( 3|2| 11|28 ) ityatra vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 527-528, pradhānasya anumantranākāṅkṣatve'pi anumantranākāṅkṣayā ākāṅkṣāpya viniyogo bhaviṣyati |
pṛ. 1198. pradhānasyopakāra ( yājamānāḥ vapanādimiḥ ) eṣa eva, yadasya phalagrahaṇāya yogyaḥ kartā kriyate |
vā. 3|1|216. pradhānasya upakāriṇe ye dharmāste ati-
bhā. pradhānasya hi codakena sāmānyaṃ na dharmāṇām |
dup. 7|1|12 pṛ. 1626, pradhānasya padāntaramapekṣamāṇasyāpi bhavati samāsaḥ |
yathā rāja- puruṣo darśanīyaḥ iti prādhānyāt puruṣasya darśanīyatvama- pekṣamāṇasya rājñā saha samāso bhavati, evaṃ prāyaṇīyodaya- nīyayoḥ ekādaśinanirapekṣamāṇayorbhavati samāsaḥ |
' vi. prastāvanā 16. pradhānasya vedāntarīyasya yatra vedā- ntarīyamaṅgaṃ bhavati, tatra pradhānadharmeva aṅgaṃ kartavyam ( iti tātparyam ) |
vā. 3|7|14, pradhānasya siddhasya na guṇānu- rodhena āvṛttiḥ |
3|6|10 pṛ. 1036, bhavati ca pradhānasya sāpekṣasyāpi samāsaḥ ( mahābhāṣya 2|1|1 pṛ. 5 kāśī ) |
2|1|5|18 pṛ. 422, yadaṅgaṃ pradhānena niyamenāpekṣitaṃ tādṛśāñcalatvāt pradhānasya saṃkocaḥ |
yatu aṅgaṃ pradhānena niyamena anapekṣitaṃ tādṛśāñcalatvāt pradhānasya saṃkocaḥ |
ata eva ' indrāya tvā ' ityādi- mantratvāt aindrapradhānaviṣayatayā somasya na saṃkocaḥ |
anendrapradāneṣu mantraṃ vinā'pi upāyāntareṇa anuṣṭheyārthasahitaṃbhavena mantrasya aindrapradānairnīyamenapekṣitatvāt |
anyathā tatrāpi aindrapradhānamātraviṣayatayā saṃkocaḥ syāt iti bodhyam |

prājāpatyānāṃ klṛptaśanāṃ ca samuccaya vadhyate, 'prājāpatye cāmnānāt' iti |

tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ prājāpatyānāṃ vapā abhighārayituṃ prayājaśeṣasya dhāraṇārthaṃ pātraṃ aparaṃ utpādayitavyam, tatastena prājāpatyānāṃ vapā abhighārayitavyāḥ, uta na śeṣo dhārayitavyaḥ : naiva tataḥ prājāpatyānāṃ vapā abhighāraṇīyā iti |
prātaḥ savane ca prayājaśeṣaḥ, viprakṛṣṭa kāle mādhyāndine savane brahmasāmakāle prājāpatyānālabhyaḥ śrūyate 'tān paryabhi- kṛtānutsṛjanti |
bhāṣyam- na vā prājāpatyānāṃ vapā abhighāryāḥ |
prayājasya hi gṛhītasya ājyasya sa ekadeśaḥ śeṣaḥ |
kimatau yadyevam ? ekadeśatvāpatteḥ śrūyamāṇo nāvayavinamupādeya- tvena codayati |
ekadeśatvādbhi- dhāraṇaṃ dravyameva na prayuṅkte ityucyate |
ājyabhāgārthaṃ ājyenāsaṃsargo juhvā riktayā prayojanam, nābhiṣṭena haviṣā |
tasmāt prājāpatyānāmabhighāritābhirvāmiḥ prayojanameva nāsti, kimarthaṃ śeṣo dhāryate iti |
dup- prakṛtatvāpi saṃbhavāt vicāre vikṛtirudāhṛtā, tadvipāyāṇi liṅgadarśanāni upāttāni sūtrakāreṇa |
tasmāt idaṃ syām (anyatra śeṣa- tvenopayuktam) na (tataḥ) anyena prayujyate yathottarārthaḥ sviṣṭakṛtā |
upādīyamānatvāt haviṣāṃ saṃkhyā vivakṣitā [ anānandāśramīyāditeratra triṣu ādarśeṣu pāṭho'yam |
taduttaraṃ tantraratne 'yadi upādīyamānatvaṃ haviṣāṃ syāt, tataḥ saṃkhyā vivakṣitā syāt, na tu tadasti iti avītoktiriyaṃ vyākhyeyā' iti |
avītoktiṃ vinaiva tu 'anupādīyamānatvāt haviṣāṃ saṃkhyā avivakṣitā' iti ānandāśramīyaḥ pāṭho yujyate |
yat (ājyabhāgadvayaṃ) tayā (juhvā) hoṣyate, tat kathaṃmasaṃ- spṛṣṭaṃ (prayājaśeṣeṇa) syāt |
haviḥsaṃskārasya tu anapekṣitatvāt (tādarthyaṃ abhighāra- ṇasya) adṛṣṭaṃ kalpyam |
prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇanyāyena bhakṣasya tadatkartṛ- niyamasya vā kartṛsaṃskāratvāt havirviśeṣasya tadvi- śeṣaṇasyāpi avibhakṣā|
bhāṭṭa. 6|1|47, 'gudenopayajati' ityatra asadakṛprayājaśeṣābhi- ghāraṇanyāyena upayuktasya gudasya pratipatyapekṣatvāt upayājabhakṣaśeṣaṇa vākyāntarakalpanāyā pratipattilopattiḥ|
bhāṭṭa. 12|4|4, 'jāghanyā patnīsaṃyājaṃ yajati' asya vacanasya niyamamātratve'pi prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇanyāyena niyamasyaiva jāghanīsaṃskārārthatvakalpanāṃ ityapi anā- śakyam|
kāmyamānatvaṃ dravyārjananimittavat, arthasaṃśaya tu jñāte'jñāte ca kāmyamānatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti arthavādādhi- karaṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |
adhyāpanasya adhyayanamātrasādhyatvāt viśiṣṭādhyayanaprayuktirna saṃbhavati, iti cet, upanayanaṃ tāvat kratvāpatyena adhyāpanāṅgatvamavagamyate, adhyayanaṃ copanayanaṃ prakramya vihitam |
naivam, adhyāpanāṅgabhūtaupanayanasya dvāratayā māṇavakāṅga- tvopapatteḥ, apūrvāṅgabhūtasyādhyāyatasya dvāratayā vrīhi- saṃśravat |
kiñca adhyāpanavidhyabhāve'pi svavidhipra- yuktirna saṃbhavati, kratuvidhiprayuttyupapatteḥ |
tathā ca sati svargakāmasya śrutyādhyāpyadhikāraḥ syāt |
asannamate tu prayojyapekṣayā kratuvibheṣu prayojyaphalavicāpekṣayā ajñopāyapekṣayā ca vilambitā |
anukte śabdena anukte'pi virodhe arthāntaratvāt pratyakṣādipramāṇāntaragamyatvāt |
tādarthye, svargasya puruṣāmilaṣaṇīyatve ava- gate sati puruṣasya taddeoktuḥ svargaṃ yāgaṃ vā prati na guṇā- rthatā saṃbhavati |
uktaśca grahaikatvanyāyaḥ pradhānagatā saṃkhyā na vivakṣitā iti |
na ca saṃkhyāyāḥ vivakṣā cāvivakṣā ca saṃbhavataḥ arthāntaratvāt arthabhedāt arthāntaratvamuktavākyabheda- doṣāpātāt |
bhūtaṃ iti bhavetśraudrādikāt prāpyaryāta niṣṭhā prāptamityarthaḥ |
yāgaṃ prati kartuḥ puruṣasya ekasyaiva phala- bhoktṛtvalakṣaṇaṃ prādhānyaṃ prāptatvāt prakṛte nāsti puruṣa- bhedaḥ |
sā yadi phalotpattiṃ yāgotpattiṃ vā vihate, tadā kartā na svārthena |
yadā punaḥ svārthena, tadā yāgaḥ phalaṃ vā tādarthyena |
tasmāt na yāge phale vā puruṣasya guṇabhāvaḥ |
ataḥ eko dvau bahavo vā yajeran iti pūrvapakṣaḥ pakṣaḥ |
apivā kāmasaṃyoge saṃbandhāt prayogopa- diśyeta, pratyarthaṃ hi vidhiśrutirvidhānāt |
svargakāmaḥ iti kāmena kāmyamānena phalena saṃyoge gamyamāne, saṃbandhāt yajete- tyekavacanena ekasyaiva kartuḥ saṃbandhāt yāgasya prayogāya anuṣṭhānāya eka eva kartā upadiśyeta na dvau bahavo vā |
yatra tu aneke arthā vaktavyā bhavanti tatra pratyarthaṃ artha- arthe vidhiśrutiḥ pṛthak bhavati |
yathā 'kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kaṇḍūyati' iti vipāṇākaraṇakaṇḍūyane pṛthak vidhiḥ; 'cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' iti viṣāṇākarmakaprāsane pṛthak vidhiḥ |
prakṛte tu vidhi- śrutiḥ pṛthak nāsti, tasmāt svargakāma iti vā yajeta iti vā ekavacanaṃ vivakṣitameva |
atra bhāṣyapadāni sūtrārthapratipādakāni imāni bhavanti- apīveti pañcamyāvṛttiḥ |
kāmasaṃyoge saṃbandhāt kāmasya ātma- saṃbandho''gamyate saṃbandhāt |
phalakāmaḥ ātmana eva phalaṃ kāmayate, na parasya |
yatra tu ubhau arthau vaktavyau bhavataḥ pratyarthaṃ tatra vidhiḥ śrūyate |
yathā 'kṛṣṇa- viṣāṇayā kaṇḍūyati, cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' iti |
kāma- saṃyoge kāmasya kāmyadasya saṃyogo yasmin tat kāma- saṃyogaṃ 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' iti vākyam |
tasmin kāmasaṃyoge vākye ākhyātasya saṃbandhāt ghaṭakatvena saṃbandhāt prayogāya puruṣapradārthye upadiśyate śrūyate |
pratyarthe prādhānyārthe vidheyatve ca vidhiśrutiḥ vidhātātparyathā yathā viṣāṇāyāṃ tathā atra neti |
atha kutūhalam-- yatra guṇapradhānabhāvau ubhau vidhi- stistau bhavataḥ tatra pratyarthaṃ pratyekaṃ vidhiśrutiḥ vidhāyikā śrutirasti |
kāmasaṃyoge kāmasaṃyukte vākye prayogāya yāgaṃ prayoktuṃ puruṣaḥ kartṛtvena ekatvena ca upadiśyeta, na tu phalaṃ prāpnuyāditi phalavyāpyatvalakṣaṇapradhānatvena |
8 pūrvapakṣī āha-- anyasyāpi svargaṃ kāmyamānaḥ kaścidyāgaḥ anyo yajeta |
anyasya svargaṃ kāmyamāno'pi svargakāmapadāvācyaḥ syānnāma tathāpi anyārthe anuṣṭhāne
sati tasya anyasya phalena svargeṇa abhisaṃbandho na syāt |
kartṛgāmini kriyāphale eva ubhayapadadāttaḥ ātmanepada- vidhānāt atra yajeta iti ātmanepadaprayogāt |
anyārthena anyasya svargaicchatvātā sati kartuṃ na abhi- saṃbandhaḥ, na abhedaḥ |
arthena phalena anyasya abhisaṃbandhaḥ vyāpyamānatvaṃ na bhavati |
yajeta ityātmane- padasya kartṛgāmini phale vihitatvāt |
svargaphalaṃ phalaṃ anyasya kāmyamāno'pi phalakāmaḥ ānuṣaṅgikaphalakāmaḥ |
'āśāste'yaṃ yajamānaḥ āyurāśāste suprajāstvamāśāste' ityādi sūkavākoktaṃ phalaṃ svasya kāmyamānaḥ : 'yajeta' ityātmanepadasya nimittaṃ bhavet |
phalakāmaḥ svargakāmapadaṃ nimittaṃ yajeta ityātmanepadasya nimittatvadyotakam |
phalakāmaḥ prayoktṛgatāṅgaphalakāmā ātmanepadasya nimittaṃ iti cet |
yasyaiva pradhānakarmaphalaṃ tasyaiva ānuṣaṅgikamapi phalaṃ bhavitumarhati |
tasmāt svasyaiva yāgaphalamicchan yajeta na parasya |
sa ca yāgakartā eka eva, na dvau bahavo vā |
bahiṣpavamāne śrutaṃ 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī iti dvayoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt, ete asu- abhinandaḥ iti bahumyo yajamānebhyaḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt |
evaṃ ca dviyajamānake bahuyajamānake ca karmaṇi prati- padidhāne karma tathā dviyajamānakameva syāt, tathā ca yajamānasaṃkhyāyā yāthākāmyam |
kutūhale tu, tathā satyeva yajamānasaṃkhyāyā mī. ko. 350
avivakṣitatve satyeva dvivahuyajamānake jyotiṣṭome prati- padi śeṣayuktaṃ bahiṣpavamānakarma śrūyamāṇaṃ saṃgaccheta iti vyākhyātam |
keṣu cidahīneṣu satreṣu kulāyayajñe ca anekayajamānakatvamasyeva |
tasmāt eko yajeta, na dvau bahavo vā |
su. 3|79 pṛ. 9. prayogeyattāvicārārthaṃ ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ śeṣe- yattāprasaṅgena |
gaurgāvī goṇī gopotalikyetyevamādayaḥ śabdā udā- haraṇam |
yathā gośabdaḥ sāsnādimataḥ pramāṇaṃ tathā gāvyādayo'pi, uta neti saṃdehaḥ |
kimatra ekaḥ śabdaḥ avicchinnapāramparyaḥ arthābhidhāne, itare tu apabhraṃśāḥ |
atra prabhākareṇa saṃgati- lobhāt 'na codāharaṇamādaraṇīyam' iti bhāṣyakārīya- mudāharaṇamanāhatya 'aśvamālabheta' ityādicodanāgataḥ adhvaśabdaḥ udāhṛtya vicāritaḥ |
loke aśvaśabdasya turage daridre ca prayogo dṛśyate |
tatra ca na jñāyate kutrāyaṃ sādhuḥ; kutra cāsādhuriti |
ataḥ 'aśvamālabheta' ityanyavasthitārthaśabdavatī codanā na pramāṇamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhāntastu vyākaraṇasmṛteḥ anādiprayogamūlatvena pramāṇatvāt taddeśana tālvya- vyākaraṇasyo'yamaśvaśabdaḥ |
prayogotpatti . 2694 prayogotpatti yuktaśca ' na vidyate svasmin ' iti vyutpattyā daridra sādhuḥ, na tālavyaśakārayukta iti ' aśvamālameta ' iti codanā adhyavasitārthatvāt pramāṇameveti |
tadidama- yuktam, pūrvapakṣe hi vyākaraṇamaternirmūlatvena prāmāṇye sati prayogavaśādeva sarvatra sādhutvaṃ vaktavyam |
tadubhaya- trāpi aviśiṣṭamiti turage daridra ca ayamaśvaśabdaḥ prayujyamānaḥ sādhureva |
tathā ca sati anekārthādiśābde- ṣviva arthaprakaraṇābhyāmvyavasāyasaṃbhavāt nānavyavasāyāt aprāmāṇyam |

pūrvaṃ smṛtyācārayordharma iti sarvaprakāraṃ nirūpya idānīṃ prasaṅgena vyākaraṇasmṛteḥ śabdasādhutvaṃ prati prāmāṇya- masti nāstīti ' sādhumimaṃṣita ' iti sādhuśabdasya dharma prati upayogatvena nirūpyate |
bhāṣyakāreṇa tu kiṃ sarve gogāvyādayaḥ śabdāḥ sāsnādimatpadārthe sādhavaḥ uta gośabda eva sādhuḥ gāvyādayaḥ apabhraṃśāḥ iti phalabhūtaḥ saṃśayo darśita iti mantavyam |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo'misaṃdhiḥ- gogāvyādiśabdānāṃ sādhvasādhuviveka vyākaraṇasmṛtiḥ pramāṇaṃ bhavet, yadi manvādismṛtivat mūlabhūtaṃ pramāṇamanumātuṃ śakyeta |
tatra na tāvat pratyakṣaṃ mūlaṃ saṃbhavati, tasya varṇasvarūpātirikta- vācakaśaktikarūpasādhutvaviṣayatvāt |
nāpi vyākaraṇa- smṛtisahakṛtam, nirmūlatvena vyākaraṇasmṛteḥ sahakāritvā- saṃbhavāt |
nāpi arthāpattiḥ, tasyā api artha- pratipattavyanyā'nupapattiprabhavatvena gāvyādiṣvapi avi- śeṣāt |
tenāyamarthaḥ, jananasya kartā jāyamānaḥ tasya yā prakṛtiḥ utpādakaḥ tasya apādānasaṃjñā bhavati |
na ca janiśabdena jagatyena jananamevamabhidhīyate, 'itikṛtipā dhātunirdeśe' iti svaya- meva pratiṣiddhatvāt |
tathā janikarturiti samāso'pyanu- papannaḥ; 'tujakābhyāṃ kartari' (pā0 2|2|15) iti tujantasya kartṛśabdasya svayameva ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhāt |

tathā akrapratyayāntasyāpi anena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaniṣedhāt 'tatprayojako hetuśca' (pā0 1|4|55) ityatra sūtre tasya prayojaka iti tacchabdena saha akrapratyayāntasya prayojakaśabdasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'pi anupapannaḥ |
tathāhi, 'bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ' ' ityatra kiṃ dhātuśabdapravṛttinimittam ? na tāvat guṇapāṭhaḥ; 'bhū sattāyām' ityatra 'sattā'śabda- syāpi dhātutvaprasaṅgāt |
ata eva na militayorapi dhātuśabdapravṛttinimittatvam, 'bhū sattāyām' ityeva kriyāvacanatvābhāvāt |
yadi icchāprayatnādhāratvaṃ svātantryam, tarhi 'kāṣṭhāni pacanti' 'sthālī pacati' ityatra akartṛlatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha dhātupātnyāpāratvaṃ kartṛtvam, tarhi pacatītyatra pacidhātunā sthālīsaṃmārjanopakramasya sikathapariṇamaparyantasya vyāpāra- niścayasya upapattatvāt sarvakārakāṇāmapi kartṛtvaprasaṅgaḥ |
evaṃ karmādayo'pi adhikaraṇaparyantāḥ sarve eva durnirū- pyatvā ityuktamapi vārtike vistarabhayāt nocyate |
ato vyākaraṇasya sādhuśabdagopattau aśāśvatvāt tadanugate- ṣveva śabdeṣu sādhutvaṃ nātiṣṭhate iti na sādhutvaṃ prati vyākaraṇasmṛteḥ prāmāṇyam |
evaṃ prāpte, abhidhīyate- śabde prayatnaniṣpatteraparādhasya bhāgitvam
bhavedevaṃ yadi śabdasādhutve vyākaraṇa- smṛtiḥ pramāṇaṃ na bhavet |
tathāhi, sādhutvaṃ nāma kaścidartha- viśeṣe svābhāvikapratipādanaśaktiyoginaḥ śabdasya

tacca prakṛtipratyayādidvāreṇa vyākaraṇa- smṛtyā yasya pratipādyate, tasyaiva vyākaraṇasmṛtisahakṛtena śrotrapratyakṣeṇāsādhuśabdādvyāvṛttaṃ sādhutvarūpaṃ sphuṭataramavadyatane- stāvata pratīyate eva, brāhmaṇatvamiva mātāpitṛsaṃbandha- smaraṇasahakṛtena cākṣuṣapratyakṣeṇa, ratnatvamiva ratnaparīkṣā- śāstrajñānasahitasaṃskārasahakṛtena cākṣuṣapratyakṣeṇa |
tena pāṇinairapi pūrvataravyākaraṇasmaraṇāhitasaṃskārasahitaśrotra- pratyakṣeṇa sādhutvopalambhān nirmūlatvaṃ vyākaraṇasmṛte- riti |
dṛṣṭā hi sarvatra sūtrakārāṇāṃ sūtreṣu gauṇalakṣaṇikā eva prayogāḥ |
yathā hi jaiminereva nitye vācye aupādhikaśabdaprayogaḥ, tathā janiśabde'pi dhātyarthe, janmani lākṣaṇikatvena doṣa- māvahati |
tathā 'tujakābhyāṃ kartari' iti niṣiddha- ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaśravaṇamapi niṣedhasya vaikalpikatvapradarśanārthameva |
yacca 'bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ' (pā0 1|3|1) ityatra dhātuśabdārthaparijñānādaprāmāṇyamuktam, tadayuktam, tiḍā- dipratyayaprakṛtitvameva hi dhātutvam |
etadeva 'pratyayaḥ, paraśca' (pā0 3|1|1, 2) iti sūtrābhyāṃ pāṇinā svayameva darśitam |
yadapi 'svatantraḥ kartā' iti kartṛ- lakṣaṇaṃ svātantryanirūpaṇāt ayuktamityuktam, tadayuktam, kriyāsiddhayanukūlakārakaprayojakatvaṃ hi svātantryam |
tadukte bhartṛ- hariṇā 'pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā kārakāṇāṃ ya īśvaraḥ |
asaṃpṛktaḥ prayukto vā sa kartā nāma kārakam ||
yastu 'kāṣṭhāni pacanti' ityādiṣu acetaneṣu kartṛnirdeśaḥ, sa vaivakṣika eveti mantavyam |
ataḥ śrotra- pratyakṣamūlatvena śabdasādhutvena vyākaraṇasmṛtiḥ pramāṇameveti gavādi śabdā eva sādhava iti |
gāvyādiśabdānāṃ punaḥ uccāraṇasāmarthyato mūlaśabdāpabhraṃśānāṃ vivakṣiteṣu mūla- śabdānusāreṇa arthapratipādakatvam, avivakṣiteṣu tu vācakatvānvayyeveti |
prayojanam- kratau caraṇabharasaṃkalpādivākyeṣu apa- bhraṃśenāpi vyavahartavyam, yadi pūrvaḥ pakṣa |
sūtraṃ tu- śabde abhivyajyamāne tadabhivyakteḥ prayatnā- dhīnaniṣpattitvāt aparādhābhāgitvaṃ apabhraṣṭatvaṃ abhi- vyañjakadoṣādeveti bhāvaḥ |
gaurgāvī goṇī gopolatikā ityevādiṣu śabdeṣu ayamarthaḥ sādhuḥ anenaiva vyavahartavyam, nāyaṃ sādhuḥ na tena vyavahartavyaṃ iti vyavasthā na syāt |
vyākaraṇa- smṛtyā vyavasthā syāditi cet, na, prayogotpattiśāstra- tvāt |
athavā prayogasya utpattiḥ vyavasthā yathā sā prayogotpattiḥ vyākaraṇasmṛtiḥ |
athavā sādhumimaṃṣita asādhurbhinna iti prayogotpatteḥ uccāraṇaniyamasya aśālīyatvāt |
tasmāt yaḥ ko'pi śabdaḥ karmādau prayoktavyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
katham ? śabdoccāraṇe hi mahān prayatno bhavati |
vāyunamitaiḥ : urasi vistīrṇaḥ, kaṇṭhe vivartitaḥ, mūrdhānamāhatya parāvṛttaḥ vaktre vicaran vividhān śabdān abhivyanakti |
evaṃ śabde uccārayitavye sati uccārayituḥ prayatnana śabdasya niṣpatteḥ abhivyakteḥ aparādhasya bhāgitvam |
tathā ca aparādhasya saṃbhavāt naikāntataḥ sarveṣāmanādittvam |
yo hi askhalitaprayatnaḥ śabdamabhivyanakti tasya paraṃparāgata-
yadā tu aprayatnaniṣpattirapi śabde saṃbhāvyate, tadā tatra aparādhajanyarūpāntarapattiprasaṅgāt na sarvaśabdānāṃ samāna- prakāratvam |
athavā śabde śabdaviṣayasya prayatnasya vā niṣpattiḥ tasyāṃ aparādhaḥ sunipuṇānāmapi acikalakaraṇānāṃ dṛśyate kimuta anipuṇakaraṇānām |
' tathā sati sādhutāniyāmakāraṇe vyākaraṇadeḥ niyāmakatvaṃ upapadyate |
tasmāt sādhava eva prayoktavyāḥ nāsādhavaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
śabde gavyādiśabde prayujyamāne aparādhasya ayayo- cāraṇasya bhāgitvam |
janakatā- saṃbandhena tadvāg bhāg, tasya bhāvaḥ bhāgitvaṃ pravartakatvaṃ iti yāvat |
prayatnaniṣpatteḥ prayatnaviśeṣa eta śabda- svarūpasya yathāvat abhivyakteḥ |
nanu sarveṣāmeva vācakatvaṃ kuto na svīkriyate iti cet, tatrāha |
anekaśabdāt anekaḥ śabdaḥ vācako yasya ekasyārthasya saḥ anekaśabdaḥ; tasya bhāvaḥ anekaśabdatvam |
ekasyārthasya anekaśabdavācyatvaṃ na yuktaṃ yogyārthasyanudayāt anyā- narthakyāt vikalpāpatteḥ arthamedāpatteḥ vācyatvāvacchinna- vācakāśritaikaśabdāmātreṇa upapatteśca |
asyaiva sūtrasya rūpaparivartane 'anyāyyānekāryatvam' iti paribhāṣā pravartita iti jñeyam |
nanu gavādiśabdā eva sādhavo vācakāḥ gavyādi- śabdāstu aśāstrajñāḥ ityatra kiṃ vinigamakama ? ata āha siddhāntī |
lakṣaṇasya vyākaraṇasya śravaṇaṃ abhyāsaśca tābhyāṃ abhiyogaviśeṣo bhavati |
yat lakṣyaṃ udāharaṇīkṛtya lakṣaṇaṃ śrutamanyastaṃ ca tadvyati- riktanāmāpi tulyanyāyānāṃ lakṣyāṇāṃ jñānaṃ bhavati |
nanu gavyādiśabdasya śaktyā vinā kathaṃ artha- pratipādakatā lekasiddhā saṃbhavati |
tadaśaktiḥ teṣāṃ gavyādiśabdānāṃ gavyārthe aśaktiḥ nāsti śaktiḥ |
ayaṃ bhāvaḥ — gośabdamuccārayitukāmena kena cit indriyāpāṭavena gāvītyuccāritam |
apareṇa jñātaṃ sāsnādimantaḥ asya vivakṣita iti |

'kuta āgato'si' iti pṛṣṭe 'aśmakebhya āga- cchāmi' iti vaktavye kena cit 'aśmakairāgacchāmi' ityuktam, tatra aśmakaprātipadikasya ekadeśatvāt aśma- kebhyaḥ iti śabdasmaraṇāt pṛṣṭottaraṃ bhraṣṭyā pratipadyate |
evaṃ aśmakebhya ityatra aśmakaiḥ iti vibhaktiyavyaye'pi yathā iṣṭārthasya pratyayo bhavati tathā gavyādiśabdāt vācakasādhuśabdasmaraṇadvārā arthasya pratipattiḥ |
atha gaurityemādayaḥ śabdāḥ kimākṛtaḥ pramāṇam, uta vyakteḥ iti saṃdehe ucyate |
idaṃ tāvat parīkṣyatāṃ kiṃ ye eva laukikāḥ śabdāste eva vaidikāḥ, uta anye iti |
yadā te eva, tadā kiṃ te eva eṣāmarthaḥ, uta anye iti saṃśayaḥ |
atra prabhākareṇa ya eva laukikāḥ te eva vaidikāḥ uta anye ityasyāpi vicārasya ākṛtirūpodyavātāmabhyupagatyāpi sākṣāt saṃgati- lobhāt aprāmāṇyena pūrvapakṣamuktvā pṛthak saṃgatirdarśitā |
sā ceyamatidānarasiktayā jāmātṛsahāyasyāpi taukadāna- miva bhāti |
yato na hi upodghātasyāpi pṛthak saṃgatya- pekṣā bhavati |
prakaṭavicārasiddhayarthatayā tatsaṃgatayeva tasya saṃgatatvāditi yathāvatikameva adhikaraṇaṃ prastūyate |
pūrvādhikaraṇe hi gavādiśabdānāṃ vācakatve nirū- pite tatprasaṅgena vācyanirūpaṇamārabhyate krimepākṛti- rvācyā, uta vyaktiḥ iti |
asya ca vicārasya niṣprayojanatvamāśaṅkaya tatprayojanatvañca idamupoddhātena vicāryate kiṃ ye eva laukikāḥ śabdāḥ te eva vaidikāḥ, te evaiṣāmarthāḥ, uta anye iti |

tatrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo- 'bhisaṃdhiḥ — 'atha śabdānuśāsanam' ityuktvā 'keṣāṃ śabdānām, laukikānāṃ vaidikānāṃ ca' ityabhiyuktānā- meva śabdavidāṃ (mahābhāṣyākārāṇāṃ) vyapadeśabheda- darśanāt medastāvadagamyate |
tathā vede 'agniṣṭomaḥ' iti, loke ca 'agniṣṭomaḥ' iti |
vede śrūyate — 'uttānā vai deva- gavā vahanti' iti, 'suvarṇaparṇo vanaspatiḥ' evaṃ 'ghṛtaṃ madhu' iti |
tena yatrāpi gavādiśabdeṣu rūpabhedo nāvagamyate, tatrāpyarthabhedādeva śabdabhedaḥ |
vede ca śabdārthayorbhinnatvāt laukikagavādiśabdānā- kṛtivyaktivācitvanirūpaṇaṃ vedaprāmāṇyānupayogāt- meveti |
to tu pratyabhijñānāt loka- vedayopi ekaiva |
ye eva gavādiśabdā loke pratīya- yante, te eva vede'pi pratyabhijñāyante |
bhavatu vā keṣāñcit anyatvam, na caivam, avikṛtapratyabhijñāya- mānānāṃ gavādiśabdānāmapi anyatve kiñcit kāraṇamasti |
yat 'uttānā vai deva- gavā vahanti' iti tadapi arthavādāmātram, lokasiddha gapadārthasyottānavahanarūpakriyāviśeṣapratipādanasya praśaṃsā- 'rthatvāt |
taduktaṃ bhāṣye 'ya eva laukikāḥ śabdāsta eva vaidikāsta eva caiṣāmarthāḥ' iti |
sūtraṃ tu lokedavayoḥ śabdarūpasya arthasya caikatvaṃ pratyabhijñāprayatnāvibhāgāt |
evaṃ ca sati darśapūrṇamāsādiprayogacodanānāṃ bhāvaḥ syāditi |
goḥ ityemādayo ya eva laukikāḥ śabdāḥ ye ca teṣāmarthāḥ kiṃ ta eva vaidikāḥ utānye iti vicāre siddhāntāha |
arthakatvaṃ arthasya abhidhānasya abhi- gheyasya ca ekatvam |
ya eva loke śabdā arthāśca ta eva vede nānye |
prayogacodanābhāvāt lokavedayoḥ pada- padārthanāmatve vaidikapadānāṃ agṛhītasaṃgatikatvāt veda- vākyārthedhāya vākyoccāraṇasaṃbhavaḥ |
tasya codanā uccāraṇaṃ tasyāḥ bhāvāt vidyamānatvāt |
padapadārthayorbhede tu sarvavaidikapadānāṃ anava- gatasaṃbandhatvena arthajñānābhāvāt kriyākārakasaṃgatitmaka- prayogacodanānāṃ amāvāt abhāvāt prasaṅgāt |
evaṃ ca bhāvāt abhāvāt ityubhayathā padacchedaḥ |
tasmāt loke vede ca padānāṃ tadarthānāṃ caikyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
atha ākṛtiḥ śabdārtho vyaktīti vicāre pūrva- pakṣamāha |
prayogacodanā- 'bhāvāt ākṛteḥ padārthatve 'vrīhīnavahanti' , 'paśu- mālabhate' ityādīnāṃ prayogacodanānāṃ amāvāt abhāva- prasaṅgāt |
śabdasya vyaktiḥ vyaktau eva svīkāryā na jātau |
'ekā deyā, ṣaḍ deyāḥ, dvādaśa deyāḥ' iti āghānadakṣiṇā- vidhāyakādivākye ṣaḍādiśabdānāṃ gopadena anvayo na syāt, gotvajāterekatvāt |
'yadi paśupākataḥ palāyeta anyaṃ tadarthaṃ tadyasa- mālabheta' iti vacane prathamaṃ svīkṛtasya paśoḥ sthāne anyasya darśanāt |
yadi paśuśabdaḥ ākṛtivacanaḥ syāt tadā anyasya ālabhamo nopapadyeta |
tasmāt vyaktivacanaḥ śabdaḥ ityeva svī- kartavyaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
śabdānāṃ vyaktiḥ śakyo'rthaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhāntasūtram |
na kriyā syāditi cedarthāntare vidhānaṃ, na dravyamiti cet |
śabdasya śaktirākṛtau iti pakṣe vahananādiḥ kriyā na syāt |
vyaktauaiva vahanamālabhanādikriyāyāḥ saṃbhavaḥ na jāto, iti cet |
ākṛtipakṣipakṣe 'yadi paśurūpā- kṛtaḥ palāyeta anyaṃ tadarthaṃ tadyasamālabheta' iti arthā- ntare vyaktyantare vidhānaṃ na syāt tatrāpi ākṛterekatvāt iti cet |
'ghaḍ deyāḥ dvādaśa deyāḥ' ityādi ṣaṭtvāderanvayaḥ gavādau na syāt ākṛterekatvāt na dravyaṃ upadiśyamānaṃ yuktaṃ syāt, iti cet |
tasmāt vyaktā- veva śaktiḥ svīkāryā, iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
niśaikatriṃśadātriṃśatsūteṣu pūrvapakṣahetavo ye uktāḥ teṣā- meva atrānuvādaḥ |
atra ca vākyatrayaṃ 'na kriyā syāditi cet' ityekam, 'arthāntare vidhānaṃ syāditi cet' iti dvitīyam, 'na syāt dravyamiti cet' iti tṛtīyam |
vastutastu asmin sūtre ye pūrvapakṣahetavaḥ uktāḥ te pūrvaṃ sūtrerevoktāḥ iti punaranuvādo vyarthaḥ iti sūtramevedaṃ vyarthaṃ bhavati |

atra sudhā-- ākṛtyabhidhānapakṣaparāmarśāt ākṛti- vācitāyāṃ ālabhanādikriyā na syāt, 'anyaṃ tadarthaṃ tadyasamālabheta' iti cārthāntare ālabhavidhānaṃ na syāt, 'ṣaḍ deyāḥ' iti ca dravyāvyasya saṃkhyālakṣaṇasya vācakaḥ paṇḍito śabdo na syāditi pūrvapakṣasūtrārthānu- bhāṣaṇārthaṃ sūtraṃ iti |
śabdasya vyaktau eva śaktiḥ nākṛtau iti pūrvapakṣe ye hetavaḥ triṃśaṃ sūtramārabhya caturviṃśāntasūteṣu uktāḥ tatra uttaramanena sūtreṇocyate |
prayogasya vahana- nādiprayogasya tadarthatvāt vyaktyarthatvāt vyaktidvārā ākṛtau siddhatvāt na kaścit virodhaḥ |
avibhāgaḥ, yasmāt jāteḥ vyakteḥ sakāśāt atyantaṃ vibhāgo nāsti tasmāt na virodhaḥ |
atra vārtikam-- tadarthatvāt apūrvārthatvāt, ālabhanaprokṣaṇādyajñānāṃ apūrvasādhane prayogeṇa bhavita- vyam |
dravyaṃ ca apūrvasādhanaṃ yāgena svasiddhayarthaṃ ākṣita- tvāt, nākṛtiḥ asamarthatvāt |
tadabhidhānaṃ tu dravya- niyamārthaṃ pratipattavyaṃ na svārthaṃ jāterapekṣitvatvāt adṛṣṭārthatvaprasaṅgāt, sādhanatvāpratīteśca |
yadapi jāteḥ prātipadikābhihitāyāḥ karaṇatvaṃ pratīyate tadapi dravya- niyāmakatvenaiva na sākṣāt ayogyatāt |
tena ākṛtya- bhidhānasya (tadarthatvāt--) dravyaniyamārthatvāt dravye ca ālabhanaprokṣaṇasaṃkhyākārakasāmānādhikaraṇyādisaṃbhavā- dadṛṣṭatā |
yadā ākṛtivyaktyoḥ atyantamedā- bhāvāt kadācit vyaktirūpeṇa dravyaṃ abhīdhīyate, kadā cit sāmānyarūpeṇa, yathā vivakṣitaṃ tathā, śabdasya ubhayarūpastvarthatvāt (tadarthatvāt) |
vyaktyanabhi- dhāne'pi na prayogasya vibhāgaḥ nānāpyate |
jātervā vyaktitaḥ atyantamedābhāvāt vyakteḥ dharmā jātau kṛtā eva bhavanti iti na prayogasya vibhāgena prayojana- miti |
yadā ākṛtivyaktyorubhayoḥ (tadarthatvāt--) yāgārthatvāt dharmāṇāṃ yatra yatra ca yāgasādhane kṛtānāṃ prayojanavatvāt dravyādavibhaktateti |
tasmāt ākṛtipakṣe'pi ālbhamādisaṃbhavāt ākṛti- reva śabdārtha iti siddham |
upaśabdaḥ samīpavacanaḥ, saṃśabdaḥ sākalyavacanaḥ, grahaṇaśabdo gṛhṇativacanaḥ |
(aṃśa- trayamadhye yaḥ anuṣṭhānāpratyahaṇārthaḥ sa prayogavacanasya svarūpaṃ iti bhāvaḥ) |
ḍupa. 1211 2|7. prayogavacanaḥ codakāt durbalaḥ jaghanyakālatvāt iti uktaṃ guṇamukhyavyatikramādhikaraṇe ( 3|1|2 ) svayam |
vā. 3|1|2|15. prayogavacanaścodakāpekṣayā durbala iti dvādaśe ( 1|2|12|7 ) vakṣyate |
soma. 5|1|10. prayogavacanastāt padārthān prāpayati yeṣāṃ ṛtvartha- tvam |
6|1|4| 10|3|4|26. prayogavacanaḥ sahakartavyavāgateṣu padārtheṣu sarvārthamanā tvaramānasya yāvānevātyantaśaktyā kālaviprakarṣo bhavati tāvanmātrameva anumanyate |
śaktastu kṣaṇamātramapi yadi vikṣepaṃ kuryāt tadasya prayogavacana- vidhiḥ na saheta |
vā. 1|3|16, prayogavacanatvena sarve padārthāḥ pradhānakālatvaṃ viprakṛṣyatyāḥ iti pratipāditam |
1|3|16. prayogavacanena hi ekena śabdena aṅga- pradhānāni ucyante |
bhā. 10|1|16, prayoga- vacanāt utpannopasaṃhārakāt codakaḥ utpādakaḥ prāpakaśca balavān |
ḍupa. 1211|13. prayogavacanāśrayaṃ codakāśrayeṇa bādhyate, yathā syene prākṛtāṅgeṣu udgātuḥ kartṛtvaṃ codakaprāptena nāna- tvikartṛtvena |
bāla. pṛ. 141. prayogavacanāśritaṃ codakāśrayeṇa bādhyate, aprāptatvāt |
vā. 3|1|14 pṛ. 860. prayogavacanāśritatvāt mukhyavyatikramayordaurbalyaṃ codakāśritatvāt tu śrutyarthapāṭhakāṇḍānāṃ valīyastvam |
bhāṭṭa. 1112|1 pṛ. 151. prayoga- vidhiḥ kramaviṣaye'pi durbalaḥ |
soma. 5|1|10. prayogavidhiścodakāddurbalaḥ; padārtha- prāpyadhīnatvāt prayogavidheḥ; tatprāpteścodakādhīnatvāt |
iti asvarasakalpyā bāhyasyānivārpaḥ pūrva tataḥ sara- svatyājyanirvāpaḥ |
5|1|10|17-18. prayoga- vidhiḥ nityādhikāre'pi sarvāṅgaviśiṣṭameva pradhānaṃ anu- ṣṭhāpayati |
su. pṛ. 532. prayogavidhiḥ sāṅgānuṣṭhāna- bodhako vidhiḥ |
sa ca nityakalpo mitraḥ utpattividhi- yogavidhivyapajīvakaśca |
na ca kimartha tatkalpanāṃ iti vācyam |
maṇi. pṛ. 99. prayogavidhinā yathā śrutiliṅgādibhirvinīyatvāḥ padārthā vidhīyante tathā śrutyādibhirviniyuktatvāt kramo'pi prayogavidhinā vidhīyate |
soma. 5|1|1 pṛ. 406. prayogavidheḥ nimittaparatantratvāt tadanu- rodhena nimittaśrutināghāyogaḥ |
su. pṛ. 532. prayogavidhau prayājāderguṇatvāt na pratyekamekakriyā- nvayaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 165. prayogavidhyāśritasya daurbalyaṃ tatratatra nirūpitam |
bhāṭṭa. 1112|7. prayogavidhiprayojyatvena yasyaiva śaktau anuṣṭhāna- prasaktiḥ, tasyaiva aśaktau nimittaśrutyanurodhena tyāgaḥ |
māṣakaṃ hāstikaṃ kauṇḍinyakamityevalakṣaṇāni kiṃ pramāṇaṃ aprāmāṇamiti saṃdigdhāni |
kalpasūtrāṇāmapi vedavat svādhyāyā- dhyāya rūpādiraviśeṣāt arthāviśeṣācca, māśakādidhamā- khyānāṃ ca kāṭhakādivat pravacanato'pi upapattervedatvam |
tathāhi, 'sarvāsu tithiṣu darśapūrṇamāsau' iti kalpasūtram, paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyayoreveti vedāḥ |
atra sarvāsu tithiṣu darśapūrṇamāsā- viti paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyayopi prāptatvāt vikalpasaṃbhavena viruddhārthayoḥ parasparavyāghātāt aprāmāṇyameveti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
na hi saṃkīrṇārthayoḥ parasparavirodhena aprāmāṇyaṃ bhavati |
tathā sati 'ekā devyā' ityādiṣvapi aprāmāṇya- prasaṅgāt |
atha tatra phalabhūyastvakalpanāyā avirodhaḥ; tathā atrāpi phalabhūyastvārthameva paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyayoḥ śravaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti yathāvārtikameva adhikaraṇaṃ prastūyate |

pūrvaṃ manvādisamṛtimudāhṛtya tulyanyāyatayā kalpa- sūtrāṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ ca śrutimūlatayā prāmāṇye nirūpite idānīṃ kalpasūtramudāhṛtya teṣāmeva svatantryeṇa vedavat prāmāṇyamāśaṅkaya tannirākaraṇena smṛtadhikaraṇanyāyaḥ eva vyākhyāyate |

na ca vācyam 'dharmasya śabdamūlatvāda- śabdamanapekṣya syāt' ityupalavyamānamūlaśabdānāmaṣṭakādismṛtīnāṃ tannyāyaviṣayatvāt, kathaṃ pratyakṣo- palabhyamānamūlatvaṃ kalpasūtrāṇāmapi tannyāyaviṣayatvam |
yattu prathamaṃ kalpasūtramātrameva udāharaṇamityu- ktam, tattu bhāṣyānusāreṇeti nādaraṇīyam |
atrāyaṃ pūrva- pakṣiṇo'bhisaṃdhiḥ :- smṛtīnāṃ purāṇānāṃ kalpasūtrāṇāṃ ca mahājanādaraparigṛhītātīndriyārthaviṣayatvāt abhihotrādi- codanāvat vedatvameva |
anyathā nityānityasaṃyogavirodhāt māśakādismākhyā- yāśca kāṭhakādismākhyātvaṃ pravacanādevopapatteḥ |
yathāhi 'śiśrvā''ṅgiraso mantrakṛtā mantrakṛdāsīt' iti (tāṃ. brā. 13|3|124) mantrapravattari mantrakṛddeśo vede, tathā pravattari māśakādau loke kartavyapadeśa iti |
evaṃ ca sati buddhāgrādyamānāpi vedadeva tulyanyāyatayā prayogaśāstratvāviśeṣāt dharme prāmāṇyaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇe'bhimita- miti |
bhavedevaṃ yatra mahājanādaraparigṛhī- tātīndriyārthaviṣayatvaṃ vedatvamantareṇa upapadyeta |
tacca ubhayathā'pi upapadyate, vedatvena vedamūlatvena ca |
tatra avicchinnadṛḍhatarakartṛsmṛteḥ pauruṣeyena vedatvātsaṃbhavāt smṛtyudhikaraṇasiddhāntena vedatulyatvena vyavasthāpyate |
yattu nityave'pi mantrakṛddeśavat kartavyapadeśa ityu- ktam, tadasaṅgatam, vyapadeśamātraṃ hi mantrakṛddeśavat yathākathañcit samādhānamadhikurute |
evaṃ ca sati samākhyā'pi pauruṣeyatva- nibandhanā, na tu kāṭhakādivat pravacananibandhanā |
yattu 'ācāryavacanaḥ pramāṇam' iti veda eva kalpa- sūtrādīnāṃ nityatvaṃ pratipādayati, itarathā nityānitya- saṃyogavirodhatvādidamuktm, tadasat |
nahyaṃ vedo māśakā- dīnāṃ kalpasūtrarūpapravacanaviṣayaḥ; ki tarhi ? ācārya- vacanaviṣaya evāyam |
ācāryaśabdasya pravṛtti- nimittopādhitāmāśrityaṇe pāśakādiṣvat nityārtha- tvāt |
athavā ācinoti śrotṛbuddhimiti vyutpatyā ācāryo veda eveti nātūpapannam |
ata eva dṛḍhatara- kartṛsmṛteḥ : buddhādyāgamānāmāpi na svātantryeṇa pramāṇatā |
iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ :- kalpasūtrādīnāṃ vedamūlatvena prāmāṇyam, teṣāṃ tu asanmūlatvena aprāmāṇyameveti |
prayojanam- pūrvapakṣe adhītakalpasūtraprasaṇe'pi vedaprasannaprāyāścittam, siddhānte tu avetvācceti |
sūtraṃ tu-- na vedatvaṃ kalpasūtrādīnāṃ prāka asatā- meva māśakādibhiḥ niyamāt nibandhanaditi |
māśakaṃ hāstikaṃ kauṇḍinyakaṃ ityevajātīyakaṃ kalpa- sūtraṃ pramāṇaṃ na veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
prayogaśāstraṃ prayogasya anuṣṭheyapadārthapaurvāparyasya śāstraṃ śāsakaṃ kalpa- sūtraṃ pramāṇaṃ svātantryeṇa iti cet |
naitat samyakninandhanaṃ svarā- bhāvāt iti bhāṣyam |
prāgasaddhiḥ janyaiḥ bodhanādi- puruṣaiḥ niyamāt niyamāt praṇītatvāt iti kutūhalam |
yathā vede vākyaśeṣāḥ arthavādāḥ santi tathā kalpasūtreṣu na santi iti avākya- śeṣāt vākyaśeṣaśūnyatvāt na vedavat svātantryeṇa pramāṇaṃ kalpasūtram |
kalpasūtrāṇi satyāvācāṃ vacanāni iti svātantryeṇa prāmāṇāni iti pūrvapakṣoktaṃ dūṣayati siddhāntī |
'pūrva- pakṣe sarvāsu tithiṣu amāvāsyā' iti kalpasūtravacane sarvatra sarvāsu pūrvapakṣatithiṣu amāvāsyāśabdasya prayukta- tvāt amāvāsyāyāgakartavyatā uktā |
amāvāsyāyāga- saṃnidhāne śāstraṃ śrutivacanaṃ tu 'amāvāsyāyāṃ amā- vāsyā yajeta' iti |
evaṃ sarvatra prayuktatvāt saṃni- dhānaśāstrācca na satyavacanatā kalpasūtrakārasya sidhyati |
tasmāt svātantryeṇa prāmāṇyaṃ kalpasūtrāṇāṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
atra kutūhalam- cakāraḥ arthaḥ heto yato vedamūlakatvaiva kalpasūtrāṇi pramāṇaṃ na svatantratayā, tassāt pratyakṣaśruti- virodhe apramāṇaṃ iti |
ke. prayojakaṃ apūrva agnihotrādigatānāmaṅgānām, tena ūhasiddhiḥ |

bhā. 9|1|4|9, yasya ca aṅgadvāreṇa prayojakatvaṃ tadeva prayojakaṃ iti āmikṣādhi- karaṇe vakṣyāmaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 9, yeṣu dharmeṣu vidhīya- māneṣu yadapūrvamucyate tat teṣāṃ prayojakaṃ bhavati, na yāvat kiñcit |
vā. 3|1|40 pṛ. 670, yadarthaṃ hi kriyante dharmāḥ tat prayojakam |
bhā. 9|1|12 varṇakaṃ 2, yadi yena kartavyaṃ bhavati, tat tasya prayojakam |
9|1|2|12, yanniṣṭhakṛtiyāsyatāni rūpitoddeśyasyāli yat tat tasya prayojakam, yathā- āmikṣādiśadi dadhyānayanā- (na maprayājā) deḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|1, prayojake na śaknuhoti paśoḥ agnīṣomīye paśau |

bhā. 4|1|2 varṇakaṃ 3, prayojako na avaghātakālīnastupopavāpaḥ kapālo- pādānāsādanayoḥ |

paurṇamāsyāṃ tu upavepārthaṃ kiñcit kāṣṭhaṃ grāhyam |
4|1|121-6, prayojako na sviṣṭakṛtyāgaḥ avayavino haviṣstaduttarārthasya vā, ājyaprekṣepasya tu prayojakaḥ |

ādyo yathā- śeṣī svargādiḥ śeṣaṃ yāgādikaṃ svārthaṃ prayuṅkte na parārtham |
dvitīyo yathā- nimitte jīvanamedanādi areṣibhūtaṃ daśādikaṃ medanahomādikaṃ ca na svārthaṃ prayuṅkte |

ṭupa. 7|1|1|1, prayojakā- prayojakatvaṃ hi 'arthe samavaipamyam' 4|1|8|29 ityataḥ:
[1] kaścit utpatte- rapi prayojakaḥ , upādānasyāpi pālanasyāpi |
[2] kaścit tritayasyāpi aprayojakaḥ , yathā- tuṣopavāpaḥ kapālasya notpatteḥ prayojakaḥ , nopādānasya, na pālanasya |
sa tu puroḍāśārthamevotpannaṃ upāttaṃ pālitaṃ ca kapālaṃ sādhanatvena gṛhṇāti |

[3] kaścit utpatteraprayojakaḥ , upādānapālanayostu prayojakaḥ , yathā- akṣāmyajñanaṃ na pāṃsunāmutpatteḥ prayojakam, khata eva tulyatvā siddhānāṃ teṣāṃ padagrahaṇarūpopādānasya prayojakaṃ pālanasya ca |
evaṃ prātardohyāgo 'pi aśītapītotpatteravya ūdhaḥsthitadugdhasya dohanarūpamupādānaṃ pālanaṃ ca prayuṅkte |
vājinayāgo'pi vājinotpatteḥ aprayojakaḥ tasyā āmi- kṣārthadadhyānayanādhīnatvāt , vājinopādānapālanayostu prayojaka eva |
[4] kaścit utpattereva prayojaka nopādānapālanayoḥ, yathā- āmiṣā vājinotpatteḥ prayo- jikā, nopādānapālanayoḥ |
evaṃ svargādiphalaṃ yāgotpatte- reva prayojakam, na yāgopādānapālanayoḥ |
[5] kaścit utpattyupādānayoreva prayojakaḥ pālanamātrasya tu prayojakaḥ, yathā- sviṣṭakṛdāgādiḥ śeṣasya |
[6] kaścit upādānasyaiva prayojakaḥ , notpattipālanayoḥ : yathā- grāvaṇi saptamapadanidhāne akṣāmyajñanaṃ asaṃskṛta- pāṃsupādānasyaiva prayojakam, na pāṃsutpattipālanayoḥ |
evaṃ carau tuṣopavāpo hastopādānasyaiva prayojakaḥ , na tadutpatteḥ pālanasya vā |
evaṃ āgneyādigāgo devatāyāḥ uddeśātmakapādānasyaiva prayojakaḥ , na devatotpatteḥ tatpāla- nasya vā |
[7] kaścit utpattipālanayoreva prayojakaḥ, na tūpādānasya, yathā- svargādiphalaṃ apūrvasyotpatteḥ prayojakaṃ pālanasyāpi dharmanāśakakarmanāśajalpasyādau
hi kṛte svargātpatteḥ, na tu utpattiyatiriktaṃ kiñcidasti apūrvasyopādānam, yat svargādinā phalena prayujyate |

[8] kaścit utpattyupādānayoreva prayojakaḥ , na pāla- nasya, yathā- agnīṣomīyasya vikāre nirupadadhau asati dīkṣite maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍadānaṃ daṇḍotpatyupādānayoḥ prayojakam, na tapālanasya pūrvavidyamānatvāt tasyeti |
evaṃ prayojakaḥ ādyabhedāt tṛtīyādibhedānāṃ ca gaṇanayā saptavidhaḥ |
aprayojako'pi dvitīyasya tṛtīyā- dibhedānāṃ ca gaṇanayā saptavidha iti siddham |
kaścit svārthaṃ prayuṅkte, yathā- śeṣī svargādiḥ śeṣaṃ yāgādikaṃ svārthaṃ prayuṅkte, na pārārthyam |
kaścit parārthaṃ kiñcit prayuṅkte, na svārtham, yathā- nimittaṃ jīvanamedādi aśepibhūtam , darśādikaṃ bhedanahomādikaṃ ca na svārthaṃ prayuṅkte, kintu pāpakṣaya- ṛtūpakārādi śeṣārthaṃ prayuṅkte |
kaścit svāṅgasyāpi aprayojakaḥ, yathā- tuṣopavāpaḥ kapālasya svāṅgabhūtasyāpi aprayojakaḥ |
kaścit parāṅgasya svopakāriṇo'pi aprayojakaḥ, yathā- dadhyānaya- nasya vājinayāgaḥ, yathā vā akṣāmyajñanaṃ ekahāyanīnayana- sādhyamapi na tasya prayojakam |
tathā prasaṅgī api paśupuroḍāśayāgādiḥ paśvaṅgasya prayājādeḥ sveopakāriṇo'pi aprayojakaḥ |
prayojakatvaṃ dvedhā bhavati, yadā khaṇḍaśaḥ sampadyate athavā vrīhi ityādi- dhīyate iti |
prayojakatvaṃ yasya siddhayarthaṃ kiñcit kriyate tattvam |
' vā. 3|1|1 pṛ. 651. 'prayojanamuddiśya na mando'pi prava- rtate' iti nyāyaḥ |
jagaccāsṛjatastasya kiṃ nāma na kṛtaṃ bhavet |
( ślokavārtike saṃvandhākṣepaparihāraprakaraṇe 'jagaccāsṛjata- stasya kiṃ nāmeṣṭaṃ na sidhyati |
'prayojanamuddiśya na mando'pi pravartate' iti nyāyena prayojanaṃ vinā pare ( paramātmani jagatsṛṣṭi- sthityādi ) pravṛttirna saṃbhavati ( iti śaṅkā ) |
prayojanaṃ asamaraṇaṃ api bhavati sakṛdvacanena śatasya punarvacane |
prayojanaṃ ( arthaḥ ) krame pramāṇam, vyutkrame tasya anupapadyamānatvāt |
'yamarthamadhikṛtya pravartate tat prayojanam' iti naiyāyikaṃ lakṣaṇam ( nyā. da. 1|1| 24 ) |
'aindrāgnaṃ caruṃ gṛhṇāti' ityetadvākyapravṛtti kāle kiṃ prayojanamityapekṣā bhavati |
vā. 2|2|6|9 pṛ. 519, prayojanena pakṣokenaiva bhavitavyaṃ iti niyamaḥ |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ tatastasya kṛtslena phalena arthinaḥ satre adhikāraḥ, uta parṣadaḥ arthinyā adhikāra iti |
āha, nanu arthino bahusaṃkhyāviśiṣṭā nirdiśyante, katha- meṣāṃ ekaikasyo'dhikāro bhaviṣyatīti |
ucyate 'ṛddhi- kāmāḥ' ityevamādi vidhīyamānaṃ ṛddhikṣipeṣu samasteṣu vyasteṣu ca prāptaṃ na śakyaṃ bahuvacanena viśeṣe avasthā- payitum |
tena taṃtaṃ adhikṛtyā parṣadaṃ veti bhavati saṃdehaḥ |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? ekaiko na samartho bahukartṛkaṃ satraṃ racitum |
tasmāt samastānāṃ phalaṃ ekaikasya phalāvayavaḥ, madhyamaṃ syāt kṛtsnaṃ phalamiti |
saha kriyamāṇe satreḥ ekaikaṃ puruṣārthaṃ sādhayati tantreṇa |
kartṛṇāṃ phale ca bhavati, ekaikaścātra kartā |
āha, nanu etaduktam, ekaiko na śaknoti bahukartṛkaṃ kartumiti |
yadā ekaikaḥ svātantryeṇa pravartate tadā anyān saṃvyānivṛttyarthaṃ sāmādibhiḥ prayodhyate |
sarve cet kartāraḥ, pṛtha- katvena phalena saṃbhatsyante |
dup- nanu itaretarayuktā itarāpi anutiṣṭhanti itarāpi |
prayogatā yā adhikāracintā sā yuktā ( kartṛm ) |
kṛtsnena phalena vyāpyate phalātrayeṇa vā iti kākadantaparīkṣā, prayogā- viśeṣatvāt |
kiṃ kṛtsnaphalārthino yāgopadeśaḥ, uta ( phala- ) avayavārthino'pi ityevamupadeśaḥ adhikāra eva cintyate |
( karmopadeśo yo'yaṃ ṛddhikāmādhikāraḥ sa eva cintyate iti tantratve vyākhyāyate |
adhikāre iti saptamyantaṃ chittvā adhikārādhyāye cintyate iti na adhyāyāsaṃgatiḥ |
viśeṣe (mānasī smṛtiḥ kiṃ kṛtsnaphalaviṣayādhikāriviśe- ṣaṇam, uta tadavayavavidhayā iti yuktā cintā |
) athavā kriyāphalaṃ kartṛgāmi bhavati ekasmin pakṣe itaratra akartṛgāmi |
sa hi pūrvapakṣaṃ manyamānaḥ svapakṣe- svapakṣe kartṛgāmi phalam, siddhāntapakṣe tu pratyekaṃ bhoktṛtvāt teṣāmakartṛtvāt akartṛgāmi phalamiti manyate |
ekamanthe- nāha-) evaṃ cet ( yathā pūrvapakṣai manyate tathā cet ) samudāyasya kartṛtvāt na te ( samudāyinaḥ ) kartāraḥ |
itthaṃyāṃ pratīyate, ( samudāyakartṛtpapratītī, anuṣṭhāne-) asti viśeṣaḥ |
( tathāhi, ) samudāyakartṛttve karmamadhye ekasmin pramṛte nānya ānayet labhyate |
siddhānte tu ekaikasya kartṛtvāt ( ekasmin mṛte sadasada-) saṃkhyā- pūraṇārthamānīyate |
( ucyate, ) dravyamedāt tatra ( pūrvapakṣe ) saṃkhyā, na kartṛbhedāt |

evaṃ cet ' samadhaḥ prājapatyān ' ityatra yathā pūrvapakṣe ekasmin paśau vinaṣṭe ( samudāyā- tmakaṃ sādhanaṃ vinaṣṭam, iti ) kṛtsnaḥ paśugaṇa āvartate, evamihāpi ekasmin vinaṣṭe ( yaḥ saṃkhyāpūraṇārthamānītaḥ, tena saha ) samadaśa bhūtvā punarādau ārabhya yāgamanu- tiṣṭhanti, īdṛśasya ( sadasadaśasya ) sādhanavācyamāt |
( evaṃ saṃdehaṃ prasādhya pūrvapakṣaṃ gṛhṇāti-) kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? ( eka-) phalāvayavatvena ( pratyekaṃ ) saṃbandhaḥ |
kutaḥ ? kṛtsnaṃ phalaṃ prāpnuyāt yadi ekaikaḥ, ( tataḥ ) pṛthak pṛthak prayogaḥ syāt |
tato bahutvaṃ nopapadyate ( tasmāt phalavayavavākyasya satre'dhikāraḥ ) |

api ca yat karma ( jyotiṣṭomādi ) bahuṣu phalameva codyate, tat ( api tāvat ) ekatra prayoge ekameva phalaṃ sādhayati ityuktaṃ ( yogasiddhayadhikaraṇe 4 | 3 | 99 ) kimuta yadekaphalameva coditaṃ ( satrādi |
evaṃ tāvat ākhyātāvagatasahaprayogabalena phale'pi sāhityaṃ ityuktam |
idānīṃ kāmaśabdadāpi bahutvānnāttā aya- martho gamyate ityāha-) kiñca ' ṛddhikāmāḥ ' ityeka- śeṣo'yam |
tatra yadi itarayuktāḥ phalaṃ kāmayante, tataḥ ( itarayogaṃ pratipādayan ) ekaśeṣaḥ upapadyate |
tasāt anena itaretarayogasya pratīteḥ sahajātāmeva phalam |
) nanu udiyamānatvāt ( ṛddhikāmānāmekaśeṣāvagateḥ ) ita- retarayogāvivakṣā ( syāt |

satyam, ( yadyapi ) asmin pade avivakṣitaḥ ( itaretarayogaḥ ), tathāpi ( ākhyātopāttānāṃ ) yādṛśānāṃ sādhanabhāvaḥ ( kartṛbhāvaḥ ) avagataḥ, tādṛśānāmeva phalasaṃbandho yuktaḥ ( kartṛgāmitvāt phalasya ) |

' yasmin prītiḥ puruṣasya ' ( 4 | 1 | 2 | 12 ) ityanena nyāyena ( phalasyāvidheyatvāt ) ekaikasya kṛtsnaṃ phalaṃ prārthyamānasya satramupāyo vidhīyate, na satraṃ prati te vidhīyante ( teṣāṃ tu satraṃ prati uddiśya- mānatvāt avivakṣitaṃ sāhityam |
tatraiva hetvantara- māha-) kartṛprāye kriyāphale ātmanepadaṃ bhavati ( kartṛtvaṃ ca pratyekameva ) yadi ca ekaikaḥ kartā ( syāt ) tato bahutvān kartṛṇāṃ bahutvamanupapadyate |
itarathā ( pratyekaṃ kartṛtvābhāve ) pariṣadaḥ kartṛtvāt tasyāḥ ( ca ) ekatvāt kartṛbhedābhāvaḥ, kartṛbhedābhāvāt ( ca ākhyāto- pāttaṃ kartṛtva-) bahutvaṃ anupapannaṃ ( syāt |
) atha kartṛttve ( kartṛrūpe ) śrutaṃ ( bahutvaṃ ) dravyeṣu kalpyate, tataḥ ayameva doṣaḥ yat anyatra śrutaṃ anyatra kalpyate ( iti ) |
' sāmādibhiḥ prayokte ' ityasya ( bhāṣyasya ayaṃ-) arthaḥ, phalaṃ prārthayataḥ satramupāyo vidhīyate, tacca ( satraṃ ) bahukartṛkaṃ phalasādhane samartham ( ākhyātopāttasya bahutvasya vivakṣitatvāt |

) tatra ( ataḥ svatantraḥ pravartamānaḥ anya- māpi svatantraṃ pravartamānaṃ sahāyāpekṣaṃ evaṃ bravīti-) mayā saha bhavatā yaṣṭavyam, nānyena iti asmin ( sahāya- niyama-) vipaye sāmādayaḥ avataranti ( upāyāḥ ) pathikavat ( yathā durgaṃ panthānamabhipretiṣṭhāmānāḥ sarve svatantrā eva santaḥ mithaḥ sahāyā bhavanti, tadvat ) |
yadi ekasya ( svatantraṃ ) kartṛtvam, itare ( tu ) saṃkhyā-
pūraṇārthāḥ ( ṛtviksyānīyāḥ ) syuḥ, tataḥ ( teṣāṃ svatantra-) kartṛtvābhāvāt bahutvanābhāvaḥ iti sa ( eva pūrvapakṣoktaḥ ) doṣaḥ ( tasmāt yathokta eva bhāṣyārtha iti ) |
yaduktaṃ ( pratyekaṃ kartṛtve ) prayogabhedāt bahutvanābhāva iti, ( tatra ) ucyate |
sa eva ( prayogaḥ ) ekaikasya ( tatra ) tulyaḥ ( na vyastaḥ ), tatra na gamyate viśeṣaḥ, itarasya prayogaḥ netarasyeti |
( kathaṃ na gamyate ? tatrāha-) devatodeśena dravyasya yaḥ saṃkalpaḥ, sa ekaika- syāviśiṣṭaḥ |
evaṃ ca ( sati ekasminneva prayoge sarveṣā- meva kartṛtvopapatteḥ ) prayogabhedo na labhyate ( prasajyate ) |
api cotpattisaṃyogādyathā syāt sattvadarśanaṃ tathā bhāvo'vibhāge syāt |
bhāṣyaṃ- api ca naitādidaṃ ' yadekaṃ karma bahubhiḥ kriyate ' iti |
yadi ucyeta, viruddham, ekena karmaṇi kṛte dvitīyaḥ kiṃ kuryāditi |
tantreṇa tu kriyā bhavati kacit saṃbhavaḥ |
yathā syāt sattvadarśanaṃ tathā bhāvo'vibhāge syāt |
yathā ekaikasya hastino'śvasya vā darśane ekena kṛtsnaṃ abhinirvartyate, evameva satre tantrabhāvo bhavet |
yadi hi utpannaṃ saṃyujyeta, tataḥ ' aneka- saṃbandhārye ' iti vacanaṃ gamyeta |
tasmāt ekaikasya kṛtslena phalena abhisaṃbandha iti |
' nanu ekasmin prayoge na bahūnāṃ kartṛtvaṃ saṃbhavati, ekena kṛte karmaṇi aparasya kartṛyogāt ' iti padāni |
dup- ( utpattisaṃyogāt iti sūtrapadavyākhyānārtha- midaṃ bhāṣyam-) nātrotpattisaṃyogaḥ, ( kintu utpatyaiva tu saṃkhyayā karma saṃyujyate ( iti |
tat vyācaṣṭe-) ' ṛddhikāmāḥ ' ityatra utpattivākye eva ( phalavākye eva )
yadi ( hi ) guṇavākye śrūyeta, na ( tu utpatyamāne ) yāge, tataḥ ekaikasya kriyāphalena saṃyogo na syāt |
tasmin ( utpanna- saṃyoga-) pakṣe na phalena vyāpyamānāḥ syuḥ iti ( eva- marthaṃ bahutvanam ) ucyate, kiṃ tarhi ? yāgo bahutvasaṃkha- viśiṣṭaḥ kāryaḥ ityevamartha ( ucyate |
utpattivākyasya tu bahuvacanasya svatantrakartṛtvābhidhāyinaḥ balavadvirodhā- bhāvāt kartṛgāmeva bahutvān pratyekameva phalam |
śā- ' samudāyasya kartṛtvāt tasya kṛtsnaphalā- nvayaḥ |
' iti prāpte, abhīdhīyate ' samudāyasya kartṛtvaṃ yadyapi syāttathāpi tu |
kartṛgāmi bahutvaṃ hi dravya- gāmyanyathā bhavet |
soma- pūrvasmin pāde svargakāmanipādasyapādi- rādhikāranirūpaṇapakṣakāvadhaidhikāro nirūpitaḥ, iha tu ākhyātenādhikāro nirūpyate |
ākhyātaṃ ca anavagata- saṃkhyāmātrāpratipādakaṃ taddvārā narapratītirlambitā iti pādāntaratvamānantaryaṃ cetyāhuḥ |
sūtrārthastu- tasyatasya pṛthagādhikāraḥ syāt, puruṣārthasya phalasyaikasiddhatvāt pratyekasiddhatvāditi |
vi- ' satre phalādāḥ pratyekaṃ sarve vā, sasyaḥ samū- hake |

bhāṭṭa- ' ṛddhikāmāḥ : satramāsīran ' ityādau anekakartṛka satraprayogāt ekaṃ phalaṃ sarvaiḥ kartṛbhiḥ atra- yaśo bhujyate uta kṛtsnaṃ iti vicāre yadyapi sarveṣāṃ pratyekaṃ kartṛtvaṃ yadi vā dampatyoriva vyāsakam, ubhayatrā'pi ekasatraprayogāt anekaphalanimittaṃ darśādāvapi ekasādeva prayogān yugapat krameṇa vā anantasvargotpatteḥ : eka- prayogān ekaphalaciniyasya avaśyaṃ vāñchatvāt eka- meva phalaṃ sarvaiḥ avayavaśo bhujyate |
iti prāpte, na tāvat ekasya phalavayavino mukhyāvayavāḥ saṃbhavanti sukhādi-

satrajanyatvā''cchedaka- buddhitvādeḥ tāvatpuruṣaniṣṭhabuddhisa vyāptyavṛttitvamātraṃ paraṃ vācyam, na ca tatra pramāṇamasti, śrutakalpanādi- śabdānāṃ phalamātrapratipādanaparatvāt, ṛddhikāmakartṛniṣṭha- phalabhogapratipādake kalpyādhikāratvāpi ṛddhikāmanāyā vyāsajyavṛttistvasya bādhitatvena vyāsajyavṛttikānāla- rūpātiriktamārgīkāre pramāṇābhāvāt pratyekameva ṛddhi- kāmatāvasāyāt pratyekameva phalavatiḥ |
nahi tatra bahu- vacanāntaṛddhikāmapadena bahutvāvacchinnānāṃ ṛddhikāmatvaṃ pratipādyate, yena vyāsajyavṛttitvāpattirbhavet |
api tu ṛddhikāmatvāvacchinnānāṃ bahulatvam, paśūna ityādivat |
na ca kartṛtvasya vyāsaktatvāt phalavattvasya apūrva- vattvasya ca vyāsaktatvam, phaladau kartṛtvasāmānyā- karaṇasya pratyekavṛttitve'pi upapannatvena etādṛśaniyame pramāṇābhāvāt |
ataśca daṃpatyoḥ vyāsajyavṛttitve- 'pi apūrvaṃ phalaṃ ca bhinnameva janyatā''vacchedakadharma- paryāptyadhikaraṇaṃ vācyam |
samavāyasaṃbandhenaiva phalatvāvacchinnaṃ prati phalatvena pratibandha- kalakalpanāt āmāntare bādhakābhāvāt |

na ca eva- mapi pratyekavṛttitvapekṣā phalavattvādervyāsajyavṛttitvakalpane gauravāderabhāvāt niyāmakabhāvaḥ, janyatā''vacchedakadharmā- tvādeḥ vyāsajyavṛttitvakalpane tatparyāptyadhikaraṇatvā''cche- dakasya satre yāvatkartṛniṣṭhajanyaphalakatvādeḥ kalpanīyatvena gauravāpatteḥ |
tadvat satrajanyaphalatvādereva tattvakalpanāyāṃ lāghavāt pratyekameva phalam |
prayojanā— (ekaprayojanā iti su-pāṭhaḥ) bhisaṃbandhāt pṛthak satāt tataḥ syādekaikameya- śabdābhisayogāt |
(1|1|1|1) iti nyāyena darśapūrṇamāsau saṃhatya phalaṃ sādhayataḥ |

darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āgneyādīnāṃ ṣaṇāṃ pṛthak satāṃ svarūpataḥ minnānāṃ satāṃ ekaśabdābhisayogāt ‘darśapūrṇa- māsa’ iti ekena śabdena abhisaṃyogāt kroḍīkārāt prayojanābhisaṃbandhāt ekena svarga rūpeṇa prayojanena phalena abhisaṃbandhāt tataḥ tasmādetasmāt kāraṇāt aikakyaṃ syāt |
karmaśabdena phalamucyate kriyate iti karma- vyutpatyā |
ekaṃ karma phalaṃ yeṣāṃ yāgānāṃ te ekakarmāṇaḥ |
tataśca ṣaṇṇāmapi yāgānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsetyekaśabdāvavyatvaṃ tena ca ekena śabdena ekena phalena saṃbandhaḥ iti jñāyate |
tasmāt tanmeṇa phalam, na medena iti siddhāntaḥ |
yathā ‘gaṇāyā snānam, gaṇāyānu- lepanam’ ityukte snānādiḥ śeṣaḥ na samudāyena saṃvadhyate kintu samudāyāmiḥ |
evaṃ śeṣavat svarga rūpaṃ prayojanamapi ṣaṭsu yāgeṣu pratikarma pratipāgaṃ vibhajyeta vibhāgena anvitaṃ syāt |
naivaṃ syāt samudāyādināṃ pratyekaṃ phalaṃ na syāt |
tathā avidhānāt pratyekaṃ phalasya vidhānā- bhāvāt |
śeṣasya hi parārthatvāt vidhānāt pratipradhāna- bhāvaḥ syāt |
śeṣavat iti pūrvapakṣoktaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ vaipamyena pariharati |
śeṣasya snānānulepanādeḥ parārthatvāt vidhānāt parārthena puruṣasaṃskārakatvena vidhānāt pratipradhānabhāvaḥ syāt |
dārśapaurṇa- māsikaṣaḍyāgeṣu tu naitādṛśaṃ kiṃciditi samudāyasyaiva phalam |
prayojanalakṣaṇaṃ akṣapādoktaṃ ‘yadadhikṛtya kṛtiḥ pravartate tat prayojanam’ (1|1|24) iti |
ye yatra kriyamāṇāḥ prayojanavantaḥ te tatra kartavyāḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|2 varṇakaṃ 3, prayojyaṃ dadhyānayanaṃ āmi- kṣāyāḥ cāturmāsyeṣu vaiśvadevaparvaṇi |
4|1|122-24. prayojyaṃ dravyārjanaṃ puruṣārthasya na tu kratoḥ |
bhā. 4|1| 2|2 varṇakaṃ 3. prayojyaṃ na ekahāyanīnayanaṃ akṣāmya- janasya padagaṃsatā padahomasya vā jyotiṣṭome somakraye |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|10. prayojyaṃ na dadhyānayanaṃ vājinasya cāturmāsyeṣu vaiśvadevaparvaṇi |
4|1|121-26. prayojyaṃ na lohitaṃ nirasanasya śakya saṃbhavenasya paśoḥ |
4|1|13-6. prayojyaṃ vedavatsajānutvam, vederanati- hasyastaramaṃ, vedeḥ āhāryapurīṣatvaṃ ca puruṣārthasya |
bhā. 4|1|2|2 varṇakaṃ 2. yaddeśaprapavṛttakṛtivyāpyatvaṃ yasya tat tatprayojyaṃ yathā dadhyānayanaṃ āmikṣā- prayojyam, prayājādi vā darśapūrṇamāsaprayojyam |
prayojyaḥ na paśvālambhaḥ lohitanirasanasya śakya- staṃbhavenasya vā |

sudhā— prayojyakartṛkāṇāṃ bhavanādīnāṃ vyāpārāṇāṃ pratipādakāḥ ye mūvādayo dhātavaḥ teṣāṃ prayo- jyānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ ye prayojakāḥ kulālādayaḥ; teṣāṃ vyāpāreṣu pyantā eva prayujyante (bhāvayati, vikledayati iti) |
anyotādānukūlatvā- bhāve'pi aniśraṇarūpatvāt ekāntena vyāpāratā astī- tyāśayaḥ |
kṛti- vyāpyatvaṃ ca anuṣṭhāpyatvarūpaṃ kālādivāvṛttaṃ vājapeyādi- karaṇe kaustubhe evopapāditam |
tena yaddeśaprapavṛttakṛtivyāpyatvaṃ yasya, tat tatprayojyaṃ yathā dadhyānayanaprayājādi āmikṣā- darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ |

pravartanā- rūpo hi vidhiḥ iṣṭasādhanatvamiba kṛtivyāpyatvaparyantaṃ prayojyatvamapi viṣayasya ākṣipatti, iti bhavati prayojakaḥ; tathāpi sa yaduddeśena prayojayati tasyāpi prayojakatvavyavahāraḥ śāstre |
āpaśrī. 8|5. (idaṃ ca vākyaṃ aitareyake kaupītake ca nāsti tena bahucabrāhmaṇāntarāṇi santīti jñāyate) |
prarocanā (arthavādāt) anyena kṛtā na karmā- ṅgam |
vā. 1|2|17 pṛ. 195. yadā na stutipadāni vidhiśabdenaiva tadā prarocanā, yadā stutivacanaṃ tadā stvanena |
bhā. 1|2|17, prarocanā tu pravartate, dveṣā- nnivartate |
1|2|1|10. (idaṃ savistaraṃ arthavādādhikaraṇe bhāṣye vārtike ca draṣṭavyam) |
svārthe tu tathā stutiḥ ākā- ṅkṣyate, viṣayavataśreyaḥsādhanatvādeva tu pravṛttivicchi- jananena tadvirodhasyādinākaraṇasiddheḥ anarthikā stutiḥ |
prarocanāśabdena icchāvirodhivideśanādyavācinā taddevabhūtaguṇātiśayavattvalakṣaṇaṃ prāśastyaṃ lakṣyatayā vā uktam |

iti prāpte, mānuṣeṇa hotrā devahotāraṃ prati 'āha' iti praiṣamātre kṛte'pi tadātve eva devastenā- hūtāḥ ityatra mānābhāvena adhikṛtadevatāvāhanānusthāpanā- 'pyasiddhatvābhiprāya mantraliṅgopapatteḥ mantrapāṭhātanusāreṇa hotṛpravara eva pūrvaḥ |
pralapitamantra: 'akṣī te indra piṅgale huleriva' iti |
manuvatpakṣe tu yasyāpyeko yasyāpi pañca tasyāpi sakṛdevoccāraṇaṃ manu- vaditi |
caturāṣeyena pañcārṣeyeṇāpi ca karmaṇi traya eva pravarā uccāryāḥ |
na ca pralayaḥ (ucchedaḥ bhūtānāṃ) na saṃbhāvyate |
'na caivaṃ sati yat kiñcit pramāṇaṃ āptasyate, śiṣṭairvairṇiākaṭhadassaraṇīyānyanupapatti- lambatvāt śrutyanumānasya |
tatra pravaraṃ evaṃ paṭhanti 'āṅgirasa bārhaspatya bhāradvāja' iti |
nāmadheyaṃ ca 'asau devadattaḥ amuṣya putraḥ amuṣya pautraḥ amuṣya naptā, amuṣyāḥ punaḥ amuṣyāḥ pautraḥ amuṣyā naptā' iti |
nanu pralaye kiṃ mānamiti cet, na |

kālakapālānyutpattiḥ prāgabhāvaḥ kāryadravyānādhāra- kāryādhikaraṇapravṛttiḥ, abhāvatvāt, ātmamṛtyavyonyā- bhāvavat ityanumānena, ghaṭaḥ kāryadravyānādhikaraṇakāryādhi- karaṇapravṛttidhvaṃsapratiyogī, bhāvakāryatvāt, śabdavat ityanu- mānena ca khaṇḍapralayasya siddhiḥ |
paṭaḥ ahasramāna- kālīnadhvaṃsapratiyogī, bhāvakāryatvāt, mukhyatvavyahita- prākālīnaśānavat |
buddhiḥ prāgabhāvāsamānakālīnadhvaṃsa- pratiyogī, bhāvakāryatvāt, mukhyatvavyahitaprākālīnā- dṛṣṭavat |
ekākīnāḥ sarve paramāṇavaḥ samagropādeya- prabandhavattvāḥ, ārambhakatvāt, naṣṭapavanārambhakaparamāṇuvat |
duḥkhasaṃtatiḥ atyantamucchidyate, saṃtatitvāt, pradīpaṃpatati- yat ityācāryopadarśitānumānena ca mahāpralayasya ca siddheḥ |
evaṃ ca 'nandantaṃ kṣatriyakulaṃ' ityādipurāṇa- vyavahāropapattiḥ ityāhuḥ |
pravarapravaraṇe pañcapravarā api śrīneva pravarān- cārayeyuḥ, na nyūnaṃ nāpyadhikam |
uktānumānena 'dhātā yathāpūrva- makalpayat' ityādimantraliṅgena avāntarapralayasiddhāvapi mahāpralaye nāsti pramāṇam, uktānumānānāṃ upādhigrasta- tvāt |
uktaḥ pakṣaḥ kāryadravyādhārādhāraḥ mūrtamātratvabhāvatvāt, tantuniṣṭhapaṭaprāgabhāvavat iti sadyatipakṣaśca |
mahāpralayānanumāne uktāḥ pramāṇavaḥ samagropādeyaprabandha- vantaḥ; prāgabhāvavattvāt, kapālavat iti sattatipakṣaḥ |
pravaravaraṇe dvigotrāṇām 'ekato dvau anyata ekaḥ' iti trayaḥ |
ācāryanumānaṃ tu 'dhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat' iti śrutivirodhāt, 'acandrārkagrahā bhūmiḥ kadā cittu bhaviṣyati |
apauravā tu pṛthivī kadāpi na bhavi- ṣyati |
' iti harivaṃśarūpanyāsasmṛtiviruddhatvāt 'yāva- tailaṃ tāvad vyākhyānam' iti dṛṣṭāntaprasiddhatailāmāvādi- rūpopādhivismaraṇānca anācāryānumānameva |
anyathā naraśiraḥkapālaṃ śruti, prāṇavyaṅkalāt śaṅkhavat ityanumāna- syāpi prāmāṇyāpatteḥ |
agniṣṭomasya prayame prayoge niṣiddhaḥ, na tu jyotiṣṭomasya prayogamātre |
pravarge: atirātre prathamāhre nityameva na kartavyaḥ |
su. pṛ. 1321, pravarge: prathamaprayoge'gādutkṛṣṭaḥ sarvatrānyatra bhavati |
pravarge: yasmin karmaṇi pravargyaṃ vartate saḥ |
pralāpa: arthavādaḥ 'na caitad vipro brāhmaṇāḥ smo vayamabrāhmaṇā vā' iti |
pravarge prakṛtya 'na prathamayajñe pravajñyāt' iti niṣedhaḥ |
agniṣṭoma- prathamaprayoge anucānasya pravartyasya nityaṃ prayogaḥ; anyeṣāṃ nityaprayogaḥ |
tatrāpi 'kāmaṃ yo'nucānaḥ śrotriyaḥ syāt tasya pravṛjyāt' iti vacanaṃ tadā pratiprasava- vacanasya vikalpakāriṇaḥ kartṛviśeṣagāmitvāt tadviṣaya eva vikalpaḥ |
vā. 31|12|33, pravargesya atirātraprathamahāre nityaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, agni- ṣṭome tu vihitapratiṣiddhatvāt vikalpa iti kecit |
pravargesyāpi upasat pūrvāhṇāparāhvena kartavyasyāpi 'purastādupasadāṃ pravargyaṃ caranti' iti ekaprayogatvāvagatiḥ |
pravargesya kauṣītakibrāhmaṇe jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇa eva 12132, pravargesya pratiṣedhaḥ atirātrasaṃsthasya jyotiṣṭomasya prathamāhre, agniṣṭome tu vidhiḥ ityapare |
so'yaṃ sāmānyena ubhayoḥ saṃśayayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, agniṣṭome tu viśeṣavidhiḥ sa balīyān iti |
pravargesya sāṅkhyasya uccaistvam, 'uccaiḥ pravargyaṃ' iti karaṇavibhaktinirdeśāt |
pravarge 'na prathamayajñe pravajñyāt' iti prathamayajñagrahaṇe jyotiṣṭomya prathamaprayogamātraṃ gṛhyate, na sarvasaṃsthaḥḥ sarvaprayogavattvaśca gṛhyate |
pravarge rohiṇi nāma puroḍāśaṃ yavamayī tūṣṇīṃ kāryāṃ, puroḍāśaśabdasya jātivācakatvāt |
mṛtasākṣikavyavahāravat pralīnaśākhāmūlakalpanāyāṃ yasmai yadarocate sa tat pramāṇīkuryāt |
vā. 131|12 pṛ. 161, yadi tu pralīnaśākhāmūlatā kalpyeta (smṛtīnāṃ) tataḥ sarvāsāṃ buddhiādasmṛtīnāṃ api tadaddhāraṃ prāmāṇyaṃ prasajyeta |
yasyaiva ca yadabhipretaṃ sa eva tat pralīnaśākhāmataṃ nikṣipya pramāṇīkuryāt |
pravarjyamahāravibhedena 'taṃ bhinnamamimuśe- yate cidabhibhravaḥ' iti sāmavedavihitasya uccaistvaṃ jyotiṣṭome |
pravacanaṃ brāhmaṇasya 'pravayād brāhmaṇa- stepāṃ netarāditi niścayaḥ' iti smṛteḥ |
yathā 'prācīnapravaṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta' iti deśaḥ karmāṅgam, tathā āhīnaikādīnāṃ aṅgaṃ deśaḥ |
hotṛpravaradhvaryupravarayoḥ krameṇa mantrapāṭhaḥ brāhmaṇapāṭhastu śākhābhedena kaścidviparīta'pi dṛśyate |
tathāpi adhvaryu- pravara eva pūrvaḥ syāt, mantraliṅgopadeśitabrāhmaṇapāṭhasya mantrapāṭhāt balavattvāt |
pravaryādhikaraṇe (3|1|12|13-33) vārtikakṛtā miśraiśca siddhānta uktaḥ 'na prathamayajñe pravrajyāt' iti prathamaprayogāṅgabhūta-'yaṃ niṣedhaḥ |
taccaitanna dvitīyādiprayogaviṣayam, tatra 'yat pravargyaṃ pravrajanti' iti pravargyotpattividhineva anuṣṭhāna-siddheḥ |
ataḥ prathamaprayoge niṣiddhasya pratiprasavamidam, atastatra vihitapratiṣiddhatvāt vikalpaḥ |
atirātraprathamā-hāre tu nityakaraṇameva vaikalpikatvātirātraprathamāhāravidhāne tatra niṣedhātideśāt agniṣṭomasaṃsthatvābhāvena ca prati-prasavānatideśāditi |

daśame 'pratiṣedhaḥ pradeśo'nyasyavidhāne ca prāpta-pratiṣiddhatvāt vikalpaḥ' syāt' (10|1|14) ityanena 'durbalo'pi vidhiḥ tadadhīnāmlāmena pratiṣedhena tulyabalo bhavati' iti nyāyena 'na prathamayajñe pravrajyāt' ityasya pratiṣedhatve 'yat pravargyaṃ pravrajanti' ityasya pratiṣedhatve tu atidiṣṭatvādaiva agniṣṭoma-prathamaprayoge iva atirātraprathamāhāre'pi vikalpa evāpadyeta, na nityakaraṇaṃ sidhyet iti dvitīyo doṣaḥ |
svayaṃ tu (sudhākṛtā) samāhitam, 'na prathamayajñe' iti na pratiṣedhaḥ; kintu paryudāsaḥ 'yat pravargyaṃ pravrajanti' iti pravargyotpattivākyaśeṣaḥ, paryudāsapratiprasavaśca agniṣṭoma-vākyam |

nanu akartavyena uktasya kartavyatvenoktaiḥ pratiprasavatvāt paryudāsasya ca akartavyatvoktyarhatvābhāvāsya 'vidhinā-mekadeśaḥ syāt' iti sūtreṇa (10|8|1|4 sarvaikadeśaḥ) avikalpāya daśame siddhāntayiṣyamāṇatvāt paryudāsaprati-prasaṃvo na yuktaḥ |
ata eva agniṣṭomaprathamaprayoge vikalpo-'pi ayuktaḥ, kartavyatvākartavyatvayorāsīnatvena paryudāsena sāmānyavidheḥ dvitīyādiprayogamātraviṣayatvenopasaṃhārāt |
prathamaprayoge tu vidhyābhāvena anuṣṭhāne prāpte agniṣṭoma-vihitaḥ tatrāpyanuṣṭhānamātraṃ sidhyet |
iti cet, satyam, anyatra paryudāso naiva akartavyatvoktyarthaḥ, tathāpi iha avaśyaṃ tadarthatā''śrupeyā |
ato'tra paryudāsya akartavyatvoktyarthatvāt punaḥ-vidhinā vikalpyaḥ, tasya ca pratiprasavatvaṃ yuktamiti |
yā'pi niṣedhatve atirātre vikalpyāpattiḥ, sā'pi na, prakṛtau sāmānyavākyaśeṣabhūtasya paryudāsasya atirātre atideśātā prāpteḥ nityakaraṇatvāt vikalpārthasyaiva pratiprasavasya ana-tideśāditi |
yattāvadiha paryudāso'pi akartavyatvoktyartha iti kvāpi anyatra adṛṣṭamaśrutaṃ ca kalpitam, tatra, evaṃ hi tatrāpi atirātraprathamāhāre'pi vikalpaḥ aparihāryaḥ |
yattu atroktaṃ vikalpārthasya pratiprasavasya anatideśāt nityākaraṇamiti, tadapi na |

nahi vikalpaḥ pratiprasavasya vākyārtha eva, kintu paryudāsasya akartavyatvatātparyanirṇaya-dvārā prayojanam, tataśca tātparyagrāhyakatva anatideśe'pi tenākartavyatve gṛhītatātparyakatā nirṇītārthasyaiva paryu-dāsasya atideśāt, ekasya ca tasya prakṛtau akarta-vyatve tātparyam, vikṛtau tu na iti parasparaviruddhatvenārthenā-yathāyogyāt, vikṛtāvāpi akartavyatvoktyarhatvāt ati-rātre'pi vikalpaprasaṅgaḥ |
nirṇītaṃ 'prakṛtau anyārthatvena nirṇītasya śāstrasya vikṛtau ati-deśe anyārthaparatā na nyāyyā' iti (śā. ārthika'ḍa-nuvādaḥ) |

tena paryudāsasya akartavyatvoktyarthatve ati-rātraprathamāhāre'pi vikalpyāpattiparihārāya, itaraparyudāsasya akartavyatvoktyarthatvābhāve tu agniṣṭomaprathamaprayoge nityā-nuṣṭhānāpatteḥ vikalpasiddhiḥ, iti ubhayataḥpāśā rajjuḥ, agniṣṭomavākyasyānarthakyāpattiḥ syāditi |
nanu evaṃ bhaṭṭasomeśvaradūṣaṇe'pi vārtikakṛnmate taduktaṃ dūṣaṇadvayaṃ kathamaduṣṭatamaṃ iti cet |
'na prathamayajñe' iti pratiṣedha eva, tasya ca vaidhakriyāviṣaya-tvāt vikalpaḥ siddha eva, na tvasau agniṣṭomavākyalabhyaḥ |

evamapi tu agniṣṭomavākyānarthakyam, tādṛśaśca vikalpaḥ atirātre prasajyeta iti bhaṭṭasomeśvarayoktaṃ dūṣaṇadvayaṃ evaṃ parihartavyam, agniṣṭomavākyārtha (vākyaṃ) parisaṃkhyā-rtham, agniṣṭomātirātraprathamāhārayoḥ prasakto vikalpaḥ-agniṣṭome eva, na atirātraprathamāhāre iti |
pratiprasavo-'pi ca tadā agniṣṭomavākyaṃ bhavatyeva, akartavyatvena buddhasya kartavyatvabodhāt |
na ca pratiprasavatvaṃ pari-saṃkhyātvaṃ ca viruddham |
yadvā parisaṃkhyātvena pratiprasavaśabdena pūrvoktasādṛśyāt gauṇyā ucyate |
nanu vikalpaparisaṃkhyā atirātre anuṣṭhānamātreṇāpi nirvahati anuṣṭhānamātreṇāpi hi, iti anuṣṭhānameva na sidhyet iti cet, maivam |
nahi atra vikalpaparisaṃkhyā śābdī, kintu 'agniṣṭome eva pravrajyāt, nātirātre' iti pravaryānuṣṭhānaparisaṃkhyādvārā arthī, iti atirātre nityānuṣṭhānasiddhiḥ |
kāpi adṛṣṭā iti yadi brūyāt, pratinayādena (someśvaraṃ) akartavyatvoktyarthaparyudāsarītirvā kva dṛṣṭā iti |
atha asau atraiva kalpyate, tataḥ pūrvo'pi atraiva kalpyate, iti tulyau paryudāsānuyogaparihārau |

nanu agniṣṭome eva pravrajyāt nānyatra iti pari-saṃkhyāyāṃ atirātrādīyādiprayogeṣu vikṛtyantare ca sarvatraiva pravargyo na syāt, tatra vaikalpikapravagyamātrapari-saṃkhyāyāṃ satyāṃ atirātraprathamāhārasyaiva pravargyasya pākṣika-tvāt parisaṃkhyā syāt, na tu vaikalpikapravagyamātrapari-saṃkhyāyāmeva pramāṇamasti iti cet |

agniṣṭome eva pravrajyāt nānyatra -iti hi parisaṃkhyā yā anyatra pravargyanivṛttirvā'nyāmānā yatra atirātraprathamāhāre vikṛtāvādideśāt pakṣe pravargyani-vṛttiḥ prasaktā tatraiva pakṣāntare'pi sā cet śrūyate lāghavaṃ bhavati |
yatra tu atirātre dvitīyādiprayoge vikṛtyantare ca pravargyanivṛttiḥ pakṣe'pi na prasaktā, tatra cet pari-saṃkhyā sā bodhyate, tatra atyantaṃ gauravaṃ syāt |
yathā niyamavidhiḥ avaghātādeḥ aprāptapakṣameva pūrayati, prāpti-pakṣe tu udāste, evamapi parisaṃkhyā yatra pravargya-nivṛtteḥ aprāptapakṣaḥ tameva pūrayati, tatrāpipakṣe tu

yathā ca vrīhimimam yatra āmeyādau vrīhayaḥ ṣaṣṭhe'prāptāḥ tatraiva tadaprāptipakṣaṃ pūrayan pravartate, nopāṃśu-yājādau, tatrānupattiviśiṣṭasya sāmānyavihitasyāpi vrīhasya prāpteḥ pakṣe'pi vrīhīṇāmaprāpteḥ |
