lāghavāccā-viśeṣapravṛttasyāpi vākyasya viśeṣaparatā daśame (10|1|12|13-17) uktā, yathā- vāyavye paśau 'hiraṇya-garbhaḥ samavartatāgre ityādyāramādhārayati' iti śrutaṃ uttare jauhavādhāre eva, tatraiva 'indra ūrdhvo'dhvaraḥ' iti prākṛtamantrajanyāniyamahakkṛpterlāghavāt |
nanu evamapi eṣā prāptaparisaṃkhyā, sā ca vaidoṣya-parihārāsaṃbhavāt na kvacidapi aṅgīkṛtā, iti cet |

yathā hi 'imāmagṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtasya' ityādiharaṇe yadi iyaṃ na syāt, tato liṅgāt viniyojakavākyakalpanāyā gardabha-raśanā'''dāne'pi mantraḥ prāpnuyāt, asyāṃ tu satyāṃ liṅgakalpyavākyalainaiva pratiṣidhyate, evamapi yadi 'agniṣṭome pravrajyāt' iti parisaṃkhyā na syāt, tataḥ-atirātraprathamāhāre 'yat pravargyaṃ pravrajanti, na prathamayajñe pravrajyāt' ityanayoḥ atideśakalpanāt vikalpaḥ prāpnuyāt, asyāṃ tu satyāṃ atideśapratibandhāt nāti-rātraprathamāhāre vikalpo bhavati |
'parīpākācchāstre yadupaditamaho vārtikakṛtā, tadakṣātvā someśvara iha bahu sānthyayati |
taduhyāhaṃ svāṃ prakṛti-manayaṃ vārtikamataṃ, tadajñātvā duṣṭaṃ na, vibudhadhanendraiḥ viduḥlaiḥ !!' iti pravaryādhikaraṇadūṣaṇoddhāraḥ |
jyotiṣṭome prathame prayoge pravargyasya niṣedhaḥ, dvitīyādiprayoge tu na niṣedhaḥ iti bhāṣyasiddhāntaḥ |
anuṣṭhānaśrautasya agniṣṭomaprayogāye pravargyasya vikalpaḥ, itarayajamānasya agniṣṭomaprathamaprayoge nitya-mevāmāvaḥ |
vikṛtyantareṣu tu prathamaprayoga eva nāsti iti teṣu na niṣedhaḥ |
'na prathamayajñe' iti ca na paryudāsaḥ : kintu pratiṣedha eva |
prathamaprayoge anucānasya nityaṃ prayogaḥ, anyeṣāṃ niyama- prayogaḥ |
atirātrapratyāhāre tu sarveṣāmeva aprayogaḥ iti śāstradīpikākṛtsiddhāntaḥ |
agniṣṭomasaṃsthāka-(prathama-) prayoge anucānasya nityaṃ karaṇaṃ tathā śrotriyasyāpi |
yattu vārtike anucānādevikalpaḥ anyeṣāṃ tu nityamakaraṇaṃ ityuktam, tat prauḍhivādamātram |
yadi tu tadeva samartha- nīyaṃ ityāgrahastadā vikalpyāmibhānāt agni- ṣṭomavākyasya ca tenopasaṃhārāt anucānādevikalpaḥ ityevaṃ samarthanīyam |
jyoti- ṣṭome śrutasya pravardhyasya anucānavyatiriktakartṛke agni- ṣṭomaprathamaprayoge eva niṣedhaḥ ||
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome pravardhyaṃ prakṛtya samāmnāyate ‘na prathamayajñe prayuñjyāt’ dvitīya tṛtīye vā prayuñjyāt iti |
tatra sandehaḥ kiṃ jyotiṣṭome sarveṣveva prayogeṣu na pravarjitavyam, uta prathame prayoge pratiṣedhaḥ iti |
tasya hi prathamasaṃyogaḥ evaṃ samāmnāyate ‘eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānāṃ yajjyotiṣṭomo, ya etenāniṣṭvā'thānmena yajeta’ iti |
) atirātravākye'pi yadi tadīya- kṛtyabhāvapūraṇavelāyāṃ etadupyante, tataḥ śeṣo bhavet|
na tu tathoktam, saṃsthānāṃ asamānavidhānatvāt, avāntara- prakaraṇe ca pratiṣedhāśravaṇāt|
na hi anekavyatiṣṭhi- mikavākyāntaravyavahitātirātraprakṛtitvacchabdasya eṣa śeṣaḥ avaklapate|
tassāt 'na tau paśau' itivat pratiṣedhaḥ evāyaṃ vijñāyate|
na tu pratiṣedho'pi san prakṛtiviṣaya eva prāpnoti|
sa tu (pratiṣedhaḥ) prāptimātrāpekṣatvāt upadeśamatideśaṃ vā anādṛtya ubhayatrāpi pravartate|
(prakṛtimātraviṣayatva- manujānāti-) śakyaṃ tu iha (api) vaktuṃ 'prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt' iti|
asti ceha arthabhedaḥ, prakṛtau vaikalpiktvāt atirātre ca codakaprāptasya nityapratiṣedhāt|
vakṣyati hi etat 'prati- ṣedhaḥ pradeśe, anārabhyavidhāne ca prāptapratiṣiddhatvāt vikalpaḥ syāt' (10|8|111) iti|
(sūryārthamupa- pādayati-) yasya śākhāhāte prāptiḥ nāsti, tasya prāptiṃ anamyanujñāya pratiṣedhāsaṃbhavāt avaśyaṃ pratiṣedhenaiva tadiṣyo'pi vidhiḥ aṅgīkartavyaḥ|
tasmāt dviruktatvāt upadeśātideśayośca prāptikālevaiṣamyāt prakṛtyarthataiva varaṃ iti|
nanu evaṃ sati 'agniṣṭome pra- ṇakti' ityanenaiva prakṛtitveḥ siddhatvāt anārabhyavādaḥ anarthakaḥ prāpnoti|
tena utpattiḥ, anena viniyogaḥ: ityevaṃ vyāpārabhedāt|
tannāma viśeṣavacanena upasaṃhriyate, yatra kṛtyupayoga asamarthaṃ kathañcit parokṣavṛttyā saṃyujyate, yathā sāsadasyam|
ataśca vikṛtyo bhaviṣyati tathā sati ca 'na prathamayajñe' ityanārabhyavādataḥ upapadyate iti atirātraprayamāhāre
niyamaprayogaḥ: agniṣṭome ca kevalavidhisaṃsparśāt nityaṃ prayogaḥ|
(ekadeśīya anārabhyavādasya vikṛtyarthatvaṃ nirasyati-) etāvatu iha avadhārayituṃ śakyam, nāyamanābhyavādaḥ prakṛtyanvaya gacchati|
yadi gacchet, tataḥ iṣṭipaśu- bandhānapi gacchet|
na ca gantumarhati, 'purastādupa- sadām' iti sthānaniyamasya tatrānupapatteḥ|
tataśca prāptikālavaiṣamyāt prakṛtau tāvat tāḥ (upasadaḥ) santi, iti antareṇāpi vacanaṃ gacchet, kimuta yadā vispaṣṭameva vacanam|
sphuṭasāmānyasaṃbandhasyāpi ca evamādeḥ upasaṃhāraḥ iti vyākhyātaṃ caturthādhikaraṇe (3|1|16 iti tu ṭippaṇyā- muktam) tasmāt utsyativiniyogābhyāmeva apunarukta- tvam|
evaṃ sati yeṣāṃ prakaraṇe eva pravartyapāṭhaḥ, taiḥ saha saṃgatārthatā bhaviṣyati|

(ekadeśyukaṃ dūṣayati-) yadi tarhi dvayorapi ekavākyatvena 'agniṣṭome pravaṇakti' ityayamartho niṣpannaḥ, tataḥ 'na prathamayajñe' ityetasya aprathamayajñe agniṣṭome ityevaṃ pravartamānasya na kaścit virodhaḥ iti pūrvadāsāt nityameva akaraṇeva bhavitavyam|
anārabhyavādasya prakṛtyarthatayā siddhayāṃ 'agniṣṭome pravaṇakti' ityetasya anyaprayojanatvāt pratiṣiddhapratiprasavārthatā gamyate|
na hi anena saha paryudāsaḥ: avaklapate iti darśi- tam|
na ca anārabhyavādaḥ anagniṣṭomārthaḥ, yataḥ : tadvi- ṣayaḥ paryudāsaḥ avaklapate|
ataśca yadyapi ayaṃ paryudāsaḥ, tathāpi ubhayoḥ sāmarthyāt vikalpenaiva bhavitavyam|
kutaḥ? 'nityaṃ hi kriyamāṇe'smin paryudāso vṛthā bhavet|
' tataśca yasmādiktvāt cimyaddhiḥ paryudāsa āśrīyete, sa tasmin satyapi āgataḥ, iti varaṃ śabdasvaralasyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ eva āśritaḥ|
cit idaṃśaṃ vacanaṃ 'kāmaṃ tu yo'nūcānaḥ śrotriyaḥ syāt, tasya pravṛhyāt' iti, tadā pratiprasavavacanasya vikalpa- kāriṇaḥ kartṛviśeṣagāmitvāt tadviṣayaḥ eva vikalpaḥ, anyeṣāṃ nityamevābhāvaḥ|
kathaṃ punaḥ aśrotriyasya karmaṇi pravṛttiḥ, yena tat viśeṣaṇatvena śrūyate? satyaṃ prāptasya punarvacanaṃ tāvanmātraphalaṃ anarthakaṃ iti sāmarthyāt prakarṣagatirvijñāyate|
yathā 'abhi rūpāya kanyā deyā' ityatra abhi rūpatarāya iti gamyate|
anucānagrahaṇaṃ tu brāhmaṇasya anuvacanasaṃbandhāt kṣatriyavaiśyanivṛtyartha bhaviṣyati|
tatra 'na prathamayajñe' iti pratiṣedhāt agniṣṭomatvena ca prati- prasavābhāvāt nityameva na kartavyaḥ|
nanu tatrāpi 'na prathamayajñe' itideśāt agniṣṭomasvarūpasya ca prati- prasavanimittasya abhāvāt prathamaprayoge abhāva eva prāpnoti|
prathamaśabdasya aśeṣitasya sarvatra pravartamānasya anyatra apravṛtteḥ|
tassāt kevala- jyotiṣṭomaprayogaviṣaya eva caiṣa pratiṣedha iti siddham|
' agniṣṭomaprayoge anūcānasya nityaṃ prayogaḥ, anyeṣāṃ nityaṃ aprayogaḥ|
soma- bhavat pūrvatra prakaraṇavākyayorvisaṃvādāt vākyena prakaraṇabādhaḥ|
iha tu visaṃvādābhāvāt na prakaraṇaṃ bādhyaṃ iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ|
sūtrārthastu- saṃkhyāyuktaṃ lakṣaṇyā prāthamyaṃkte na prathamayajñe ityetat niṣedhanaṃ prakaraṇataḥ kratoḥ syāt iti|
pratiṣedhaḥ, kratau yukta uktā hyasyathā, pravṛṇa- ktyupasadyaḥ prāpti vākyāt kratau vidheḥ|
bhāṭṭa- anārabhyādhītaḥ pravargyaḥ: 'yavapravargyaṃ pravṛṇakti' iti śrutaḥ|
tasya ca 'purastādupasadāṃ pravargyaṃ pravṛṇakti' iti jyotiṣṭomāṅgatvena viniyogaḥ:|
na ca upasada- jñatvameva kiṃ na syāditi vācyam|
upasadasya purastā- tkālapratiyogitvena svāthopasthāpakasya uddeśyasamarpakatvā- bhāvāt|
upasthitatvāt tadvācakapadāntarakalpanāyā uddeśya- tvāṅgīkāre tu upasadāṃ phalavattvajñānārthe jyotiṣṭomopasthite- rāvaśyakatvāt lāghavena tadarthatvopapatteḥ|
tatra ca 'na prathamayajñe pravañjyāt' iti śrutam|

prathama- yajñapadena sarvasaṃsthasya: sarvāvaśyaka jyotiṣṭomaḥ abhidhīyate, uta tadīyaprathamaprayogamātramiti cintāyām, prathamayajña- śabdo jyotiṣṭomanāmaiva 'eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānāṃ yajñotiṣṭomaḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyāt, tasya prathamaṃ prayujyamānatvena pravṛttimittatvāt|

yadyapi ca anya- saṃsthānāṃ anyapadenābhidhānāt tāsu jyotiṣṭomatvakāla- tvavidhānāt sarvasaṃsthājyotiṣṭomasya prathamaṃ prayujyamāna- tvam, tathāpi jyotiṣṭomatvasāmānādhikaraṇyena tāvat tadastīti pravṛttinimittatvāt|
tato vākyāt prakara- ṇācca jyotiṣṭomatvāvacchedena ayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ paryudāso vā yajñe 'agniṣṭome pravaṇakti' iti vacanaṃ tat paryudāsa- pratiprasavārtham|
tadapi ca 'kāmaṃ tu yo'nūcānaḥ śrotriyaḥ syāt tasya pravañjyāt' ityanena upasaṃhriyate|
tena anūcānasya śrotriyasya agniṣṭomasaṃsthākajyotiṣṭome nityaṃ karaṇam, anyajyotiṣṭome nityamakaraṇam, vikṛtiṣu ca nityaṃ karaṇam|
iti prāpte, pratyakṣākasyaiva arthabodhopapattau atiriktakalpanāyā pramāṇābhāvāt, prathamaśabdasya ca apravṛttapravartanaviṣayatvāt āyaprayogaparatvāvagateḥ|
yajñaśabdasya ca lakṣaṇayā prayogaparatvam, prakaraṇāt jyoti- ṣṭomaprayajñaparatvameva vā aṅgīkṛtya prathamayajñapadena jyoti- ṣṭomasya, pāñcamikanyāyāt|
'prathamaṃ yajamāno'ti- rātreṇa yajeta' iti vacanādatirātrasaṃsthākasya ca|
ubhayatrāpi anena vacanena pravargyasya pratiṣedhaḥ paryudāso vā |
na tu vikalyantare, tatra upadeśātideśābhyāṃ tatprāpteḥ |
na ca jyotiṣṭome dvitīyaprādayopekṣāyā prāthamyasya vivakṣitatvāt vikṛtāvāpi tadvitīyaprādayopekṣāyā prayogavṛttiprāthamyasya sattvāt kathaṃ na tatprāptiriti vācyam |
'eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānām' iti vacanena jyotiṣṭomavikṛtimātrasyaiva tadavadhāraṇāt |
ata eva prathamaprayogaviṣayo'pi jyotiṣṭoma eva bodhyaḥ |
tathā ca prathamayaśaśabdo vākyaśeṣāt vaidikaprayogāntra nirūḍhalakṣaṇayā somāntaranirūpitaprāthamyavat prayogaviṣaya- jyotiṣṭomamevāmidhatte |
anyathā svasvadvitīyaprayoga- nirūpitaprāthamyavatprayogasyaśamātrābhidhāne 'āhitā- maya idhmamayaśa gṛhṇatisaptadaśaḥ satramāsīran' ityādau satre yadhamātrottarakālapateḥ |
ata eva ukta- dvividhajyotiṣṭomaprathamaprayoge eva pravargya
maṇi. pṛ. 117, itsādhanatvameva pravartanā iti maṇḍana: |
vede ca tadabhāvāt icchābhinnasya kasya cit pravartanātvaṃ bodhyam |
artha- bhāvanābhidhānāntukūlāyā: liṅādiniṣṭhasyaiva abhidhā- khyāyā: pravartanātvena rūpeṇa liṅavācyatvaṃ parikalpya tajjñānasya pravṛtti prati kāraṇatvamātraṃ kalpyate iti pārthasārathi: |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|1. 'pravarta'ḍe samiti jñānaṃ yena śabdena janyate |
maṇi. pṛ. 12. pravāsagatasya yajamānasya agnihotre'pyanyupa- sthānārthaṃ āśīrmantra: 'ihaiva san tatra sant tyāge' iti |
su. pṛ. 1201. pravāhasamudranyāyena sarvāṇi vedāntavākyāni ṛjukuṭilamārgeṇa paramaśivaprapādakānyeva |
(gaṅgādi- pravāhā: sarve antata: samudrameva prāpnuvanti tadvat, iti nyāyākṣarārtha: |
bahuṣu vīṇāvādya guṇeṣu satsu nipuṇe evaṃ pravīṇaśabdo vartamāne rūḍha ityucyate |
śrutadravyāpacāre pratinidhi upātte, pravṛtte'pi karmaṇi kṛteṣu keṣu cit saṃskāreṣu yadi tadeva mukhyaṃ upalabhyeta mukhyameva grāhyam |
atra ṭupaṭīkā-- 'keṣu cit saṃskāreṣu kṛteṣu anabhinivṛtte (mukhye) prayojane śrutameva upādātavyam |
tasmāt ye abhinivṛttā: saṃskārā: teṣāṃ (mukhye) āvṛtti: syāt |
athavā pravṛtte'pīti cet kṛte (mukhye) prayojane śruta- māgamayitavyamiti (pūrva: pakṣa:) ' iti |
tathā sati khadire ādita ārabhya sarve saṃskārā: puna: kartavyā: |
paśurniyojanaṃ ca khadire kṛtvā śiṣṭa: prayoga: samāpanīya iti siddhānta: |
atra 'pravṛtte'pīti cet' iti pravṛttacchanda: paśurniyojanātiriktasaṃskāra- grāhaka: |
athavāpya tu pravṛttacchanda: paśurniyojanāntān sarvaneva saṃskārān gṛhṇāti |
tadāpi sarva: prayoga: khadireṇa puna: kartavya: iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
tatra prathamapade sūtrārthastu 'iti cet' iti pūrvasiddhāntaparāmarśa: |
mukhyādhigame mukhyaṃ iti cenyāya: tata: pravṛtte'pi pratinidhī mukhya- meṣopādeya iti |
mukhyasya dravyasya khadirasya alābhe kadere pratinidhī paśurniyojanaṃ kṛtam, atha khadiro labdha:, paraṃtu pravṛtte jāte niyojane sati khadire mukhyo'pi na grāhya: |

ke. 'pravṛttatvādiṣṭhe: some pravṛtti: syāt' ityedhamādhikaraṇe (8|1|31) pūrvapakṣadvayamāgasya klṛptopakārakatvāt darśapaurṇamāsānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ grahaṇasya kṛtsnavidhānāt tātparyatvamiti siddhānte nirākariṣyamāṇa- tvena abhāvāt |
dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ prāyaṇīyāyāṃ ātithyāyāṃ pacau udayanīyāyāṃ ca darśapaurṇa- māsiko vidhyantaḥ pravṛtta: |
tanmadhyavartini some'pi sa eva vidhyantaḥ syāt |
some dāśapaurṇamāsiko vidhyantaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe liṅga- māha |
'tasyaikaśataṃ prajāyānuyājā:' iti aiṣṭikā: prayājādayo dharmā: some dṛśyante |
some aiṣṭiko vidhyantaḥ iti pūrvapakṣa sūtrābhyāṃ prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
some kartavyānāṃ sarveṣāmeva dharmāṇāṃ somaprakaraṇe vidhānaṃ bhavati |
some aiṣṭiko vidhyanto nāsti, svatantratvāt tasya iti siddhāntinā ukte iyaṃ śaṅkā-- nanu 'ghṛtaṃ vai devā vajraṃ kṛtvā somamaghnan, sucau bāhū |
tasmāt niṣedhāt liṅgāt aiṣṭikasya some prāptiriti |
suc ca abhidhāraṇaṃ ca tayo: abhāvasya nityānuvāda: syāt |
nityasiddhasyaiva abhāvasyāmanu- vāda:, na tu prāptasya niṣedha: |
suci somagrahaṇasya, ājyābhidhāra- ṇasya ca yo'yaṃ niṣedha: sa na siddhānuvāda: kintu vidhiraiva niṣedharūpa: |
some yo'yaṃ suci somāsādanasya ājyābhidhāraṇasya ca niṣedha: sa na vidhi: kintu nitya- siddhānuvāda eva |
yadasya sucau bāhū kurvanti, yaccājyamantikamakārṣu:, adyaṃśurhaste deva somāpyāyatāmiti |
yadevājyamannaṃ taṃ dhuramakurvan tadā- pyāyayanti' ityatra yo'yaṃ 'aṃśurhaste' iti vidhi:; tasya vākyaśeṣo'yaṃ 'ghṛtaṃ vai devā vajraṃ kṛtvā somamaghnan sucau bāhū |
tasmāt suci somahavirnāśādyate, na soma- mājyenābhidhārayati' iti |
asya vidhervākyaśeṣatvāt nāyaṃ niṣedharūpo vidhi: saṃbhavati |
soma: apūrva eva na tatra aiṣṭiko vidhyantaḥ iti siddhānte helantaramāha |
yadi some aiṣṭiko vidhyantaḥ syāt upoṣaṇāt prāptatvāt anupoṣaṇācca na syāt |
anupoṣaṇāt ca śaṅkate 'yadatupauṣya prayāyāt śrīvabrahmanena abhyulliṅge nenī- yeran' (taisaṃ. 3|1|8|1) iti |
some aiṣṭiko vidhyantaḥ ityatra 'tasyaikaśataṃ prajāyānu- yājā:' iti liṅgayuktaṃ 'liṅgadarśanācca' (8|1|3|4) iti sūtre tatroktaṃ siddhāntī |
uktaṃ darśanaṃ liṅgadarśanaṃ somagatānāṃ aiṣṭikānāṃ syāt |
some yā dīkṣaṇīyādaya iṣṭaya:, tāsu sarvāsu militvā ye prayājāyājā: teṣāṃ sā saṃkhyā |
aṅgāṅgamapi ca 'tasya' iti śakyate vaktuṃ yathā 'vājapeyasya yūpa:' iti |
tathā ca na talliṅgaṃ some aiṣṭikasya vidhyantasya sādhakam |
ke. atha samastānāmāgreyādīnāṃ kāryaṃ cit rūḍhe: 'pravṛttatvādiṣṭhe: some pravṛtti: syāt' itivat
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ hoturvarṇaṃ 'agnidevo daivyo hotā devān yakṣat' ityāmmātam |
tat somāṅgabhūteṣu aiṣṭi- keṣu karmasu prāpyate |
saumikaṃ hotṛvarṇaṃ 'abhihotā sa me hotā hotastvaṃ me hotā'si iti hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' ityāmmātam |
tatra saumikena varaṇena ānto hotā iti dārśikaṃ varaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ iti prāpte siddhāntāt |
prati- tantraṃ pratīṣṭi karmaṃ hotuḥ varaṇaṃ kriyeta |
kutaḥ ? pravṛtta- varaṇāt varaṇāt pravṛtte karmaṇi dārśikaṃ varaṇaṃ kriyate, ata tanna ānatyartham |
tasmāt pratikarmaṃ hotṛvarṇaṃ medena kartavyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
na ca evaṃ caitro rajatajñānavān, kārya- tājñānavattvāt iti jñānāt maitrasya pravṛttyāpatyā bhrānta- bhrāntisaṃkarāpattiḥ |
parakīyarājatatvaparakārakajñānajñāna- vataḥ kṣaṇavilambena rajatatvaprakārakajñānādeva pravṛttyaṅgī- kārāt, jñānāviṣayakajñānatvena pravṛttyaṅgīkārādā |
yadvā rajataviṣayakapravṛttvāvacchinnaṃ prati rajatatvaprakāratāni- rūpitarajataniṣṭhamukhyaviśeṣyatāśālijñānatvena hetutvāt na kā'pyanupapattiḥ |
pravṛttyā hi prājāpatyeṣu paśuṣu upakaraṇādīnāṃ prakṛtau anirūpita eva kramo nirūpyate
711112. prasaṅgo na jyotiṣṭome dīkṣākālīnena jāgaraṇena dārśikajāgaraṇasya |
12|1|8|17. prasaṅgo na jyotiṣṭome savanīyapuroḍāśa- diśu saumikapātrairmahaccamasaiḥ dārśikapātrāṇāṃ juhvā- dīnām ||
bhāṣyam-- some eva yāni darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtīni grahacamase prayukte vartante, yathā sāvanaḥ paśuḥ, sāvanāḥ puroḍāśāḥ, saumyaścarati |
teṣu vicāryate kiṃ teṣāṃ grahacamasairvā homaḥ kartavyaḥ, athavā dārśikaiḥ suvādibhiḥ pātrairiti |
atha yadgṛhītvā ājyānsādayanti, na yajamānamahanti iti prathamaṃ tāvat teṣāṃ prayogaḥ |
yanmadhyapātino'ṅgaṃ na prayuktam, tatkāryaṃ tannimittaṃ'ṅgaṃ prasajyate |
asaṃnihite hi svasmin yāne devadatto yaścadattyānamārohati |
tatra hi tasya yādṛśaṃ svātantryeṇa gamanasukham, na tādṛśaṃ parayāne |
puroḍāśānāmapi dārśikaiḥ pātraiḥ yādṛśaṃ sādguṇyaṃ tādṛśaṃ grahacamasairna |
na tatra prākṛtyo vṛkṣajātayaḥ prokṣaṇādyaśca saṃskārā labhyante |
yadi punardārśikānyaprayuktāni bhaveyuḥ, kiṃ grahacamasaṃ prasa- jyeta ? neti brūmaḥ |
yatra tantri- go'ṅgaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ itarasyāpi kṛtaṃ bhavati, tatra prasaṅgaḥ,
iha tu grahacamase prayukte, netārāṇi prayuktāni bhavanti |
na hi some hūyamāne puroḍāśā hutāḥ |
yadi prayoga eṣāṃ nopapadyeta, pratiṣidhyeta vā, tataḥ prasaṅgaḥ syādityarthaḥ |
api ca nyāyyāni dārśapūrṇamāsikāni, na mahaccamasam |
darśayati caitāni pātrāṇi, 'yunajmi te pṛthivīṃ jyotiṣā samidhaṃ dhuvāmabhimṛśati, yunajmi vāyumantarikṣeṇa te sahatyupabhṛtam, yunajmi vācaṃ divā sayeṇeti juhūm' iti |
śā-- somāgneṣu aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu kiṃ somānyaiva pātrāṇi prasajyeran, uta juhvavādīni pātrāṇi pṛthak prayoktavyāni iti saṃdehe saumikaireva homārthaiḥ |
juhvādi kāryāṇi homādīni anyaiḥ kriyamāṇāni viguṇībhaveyuḥ |
na cātra anyaireva homādayaḥ kṛtāḥ, yena pṛṣadājyānyājavat na punaḥ kriyeran |
tena kartavyāḥ santo homādayaḥ sādguṇya- saṃbhave kimiti viguṇāḥ kriyante |
soma-- yadi pracārādyarthatā'pi vedyā prākṛtahavi- rāsādanasiddhiḥ, tadā kimu vaktavyaṃ homārthatayā samā- nārthaiḥ pātraiḥ prakṛtahomasiddhiḥ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- saumikānāṃ grahacamasādipātrāṇāṃ kharāsāda- nottaraṃ yānyaiṣṭikavikārāṇi savanīyapaśvādiṣu, teṣu tairupapāttaiḥ kāryasiddheḥ na prākṛtajuhvādipātrākṣepatvam |
iti prāpte, na tāvat teḥ somakṣepeṇa havistaraprakṣepa- siddhiḥ, tasya pṛthagjuhvādāvaśyakatvāt |
havistaraprakṣepādī ca na grahādīnāṃ kāraṇā prakṛte prāmāṇikī, upadeśāti- deśayorabhāvāt prayājādyaṣṭānāṃ hi puroḍāśopakārakatve

atideśena siddhe yuktaṃ yat siddhānāmeva teṣāmupajīvanam, prakṛte tu bhaumikānāmetastathācepāttve pramāṇābhāvāt mahā- vedivacca grahacamaseṣu ākāraviśeṣaviśiṣṭahavistvalādi- rūpajuhlādi rūpatve pramāṇābhāvāt, atidiśikapātrāṇāṃ cādhānavelāyemegopāttatvena lāghavanyāyasyāpyabhāvāt nātra prasaṅgasiddhiḥ |
ata eva 'yunajmi te pṛthivīṃ jyotiṣā saheti sucamamiśrati' ityādinā aiṣṭika- pātrāṇāmabhimarśanaṃ vihitam |

ata eva 'grahajuhoti' ityādinā aṅgamānasādhāraṇaprakṣepānuvādenaiva 'hiraṇmayaḥ suco bhavanti' itivat grahādividhānādupadeśenaiva havi- rantaraprakṣepe grahādipauraiṣṭikapātrādhaḥ ityapi apāstam, tathātve dhruvādidarśanavaiyarthyāt, grahādīnāṃ somamātrārthatve gamakāntarāṇāmapi sattvāt |
bhāṣyam-- atha śeṣabhakṣā api tathā nivarteran, yathā anvāhāryaḥ, iti cet |
śā-- pūrvaṃ yajamānabhakṣasya vṛttyarthatvāt vratena nivṛttirāśaṅkitā |
saṃprati ṛtvigabhakṣāṇāṃ parikriyārtha- tayā pradhānadakṣiṇayā nivṛttirāśaṅkyate |
nirākaraṇaṃ ca tadeva śeṣapratipatyarthaṃ bhakṣāḥ nānvarthā iti |
daśame eva ca (śeṣabhakṣāśca tadvat 10|2|130 ) ānatya- rthatvaṃ bhakṣāṇāṃ nirākṛtam |
soma-- yadi pradhānadakṣiṇayā ānatiḥ kṛtā itya- nvāhāryanivṛttiḥ, tadā bhakṣaṇānāmapi nivṛttiḥ syāt ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- 'ṛtvigbhakṣā, nivarteran yadyanvāhāryava, bra tat !, yājamānavadeteṣāṃ kāryatvāt pratipadyave ||

' bhāṭṭa-- ṛtvikkartṛkāṇāṃ śeṣabhakṣāṇāṃ dvitīyā śeṣa- pratipatyarthatve'pi prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇanyāyenānyatvasyāpi kariṣyamāṇakarmaṇi balādhānārthatvat saṃbhavat, tatthaiva cānumānikatayā prayojakatvāvagateḥ yukta eva dvādaśaśata- dakṣiṇayā prasaṅgaḥ |
iti prāpte, anvāhāryadakṣiṇāniyama- vidhivalena śeṣabhakṣasyāntyatvakalpanāt kevalaṃ dvitīyā śeṣapratipatyarthatvam |
prasaṅgo niśicaye amāvāsyātvasya, paraṃtu iyā- vaihiḥ pṛthak kāryaṃ agnyādhānaṃ ca yadi devatārtham |
viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ ca samadhā- phala- kāmanātaḥ nimittataḥ rūpataḥ saṃkhyātaḥ kālataḥ mantrataḥ kartṛśveti |
prasaṅgaḥ savanīya- puroḍāśeṣu pāśukatantrasyaiva, na vikalpaḥ |
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ vidyamāne svake vidhau iti |
yadyapyasya anyo vidhividhatte, paravidhinā tu kṛtārthatvānna kriyate |
yathā prayājāḥ paśorapi codakena prāptāḥ paśupuroḍāśāpi |
bhā. 12|1|11, na ca tulyakālatve prasaṅgo bhavati |
yathā vaikṛtyaḥ iṣṭyaḥ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ tulyakālā api na dārśapaurṇamāsikaṃ tantraṃ upajīvanti |
anyasya tantre yatadanyat tulyadharma- kamāpatati karma, tasya pūrvakarmaṇe yatikartavyatā, sā prasajyate |
sa copamitalakṣita- prāpaṇena agnīṣomīyasya yo yāgagato vyāpāraḥ |
sa iha pāśukrena prayogavacanena kuta- tvāt na bhūyaḥ pauroḍāśikaḥ samīpe karoti |
prasaṅgallakṣaṇaḥ prāsavācaḥ sasacivaḥ - pradhāna- prasaṅgaḥ ekaḥ; aṅgaprasaṅgaḥ ṣoḍhā |
prasaṅgallakṣaṇe (dvādaśādhyāye) anyārtheva aṅgaiḥ upakramamāṇāḥ paśupuroḍāśayaḥ na svāṅgyanupasaṅgahanti |
yatprasaktyā yo vicāraḥ, tatsamāptau sa eva buddhito bhavati |
prasaṅgasiddhaṃ jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu dārśikaṃ ārabhyabhojanaṃ codakaprāptaṃ saumikena payovratādinā |
prasaṅga- siddhaṃ na hotṛvarṇaṃ jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu |

bhā. 12|1|18-49, prasaṅgasiddhaṃ prātaḥsavanayānāṃ puroḍāśānāṃ tantraṃ pāśukrena tantreṇa, mādhyandinasavanīya-tṛtīyasavanīya-puroḍāśatantraṃ tu pāśukrena vā prātaḥsavanīyapuroḍāśatantreṇa vā prasaṅgasiddham |
12|1|130-32, prasaṅgasiddhaṃ brahmavaraṃ jyoti- ṣṭome aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu dārśikaṃ codakaprāptaṃ saumikena |
prasaṅgasiddhaḥ na dārśikaḥ aidādiḥ śeṣabhakṣaḥ jyoti- ṣṭome aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu codakaprāptaḥ; saṃskārārhatvāt |
prasaṅgasiddhaḥ parikrayaḥ anyā- hāryaḥ dārśikaḥ jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu codakaprāptaḥ saumikena parikrayeṇa |
prasaṅgasiddhā haviṣkṛt savanīya- paśvarthā, tṛtīyasavanasya savanīyapuroḍāśasya, saumye caro āśvine dvikapāle ca, medena nāhātayā |
prasaṅgasiddhiḥ agnīṣomīyapaśupuroḍāśatantraṃ deva- suvāṃ haviṣāṃ tantrasya |
prasaṅga- siddhiḥ anubandhyā tantreṇa anunirvāpyāṇāṃ devikāhaviṣāṃ tantrasya |
prasaṅgasiddhināsti jyotiṣṭome dīkṣākālīnajāgaraṇena prāpaṇīyādiṣu dārśika- jāgaraṇasya |
prasaṅgasiddhināsti darśa- pūrṇamāsānvārambhaṇīyā vikṛtiṣu anvārambhaṇī- yāyāḥ |
prasaṅgasiddhināsti dārśikahotṛvaraṇasya saumikeṣṭipaśvādiṣu saumikena hotṛ- varaṇena |
prasaṅgasiddhinaṃ ipsya barhiṣaḥ anyanvādhānasya ca niśiṣyate amāvāsyāttragatasya |
bhāṣyam- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śeṣabhakṣa aidādiḥ, some caiṣṭikeṣu karmasu codakaprāptaḥ |
saṃskārārthasau, upayuktaśeṣatvāt bhakṣā- ṇām, dvitīyānirdeśācca ‘yajamānapañcamā iḍāṃ bhakṣayanti’ iti |
tasya tu idaṃ prayojanakathanaṃ prasaṅgātmakatvāt ihoktam (iti saṃgatiḥ) |
vi-- ‘yajamānagatā bhakṣā, na santyāraṇyavad yadi’, na vṛttaryā ime kintu kartavyāḥ pratipattaye |

’ bhāṭṭa-- evaṃ tarhi yajamānakartṛkāṇāṃ śeṣabhakṣā- mapi prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇanyāyena kartṛsaṃskāratvasyāpi sattvāt prāṇaghāraṇārthatvopapatteḥ; satyapi dvitīyā śeṣa- pratipatyarthatve asyaddhaprayājaśeṣābhighāraṇasya ānu- mānikasyaiva prāṇaghāraṇasya prayojakatvātgeteḥ tasya ca payovratena prasaṅgasiddhayupapattiḥ |

iti prāpte, ākhyāśana- niyamavidhānāt tenaiva prāṇadhāraṇakartavyatvapratīteḥ yajamāna- bhakṣasya kevalaśeṣapratipatyarthatvāt tasya ca prasaṅga- siddhayabhāvena bhakṣayitavya eva yajamānena prāṇaṇīyādi- pyapi śeṣaḥ |
prasaṅgasiddhiḥ niśiṣyate vedyuddhananasya vratasya ca amāvāsyāttragatasya |
bhāṣyam- patnyāḥ saṃnahanaṃ ca darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ samānāntaṃ ‘yoktreṇa patnīṃ saṃnahati’ iti |
tat somāṅga- bhūtaivaiṣṭikeṣu karmasu codakena prāptamapi na kartavyam |
dīkṣākāle somārthaṃ patnyāḥ saṃnahanaṃ vṛttam, ‘yoktreṇa patnīṃ saṃnahati, melalayā dīkṣitām, mithunatvāya’ iti yadāmnātam |
sūtrārthastu saṃnahanaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ some tasya pravṛttatvāt iti |
vi-- ‘patnīsaṃnahanaṃ, kāryaṃ codakāditi ce, na tat |
’ bhāṭṭa-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ‘yoktreṇa patnīṃ saṃnahati’ iti vihitaṃ saṃnahanaṃ prāpaṇīyādiṣu dīkṣākālakṛtena yoktra-
karakapatnīsaṃhananena prasaṅgasiddhena kāryam, dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ tu kartavyameva |
nahi tadadṛṣṭārtham, yena jāgaraṇanyāyena punaḥ kriyate, vāsodhāraṇārthatvarūpaprayojanasaṃbhave aṣṭakalpanānyāyatvāt |
sakṛdanuṣṭhasyāpi punaḥśrutībhāvasaṃbhave savanīya yūpa- dāḍharyātideśārthaṃ paripyāṇāntarvat punaḥ saṃhananopapatti- riti vācyam |
upadiṣṭapariṣyāṇasya vikṛtau prayojanā- ntarakalpanāyāpi prākṛtasya saṃhananasyāsaṃndanasaṃhananārtha- tvena klṛptaprayojanasya vikṛtau kāryantarakalpanānupapatteḥ |

yadi tu saṃhananaṃ prakṛtāveva na vāsodhāraṇārtham, api tu kariṣyamāṇakarmaṇi balādhānārthamityucyeta, tathāpi somāthasaṃhananaiva balādhānasiddheḥ, śrutībhāve ca tatsyaiva prakṛtitvat karṣaṇopapatteḥ prasaṅgasiddhivirodhaḥ |
agnimāstādūdhve anuyājeṣu utkṛṣyamāṇepu utkṛṣṭhaṃ tṛtīya- savane |
ataḥ prātaḥ- savane eva prahartavyā vinā'pi prastareṇa |
saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharati ' ityatra śākhā na prastarā'rha iti siddhānte sānoyapakṣe vidyamānāyāḥ śākhāyāḥ pratipattiḥ |
vastutastu ' upa- veṣaṇa kapālānyupadadhāti ' iti ' upaveṣaṇa astriāccha dohakumbhīmadhiśrayati ' iti ca śravaṇāt upaveṣaḥ sānā- yyārthaḥ kapālopadhānārthaśca |
tatra pūrṇamāse dohābhāve- 'pi kapālopadhānaṃ ātmanirhaṇyartha upaveṣaṃ prayojayet |
prastarādityuttharyo yajamānaśabdaḥ ' yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ ' ' yajamāna ekakapālaḥ ' iti |
prastarapraharaṇaṃ ' idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ' ityādinā sūktavākamantreṇa prastarasya agnī prakṣepaḥ |
prastaradravyasa haviṣpakṣe'kīrtanādanyā- dīnāṃ ca devatātvāt yāgo'yaṃ vijñāyamānaḥ prakṣepāyika- tvāt homa ityavadhāryate |
sā saṃ saṃyata eva, na tu asaṃyatataḥ |
mṛtādhikārapakṣe sūktavākamantragataḥ yajamānā''śāsanaparo bhāgaḥ ' āśāste'yaṃ yajamāno''ste' ' ityādirlupte |
prastarapraharaṇe sūktavākaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ mantraḥ, na tu kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
6|4|14| 43-47. mīko. pṛ. 2024 ' darśaṃ śākhāpraharaṇaṃ ' iti cindau draṣṭavyam |
ke. prastāvaḥ ' aṣṭākṣareṇa prathamāyā ṛcaḥ prastauti, dvyakṣareṇottarayoḥ ' iti |
ayaṃ ardhī dakṣiṇādharmāk paṭ gā labhate |
prastotrādya eva upagāḥ nāma, nānye ke cit |
evaṃ sūktavākena prastaraḥ prahartuṃ śakyate yadi praharatiryajatiḥ |
bhā. 3|2|5|13, praharaṇaṃ śākhāyā na prayojakam, na
bhā. 6|4|14|44, praharaṇaṃ somānte svaroḥ agnīṣomīye upāttasya tantratayā pravṛttasya, nānubandhakālasya |
praharaṇe prastarasya ca pratipattiḥ śākhāyā api |
tatra aniyatakāle praharaṇe prāpte saha praharati iti vidhīyate ' saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharati ' iti |

' darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate ' malavadvāsasā na saṃvadeta, nāsyā annamadyāt ' iti malavadvāsasā saha saṃvādasya pratiṣedho'yaṃ kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsādyasya uta puruṣasya sarvatra pratiṣedha iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
prāk sāgnyaprayogānmāt prāgeva tasyāḥ aparodhāta aparodhasya uktvāt ' yasya vratayeḍahan patnī analambhukā bhavati tāmaparcha yajeta ' iti |

malavadvāsasaḥ nāma rajasvalāyāḥ striyāḥ ' nāsyā annamadyāt, abhyañjanaṃ vai striyā annam ' iti śrutyā annasya abhyañjanaparaṃparayā lāṭadevatāprasiddhasya mithunabhavanasya pratiṣedhācca saṃvādādiniṣedhasya puruṣadharmatvasiddhiḥ |
tasmāt ayaṃ niṣedhaḥ na kṛtvadharmaḥ kintu puruṣārthaḥ prakaraṇādutkṛṣṭaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
madhyamāyāmapi lokaṃpa- ṇayāḥ nāma iṣṭakāyāḥ prāgeva upadheyāḥ na parastāt |
tasmāt sā ante eva upanidhīyate ekā anekā vā |
tata uttaraṃ na kā'pi upadhātuṃ śakyate |
tasmāt citriṇyādayaḥ madhyamāyāṃ citau lokaṃpaṇāyāḥ prāk upadhātavyāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. prākaraṇikena anāramyādhīta bādhyate yathā sāsaṃ- dasyaṃ pājñadadyena |
prākaraṇikānāṃ kṛtsnānāṃmapi hastāvaneṃjanaṃ vāgyamaḥ muṣṭikaraṇaṃ ityādi |
bhāṣyam-- anāramyābhimucyate ' citriṇyādupadadhāti; vajriṇīrupadadhāti, bhṛteṣṭakā upadadhāti ' iti |
santi tu prakaraṇe iṣṭakādharmāḥ ' āvaṇḍāmakṛṣṇalāmiṣṭakāṃ kuryāt ' iti, tathā ' bhasmaneṣṭakāḥ saṃyujyāt ' iti |
soma- sūtrāṃstvastu apakaraṇe yadyanyad citriṇyā- dikaṃ tadapi aśvedāgyagrahavaddharmayuk syāt iti |
santi vā, vākyamapyatrānāryoktaṃ tato na te |
' bhāṭṭa- ihakādharmāṇāṃ kṛṣṇādīnāṃ nāmanāryyādhīta- citriṇyādīkadhāviniyogasyāpyanyādhītatvāt prākaraṇi- kephākāmādharmmatvam |
iti prāpte, pūrvvavadanuṣṭhānasādeśyāt ihakāprayojyaccayanyāpūrvvasaṃbandhitvasya tatprayojyakalpapūrvva- saṃbandhitvasya vā lakṣaṇīyatvānāryyādhītatvātpyaviśeṣa- cātrāpyabhayadharmmatvam |
satyaṃ prāpnoti baddhī, na tu tadabhāve saṃbandho nāstyadhvaryuṇā |
caturthīśrutira yā, sā vākyamapabādhi- pyate iti |
kathaṃ tarhya- vidhitsite saṃpradāne śrūyate iti |
uktaṃ vā sarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ dānaṃ vidhīyate iti |
ḍupū— na kṛtsnasya dākṣiṇyasya nivartakā prākāśyau |

kutaḥ ? yadi dakṣiṇāmanūya ( prākāśyau prathamāntau ) vidhīyetām, tataḥ kṛtsnayā dakṣiṇayā nivartako syātāṃ ' prākāśyau dakṣiṇā ( iti ), to cādhvarye ' ( iti, paścāt vākyāntareṇa puruṣāpanayaḥ syāt ) yathā ' audumbaraḥ somacamaso dakṣiṇā, sa brahmaṇa deyaḥ ' iti ( na tu evamasti |
katham ?) ekaṃ cedaṃ vākyaṃ prākāśau ( apyadhvarye dadāti ) iti ( caśabdo hetau |
prākāśyau iti— ) na ceyaṃ prathamā, yathā somacamasaḥ |
sā ( ca ) adhvaryudadātinā saṃbadhyate ( na dadātimātreṇa ), ekavākyatvāt ( adhvaryupadaika- vākyatvādityarthaḥ |
tatra ca— ) adhvaryuprākāśyordadātinā ( dadātipareṇa vidhinā ) saṃbandho vidhīyate |
prākāśyaprātipadikaṃ ca dvitīyāntamanadhvaryuṃ prati guṇabhāvena, tayoḥ prātipadikayoḥ saṃbandhāt caturthī labhyate iti |
nanu dadātimanudya prākāśyau vidhīyete ityu- ktam |

adhvaryupadasaṃbandhāttadvadantaryeṇa yo'rthaḥ sa grahītavyaḥ, na prākāśadadātyoḥ saṃbandho grahītavyaḥ ' iti ānandaśamīpustakake adhikam, asmadīyalikhitapustake tannaratne ca ayaṃ grantho na upalabhyate ) tatra caturthyantā- dhvaryusaṃbandho grahītavyaḥ ( iyaṃ paṅktiḥ ānandaśamīye nāsti ) ( nādhvaryuḥ svarūpeṇa ) |
nanu śrutaiva kriyā kārakāṇi saṃbadhyante ( tena ) dadātiprākāśyayoḥ saṃbandho bhaviṣyati ( na tu adhvaryuprākāśayoḥ ) |
avidhīyamānatvāt dadāteḥ vākyasaṃbandha eva bala- vān bhavati |
( etadeva vivṛṇoti— ) vidhīyamānāyāṃ tu kriyāyāṃ kārakāṇi udbhūtaśaktau bhavanti |
avidhīyamānāyāṃ tu ( kriyāyāṃ kārakāṇi udbhūtaśaktīni ) na bhavanti |
tatra ( avidhisthe śrūyate sati ) ānantaryeṇa yaḥ saṃbandho vākyalakṣaṇaḥ ( pratīyate ) sa eva grahītavyaḥ, na vyavahitena dadātinā, adhvaryudena vyavadhānāt prākāśyayoḥ |
' nāśya vākyanapekṣaṇī śrutiḥ ' ityādi ( bhāṣya— ) granthaḥ anenaiva ( śrutyasya avidhisita- tatva— ) nyāyena neyaḥ |

( ' yogyatvaṃ darśanena bādhyate ' iti bhāṣyārthaṃ arthata upāyadāya vyācaṣṭe— ) prasiddheḥ ( kārakavibhaktirākhyātāsaṃbandhini iti, ) darśanena bādhyate ' ityayamapi ( granthaḥ ) avidhīyamānatvādeva neyaḥ |
) ( ullikhitaṃ ' ekā pañceti ' ityadhikaraṇaṃ vyācaṣṭe— ) ' ekā gāṃ ' ityekaśabdasya gośabdena saṃbandhaḥ, na dadātinā, anudyamānatvādeva kriyāyāḥ, ityayameva nyāyaḥ |
( upari- tanmadhikaraṇatrayamaiva sthitvā saṃkṣipya darśayati— ) dvitīya- madhikaraṇaṃ ( prākāśyādhikaraṇamapekṣya dvitīyam ) kṛtsnasya ( dākṣiṇyasya nivartakaḥ saḥ iti ) |
tṛtīyamapi ( ' tathā ca somacamasaḥ ' iti ) kṛtsnasyaiva |
tatra viśeṣaśaṅkāmāha— ) liṅgā- kṣānnivṛttyarthaṃ tu ārabhyate |
( yajyurdhakādhikaraṃ tu— ) na kṛtsnavikāraḥ, nedantāvikāraḥ ( na bhāgavikāraḥ ), adhvaryubhāgānimārthaṃ tu anyam |
śā — aśvamedhe ( vastutastu rājasūye śrūyate ' prākāśyā- vadhvarye dadāti ' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ prākāśyau kṛtsnasya krudākṣiṇyasya nivartakau, uta adhvaryubhāgasya nivartakāviti |
yadi ' prākāśyau dadāti ' iti saṃbandhaḥ, tataḥ kṛtsnasya |
tasmāt ' adhvarye yuṅkte ' ityevamadhvaryuśabdaṃ kathañcit kṛtsvimātre nyāyyāya ( anuvādātvāt kathañcit vyākhyānaṃ na doṣaḥ ) |
( ' ucyate, 'dhvaryusaṃbandha eva prākāśyayorvicīyate— 'thavā pūrvaṃ dānaṃ dvābhyāṃ viśeṣitam ' ) adhvaryu- śabdasyānarthakyabhayāt na dānamātre vidhānam |
ataḥ kriyānvayanimitto yaḥ paścāttataḥ saṃpradānasyādhvaryoḥ saṃpradeyabhūtasya prākāśyayormīyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, sa eva vidhīyate |
( caturthītvāt adhvaryuviśiṣṭaṃ saṃpradānakāraka- muddiśya dvitīyānlāt prākāśyāviśiṣṭaṃ karmakārakaṃ vidhīyate |
kārakasya sāpekṣatvāt uddeśyasya adhvaryuṇā viśeṣaṇe'pi na vākyabhedaḥ |
pradeyasaṃpradānasaṃbandhaśca dānakriyā'dhīna iti dadātyanvitayoḥ pāṭhiko yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tatra vidhiparyavasānāt, tadabhayasaṃbandhacchadatvena apekṣitadānakriyāpekṣatvāt dadāternātyantārthakyam |
sa ca prākāśyayoḥ adhvarye dānāt bhavati, ityadhvaryusaṃpradānatvasya prākāśakarmatvasya dānatvasya ca prāpteḥ dvitīyācaturthībhyāṃ saha dadātinuvādaḥ |
tatra kriyādāsādhāraṇyasya svasvāmibhāvasaṃbandhasya niyamena dānākṣepaphalatvāt tadapi vidheyaṃ syāt ityaparituṣṭā granthakāraḥ kārakasaṃbandha evopapāditaḥ |
athavā adhvaryuśabdasya ānarthakyaparijihīrṣayaiva dānāntaramevāpūrva adhvaryuprākāśyaviśiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate |
tena ca dṛṣṭārthatvāt adhvaryānitisiddheḥ tadabhāgaḥ prākṛto nivartate iti na kṛtsnanivṛttiḥ ( athavetipakṣaḥ : prauḍhavādaḥ, viśiṣṭavidheḥ kevalavidhyasaṃbhavandhanatvāt ) |
soma— ekāgnistasya dadātyanvābhāvāt kṛtsna- dākṣiṇyanivṛttāvapi iha tadanvayasaṃbhavāt kṛtsnanivṛttiḥ ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
prākāśyau iti, prākāśa-te rūpayantra ityadhikaraṇe ghañ |
' upasargasya ghañyamanuṣye bahulam ' ( pā0 6|3|122 ) iti upasargasya dīrghaḥ, chāndaso vā |
sūtre venuvat sarvinavartakau iti tathā- śabdārthaḥ |
vi— ' kiṃ prākāśyau bādhakau svataḥ kṛtsnādhva- ryavasya vā |
bhāṭṭa— aśvamedhe ' hiraṇmayau prākāśyāvadhvarye dadāti ' iti śrutam |
na ca hiraṇmayatvasyāpi vidhāne vākyabhedaḥ, prākāśyapadārthasyānyadravyatvābhāvena hiraṇmayatvasya nityaprāptatvāt |
uddeśyasya ca dānasyā- dhvaryuṇā viśeṣaṇamuktatvāt, ' adhvarye yunakti ' iti vyutpatyā adhvaryuśabdaṃ kṛtsnamātre kathañcidvyākhyāya prākṛtadakṣiṇāmātrasya nivṛttiḥ |
iti prāpte, adhvaryupada- vaiyarthyapattimā tṛtoyavidhiprakāratyāgenādhvaryusaṃpradānatva- muddiśya prākāśyavidhānam |
saṃpradānatvaṃ ca na dānātirikta- kriyāyāmiti yogyatayaiva dānasyāśrayatvasiddhiḥ |
yattu ' prākāśyādhvaryusaṃbandho vidhīyate ' iti mūlam, tasyāpya- yamevārthaḥ, na tu apadārthasyānyasya saṃbandhasya vidhya- tvamityevaṃ yathāśrutam |
ataśca yathaiva godyaderanekavidhiḥ, indroddeśena vā dadhividhiḥ, tathā'trāpi saṃpradānatva- muddiśya prākāśyavidhāne'pi uddeśyavidheyayorhyamayorbhā- yāmevānyāt nāvyutpannatvam |

yadi tu vibhaktyarthakarma- tvadvaiva sarvatra prātipadikasyaiva gavāderbhānāyāmuddiśya- lam, na tu karmatvasaṃbodhena vibhaktyarthasaṃpradānatvasyeti vibhāvyate, ata eva na metrāvaruṇādīnāmapi saṃpradānatve- naivoddeśyatvam, api tu tattvena guṇatve'pi padāntarakalpanā tadvadadhvaryusya tadityuktam, tadā''stu atra caturthīvidhi- prākārasyāpi tyāgena viśiṣṭadānāntaravidhireva |
na ca tathāpi caturthyā karmatvalakṣaṇayā adhvaryeruddeśyatvena prākāśyabhāvanāṃ prati anvayopapatterna dānāntaravidhirityeva yuktā iti vācyam, tathātve dānasyaiva nitya
ataḥ ṣaḍdhividhaprakārāṅgīkāre- pāpi dānāntarameva saṃpradānaprāśobhayaviśiṣṭaṃ padāntara- kalpanāyā vidheyasāmarthyānurodhena adhvaryānatijanakatvena vidhīyate, kāyāntarakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |

vastutastu lāghavāditādeśapravṛtteḥ pūrvapravṛttya- ṅgīkāreṇoktadānābhyāsa eva uktaviśeṣaṇadvayaviśiṣṭo vidhīyate, pūrvavadadhvaryānatisiddhatvarthamiti prākṛtadāna- nivṛttyabhāve'pi prākṛtatadgānānnivṛttiḥ |
' prākāśanyāyena śyāmo'śvaḥ brahmāgatasya vācaka iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
oṃ 'prākāśyaṃ svaguṇodyena guṇiṇo gacchanti kiṃ janmanā' iti nyāyaḥ |
yatra nikṛṣṭajāti'pi guṇī svaguṇodyena khyātiṃ yāyāt tatrāyaṃ pracaratīti |
prākṛtamaṅgaṃ yat vikṛtau śrūyate, tadeva vikṛtiḥ nirākāṅkṣatvāt svīkaroti |
prākṛtaṃ arthalopena bādhyate, yathā kṛṣṇalacarau avaghātaḥ prākṛtaḥ codakaprāptaḥ vaitulyasyārthalopena, yathā vā kharyādite barhiṣi lavanaṃ prāptirūpārthalopena |
vāla. pṛ. 131, prākṛtaṃ paryudāsena bādhyate, yathā hotṛ- varaṇaṃ prākṛtaṃ codakaprāptaṃ piṇyāyāṃ 'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte' iti paryudāsena |
prākṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ vaikṛtamante, yathā nakṣetreṣu upahomebhyaḥ prāk nārihomāḥ |
prākṛtaṃ pratyāmnāne anārabhyādhītena bādhyate, yathā 'ya iṣṭyā' ityanārabhyāvihitena sadya- skatvena vikṛtiṣu atidiṣṭagrahakālameva |
vāla. pṛ. 132, prākṛtaṃ pratyāmnāne ārabhyādhītena bādhyate, yathā kuśamayaṃ barhiḥ prākṛtaṃ codakaprāptaṃ dyenādī śara- mayena ārabhyādhītena |
prākṛtaṃ yat vaikṛtena bādhyate tatrāpi etadeva kāraṇaṃ 'na avādhilā pūrvavidhānaṃ vaikṛtaṃ saṃbhavati' iti |
paścāt 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet dīkṣiyamāṇaḥ' iti dīkṣaṇīyā āmnātā |
tatra prakṛtau dīkṣaṇīyā kalpopakāratvāt cayane śīghraṃ smaryate, tasmāt agnidhane dīkṣaṇīyā prāk kartavyā, paścāt sāvitra- homādayaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe utsūtre prāpte siddhāntamāha |
cakāraḥ 'sa deśaḥ syāt' iti pūrvasūtrasyānukarṣa- pārthaḥ |
yata sāvitrahomādi prākṛtāt dīkṣaṇīyākarmaṇaḥ purastāt tasya sa eva dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ prācīna eva deśaḥ syāt, na tu dīkṣaṇīyāyā ante |
agnikāṇḍe codaka- prāptasyāpi dīkṣaṇīyādeḥ sāvitrādibhya ūrdhvaṃ punaḥ pāṭhāt |
kai. oṃ prākṛtasya guṇaśrutau saguṇenābhidhānaṃ syāt |
prākṛtasya prakṛtigatasya devatā'bhidhānasya vikṛtau guṇaśrutau guṇa śravaṇe sati saguṇena devatāśabdena āvāhanādinimedheṣu abhidhānaṃ syāt |
yathā pavamānahaviḥṣu 'agni pavamānamāvaha', 'agni pāvakamāvaha', 'agni śucimāvaha' ityādi vaktavyam |
pavamāneṣu 'agnaye pavamānāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi, agnaye pāvakāya, agnaye śucaye' itītyetā sarvatra prākṛtasya devatābhidhānasya vikṛtau avikāraḥ syāt vikāro na syāt nirguṇābhidhānaṃ kartavyam |
arthaśabdatvāt arthasya śabdaśca arthaśabdau, tayoḥ anapāyatā apāyābhāvāt |
atha pavamānādiguṇaśabde sati asati vā saiva devatā
dravyavat yathā 'sā vā eṣā sarvadevatyā yadā vaśā vāyavyāmālameta bhūtikāmaḥ' |
iti ajāvaśāśabdena codite'pi karmaṇi chāgāśabdena nigamā bhavanti, na ca tatra arthasya śabdaśca apeto bhavati tadat |
ārambhasamavāyācca coditenābhidhānaṃ syā- darthasya śrutisamavāyāttvavacane ca guṇaśāsana- manarthakaṃ syāt |

ārambhasamavāyāt devatāyāḥ svena rūpeṇa karmārambhe samavāyāsya saṃbandhasya abhāvāt, arthasya devatārūpasya ca śrutisamavāyāt 'agnaye pavamānāyākapālaṃ nirvapet' iti śrutvā devatārūpasya arthasya samavāyitvaṃ sākṣātsaṃbandhavattvaṃ abhidhīyate |
tasmāt coditena vihitena saguṇadevatāpadena arthasya devatārūpasya abhidhānaṃ āvāhananigadādiṣu syāt |
saguṇena avacane ca pavamānādiguṇavacakapada- sahitena agnipadena abhidhāne tu guṇaśāsanaṃ viśeṣaṇa- vidhāyakaṃ pavamānādipadaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt |
tasmāt saguṇena agnipadena nigadādiṣu devatāyā abhidhānaṃ kartavyam, na nirguṇena iti siddhāntaḥ |
pavamāneṣu viśeṣaṇapadarahitena kevalenagnipadena āvāhanādinimedheṣu devatā'bhidhānaṃ kartavyaṃ iti pūrva- pakṣe 'dravyavat' iti padena ajāvaśāśabde uktaḥ (10|4|14|27) taṃ vaiṣamyena nirasyati |
'sā vā eṣā sarvadevatyā yadā vaśā, vāyavyāmālameta' iti vihite vaśāyāge ajādravyaṃ svena rūpeṇa samavāyaṃ gacchati |
atha avikāre'pi chāgarūpe dravye vikārarahite'pi ajā- vaśāpaviśeṣarahite kevale chāgāśabde uccārite'pi ityarthaḥ |
prakṛtapavamānedyau tu devatāyāḥ svarūpe karma- saṃbandhabhāvāt codanānuvāreṇa saguṇenaivābhidhānaṃ kartavyaṃ iti yuktaḥ siddhāntaḥ |
prākṛtabarhiḥstaraṇamantre haritapadasthāne raktapada- syoho maudre carī |
prākṛtavaikṛtayoryena yugapanna saṃbhavaḥ, tatra vaikṛtena prākṛtaṃ bādhyate |
' kṣīre dadhyādi yannāsti prāgabhāvaḥ sa ucyate |
' iti saṃpāditā tṛtīyā bṛhatī gātavyā iti |
agniṣṭome āmabhe pavamāne ityāśādhvīgavayoḥ ānuṣṭubhe eva pragāthe gānaṃ kartavyaṃ ityana vyatirekena liṅgaṃ bhavati 'caturviṃśatirgātyaḥ tṛtīyasavanaṃ ekā kakup' iti |
pramayanaṃ tu 'purojitī vo anyasaḥ' ityanuṣṭup yathāpāṭhaṃ gātavyā |
tasyā eva caturtha pādaṃ punarupādāya 'yo dhārayā pāvakayā' ityanayā gāyanyā saṃyojya geyam |
punastasyāḥ caturtha pādaṃ puna- rādāya 'taṃ duroṣaṃ' ityanayā saṃyojya geyam |
tacca dvayordvayoḥ pragāthātmakayorṛcoḥ pādapramayana saṃpādite tṛce geyam |
na tu prathamasya pragāthasya ṛgdvayaṃ dvitīyasya ca pragāthasya prathamaṃ ṛcaṃ gṛhītvā jāyamāne tṛce geyam |
liṅgadarśanāvyatirekāt 'anyā anyā ṛco bhavanti' iti ṛgyatvavidhyātmakamaliṅga- darśanasya anyatirekāt avirodhāt |
(prācīnavaṃśā catu- rviṃśatīkāśā dakṣiṇato varṣīyāsī astināmātra- madhyadvāravatī ṣoḍaśaprākramaṇyā dvādaśaprākramavistīrṇā dīrghacaturasrā |
prācī dik iti na pratyakṣaiva pratīyate, nānumānena |
'prācī devā abhajanta' iti jyotiṣṭome digvibhāga- vākye vidhirarthavādo vā iti saṃśayaḥ |
prācyāṃ diśi aindralīvyapadeśaḥ, indrasya purāṇetihāseṣu prācīdikpālatva- smaraṇāt |
'prācīnavaṃśe vaiśvadevena yajeta' iti deśasya niyamavidhiḥ, nānuvādaḥ |
prācīnavaṃśaḥ nāma maṇḍapo dārśikī vedi- mantarbhāvya avatiṣṭhate jyotiṣṭome |
yasya maṇḍapaviśeṣasya uparideśāḥ prāgrā bhavanti saḥ |
3|4|6, prācīnavaṃśe paścima- vandeḥ pūrvaprasiddhamukhyagārhapatyasya prājahita iti pūrvācārya- saṃjñā |
12|1|6, prācīnavaṃśe pūrvamavasthāpitaḥ somo vaisarjanahomādūrdhvaṃ havirdhāne prāṇīyate |
5|1|14, prācīnavaṃśe samānayanti krītaṃ somam, śakaṭe avasthāpya |
prācīnavaṃśagato vahiḥ vaisarjanahomādūrdhvaṃ āgnī- dhrīye praṇīyate |
prācīnavaṃśaśālāyāṃ pūrvabhāge vartamānaḥ āha- vanīyaḥ śālāmukhīvo nāma |
su. pṛ. 1353. 'prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇām' iti darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇavākye prācīnāvītaṃ vāsovidhamam, na tu trivṛtsūtraviṣayam |
bhā. 13|7|19. prācyai holākādayaḥ kartavyā iti na niyamaḥ, kintu sarvadharmaḥ saḥ |
prājahitaḥ prācīnavaṃśasya paścimavahnirūpaḥ mukhya- gārhapatya eva |
vi. 12|16. prājahiteḍamau māsamihotraśapaṇam, na śālāmukhīye kauṇḍapāyināmanaye |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|25. mīko. pṛ. 95 'agnihotrapākaḥ paśoḥ 0' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
prājahitavādaḥ 'sa vaiva syāt' iti jyoti- ṣṭome |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|21. mīko. pṛ. 1830 'jyoti- ṣṭome sa vaiva syāt' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
prājāpatyaṃ agnīṣomīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ veti darśapūrṇa- māsayopāṃśuyājājyam |
bhā. 5|1|6|21. prājāpatyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vā upāṃśuyājājyaṃ brāhmaṇena somāt prāk kartavyam |
agnīṣomīyaṃ tu upāṃśuyājājyaṃ somāt prāk na kartavyaṃ iti upāṃśuyājasya na utkarṣaḥ |
prājāpatyāḥ saptadaśa paśavo yadyapi ṛtupaśubhiḥ sahopakrāntāḥ tathāpi paryagnikaraṇottaraṃ ciraṃ vilambya brahmasāmakāle ālabhyante, ṛtupaśavastu prātarālabhyante |
tatra 'daivyāḥ śamitāraḥ' ityabhyupaśra āvartanīyo na tantram |
tatra ete saptadaśa yāgāḥ, na tu saptadaśapaśugaṇakaṃ ekaṃ karma |
2|1|7|21. 'prājā- patyaṃ dhṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ' iti śrūyate |
8|1|1|8|13-39. 'prājāpatyaṃ dhṛte caruṃ nirva- pet śatakṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ' : 'catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇalā- nyavadyati' |
bhā. 10|1| 1040, prājāpatyān paśūn prakṛtya 'tān paryagnikṛtān utsṛjanti, brahmasāmna ālabhante' iti śrūyate |
tatra pūrvaḥ paryagnikaraṇat pareṣāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ prati- ṣedhārthaḥ uttaraśca teṣāmeva kālāntare pratiṣedhārthaḥ |
1|1|2|15-53. prājāpatyaiḥ paśubhiḥ ṛtu- paśūtāṃ samuccayaḥ vājapeye |
'prajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyat' iti tūṣṇīṃbhāva eva prajāpatidharmaḥ; ityapi pakṣaḥ |
vi. 10|8|17. prājāpatyānāṃ ālabhmaḥ mādhyaṃdine savane brahmasāmakāle śrūyate |
paryagnikṛtānāmutsarge prājāpatyānāṃ karmotsargaḥ: śrutisāmānyādāraṇavat tasmāt brahmasānni codanāpṛṣṭhatvaṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam- vājapeye prājāpatyān paśūn prakṛtya śrūyate 'tān paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti', 'brahmasāmyālabhante' iti |

tatra vicāryate, 'tān paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti' iti kiṃ ayaṃ karmaśeṣapratiṣedhaḥ, 'brahmasāmyālabhante' iti karmāntaracodanā, athavā pūrvaḥ paryagnikaraṇat pareṣāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ pratiṣedhārthaḥ, uttaraśca teṣāmeva kālāntare prati- prasavārtha iti |
yathā 'paryagni- kṛtānyutsṛjanti' ityasya karmaśeṣapratiṣedha ityuktam 'śeṣapratiṣedho vā'rthābhāvādidāntavat' (9|4|13| 52) iti |
kimanayo- stutyatvam ? tatra karmāṇi coditāni 'vasantāya kapi- ñjalānalabheta' iti |
teṣu prāpteṣu paryagnikaraṇaṃ guṇakāṇḍaṃ punaḥ śrutam 'paryagnikṛtānutsṛjanti' iti |
nirguṇaṃ punarvacanamitarapari- saṃkhyāpakaṃ bhavatīti karmaśeṣasya pratiṣedhakaṃ vijñāyate |
evamevāpi 'prājāpatyānālabheta' iti coditānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tathaiva sarvaśeṣu pratiṣedhaṃ paryagnikaraṇasya guṇakāṇḍasya nirguṇaṃ punarvacanaṃ karmaśeṣasya nivartakam |
tatra yadeva dravyadevataṃ pūrvaiṣu yāgeṣu tadevanānupajyate |
kiṃ tarhi ? saṃskārāṇāṃ prāptāvasarāṇāṃ tasmādavasarāta pratiṣidhya brahmasāmni pratiprasavaḥ |
tadā hi kevala ālabhyo vaktavyaḥ; dravyadevatoktatvāt |
atha vākyabhedaḥ syāt, tataḥ pūrveṇa karmaśeṣaḥ pratiṣidhyeta, pareṇa karmāntaraṃ codyeta |
nanvekasmin kratau pūrveṇa saṃskārāḥ pratiṣidhyante, pareṇa vidhīyante ityarthamedāt vākyabheda eva bhavati |
na hi 'brahmasāmyālabhate' ityukte arthādeva paryagnikaraṇāntaṃ utsargaḥ siddhaḥ |
tamanucca ālabhyaḥ kevala utkṛṣyateti nāsti ṛtusāmānye vākyabhedaḥ |
saṃskārāḥ asmin kāle na kartavyaḥ (kintu brahmasāmni) ityevamādi vākye upadiśyamāne aṅgītividhānaṃ na gṛhṇīmaḥ |
(tathā sati mithaḥ karmadvaye asya saṃbandhābhāvāt ) vākyabhedāt (tataśca karmabhedaḥ ; karmabhedādatyantamabhedaḥ iti) aṣṭakalpanāmāya |
yadā hi ālabhyo'nyasmin kāle vihitaḥ tadā nyāyādeva sarva-saṃskārāṇāmutkarṣataḥ prasaṅgaḥ anyasmin (paryagnikaraṇa-) saṃskārāṇām, yena pratiṣidhyante |
bhāṣyam-- 'sadhyā vā etarhi vapā namighṛtā, brahma vai brahmasāma, yadbrahmasāmyālabhate tenāsyatenāmighṛtāḥ' iti |
yadi saṃskārapratiṣedhaḥ, tato juhvāḥ savanīyapracāreṇa recitatvāt prayājaśeṣo nāsti |
ṭup-- yadyapi 'brahmasāmyālabhate' iti karmāntara-nantaram, tasyāpi paśupuroḍāśasyaiva (tatkālanāṃ karmāntarāṇāmapi 'paśośca viprakarṣastantramadhye vidhānāt' iti nyāyāt ) prāsaṅgikāḥ prayājāḥ |
ekaḥ pakṣo (āśvinagrahagrahaṇātparaṃ ṛtupaśubhiḥ sahopakṛtānāṃ paśūnāṃ paryagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tata utsṛjya) brahmasāmakāle ālabhyam |
yadā ca māghadine (saccane) ālabhyaḥ, tadā yat tadabhamighāraṇaṃ tatrāsti, prayājāvasare vapāyā anutpannatvāt |
yājñavalkye yo'sau abhighāraṇasaṃskāro nāntarīyako haviṣi anubhūtaḥ tasya idānīṃ aviyamānatvāt (doṣasya) āśaṅkāvacanam ( 'sadhyā vā etarhi' iti ) upapadyate |
tatra ('sadhyā vā etarhi' iti) śaṅkeva nāsti (doṣaśaṅkadarśanāt akarmāntaratvaṃ iti) |
karmāntaravādinaḥ api haviṣāṃ codakena prāpnoti iti saha iha nāstī-tyāśaṅkāvacanamupapadyata eva iti |
śā-- ataḥ paryagnikaraṇāntāḥ prājāpatyāḥ : 'brahma-sāmyālabhyate' iti 'ājyena śeṣaḥ' itivat karmā-ntaramiti manavānasyottaram 'nānyakarmavidhiryukto'nekā-dṛṣṭaprakalpanāt |
bhāṭṭa-- vājapeye prājāpatyān paśūn prakramya 'tān paryagnikṛtānutsṛjati', 'brahmasāmyālabhate' iti śrutam |

tatra pūrvavākyena 'paryagnikṛtārān utsṛjati', 'paryagnikṛtaṃ pālītvamutsṛjati' itivat paryagnikaraṇā-ntāṅgītividhānāt gṛhamedhīyādyavanāpūrvatvātpañcau uttarājñānāmakartavyatvāvagateḥ : 'brahmasāmyālabhate' iti 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati' itivat karmāntaravidhiḥ |
tatra ca tadeva 'sasadaśa prājāpatyān paśūn' ityasyānu-ṣaṅgeṇa dravyadevatālābhaḥ |

iti prāpte, āśvinagrahagraho-ttaraṃ ṛtupaśubhiḥ sahopakṛtānāṃ prājāpatyānāṃ brahmasāma-kāle paryagnikaraṇottarakriyamāṇalambhakarmaprārthanāvidhāne 'brahma-sāmyālabhate' ityanena kṛte arthāt paryagnikaraṇāntasya ṛtupaśubhiḥ saha karaṇāvagateḥ; tadante utsargasya prāpta-tvāt pūrvavākyasyātathātvāt tadarthādavatvāccottara-vidhyaikavākyatvapattiḥ; pūrvottaravākyayorvākyabhedamedīkṛtya pūrvasmin parisaṃkhyāphalakatutīyavidhiprakārāṅgīkaraṇe tunnara-simaśca dravyadevatāviśiṣṭapūrva karmavidhilaka-paṣṭhavidhi-prakārāṅgīkaraṇe gauravāpatteḥ, ato'tra ālabhyotkarṣamātraṃ vidhīyate |
tadā ca taduttarajñānāmutkarṣaḥ : 'tadādi vā'bhi-saṃbandhāt' (5|1|12|24) iti nyāyādeva labhyate |
su. pṛ. 813. prājāpatyeṣu ca āmānāt (10|4|13|6) ityatra vājapeye upadiṣṭānāṃ prājāpatyanāmavihitānāṃ saṃsthāpyantāṃ ca samuccyaḥ uktaḥ |
bhā. 4|1|4|133, bāla. pṛ. 177. prājāpatyeṣu cāmmānāt ityādi tatra-tatra avirodhāt samuccayaṃ vakṣyati (iti śaṅkā) |
prakṛtau ṛtupaśavaḥ samāmnātāḥ : vājapeye ca 'sapta-daśa prājāpatyān paśūnālabhate' iti vihitam |
tatra prājāpatyeṣu ca āmmānāt ṛtupaśubhiḥ samuccayaḥ |
āmnāyate hi vājapeye ṛtupaśavaḥ : 'brahmavādino vadanti nāgniṣṭomo, nokthyo, na ṣoḍaśī, nātirātra iti, atha kasmāt vājapeyena sarve yajñakratavo'vakṣyante ? paśūbhiriti brūyāt |
yadagneyaṃ paśumālabhate agniṣṭomaṃ tenāpnoti, aindrāgnenokthyam, aindreṇa ṣoḍaśinam, sāra-svatyā'tirātram, mālyā bṛhat stotram |
etāvanto vai yajñakratavān paśūbhiravāpnuvante' iti samuccayaṃ darśayati |
bhā. 11|4| 11|39. prājāpatyeṣu paśuṣu 'chagasya vapāyā medasaḥ' ityatra 'chāgānāṃ vapānāṃ medasām' ityūhaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 127. prājāpatyeṣu paśuṣu vājapeye kummīśūlapā- śrapaṇānāṃ tantram |
na ca prājāpatyādhikaraṇa- (2|2|12|1) pūrvapakṣanyāyāt ekapadopādānāt sahitānāṃ hṛdayādīnāṃ ekadevatāsaṃbandhopapatteḥ kathamanekayāgakalpaṃ iti vācyam |
prāṇaprahān prakṛtya 'prāṇā vai prāṇabhṛtāḥ' ityādinā śrutvā tatsaṃbandhi 'te ṛtumapi buñjanti viśve' ityādi mantrāḥ paṭhitāḥ |
teṣāṃ ca parasparakāṅkṣā saṃbandhaḥ, mantrāṇāṃ grahebhyo'lpatve'pyāvṛtyā pūrtisaṃbhavāt |

iti prāpte, 'jyeṣṭhā vā etā brāhmaṇāḥ purāvidāmakan' iti tadarthavādeṣu tanmantrāṇāṃ maharṣiliṅgatvena saṃstavāt tādṛśānāṃ ca cayanaprakaraṇe vasiṣṭhaviśvāmitrabharadvājādipadaghaṭitatvāt prāṇabhṛnmantrāṇāṃ evopalambhāt teṣāmeva grahaṇe'pi karaṇa- tvam |
ata eva 'prāṇabhṛta upadhāya saṃdhat upadadhāti' iti vidhiśeṣe 'prāṇabhṛtasmin citvā saṃdhadiḥ saṃya- cchati' iti teṣāmiṣṭakānāṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ ca prāṇatvena tulyaḥ stava upapadyate |
padeṣu nirdeśa eva vācyaḥ śakyatāvacchedako vā |
tatra naraka- padāntargatasānusvārakakāraṇa narakapratītiḥ, samāśritapadā- ntargatasakāratvena ca samāśritapratītiḥ |
tena svopasthāpya- sānusvārakakārasakāravattvasyaiva kakārakārāveva vācyau vācyatāvacchedakau vā iti |
evaṃ cāmuṇḍādi- pade'pi caṇḍamuṇḍānayanavattvādisena varṇatrayameva śakyaṃ śakyatāvacchedakaṃ vā |
evaṃ parīkṣitādipade 'pari- kṣīṇe kule jātaḥ' ityādisena tattadvarṇatvaṃ bodhyam |
eteṣu ca jātiguṇakriyāsambandhāsiddherna jātyādiṣvatvam, nāpi yacchabdādyavacchedam, saṃbandhapradarśanāt |
ataste varṇā eva śakyatāvacchedakāḥ śakyā veti |
vyaktisaṃketapakṣe sarvāsu vyaktiṣu saṃketa eko nānā vā |
gauḥ śuklaḥ calaḥ ityādipadānāṃ vyaktye- kyena arthabhedābhāvāt sahaprayogānupapatteśca |
tatra jātau ca niravacchitvenaiva prakāratā tatra lāghavam |
anyathā gola- dharmitāvacchedakatvatattadaprakārakaniścayatvena hetutāyāṃ tattadatvasya prakāratātvacchedakatvayā gauravam iti jātāveva śaktiryuktā |
evaṃ ca sarvatra nānānīlapītarūpavyakliṣu vartamānā nīlapītatvādijātiḥ nīlapītādipadavācyā |
dvityādi- śabdānāpi bālādyavasthāparigate nānāvidhadharmadhyāsāt bhinnādiśrayārthaniṣṭhā dvitvajātireva vācyā |
'bāla- vṛddhaśyākodirityādibhedena śabdaniṣṭhaiva jātirvācyā' ityapi ke cit |
tatrāpyevaṃ vibhāgaḥ, jātireva nāmārthaḥ; uktayuktyā ākṣepācca vyaktilābhaḥ |
arthapattiḥ samānavittitveva vā ākṣepo niruḍhalakṣaṇā vā |
tena śrutyā prakṛtyupasthāpya- tvasya prakṛtyarthatvāt na pratyārthānvayānupapattiḥ |
'śakyādanyena rūpeṇa māne bhavatī lakṣaṇā' iti niyamasya aprayojakatvāditi |
evaṃ ca śabdābdabodhe ghaṭatvaśaktiḥśānatvena kāraṇatāyāṃ lāghavam |
aśakyāyā api jāteḥ upalakṣaṇatayā tadupalakṣitavyaktivyaktīkaraṇa na vyabhicārānantaśakti kalpa nādidoṣaḥ |
śabdaḥ sukara- saṃbandho na ca vyabhicariṣyati |
anyathā ghaṭa- tvāṃśe śaktyābhāvena ghaṭatvādeḥ śābdaviṣayatvāsaṃbhavāt |
na ca ghaṭaviśepyakaghaṭatvaprakārakanope jātiśaktijñānatvena vyaktiśaktijñānatvena vā hetutvāt nāyaṃ doṣa iti vācyam |
na ca padajñānasya saṃbandhajñāna- vidhayā hetutvena yena rūpeṇa upasthitayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ tena rūpeṇa upasthāpakatvaniyamaḥ |
evaṃ ca ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭa śakya- grahe'pi tenaiva rūpeṇa upasthitaḥ iti vācyam |
liṅgaṃ dvedhā, śāstrīyavyavahāretuḥ laukikaṃ ca, avayavasaṃsthānaviśeṣavattvaṃ anyaṃ tattadvyaktiviśeṣaniṣṭhaṃ vyavasthitam, iyaṃ vyaktiḥ, ayaṃ padārthaḥ, idaṃ vastu iti sarvatra vyavahārāt |
'paśunā yajeta' ityādau mukhyapuṃstvavivakṣa- ṇāt na strīpaśunā yāgaprasaṅga ityāhuḥ |
anye tu paśu- śabdasya liṅgatrayasādhāraṇyena prayoge'pi māntravarṇika-
cchagapadasya vyavasthitaprayogeṇa laukikapuṃstve śaktimādāya doṣoddhāra ityāhuḥ |
yadā śālīyaṃ liṅgaṃ śabdaniṣṭhameva, laukikaṃ tu artha- niṣṭham |
ata eva 'prāssā agniṃ bharata' ityatra upasthitavyaktigatapuṃstve śaktisvīkārāt kevalamebhyāmpūhaḥ |
atra ṭādyādīnāṃ ṅīnādīnāṃ śīghrapratīnāṃ dyotakatvaṃ asminmate |
yadā jātivyaktiliṅgasaṃkhyā iti catuṣkaṃ prātipadi- kārthaḥ |
tenaiva ca nāmārtha- prakārakābdabodhe suvādinyopasthiterhetutvanirvāha iti dika |
etat sarvaṃ mahābhāṣye 'sarūpāṇāmekaśeṣaḥ' (pā. 1|2|64) iti sūtre spaṣṭam |
ālaṅkārikāstu 'viṣayatvamanāhya śabdenārthaḥ prakāśyate' itimatādvahamena pañcakaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ |
pare tu śabdasyāpi prātipadikārthatvaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ prāti- padikārthaḥ |
tathāhi -- 'gāmuccāraya' ityādilaukika- prayoge 'śipiviṣṭavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' ityādi- vaidikaprayoge ca śabdo'pi bhāsate iti nirvivādam |
vṛttiściṣya ca śābdabodhe viṣayaḥ iti niyamaḥ |
tathā ca śabdasyāpi śabdaśaktiviṣayatayā bhānaṃ aṅgīkāryam |
tatra ghaṭādipade śabdaniṣṭhe'pi śaktiḥ bhinnā kalpyate iti ke cit |
tena ghaṭādi- padānāṃ śaktisaṃbandhena ghaṭatvādin padamapi śakyam |
etāvān viśeṣaḥ yat saṃbandhasyobhayoranirūpyatvena ghaṭādivat śabdasyāpi tathaiva ca upasthitau satyāṃ artha- bodhe tātparya sati tatra viśeṣaṇatayā sa śabdo bhāsate |
tatrāpi ghaṭatvādipeṇa viśiṣya śaktigrahavatāṃ padajātya- bhayaprakārakabodhaḥ |
na layudhiṣṭhirādipadavadiśiṣya śaktigrahā- bhāve tu vyaktiviśeṣyakaḥ kevalapadaprakārakaḥ nalpadavācyaḥ kaścit ityādyākārako bodhaḥ |
yatra tu uktodāharaṇepu śabdamātre tātparyaṃ tadā tatra śaktyā śabdasvarūpasya prādhānyena bhānamiti |
evaṃ ca kacit tātparyavaśāt śabda eva prādhānyena bhāvyate kacit tadabhāve arthaviśe- ṣaṇatvena iti siddham |
ata eva 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' ityādi tasya viśeṣaṇatvena anvayāt agnihotranāmakena iti bodhaḥ |
evaṃ ca 'udeti savitā tāmrāstameti evāstameti ca |
' ityādi 'rakta evāstameti' iti yadā kriyate tadā padāntarapratipāditaḥ sa evārthaḥ |
arthā- ntaratathaiva pratibhāsate iti kāvyaprakāśoktiḥ saṃgacchate |
taduktam 'ādyatvaṃ grāhakatvaṃ ca dve śaktī tejaso yathā |
maṇi. pṛ. 118-123. prātipadikārthaḥ pradhānaṃ vibhaktyarthaṃ gauṇa |

bhā. 9|13| 516. prātipadikārtho yadyapi gauṇaḥ, prakṛti- pratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyāt, tathāpi 'paurṇa- māsyāṃ caturhotrā abhidharet' ityādau abhidharaṇya- viśeṣaṇavanmāt samastasuvādiviṣayasaṃśayopaplave sati viśeṣo'nyataḥ eva labhyavyaḥ iti sākāṅkṣatvāt asaṃ- digghaparigrahāya prathamagṛhītatvena ca prātipadikārthe mukhyamāśritya vibhaktaḥ satyamarthe'vaklṛpte paurṇamāsyā- miti |
su. pṛ. 154. guṇaśca vibhaktyarthaḥ, pradhānaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ |
‘prātipadikārtha-liṅga-parimāṇa-vacanamātre prathamā’ (pā0 2|3|46) iti sūtraṃ prathamāyāḥ liṅgaparimāṇavacaneṣu śaktigrāhakaṃ iti vaiyākaraṇāḥ|
nedaṃ śaktigrāhakam, kintu neyaṃ kārakavibhaktiḥ iti sūcanārtham |
striyāṃ yat prātipadikaṃ vartate tata-ṣṭhānādayaḥ iti |
mantraśāstre mātṛkānyāsādī dīrghatvavarṇo yadyapi svīkṛtaḥ, tathāpi prātiśākhyanyāyena anyatra asau nopayujyate eva (yathā tatrātiśākhyoktaṃ tacchākhāyāmeva nānyatra tathā) |
prādāvyenāminā āhavanīyādeḥ saṃsargaṃ prāyaścittam ‘agnaye śucaye'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet’ iti |
vā. 3|4|142 pṛ. 903, prādhānya vyapa-deśā bhavanti’ iti nyāyena (‘somena yajeta’ ityatra) vākyīyādhvarasya śrautāṅgatvasya vā vyavahāraḥ |
murāri. pṛ. 1172, prādhānyena vyapadeśā bhavanti’ iti nyāyena (‘aindyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate’ ityatra) śrautāṅgatvasya vyavahāraḥ, na tu vākyīyājñatvasya |
prāptasya punarvacanaṃ tāvanmātra-phalaṃ anarthakaṃ iti sāmarthyāt prakarṣagatirjijñāsyate |
yathā ‘adhirūpāya kanyā deyā’ ityatra adhirūparāya iti gamyate |
prāptasya punaḥ śravaṇaṃ asati prayojane anyasmin-parisaṃkhyāmeva bhavati |
prāpte karmaṇi anekārthaguṇa-vidhānaṃ na ca saṃbhavati |
prāpte karmaṇyapi ekapadācānekāryavidhiḥ śauṇādyudāharaṇaistatra tattra pratipāditaḥ |
prāpte karmaṇi nāneko vidhātuṃ śakyate guṇaḥ |
karmotpatti-vākye hi pratyayo bhāvanāṃ aprasatvāt vidhātumaśakyamate |
sā ca yāvat dhātvarthakārakaḥ na paripūryate tāvat anuṣṭhātumayogyā iti vidhitvaparyavasānam |
tatra bhāvanā ātmasaṃbhūtāvatagatakārakasāmānyānyathā'nupapattyā ākṣita-pratīterviśeṣaiḥ bhāvanāmātrāṅgāṅgibhiḥ vākyādeva viśeṣyate |

pratipadaṃ ca yāvatsiddhaṃ dravyāśritaṃ jātiliṅga-saṃkhyādi tatsarvamekapadādānalakṣaṇaśrutipratilabdhaviśeṣaṇa-viśeṣyabhāvaṃ apratipannaparasparaśeṣatviva vibhaktiśrutyaiva kārakātmanā bhāvanātyarthaṃ pratipadyate |
evaṃ yāvanti padāni saṃnikarṣavibhaktyarpakāni tāni sarvāṇi anuṣaṅga-dhikaraṇāttikena mārgeṇa (2|1|16) anāhatya saṃnikarṣa-vibhaktīṃ yugapat saṃnipattanti |
tataḥ sarvaviśeṣaviśiṣṭāṃ anuṣṭhānayogyāṃ bhāvanāsādhāraṇa vidhiḥ samāptyate |
sa ca ekenaiva prayatnena tāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ vidadhāti, iti nāneka-śaktikalpanāpattidoṣaḥ |
ekoktyavasitānāṃ tu nārthakṣepau tu aṃstyeva, yathā ‘pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ’ iti |
vidhiliṃ yadi anyatrāpi śrutyaiva punarvyāpriyeta, tataḥ prāptabādha: dvividhaḥ nityau vaikalpikaśceti |
prāptabādha: nāma ‘sādhāraṇasya śāstrasya sakṛdvidhāya nivṛttavyāpāraḥ svārthānvayapattyā sarva-viśeṣaviṣayādinā |
saṃkocaḥ klṛptarūpasya prāptabādho'bhi-viśeṣeṣu pratyekaniściti vidhyantarāṇāyābhidhayan samā-dhīyate |
yatra klṛptasyaiva śāstrasya sāmānyadvāreṇa mnāyāvagataikaparupāparityāgena asakṛduccāraṇaphale vartate |
viśeṣyānupasarpata: kacit viśeṣyagādinā prāptipacyate, 2|2|136 pṛ. 485, prāpte karmaṇi saṃbandhaghadakaraṇe vākyaṃ tatra prāptabādhaḥ |
3|1|1|121 pṛ. 734, prāpte puna- prāptabādha: prākṛtājñasya vikṛtau codakaprāptasya pratyāmnā-rārambho niyamāya’ iti nyāyena ‘yajñopavītyevādhīyīta’ nāt arthalopāt pratiṣedhādvā yo bādhaḥ |

yathā prākṛtānāṃ yājayedyajeta vā’ iti vihite punaḥ ‘upapadyate’ iti kuśānāṃ pratikulaśarāmmānāt, avaghātāt kṛṣṇaleṣu vidhiḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ piṇḍe'pi karmaṇi yajñopavītyeva vaituṣarūpaprayojanasya lopāt, piṣṭedhau |
satyāśrau. 11|1|7 vaijayantī. prāpte hotāraṃ vṛṇīte’ iti pratiṣedhāt |
prāptasyānuvādo bhavitu-bādha: yatra atideśasāmānyaśāstrādijanite jñāne aṃśe rhati |
sarvaviṣaye vā ‘mityedaṃ’ iti pratyānantaraṃ bhavati sa prāpte
na ca ato na jñānotpatteḥ paratastvam |
samānasaṃvitsaṃvaidhatayā jñānatvavat pramātvasya svatastvaṃ vadhāyā arthavyabhicāreṇa tena arthaniścayāsaṃbhavāt |
nāpi tajjanyasulotpattyā, ayathārthadāpi svapne candanalepā- dijñānāt sulotpatteḥ tasyāpi arthavyabhicārāt |
tasyāḥ viṣayajñānāti- kiñca, udakāharaṇādisupārthakriyā vyāpyaviṣayayā ghaṭa- |
anantatacchidrayakṣaṇeḥ anantatacchidrayotpattināśa- evaṃ ca svata eva arthatatvaniścayo vācyaḥ |
evaṃ ca nadyucchidrādiviṣayaka- tarhi ghaṭādijñāne'pi svata eva prāmāṇyam, tathāparadhā- |
tena jñānagrāhakeṇaiva tasya jñānaṃ iti siddhaṃ |
anye tu ārambhaṭayoḥ vyāpyalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandho prāmāṇyasyai svatastvam |
teṣāṃ bhāvaṃ nākala- kiñca, jñānaṃ na pratyakṣam |
na ca asataḥ kāryaṃ kāryopacaritamiti vācyam |
dvitvā- cchedakaprakāraniścaya ityetathā tadabhāvāt na nirvi- |
na ca tatra naṣṭadvitvasya kalpakapratyakṣatāpattiḥ iti vācyam |
ṣaṇaṃ' iti rītyā 'ekatrobhayaṃ' iti rītyā vā tādṛśa- |
na ca yāvadāśrayapratyakṣaṃ vinā kathaṃ dvitvapratyakṣamiti pratyakṣe viśeṣaṇatāvacchedakaprakāraniścayasya hetutvābhāvena |
lāghavena saṃyogapratyakṣe tasya hetutvābhāvena tadīyā nirvikalpakapratyakṣapatterdurvārātvāt |
vyāptivyucchittirmadhyapratyakṣe tasya hetutvābhāvena tanmayasya evaṃ ca āvaśyakapratibandhakatvābhāvena kalpanemapekṣya |
na cāśrayapratyakṣatvābhāve'pi tacchidrasaṃpratyakṣa- ātmaniṣṭhaguṇapratyaye tādātmyena jñānasyaiva dharmādharma- |
rguṇasya samavāyikāraṇābhāvena māvibhūtayoḥ kayamutpatti- evaṃ ca viṣayaniṣṭhātatayā tanniṣṭhameva jñānaṃ anu- |
samavāyasaṃbandhena māvakāryautpattau tādātmya- mīyate 'ghaṭo jñānavān, jñātatvāt' iti |
murārimiśrāstu ghaṭādijñānettaraṃ 'ghaṭaṃ jānāmi' samavāyena tadapyabhāvena samavāyikāraṇāvaśyakatvāt |
ityādyanuvyavasāyā jāyate, tena ghaṭatvadiśeṣyakatvaghaṭatva- saṃkhyāyā viṣayatāyāśca 'abhāvaṃ jānāmi' 'abhāvau dvau' |
vastuto jalādiśānottaraṃ pravṛttyā jalādiniścayottaraṃ svarūpasaṃbandhenaiva utpattyaṅgīkāreṇa samavāyakāraṇāvaśyaka- |
kaścittu (svamataṃ) jñātvā prāmāṇyaṃ pravartate ityanu- riva janakatvā niyāmakatvāt |
bhavāt 'jātaṃ jñānaṃ pramā na vā' ityādisaṃśayānubhavāt na niyatatayā na tadāpattiprasaṅgo'pi |
nāpi parata: tvena ananyatvānumānāt kathaṃ nityatvamiti vācyam |
kintu kutracit ekatvenākṛtāsu aruṇādivyaktiṣu vyabhicārāt, anu- |
svata:prāmāṇyagrahaḥ, kacit parata: ityanugataṃ eva prāmā- kūlatarkābhāvena aprayojakatvāt |
tena vedajanajñāne saṃśayābhāvāt tāditvādeḥ kāvasthānamiti vācyam |
ata kṣaṇamātraṃ ghaṭāderiva viṣayatāyā api sattve bādhakā- |
eva smṛtijanyajñāne samūlakatvaguṇānādeva prāmāṇyaṃ bhāvāt, ato naṣṭadādivāpi 'ghaṭo jñātaḥ' ityādyanu- |
sarvajñānāni adhikṛtya cintyate saṃskārāṇāṃ samānaviṣayakatvenaiva kāryakaraṇabhāve lāghavādi |
kiṃ prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ ca ubhayaṃ svata evāvagamyate, viṣayatā atiriktā |
athavā anyataradapi svabhāvena anirūpitaṃ kāraṇaguṇa- gṛhyate, tanniṣṭhapramātvamapi iti svatastvam |
doṣapratyayābhyāmāvagamyate, āhosvit aprāmāṇyaṃ svatau- nanu evaṃ 'idaṃ jñānaṃ pramā na vā' iti saṃdehoṃ na |
'vagamyate prāmāṇyaṃ tu kāraṇaguṇajñānāt saṃvādajñānāt syāt, jñānāgrahe dharmijñānābhāvāt tad-grahe tanniṣṭha- |
arthakriyājñānādvā avagamyate, uta prāmāṇyaṃ svataḥ pramātvasyāpi grahāt, iti cenna |
prāptaṃ sat arthānyatvātkāraṇadoṣajñānāmyāṃ avagamyamānena pramātvasaṃśayaḥ kintu viṣayasaṃśaya evāyam |
rajatatvamasti na vā' iti rajatādijñānottaraṃ pramātva- |
tatra sarvakāraṇānāṃ svakāryaśakteḥ svābhāvikatvāt smaraṇe rajatādijñānanāśāt tatsaṃśayopapatteḥ |
ubhayapi jñānaṃ svarasādevāvagamyate iti ke cit |
tanmate hi sarvameva yadā satyapi prāmāṇyajñāne doṣaśavādeva tadutpattiḥ |
kāryajātaṃ sat utpadyate, iti prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyakaṃ- doṣaśca anyatsadaśānāt (daśāpanna) tvaṃ iti |
nahi jñānaṃ svaviṣa- yuktaṃ iti prāmāṇyasya svatastvamiti |
yasya tathālaṃ atathālaṃ ca yugapat śaknoti vedayituṃ guruvastu ghaṭādimātraviṣayakaṃ na jñānam, sarvajñānānāṃ |
atha kā'pi jñānavyakti: svaprāmāṇyaṃ svatau tripuṭīviṣayatvaṅgīkārāt |
bodhayati, kā'pi aprāmāṇyaṃ ityucyate, tathāpi na rūpā |
kiṃ ka jñāne bhavati iti na śakyaṃ vivektum |
svata eva jñānadarthatātvarūpamāmīyaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ niśvīyate, na tu guṇajñānāt saṃvādajñānāt arthakriyājñānādā tadava- gantavyam |
aprāmāṇyaṃ tālīyamarthatātvarūpaṃ svatau nāvagamyate, na tu (? kintu) : kāraṇadoṣajñānāt sākṣā- deva vā naitadevamiti jñānādavagamyate ityetadatra prati- pādyate |
tathā ' pramāṇaṃ punaḥ svārthe pramāṇamiva hi svataḥ : |
tathā vicāropakrame ' pramāṇatvā- pramāṇatve jñānasya svata eva kim |
' iti vadan pramāṇatvāpramāṇatvanirūpaṇameva hi svataḥ parato viti cintyate iti spaṣṭamevāha |
yat tu ' nanu pramāṇamityevaṃ pratyakṣādi na gṛhyate |
' ( ślovā. codanā- sūtram 82-83 ) : iti vārtikaṃ tat pramāṇamasmītyanena ākāreṇa agrahaṇāt tathā ca pramāṇamityevaṃ pratyakṣādi na gṛhyate ityāha |

nanu yadi prāmāṇyaṃ jñānotpattisamaye avagamyate, yat utpattau pramāṇatayā na cakāsti tadapramā- ṇamityutpattāveva pariśeṣātpanniśretuṃ śakyaṃ vināpi kāraṇa- doṣagrāhakamityāyāṃ iti aprāmāṇyamapi svataḥ evāpaceta |
na hi svaśabdo'yaṃ prāmāṇyaparatayā prayuktaḥ prāmāṇyadeva prāmāṇyaṃ bhātīti, nāpi pramāṇapara- tayā |
yadi hi tathā syāt tato'pramāṇeṣu prāmāṇyanaba- . bhāsāt pariśeṣāsiddhamaprāmāṇyaṃ syāt |
tatkṣaprāmāṇa- jñānādapi prāmāṇyamevātmano''dapi bodhyata iti nāprāmā- ṇyasya pariśeṣasiddhiḥ |
aprāmāṇyaṃ tu pratītaprāmāṇya- vādarūpeṇa paśvāddeṣyata iti |
yathā''ha - ' yasmāt : svataḥ pramāṇatvaṃ sarvatrotsargikaṃ sthitam |
sarvatraiti na kevalaṃ pramāṇeṣu, jñānamātre iti yāvat |
tathā ' apramāṇamapi svārthe pramāṇamiva hi svataḥ : |
na ca pramāṇajñānāntyadhikṛtya pramāṇānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ svataḥ parato veti |
kiṃ tarhi ? yāni tāvat sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā iti parasparapadanekakoṭisaṃśayaviśānebhyaḥ smṛtijñānebhyaścātiriktāni ghaṭo'yaṃ paṭo'yamityevarūpāṇi jñānāni tāni sarvāṇyadhikṛtya cinteyam |
yadi pramāṇānyeva viṣayīkṛtya cintyeta tato viṣayobhayavādi- siddhatvāt yānyubhayoḥ pramāṇatayā prasiddhāni teṣāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ svata ityetāvata siddhānveta |
tataśca vedasyobhayavādi- siddhaprāmāṇyāvena vicāraviṣayatvāt nāsya svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ sādhitaṃ syāt |

jñānamātraṃ tvadhikṛtya svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ paratvāprāmāṇye sādhyamāne vedasyāpi svatastāvādviṣayatvāttvarūpaṃ prāmāṇyamavagataṃ syāt ( 1 sat ) kāraṇadoṣajñānāderabhāvācciravāda sthitaṃ bhava- tīti prayojanavatī cintā |
nanu nārthatvātmātraṃ prāmāṇyam, smṛterapi tathātva- prasaṅgāt |
asmin prakaraṇe tāvanmātrameva svataḥ parato veti cintyate |
kaśca tasya bhāvaḥ ? pramāṇāntarā- dhigatatayā anusaṃdhīyamānatvam, tathābhāvaśca arthasya, jñānasya tanniścayajanakatā, iti tritayaṃ militaṃ pramāṇa- buddhiśabdayorvācakaṃ pramāṇyam |
tatra yadetadarthasyāvagatatayā anusaṃdhīyamānatvaṃ tayorjñānupāṇupalavdhigamyate na jñānasva- rūpād gamyate |
na hi ghaṭajñānaṃ ghaṭasyālyataḥ anavagatā pratipādayati |
tena na tatra svataḥ parato veti |
yadeva tu nanvatābhūta- mityanenāyathārthatvalakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyāśāṅkitaṃ tatparihārāyā- rthatātvalakṣaṇameva prāmāṇyaṃ svata iti sādhyate |
tathāhi yadarthatātvaniścāyakaṃ tadeva tadiṣyasya niścayasyotpādaka bhavati |
yadeva hi jñeyāpekṣayā jñāpakaṃ tadeva jñānāpekṣayā janakaṃ bhavati |

' tena arthatātva- lakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ guṇajñānānnidhrīyate ' iti pratipādayataḥ pūrvepakṣiṇo nāsaṃgataḥ : ' niścayātmakaprāmāṇyotpādanaṃ tu vastusvarūpatvāt saṃvādaguṇajñānakāryatvena svavyavasānam ' iti granthaḥ |
yadi punaridameva sākṣāducyate ' niścayātmakaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ svatau jāyate ' iti, tathā satyaprāmāṇyamapi parato jāyeta iti vaktavyam |
prāmāṇyaṃ svatau jāyate, aprāmāṇyaṃ parato'vagamyate iti |
tasmāt svataḥ parastva prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ cāva- gamyate ityeva prakaraṇārthaḥ |
evaṃ hi nyāyo granthasya samañjaso bhavati |
tadayamatra pūrvottarapakṣasaṃkṣepaḥ : ghaṭādyaṭā ca ghaṭa- jñānadarśanāt tanmātreṇa ghaṭo niśvetuṃ śakyate |
tenārtha- kriyādarśanādeva tadetadbhūtaghaṭaniścayapuraḥsaraṃ pūrvasya ghaṭa- jñānasya ghaṭādutpattirniścīyate |
arthakriyājñānaṃ tu anyabhi- cārāt svataḥ prāmāṇyamarthakriyāyāṃ niścayāyat na śaknoti pūrvejñānasya prāmāṇyaṃ niścayāyitum |
tathā jñānāntara- saṃvādo'pi nārthatātvābhāve ghaṭate iti tato'pyatha- tātvaniścayaḥ |
tathā guṇavatkāraṇajanyaṃ vijñānaṃ yathārthameva bhavatīti kāraṇaguṇāvadhāraṇādapi śakyate'sya tathā- bhāvo niśvetum |
tasmāt parata eva jñānasya prāmāṇya- niścayaḥ, na svataḥ : tasyārthatātvalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ niśvetuṃ śakyam, anaikāntikatvāt |
aniścitai cārthe nāsti prāmāṇyamityaprāmāṇyameva jñānasya svataḥ |
kiñca niścaya- prābhāvo na doṣajñānena śakyate janayitum, niścayastu vastutvācchakyate guṇajñānādinā janayitum |
tasmāt parata evārthatātvarūpaprāmāṇyaṃ niśvīyate iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhāntastu na jñānamabhicāramukhenaiva arthe niṣkā- yayati, kintu svata eva |
yadi hi svatau niśvetuṃ na śakyatvāt tathā sati niścayāntābhāva eva syādityā- syamevāśeṣaṃ jagato bhavet |
na hi svatau'niścito- 'rthaḥ parato niśvetuṃ śakyate, parasyāpi tadadevāsābhyāt |

yathā hi ghaṭajñānamalpi ghaṭe dṛṣṭamityaniścāyakam, tathā arthakriyājñānamapyasatyamevārthakriyāyāṃ svatvāvasthāyāṃ dṛṣṭamiti na tenāpi sā niśvetuṃ śakyā, natarāṃ tathā ghaṭaniścaya ityāyātamanyamyaśeṣaṃ jagataḥ |
atha artha- kriyājñānena nodakāharaṇādikamucyate, kintu jñānameva sutrātmakam, sarvaṃ ca sutrajñānaṃ svātmani svata eva pramāṇam, anyabhicārāt ityucyate |
tathā sati bhavatu nāmāthakriyāniścayaḥ, tathāpi tu na tathā pūrvejñānasya śakyaṃ yāthārthyaṃ viśātum |
api ca gṛhītā- vināmāvārthakriyāyā pūrvajñānaviṣayasya niścayaḥ |
na hi guṇajñānād guṇo- 'pi niśvetuṃ śakyate, kiṃ punaḥ pūrvajñānaprāmāṇyam |
tasya pūrvajñānāt tu viśeṣaḥ yena pūrvajñānānnimittamanena niścīyate |
yadyapi vastulāñjanyo niścayaḥ tathāpi jñāne- naiva janyate, nānyena |
tasmāt svata eva prāmāṇyaṃ parata- prāmāṇyaṃ doṣajñānādvākyajñānādvā niśveyam |
nanu avastatvācca doṣajanyamaprāmāṇyaṃ bhavati, ata- jjanyaṃ ca na tato'vadhārayituṃ śakyam |
na tāvanniścayaprābhāvavaprāmāṇyaṃ doṣairjanyate iti brūmaḥ, kintu arthānyathātvarūpam |
taddhi śakyaṃ doṣajñānena niśve- tum, doṣanimittakatvādyathārthatvasya duṣṭeṣu kāraṇeṣvayathārtha- tvadarśanāt |
vede'pi satvāt prāmāṇyaṃ doṣabhāvā- danapoditaṃ sthitam |
kathaṃ punaravagamyate doṣanimittamayathārthatvam, na guṇā- bhāvanimittamiti ? sarvatra hi guṇavidyureṣu duṣṭeṣu ca kāraṇeṣpa ayathārthatvaṃ jñāyate |
tatra kuto'yaṃ vivekaḥ doṣa eva nimittaṃ na guṇavaidhuryamiti ? tasmādyapi parata evāprāmāṇyopalakṣaṇaṃ tathāpi guṇābhāvedopalakṣaṇasaṃbhavā- dede ca āsapraṇītatvaguṇayogāt svarasaprāmāṇyasyāpi
dṛśyānukāriṇī hi kalpanā bhavati, na dṛṣṭairāpadyatena |
tena vedasya svata eva prāptaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ yathā na virudhyate tathā caitat kalpayituṃ śakyate |
tena yadyapi prasidde- vyarthatājñāne guṇābhāvo doṣaśca dṛṣṭaḥ, tathāpi vede guṇābhāve'pi prāmāṇyadarśanāt tanmā bādhite doṣa- nimittamevāthayārthatvaṃ śuktirajatādijñānānāṃ kalpyate |
anyathā hi jñānatvanindhanamathayārthatvaṃ kalpyate, sarvaiba- pramāṇeṣu jñānatvadarśanāt |
evaṃ guṇābhāvo- 'pi yathāthoṃ vede dṛṣṭatvāt nāyathārthatvasya nindhanam |
asiddhaṃ tasya yathārthatvamiti cet, pratyakṣādīnāṃ vā kutaḥ siddham ? svata iti cet, tadbhede''pi samānamanthatra nāstiktāminiveśāt |

prāyaṇīyayeṣṭādau asthiyajñe mṛtādhikārapakṣe prastaragrahaṇe sūktavākamantragataḥ yajamānā''śāsanaparaḥ ‘āsāste'yaṃ yajamāno'sau’ (asau iti nāma gṛhṇāti ‘keśavaśarmā’ ityādi) ityādiḥ luṣyate (kṛtvācintā) |
sudhā- prāyaṇīyaye pañca, udayanīye pañca anyo'pi āsanatvāt udayanīye eva ityavayavaśaḥ dvādaśāha prāyaṇīyayodanīyā- nyo vakṣyate daśame |
prāyaṇīyāniṣkāse udayanīyānirvāpaḥ udaya- nīyāsaṃskāraḥ, nārthakarma nāpi pratipattiḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ adhikāre ‘bhinne juhoti, skanne juhoti’ ityādi yat kiñcit prāyaścittaṃ uktaṃ tat sarvatra yatrayatra bhidyate skancate vā tatratatra agnihotrādāvapi syāt |
doṣasāmānyāt doṣa bhedanādeḥ samānatvāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pūrvapakṣa sūtre prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
prāyaścittaṃ evaṃjātīyakaṃ prakaraṇe tasminneva kartavyaṃ syāttrā- nyatra karmaṇi |
śabdahetutvāt prakṛtaikākyatvāpādakaprayoga- vacanarūpasya śabdasya tatra hetutvāt |
tasmāt yat prāyaścittaṃ yasmin prakaraṇe utpannaṃ tat tatraiva prakaraṇe svāmnāyasya phalāntarakalpanāprasaṅgāt |
agnihotrasya jyotiṣṭomādevā ataddhikārāt tadadhikāratvābhāvāt darśapūrṇamāsādhikāratvā- bhāvāt |
prakṛtau utpannaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vikṛtau tu syāt |

6|4|10-16. mīko. pṛ. 2039 ‘darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ kapālādeḥ’ ityatra draṣṭa- vyam |

prāyaścittaṃ puruṣārthe laukika eva yūpopasparśanai na vaidike |
‘yadyekaṃ yūpamupaspṛśet eṣa te vāyo iti brūyāt |
yadi dvau, etau te vāyū iti |
yadi bahūn ete te vāyavaḥ iti’ |
1|3|1|9. mīko. pṛ. 118 ‘agnihotrīye paśau yāgasamāptyantaram’ ityatra draṣṭavyam |
prāyaścittaṃ prādāyanāminā āhavanīyādeḥ saṃsarge ‘agne śucaye'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet’ iti bhā. 1|2|4| 7|22. prāyaścittaṃ yūpavirohaṇe prakṛtāvāpi |
kāni cit vaiguṇyasya pramādā- dāpatitasya samādhānāni, kāni cit nimitte karmā- jñāni |
bhā. 12|3|15|16. viṣayaparāce ca prāya- ścittāni vidhīyante, nimitte karmāṅgabhūtāni, yathā ‘bhinne juhoti’ iti |
tatra samādhānāni yathā ‘yadyukto yajña ārtimimāt, bhūḥ svāheti gārhapatye juhuyāt, atha yadi yajuto dakṣiṇābhau bhuvaḥ svāheti, yadi sāmataḥ svaḥ svāhetyāhavanīya eva’ iti |
yathāvijñāto bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhetyāhavanīya eva’ iti |
kaḥ punaryaśate vināśaḥ ? śiṣṭa- syākriyā, pratiṣiddhasevanaṃ ca |
kathaṃ punaryaśate vina- śasya samādhānārthaṃ tat prāyaścittamiti ? vākyasaṃyogāt |
yadi tasmin kṛte'pi tat vinayameva, ko'rthastena kṛtena |
yastvaṃ brūte, ārtau nimitte karmāṅgaṃ prāyaścittamiti |
aṅgaṃ nāma tat, yat pradhānaṃ phalavat karoti |
yadi tadanena phalavat kriyate tat etadaṅgam |
tavedaphala prasaktametena phalavat kriyate, hanta tarhi jātasya vinaṣṭasya samādhānārtham |
atha na kriyate, na tarhi karmāṅgam |
tatra yadyucyate nimitte karmāṅgamiti tadeva nāsti |
api ca tatratatra nahasamā- dhānameva vākyaśeṣe śrūyate ‘agnirvai devānāṃ pathikṛt svena bhāgadheyenāsīran |
sa evaṃ paṃthānamapi nayati, sa enaṃ vratamālamamyati’ iti |
kathamekādhyāteṣāme ? niṣpanne doṣeṇa kevalasya tasya- syāmi saṃyogaḥ, ‘yadyukto yajña ārtimimāt, bhūḥ svāheti juhuyāt’ iti |
ekena cennihate doṣo dvitīyadīna prayogāna- ntarāṇi bhavanti |
soma-- na naimittikamātrasya vaiguṇyasamādhānārthatvam, kintu karmavaiguṇyasya nimitte vidhīyamānasya |
bhavanāthastu (prabhā- karānuyāyī) yathātirūpeṇa ajñānvayaḥ, na tu ṛgādyā- titayā ityekārthamāha |
sūtrārthastu- prāyaścitteṣu yasmāt niṣpanne vaiguṇyaparimitena yogaḥ, tasmādekāryam |
tata ekena sarvasya vaiguṇyasya nirghātaḥ iti vikalpaḥ iti |
vi-- ‘vaiśvānare pathikṛte sāhityaṃ vā vikalpa- nam |
teṣu yāni ekasminneva vaiguṇya anekāni nirapekṣāni tattadākyairvidhīyante teṣvapi satyapi adṛṣṭā- thetve pūrvavat vikalpaḥ |
yathā ‘yadi sāmato yajña ārtimimāt suvarityāhavanīyye juhuyāt’ iti kasyāṃ- cinchākhāyāmadhvaryukartṛko homaḥ |
aparasyāṃ tu ‘yadi sāmato yajña ārtimimāt svarityāhavanīyye’ iti brahmakartṛko homaḥ |
tathā darśapūrṇamāsātikramaṇe eva kacitpāyikṛtītthe; kacit vaiśvānarīti |
tatrāpi darśa- pūrṇamāsātikramanimittapratyayaparihārārthatvamapekṣitavidhi- balāt vākyaśeṣāt ca avagamyate |
ataśca śrīhiyavā- divadeva tattadiniyogavidhivelāyāmeva ekavaiguṇyasya- rūpāvantarakāryanirapekṣeṇa sādhanatvāvagamāt yukto'trāpi vikalpaḥ |
na ca kāraṇātā''cchedakavejātyāt dharma- vyavasthāsiddhaye ca avāntarapūrvamedāvaśyakatvāt kathaṃ na prayājādivat samuccayaḥ |
tadede'pi nairāpekṣyeṇa vini- yogavidhivaśāt ubhayostadadṛṣṭayoḥ ekavaiguṇyadhvaṃsajanaka-

nahi ekādaśottarīyā (11|1|5) ekasmin pradhānopakāralakhye mahākārya prayājādīnāṃ sarvaiṣā- majñānāṃ prayogavidhinā sāhityāvagamavat avāntarakārya'pi sāhityāvagamaḥ, tathātve utpattiviniyogāvagatanairāpekṣya- bādhāpatteḥ |
atastasya viniyogavākyapramitāvāntarakārya- nirūpitatvasya āvaśyakatvāt yukto vikalpaḥ |

na caiva- mapi prakṛte nairāpekṣyasya tattadavāntarapūrvarnirūpitatvenaupapatteḥ vaiguṇyadhvaṃsanirūpitatve pramāṇābhāvaḥ, tasya vaiguṇyadhvaṃsa- nirūpitatvanairāpekṣyavattvottarakāla dharmavyavasthāsiddhayarthe kalpitasya tadbādhakatvānupapatteḥ |
' 'prāyaścitteṣu caikārthyāt' (12|3|15|6) ityadhikaraṇe pāthikṛtasya vaiśvānaradvādaśakapālasya ca vikalpo vakṣyate, ekārthatvāt |
bāla. pṛ. 85. 'prāyaścitteṣu caikārthyāt' iti nyāyena eteṣāṃ naimittikānāṃ karmaṇāṃ (candrābhyudayeghyādīnāṃ) svakāle kriyamāṇadarśapūrṇeṣṭyādīnāṃ |
tacca akālopakramanimitta- doṣanirghātārthatvāt ca dvādaśādhikaraṇanyāyena vikalpyeta, iti prāpte |
bhāṭṭa. 6|5|9. prāyaścitteṣu caikārthyāttriṣannenāmisaṃyoga- stasmāt sarvatra nirghātaḥ |
'yadi ṛkto yajña ārtimimāt bhūḥ svāhā iti gārha- patye juhuyāt' ityādiṣu doṣanirghātārtheṣu prāyaścitteṣu aikārthyāt ekārthatvāt vikalpaḥ syāt |
niṣpannena doṣeṇa abhisaṃyogaḥ tasyatasya prāyaścittasya nāśakatvena bhavati iti ekārthya bhavati |
tasmāt anyatamena prāya- ścittena sarvasya doṣasya nirghātaḥ nāśo bhavati |
