bhāṣyam— vājapeye 'saptadaśa prājāpatyān paśūnā- labhate' iti śrūyate |
teṣu paśuṣu codakaprāptāḥ prokṣaṇā- dayo dharmāḥ |
dvitīyādiṣu bhavati saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ tata eva dvitīyo'pi
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? niyamakāriṇaḥ śāstrasyābhāvādaniyama iti |
yataḥ pūrva ārabdhasta eva dvitīyādayo'pi padārthā ārabdhyā iti |
sarve hi padārthāḥ pradhānakālāt vipra- kṛṣṭavyāḥ |
sahavacanaṃ hi bhavati padārthaiḥ saha pradhānaṃ kartavya- miti |
tathāpi tu yāvadvirnāvyavahitaḥ śakyaḥ padārthaḥ kartuṃ tāvadvirvyavadhānamavaśyaṃ kartavyam, tato'bhyadhikena na vyavadhāyatvamiti |
yadi dvitīyaṃ padārthamanyata ārabheta, tato'dhikerāpi vyavadhayāt |
anumatānāṃ vyavadhāyānāṃ tyāgena kaścidyathādhiko guṇo bhavatīti |
tasmādyataḥ pūrvapadārtha ārabdhasta evotta ārambhaṇīya iti |
ḍupū— 'vaiśvadevī kṛtvā prājāpatyaiścaranti' ityasmi- nkāle upādīyamānāḥ setikartavyatākāḥ itaretaryuktāḥ (vaiśvadevānantarakāle karaṇatvena upāttatvāt ) saha kāryā ityavagate kramaścintyate |
dvitīyastu (padārthaḥ) kiṃ prathamo yata ārabdhaḥ tata evārambhaṇīyaḥ uta (tatrāpi) aniyamaḥ (eva) iti (saṃśayaḥ) |
(prathamaḥ padārtho yena krameṇa kṛtaḥ sa evottareṣvapi niyamyate |
prayogavidhisamottarakālabhāvinī pravṛttiḥ kathaṃ tadvāpārasya niyantrī bhavati ityarthaḥ |
) sarve hi padārthāḥ pradhānakālāt na viprakṛṣyāḥ |
sahavacanaṃ hi padārthāḥ padārthaiḥ saha pradhānaṃ kartavyaṃ ityevaṃ vyavahito'rthasaṃbandhaḥ (kartavyaḥ |
) kathaṃ (vyavahitasaṃbandhaḥ ? ityuttaram --) pradhānakālāt na viprakṛṣyā ityasya hi sahavacanaṃ bhavati- tyupapattiḥ |
(ato yogyārthayornyaḥ anyoravyavyārtha pradhānaṃ hi cikīrṣitaṃ ityādibhāṣyaṃ avadagmabhāvī viprakarṣa ityasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyam |
) kathaṃ (padārthaiḥ saha pradhānasya vacanaṃ yāvatā 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityādi pradhāna- mātraṃ śrūyate ?) bhavantaṃ śravayedyāgeneti ( 'yajeta' ityasya arthaḥ |
) tatra yasminneva velāyāṃ svargaṃ bhavane kartṛtvaṃ pratipadyate tasminneva kṣaṇe karaṇetikartavyate api vyāpriyate |
yadi bhūtakālaṃ bhāvyam, bhaviṣyati kāle karaṇetikartavyate, tato'nayoḥ karaṇeti- kartavyatātvameva na syāt |
) bhaviṣyati bhāvye bhūte (ca) karaṇe ayameva doṣaḥ (na hi vinaṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ bhavatīti |
tatra yadi phalasya kālaḥ avagamyeta, tatastadīyena kālena karaṇetikartavyatayoḥ paricchedaḥ syāt |
iha tu svargasya anavagataḥ kālaḥ, karaṇetikartavyatayostu avagataḥ |
tataḥ pradhāne setikartavyatā ke ekasmin kṣaṇe sahakartavye prāpte, ekakarttā bahuni pradhānāni itikartavyatāṃ vā asamarthaḥ kartuṃ yaugapadyenaivamabhāvī viprakarṣaḥ |
īdṛ- śena viprakarṣeṇa kriyamāṇe api sahaiva padārthāḥ kṛtā bhavanti |
tatra pradhāna-(āsatti-) niyamena padārthāḥ prāpnuvanti āgneyādīnāṃ sakāro |
tatra śrutyarthāḥ aniyamena vā āsattiḥ sā vyāvartyate |
(na niyamamāne śrutyādīnāṃ vyāpāraḥ, na tu kramasvarūpe ityarthaḥ |

) asminśastre utkṛṣṭhaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyātavyamityāha—) avaśyambhāvine viprakarṣe pradhānaṃ hi cikīrṣitam, kṛtaṃ vā teṣāṃ nimittaṃ ityanayoḥ vyavasthāṃ (agnyādhānā- dīnāṃ kariṣyamāṇaṃ pradhānaṃ nimittam, svecchayādīnāṃ tu kṛtam |
tenaivaṃ (avaśyambhāvine viprakarṣe) ke- cit padārthāḥ kṣaṇavyavahitāḥ (pradhānena) apekṣyante, ke cid dravyābhyāṃ, ke cit vṛṃhabhiḥ |
agnyādhānādi prāgupākaraṇāt sādhāraṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ ( paśūnāṃ ) sakṛt kṛtam |
upākaraṇādayo'pi saṃnipatyopa- kārakāḥ sāhityena ( paśubhiḥ ) anubhavitāvyāḥ; saha- coditatvāt teṣām |

tadevaṃ yasya prathamamupākaraṇaṃ kriyate, tasya pāṭhena yadyapi dvitīyaḥ padārthaḥ ( niyojanarūpaḥ ) upasthāpyate, tathāpi sahavacanādimarthamākāṅkṣati, sajātīyena ṣoḍaśa- kṣaṇāvyavahitaṃ dvitīyaṃ padārtham, dvitīyastu ( paśuḥ ) pañcadaśabhipākaraṇakṣaṇaireva ca ( prathamasya paśoḥ ) niyojanakṣaṇe ( vyavahitaṃ svīyaṃ dvitīyaṃ padārtham ) evaṃ tṛtīyo'pi ( paśavaḥ ) sajātīyavijātīyavyava- hitānapekṣante |
saṃnipatyopakārakāṇāṃ īdṛśī apekṣā ( ṣoḍaśakṣaṇavyavadhānā ) pradhānānāṃ bhavati |
ata āha ( bhāṣyakāraḥ - ) yāvadbhirvyavahitaḥ śakyaḥ padārthaḥ kartuṃ tāvadbhiḥ vyavadhānamavaśyam, tato'dhikaistu na vyavadhātavya
vikalpapādakatayā anupapatteḥ agatyā vākye prāśastya- lakṣaṇayā'pi ekavākyatvāṅgīkaraṇam |
nahi tatra ‘yaja- mānaḥ prastaraḥ’ itivat ekasmin pade lakṣaṇamaṅgīkṛtya lakṣitaprāśastyasya uttarapadārthe anvayaḥ saṃbhavati |
tena yatra ekasmin pade prāśastyalakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya tasya itarapadārthānvayaṃ aṅgīkṛtya vākyārthaparyavasānaṃ tatra arthavādavidhyoḥ vākyaikavākyatā |
yatra tu na tathā sarvatra vākya eva prāśastyalakṣaṇā- maṅgīkṛtya padārthavidyayā upasthitasya vidhyākhyātārthe eva anvayāt vidhyarthavādayoḥ padaikavākyatvaiva iti yukta- mutpaśyāmaḥ |
prāśastyarūpo'rthaḥ anantaramṛṣṭaviśuddhekādaśi- tattvāt prayojanākāṅkṣāṃ śaknoti pūrayitum |
prāśitrāvadānaṃ darśādau ‘āgneyasya mastakaṃ vibhajya prāśitramadyāt’ iti sarvameva |
tatra āgneyasya mastakā- devādānam, agnīṣomīyasya mastakāt anyasādā ityaniyamaḥ |
prāśitrādibhakṣaṇaṃ gṛhamedhīye nāsti, sviṣṭa- kṛdyāgabhāgamyāṃ itareṣāṃ aṅgānāṃ parisaṃkhyātatvāt ( pañcamapūrvapakṣāmiprāyeṇa parisaṃkhyāṃ kṛtvā-cintyem ) |

savanīye paśau ‘agnimārutāduccaimanuyājaiścaranti’ iti vacanāt utkṛpyamāṇā anuyājāḥ dākṣiṇāgnikī viṣṭalepalīkaraṇahomau api tadādyatkarṣantyānyena ukta- ṣanti na veti vicāre saṃbadhadātkarṣanti iti utsūtratvena prātaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ caśabdena nirasya siddhāntayati |
prāsaṅgikaṃ paśvarthaṃ sat prapañcāt paśupurāḍāśe upakārakaṃ anuyājakarma dākṣiṇāgniko homo notkarṣet |
prāsaṅgike prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate parārthatvāt tadarthe hi vidhīyate |
agnihotre āmnāyate ‘aggaye jyotiṣmate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet yasminpraduṣṭo'hute'gnihotre udgāyet’ iti |
yadi darśārtena paurṇamāsārthena vā agnidagdhaḥ ahute iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
tasmin prāsaṅgike agnī anugate (śānte sati) prāyaścittaṃ jyotiṣmatī na vidyate na kartavyā |
parārthatvāt, tat uddharaṇaṃ parārtha darśāpūrṇa- māsārtham, na svārthe agnihotrārtham |
hi yasmāt tadarthe svārthe agnihotrārthe agnī udgate anugate prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate na parārthe |
tasmāt agnihotrārthamaduṣṭe anugate eva prāyaścittaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
prāsanaṃ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyāḥ na prayojakam, kintu pratipatti karma, kaṇḍyanaṃ tu prayojakam |
jyotiṣṭome ‘krīte some maitrāvaruṇyāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati’ iti śrutam |
dīkṣāyāṃ dīkṣitāya pradatto daṇḍaḥ somakrayo- ttaraṃ maitrāvaruṇyāya pradīyate |
tadidaṃ daṇḍapradānaṃ pratipattirvā arthakarma vā iti vicāre pūrvapakṣayati |
maitrāvaruṇyāya daṇḍapradānaṃ prati- pattiḥ syāt, tasya dīkṣāyāṃ kṛtārthatvāt |
ekatra kṛtā- rthasya dravyasya anyatra viniyogaḥ pratipattirbhavati |
yathā dīkṣitasya svāṅgadaṇḍane kṛtārthāyāḥ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāyāḥ dakṣiṇādānottaraṃ cātvāle prakṣepaḥ pratipattiḥ tadvat |

atra bhāṣye ‘maitrāvaruṇyāya daṇḍa- dānaṃ’ ityevoktaṃ na tu daṇḍapradānamiti tathāpi viṣaya- śrutau ‘prayacchati’ iti pra-upasargaprayogāt sūtre'pi pradānaśabdaprayoga eva yukto bhavati iti asyābhirāpi sūtre sarvopalabhyaḥ pradānaśabdaprayoga eva svīkṛta iti dhyeyam |
jyotiṣṭome maitrāvaruṇyāya audumbarasya daṇḍasya pradānaṃ na pratipattiḥ, kintu arthakarma |
kartā maitrāvaruṇena pradhānena guṇabhūtasya daṇḍasya saṃyogāt ‘maitrā- varuṇyāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati’ iti śrutvā saṃyogasya pratipāda- nāt |
yathā ‘khajamudrāne’ iti udgātre khajadānaṃ arthakarmaiva rājasūye tadvat |
karmayukte pretāyuvacanarūpakarmasaṃyukte eva maitrā- varuṇe ‘daṇḍī pretānavyāha’ ityanuvādavākye daṇḍasya darśanādapi daṇḍapradānaṃ arthakarma, na pratipattiḥ iti sidhyati |
nāḍīpurītadavadbrahaṇāṃ prāsādaparyaṅkanyāyena (prāsāde śete, paryaṅke śete ityatra adhikaraṇayoḥ samuccayaḥ |
) samuccaye saṃbhavati na pākṣika- bādhāpado vikalpaḥ upagantuṃ yuktaḥ (ayameva prākāra- nyāyaḥ) |

yathā eka eva devadattaḥ kālabhedena prāsādoparyevatha vasati prāsādavāsanyāyena (pā0|1|1|8) iti sūtramahābhāṣye tu mukhagrahaṇaṃ śakya- makartum, kenādanīmukhavacanānāṃ siddhirbhaviṣyatīti, prāsādavāsinyāyeneti |
tathā ca kecit prāsādavāsinaḥ, kecidbhūmivāsinaḥ, kecidubhayavāsinaḥ |

ye prāsāda- vāsino gṛhyante te prāsādavāsagrahaṇena, ye bhūmivāsino gṛhyante te bhūmivāsagrahaṇena, ye tumyavāsino gṛhyante te bhūmivāsagrahaṇena prāsādavāsagrahaṇena ca, evamapi kecit mukhavacanāḥ, kecinnāsikāvacanāḥ, kecidubhaya- vacanāḥ |
tatra ye mukhavacanā gṛhyante te mukhagrahaṇena, ye nāsikāvacanā gṛhyante te nāsikāgrahaṇena, ye tumya- vacanā gṛhyante te mukhagrahaṇena nāsikāgrahaṇena cetyuktam |
pretāmihotre ‘akṣatāt samidhaṃ dhārayan anu- dravet upari hi devebhyo dhārayati’ atra daivike haviṣi sugandhasyopari samiddhāraṇaṃ apūrvatvādadhīyate |
pretāmihotrotkarṣaḥ, na tu uparidhāraṇasya stutyartha anu- vādaḥ |
kṛtvācintyaṃ ‘sugdaṇḍe nidhāya samidhamanudravati’ iti nyāyasudhākṛ- ddhikhitavacanasadbhāvāt iti bhāṭṭa |
pretāmihotre ‘prācīnāvītī dohayet yajñopavītī hi devebhyo doha- yati’ |
atropavītamanūca prācīnāvītaṃ mṛtasya abhi- hotradohane vidhīyate, na tu anopavītasya vidhiḥ |
vi. 3|4| 4, pretāmihotre ‘ye purodadho darbhāntān dakṣiṇāgrān stṛṇīyāt’ atrotrāgratvamanūca dakṣiṇāgratvaṃ vidhīyate |
saṃbhavati preṣe loṭa: prāta:kālārthatvaṃ svīkṛtaṃ na yuktam |
preṣakartu: parasya anyasyaiva preṣārthakaraṇe adhikāra: na svasyaiva |
tasmāt preṣaṇāt kartā preṣārthakarturanya eveti siddhānta: |
tatra preṣa: samāmnāta: 'prokṣaṇī- rāsādaya, idhmābarhi rūpasādaya, suvaṃ ca sucaśca saṃmṛḍḍhi, patnīṃ saṃnahya''jyenodehi' iti |
tatra saṃdeha: kiṃ ya eva preṣe sa eva preṣārthe uta anya: iti |
prāsaṅgikaṃ samāpyedānīṃ prakṛta eva samākhyāyā liṅgena virodha- śrūyate |
'prokṣaṇīrāsādaya' ityādipreṣa- mantrasya prokṣaṇāsādanādirūpasya preṣārthasya samākhyāyā adhvaryukartṛkatvameva gamyate |
na ca ātmani preṣasaṃbhavena preṣarūpaliṅgavirodhāt ādhva- ryavasamākhyāvācyena bhinnakartṛkatvamiti vācyam |
yato naivāyaṃ preṣa:, kiṃ tarhi ? prāta:kālatāyāmayaṃ loṭpratyaya: |
tata: 'prokṣaṇīrāsādaya' iti prokṣaṇyāsādanarūpāyā: prāptakāla ityartho bhavati |
tathā ca sati eka evādhvaryu: prāptakālatāṃ nirdiśya prokṣaṇyāsādanaṃ kariṣyati |
bhavatu preṣārthatvam, tasyāpyeka evādhvaryu: śarīriśarīro- rayāntaratvāt medamāśritya preṣaka: preṣaśca bhaviṣyatīti ekakartṛkatvameveti |
sa cāntarbhāvitayuṣmadarthatvātpuro- vartitṛtīyaviṣaya eva paraṃ bhavati |
na ca tatra yuṣmadartha: kathaṃcidapi saṃbhavati, asannidhānāt acetanatvācca |
na ca prāptakāla iti kriyāyā nirdeśa: saṃbhavet |
tena prāptakālateyaṃ prathama- puruṣa eva kathaṃcit saṃbhavati, na tu madhyamottamapuruṣayo: saṃbhavati |
yattu śarīriśarīra- yorantaritrāṇāṃ cāmede sati ekasyaiva preṣakatvaṃ preṣyatvaṃ ca bhaviṣyatītyuktam, tadayuktam, praiṣasyādyarthatva- prasaṅgāt |
śrutivirodhe mukhyārthatvameva mantrāṇāṃ na gauṇatvamityavadhāritaṃ guṇamukhyādhikaraṇe |
tasmādevamapi naikakartṛkatvaṃ preṣamaiṣārthayo:, kintu bhinnakartṛkatvameveti siddham |
sūtraṃ tu preṣeṣu ya: kartā tato'nya: praipārtha: preṣasya svabhāvato'nyaviṣayatvāditi |
somayāge'pyāpi 'yaja' iti śabda: 'preṣeṣu ca parādhikārāt' ityevaṃ nivartamāna: maitrāvaruṇasyaiva |

vāgbisargapūrvapakṣavādamedite 'uttiṣṭha- nyāha agnīdanī vihara' ityasya mantrasya preṣatvābhāvena abhidhiraṇāde: 'preṣeṣu parādhikārāt' iti nyāya- viṣayatvābhāvāt āgnīdhrakartṛkatvānupapatti: ; samākhyāyā ādhvaryavatvāt |
ṛtugrahe 'hotā yasdindra hotrāt' ityādīn 'hota- ryaja' ityantān praiṣān āmanāya 'preṣaṇa yajanti' iti āgamāt |

tatrāpi yathāsamāmnātasyaiva mantratvena pradānābhyo: yeṣyājāmaheṣaṭakārayo: ṛgāmnātamāṇayo- riva yojanayā prayoge prāpte, 'hotā yakṣat' 'hota- ryaja' ityaṃśayorananvitatvena tāvanmūlya tatsyāne tayo- ryogena prayoga: |
mīko. pṛ. 2054 'darśapūrṇamāsayo: preṣa- praiṣārthau' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
asti jyotiṣṭome paśurgromīya: 'yo dīkṣito yadagnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatredamamananti- 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇa: preṣyati cānvāha' 'cānu cāha' iti bhāṣyādau pāṭha: iti |
tatra saṃśaya: kiṃ sarvānuvacaneṣu preṣeṣu ca maitrāvaruṇa: syāt uta yatrānuvacanaṃ tatra preṣa: iti |
sāmānyasamākhyāyā viśeṣasamākhyāyā bādhe nirūpite idānīṃ yatra vacanena sāmānyasamākhyāyā bādha: sa kiṃ sarvaviṣaya: uta ekadeśaviṣaya: iti prakṣajñā- rūpyate |
evaṃ ca sati preṣeṣu vacanāni tānyabhyakartṛ- kāṇi prāpnuvanti |
viśeṣaṇa ca preṣe vacatata upadeśena maitrāvaruṇopādānaṃ prīyate |
tatra yadyapi 'preṣyati cānvāha' iti caśabdātsamuccayo'vagamyate, tathāpi uddeśa- gatatvena avivakṣitatvāt sakalapraiṣānuvacanāmādeśenaiva maitrāvaruṇe vidhīyate iti |
tatsanidhau ca 'maitrāvaruṇa: preṣyati cānvāha' iti śrūyamāṇaṃ apekṣitavidhānāt saṃnihitaviṣayamavadhāryate |
kiñca sācaryavaśādapi yatraivāpekṣitaṃ tatra maitrāvaruṇa- vidhānamucitam |
'maitrāvaruṇa: preṣyati cānvāha' ityatra sahacarita eva praiṣānuvacana: pratīyate, puronuvākyā ca tayo: sācaryamavagamyate |
tena maitrāvaruṇavidherna kevalavacanameveti na sarvatra sāmānya- samākhyāyā iti siddham |
sūtraṃ tu puronuvākyā- sveva maitrāvaruṇavidhi: sapreṣānuvacanatvena tāsāmeva saṃni- dhānāt |
praiṣaśca anuvacanaṃ ca teṣāṃ samā- hāra: praiṣānuvacanam |
kuta: ? 'maitrāvaruṇa: preṣyati ca anu cāha' iti tasya upadeśāt |
vākye cakārī uddeśyagatatvāt avivakṣito, tena praiṣānuvacanayo: samuccayo na vivakṣita: |
yatra praiṣaśca anuvākyā ca saha ucyate tatra maitrāvaruṇa: |
yatra kevalānuvākyā kevalo vā preṣa: tatra na maitrāvaruṇa: |
puronuvākyā'dhikāra eva maitrā- varuṇasya kasmāt ? praipasaṃnidhānāt 'maitrāvaruṇa: preṣyati cānu cāha' iti vidhau anuvākyāyā: praiṣasya saṃni- dhānāt |
tasmāt yatra praipasaṃnihitā anuvākyā tatraiva maitrāvaruṇa iti jñāyate |
atra kutūhalam-- kevalānuvacaneṣu hautrasamākhyā hotā prāpta: |
ubhayātmakeṣu tu 'hotā yakṣat' ityā- diṣu mantratvena kartṛmedāsaṃbhavāt adhvaryo: hotṛśva pravṛttatvāt apekṣitakartṛviśeṣatvena maitrāvaruṇa vidhi: ; iti |
kuta: ? prātaranuvāke kevalānu- vacanatvameke hotureva kartu: darśanāt |
'yatra hotṛ: prātaranuvākanuvata upaśṛṇuyāt tatrādhvaryurhīyāt (apa: )' iti prātaranuvāke hotāraṃ darśayati |
agnīpomīye paśau praiṣānuvacanayoḥ samuccitayoḥ maitrāvaruṇaḥ kartā ||
bhāṣyam— asti jyotiṣṭome paśurbhīpomīyaḥ 'yo dīkṣato yadagnīpomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatredaṃ samāmananti, 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cāha' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ sarvānuvacaneṣu sarveṣveṣu ca maitrāvaruṇaḥ syāt uta yatrānuvacane praiṣaḥ iti |
na hi kaścit viśeṣa āśrīyate, asminnanuvacane maitrāvaruṇaḥ asminneti |
tasmāt sarvānuvacaneṣu sarveṣveṣu ca maitrāvaruṇaḥ syāt |
vā— upadeśāt siddhe samākhyābādhe samastaikadeśaviṣayatvena vicāraḥ |
jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe eva etat śrūyate 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cāha' iti |
tat kim tenopadeśena samastaviṣayaḥ ? samākhyāyorbādhaḥ, uta kaścideveti |

kiṃ prāptam ? praiṣānuvacanena maitrāvaruṇopādānāt uddiśyamānasyaiva śabdapratipāditasāhityavivakṣā-nupapatteḥ śrayamāṇaśca śabdaḥ samuccayamātraṃ pratipādayati netaretarayogasamāhārau, nityaṃ samāsamagatatvāt |
na ceha anvācayalakṣaṇaṃ ubhayostulyatvāt upapadyate, iti samuccayaḥ |
sa ca pṛthagapi sarveṣu anuṣṭhīyamāneṣu saṃbhavatyeva iti sāmānyavacanāt sarvapraiṣatvam |
kutaḥ ? yatra praiṣānuvākyā ca sahocyete tatra maitrāvaruṇaḥ |
yatra vā kevalaḥ praiṣaḥ tatrāpi na |
tathāhi samuccitayoḥ taṃ samāmananti, 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu cāha' iti |
tāśca tādṛśyo hautre eva paṭhitāḥ iti tasyaiva kevalasya prāpnuvanti |
yastu tāsāmante yaja iti śabdaḥ sa iṣṭaprakṛtiṣu tāvat agneṣu atideśena adhvaryoḥ prāpnoti |
athavā preṣakasya ubhaya kartṛtayā vakṣyamāṇanyāyena preṣyatvaṃ maitrāvaruṇa-varuṇasya kalpayitvā hotureva prāpnoti |
tathā adhvaryoḥ 'preṣya' iti praiṣāntarāmnānāt 'yaja' ityeṣa nivarta-mānaḥ pratiprasthātuḥ prāpnoti |
śeṣāṇi tu praiṣānuvacanāni nivartakatvaviśeṣatvāt nirākāṅkṣatvena iti na teṣu maitrāvaruṇavidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
puronuvākyānāṃ punaḥ ubhayāṃśapātitvāt ekapadārthatvena ca nānākartṛtvānāpatteḥ hoturarthośca pracayamānānāṃ sākāṅkṣatvāt saṃnidhānācca yukto maitrāvaruṇavidhiḥ |
evaṃ caśabdo'pi sahaprayogā-dapi prakṛtyarthaḥ samarthito bhavati, praiṣasannidhānāt |
na ca 'preṣya' ityādayo'pi praiṣāḥ tasyaiva ātma-viṣayāḥ saṃbhavanti |
bhāṣyam— itaśca paśyāma na sarvānuvacaneṣu maitrā-varuṇaḥ iti |
katham ? yatra hotṛḥ prātaranuvākamanubhavata upaśṛṇuyāt tadādhvaryūgṛhṇīyāt iti |
soma— sūtrārthastu- sarve praiṣāḥ sarvānuvacanāni ca maitrāvaruṇasya kartavyāni syuḥ upadeśāt iti |
4|2|24-25. praiṣapraiṣārthau tu viparyayeṇāsnātau viparyayeṇa kartavyau (iti āryaḥ kramaḥ) |
thāla. pṛ. 59. praiṣamantre dvivahupalīke darśapūrṇamāsaprayoge patnīśabde ūho na |
praiṣagādhādhikaraṇanyāyāt (3|8|1|123) ṛtvijeṣu 'indraṃ hotāt' ityādaya eva mantrā bhavanti |
saṃkarṣa. 3|4|11. prokṣaṇaṃ agnivacane 'hiraṇyakalaśahastenāmi prokṣati' 'daśā madhumiśreṇāmi prokṣati' iti |
taṃca prokṣaṇaṃ na pratīkaṃ kintu sakṛdeva, ame- rektvāt |
9|1|8. prokṣaṇaṃ anavahanirapi yaḥ tatkāyaṃpraḥ tatra bhavatyeva, yathā nakhanirminne carī nakhepu prokṣaṇaṃ bhavati |
bhā. 9|1|2 pṛ. 1645, prokṣaṇaṃ avahananaṃ nirvapaṇaṃ.ityādayaḥ auṣadhadharmāḥ |
5|1|12-3. prokṣaṇaṃ kiṃ hantipiṣṭayukaṃ uta apūrvaprayuktaṃ iti (saṃśayaḥ) |
vākyāt hantipiṣṭayarthaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ, prakaraṇādapūrvārtham, vākyaṃ ca prakaraṇāt balīyaḥ |
prakaraṇapāṭhāt taṇḍulanirvṛttiṇā śakyama- pūrvaṃ lakṣayitum, śakyate ca brīhyarthaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ pratipattum |
tatra lakṣitalakṣaṇāyāṃ yakṣamāṇāyāṃ phalakalpanā na bhavati |
tasmāt phalakalpanāmāt lakṣitalakṣaṇāyāṃpadārthaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ṭup. prokṣaṇaṃ jyotiṣṭome agnīṣomīyam 'adabhyastvauṣadhībhyo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi iti paśuṃ prokṣati' iti |
prokṣaṇaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ na dravyaprayuktam (na brīhi- svarūpaprayuktaṃ), kintu apūrvaprayuktam |
9|1|11-19, prokṣaṇaṃ prākṛtolūlamusaladharmaḥ rājasūye nairṛte carau nakhepu bhavati |
ṭup. 10|1|3|5. prokṣaṇasya svarṇaṃ prayojakaḥ agnīṣomīye paśau |
4|2|11-6. sāṃnāyyapātraprokṣaṇasya ahaṃ 'śugadhvaṃ daivāya karmaṇe' iti mantraḥ |
vi. 3|3|5. prokṣaṇe mantraḥ adhvaryupratipattāmya medena prayoktavyaḥ, na tantram |
bhā. 12|1|2|18. prokṣaṇādi ādityavahirhiṣi kṛtaṃ sat upasatsu agnīṣomīye ca prasaṅgasiddhaṃ pratikarma na kartavyam |
bhā. 12|1|19|43-44. prokṣaṇādayo dharmāḥ śruti- viniyuktāḥ: apūrvaprayuktāḥ, na tu dravyasarvasamudāya- prayuktāḥ |
mā. 9|1|2| 40. prokṣaṇādīnāṃ pauroḍāśikānāṃ saumikapadārthebhyaḥ pūrvabhāvitvaṃ jyotiṣṭomamukhyānām |
5|1|25-26. mīko. pṛ. 1794 'jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikāḥ prokṣaṇādayaḥ' ityatra dravyam |
11|4|15-50. prokṣaṇasyaḥ iti upasargadhātupratyayasamudāyasya jāti- nimittatā prayogadātnumīyate |
sevanasaṃyogāt upasarga- dhātukaraṇapratyayasahitaḥ ap pravarttate iti (prokṣaṇībhiḥ udejitāḥ sa iti) prasiddhiranugṛhītā bhaviṣyati |
bhā. 11|4|18|19. 'prokṣaṇīrāsādaya' iti prokṣaṇīśabdaḥ yaugikaḥ, na saṃskāranimittaḥ, nāpi jātinimittaḥ |
11|4|18|19. prokṣaṇīrāsādaya, idmābarhirupasādaya 0.' ityādiḥ praiṣaḥ ādhvaryavaṃ karma |
vi. 3|8|123. prokṣaṇībhiḥ udejitāḥ sa iti asaṃskṛtāsvapsu kasiṃściddeśe pravaktāro bhavanti |
'prokṣaṇīrāsādaya' ityādipraiṣamantre prokṣaṇīśabdaḥ kiṃ saṃskāranimittaḥ uta jātinimittaḥ kiṃvā yaugikaḥ iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
prokṣaṇīṣu apsu kevalasu prokṣaṇīśabdaḥ yaugikaḥ syāt |
prokṣyate ābhiḥ iti prokṣyaḥ iti yogaḥ |
yenayena sevanaṃ kriyate sā sarvā prokṣaṇī |
tasmāt prokṣaṇī- śabdo yaugikaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'prokṣaṇīrāsādaya' iti prokṣaṇīśabdaṃ prati saṃdehaḥ; saṃskāraśabdo jātinimittau yaugiko vā iti |
prayujyate tāvat keṣu ciddeśaviśeṣeṣu asaṃ- skṛtāsvapnu |
taduktaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa 'prokṣaṇībhirudejitāḥ saḥ iti kasiṃściddeśe bhavanti vakāraḥ ' iti (pṛ. 344) |
prakarṣeṇa ucyate anena ityasya yogasya ghṛtamṛdādisādhāraṇyena jalajāti- vinigamanābhāvāt |
tatraiva hi sā kalpyate, yatrāvayavārthānusāreṇa prayogo dṛśyate, yathā vṛkṣaviśeṣe aśvakarṇaśabdasya |
ataḥ samudāyaśakteḥ aklṛptatvāt klṛptāvayava- śaktidvāreṇaiva ca prayogopapatteḥ prokṣaṇīśabdasya yaugi- katvameva |
vyutpannāt prapūrvakāt uhyate'rthoḥ- secanasamarthaṃ dravadravyamātramevāvagamyate, bahuvacanastrīliṅga- vaśāttu āpa eva śabdārthaḥ iti nidhīyate |
prayojanam- vikṛtau yatra śrūyate 'ghṛtaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ bhavati' iti 'prokṣaṇīrāsādaya' iti ca praiṣaḥ ati- deśaprāptaḥ, tatra yadi saṃskāravacanatvaṃ tadā 'prokṣaṇī- rāsādaya' ityavikṛtasya prayogaḥ |
aya jātivacanatvam, tadā uhena 'ghṛtamāsādaya' iti prayogaḥ |
siddhānte tu yaugikatvena vācyaliṅgatvāt ghṛtasya napuṃsakaliṅgatvena 'prokṣaṇamāsādaya' iti prayogaḥ |
sūtraṃ tu prokṣaṇīṣu yaugikatvaṃ arthasaṃyogāt ava- yavārthasaṃyogādityarthaḥ |
tatra prokṣaṇīśabdaṃ prati saṃdehaḥ; kiṃ saṃskāranimitta uta jātinimitta uta yaugikaḥ iti |
tatra saṃskāreṣu satsu darśanāt saṃskāraśabdatāyāmavagamyamānāyāmasaṃskṛte śabda- lāmājjātiśabdaḥ |
asaṃskṛtāsvapnu prokṣaṇībhirudejitāḥ saḥ iti kasiṃściddeśe bhavanti vakāraḥ |
tena jātiśabdaḥ iti prāpte, yaugika ityucyate |
sevanasaṃyogāt tupasargadhātupratyaya- sahito'p pravarttata iti prasiddhiranugṛhītā bhaviṣyati |
yadā'nyadapi secanaṃ prokṣaṇadyenocyate tadā tadyogā- devapsu bhaviṣyatīti na samudāyārthaḥ kalpituṃ śakyate |
yasmin deyanidhye karmaṇyasya kāryatā tat nimittam |
(1 yasmin nitye karmaṇe'sya kāryatā tat nimittam |
deśasyāpi 'dakṣiṇe tīreṇa sarasvatyā āgneyādha kapālena' 'śamyāprāsamīyāt' ityādi |
atra ca yadyapya- tithyādivat yaliśravaṇaṃ nāsti, tathāpi dravyadevatāsaṃba- ndhasya yajamānavyatirekeṇaparyavasānādagnihotrāditva- tvameva iti karmāntaratvameva |
nimittasyāpi 'sannāyābagyai viśvajitā yajeta' 'sāmyathāne viśvajit' ityādi pūrvādhikaraṇa eva draṣṭavyam |
maivam, adhi- hotre khalu juhotītyādyetana nāmadheyam |
nāmadheyaṃ ca tatparatantratvān pūrvakarmotpattipakṣa- miti karmāntaratvam |

iha tu pūrvādhikaraṇasya karmaṇe dravya- devatāsaṃbandhenopasthāpitatvāt tadeva karmaphalasya kāmya- mānatvena upādeyasya ca prāptatvenāvidheyatve'pi tasmin vidhīyamānaṃ karma na micyate iti vaiṣamyam |

evaṃ 'maitrāta- vīyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' ityatrāpi 'māsaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ yajeta' ityitat yajaśravaṇāt maitrāvīyā- nāmastatvarantatvābhāvāt pūrvasiddhasya sthānasthitatvedhā- tavīyopasthāpakatvameva |
tathāca prakaraṇa bādhitvā vākyena pūrvasiddhaiva maitrāvīyā saṃskārabhūtā yajamānasaṃskāratve- naiva dīkṣaṇīyā ... ('kārya' iti truṭitaṃ kalpyate ) vidhīyate |
kiṃ tarhi ? kriyāyā eva tadartha- mutpādanamiti tadapekṣamanupādeyatvameva |

na caikastaiva yajipadasya pūrvopasthāpane phale viniyoge caikadā karaṇatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti phalasamabhivyāhṛta karmaṇaḥ śrutasyevānumitasyāpi agnihotrāditvat anupādeyaṃ pratyu- pādāna.śabdābhyāṃ karmāntarameva iti |
nanu 'maitrāvīyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' ityatra na yajiḥ śrūyate |
nāpi dravyadevatāsaṃbandhenānumīyate, tadabhāvāt maitrāvīyā- padasya ākhyātaparatantratvābhāvāt atirātrādivat vākyavat pūrvakamopasthāpakatvamanāhyatameveti kathaṃ karmāntaratvam |
syādevaṃ yadi sakṛduccaritamaitrāvīyāpadaṃ pūrva- karmopasthāpanaṃ kāryantare ca viniyogaṃ kartumutsahete |
tadatra kāryāntaraviniyogasya āvaśyakatvāt anapekṣitapūrvakamopa- sthāpanaṃ karmāntarameva viniyuktam |
etacca 'sāmyathāne viśvajit' ityatrāpi samānamiti siddhamatrāpi prakaraṇāttarādeva karmabheda iti |
prayojanam - pūrvapakṣe darśapūrṇamāsaprayuktatva apavarga- saṃbandhadvayemeva phalāntaramiti na pṛthaganuṣṭhānam |
siddhānte sūtraṃ tu akarmasannidhau śrūyamāṇaṃ phalaṃ karmabhedaṃ karotī- tyarthaḥ |
sūtrārthaḥ--- yasmin svargadau anubhūyamāne puruṣasya prītiḥ tṛptirbhavati, tasya lipsā arthalakṣaṇā svābhāvikī iti yāvat |
vi--- 'phalaṃ vidheyaṃ no vā, SSyo bhāvanāśa- stato'nyavat |
na bhāgyāṃśo vidheyaḥ syāt rāgāt tatra pravartanā ||
yadi tu viśiṣṭa- bhāvanāvidhī arthāditādaśayorvidhīyate tata phalasyāpya- viśiṣṭam |
iti prāpte, viśiṣṭabhāvanāvidhāne ārthika- viśeṣaṇavidherāvaśyakatvāt, tasya ca yadaṃśe aprāpti- stadaṃśe eva kalpanāt, phalasya ca rāgāptatvena tatkalpane pramāṇābhāvādidheyatvam |
siddhānte tu rāgaprāptatvāt 'na hiṃsyāt' iti niṣedhaviṣayatvam |
na ca hiṃsāśabdasya maraṇānukūlavyāpāravācitvāt, tasya ca vairimāraṇavyābhicāraphalakatvenarūpasya vihitatvāt kathaṃ niṣedhaviṣayatvamiti vācyam |

'abhicaran yajeta' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyatayā śyenasamānakartṛkatvāvateḥ : abhi- cārapadasya maraṇānukūlyenakartṛniṣedhanādādidurupapāyāra- vācitvāgatasyaiva śyenaphalatvāvācāyāt, rāgaprāptasya iti cāvaśyaṃ śyenana vivadanāttu- taccitena vairimāraṇam, na tu śyenanaiva sākṣāditi dhyeyam |

yattu vairiniṣṭho maraṇākūlavyāpāra evābhicāra- padārthaḥ, tatra ca yajamānasya prayojakakartṛttvamiti tasya niṣedhaviṣayatve'pi yajamānasya pāpatvamiti kena ciduktam, tacca śyenasyaiva prayojakavyāpāratvāt, tasya ca vihitatvāt tatkartṛttvena yajamāne pāpatvanupapatte- kṣitam |
yatra tu 'vairimāraṇako yajeta' iti śrutam, tatra vairimāraṇānukūlakartṛlaukikavyāpārābhāve'pi vairi- maraṇoparādanicchittatvādeva pāpamiti dhyeyam |
anārabhya śrūyate 'āgneyadhaḥkāla nirvapet rukkāmaḥ' 'aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet paśukāmaḥ' |
atra prākṛteṣu āgneyādiṣu phalaviśeṣo vidhīyate iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntāmāha |
akarmasannidhau prākṛteyādipharma- sannidhāye prakaraṇāntara śrūyamāṇaṃ phalaṃ karmabhedakaṃ bhavati |
anuvāde sati na śakyate phalaṃ vidhātum |
tatrāpi saṃskārasya yajamānasya saṃskārārthā dhaidhātavīyā karmāntarameva |
ke, ❀ agnihotravākyaṃ hi kevalaguṇavidhiḥ iti pakṣe eva paraṃ 'sāyaṃ juhoti' 'prātaṃ juhoti' iti vākyayoḥ anupādeyakālasaṃbandhāt karmavidhisaṃbhavaḥ; na tu agnihotra- vākyaṃ karmavidhiḥ |
tadā 'sāyaṃ juhoti' 'prātaṃ juhoti' ityanayoḥ satyapi anupādeyakālasaṃbandhe na karmāntaravidhāyakatvaṃ 'phalaṃ cākarmasannidhau' iti nyāyasya karmabhedaprayojakatvāt |
soma. 4|1|4 pṛ. 64. anupādeyatve 'phalaṃ cākarmasannidhau' iti nyāyena karmāntaravidhaiva syāt nāmyāsavadhiḥ |
❀ 'phalaṃ tu tatpradhānāyām' (4|3|13) iti ca kāmapadopabaddhāyāṃ (codanāyāṃ) tadarthatvaṃ (kāmārthatvaṃ) vakṣyate |
vā. 3|4|15 pṛ. 946, avaghātādideva 'phalaṃ tu saha ceṣṭayā (śabdārtho- 'bhāvād viprayoge syāt |
3|1|8|17. phalaṃ deśaḥ kālaḥ nimittaṃ saṃskārya ityanupādeyaprakam |
yasmin prītiḥ puruṣasya tasya lipsā'rtha- lakṣaṇā'vibhāgāt |
śā--- (vicāraśāstre lakṣaṇakathaṃ nātyantasaṃgataṃ ityanuśayena bhāṣyānuktamapi varṇāntaramāha - ) athavā, phalāṃśasya kiṃ vidhiḥ ? prayojakaṃ veti cintyate |
vidheya- bhāvanāviśeṣaṇatvāt karaṇāditvat phalasyāpi vidheyatva- śaṅkā |
soma--- prayojanam- pūrvapakṣe śyenayāgaphalasyā- bhicārasya hiṃsātmakasya vidheyatvena tatra 'na hiṃsyāt' iti niṣedhāpravṛttiḥ |
phalārthatvāt iti pāṭhe tu karmaṇaḥ vidhāyakaṃ |
phala prati karmaṇo śeṣa iti jaiminiḥ |
4|1|2|2 varṇakaṃ 2. phala 'bhadra' iti mantroktaṃ abhyudya- yajamānomayagāmi jyotiṣṭome uparaveṣu |
vi. 4|1|6. uddiśyamānaṃ hi sarvatra phalaṃ bhavati |
karmotkarakāle ca bhavati, tat tena karmaṇā bhāvyate |
svidyat: pratipāditatvāt atrāpyekādaśānāṃ avayavānāṃ 'nyagrodhe: svidyakṛtaṃ yajati' ityādiṣu vyaṅgyādi |
na ca pūrva- madhye vai: kaiścittribhirihairiteṣve: svidyakṛta: kartavya pakṣe phalacamasa: kṛtaprayojana: |

nāpi prayojanārthāpadāna- iti pūrvapakṣayitvā, yāgasaṃbandhāpekṣasya trilasya aṅgai: nāntarīyakopādāna iti pratipattyapekṣābhāvānna pratipatti- saha samāsāsambhavādekādaśāt madhye trayāṇāṃ avāntara- saṃvandho ghaṭate |
vyaṅgyasya tu paśuyāgārthopapattaśca nāntarīya- sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ nirdhārayitumasamarthena yāgaśeṣāṇāmupādā- kopādānasya ākīrṇakaraṇatvena pratipattyapekṣāyā vacanābhāve nam |
kiṃ tarhi ? 'doṣṇo dakṣiṇasya pūrvādhārddhamadhye sama- puruṣabhedāccātra kācit pratipattirbhavet |
vacanasadbhāve vayati, guḍasya madhyataḥ, śroṇyā jaghanataḥ' ityekenāpyu- tu yathāvacanameva pratipattirbhavati |
tairaiva viśeṣai: svidya- bhakṣaṇasaṃbandhānyathānupapattyā phalacamasasya somavat avaśyaṃ kṛyāga: kartavya iti siddhāntitam |
tatrāpi 'sa yadi somaṃ trima- vikāra:, tathā ihāpi ijyāśeṣāṇāmanijyāśerai: vikāra kṣayiṣyeta ' iti yajamānasaṃbandhibhakṣaṇakīrtanāt yāvat ( 10|1|311 ) iti |
ato'śrāpyanyathāśeṣeṇa phala- vyaṅgyeḍanupayujyamāno yajamānabhakṣaṇasaṃskāra: pratipadyeta, camasenejyāśeṣasya somasya vikāro na cirotsṛṣṭe |
evaṃ tāvataiva yajñabhāganārthapatyā saṃtratva iti yajamānacamasa ca sati utpattiṣṭa: soma: pradhānakarmaṇi yāge bādhito eva somaṃ vikaroti, na grahaṇamasāntareṇeti sthitam |
'na somam' iti arthaprāptabhakṣaṇagata- naimittikatvādviśeṣasomaprāpto'pi na doṣa: |
evaṃ ca somanighṛttyanuvādena bādhāt atrāpyupapadyate iti |
sati krayābhivādisaṃskṛtanaitavya yajamānasya pāde prati- pādanīyam |

evaṃ 'yadi somaṃ na vindet pūtīkānabhiṣuṇu- ye tvādupakārakaṃ phalacamasasādhanaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ vidhīyata yāt ' ityatrāpi somābhāve somasaṃbandhino'mipavasvarūpa- iti pūrvapakṣayanti, taiśca pūrvapakṣavārtikākṣarāṇi anākali- saṃskārasya pūtīkeṣu darśanāt pūtīkānāṃ yāgasādhanatvamete- tāni |
na cāyaṃ pakṣo yuktasyāpi saṃgacchate, anekadoṣa- naiva nyāyenāvagantavyam |
tathāhi, phalacamasantaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ pracchedāti viniyogabhaṅgi (?) na bhakṣaṇaṃ kuryāditi |
tathā soma- prayojanam - pūrvapakṣe yajamānasya camase'pi bhakṣaṇasya phalacamasenātulyakāryatvena anivartitatvāt somametanna yaṣṭavyam |
siddhānte somiti nāyamarthaprāptānuvāda:, niṣedhaparatve ca vākya- tu phalacamaseneva yaṣṭavyam |
vihitasomabhakṣaṇapratiṣedhācca aṣṭadoṣaduṣṭavikalpā- somasya vikāreṇa bhakṣaṇamātra saṃskārasya bhakṣaṇarūpasya patti: |
siddhāntasamaye pakṣavikalpamātreṇa yaccintyate tadevātra tai: pūrvapakṣīkṛtaṃ ityapekṣaṇīyameveti |
tasmāt bhakṣaṇaśruti- phalacamaso naimittiko bhakṣavikāra: śruti- saṃyogāt rājanyavaiśyanimittaka: phalacamaso bhakṣavikāra saṃyogāt |
bhavedevaṃ yadi pūrvapakṣe phalacamasa: jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'sa (adhvaryu:) yadi rājanyaṃ pratipattisaṃbandhāt bhavet |

dvividhaṃ hi dravyamākīrṇakaramiti vaiśyaṃ vā yājayet, sa (rājanyo vaiśyo vā) yadi somaṃ pratipattimepekṣate, kṛtaprayojanatvāt yathā somarasa: puro- vibhakṣayiṣyet nyagrodhastīmarāhatya tā: saṃpiṣya dadhanyu- ḍāśo vā, prayojanārthāpadānanāntarīyakopādānatvāt yathā nyujya tamasai bhakṣaṃ pracchet na somam' iti |
anena vākyena rājanyasya vaiśyasya vā phalacamasa ukta: |

) sa kiṃ bhakṣavikāra: uta ijyāvikāra:, ṛtvijāmiva rājanyavaiśyayajamānasyāpi prāptasya bhakṣya kiṃ phalacamasaṃ bhakṣayedityartha: uta phalacamasena yajeta ya: siddho niṣedha: tasyānuvāda: kuto dṛśyate |
tadidaṃ ityartha: iti saṃdehe pūrvapakṣamāha sūtram |
asmāt liṅga- rājanyena vaiśyena vā nimittena nirvṛtta: phalacamasa: darśanācca somasyeva phalacamasasyāpi yāgārthatvaṃ sidhyati |
vibhakṣayiṣet iti tasmāt ijyāvikāra: phalacamaso na bhakṣavikāra: |
ke. bhakṣaśrutisaṃyogāt, 'tamasai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet' iti ca phalacamasa: rājanyasya vaiśyasya ca jyotiṣṭome, na bhakṣapadaśrutisaṃyogāt |
'sa yadi rājanyaṃ vā vaiśyaṃ vā yājayet ijyādhikāro vā saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt |
sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayiṣet, nyagrodhastīmarāhatya tā: siddhāntapratipādanārthaṃ sūtram |
vāśabda: bhakṣavikāra- saṃpiṣya dadhani unmṛjya tamasai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet somam' tnivṛttyartha: |
saṃskārasya krayābhivādi- brāhmaṇe -- audumbarāṇi āśratthāni plākṣāṇi ca saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt yāgārthatvāt |
somacamaseṣu tathā phalāni 'etāni asya (kṣatriyāderye) purastāt darśanāt |
( somakrayāt prāgeva ) upahastāni bhavanti, atha homāt |

somaṃ rājānaṃ krīṇanti, te ( ṛtvija: ) rāja eva jyotiṣṭome rājanyasya vaiśyasya vā yajamānasya sataḥ āvṛtā ( somasya eva paddhatyā ) aupavasathāt ( dināt yajamānacamasa: nyagrodhaphalacamaso bhavati na somacamasa: |
pūrvaṃ ) prativeśaiśvaranti ( pūjāṃ naivedyasamarpaṇaṃ ca kurvanti ) |
sa cāyaṃ phalacamaso yāgārtha eva vidhīyate, bhakṣastu 3|6|16|4 |
'tadyatra etān ( somasya ) camasān śeṣasya vākyāntareṇa prāpta: syāt iti siddhānte hetva- unnayeyu: tadetaṃ yajamānacamasaṃ unnayet, tasmin ntaraṃ vaktuṃ sūtramidam |

'yadā anyāncamasān juhvati, ( phalacamase ) dve darbhataruṇake ( dvau dṛḍhau darbhau ) prāpte athaitasya darbhataruṇakena upahṛtya juhoti' iti homāt syātām ( ekaṃ prāsta tato dvitīyaṃ iti rītyā ) tayo: homasya uktatvāt yāgavikāra eva phalacamasa: |
( madhye ) vapaṭkṛte antaḥparidhi pūrva ( prāstaṃ darbhaṃ ) camasaiśca tulyakālatvāt |
( prāsvet ' dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ ' ityetayā ṛcā siddhānte hetvantaraṃ vaktuṃ sūtramidam |
'yadā anyān- sasvāhākārayā, anuvaṣaṭkṛte aparaṃ ( camase paścāt prāstaṃ camasān unnayanti athainaṃ camasamunnayati' iti vacanena darbhe ) ' ā dadhikrāvṇa: śavasā pañca kṛṣṭī: ' iti |
'tadyatraitān camasān ( somamasān bhakṣārtha ) somacamānāṃ unnayanaṃ kriyate tadaiva phalacamasasyāpi āhareyu:; tadetaṃ yajamānacamasamāharet, tān yatra ud- unnayanamuktam |
unnayanaṃ nāma anyāpātrasthitāt soma- gṛhṇīya: tadetaṃ upodgṛhṇīyāt |
tadyadā iḻāṃ hotā upa- rasasya piṣṭānāṃ dadhimiśritānāṃ nyagrodhaphalānāṃ ca camase hayeta yadā camasaṃ bhakṣayet ( hotā somacamasaṃ, ) atha homārthaṃ grahaṇam |
tulya- enaṃ ( phalacamasaṃ yajamāna: ) etāṃ bhakṣayet ' ' yadatra kālo yasya sa tulyakāla: phalacamasa: |
tasya bhāva: ; śiṣṭaṃ rasa: sutasya yadindro apivacchucīmima: |
tadasya manasā śivena somaṃ rājānamiha bhakṣayāmi ' iti |
'śaṃ na edhi hṛde pīta: pra ṇa āyu- siddhānte hetvantaraṃ vaktuṃ sūtramidam |
'tamasai bhakṣaṃ jīrvase sametu te; iti āratamana: pratyabhibharśa: |
prayacchet na somam' iti vākye yāgārthasya sa: somasya 'āpyāyasva sametu te, saṃ te payāṃsi samyantu vājā: :

‘tatraitan camasān sādayeyuḥ, tadetaṃ yajamānacamasaṃ sādayet, tān yatra prakalpayet; tadenamanu prakalpayet, athaināmāhata bhakṣayet 'narāśaṃsapittasya deva soma te mativida umeḥ ; pitṛbhirbhakṣitasya bhakṣayāmi' iti prātaḥ- savane narāśaṃso bhakṣaḥ; 'ūrvaiḥ' iti mādhyaṃdine, 'kāṇvaiḥ' iti tṛtīyasavane' ( ūhaḥ kartavyaḥ |
atha satvāpāhāstu āha- 'na vaidyarājasyayoḥ somabhakṣaṇaṃ vidyate 8|17|2 |

yadi atrā- kṣaṇaḥ somaṃ pipāset nyagrodhastaminīrāhatā taḥ saṃṣiṣya dadhani unmujya yadanyāṃśramasān juhati athaitasya dharmatapanena upahavya antaḥparidhi āhnīyādvā nirvatya ‘ahaṃ tvadasmi' iti juhoti ' yadanyāṃśramasāna
tena phalacamasaḥ saṃskārabhūtaṃ bhakṣamapasarpanneva śakyo niyoktum, ' yadi kaścidupayogaṃ gacchati, tato bhakṣaṇena saṃkriyase nānyathā ' iti |
sa copayujyamānatvaṃ prārthya- mānaḥ prakaraṇāt yāgopayogitvaṃ pratipadyate |
tatrāpi yāvat anupujyamāno yajamānabhakṣaṇasaṃskārārthatvaṃ na pratipadyate, tāvattaiva yaśabhāgena arthāpattyā saṃbadhyate ityava- dhāraṇāt yajamānacamasābhyāsenaikena saṃbadhyate |
nahi yahacamasāntareṣu anupayujyamānasyāsya yajamāna- bhakṣatvaṃ anupapannam |
yadvā jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇena saṃśraddho'yaṃ bhakṣaṇaśabdaḥ uccārya- māṇaḥ prakṛtaṃ somamakṣameva avalambate |
sa ca yāgo- payuktadravyaśeṣasaṃskāratvena praśastaḥ iti phalacamasami- tādaśameva saṃskṛtaṃ śaknoti |
na tu asau idānīṃ anya- prayojanaḥ śakyaḥ kalpayitum |
na ca tasya karmā ntare kiñcit śabdāntarādadhikāramasti |
api ca ' sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayet ' iti svavākyopāttenaiva somabhakṣaṇena sambandho vijñāyate |
na ca ' na somam ' ityanuvādāt avakalpate |
yadi bhakṣāntaramevamevāt ārāt upakārakaṃ coyeta, tataḥ samānakāryatvābhāvāt naiva somaṃ nivartayet |
ani- vartite ca tasmin na pratiṣedhenānuvādaḥ syāt |
yadi somaṃ bhakṣaṇe saṃskṛtaṃ micchet, tataḥ phalacamasabhākṣaṇaṃ ārādupakārakaṃ kuryāt, phalacamasaṃ vā saṃskuryāt iti |
yadā tu ayamartho gṛhyate ' yena bhakṣaṇena yathābhūtaṃ somaṃ saṃskṛtamicchet, tena tathābhūtameva phalacamasaṃ saṃskuryāt ' iti, tadā arthāpattyā yajamānacamasābhyāsāt asaṃbandhaḥ kuto bhavati |
yathaiva adhrapratīgraheṣṭyāṃ ' yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt ' iti śrute pratigrāhayet iti vyavadhārya kalpitam, tathaiva ' bhakṣaṃ yacchet ' iti śrute yāgasādhanaṃ prayacchet iti kalpyate |
bhāṣyam-- homaviśeṣavacanaṃ bhavati ' yadā anyān camasān juhati, athaitasya (phalacamasasya) dharmataruṇena ( kiñcitsyūlena haṭhena prādeśamātreṇa darbhena ) upahatya juhoti ' iti |
ijyāvikāre sati dharmataruṇena iti juhoti guṇavacanamavakalpate |
ijyāvikāre sati, unnayanadarśanaṃ yujyate, na bhakṣavikāre |
ijyā- vikāre sati somo na bhakṣyate |

' (nyagrodhastiminīḥ nyagrodhaphalāni tatkalyuktaḥ camamaḥ) soma-- pūrvatra saṃpūrṇayaṣṭṛvaśravaṇāt yajamānasya vapaṭkārasaṃjñve'pi iha phalacamasasya na yāgasaṃbandhaḥ aśravaṇāt iti pratyavasānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtre śruti- saṃyogāt śruti phalacamasasya bhakṣaṇena saṃyogasya avagamāt ityarthaḥ |
bhakṣamātre vikuryāt tat somayāge'pi vā tathā ||
bhāṭṭa-- tatraiva ' yadi rājanyaṃ vaiśyaṃ vā yājayet, sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayet, nyagrodhastiminīrāhṛtya tāḥ saṃpiṣya dadhnyunmṛjya tasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet, na somam ' iti śrutam |
tatastasya phalacamasapadamadheyasya kiṃ bhakṣaṇa- mātram, kiṃvā yāgo'pīti cintāyām, nimittatvena apekṣitvasya yāgasya phalacamasānvitatvānupapatteḥ |
tacchabda- parāmṛṣṭasya ca tasya bhakṣānvayaśravaṇāt prāptāyāgānuvādena anekapepaṇādiguṇopaguṇavidhāne vākyabhedāpatteśca anekaguṇa- viśiṣṭaṃ bhakṣāntarameva phalacamasakaraṇakaṃ vidhīyate |
phala- camasasya viniyogābhāvena saṃskārātyanupapatteḥ satkunāyena viniyogabhaṅgasya āvaśyakatvāt |
tadapi ārādupakāraka- mapi yajamānasomabhakṣyasya bhakṣakam, ' na somam ' ityanu- vādabalāt, ' na girā giriti brūyāt ' itivat eka- kāryakāritvābhāve'pi bādhakasvarūpāyā eva sthānāpattervī- kārāt |
astu vā ayaṃ svatantra eva tanniṣedhaḥ |
iti prāpte, yadyapi bhakṣāntaramidam, tathāpi tasya na ārā- dupakārakatvam, ' tam ' iti dvitīyānirdeśena phalacamasa- saṃskārārthatvapratīteḥ |
anupayukttasya ca saṃskārāyoge'pi ' adhvaryuṃ vṛṇīte ' ityādivat viniyogakalpanā |

tatrāpi ' sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayet ' ityādyanuvādatvāt yaja- mānakartṛkasomabhakṣasya ca tāvataivopāttaṃ sarvatra somabhakṣaṇena sarvārthatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt yajamānacamasāgyāmāsa- sādhanatvameva phalacamasasya kalpyate iti na kācidanupa- pattiḥ |
vastutastu, bhakṣāntaratve pramāṇābhāvāt somabhakṣa eva yajamānakartṛkaḥ |
tasya ca yajamānacamasā- bhyāsīyadravyasaṃskārabhakṣasaṃskārārthatvāt pūrvoktaiśca tadī- yayajamānānāt kalpitavākyena phalacamasasya uktāyāgā- bhyāsasādhanatvasiddhiḥ |

evaṃ ca sthānāpatyaiva phalacamase itarasoma- saṃskāravat yajamānabhakṣasyāpi prāptisaṃbhave pūrvapravṛttyā tadvidhvaikaraṇaṃ guṇadvayavidhānārtham, phalacamasasya yāga- sādhanatvasiddhaye ceti draṣṭavyam |
etena ' yadi somaṃ na vindate pūtīkānabhiṣuṇuyāt ' ityatra abhiṣavayuktapūtīkā- nāmapi yāgasādhanatvaṃ vyākhyātam |
tatra niravakāśena naimittikene nityapanayā- bhāve'pi nityasya bādhaḥ |
phalacamasanyāyaḥ : (3|6|19|47-59) āgneyahāviḥ : śrapaṇādyanatvasya naimittikasahaśrapaṇaprayuktatvena naimittikatulyatvāt phalacamasanyāyena sthānāpatyaiva dadhi- śrutayoḥ |
phalataḥ : vācaniko vyavasthitavikalpo yathā, jyotiṣṭomasyāsu saubhare ' hīp iti vṛṣṭikāmāya niśanaṃ kuryāt, urgilananyāyakāmāya, ū iti svargakāmāya ' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 160, phalataḥ : vācanikī vyavasthā yathā ' muṇḍamayena pratiṣṭhākāmasya praṇayet kāsyena brahma- varcasakāmasya ' iti |
smārte tu- brahmayasa eva phala- viśeṣārtha ṛgyajuḥ sāmādhyayanavidhiḥ |

pṛ. 19, phalataḥ : vyavasthāpaḥ pratiṣedho yathā, ' yo brāhmaṇāyāvagureta taṃ śatena yātayāt, yo nihenet sahasraṇa, yo lohitaṃ kuryāt yāvataḥ pāṃsūna saṃgṛhṇīyāt tāvataḥ saṃvatsarān suvarṇaṃ lokaṃ na prajānāyāt, tasmācca brāhmaṇā- yāvagureta na hanyāt na lohitaṃ kuryāt ' iti |
pṛ. 35, phalato vyavasthitavikalpo yathā- jyotiṣṭome ṣoḍaśinastye ' saubharayuktyānāṃ brahmasāma bhavati ' ityukthya- śrayahastottrāsādhanatvena nityaṃ saubharaṃ vihitam |
jyoti- ṣṭomātirātre tu ' yadi bṛhatsāmatirātraḥ syāt saubhara- muktvānāṃ brahmasāma kāryam ' iti brahmasāmatvameva naimittikaṃ
‘yadi rathaṃtarasāmā saubharaṃ kuryāt’ iti coktavyame'pi naimittikaṃ vihitam|
tato nityaṃ naimittikaṃ ca saubharaṃ punaḥ phalatrayasādhanatvena vihitam ‘yo vṛṣṭikāmo yo'- nnādyakāmo yaḥ svargakāmaḥ sa saubharena stuvīta’ iti|

saubharasya ca nānāśākhīyasya nānaṃdhanasyāvyavasthita- vikalpe prāpte ‘hīpiti vṛṣṭikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt ūrjityānnādyakāmāya ū iti svargakāmāya’ iti tattkale tattaddhanasya saubharasya vidhānāt phalato vyavasthita- vikalpaḥ |
‘phaladevatāyojya’ ( 9|1|3|4 ) ityatra liṅgena ye saṃyuktāḥ te apūrvārthaṃ na sambanti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
‘phaladevatāyojya’ kartavyaṃ iti sādhyabhūtamupūrvam, athavā vidheyatvānuṣṭheyatvābhyāṃ bhāva eva pratyayavācyo'bhidhīyate |
tasya kālāntarabhāvitvena prayogasamavāyitve sati tassiddhaya- rthupaiva kartavyatvāvadhāraṇāt |
tathā ca..... phaladevatāyojya ityupanthasya nirākariṣyate ( upanyasya phaladevatāyojya iti nirā- kariṣyate ityanvayaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : ‘agnema svaḥ saṃ jyoti''bhūma’ iti phalasaṃbandho dharmaḥ śrutaḥ |
tathā ‘agrerahamujjiti- manujjeyam, somasyāhamujjitimanujjeyam’ iti devatā- saṃbandhaḥ |
tatra kiṃ ete mantrāḥ svargāndyādiprayuktāḥ uta apūrvaprayuktāḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
phaladevatoḥ phalasya svargaḥ, devatāyā agnyādeśa mantraprayojakatvaṃ syāt |
tathā ca sauryādauge svargaphalasya agrirūpa- devatāyāśca abhāvena prayojakābhāvāt mantranivṛttau ūho na saṃbhavati iti |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : ‘agnema svaḥ saṃ jyoti''bhūma’ iti mantraḥ svargaphalaprayuktaḥ, ‘agrerahamujjitimanujjeyam’ ityādimantraśca agnyādi-
liṅgaṃ ca tato balavattaram, na tato bādhituṃ yuktam |
tena yathā vāṅniyamo jyotiṣṭomātha- dīkṣaṇīyārthaḥ tathā mantro'pi |
] athavā aya [mantraḥ] svāsāmarthyadeva [ ‘svāsāmarthyena’ iti pāṭhaḥ tantraratne tu pañcamyanta eva pāṭhaḥ : ] apriprakāśakaḥ |
evaṃ prakaraṇabādhaṃ sāmarthyena manyamānaḥ pūrvapakṣaṃ karoti [ ‘ārabhate’ iti pāṭhaḥ |
tantraratne tu karoti ityeva pāṭhaḥ ] prokṣaṇavat tu uttaram |
yat phalavat codanā tat iti- kartavyatayā anuvadhyate |
apūrvaṃ ca phalavat, na svargā- gnyādi |
etasmin pakṣāntare dṛṣṭe sati na svargāgnyādivacanasya apūrvakalpanā nyāyyā |
śabdārthasya ca phaladevatvena saṃpratipannatvāt lakṣaṇā adṛṣṭā |
kiṃ bhavati vicārasya prayo- janam ? yathā pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, saurye karmaṇi avikāreṇa mantraḥ prayoktavyaḥ |
yathā tarhi siddhāntaḥ ūhena, ‘agrema brahmavarcasam, ‘ sūryo'jjiti (srāhamujjiti) man- traiṣpam’ iti |
(siddhāntamāha-) satyaṃ phalasya sarvasmāt prādhānyaṃ na tu tāvatā |
soma-- pūrvatra yathā paramāpūrvārthadīkṣaṇīyā''pūrvārthatvaṃ vāṅniyamasya na paramāpūrvārthatvam, evaṃ mantrasyāpi agnyādyarthatvaṃ na taddvārā darśapūrṇamāsārthatvaṃ ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- ‘agnmādeḥ svargadevau hetu yadvā''tra codi- tam |
’ bhāṭṭa-- pūrvoktāyā apūrvasaṃbandhatvena uddeśyatāyāḥ kacidākṣipya samādhānāyarthamidamadhikaraṇam |
darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ : ‘agnema svaḥ suvaraganma’ iti svargaprati- pādako mantraḥ |

tayośca svargatvādi- tvādidaiva svargānvayoḥ liṅkakatvaśrutau uddeśyatā upa- sthitatvāt, na tu apūrvasaṃbandhatvena mukhye evārthe vini- yogasya autsargikatvāt : sādhitatvena tena rūpeṇa svargādi- padeḥ anabhidhānāt |
na ca svargādirūpe ānarthakyam, sākṣāt phala rūpasya tasya aniścitopāyatvāviśeṣaṇa tada- rthatve vaiyarthyābhāvāt |
mantrajapaprakāśanavyatirekena itarā- ṅgyukapradhānamātradeva utpattisiddheḥ ānarthakyaṃ apūrve- 'pi tulyam |
evaṃ devatāyāmapi mantrārthavādeti- hāsādivāt satyapi apūrve tajjanitadevatāprasādadeva phalotpattiḥ prasādasya ca mantrajapaprakāśanavyati- rekeṇa utpattau pramāṇābhāvāt tadarthatvam |
ata eva liṅkakatvaśrutiviniyogavidhī upasthitatvāt prasādā- śrayībhūtāmaireva tattvena uddeśyatā, na tu apūrvīyadevatātvena iti na sauryādau brahmavarcasasyādidoṣaḥ |

iti prāpte, na tāvat sarvagāmeva avaghātādīnāṃ apūrvārthatvamapahāya svargārthatvaṃ śaṅkituṃ śakyam, brīhyādipadena pratyāsannatayā tepāmathādhikaraṇa-yāyena āgneyādyutpatyapūrvasādhanatvasya lakṣaṇāt |
evaṃ apūrvāṅgīkāreṇa devatāprasādārthatvaṃ ava- ghātādīnāṃ nirākartavyam |
taddhi kiṃ darśapūrṇamāsajanyasvargavyakti pratyeva mantrajanyaprakāśanasyopayogaḥ, uta svargavyaktyantaraṃ prati |
nānyathāḥ tadarthe darśapūrṇamāsāṅgatvabhāvātsāmānyā- saṃbandhabodhakapramāṇābhāvena liṅkakatvaśrutereva akalpanena svargārthatve eva pramāṇābhāvāt |
na ca svargādhikāra eva sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakaṃ pramāṇam, svargasya yāgālya-
na ca mantrasya prayojanākāṅkṣayaiva liṅgena śrutikalpa- nam, vācattome viniyogenaiva tasya nirākāṅkṣatvāt |
pāke samartha- syāpi devadattasya ākāṅkṣā'bhāve viniyogādarśanāt |
tathātve hi darśapūrṇamāsajanyasvargavyaktīnāṃ na svargatvādinā uddeśyatā, atiprasaṅgāt |
ata eva saṃnipatyopakāra- katve'pi svargamāsajanyatvāt apūrvameva, na tu avāntarapūrvaṃ uddeśyatāvacchedakakoṭipraviṣṭam |
ataścaiva mantraliṅgakatvā śrutiḥ anena mantreṇa śaktijanyabodhadvārā paramāpūrvasādhyaṃ saṃkuryāditi |
śaktijanyabodhaśca vastutaḥ svargalaprakārakaḥ svargaviśeṣaśca eva dvārātāṃ śaktijanya- bodhanatvena praviṣṭaḥ, na tu apūrvasaṃbandhitvaprakārakaḥ; tathātve śaktijanyatvātnupapatteḥ |
ata eva brahmavarcasādī dvārābhāvāt svargadalope brahmavarcasaviṣayakaśaktijanyabodha- siddhayarthaṃ brahmavarcasapadohaḥ |
ityatra prakṛtatvena lakṣaṇayā svargapadenāpūrvasaṃbandhitvaprakārakabodhajanane brahmavarcasasyāpi tenaiva rūpeṇa bodhopapatteḥ ūhānupapattiḥ |
ata eva ca 'mukhya evārthe mantrāṇāṃ viniyogaḥ' ityupapannam |
śaktijanya- bodhena ca apūrvasādhye jñātatayā ādhānāt tasya saṃskā- ryatvaṃ uddeśyatvaparaparyāyaṃ nānupapannam |
tādṛśabodhasya ca svajanyaśraddhājanyatvāddvārā paramāpūrva eva phalotpatyanukūla- yogyatājananāt phale upayogaḥ, na tu phalotpādakatvam, tathātve samaprādhānyāpatyā prakaraṇabādhāpatteḥ |

evaṃ anyādiprākṣakatve'pi svatantrābhiprāyakāśānā- thaitvasya anupayuktatvāt sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇā- māvācca pūrvavat tatkalpanā''nupapatteḥ avaśyaṃ āgneya- saṃbandhaviprakāśānāthatvasyaiva kalpanīyatvāt āgneyasvarūpe cānarthakyena pratyāsannatayā tadatyatpapūrvīyadevatātvenaiva anyādeḥ uddeśyatvakalpanā |
na tu prasādāśrayatvena, prasādasya paramāpūrvajanyatvena viprakṛṣṭatvāddeva prayojaka- tānupapatteḥ |
parantu prasādasāmānyāśrayatvasya āgneyādau atiprasaṅgāt noddeśyatāvacchedakatvam, āgneyāpūrvajanyaprasādāśrayatvā- pekṣayā tadīyadevatātvasya laghutvāt |
ataścatrāpi anena mantreṇa śaktijanyabodhadvārā āgneyotpatyapūrvīyadevatāṃ saṃskuryāt iti liṅgakalpyaśruti kalpayitvā ūhasiddhiḥ pūrvokta upapādanīyā |
upayogo'pi nirvāpādimantreṣu smṛtidādyena tyāgakāle jhaṭiti devatāsmṛtidvārā utpatyapūrvānukūlayāganiṣayogyatāsaṃpādane eva ityanya vistaraḥ |

protsā- hanārthanāmāpi ' agnim suva ' ityādīnāṃ śraddhājananāthaṃ anuṣṭheyasyāpi karmasamavetasya phalādeḥ spaṣṭerepekṣitatvāt tadarthatvena dṛṣṭavidhayevoktavyāpārasiddhiḥ navame bhāṣye phaladevatādhikaraṇe evopapāditā |
phalaṃ svargaḥ; niyamo yāvajjīvikoṣyāsaḥ; kartā svargakāmaḥ; samudāyo darśapūrṇamāsau |

vā. 2|2|13 pṛ. 483, su. pṛ. 733. phalabhāja eva pradhānakartṛtvaṃ iti nyāyaḥ |
kiṃ sakṛt prayoga eṣāṃ uta aśrutasyāso'pi kartavya iti |
tatra ' dharmamātre svadarśanacchandārthenāparvaḥ syāt ' ( 1|1|16|28 ) ityanena nyāyena sakṛt prayoge prāpte evamucyate, ' ṛtuvadvā'numānenābhyāse phalabhūmā syāt ' |
kiṃ tadanumānam ? prāk aṅgamayogāt pradhānopakāro nāsīt ūrdhvaṃ tato bhavati, tena vijñāyate nūnaṃ aṅgena kriyate iti |
ṛtuvat, tadyathā karmasu sauryādiṣu phala karmaṇā kriyate iti karmābhyāse phalabhūya- svam, evamihāpi |
bhāṣyam-- sakṛt vā aṅgaṃ prayoktavyam, nāvṛttyā |
ka punarasau ? yena pradhānāni phala dadati |
taccet sakṛtprayuktenāṅgaṃ kṛtaṃ jānāti pradhānāni phala- vantīti, punarabhyāsāprayogaḥ |
yena sakṛtkṛtena nopakṛtam, sa punaḥkriyamāṇa upakariṣyati iti kā āśā |
bhāṣyam-- yadi cāniyamaḥ sakṛdasakṛdā prayogaḥ, tataḥ ' caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāmāhutayo hūyante, trayodaśā- māvāsyām ' iti yo'yaṃ nityavadāhutiparimāṇavādaḥ; sa na syāt |
sa tāvat bhavatāṃ pādhikaḥ kalpyeta tathā cāsya rūpaṃ bādhyate |
bhāṣyam-- yattu ṛtuvaditi, yuktaṃ yat ṛtuṣu abhyāsaḥ |
aṅgesya punaḥ uktaparimāṇaṃ phalaṃ pradhānānāṃ phalavattāsaṃpāda- nam |
taccet sakṛtkṛtena kṛtam, na bhūyaḥ kriyā'stīti |
arthāvattu naiktalādabhyāsaḥ syādanarthako yathā bhojanamekasminnarthasyāparimāṇatvāt pradhāne ca kriyārthatvādniyamaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- yaduktaṃ sakṛtkṛtena aṅgena kṛtatvāt arthasya anarthako'bhyāsa iti |
atra brūmaḥ ! arthāvattu abhyāsaḥ aṅgābhyāsaḥ, nārthako'bhyāsaḥ |
yadi ekamevārthaṃ abhyasa- mānamapi karoti, tataḥ abhyāso'narthakaḥ syāt |
yathā bhojanamekasmin kāle abhyasamānaṃ ekameva phalaṃ tṛptiṃ karotīti nāmyasyate |
nanu yāvatā pradhānaṃ phalavadbhavati tāvat karoti iti gamyate |
abhyāse ca asaṃkhyāṃ bhūyānupakāraḥ syāt kāryatvāt tasya |
tasmādaniyamaḥ syāt sakṛdā prayogaḥ, abhyāso veti |

bhāṣyam-- yattu āhutisaṃkhyeyā virudhyate iti, pṛthaktvādupakārasya abhyāse nyāyaprāpte yo'yaṃ āhuti- saṃkhyānuvādaḥ sa vihitaḥ syāt, āhutividhīnabhipretya ' caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāṃ āhutividhayaḥ; trayodaśa amā-
abhyāso vā prayogavacanaikatvāt sarvasya yugapacchākhādaphalatvācca karmaṇaḥ syāt kriyārtha- tvāt |
ekaḥ prayogavacanaḥ ajñānāṃ pradhā- nānāṃ ca |
tasyaikatvāt sarvasya yugapacchāsanaṃ 'anena karmaṇā sāṅgena yajeta' iti |
sakṛtkṛtaiścāṅgaiḥ tat sāṅgaṃ jāta miti na punaḥ kriyāyāṃ hetursti |
yadi aṅgāni adṛṣṭamupakāraṃ kuryuḥ, tataḥ tadabhyāse upakārabhūyastvamanumīyate |
dṛṣṭameva ca artha aṅgāni kurvanti pradhānasyāṅgatvām |
sā cet phalasaṃbaddhā sāṅgena yajeta iti, nāṅgāni |
yadā hi prayājāḥ, na tadā pradhānayajñaḥ apūrve vā |
yadā ca yajñaḥ apūrve ca, na tadā prayājāḥ |
tadevaṃ adṛṣṭarahite samidādimātre sati aṅgavattvaṃ nāsti, kuta upakāraḥ ? |
api ca yadi yajimātramevāṅgaiṣu, nāpūrvaphalamasti, tataḥ somāṅgabhūtānāṃ iṣṭiputrabhūtānāṃ codaka eva nāsti |
yajateḥ prajñātetikartavyatā- katvāt itikartavyatāṃ codako nādiśet |
'tasyaikaśataṃ prayājānuyājāḥ, na ca samidho'jyei juhoti, prahṛtya paridhīn juhoti hāriyojanam' iti |
ekaḥ prayoga- vacanaḥ ajñānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ca |
kasya hetoḥ ? sakṛtkṛtaiḥ pradhānaiḥ kṛtaḥ śrutyarthaḥ ; 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
kṛte śrutyarthe yat śāstravihitaṃ phalaṃ tallabhyaṃ iti na punaḥ kriyāyāṃ hetursti |
evamabhyasyāpi sakṛtkṛtyeṣu yadajñānāṃ prāpakaṃ śāstraṃ tatsādhyaṃ : kṛtaḥ |
tasmin kṛte yat śāstrā- dhigataṃ aṅgaphalaṃ tallabhyamidaṃ ityavagantavyam |
darśapūrṇamāsayoryat phalaṃ tadbhāvanāyāṃ aṅgopakāra upayujyate, nāpūrvasya phalasyotpattau |
yadi apūrve phalaṃ aṅgairutpādyeta, aṅgaphalameva tat syāt |
tasyāḥ phalaṃ na śrūyate, karaṇāt phalamiti |
satyam, karaṇasya phalaṃ sādhyataḥ abhyasyamānā itikartavyatā mahantamupakāraṃ karoti |
tacca mahatā upakāreṇa anugṛhītaṃ mahat phalaṃ karoti |
tatra karaṇaṃ phale vyāpriyate, itikartavyatā karaṇamanugṛhṇatī ākāṅkṣitā |
tasmāt sakṛt atra granthaḥ 'yadā prayājāḥ, na tadā pradhānayajñaḥ : apūrve vā, yadā ca yajiḥ apūrve ca na tadā prayājāḥ' iti (bhāṣyagranthaḥ) etadayuktam |
katham ? yasminneva kṣaṇe svargo bhavane kartṛtvaṃ pratipadyate, tasminneva karaṇamapi bhāvakatvena vyāpriyate |
yadi anyasmin kṣaṇe svargo bhavane kartṛtvaṃ pratipadyeta, karaṇamapi anyasmin bhāvakam, tathā sati bhāvyabhāvaka- saṃbandha eva na syāt |
tathat asakṛdajñānāṃ prayogaḥ tataḥ etāni vacanāni upapadyante |
yat chenādiṣu vacanāt sakṛttvasya anyatra abhyāso vijñāyate iti |
yadyapi anabhyāsaḥ, tathāpi chenādiṣu vācyaṃ sakṛttvam |
tathā 'dvirhaviṣo'vadyati' ityaviśeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛtyapi dvitvaṃ prāptaṃ tatra sakṛttvaṃ vidhīyate |
tasmāt chenādiṣu sakṛ- ddhacanāt nānyatra abhyāso vijñātuṃ nyāyyaḥ iti |
śā-- phalabhūmārcinā karmāṇi punaḥ punaḥ prayoktavyāni iti sthite cintyate, kiṃ ekasmin prayoge aṅgāni punaḥ punaḥ prayuñjānasya phalabhūyastvaṃ bhavati, neti |
tatra abhya- syamānāni aṅgāni bahūpakāraṃ janayanti, bahūpakārayuktaṃ ca pradhānaṃ phalabhūyastvaṃ bhavati iti manvānasyottaram |
samagrakāraṇāguṇyaṃ hi kāryamāvartate, pradhānaṃ ca sāṅgaṃ phala- sāmagrī nāṅgamātram, atastanmātrāvṛttyā na bhūyaḥ phala- lābhaḥ |
na ca upakārabhūyastyā phalabhūyastvaṃ pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
na ca śāstrīyeṇa prayāsagauraveṇa phalabhūmā śakyate kalpayitum |
ataḥ phalabhūmārcinā sāṅgaṃ pradhānaṃ abhyasitavyam, nāṅgamātram, nāpi pradhānamātram |
soma-- sūtrārthastu- aṅgaṃ phalabhūmāryamabhyāsamerhati saphalatvāt, sauryādivat ityanumānena aṅgabhyāse phalabhūmā syāt iti |
vi-- 'aṅgaibhyāso na vā, bhūmā'bhyāso, nāṅge pṛthak phalam |
bhāṭṭa-- ekasminneva prayoge punaḥ punaḥ kriyamāṇai- raṅgaiḥ prayāsagauraveṇa phaladhikyaṃ manvānasyottaram |
na tāvat phalāntarotpattiḥ, ekasmāt pradhānāt ekasyaiva phalasya utpattiniyamena pradhānābhūtabhāve sāmanyabhāvena phalā- ntarotpattī pramāṇābhāvāt |
sa hi yatra tadvyatirekeṇa ṛtūpakāra- siddhiḥ pramāṇapramitā, tatraiva tadvidhaivayarthyabhiyā kalpyate, yathā ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāt, yathā vā 'ekā devyā, ṣaḍ devyāḥ' ityādī |
prakṛte tu aṅgavidhīnāṃ sakṛtkaraṇena caritā- rthatvāt kratośca ekakṛtakāramātraikṣāpekṣitayā punara- vyutśanākṣepakatayā puruṣecchāmātreṇaiva āvṛttau phaladhikye pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
yatra hi 'paśumālabheta' ityādau mahān paśurālabhyate, yatra svalpaḥ, tatrāpi na phale tāratamyaṃ ityuktaṃ bhāṣye (11|1|144 akṣaramedena) |
tatra prayājā- dīnāṃ punaḥ karaṇe kā saṃbhāvanā ? 'gāṃ dadyāt' ityādī tu samīcīnagodāne phalādhikyamastyeva iti dhyeyam |
' phalabhūmāthī bahukṛtvaḥ prayoge pravartata, saṃtuṣṭaḥ sakṛt |
yathā cāyaṃ nyāyo muktāvalyāṃ samāsalakṣaṇā nirūpaṇaprastāve nirūpita- sathādi, ata eva 'niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet' ityatra na tatpuruṣo lakṣaṇāpatteḥ, kintu karmadhārayaḥ lakṣaṇā- bhāvāt |

ke. ] itaratra ( yājñeyaḥ ) phalavatsannidhāvat tadaṅgaṃ bhavati |

yathā āpastambasūtram, tadyathā- ‘āme phalārthe nirmite chāyāgandhe anūpyate, evaṃ dharme caryamāṇe aryādayo'nutyante’ |
