phalavidhānaṃ hi īdṛśena śabdena ( ‘prāṇāpānāvevātman dhatte’ ityādinā ) na kriyate iti vakṣyāmaḥ ( 4|3|1|1-3 ityatra ) |
phalavidhiḥ arthavādaḥ ‘pratitiṣṭhanti ha vā ya etā rātrīrupayanti’ iti |
phalavidhiḥ ‘gvādir vīryakāmasya yūyaṃ kuryāt, pālāśaṃ brahmavarcasa- kāmasya, bailvamannādyakāmasya’ iti |
phalavidhiḥ mantraḥ trividhaḥ yajamānagāmiphalavidhiḥ, ṛtvigāmiphalavidhiḥ, ubhayagāmiphalavidhiśceti |
phalavidhisarūpaḥ arthavādaḥ ‘yasya parṇamayī juhvaḥ bhavati’ iti |
bāla. pṛ. 53, phalavidhisarūpaḥ mantraḥ ‘āyurdā agne'syāyurme dehi’ iti |
phalaśrutiḥ anyānyavākyaprasaṅga- vijñātapārthāpāditādityatvāt na phalapratipattiścā vijñāyate |
yathā ‘yo'śvamedhena yajate, ya u cainamevaṃ veda’ iti jñānamātrādeva brahmahatyātaraṇaṃ yadi sidhyet ko jāḍa cit bahudravyavyayayāsāsādhyamaśvamedhaṃ kuryāt |
phalaśrutestu karma syāt phalasya karmayogi- tvāt’ ( 2|1|1|25-26 ) ityadhikaraṇe guṇa- karaṇatvaṃ vyutpādyate |
phalaśrutestu karma syāt phalasya karmayogi- tvāt |
tatra kiṃ agnihotramātahomāntaraṃ dadhyā- dihomaḥ uta dadhyāderguṇāt phala iti vicāre pūrvapakṣa- māha |
‘dadhnā juhuyāt’ iti karma homāntaraṃ syāt, phala- śruteḥ |
indriyakāmatvaṃ phalamatra śrūyate, tacca karmaṇo nyāyyam |
tasmāt dadhiviśiṣṭo homaḥ phalāya vidhīyate iti karmā- ntarametat |
‘agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ : ‘dadhnendriyakāmasya juhuyāt’ iti vākyayoḥ atulyatvāt tulyatvābhāvāt tasya agnihotrahomasya guṇe dadhi rūpe phalatvanvayaḥ pratīyate guṇāt phalaṃ iti |
indriyakāmatve tu homāśritasya dadhnaḥ indriyārthatvena vidhiḥ iti atulyatvam |
tasmāt na karmāntaravidhiḥ kintu phalasya guṇavidhiḥ |
phalaśrutestu karma syāt phalasya karmayogi- tvāt |
homāntaraṃ dadhyādihomaḥ uta dadhyāderguṇāt phalaṃ iti |
bhāvāthārdhikaraṇe hyetadavasthitam, ākhyātaśabdāḥ phalasaṃbandhino na dravya- guṇaśabdāḥ |
tadatrāpi tenaiva nyāyena 'indriyaṃ bhāvayet' itīndriyabhāvanā sādhanākāṅkṣiṇī samānapadāttaṃ homa- (rūpadhātvartha) meva karaṇatayā gṛhṇāti, na viprakṛṣṭaṃ dravyam |

na caivaṃ sati phale homavidhānādame ca dadhividhānā- ddhakyabhedaḥ, agtyā 'daśāpavitreṇa ahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' iti vat dadhimatā homanendriyaṃ bhāvayediti mattvarthalakṣaṇa- (yā viśiṣṭa-) vidhānenaiva karmāntaravidhāyopapatteḥ |
nanu bhavatu homāt phalam, tathāpi prakṛta eva homaḥ 'saṃnidhau tvibhāgātphalatrayeṇa punaḥ śrutiḥ' (2|3|126) iti nyāyena svargayāvadvīryondriyaphale vidhīyatām |
na ca 'dadhnā juhoti' iti dadhiviśiṣṭo'pi homo viccata eveti tatpratyabhijñānamiti vācyam |
na ca guṇavākyaphalavākyayostulyatvākā- pekṣayoḥ parasparanirapekṣatvāt saṃbandho'sti |
na ca utpattivākyāvagatameva karma guṇavākyāpādita- dadhisaṃbandhaṃ phale vidhāsyatīti vācyam |
yathendriya- kāmaḥ syāttadā nityaṃ kevaladadhidhiśihomaṃ (bhāvaye-) diti dadhi vaikalpiktvena daśame pakṣe saṃbadhyate |
ato yathābhūto nityadadhiviśiṣṭo homa indriyakāmavākye pratīyate, tādṛśasyāpratyabhijñānāt, anupādeyaṃ phalaṃ pratyu- pādānāt karmāntarameveti |
na ca prakṛta- homāśritasyaiva dadhnaḥ phale vidhānamasti, kiṃ vidhigaurava- matvarthalakṣaṇāśrayaṇeneti vācyam |
'asaṃyuktaṃ prakaraṇam' iti nyāyena phalārthasya dadhnaḥ prakaraṇagrahaṇāsaṃbhavāt |
yataḥ śabdo hi saṃnidhivaśāt viśeṣaṇatve pramāṇam |
na tu saṃnidhānaṃ nāma yāgasya pramā(ṇa)sti |

na cātra prakṛtāśrayasaṃbandhapratipādakaḥ śabdaḥ kaścidasti, śrautendriya- kāmavākyasya ubhayasaṃbandhakaraṇe vākyabhedasyoktatvāt ! kalpitatvācca ''śrayasaṃbandhakaraṇe kalpaneva doṣa iti śrutasyaiva vākyasya viśiṣṭakarmavidhāyakatvameva yuktam |
tenāndriyakāmavākye phalasya śrutatvāt karmā- ntarameva vidheyaṃ bhavediti |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ, bhavedevaṃ yadi bhāvāthārdhikaraṇadeva bhāvāthartriyayo vidhirbhavet |
sarvatra khalu bhāvanā eva vidhisiddhādyarthamedena tatra tatra bhidyate |
yatra phalavatī bhāvanāsātrāt dhātvarthaparo vidhirbhavati, tatra dhātvarthameva phalkaraṇaṃ karoti |
yatra tu svavākyopāttavidheyaguṇāntara- pādānamasti, tatra viśiṣṭavidhirauravabhiyā guṇamātra- vidhānalolupe yadi dhātvarthaprāpti paśyati, tadā samasta- mantra guṇamātrameva phale vidhatte |
atha na paśyati, tadā vidhividhāne matvarthalakṣaṇāṃ ca svīkurute iti sthitam |
tadihāpi prakṛtadhātvarthapratyabhijñānāt tamupekṣya guṇasaṃkrānto vidhiḥ guṇameva phale vidhatte |
evaṃ sati matvarthalakṣaṇādoṣo viśiṣṭavidhivauravaṃ ca na bhaviṣyati |
nanu bhavatu dhātvarthasya homasya prāptatvāt anuvādaḥ, dadhihomasaṃbandho'pyatra
tadatra 'dadhnendriyakāmasya juhuyāt' iti vākye pratīyamāno dadhihomasaṃbandho na tāvadanūdyate, prāgaprāptatvāt |
vidhīyate cet tadekasya dadhnaḥ phalasaṃbandhavidhāne homasaṃbandhavidhāne ca vākyabhedaḥ syāditi |
tathāhi, dadhneti tṛtīyāyā karaṇatvenopāttaṃ dadhi vidhīyate |
yatrivartayato'sya kārakībhūtasya phalasādhanatve'pekṣāyāṃ saṃnidhiprakaraṇopanītahomaeva dhātvarthaḥ saṃbadhyate |

tena kārakībhūtadadhidhātvarthaparāmarśadeva prakṛtahomasaṃbandho- 'pyasya vākyāt pratīyamāno'nudyata eva, phalasaṃbandhaḥ paraṃ vidhīyata iti kuto vākyabhedaḥ ? taduktam 'dadhi- saṃbandho'pi cāsya prakaraṇādevāśrayatvaḥ prāpto'nu- vadyate' (vā. pṛ. 548) iti |
na ca vācyaṃ keyamatrāśrayasaṃbandhaviśeṣāpekṣā, kiṃ kāraṇatvena itikartavyatātvena vā iti |
yato labdha- karaṇabhāvasya yā tadanugrahākāṅkṣā bhavati sā iha kriyā- viśeṣāpyanirūpya karaṇatvameva kriyāviśeṣāntarbhāvamantareṇa pratīyata iti karaṇākāṅkṣayeva pravartatatetyavadhātvatvam |
idaṃ tviha vaktavyam-- kiṃ dhātvarthadadhnā'sya saivānyate anyā vā vidhīyate ? na tāvat saivānyate, phalebhedena sādhanabhedena ca tasyāḥ pratyabhijñānāsaṃbhavāt |
na hi phalabhedena sādhanabhedena bhāvanā bhidyate |
tatra tatra agnihotramityupacitāvākyagatā- nubandhabhūtahomādidhātvarthāvacchinnarūpasya svargakāmavākye yāvajjīvavākye indriyakāmavākye ca pratyabhijñānāt saiva bhāvanā |
phalakaraṇādibhedena tu bhedaḥ tasya upakāraka eva |
na ca vācyaṃ kathaṃ prāptāyāṃ bhāvanāyāmindriya- saṃbandho dadhidhiśrvadha vidhīyate iti |
yato na kaci- dapi bhāvanāyāḥ phalasaṃbandho vidhīyate |
taduktaṃ kārikāyām- 'phalaśrute mī. ko. 364 bhāvanāyāśca pratyayo na vidhāyakaḥ |
ato nātra prakṛtahomāśrayasya dadhnaḥ phale vidhāna- miti siddhaṃ karmāntaratvam |
prayojanam-- pūrvapakṣe dadhihomatvenāpūrvatvāt sakṛ- deva kevaladadhisādhanakahomātmānam |
siddhānte tu homa- bhedāt sāyaṃ prātarastyato dadhisādhanako homa iti |
sūtre tu-- karmaphalasaṃbandhaguṇaphalasaṃbandhavākyayoḥ atulyatvāt tasyendriyaphalasya saṃbandho guṇe pratīyate |
phalasaṃbandhasya aveṣṭī 'etayā'nnādyakāmaṃ yājayet' iti vidhiḥ, na karmāntarasya |
'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' iti vidhāya āmnāyate 'yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati pūta eva sa tejasyannāda indriyāvī paśumān bhavati' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, iyamiṣṭiḥ kartuḥ phalaḥ putrasya phalāya veti |
karmakartṛḥ karmaphalena saṃbandhāt pituḥ phalāya iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntamāha |
anaudite vākyaśeṣe anukte pitari pūtatvādivākyasya saṃyogo na syāt |
'yasmin jāte sa pūto bhavati' iti ca spaṣṭameva jātasya putrasya phalaṃ brūte |
nanu 'yatreke kapālaṃ nasyedeko māsaḥ saṃvatsarasyāpetaḥ syāt |
atha yajamānaḥ pramīyeta cāvāputhīyamekakapālaṃ nirvapet' iti kapālanāśe nimitte ātmānaḥ śreyasaphalaṃ karma evaṃ jāteṣṭirapi iti pūrvapakṣaśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti |
na hi kapālāno tadanepārtha iṣṭiḥ kriyate |
jāteḥ tu anyathāpi upapadyamānatvāt pūtatvādi phalaṃ putragatameva, na tu kartuḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
athavā anena ekena sūtreṇa varṇakaṃ dvitīyam |
‘vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte’ iti śrutā iṣṭiḥ kiṃ putre jātamātre kartavyā uta jātakarmottaraṃ iti saṃśaye jātamātre iṣṭiḥ iti na pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhānta- yati |
ajñānāṃ kālarūpa- syāsya upaghātaḥ udarāgnirmanaṃ putrajanana iti yāvat |
upaghātasya saṃyogaḥ kevalaṃ nimittārthaḥ: nimitte sati vidhānārthaḥ |
iyaṃ jāteṣṭiḥ kiṃ antardaśāhe kartavyā kiṃvā jananāśīcasamāptyantaraṃ paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ vā kartavyā iti vicāre niyā- makābhāvāt antardaśāhe kartavyā

sā ca putragatatvādilaphalaprayuktā, uta kartṛgatatvādila- phalaprayukteti cintāyām, vidhinā kartṛsamīhitasyaiva ākṣepāt ādhānagatatvamevapadena ca abhipreyojaphalasya ātmagāmitvāvagateḥ iṣṭakartavyaiva phalam |
na ca 'yasmin jāte' ityādinā dharmigrāhakapramāṇena pūtatvādeḥ putra- gatatvātsāyaḥ, tasyāpi 'sa tejasvī' iti sarvanāmnā nirvapatitadeva samānādhikaraṇavibhaktinirdiṣṭasya parāmarśe- nāvirodhitvāt |
iti prāpte, yacchabdasambandhāt tacchabdasya tadarthaparāmarśatvena putragatatvādeva phalatvāsāyāt, tasyāpi kartṛsamīhitatvena vidhyātmane- padayoḥ avirodhāt putragatatvādiyuktaiva sā |
prayojanaṃ putramaraṇe'pi jātetiḥ, pitari phalasaṃskārārtha pūrvapakṣe |
bhāṣyam - anārabhya kiñcit śrūyate 'āgneya- maṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped rukkāmaḥ' ; 'agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped brahmavarcasakāmaḥ' ; 'aindrāgnamekādaśakapālaṃ nirva- pet prajākāmaḥ' iti |
atra saṃdihyate, kiṃ prākṛtaiṣu āgneyādiṣu phalaṃ vidhīyate uta prākṛtaibhyaḥ karmāntarāṇi etāni iti |
katham ? anu- vāde sati na śakyate phalaṃ vidhātum, vidhāyakatvā- bhāvāt |
na hi avidhīyamāna upāyo rūpo bhavatīti gamyate |
api ca rukkāma'tra vidhīyamāne kāmyā- nityatvāt āgneyādīnāṃ nityatvāt saṃbandho nāvakalpeta |
śā - 'āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped rukkāmaḥ' itya- nārabhya śrutam, tathā 'traidhātavīyā dīkṣaṇīyā' ityatra- medhe |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe rukkāmārthaṃ na pṛthak prayogaḥ, kintu guṇaphalavat darśapūrṇamāsaprayogeṇa tatsiddhiḥ |
siddhānte tu karmāntara- tvāt pṛthak prayoga iti |
) saṃskārasya tu 'audumbarī prokṣati' iti brīhrokṣaṇāt karmāntaram |
'rājā rājasūyena svārājyakāmo yajeta' ityatra rājñaḥ sataḥ svārājyakāmasya phala- syāmyam |
brīhvavadyate ye avaśiṣṭaḥ kaṇāḥ, tān juhvāṃ caturgṛhīte ājye prakṣipya dakṣiṇāgnau 'agne'dagdhādyo0' (taisaṃ. 1|1|3|13) iti mantreṇa juhoti |
(phalīkaraṇaḥ taṇḍuleṣu kriyamāṇe apaneyā māli- nyākhyā-- taisaṃbhā.) |
vi. '1|1|25, phalīkaraṇa- homaḥ savanīyapuroḍāśe anuyājaiḥ saha ābhimāstādūrdhvaṃ noktavyaḥ |
phālgunāni nāma latāviśeṣaḥ somasya prati- nidhirbhavati |
sādṛśyena pratinidhitayā anekeṣu dravyeṣu prāpteṣu phālgunānāṃ niyamavidhirayam |
phalgunī- nakṣatrayuktapūrṇimāmāse yeṣāṃ phalgurṇādibhirvṛddhistadavadhī- viśeṣāḥ phālgunāni iti asmākaṃ matam |
sāyaṇācāryaiḥ tu lokavyavahāre phalgu svalpameva prayojanaṃ yeṣāṃ ārdra- dūrvādikarādīnāṃ tṛṇānāṃ tāni phālgunāni iti |
'phālgunyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ prayukte' iti vākyena cāturmāsyārambhaḥ vihitaḥ |
bakavandhanaya bakasya śirasi navanītasthāpanāyāso yathā vṛthā |
yatra kriyā niṣphalā tatra asya pravṛttiḥ |
babhruḥ gaumyaḥ : aikādaśineṣu tṛtīyaḥ paśuḥ aśvamedhe jyotiṣṭome ca |
barhatvaṃ . mahiṣatva- (1 meṣatva ) ekārthasamavā- yinī bālyāvāntarajātiḥ |
māprāneva matrāṃ pacata, na vā eteṣāṃ havirhatā |
vi. 6|7|12. barhiḥ : ātithyāyāḥ upasadāṃ agnīṣomīyasya ca sādhāraṇaṃ jyotiṣṭome, na paradravyasyopadeśaḥ na niriha- kasya na vā dharmavidhiḥ |
nanvasaṃskṛte'pi kasmiṃściddeśe upacaryate yathā bahirādāya gāvo gatā iti bhavanti vaktāraḥ |
tathā ājyaṃ kathamiti, puroḍāśena me mātā prahelakaṃ dadātīti |
kuta etat ? yata ekadeśe hi śabdaprayogaḥ |
prasiddhe hi saṃskāraśabde, sādṛśyāditi śakyate vaktum |
tena satsu śabdeṣu saṃskārairbhavitavyam, sati ca saṃskāre śabdalābhaḥ |
na ca avihitāḥ saṃskārā bhavanti, jātyākhyeya lokaḥ prayuṅkte |
tata eka- deśe'pi jātinimittā dṛṣṭāḥ, sarvatra jātinimittā bhavitumarhanti |
na cālaukikānāṃ satāṃ vedādeva pūrvottara- padasaṃbandhamanena śakyate'rtho'vasātum |
pūrvottarapade anarthake mā bhūtāmityevaṃ sa parikalpyeta |
arthavatī ca te pade pūrvottare laukikena asaṃskṛtaprayogeṇa bhaviṣyataḥ |
prayojanam - 'barhiṣā yūpavaṭamavastuṇāti' iti saṃskṛtereva stāritavyaṃ yadi pūrvaiḥ pakṣaḥ, viparītaṃ siddhānte |
vā - nāmadheyaprastāvena dravyanāmasu nimittaṃ prati adhikaraṇatrayamārabhyate |
tatra 'śāstratvā vā tannimittatvāt' (1|3| 4|9) iti yājñikānāṃ saṃskṛteṣu prayogāt sārvatrika- tvādvigītatvācca saṃskāranimittā |
kutaḥ ? 'ekadeśe'pi yo dṛṣṭaḥ śabdo jāti- nibandhanaḥ |
' 'ye eva laukikāḥ śabdāsta eva vaidikāste evāmīpāmarthāḥ' iti sthitatvāt (1|3|9 varṇakaṃ 1) lokasiddhīpratīkṣe vede yatra ekadeśe'pi
jātinimittā labhyate, na tatra punarnimittāntaraśakti- kalpanā saṃbhavati |
saṃskṛteṣvapi jāteranapagamāt tanni- mittatātikramo na śakyo vaktum |
vyabhicaranti tu saṃskārān, avihita- tvāt lokavyavahāravelāyāṃ saṃskārāṇāmabhāvāt |
' yadi hi chedanavidhivelāyāṃ vacanavidhau vā kaścillauki- ko''rtho labhyeta, tataḥ kimivaṃ vyavasthitavacanavyaktivipa- yayena kalpyeta 'yacchidyate sa nūtaṃ yūpaḥ' iti |

śā - karmanāmaprasaṅgāt dravyanāmnāṃ bahirājyapuroḍāśa- śabdānāṃ saṃskṛteṣu śāstrasthaiḥ sarvaiḥ prayujyamānānāṃ asaṃskṛte'pi jātimātre kaiścicchāstraiḥ prayuktānāṃ kiṃ saṃskāranimittā yūpadivat, uta jātivācitā iti cintyate |
tatra pītvādiṣva aśvavālādivacca śāstra- yājñikaprasiddheḥ sārvalaukikī ca aśāstramlecchakṛti- payaprasiddhetyasī, iti saṃskāranimittā |

soma - pūrvatra puroḍāśaviṣayāmevasyaiva vicāri- tattvāt tatprasaṅgena puroḍāśaśabdasya, tattulyayogakṣematvā bahirājyaśabdasyatha buddhabuddhyārūḍhatvāt tadapi vicāra idānīṃ kriyate iti samanantarādhikaraṇasaṃgatiḥ : prāsaṅgikī |

prayojanam - saṃskāravācitve 'barhiṣā yūpavaṭamavastuṇāti' iti yūpavatstararṇahi samantrakā lavanadāyaḥ; 'ājyena yūpamanakti' iti yūpārjanārthe ājye vilāpanāvekṣaṇadāyaḥ; rauhiṇapuroḍāśadādhau samantrakapraṇādayaḥ kartavyaḥ; jāti- mātravācitve tu na kartavyā iti |
sūtrārthastu - asaṃskāre saṃskārābhāve'pi bahirājyayoḥ śabdalābhāt prayogalābhāt atacchabdaḥ saṃskārātiriktajātivācakaḥ bahirājyādiśabdaḥ
atra nyāyasāmyāt sūtre bahirājyaśabdagrahaṇamupa- lakṣaṇaṃ ityāśritya puroḍāśo'pyudāhṛtaḥ |
, jātiṃ tyaktvā na saṃskāre prayuktā lokavedayoḥ |

bhāṭṭa - bahirājya-puroḍāśādibdānāṃ saṃskṛteṣu śāstrasthaiḥ prayujyamānatvāt yūpadiśabdavat saṃskāramātra- vācitve saṃskāraviśiṣṭakuśādivācitve vā prāpte, jāti vihāya kairapyapyudyamānatvāt saṃskāraṃ vinā'pi loke 'bahirādāya gāvo |
' 'ājyaṃ krayyam' 'puro- ḍāśena me mātā prahelakaṃ dadāti' ityādau prayujyamānatvāt avyabhicārāllakṣaṇyavācca kuśādijātivācilemeva |
prayojanaṃ yūpavatstaraṇādyarthabahirādau pūrvapakṣe saṃskāra- karaṇam, siddhānte neti |
na ca bahirājyādhikaraṇanyāyena (1|4|7| 10) anārthavyavahāradapi rājapadasya kṣatriyajātiparatvaṃ syāt iti vācyam |
bahirājyāsthale anārthavyavahāradapi jātyarthatvam, āryavyavahārasya jātyavyabhicāratvāt, idaṃ pūrvapakṣe |
bahirājyādhikaraṇavārtikoktanyāyaḥ : 'eka- deśe'pi yaḥ śabdo dṛṣṭo jātinibandhakaḥ |
tena rājyarahite kṣatriye jātinimittatvenābhyupagatasya rājyaśabdasya rājya- yogini kṣatriye jātyatvāt aśvamedhe'pi ca kṣatriya- kāryapattyā prayogopapattiḥ |
bahirājyādiṣu ekadeśe'pi jātinimitta- tve labhyamāne nimittāntaraṃ na kalpanīyam |
barhistaraṇamantraḥ : ātithyāyāṃ 'ūrṇamṛdasaṃ tvā stṛṇāmi' ityādiḥ sa cātithyomīyabarhiṣi puna- rāvartanīyo deśabhedāt, barhistu svarūpeṇa tadeva |
barhirdharmo aṅgapradhānārthaḥ : na kevalaṃ pradhānārthaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
bhāṣyam - iha mantrā udāharaṇam 'barhirdevasadaṃ dāmi' ityevamādayaḥ |
kiṃ mukhye evamabhidheye mantrāṇāṃ viniyogaḥ, uta gauṇe'pīti |
kaḥ punarmukhyaḥ : ko vā gauṇa iti |
yaḥ śabdādeva avagamyate, sa prathama''rtho mukhyaḥ |
yastu khalu pratīyatādarthaṃ kaścit saṃbhavena gamyate, sa paścādbhāvāt jaghanyama bhavatīti jaghanyaḥ |
evameva agnimāṇavaka iti śabde uccārite māṇavakaṃ saṃpratyayaḥ |
yasmin nirupapadācchabdāt saṃpratyayaḥ sa mukhyaḥ; yasmin sopapadāt sa gauṇa iti |
yasya hi śabdasya rūpaṃ kasya cidarthasya nimi- ttam, sopapadāpi tadeva rūpaṃ nirupapadāpi |
na ca śakyaṃ nimitte sati naimittakena na bhavitum |
kimataḥ ? yadyevam, idaṃ na śakyate vadituṃ sopapadāhate na so'rtho
bhavati, upapade tu saṃjāte so'rthaḥ saṃjaniṣyate iti |
athocyate, yaḥ suṣṭhu prasiddhaḥ sa mukhyaḥ, yo manāgiva sa gauṇa iti |
yasya bahuśaḥ prayogo'sti sa mukhyaḥ, alpaśaḥ prayujyamāno gauṇa iti |
ataḥ so'pi śabdāt pratīyate iti mukhya eva |
anā- dṛṣṭyaiva māṇavakapratyayaṃ jvalanamiśabdāt pratiyato dṛśyate |
kuta etat ? yoyaḥ agniśabdo viśvakyate, tatratāgniśabdo niyata iti |
ata eva vigatasādṛśyāt ayaṃ tu dṛśyate (vigatasādṛśyata iti aya dṛśyate) |
na ca jvalane apratīte tatsādṛśyaṃ pratīyate |
tasmāt jvalanasya agniśabdo nimittam, na māṇavakasya |
evameva tṛṇapralayasya bahiḥśabdo nimittam, na tṛṇasadṛśapratyayasya |
tadevaṃ dvaite sati mukhyaparatā śabdasya, uta gauṇaparatā'pīti yukto vicāraḥ |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? mukhye gauṇe ca viniyogaḥ |
kutaḥ ? ubhayasya śakyatvāt, ubhayamapi vahniḥśabdena śakyate pratyāyituṃ tṛṇaṃ ca tṛṇasadṛśaṃ ca |
yacca nāma darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sādhanabhūtena vahniḥśabdena śakyate pratyāyitum, tat sarvaṃ pratyāyitavyam, viniṃgamanāyāṃ hetvabhāvāt |
api ca evamadhīyamāṇe pūṣādyanumantrāṇādīni darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ noktupyante |
mukhye eva viniyogo mantraḥ, na gauṇe iti |
tatraitadā- patati, yacchaknuyādanena mantreṇa sādhayitum, tathā sādhaye- diti |
sa cāsau arthābhidhānasaṃyogāt śaknotyupakartum, na gauṇamarthaṃ śaknotyabhidhātum |
mukhyapratyayayanevāsya prayojanavattā nivṛtteti na gauṇa prati viniyoge kiñcit pramāṇamasti |
na hi anabhidhāya mukhyaṃ gauṇamabhidati śabdaḥ |
api ca gauṇasya pratyāyane sāmarthyaṃ bahuvo- 'bhyupāyāḥ prāpnuvanti |
sāmarthyaṃ ca śabdaikadeśa ityuktam, 'arthādvā kalpanedeśatvāt' iti |
tatra mantre niyogato gauṇa prati viniyujyāmāne upāyāntaraṃ vinā pramāṇena bādhyeta |
yo gauṇe mantra viniyuṅkte sa vaktavyaḥ, kimarthaṃ mukhyaṃ pratyāyayasīti |
atha sa evamabhiyuktaḥ pratibrūyāt, mukhya- pratyayo'pi pākṣikau'bhyupāya iti |
brūyādenam, na tarhi niyogato gauṇe viniyojanīyaḥ |
yadā gauṇa- pratyayāya mukhyamupādyate, tadā etadāpatitaṃ bhavati, mukhye eva viniyogaḥ |
arthena ca pratīyate prayojanam, na pratyāyakena mantreṇa |
athāpi mantreṇa pratyāyakena prayojanaṃ syāt tathāpi mukhyapratyayane- naiva nivṛttaṃ prayojanamiti natarāṃ gauṇe viniyujyate |
tacca mukhye gauṇe ca kena cit prakāreṇa vidyate |
tatra viniyogaḥ : kiṃ mukhye evārthe bhavati uta gauṇe'pīti saṃdehe naiva gauṇo nāma kaścidastīti manvāna āha-- 'kaḥ punarmukhyaḥ ko vā gauṇaḥ ?' iti |
tassiddhisye tu siddhe gauṇe tannimittabhedaḥ svārthaparityāgavṛtitvaṃ ca vyākhyātaṃ ityayamarthādvicāraḥ pūrvaṃ pratyetavyaḥ |
tatra ca 'śabdārtha- syaiva mukhyatvaṃ mukhyatvaṃ prathamodate |
ityevaṃ- lakṣaṇaṃ gauṇatvaṃ ityataḥ sarva eva (arthaḥ) śabde uccarite abhidhīyamānatvādanyataḥ śabdaśakti kalpanāṃ kurvan arthāntareṇavyavahitatvāt prathamameva mukhyamabha- vīti mukhyaḥ |
tatra paraparikalpitāni tāvat gauṇatva- kāraṇāni upanyastāni-- athocyeta yasminniprapadādi- tyādi |
nahi yathā kevalā- dagniśabdāt jvalanapratyayo bhavati, evaṃ māṇavakapratyayaḥ, padāntarādhīnatvāt |
yatrāpi padāntaraṃ na śrūyate, tatrāpi arthaprakaraṇādilabhyaṃ tadeva vyāpriyate ityavyabhicāraḥ |
tadeva ca sāmānyaṃ nāma pravṛttiheturguṇa iti |

' yathaiva cakṣuṣaḥ prakāśānugrahāpekṣitve'pi rūpamarthaḥ, yathā vā muktasaṃśayasya mukhyasya varṇakramamātrāgrahaṇasaṃskāra- smṛtisaṃvandhanānubhavāpekṣitvam, tathā atropapadampi naiva vinā sāmarthyaṃ nāmāpekṣituṃ śakyate |
tena vinā''pyupapadena sa tasyārtho bhavatyeva, kathañcit nābhivyajyate |
athopapadasya dyotakatvaṃ parityajya tulyakalpatocyate, yasmānnityāṃ māṇavakāgniśabdasamudāyāt asyārthasya pratītiḥ ataḥ : aśvakarṇādivat samudāyavācyatve sati avayavasya gauṇatvamiti |
' na cāsau samudāyārthaḥ śakyato vaktumiha tvayā |
' tatra samudāyaprasiddharbhavati, yatrā- vayavārtho tirodhāya tyaktbhedaḥ samudāyaḥ eva pratīyate |
gamyate tu atrāgniśabdasya paiṅgalyam, māṇavakaśabdasya ca piṇḍasvarūpaṃ viviktaṃ vācyam |
ata ubhāvapi prātyā- ttikorapi vācakatvāt mukhyāviti |
idānīmavayavānu- sāreṇa samudāyārthatvaṃ samarthayamāna āha-- anugatasvārtha- padadvayagamyatvāt nīlotpalavadvākyārthaḥ |
ataśca tasya padārthapratyayatvāt śabdaṃ prati pūrvavedava gauṇatvamiti |
na ca bhavataḥ paiṅgalyaṃ vācyam, asatyakṣābhedaprasaṅgāt |
tena jvalane māṇavakasya ca paiṅgalye tulyavacchabdapravṛttiriti mukhyatvam |
athocyyate yaḥ suṣṭhu prasiddha iti muklā upapadavyāpāre yatkṛtaṃ tasyāśrayamāṇamāśrayaṇaṃ ca, te eva mandasuṣṭhuprasiddhau gauṇamukhyavibhāgaya darśayati |
tatrottaram-- ' prasiddhiriti vijñānaṃ na cāsyonāti- rittate |
tasmānna tatkṛtaḥ śakyo viśeṣo vaktu- mañjasā |
' idānīṃ śrotagataprasiddhebhedamuklaṃ vaktugataṃ vahalpa- prayogittvaṃ vibhāgārthaṃ darśayati |
' ihāpi ca gauśabdasya pṛthivyādau mandasuṣṭhuprasiddhadviprayogo darśayitavyau |
na cātra maṇḍakā mukhyā gauṇā vā khaṇḍa- modakāḥ |

māṇavakasāmanādhikaraṇye aruṇāśabdantyena sati sādṛśya- 'bhidhānāt asati ca anabhidhānāt, anyatrāsādṛśya- vati vṛttidarśanāt asati cādarśanāt, viśeṣaṇatvāt avaśyamabhiprāyamapratyāyane sādṛśyameva prathamaṃ pratī- yitavyam |
na cānavagate'rthau tat pratīyate iti prathama- taramarthebhidhānam |
ete ca tassiddhasūtrektai: saha nava gauṇapakṣā draṣṭavyā: |
' (1- svārthe jahātīti jahatsvārtha: arthāntarābhidhāyī ca, tasya bhāvo jahatsvārthā- bhidhāyitvam, guṇaliṅgāpyanvisvārthatvena guṇarūpe paiṅgyādau vṛtti: gauṇatve kāraṇam |
2- anyādijāti- paiṅgyādiguṇasaṃghāta: anyādiśabdavācya: san jāti- rahitaguṇamātre śabdapravṛttihetutvāt gauṇatvakāraṇam |
3- anyādiśabdavācyasya agnivāde: māṇavakādau anyādiguṇadarśanena kalpanāma gauṇatvakāraṇam |
6- agnimāṇavaka: ityādiśabdasya avayavārthānapekṣavarṇa- samudāyatvena paiṅgyādau yā prasiddhi: tasyā: bhāva: samudāyāvayavabhūtasya anyādiśabdasya paiṅgyādau pravṛtti- hetutvāt gauṇatvakāraṇam |
6- paiṅgyāde: agnimāṇavaka: ityādivākyārthatvaṃ anyādiśabdasya paiṅgyādau vākyā- vayavatvatyāgaguṇavattvāt gauṇatvakāraṇam |
7- anyā- diśabdasya paiṅgyādau alpaśrutaprasiddhatvaṃ ajñātryaguṇa- bhūtopapadāpekṣatvanimittāt gauṇatvakāraṇam |
8- yasmin paiṅgyādau anyādiśabdasya alpairvaktṛbhi: prayoga: sa: alpaprayogī, tasya bhāva: alpaprayogitā alpasiddhatva- vat gauṇa:vakāraṇam |

etān gauṇatvakāraṇān nirasya anyādiśabdavācyena abhilādinā anyādiguṇasya paiṅgyāderlakṣaṇamā māṇavakādau agnyādiguṇavati agni- śabdapravṛttihetutvāt gauṇaśabdavācyatvarūpagauṇatvakāraṇatvena sādhitā |
sudhā. pṛ. 1083) (pūrvapakṣabhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-) 'tatra nityaṃ parārtha- tvādubhayatra prayogitā |
' evaṃ ca sati gauṇyā dhṛtyā puṣādiśabdai: anyādyabhidhānāt anutkarṣo bhaviṣyati |
mukhyena ca kṛtārthānāṃ na gauṇe śruti- kalpanā |
' 'apivā prayogasāmarthyāt' (2|1|6 | 31) ityanena hi nyāyena abhidheye tāvat viniyogāya mantrā: śrutiṃ parikalpayanti |
tatra yadi jahatsvārthā gauṇī vṛttirbhavet tatsatyatvadavamantrāpi śruti: kalpyeta |

yadi tu gauṇamapi vadatā pūrvataraṃ svārtho'bhidheya: tadā tadati- kramakāraṇābhāvāt tadviniyogaśrutau kalpitāyāṃ nirā- kāṅkṣeṣu mantraprakaraṇasāmarthyādhyayanavidhiṣu na puna: śrutikalpanaheturstīti na viniyoga: |
' tenaiva sūtrārtha: yasmādarthābhidhānasaṃyogānmanatreṣu śeṣabhāva: tasmādautpattikenaivārthenārthe saṃyoga: syāt |
bhāṣyam-- aya yaduktaṃ pūṣādyanmantrāṇāmutkarṣo na bhaviṣyati |
vā-- anaudite pūṣādau, darśapūrṇamāsayormantrānna viniyujyante, yuktameva tat |
kathaṃ punarevāmuktānāṃ vaidikai: karmabhiryoga:; kathaṃ vā katvaṅgasāmanyaviniyogamantareṇa liṅgaṃ devatāyāmeva kevalayā viniyogakamiti |
' yāgānumantraṇasamākhyā hyeṣāṃ yāgasaṃbandhāde anupapadya- mānā yāgasāmānyāllakṣatvaṃ gamayati |
tātparyaṃ ca khato mukhye, gauṇārthaparatā puna: |
' soma-- prayojanam- mantrāṇāṃ gauṇe'pi viniyoge prākṛtānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ gauṇyā vṛttyā vaikṛtadravyadevatā- ''diprakāśakatvasaṃbhavāt uhāsasiddhi:; siddhānte tu mukhyā- rthatvāya uhasiddhiditi |
sūtrārthastu - yat : kāraṇāt arthābhidhānasaṃyogāt arthābhidhānalakṣaṇadarsayogāt mantreṣu kratuśeṣatvaṃ syāt |
tasmāt utpattisaṃyoga: autpattikena mukhyārthenaiva saṃyoga: syāt, tenārthena nityasaṃyogāt iti |
ta- liṅgamarthyayormantraṃ niyukte mukhya eva vā |
bhāṭṭa-- evaṃ śrutūpayogivicāre vṛtte adhunā liṅgo- payogivicāra: prastūyate |
tatra liṅgaṃ nāma ajñatvaghaṭakī- bhūtaparodeyatvakṛtikārakavācakapadakalpanākulā klapta- suvanitvā dravyadvayapadakalpanā''nukūlā |
evaṃ mantreṣu svārthe- vṛṣṭyuddeśyatāvācipadakalpanā''nukūlā svavṛttikārakatvādi- padakalpanā''nukūla ca yogyatā liṅgam |
sā ca padarūpa- śrutikalpakatvāt taddvārā tadarthaviniyoge pramāṇam |

tatra vastusāmarthyarūpasya liṅgasya viśeṣavicārāsaṃbhavāt mantra- sāmarthyarūpasya ki śakye evārthe viniyojakatvam, uta jaghanyavṛttipratipādye''pi saṃdehe, ṛtūpakaraṇamātramantrasya 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' ityādimukhye iva jaghanye'pi utsa- rājyādau smārakākāṅkṣādirūpasāmarthyaviśeṣatvāt tatsā- dhāraṇyena viniyoga: |
iti prāpte, śakyasaṃbandhagrahasāpekṣatvena jaghanyārthapratītirvilambitātvāta jaghanyārthapratītimukhyārthaviniyogena caritārthasya mantrāde: jaghanyārthaviniyogo'nupapatte: |
ata etra yatra prakaraṇe mukhyārthopayogo na klapta:, tatra mantrāmnāyabaladeva tatkalpanā |

yatra tu virodhaguṇānāntarāvarodha: prakaraṇe, tatra sāmānyasaṃbandha- bodhakapramāṇasattve utkarṣa: yathā darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇamāta- pūpānānmantramantrāde: ; yāgānumantraṇamākhyāyā eva sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakatvāt |
utkarṣasyāpyasaṃbhave prakaraṇe eva jaghanyārthe viniyoga: yathā manotā''dau |
aprayukta- lakṣaṇādinā tasyāpyasaṃbhave tadarthābhidhānasyaiva aṣṭārthatvaṃ yathā japādau |
' barhirnyāya: 'dravyasaṃskāra: prakaraṇaviśeṣāt sarva- karmaṇām' (3|8|15|13) iti sūtrokta: dharmāṇā- maṅgapradhānasādhāraṇyasya |
barhi:praharaṇāntaṃ hāriyojanādi karma dvādaśāha prathamādinavamānteṣu ekādaśe'hani ca na kartavyam, kintu patnīsaṃyājānte virāma: kartavya: |
barhiḥśabdaḥ tṛṇapratyayasya nimittam, na tṛṇasadṛśa- pratyayasya |
bhā. 3|1|15 pṛ. 749. barhiḥśabdo na saṃskāravācako niyamena, yathā 'barhirādāya gāvo gatāḥ' ityatra |
ata eva 'barhiṣā yūpavattvavastūni' atra vinā saṃskāreṇa staraṇasiddhiḥ |
vi. 1|4|8 barhiḥśabdaḥ saṃskāraśabdaḥ uta jātiśabdaḥ iti sandehe jātiśabdo'yam, na saṃskāra- śabdaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhā. 1|4|170, barhiḥ- śabdena ubhayamapi śakyate pratyāyayituṃ tṛṇaṃ ca tṛṇasadṛśaṃ ca, tṛṇaṃ sākṣāt, tṛṇasadṛśaṃ ca tṛṇapratyayena |
3|2|11 pṛ. 749. barhiḥsaṃnahanamantraḥ 'indrāṇyai saṃnahanam' (taisaṃ. 1|1|2|2) haraṇamantraśca 'bṛhaspatermūrdhā harāmi' iti |
ātithyāsaṃskṛte barhiṣi saṃnahya agnīṣomīyadeśe nīyamāne, tau mantrau na prayojyau |
tau hi lavanadeśāt ānayane prayojyau, na gārhapatyadeśāt āhavanīyadeśe prati ānayane |
ātithyā gārhapatyadeśe kriyate, agnī- ṣomīyagaśca āhavanīyadeśe |
vi. 1|1|2|1. barhiḥstaraṇamantre prākṛte haritapadasthāne raktapadasya ūhaḥ maitre carau |
balādalādhikaraṇe ( 3|3|14 balādalādhikaraṇe ) videcanādīnāṃ sthānāt abhiṣecanīyājñatvasya pratibhāsa- mānasya prakaraṇatvāt rājasūyājñatvena bādho vakṣyate |
yadeva atyantaṃ pramāṇābhāsameva mṛgatṛṣṇājñānavadvati tat sarvadeva parihartavyam |
yat punaḥ baladvirodhāpekṣaṃ apramāṇaṃ bhavati tat virodhābhāvāt pramāṇamevetyavadhāra- ṇīyam |
1|3|1|10 pṛ. 227. balāvalaṃ kramaviṣayakaśrutyā- dīnāṃ pañcame'dhyāye ucyate |

' vā. 3|1| 11 pṛ. 652. śrauta-arthasthānāt bādhyabādhakatvalakṣaṇaṃ balāvalamālocyate ( 'uccairṛcā kriyate' ityādi ), tacca virodhahetutvāt mukhyaśraddhāvāpekṣam, na vidhyarthavāda- padasyālocanāt viparītaṃ bhavati |
balādalādhikaraṇam śruti- liṅga- vākya- prakaraṇa- sthāna-samā- khyānāṃ samavāye pāradaurbalyamarthaviprakarṣāt |
bhāṣyam-- uktāni viniyogakāraṇāni śrutiḥ liṅgaṃ vākyaṃ prakaraṇaṃ sthānaṃ samākhyānamiti |
teṣāṃ samavāye kiṃ valīya iti cintyate |
ekārthavṛttitvāt vāco yugapada- saṃnatvāt dvayordvayoḥ saṃpradhāraṇā |
śrutibalāvalavicāraḥ-- tatra śrutiliṅgayoḥ kiṃ śrutirbalīyasī, āhosvit liṅgamiti |
kimindrasya gārhapatyasya vopasthānaṃ kartavyamitiniyamaḥ uta gārhapatyasyaiveti |
yadi tulyabale ete kāraṇe, tato vikalpaḥ |
kiṃ punaratra śrutiḥ ? kiṃ liṅgam ? śrutirgārhapatyaśabdaśravaṇam |
liṅgaṃ punaḥ 'kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe' iti indraśabdasya viśiṣṭadevatābhidhānasāmarthyam |
atha kiṃ vākyaṃ nāma ? saṃhṛtya arthamabhidadhāti padāni vākyam |
yathaiva- midamapi vākyam 'aindyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti, idamapi 'kadā cana starīrasi' iti |
tena vākyasya vākyasya caiṣā saṃpradhāraṇā, na śrutiliṅgayoḥ |
yadi vā, śrutiliṅga- vākyāni vivektavyāni, idaṃ śrutivākyayorantaram, idaṃ liṅgavākyayoriti |
tadetat sarva- ṣveva vākyeṣu samavetaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ ca dṛśyate |
iha tāvat, 'kadā cana starīrasi' ityanena mantreṇa indra upasthātavya iti naitat kasya cicchabdasya śravaṇādevāvagamyate |
nāpi śabdāntarasya samīpe uccāritasya sāmarthyamasti, yenaitadava- gamyeta |
etasyāṃ khalu ṛci indraśabdo vidyate, yo viśiṣṭaṃ devatāmavagamayituṃ śaknoti |
na tvevamasmābhiḥ kasya cicchabdasya sāmarthyārhaṇapatyasyopasthānaṃ bhavati |
śravaṇādeva tu gārhapatyaśabdasya vayamapi pratīmaḥ, na liṅgāt |
yadi tu liṅgaṃ balīyaḥ, indra upasthātavyaḥ |
evaṃ tarhi liṅgavākye virudhyamāne iha saṃpradhārye, na śrutiliṅge |
indraśabdasya viśiṣṭadevatā- bhidhānasāmarthyādindropasthānam, yadi liṅgaṃ balīyaḥ; atha nu vākyam, gārhapatya upastheyaḥ |
yadyapi eta- dvākyam, śrutirapi antarāsti, yā tvatra śrutiḥ, sā liṅgena virudhyate, na yadākyam |
katham ? balīyasyapi hi liṅge, aindyopatiṣṭhate ityetadarthāpatterapi saha ekavākyatvāmu- paityeva |
yadi hi nopayeyāt tato liṅgena virudhyeta |
yastu gārhapatyaśravaṇādevārthaḥ pratīyate, sa liṅgena balīyasi pari- tyakto bhavati |
atha nu śrutiḥ : pramāṇaṃ bhavati, tato liṅgenāvāgata indropasthānaṃ bādhyate |
kutastarhi ? indraśabdavattvāt mantrasya indra- prādhānyam, dvitīyāvibhaktiśravaṇāt gārhapatyādhānyam |
vā-- ( asmin adhikaraṇe vārtikātpūrvaṃ bhāṣyādyanusāreṇa manāka parivartatā ityeveyam |
tacca bhinna- viṣayāṇāṃ na saṃbhavatīti samavāye ekārthopanipāto viṣaya- tvenodāhṛtaḥ |
' eka eva haraṇādiḥ śeṣaḥ śrutyādiprakriyāsaṃbandhī, vākyena tadviśeṣasya krayasya, prakaraṇena jyotiṣṭomikasya |
satyapi vācanikaprakaraṇasamavāye parasparānugrahanimittatvād- virodha iti balāvalavicāro na bhavati, nirviśeṣasāmānyā- nupapatteḥ |
krayasvarūpamātrayuktatve cānarthakatvāt apekṣite hi śrutivākyābhyāṃ vākyaprakaraṇe |
tasya tu śrutikalpitakriyākārakasaṃbandhasya bhūyo'pyapekṣā- vaśena krayaviṣayatvam |
tāvatā ca prayojanānavāpteḥ apekṣāntare sati apūrvasaṃbandhavataḥ krayasya jyotiṣṭomārtha- tvamiti viṣayānānātvam |
na cātra viprakṛṣṭagrahaṇe saṃnikṛṣṭasya bādho dṛśyate |
nahi krayaṃ gṛhṇan aruṇāyāḥ kriyāsaṃbandhaṃ bādhate, nāpi jyotiṣṭome kurvan krayasaṃbandham |

yatra tu ekaḥ śeṣaḥ, tāvāneva saṃbandhantarāvarodhivinā ekena pramāṇena anyaśeṣatvau vijñāyate, pareṇa tadavādhānupapattinā śeṣāntarārthaḥ; ekasaṃbandhve ca kṛtārthasya ākāṅkṣā''bhāvāt punarviniyogānānupapattiḥ; tatra pramāṇayoḥ : parasparapa- hāryasamānaviṣayatvalakṣaṇaḥ samavāyaḥ |

tathā yatra śeṣa- mede'pi ekasminneva śeṣiṇi tulyopakāranibandhanaḥ : ekena pramāṇenayaḥ śeṣaḥ sādhanatvena pratīyate, anyenāparaḥ; na caikāsādhitopakāraḥ śeṣī śeṣāntaramapekṣate, tatrāpi eka- viṣayāpaharitvāt samavāyaḥ |
yadvā brāhmaṇagatamevaikavākya- tvamadhikaraṇaṃ vivakṣan prasaṅgānmantre'pyupasthitamiti vyālaye- yam |
tatra vākyaṃ chettat ‘aindryā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate’ ityasyābhiprāyaḥ - yadaindyāḥ tṛtīyāśrutyā śeṣatvamātrama- vagataśeṣiviśeṣaṃ pratīyate |
yattu (yacca) gārhapatyamiti dvitīyāyā kimapi prati śeṣitvamātram, na tasya liṅgena saha kaścidvirodhaḥ |
padāntarasaṃbandhe hyasya yathārthameva aindyāḥ karaṇatvaṃ syāt |
gārhapatyasya vā yāṃ kāṃ cidāgneyīṃ prati śeṣitvaṃ bhavet |
parasparasaṃnidhānamapi hi śrutiṃ pīḍayitvā śakyamavirodhena netum |
paraḥ punaḥ pratyayopādānaṃ aikāntikaṃ gṛhītvā savicikitsat saṃdehaviparyayānadhyava- sāyānāṃ anyatamaṃ manyamāna āha- 'naitadyuktam |
tasya (ca) śruteśca naiva saṃdhāraṇā asti' iti kimiyaṃ aindrī bhavati na bhavati, ityaniścitaḥ |
tasya śrutirodhe apramāṇatvāt naivaṃ tayā saha balābalacintā |
yatastu nirvicikitsa aikāntena etadevatya 'yaṃ mantra iti pratyayaḥ, sa śrutyā saha tulyabalatvādirkspitumarhati |
itarastu svābhiprametameva savicikitsatvaṃ gṛhītvā ''ḍa evaṃ hi sati naiva liṅgaṃ nāma kiñcit pramāṇamabhaviṣyat' iti |
siddhāntavādī tu vadati yadi saviśeṣapratyayopādānamātreṇa kupitaṃ liṅgaṃ prāmāṇyameva muñcati 'kāma mā bhūt pramāṇam, bhavati tu saṃśayo liṅgaparijñāteṣveva' iti |
kathaṃ punaḥ saviśeṣatvaṃ parityajya saṃśaya eva saviciki- tsatvamudāhriyate |
yadavirodhakāle liṅgasyāvagataṃ viniyojakatvam, tatra tathaiva sarvatraiva avatiṣṭhate |
anyatra avirodhāt viniyogo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ, sa iha kiṃ tathaiva bhavati atha kena cidvāvatiṣṭhate iti |
tāvadeva saṃdeho bhavati tāvat pratyakṣā śrutirnopalabhyate |
na ca tāvatā viniyoga ukto bhavati |
yathā satyāmapi viprarājanyau na na vaiśyastaṃ kurutaḥ |
parastu virodhaviṣayamaprāmāṇyamabhidhānaṃ asahātvā sārvatrika- mevedamukkamiti mītaḥ prāmāṇyamartha darśayati 'prakaraṇavato- 'sya saṃnidhāne yarmethāmananti' iti |
tadetat 'api vā prayogasāmarthyānmantro'bhidhānavācī syāt' ityatra 'avi- śiṣṭāstu vākyārthaḥ' ityatra ca varṇitam |
vādinā'pi virodhe sulabhatarapramāṇatvaṃ vakṣyāmīti manya- mānena prathamaṃ svatantrameva tāvadaprāmāṇyaṃ darśitam |
tatra itareṇa virodhaviṣaya manāhatya prāmāṇyaṃ tāvadastīti nirūpya tulyabalatvamabhihitam |
indraśabdasya gauṇatvā- davayavaprasiddhervā indre mukhyatvāt samudāyaprasiddhervirodha iti cet |
prayogabhede tu sati gārhapatyābhidhānavelāyāṃ yajñasādhanatvaṃ vā guṇaṃ indrakriyālyaiśvaryayogaṃ vā''ṅgīkṛtya pravatsyati |
' yattu prakaraṇāt sāmarthyācchratvānu- mānamukkama, tacchabdenasaṃstṛṣṭaṃ īdṛśeṣveva apramāṇami- tyuktam |
parastu sārvatrikameva liṅgasyāśabdatvamuktamiti manyamāno na tarhi virodhādvāḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? apramāṇa- tvādeveti vivakṣan yathevamityāha |
siddhāntavādī tu yathā prathamaṃ pūrvapakṣavādinā liṅgasya prāmāṇyaṃ uktamāsīt tathedānīṃ svārthaṃ pratipādayati |
bhavati hi prakaraṇārthaḥ, yathā śakyatāthā yāgasya anenopakuryāditi |
na ca svārthābhidhānādanyathā śaknoti asāvupakatumiti tatra viniyogaścodito bhavati |
kledānīṃ gamiṣyatītyetāne''ha 'yadi śrutimūlaḥ, na śrutyantareṇa bādhituṃ śakyaḥ' |
tena yadi tāvat aśabdo'yamarthaḥ, tato naiva pramāṇam |
ānumānikyāḥ śruteḥ avirodhe sati ātmalābhāt virodhe cānutpādāt |
yatra hi pratyakṣayā śrutyā mantro na viniyogo prati nirākāṅkṣīkṛtaḥ : tamāsya
viniyogasiddhayarthaṃ yāvat kalpyate tatsarvaṃ āmānā- nyathā'nupapattimudritatvāt vaidikaṃ bhavati |
yatra vispaṣṭamevāvagataṃ anena gārhapatya upastheya iti tatra āmnānaprayojanena sādhye prayogopakāre vijñāte naitāvat kalpyamānaṃ vedaḥ sahate anena indropasthānaṃ kartavya- miti |
' svatantrayā śrutyā nityameva gārhapatyopasthānaṃ coditam, liṅgena svatantreṇa indropasthānam |
tatrānyatarāśrayaṇe sati itaraccoditaṃ sañ kriyate, tatpakṣayā cetaraccoditaṃ sat kṛtam |
coditasya kartavyatā prasiddhiḥ; itarasyā- kartavyatvam, tadubhayamatikriyate |
yastu virodhaparihārārthaṃ samuccaya'mihitastatra bhramaḥ, astyeva virodhaḥ |
tatra śrutivini- yogavelāyāṃ mantraprakaraṇonirākāṅkṣatvaṃ bhavedvā na vā |
tadyadi tāvat nāsti, tato viniyoga evāsiddhaḥ |
atha tu asti, tataśca ākāṅkṣā'dhīnasiddhitvāt laiṅgikaviniyogā'nupapattiḥ |
yugapadvā''śrayaṇe hi asyā''kāṅkṣā nāsti veti viprati- pannaṃ syāt |
evaṃ satyapi yadi pramāṇasyetyevapravṛttitta bhavettato viśeṣāgrahaṇaṃ jñāyeta kena prathamataraṃ nirā- kāṅkṣa iti |
atastasyā viniyukte mantre, na liṅga- syākāṅkṣa''stīti śrutibalīyastvasiddhiḥ |
' (pṛ. 849-847). ( śrutiprābalyavicāraḥ - ) kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? sarvapramāṇāni tulyabalāni ityavagantavyam |
' sarvatra pratyakṣā- dāvapi dravyeṇa gatiḥ pramāṇasvarūpaṃ pramāṇabhāsaṃ ca |
na tatra yat pramāṇam, tat kadā cidapi pramāṇabhāso bhavati |
yo'pi tadābhāsaḥ, so''pi naiva pramāṇaṃ bhavati |
śrutyā- diṣṭakasya ca samastasya khaviṣaye prāmāṇyaṃ sthāpitam |
na caitadvipayāntarasaṃcāre'sti yatra daurbalyamāśaṅkyate, na caitadupasthāpitaṃ jñānamanutpannaṃ śakyaṃ ca veditum |
na ca cotpannasya svarasabhaṅguratvāt uttareṇa vināśaḥ |
nāpyanuṣṭhānāsyāt phalāt viniyogaḥ śakyate kartum, anuṣṭhānapratyayasya dṛḍhatvāt |
' śrutyādīnāṃ hi pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ śīghrataraṃ pravartate |
' ( yadyapi śrutyā viniyogaḥ pratīyate, tathāpi aśaktasya nāvakalpate iti apīdārthaḥ |
sāmarthyavākyasya tu ākāṅkṣārūpāṇāṃ liṅga-vākya-prakaraṇānāṃ ekavākyatvākāṅkṣānirlapaiḥ vākyaprakaraṇasyā''naiva rūpyaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ |
atra yadyapi ānandamayīye 'yogo'va- kalpate' iti pāṭhaḥ, tathāpi sudhā'nusāreṇa pāṭho grāhyaḥ |
utpattikāle yasyānvayaviṣayasāmarthyamavagatam, na tasya tadviniyogakāle parāvartituṃ śakyate |
evaṃ yasya yena saha saṃbandha ekavākyatayā na vidyate, na tasya tadvidhayā śaktiḥ kalpyate |
tadabhāve tu naitadastīti pūrvataramādivādā- kāṅkṣātmakaṃ prakaraṇameva jyāyaḥ |
nahyasaṃni- hitamapekṣitaṃ saṃbandhaṃ sā śakyam, ato yatra saṃnidhiḥ tatra sarvamiti balīyastvam |
dhīstasyāḥ saṃnikarṣeṇa vipra- karṣeṇa ca sthitā |
' yadi śrutiliṅgādīnāmapi svata- ntrāṇāṃ prāmāṇyamabhaviṣyat, tata etadupapadyeta |
kathaṃ punareṣāṃ svātantryeṇa prāmāṇyaṃ na bhavati |
tatra pratyakṣagṛhītāni yānyakṣarāṇi viniyujyante, sā śrotra- vṛttitvāt śrutirityucyate |
yatra tu aviniyojyānya- kṣarāṇi pratyakṣaṃ gṛhītvā viniyojakānyarthāpattyā kalpyante tatra liṅgādīni bhavanti |

aindrīviniyogaṃ hi prati śrutiliṅgayoḥ saha prasthitayoryadā śruterviniyojakānyakṣarāṇi dṛśyante, tadā liṅge smaraṇa- samarthāni, tato yāvat teṣāṃ prakaraṇāgmānānyā sutanupapatyā viniyojakāni kalpayitumārabhyante, tāvadityaiḥ pratyakṣairvi- niyogaḥ pratyāyitaḥ |
tasmiṃśca pratīyate mantrā'pi prakaraṇāni prati nirākāṅkṣībhūtaḥ |
tathā sati prakaraṇābhāsasya anyathā''dyupapadyamānatvāt nendrāmi- dhānaśrutikalpanāyāmāpattiḥ prabhavati |
na ca śruti- mantareṇa viniyogaḥ sidhyati |
bahudhā varṇitaṃ caitatpura- stāt, yathā sākāṅkṣe vedārthe yatkalpyate, tadaindrikam, netaraditi |
nahi sākṣāt : kiñci- danyadapekṣaṇīyamasti, yathā liṅgasya śrutirevam |
' yaḥ parādhīnavṛttiḥ sa tadyathā kathaṃ- caret |
' śrutyādīnāṃ hi pūrvapūrvamuttarottaranirapekṣaṃ pravarta- mānaṃ balavadvati, paraṃparaṃ tu pūrvādhīnaprāmāṇyaṃ na śaknoti tasyaiva bādhaṃ kartum |
' viniyogottarakālaṃ hi kathametat sādha- yiṣyati ityapekṣite, yathā śaknotītyavadhāraṇā bhavati |
tatra yadyapi svarūpeṇa tadviṣayā śaktirna dṛśyate, tathāpi viniyogadarśanādeva anumīyate |
nanu ca prāgavidyamānasāmarthyasya viniyogo na saṃbhavatīti pūrvavata sāmarthyamanumātavyam |
pūrvabhāvinvena tat kalpyate, na tu pūrvameva gamyate |
nirvṛttaviniyogā- nyā''nupapatyā pūrvamapi vividyamānaṃ paścādeva anumīyate |
satyametatsāmānam, na tu tat balābalaṃ prati upayujyate |
' liṅge hi prāgavidyamānā śrutyanumānena vinā viniyogābhidhānātvāt dūratvaṃ bhavati |
śrutau punarapagate viniyogābhidhāne yasmā- detadevam, tasmāt nūnaṃ kimapi sāmarthyamastīti paścāt pravartamānamanumānam, na viniyogapratyayaviśeṣaṃ karoti |
sahaprasthitayorhi pramāṇayoryena viniyogadeśāśritena prāpto bhavati, sa vikṣepo daurbalyakaro bhavati |
avadhārite tu viniyoge, yadyapi paścādanumānasahatvaṃ bhavati na tathāpi kaścidvikarṣaḥ |
sarvatra hi parasya pūrvamanumāya viniyogānupa- pattiḥ |
pūrveṇa tu kute viniyoge parasya nāntarīyakaṃ
(śrutivirodhe-) yathā caiṣāmarthaviprakarṣādijā- tīyaiḥ saha balābalamevaṃ sajātīyairapi hetusāmānyāṃ tatra darśayitavyam |
tadyathā śruterava tāvat sāmānyaviśeṣā- dibhāvena śeṣaviṣayaḥ samavāyaḥ |
'puroḍāśaṃ caturthā karoti' ityaviśeṣaśravaṇāt amīpomīyādāvapi prāpnuvat 'āgneyaṃ caturthā' iti viśeṣaśravaṇena viśeṣe caturthā- karaṇamupasaṃhriyate |
tathā śeṣasamavāye 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti samasyutyā juhotisāmānyādhikaraṇyena avabhṛthe'pi āhavanīyaḥ prāpyāmāno viśeṣasaṃyuktā 'apasvavabhṛthe' ityanayā bādhyate |
etaiva diśā anumānādiṣvevapi sajātīyavijātīyasamavāye vicāra- yitavyam |
tatra ca pratyakṣagamyāmānānumānikaiḥ, ānu- mānikānāṃ cānumānikaiḥ saha pūrvoktenaiva mārgeṇa sajātī- yavijātīyabalavalaṃ vyākhyāyam |
pūrvapūrvamapi hyānumānikaṃ paraṃpara- ṇāpi pratyakṣeṣaṇa prāpyate |
sarvavastuviṣayaṃ ca sāmarthyam, liṅgaṃ kevalaṃ mantragatamevāva- gantavyam |
tathā ca yānyanyapadārthāni ananyagatīni, teṣāmapi liṅgatvamabhidhāsyate |
kā punaratra liṅgasya prāptiḥ, ananyāsaṃbhava ityādi |
yatra punaḥ śrutiḥ ānumānikī liṅgaṃ ca pratyakṣam, tatra katham |
tatra smṛtermūlāntaramapi saṃbhāvyate, na tu liṅga- syeti tadeva baladityanusartavyam |
pramāṇasya bādhe yadi kiñcidarthakī bhavati, tato viparītato bādho yojayitavyaḥ |

tatra yadā padārtha- taddharmaviṣaye pramāṇe virudhyete, tatra yadyapi pramāṇato'nyā- dṛśaṃ balābalam, tathāpi prameyānurodhena tadāśrayaṇāt svarūpadurbalatvenāpi balavat bādhyamānaṃ tadanuguṇyaṃ pratipadyate |
' evaṃ sūtram, śrutiliṅgavirodhopapādanāntaṃ ca bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyā- tam |
śrutivākyayorvirodhe, aruṇādivākyasāmarthyāt ānanyatayaisāmānādhikaraṇyāmyāṃ ekahāyanyāviśeṣatvaṃ prāpnu- vat tṛtīyāśrutyā kathamarthanitvena viśāyate |
dvitīya- sopānabhūtārohaṇakroriva dhātvartha vākyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ kalpayati, tāvat śrutyā viniyogaḥ kalpitaḥ, iti maha- dantaram |
śrutiprakaraṇayorvirodhe prakaraṇāderviṃśatyā- dhanuvacanānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsādiṣvāpte, śrutyaiva pratiṣṭhā- kāmādiṣu puruṣārthavicāraṇāt prakaraṇagrāhaḥ |
anuvacanānāṃ ca kriyātmakatvādi kartṛtārūpatvāt prakaraṇagrāhyatvena tadvirodhodāharaṇatvam |

'tila eva sāhutyopasado dvādaśā- hīnasya' iti tu dvādaśatvasya akriyātvāt aniti- kartavyatātmakatve sati kathamabhāvaprakaraṇagrāhyatvānupapatteḥ saṃnidhimātreṇa prakaraṇakalpanāparvakasaṃbandhavācyasattvā śruti- sthānavirodhodāharaṇatvaṃ yuktamityeke |
kutaḥ ? 'yadi dravyagatā saṃkhyā svatantrā vā bhave- diyam |
saha dharmeṇa sā yāti krameṇa paśuśepatām ||
yāvat prakaraṇādīni tasyāḥ kalpa- yati kramaḥ |

pauroḍāśi- kamiti samākhyāte darśapūrṇamāsakāṇḍe paṭhito mantraḥ sādhāraṇe prakaraṇe vartamānaḥ krameṇa cānumīlitaliṅgena aviniyujyamānaḥ puroḍāśasyaiva prāthamyāt prāpnu- van, śrutyā sāṃnāyyasyāsājñātvena vidhīyate 'iṣe tvā śākhāṃ chinatti' iti |
tatrāpi yāvat samākhyā kiñcit sāmānyaṃ kalpyate, tāvat śrutyā viniyuktatvāt prakaraṇavākyasāmarthyaśrutiṣu akalpitāstveva bādhaḥ |
evaṃ tāvadekasya śeṣasya anekaṃ śeṣaṃ prati nīya- mānasya virodha udāhṛtaḥ |
etayaiva tu diśā anekasya śeṣasya ekaṃ śeṣaṃ prati nīyamānasya virodha idānīmudā- hartavyaḥ |
tadyathā śrutiliṅgayorvirodhe 'aindrā gārhapatya- mupatiṣṭhate' iti mantrakaraṇarūpāpattividhāne kṛte liṅgāt kasmiṃścidāgneye mantra śeṣatvena prāpnuvati śrutyaindrī vini- yujyate |
tathā viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ śrutyā āmiṣaiva, śeṣo hi teṣāṃ vākyena vājinam, tat durbalapramāṇatvāt śrutyā nirākṛtam |
śrutikrama- yorvirodhe pratiṣṭhākāmadarśapūrṇamāsaprayoge pañca- daśasaṃkhyāsāmidhenyanuvacane aṅgatvena prāpte śrutyā ekaviṃ- śatisaṃkhyāvacanānyathātvavagamāt prākaraṇikanityānu- vacanabādhaḥ |
śrutyājeṣu hi hotṛ- sāmagyayā hotṛḥ prāptā yājyā yajamānakartṛkatvena kartṛ- saṃbandhavācinyā ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā pratipādyate |
śā- nanu liṅgavākyayoreva (atra) virodhaḥ, na śrutiliṅgayoḥ |
sahite hi virudhyete, na tu liṅgena kevale ||
yadyapi syād baliyastvaṃ śruterliṅgāta, tathāpi tu |
avi- rodhādvādhaḥ syāt saṃbhavī hi samuccayaḥ ||
yadvā sāmarthyarūpatvāt liṅgaṃ syāt prabalaṃ śruteḥ |
vastu- śaktyanusārī hi sarvaḥ śabdaḥ pravartate ||
gārhapatye tu sāmarthyaṃ gauṇaṃ mantrasya vidyate ||
tanna tāvad balīyastvaṃ liṅgasya na ca tulyatā ||
mantrārthaṃ mantrato buddhvā paścācchaktiṃ nirūpya ca ||
tena śīghrapra- vṛtyā śrutyā liṅgasya bādhanam ||
pratyakṣaṃ cānumāne ca yathā loke balābalam |
avirodhādvādho yo varṇitaḥ sa na yujyate |
' soma -- evaṃ śrutyādibhiḥ viniyogaprakāre kathite sati adhyāyādau upakṣitaḥ balābalavicāraḥ prāptāvasaraḥ (iti saṃgatiḥ) |
śrutiḥ śaktya- nusāreti śakya eko'sti liṅgataḥ ||
bhāṭṭa- tadevaṃ ṣaṭpramāṇeṣu nirūpiteṣu adhunā virodhe balābalaṃ nirūpyate |
virodhaikasya śeṣasya śeṣa- dvaye pramāṇadvasattve yathā aindrī mantrasya śrutyā gārhapatyā- ṅgatve liṅgasya indrāṅgatve |
yathā vā ekasmin śeṣeṇa śeṣadvayaviniyojakapramāṇadvaye yathā gārhapatye śrutyā aindrī- mantraḥ, liṅgādāgneyaḥ |
ayaṃ ca śeṣadvayaviniyogo dvāraisye satyeva balavatprayojakaḥ, na tu tadbhede'pi, vākya- prakaraṇābhyāṃ ye'dhaprayājādīnāṃ ekaśeṣatve'pi tada- bhāvāt |
yatra tu ekasya śeṣasya ekasminneva śeṣeṇa pramāṇadvayam, tatra vaiṣamye prabalasyaiva prayojanārthaṃ vini- yojakatvam |
sāmye tu ekasya viniyojakatvam, itarasya punaḥśrutivena prayojanāntarakalpanam |
evaṃ yatra 'aruṇā krīṇāti' ityādau āruṇyasyāpūrva- sādhanībhūtakrayārthatve pramāṇatrayam, tatrāpi śrutereva viniyojakatvam, na tvanyasya, vākyedeyasamarpakatva- mātratvāt |
ata eva na 'aindyā' ityatra liṅga- vākyavirodhaḥ |
vākyasya uddeśamātrasamarpakatvena śruti- sahakāritve'pi kṛtikārakatvabodhakatvaviniyojakatvā- bhāvāt |
tadiha śrutivirodhe aindrī mantrasya tṛtīyayā gārha- patyāṅgatvameva, na tu taditaśrutyā indrāṅgatvam |
evaṃ ca tasyaiva mantrasya liṅgāt indrāṅgatvamiti |
atra hi sarvatra uttarottarasya pūrvapūrvakṛtvena prāmāṇyasya tattvanirūpaṇāvasare sthāpi- tatvāduttarottarasya śrutikalpaṃ yāvadavagatatve pūrvapūrveṇa śeṣaśeṣiṇo nirākāṅkṣatvāpādanena bādhaḥ |

na ca ajñānāṃ prakṛtyarthatvena irākāṅkṣaṇāmāpi vikṛtyākāṅkṣyāvātideśa- kalpanāt indrākāṅkṣayaiva liṅgasya śrutikalpatvo- papattiḥ, tasya dhyānādyapāyāntareṇāpi smṛtisiddheniyamana vikṛtitadanākāṅkṣatvāt |
na ca śruteḥ karaṇatvamātrābhidhāyakatvena gārhapatyanirū- pitatvasya vākyādhīnatvāt nāyaṃ śrutiliṅgavirodha iti vācyam |
tathā'pi hi brāhmaṇavākyatvena mantraliṅgāpekṣayā 'yadyapyanyadeva' paśyuḥ' iti itavat prabalatvopapatteḥ |
vastutastu yathā na kevalyā śrutyā virodho naivaṃ vākye- nāpi, tathā'pi gārhapatyasamīpe ityevamupapatteḥ |
ataśca ubhayavirodhe'pi 'pradhānena vyapadeśā bhavanti' iti nyāyena śrutiliṅgavirodhodāharaṇam |
' (liṅgabalābalavicāraḥ---) bhāṣyam-- liṅga- vākyayorvirodhe kimudāharaṇam ? 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ kṛṇomi ghṛtasya dhārayā suṣedhaṃ kalpayāmi |
tasmin sīdāmṛte pratiṣṭhe vrīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānaḥ ||
atra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ kṛtsno mantra upastaraṇe puroḍā- śāsādanaṃ vā prayoktavyaḥ, uta kalpyā'myanta upastaraṇe, 'tasmin sīda' ityevamādiḥ puroḍāśāsādane iti |
katham ? 'ghṛtaidhaṃ kalpayāmi' ityetadapekṣa 'tasmin sīda' ityevamādiḥ pūrvaṇevākyavākyatāpyat kalpyā'mi tasmin sīdeti |
atha liṅgaṃ balīyaḥ, tataḥ kalpyā'myanta: sadanakaraṇe |
katham ? 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ kṛṇomi' iti sadanakaraṇa- mabhivaditumayamalamiti |
'tasmin sīda' ityayamapi puroḍāśaṃ sādayitumiti sādanaṃ viniyujyate |
yathā liṅgaṃ prati śruterbalīyastvamuktam , na tathā vākyaṃ prati liṅgasya ucyate |
na ca balīyaḥ kāraṇaṃ śakyate bādhitum |
ko'tra arthaviprakarṣaḥ ? prakaraṇavataḥ saṃnidhau āgnānāt darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ mantra ityava- gamyate |
'tasmin sīda' iti puroḍāsāsādanābhidhāna- sāmarthyāt sādane viniyujyamāne kṛtasāmarthyaṃ mantrāmnāna- miti nāsti pramāṇam , yena upastaraṇe'pi viniyujyate |
tathā, 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ karomīti' itye'pi'pi prakaraṇa- sāmarthyādeva darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmāmnāyaḥ sāmarthyādevopastaraṇe viniyogāt kṛtapraya
tasyetarābhāvaṃ darśayitvā punarātadharmamupanīya itaradharma- nirākaraṇamiti anyo nirākulīkartavyaḥ |
pūrvaḥ prastāvaḥ pramāṇasadṛśāvābhyām, madhyamaḥ śaktyākhyābhyām, anyaśca dṛṣṭārthatvādeṣṭārthatvābhyāmiti vivekaḥ |
atha liṅgavākyādīnāṃ anumīyamānaśrutitvāt aviśeṣe sati kiṃkkṛtaṃ balābalamiti ? taducyate |
' sarvatra hi mantre kiñcideva padaṃ karmasama- vetārthaṃ vadati |

śiṣṭāni tu akṣamavetāyābhidhāyāt- prayogādīni santi dṛśyamānekavākyatvā'nyathā'nupapattyā anumitasāmarthyābhidhānāni santi svārthamupasarjanīkṛtya tadviśiṣṭasamavetārthaprakāśanāne prayogātyarthaṃ pratipadyate |

yadā dṛśyamānekavākyatvayormantrayoḥ pṛthak pṛthak prakāśayitavyau arthau karmasamavetau dṛśyete, tadā ubhayopi bhedena prakāśakāpekṣaṇāt prakāśakasyośca prakāśyāpekṣaṇāt viniyogāya prasthite sati yasya yatra klṛptaṃ sāmarthyam, sa tatra śīghrataraṃ prāpnuvan nānyatraika- vākyatayā netuṃ śakyate |
' samudāye hi viniyujyamāno nāva- yatrān aviniyujya viniyoktuṃ śakyate |

tatra samudāyāvayavaviniyogāya vākyasāmarthyayoḥ saha- prasthitayoḥ asamarthaviniyogāsaṃbhavāt yāvadvākyena pūrvo bhāga uttarārthābhidhānasamarthaḥ, uttaro vā pūrvasamarthaḥ ityanumīyate, tāvat pratyekabhāgavartanā sāmarthyena pūrva-
tataśca yāvaditaratra viniyojakaśrutyanumānāya pratyayate tāvadiha viniyoge siddhe nirākāṅkṣatvāt prakampyamānasya, na kaścidapi hetuḥ śrutyanumāne ityanupajātamule viniyogo bādhyate |
mantrasyāpi hi pūrvasya pūrvārthe śīghraṃ vini- yogaḥ, uttarasya cirena |
svaprādhānye ca saṃbhavati na paropasarjanatvaṃ prati- padyate |
tasmālliṅgaṃ balīyaḥ; iti mistvā vākyaṃ viniyoga iti |
nanvevaṃ sati 'nirvapāmi' ityādinā klṛptasāma- rthyena śīghraprāptamevāvacchede'rthe viprakṛṣṭaprāptānāṃ 'devasya tvā' ityādīnāṃ bādhādaviniyogaḥ prāpnoti |
na caiṣāṃ bhinna- prayojanatvāt samuccayaḥ, tathā satyekavākyatvāmāvāt |
avaśyaṃ caitarthayākyaśribhireva ca prakāśayitavyo nānya- prakāśanam, karmānaṅgattvaprasaṅgāt |
ataḥ samānaviṣayatvāt samavāye sati vākyaprāpyapadāntarabādhena bhavitavyamiti |
' yāni hyasamavetātharvacanāni, tāni yadi svatantrākriyante, tato'narthakāni bhavanti |
tena klṛptasaṃbandhenarākāṅkṣīkṛto- 'pyathaṃ itareṣāṃ sākāṅkṣatvāt punastatprakāśyatvaṃ pratipadyate |
yeṣāṃ tu prakāśyo'rthaḥ samaveto dṛśyate, teṣāmanabhidheyānā- saṃbadhyamānānāmapi arthavattvā''sīti nā''narthakyanimitta- mavakāraṃ labhante |
sarveṣāmeva ca śrutyādīnāmanarthakya- pratihatānāṃ durvaitarapi bādhyatvamivyate |
tadyathā vrīhyādīnāṃ prokṣaṇādīn prati śrutyā śeṣitvaṃ prāpnuvadapi atilaṅghya prakaraṇamalyāpūrvasādhanatvakṛtaḥ saṃbandho bhaviṣyati |
tathā yāvaditaratra prakṛtyāgnyādiprakāśanāsamarthyam, tāvadiha viniyoga iti bādhaḥ |
liṅgakramayorvirodhaḥḥ stuta- śastrādhikaraṇe darśitaḥ ' arthena tvapakṛṣyate ' ( 2|1|15 14) iti |
sthitodāharaṇamapi yathā abhyanujñāpāmyanu- jñayoḥ praśātakramayoḥ ' upahūta upahavyasa ' ityevaṃ mantrāvā- mnātau |
tau deśāsāmānyāttathaivājñaptyā prāpnutaḥ ' upahūta ' iti anujñāpane ' upahavyasa ' iti anujñāpya |
na tu tathā sāmarthyamastīti viparītaṃ śeṣatvam |
yāvaddhi jñānena prakaraṇamutpādya ekavākyatvaṃ kalpyate, tāvalliṅgena śrutiṃ kalpayitvā sādhito viniyogaḥ; ityakalpitaliṅgaśruti- padakasyaiva kramasya bādhaḥ |
tathā parimāṇakaraṇakriyāmāṇān- vādinoḥ ' paririvarasi ' ' yuvā suvāsāḥ ' iti agnī- yomīyapaririyāṇāṅgatve prāpte liṅgāt savanīyārthadvitīya- paririyāṇāṅgatvamapi |
kathaṃ na manotā agnīmīyakrama- bādhanasamarthena liṅgena āgneyasavanīyapaśuyāgāgnimiti cet |
evaṃ hyāha ' yadyanyadevatyaḥ paśurāgne- yyeva manotā kāryyā ' iti |
anayā hi śrutyā liṅgeno- tkṛṣyamāṇā manotā vāritā |
yadya eva- kāraṃ svasthānādapanīya yathākramaṃ kāryyatvena saṃyojanā kāryya- tvavadhāyate |

liṅgasamākhyāvirodhe tu bhakṣānuvāke graha- ṇādivākyāni samākhyānyādāṅgatvena saṃbandhasāmānyādi- kalpanāyā makṣāṅgatvaviniyogo prasthitāni liṅgena grahaṇāvekṣaṇasamyagjaraṇeṣu viniyujyante iti sthitam |
yājyāsamavyākhyānace ' manotāñca ' pṛthupaśuyājatvo liṅgena sāmidhenītvena viniyogaḥ ityuktam |
( anekasya śeṣasya śeṣatve ) liṅgavākya- virodhe 'syonāderapi śeṣatvaṃ vākyena sadanaṃ prati |
pūrvaṃ syonaṃ ta ityādi sadane sābhidhāraṇe |
ekaikasya tu liṅgena tacca saṃprati gṛhyate |
liṅgasya prakaraṇamasamākhyāvirodhe nirvāpādiṣu 'devasya tvā' ityādinā prakaraṇaprāptamantrāvadhaḥ |
prathamasya kāmyasya aindrāgnasya kramāt sāmidhenīkāryaprāptasya yājyānuvākyāyugalasya liṅgena bādhaḥ |
samākhyāyā manotrāyāṃ somaudriyeṣu yājyānuvākyātvena prāptānāṃ somadrulliṅgābhirayājyānuvākyābhivridha ityudāharaṇāni |
śā -- 'yāvanti hi prayujyante padāni sati saṃbhave |
satyaṃ kalpyā śrutiḥ kintu liṅgādvāya kalpyate |
vākyena prathamaṃ liṅgaṃ kalpayitvā tataḥ śrutiḥ |
vi -- 'syonaṃ ta iti pūrvārtha tasmin sīdeti cottaram |
sadane sādane cāyaṃ sarvaṃ vā'dhai vyavasthite |

liṅgavākyayostu 'syonaṃ te' iti sadana- karaṇaprakāśakasya pūrvārdhasya 'tasmin sīda' ityuttarā- dhena sādhanaprakāśakena 'tasmin' iti vibhāge sākā- ikṣatvenānvayatvāt sakalasya mantrasya sadanasādhanayoranya- taratobhayatra vā pratiṣṭhāpane eva 'tasmin' iti pada- saṃnidhipeṇa vākyena viniyoge prāripsīte tataḥ pūrva- pravṛttena liṅgena tattadātmatayā mukhyaviśeṣatvena svārtha- bodhakasya paropasarjanatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt tacchabdasya ca 'sā vaiśvadevī' itivadvākyāntaropasthitāpārthaparāmarśa- katvenāpi caritārthatvāt pratyekameva viniyogaḥ iti |
kiṃ punaḥ prakaraṇaṃ nāma ? kartavyatvetikartavyatākāṅkṣāsya vacanaṃ prakaraṇam

vākyakramayorvirodhe parigaṇanakriyamāṇānādi- parivīrasiparivītapadavyatiriktāpādānaṃ ‘yuvā suvāsā āgāt , sa u śreyān’ ityevamādīnāṃ liṅgaviniyukta- parivītapadaikavākyatvāt sanīyaparivyāṇe viniyogaḥ |
vākyasāmyāvyorvirodhe bhakṣānuvāke eva ‘sadhyāsam’ ityevamādiṣu grahaṇādau viniyujyamāneṣu tadekavākyagata- śeṣapadāttucchidāhartavyā |
tathā ādhvaryavādismārakānāta jyotiṣṭomādiprāpteṣu tadarthameva prāpnuvatsu svargakāmādye- kavākyatvādarthādimatrayatvaṃ vijñāyate |
nātra kasya cit śravaṇāditat vijñāyate liḍā kartṛtbanabhidhānāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? padadvayasaṃnikāśadeva etat lakṣaṇayā sāmānādhikaraṇyyādagamyate |
dajjaṃ saṃkīrtya tasya purastātparastād vaikṛtamaṅgamāmnāyate, tatra kathamamāvagṛhītāṅgamevaṃvartitatvāt prakaraṇapāṭhe vijñā- yate |
'anekasyā''mnāyasya saṃnidhiviśeṣāmnāna- mātraṃ hi kramaḥ' iti kena citsaṃnidhānasya nāntarīya- katvaṃ darśayati |
yo hi bahūnāmarthena āmnāyate, tasya sarvapradhānaprayāsasaṃpradeśāsaṃbhavadāvaśyambhāvinī kena citsaha prayāsasaktiḥ |
na tu prakaraṇapāṭhasya evaṃ nāntarīya katvam |
ataḥ saha pravṛttayoḥ kramakaraṇayoḥ prakaraṇasya śīghrataraṃ śrutyarthaprāptiriti balīyastvam |
yadi tu ākāṅkṣataḥ saṃnidhau āmnāyeta, tata prakaraṇameva syāt |
atra ca prāyeṇa mahāprakaraṇopanipātyo vikṛtaya udāharaṇam |
tāsu hi prākṛtāṅgampathātvitena notpannaṃ tat purastāt parastād avasthitakramabhāvambhavati |

tatra yannibaddhā- kāṅkṣasya kasya cit samīpe paṭhyate, anyasya kāṅkṣā, tatastadubhābhyāṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ yāvat kramavato nivṛttamastī- mākāṅkṣāmupanayantī, tāvat prakaraṇavatā sahaikavākyatāṃ gacchati, yāvat itaratra ekavākyatā bhavati, tāvat prakaraṇaṃ prati upakārasamarthakalpanā |
yāvat itaratra śrutirupāsyate, tāvadiha siddhe viniyoge anumānabījahīname aklapta- śruti sarvaṃ apramāṇaṃ bhavati |
(anekasya śeṣasya śeṣatve) prakaraṇakramayo- rvirodhe girāpaderapade eva stotrāpekṣyodāharaṇam |
prakriyāsāmātyayorvirodhe 'tasmā- nmaitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati cānu nā''ha' ityetadeva jyotiṣṭomaṃ prati udāharaṇam |
tasya hi samākhyāyā hotṛkartṛkaṃ preṣānu- vacanaṃ prāpnoti, prakaraṇāttu maitrāvaruṇakartṛkaṃ nirṇīyate |
(ekasya śeṣasya śeṣatve tu) prakaraṇasamākhyayorvirodhe pauroḍāśikasamākhyāyā- mnātānāṃ prayājādīnāṃ prakaraṇāt sānāyyapādyārthatvaṃ ityudāharaṇam |

soma- taittirīyaśākhāyāṃ abhiṣecanīyaprayogamadhye 'diśo'bhayaṃ rājā'bhūt iti pañcākṣān prayacchanti ' 'śaunaḥśepamākhyāpayate' iti videvānādīnāmnāya tada- nantaram ' māstasya caikaviṃśatikapālasya vaiśvadevāśrā- mikaśyāḥ agraye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati' ityabhiṣecanī- yāṅgeṣu ihiviśeṣāmnāya 'apāṃ napte svāhā, ūrjaṃ napte svāhā, agne gṛhapataye svāhā iti tisra āhutī- rjuhoti' ityabhiṣecanīyāṅgomaviśeṣa āmnāyate |
tena videvānādīnāṃ abhiṣecanīyāṅgasaṃbandhatavyā āmnātānāṃ tadantaramprakaraṇe abhiṣecanīyāmātrāttvāt teṣāṃ krama- prakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇaṃ nopapadyate iti |
na ca śākhā- 'ntare abhiṣecanīyaprayogaparisamāptyantaraṃ āmnānāt tadabhiprāyeṇa udāharaṇatvamupapadyate iti vācyam |
avā- ntaraprakaraṇasya balavattvena kañcicchākhāyāṃ avāntaraprakaraṇena abhiṣecanīyamātrādīnāṃ teṣāṃ śākhāttare mahāprakaraṇena sarvārthatvānupapatteḥ |
prakaraṇakramayorvirodhe 'akṣairdīvyati' ityādi- videvānādīnāṃsaṃnidhānāt abhiṣecanīyākhyahomayāgāṅga- prasaktau prakaraṇāt rājasūyākhyam |
na ca abhiṣeca- nīyasyāpi phalavatvena prakaraṇaprāptyā, tasya vikṛtitvena klṛptopakāraprākṛtāṅganirakāṅkṣasya tadabhāvāt |
na ca vikṛtatvapi yat prākṛtānuvādena vaikṛtamaṅgaṃ vācinakaṃ vidhīyate yathā pṛṣṭhādi, tasyāpi vikṛtitākāṅkṣā-
yāmanivṛttāmeva vidheyatvāt tatsaṃdehasya tatpūrvabhāvitve sati pradhānottarabhāvinaḥ apūrvāṅgasya vā prakaraṇenaiva grahaṇopapatteḥ |
videvānādīnāṃ ca abhiṣecanīyottaramuktra- viṣābhiṣekapūrvabhāvitvena pāṭhāt prakaraṇagrahaṇopapatti- riti vācyam |
prākṛtānuvādena vihitasyāpyapūrvā- sya upahomavat vikṛtyākāṅkṣāyāṃ nivṛttāmeva vidhā- nāt |

yasya hi prākṛtākāryapañcatayā vaikṛtāṅgasya vidhānaṃ yathā audumbaratvaśarādeḥ; tasyaivānivṛttākāṅkṣāyāṃ vidhānaṃ tatsaṃdeśasya ca tatpūrvabhāvino vā pradhānottaraṅgasya vikṛ- tiprakaraṇena grahaṇam |
abhiṣecasya tu prākṛtakāryāpattatvā- bhāvāt tatpūrvapaṭhitānāṃ videvānādīnāmabhiṣecanīyaprakaraṇa- grāhyatvopapattiḥ |
vastutastu abhiṣecasya api svatantro- tpannasya prakaraṇāt rājasūyāṅgatvavagateḥ |
'māhendrasya stotraṃ pratyabhiṣicyate' ityatra pratiśabdayogena kālārthasaṃyogaḥ iti vakṣyate |
kramasya ca dṛṣṭādhasya saṃndhanamidhāvinaśca adṛṣṭabādhayā saṃndhanamidhāvinyā ca samākhyāyā bādhaḥ, iti prāpte |
samā- khyāyāṃ tu sāmānyaṃ kalpyatvād viprakṛṣyate |
prakaraṇā- virodhināṃ kramaviniyogaṃ kevalasamākhyāpratiyogitvena ca darśayati |
kathaṃ punaḥ prakaraṇaṃ na virudhyate, yadā tena sarvārthatvaṃ śāyamānamustajya kramavaśena kevalasāmākhyātvaṃ vijñāyate |
yadi hi apakṛte vayaṃ kramavini- yogamabhyupagacchema, tata evaṃ syāt |
na caivaṃ tasya prakaraṇatvāpattiḥ; mantrasya siddharūpatvena liṅgaviniyojakatvena ca prakaraṇaviṣayatvāt|
saṃnidhānasyāpi samākhyāvadapūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇātātparyagrāha- katve eva balāvam, na tu viniyoge|
evaṃ samākhyāyorvirodhe ādhvaryavamiti sāmānya- samākhyāyāḥ yājamānamitiviśeṣasamākhyā bādhaḥ|
evaṃ dvyantarittyantarādipramāṇasya pūrvaḥ saha virodhe śeṣā- nekte ca udāharaṇāni kaustubhe draṣṭavyāni|
) bhāṣyam— atha yattatra tatrocyate, idamanena bādhyate, idamanena|
tatra yat bādhyate, tat kiṃ bādhakaviṣayaṃ prāptam, uta aprāptamiti|
kiṃ cātaḥ ? yadyaprāptam, kiṃ bādhyate ? atha prāptam, kathaṃ śakyate bādhita
bahiṣpavamāne sakṛdeva hiṃ karotīti, ekaṃ hi tatra |
iti vacanāt sāmaikatvāt sāmāgamo na saṃbhavati |
bahunāṃ purato nṛtyannartakaḥ sarveṣāṃ sukhaṃ yugapanni- vartayati |
na ca ‘bahunāṃ syāt sadharmatvam’ iti nyāyena anekeṣu deśā- dyatrātha eva ajñānāṃ tantritvātparyāhakaḥ iti vācyam |
tasmāt dahrākāśo brahma iti bahunugraha- nyāyena nirṇayaḥ, nopasaṃhāraprāptatvena |
57|9, tasmāt siddhametat dahrādhikaraṇe nopasaṃhāraprāptyo- pajīvanamasti na vā sūtrakāramabhiprāsam, uttarebhyaḥ iti bahuvacanena bahunugrahanyāyasyaiva sūcanāt |
yatprathame uccāraṇe gamyate śatame'pi tadeva gamyate |
prāksiddhacodanāprāmāṇyameva ‘bahu- kṛtvo'pi pathyaṃ veditavyam’ ityevaṃ punaḥ kathitamanena sūtreṇa |
bahukṣīrādivākyeṣu ( ‘iyaṃ gauḥ kretavyā, bahukṣīrā’ ityādiṣu ) rūpabhrameṇāpi purupārthaparyavasāyitvaṃ dṛśyate |
ayaṃ śrīśaṃkarā- cāryaiḥ saṃkṣepeṇa bhāṣyatātparyaprakāśake śrīmaddakṣiṇāmūrti- stotre'bhihitaḥ |
tathāhi ‘nānācchidraghaṭodarasthitamahā- dīpaprabhāsvaraṃ, jñānaṃ yasya tu cakṣurādikaraṇā dvārā bahiḥ spandate |
jānāmīti tameva bhāntamanubhātyetatsamastaṃ jagat, tasmai śrīgurumūrtaye nama idaṃ śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtaye |
bhā. 11|1|2|38, bahutvaṃ cāpekṣikam, kiñcidapekṣya tato'dhikaṃ bahu ityucyate |
bahutvaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ yāgamedaṃ kuryāt, yathā ‘prājāpatyān’ iti ‘vāruṇān’ iti ca |

‘satrādudasāya pṛthaśamanīyena yajen’ ityatra bahulaṃ yathā avivakṣitaṃ tathā ‘yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvato vāruṇān’ ityatra bahulatvamiva- kṣitam, nimittasyaivāpratipādane naimittikyetāyā ava- gatatvāt |
bahu-dvi-ekaśabdāḥ saṃkhyāvacanāḥ, tāmanami- dhāya saṃkhyye vṛttyasaṃbhavāt ityākṛtyadhikaraṇe sthāpitam |
bahudviplīke darśapūrṇamāsaprayoge gaiśamantre patnī- śabde śabdo na |
bahubādhaḥ : alpārthena bādhyate, ( aprāptatvāt :) yathā aśvapratigrahe |

pratigrahītṛviṣayatve ‘varuṇāya’ iti caturthyāḥ pañcamyarthatvam, ‘anayat’ ityasya prati- ahārthatvam, ‘sa svāṃ devatām’ ityatra tacchabdasya apradhānanyāyairhṛdavarūpaparāmarśitvam, vakṣasya dātṛtve ca adevatātvāt devatāśabdāyogaḥ iti bahubādhaḥ |
yattu ‘sṛṣṭīrupadadhāti’ ityatra upasaṃhārānu- sāreṇa samudāyalakṣaṇāśrayaṇaṃ tat ‘bahubādhādalpabādho varam’ iti nyāyāt |
asṛṣṭiliṅgakammanopayedheṣṭakāstutīnāṃ icchāsāsamadavyakīrta- nasya sarvathā bādhaḥ syāt |
sahasradakṣiṇayāgakartavyapi sahasra iti prayogadarśanādaha- dakṣiṇapauṇḍarīkādivājī vā grāhyaḥ |
iti prāpte, aiṣṭika- pāśukakramanirapekṣya somasyetikartavyatābāhulpyadhikṣā- mayanāntākhilavikṛtyanugatatvāt somayājyeva bahuyājī |
ata eva ‘yo brāhmaṇo bahuyājī syāt tasya kumbhāṃ gṛhṇīyāt’ iti vidhāya ‘sa hi gṛhītavatīvarīkaḥ’ iti vivaraṇamupapadyate |
yathā ekasminpure yadā bahavo rājānastadā teṣāmekatvabhāvena kleśastathā ekasmin dehe nānendriyāṇāṃ kartṛtve svīkṛte mitho viro- dhāccaikamapi sidhyet |
tathāhi, yadā caturdarśanāya pravarta- mānaṃ bhavati tadā'nyānya indriyāṇi svakriyā nirvā- hoyatāni bhavanti cet darśanādi naikamapi jāyate, evaṃ vivakṣāyāmasya pravṛttiriti |
yathā bahūnāṃ vṛkāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ bhoktṛtve bahūnāmekamatyasaṃbhave viruddhadikkriyā mṛgadehasyonmathanaprasaṅgastathā prakṛte'pi |
bahuvacanaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ vartate tritvā- diṣu, yathā akṣaśabdaḥ sādhāraṇatve videnādiṣu |
athavā yatra ekatvitve na staḥ tatrāyaṃ vartate |
( pūrvasmin pakṣe bahu- vacanasya nānārthatvāpattiḥ, atra tu dvitvādhikyaṃ sāmānyaṃ tadarthaḥ iti na nānārthatvam |
yad bahuṣu pratipādikaṃ vartate tato bahuvacanaṃ bhavati |
bhā. 3|8|8|23, yathā loke pṛthaktvenapi kurvāṇānāṃ bahuvacanaṃ dṛśyate |
‘devaśraddha varṣeta bahavaḥ kṛṣiṃ kuryuḥ’, satyaṃ cet saṃpadyeta vahavo brāhmaṇā yajeran’ iti |
tathā vede'pi prayogadarśanam ‘satrādudasāya pṛthaśamanīyena yajeran’ iti |
loke anyataḥ prabhū- tasya arthasya anuvādabhūtaḥ śabda uccāryamāṇaḥ sāmānya- kriyāsaṃbandhābhisamīkṣayā uccaritaḥ iti gamyate |
tathā bhinnāni udayasānāni upalabhya kriyāmātraṃ vidhīyate tadbahutvaṃ ca samānakartṛtvādeva prāptamanūyate ityuktameva |
bahuvacanena traya eva kapiñjalā grāhya nādhikāḥ |
bahuvacanena śrayaścatvāraḥ pañca vā sarve ete saṃkhyāviśeṣāḥ prāpyante |

tatra kapiñjalān iti bahuvacanena tritvacatuṣṭayādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ saṃkhyānāṃ prāptaḥ bahutve sarvāṃsāmantarbhāvāt kapiñjalasaṃkhyāsu vikalpaḥ syāt trayo vā catvāro vā pañca vā āla- bhyantyāḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
bahuvacanasya na tritvameva vācyam, yataḥ ‘catvāro brāhmaṇāḥ’ ‘pañca bhūtāni’ iti caturādiṣu bahuvacanasya prayogo dṛṣṭaḥ |
tasmāt bahuvacanena saṃkhyā vivakṣitā iti vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti cet |
tathā bahuvacanasya caturādiṣu prayogavat kapiñjala- śabdasya kapote mayūre ca prayogo dṛṣṭaḥ |
tasmāt ‘vasantāya kapiñjalānalabhate’ iti vākyasyakapiñjala- padārthasya vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ syāt |
mahati kapote alpe mayūre ca kapiñjalaśabdaḥ bhaktyā guṇavṛttyā prayujyate |
yathā mahākapotau kapiñjalaśabdo gauṇyā prayujyate tathā bahuvacanamapi caturadiṣu lakṣaṇayā prayujyate |
tasmāt kapiñjaleṣu saṃkhyāyā vikalpaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
atra eva kapiñjalā ālabhyā nādhikā iti |
yathā ' ṣaḍ deyā dvādaśa deyāścaviṃśatideyāḥ ' ityādau |
kapiñjalanāṃ tritve svīkṛte śrutyarthasya na kaścit viśeṣaḥ |
nedaṃ sūtraṃ kintu bhāṣyaṃ iti bahuvaḥ |
' kṛṣṇā yāmyāḥ, avaliptā raudrāḥ, nabhorūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ, teṣāmaindrā daśamaḥ ' iti anyārthe aśvamedhe paśuviśeṣavidhānārthaṃ darśanaṃ bahutvacanasya utsargaṃtaḥ tritva- marthaḥ iti darśayati |
yadi yāmyā yamadevatākādyaḥ rudra- devatākādyaḥ parjanyadevatākāśca trayaḥ syuḥ tadaiva niyogena aindro daśamaḥ syānnānyathā |
prakṛtigatena ekatvena tadā- satteḥ tasya tritvasya āsatteḥ |
saṃnidhānāt kapiñjalān iti bahutvavacanena tritvameva niścīyate |
tatra madhyamasyeti nirutpadaṃ trayāṇāṃ madhyamasya iti śāyate |
tassāt trīneva kapiñjalānālabheta nādhikān iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. bahuvacanasya asati bādhake tritve paryavasānam |
111|8|84-46. mīko. pṛ. 1358 ' kapiñjalā- dhikaraṇam ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
bahuvacanasya paścāt śrutatvena prātipadikaṃ prati guṇatvam |
su. pṛ. 1049. bahuvacanāntasya pāśamantrasya vikalpena prakaraṇe eva niveśaḥ |
1|3|14-14. bahuvacanasthale, avaśyambhāvite prathamabhāvitve lāghave ca saṃbhavati adhikagrahaṇe doṣavattve ca sati tritvameva grāhyaṃ na catuṣṭvādi |
yathā bahupatnīkaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvāsāṃ patnīnāṃ yugapat kāmanākaraṇe'śakto duḥkhamanubhavati, tathā nānyendriyaviṣayabhogena tattadindri- yasyaiva yugapatkāryaprāptau duḥkhamanubhavatīti |
yathā coktam- ' jihvekṭo''maparṇeti karhi cit, śiṣṭo''ta- stavagudaṃ śravaṇaṃ kutaścit |
prāṇe'nyakṣapaladak kva ca karmādirbhavyaḥ sapalya iva gehapati lunnanti |
maṇi. pṛ. 150. bahuvrīheḥ : samānādhikaraṇānāṃ iti smṛtiḥ |
pṛ. 446. citrāṇāṃ gavā- mayaṃ itīhaśoḍarthaṃ bahuvrīheḥ vartate |
saṃbandhaviśiṣṭābhi- rgobhiḥ devadattādirviśiṣṭaḥ iti samāsāryo vijñāyate |
sa ca anyapadārthaḥ saṃbandhrī yogyatāvaśena jātidravyaguṇakriyāṇāmataḥ pari- gṛhyate |
vā. 3|16|12 pṛ. 677. bahuvrīheḥ : anya- padārthe śaktiḥ iti nirūpaṇam |
aruṇādhikaraṇe (3|16| 12) bahuvrīheḥ : anyapadārthe śaktiḥ ityuktaṃ ' ataśca daṇḍiśabdena saṃbandhocyate yathā |
' ityupakramāt (vā. pṛ. 677), ' tasmādupapannaṃ piṅgalākṣyādīnāṃ dravyavacanatvam ' iti copa- saṃhārāt (vā. pṛ. 679) |
karaṇadvayaparyālocanāt ( 3|2|11, 6|1|13 ) lākṣa- ṇikaḥ : anyapadārthaḥ : iti bhāti |
tathāhi, āye indra- pītaśabdaḥ : somaviśeṣaṇaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ : tatra pūrvapadārthamātra- lakṣaṇāpatteḥ, na bahuvrīheḥ : savanaviśeṣaṇam, tatra padadvaye- 'pi anyapadārthalakṣaṇā''patteḥ |
iti pūrvapakṣe bahuvrīhau anyapadārthaḥ : śakyaḥ ityevottaraṃ vācyam |
bahuvrīhisamāsārthaḥ kimabhidheyaḥ lākṣaṇikaḥ veti cintāyāṃ lākṣaṇika iti cet, abhidheya iti siddhāntaḥ |
bahuvrīhaḥ adhyāpakāḥ mahāvratapratipādakaṃ āśvalāyananirmitaṃ kalpasūtraṃ adhyeyānāḥ 'pañcamamāraṇyakaṃ' iti vadantvena vyavaharanti |
vi. 9|2|1 varṇakaṃ 2. bahuvrīhacaiva vāsiṣṭhaṃ dharmasūtraṃ parigṛhītam |
vā. 13|1|9. bahuvrīhabrāhmaṇe (adhvaryubrāhmaṇe iti vārtikaṃ) yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhoti iti jīvanaṃ nimittīkṛtya nitye'gnihotraprayogo vidhīyate, na tu kāmye kālarūpa- dharmaḥ |
yathā kaściddaṣṭriparijagareṇa veṣṭitamuccaṃ rakṣan bāṇairajagaraṃ jaghānaiti laukikī gāthā, tathā niṣedhavākyāni bāghāvadhitvenā''tmānaṃ rakṣayanti anātmānaṃ bādhante iti |
sāhasī. 104. vāvantaḥ : paridhayaḥ yatra tatra vāvanta eva utpādayitavyāḥ siddhānte |
bhā. 2|1|4|12. bādariḥ : ācāryaḥ sarvādhikāraṃ (cāturvarṇyādhikāraṃ) śāstraṃ manyate sma |
bhāṣyam-- bādaricāryau'tra dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣva śeṣaśabda iti mene, na yāgaphalapuruṣeṣu |
yadi prayojanavatī kriyā vyaktaṃ sā dravyeṇa nirvarta- yitavyā |
tasyā nirvartitatvādate na bhavatīti tannirvṛttaye dravyameṣitavyaṃ bhavati |
guṇaḥ śaknoti viśiṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ coditaṃ lakṣayitum |
tasmāt so'pi dravyadvāreṇa kriyāyā upakarotīti kriyārtha eva |
saṃskāro nāma sa bhavati, yasmin jāte padārtho bhavati yogyaḥ kasyacidarthasya |
tenāpi kriyāyāṃ kartavyayāṃ prayojanamiti so'pi parārthaḥ |
na hi tasminnirvartite kiñcidpara- masti kartavyam |
yadanyad dravyādi tat, tadarthaṃ tasya śeṣabhūtam |
tasmā- dyāgo na śeṣabhūtaḥ kasya cidarthasya |
yaḥ svargaṃ kāmayate sa yāgaṃ kuryāditye- tāvacchabdenopadiśyate, nā''tmanaḥ parasya veti |
tasmāt puruṣaṃ prati guṇābhāvena na śrūyate svargaḥ |
na cet phalayāgau guṇābhāvena codhyete, kasya puruṣaḥ pradhānabhūto bhavati |
'dravyaṃ hi 'dravyāṇāṃ karmasaṃyoge guṇatvenābhisaṃbandhaḥ' iti svabhāvata eva śeṣabhūtaṃ niyama|
guṇo'pyaruṇādiḥ kriyāyāḥ svāsādhanabhūtadravya- paricchedasāmarthyāt utpattaiva śeṣaḥ |
tathā saṃskāro'- pyavahanyādiḥ yāgasādhanapuroḍāśādinirvṛttaye coditānāṃ brīhādīnāṃ svarūpeṇopāyatvādevatāhanāṃ yogyatvādevahatānāṃ yogyatvamāpādayan utpattaiva bhavati |
na tu yāgādā- vautpattikaṃ śeṣatvaṃ dṛśyate |
nanu ca bhāvārthādhikaraṇe karaṇatvaṃ yāgasyo- ktam |
phalamapi yāgaṃ prati sādhyamānatvāt pradhānam, puruṣaṃ prati tvasya śeṣabhāvo naivopāyataḥ, kāmyamānatvena sutarāṃ pradhānatvāt |
puruṣa eva tu kāmaṃ dravyatyāge guṇatvena syāt |
bhāṣyam-- jaiministu khalvācāryaḥ karmāṇyapi śeṣabhūtāni manyate sma, na bādarirvādhāraṇamāmanyamene |
sa hi darśa, na yāgaḥ kartavyatayā codyate |
iha tu tatsiddhenaiva phalārthatvena śeṣa- bhāvaṃ yāgasyā''pādayati sma |
tasmādanavadhāraṇā, dravya- guṇasaṃskārāḥ śeṣabhūtāḥ, yāge'pi śeṣabhūtaḥ phalaṃ pravatīti |
yaḥ svargo me bhavedityevaṃ kāmayate tasya yāgaḥ |
na yaḥ svargaḥ sa ātmānaṃ lamete |
kriyāphalamamubhet kathaṃ puruṣa iti yāgaḥ prayujyate |
tasmāt phalaṃ puruṣārthaṃ yāgāt śrūyate, nā''tmanirvṛttyartham |
na hi kaściduddiṣṭāpyakāryaṃ kāmayate svargaṃ ātmānaṃ labhatāmiti |
dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣveva niyato yaji prati śeṣabhāvaḥ, āpekṣika itareṣām |
yāgasya dravyaṃ prati pradhānabhāvaḥ, phalaṃ prati guṇabhāvaḥ |
phalasya yāgaṃ prati prādhānyam, puruṣaṃ prati guṇatā |
puruṣasya phalaṃ prati pradhānatā, audumbarīsaṃmānādi prati guṇatvam |
tasmāt samatā''vadhāraṇā, dravyaguṇasaṃskārā yāgaṃ prati niyogato guṇabhūtā eveti |
mī. ko. 370 vā-- puruṣo'pi yajetetyākhyātena guṇabhūta ākṣitaḥ |
evaṃ catuḥsūtreṇā- dhikaraṇena samastaḥ śeṣatvaviṣayaḥ pratipāditaḥ |
yattāvat 'dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣu' ityatra 'na tu yāgaphalapuruṣeṣu śeṣatvam' ityabhidhāyānte puruṣa śeṣi- tvanirākaraṇaṃ tadasaṃbhavam |
yattu 'pratyakṣaśca dravyatvātkarma prati guṇabhāvaḥ' iti, tadapi vyāhataṃ punaruktaṃ ca, pūrva- mevābhihitatvāt |
na ca yāgaphalābhyāṃ śeṣatvanirākaraṇa- vadatryā sahāyātulyapravṛttitvāduccāraṇaṃ yuktam |

yadyadhikaraṇasamāsāduktam 'athedānīmatra bhagavān vṛttikāraḥ pariniścityāya' iti, tadapi prathamameva dravya- guṇasaṃskārāṇāṃ nirapekṣatvenābhidhānāt karmaphalapuruṣāṇāṃ ca dravyādīni prati prādhānye''vasite sūtraireva parasparapekṣa- śeṣatvapratipādanāduktārthamiti mandaphalaṃ dṛśyate |

tatra prathamaṃ tāvat svamatena 'śeṣaḥ parārthatvāt' ityabhihite bādarimatamupakāralakṣaṇaśeṣatvābhiprāyeṇa dravyaguṇasaṃskāre- bveva śeṣatvamityevaṃ pūrvapakṣīkṛtya jaiminimatameva siddhānta- tvena varṇayati |
tathā ca pūrvatra dṛṣṭophārānukamameva bhāṣye dṛśyate |
tatra ca puruṣasya dravyatvāt pratyakṣameva kriyānivṛttihetutvādiṣṭameva śeṣatvam |
yāgaphalostu na kiñcit pratyakṣaṃ sādhanatvamupalabhyate ityaupaśaulvam |
yattu na yāgaphalapuruṣeṣviti trayāṇāmapi bhāṣye saṃkīrtanam, na tat prakṛtaśeṣapadānuṣaṅgādeva kalpayitavyaṃ na teṣāṃ śeṣatvamiti |
kiṃ tarhi ? yatsiddhānta- vādisaṃmataṃ tatra bhavatītyevaṃ saṃbandhaḥ |
sarvatra hi pūrvapakṣavādinā siddhāntavādinaṃ pratiṣeddhavyaṃ na yatkiñcit |
śeṣatvameva hi asau tadabhipraitemeveti prati- ṣedhati, na svarūpamātreṇa |

siddhāntavādinamantaṃ yaduta yāgaphalapuruṣāṇāṃ dvayākāratvaṃ kiñcidapekṣya śeṣatvaṃ kiñci- dapekṣya śeṣatvamititi, tad bādarimatanusārī bhāṣyakāraḥ pratiṣedhati, na tu yāgaphalapuruṣeṣu siddhāntavādisaṃmataṃ vyākāratvam |
‘karmaṇyapi jaiminiḥ’ ityādibhirantarṇītadharmākārameva śeṣatvaṃ prati- pāditam, pārārthyalakṣaṇaśeṣatvāṅgīkaraṇāt |
nanvevaṃ sati puruṣasya dravyatvāt pūrvapakṣadanirvaivābhyupagamya śeṣatvam, śeṣatve nirākṛte siddhāntavādinā tadeva pratipādanīya- miti na vaktavyaṃ ‘puruṣaśca karmārthatvāt’ iti |

tataśca yāvadeva satradvayena yāgaphalyoḥ śeṣatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ tāvadeva yāgopasarjanaṃ phalaṃ prati pradhānatvādbhū prati kevalaṃ śeṣitvameva prasaktamiti dvayākāratve punaḥ śeṣatvapratiprasavādyucyate ‘puruṣaśca karmārthatvāt’ iti |
athavā paropakāradvāreṇa śeṣatvamabhyupagamya, tadayuktaṃ manyamānaḥ phalayāgayorevāsthyāpi pārārthyakṛtameveti prati- pādayiṣyāha ‘puruṣaśca karmārthatvāt’ na tadupakāritvā- diti |
kiṃ tarhi ? ‘śeṣaḥ pārārthyāt’ iti sāmānyena lakṣaṇa- muktvā tasyaiva viṣayapradarśanadvāreṇa prapañcaḥ kriyate |
tatra pūrvavyākhyāyāṃ dravyaguṇasaṃskāreṣveva śeṣatvamityeva- mavadhāraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣe kṛtam |
idānīṃ tu siddhāntatvenaiva bādarimaṃtapratiṣedhanāmataṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇaprapañcābhyāṃ śeṣatvaṃ varṇayiṣyate |
tataśca dviprakāra eṣa śeṣaviṣayo naiyamika āpekṣikaścetyubhavati |
nanu ca dravyaguṇasaṃskāraṇāmapi svājñani prati pradhānatvādvā prati guṇādāpekṣikameva śeṣaśeṣitvam |
’ vrīhyādayo hyavaghātādīn prati pradhāna- bhūtāḥ, puroḍāśanirvṛttiṃ prati guṇāḥ |
tathā guṇāḥ saṃkhyādiḥ saṃkhyaiyaṃ prati paricchedāccheṣaḥ |
yeṣāṃ tu guṇānāṃ niṣpādyā sā tān prati śeṣiṇī |
tathā saṃskāraḥ saṃmārgāghātādiribhyādeḥ śeṣaḥ, khasādha- nānāmidhmasannahanolūkhalamusalādīnāṃ śeṣī |
’ dravyaguṇasaṃskārā hi phalavantaṃ yāgaṃ prati niyogataḥ śeṣabhūtāḥ |
satyāpi svājñani prati śeṣitve taṃ prati nāstītyamidhīyate |
ata eva bhāṣyakāro'pi ‘niyogato yaṃji prati śeṣa- bhāvaḥ’ ityāha, na bravīti ‘niyataḥ śeṣabhāvaḥ’ iti |
tathā hyekasya dvau dvau prati guṇatvaṃ prādhānyaṃ ca dṛśyate |
yāgasya tāvad dravyātmakaṃ nirvartakaṃ puruṣaṃ prati prādhānyam, phalaṃ prati guṇatā |
yaśca phalaṃ prati guṇaḥ sa śakyate phalasya svāminaṃ puruṣamapi prati sutarāṃ guṇa iti vaktum |
tathā yasya puruṣaṃ prati prādhānyaṃ tasya tadupa- sarjanaṃ phalaṃ prati śrutā tadapi śakyanirūpam |
evaṃ phalasya yāgaṃ prati prādhānyattsādhanaṃ puruṣamapi prati prādhā- nyam, puruṣaṃ prati guṇatvādanuṣṭheye yāge'pi guṇatvam |
tathā puruṣasya phale prati prādhānyāttatsādhanaṃ yāgamapi prati pradhānatvam |
yāgaṃ ca prati guṇābhāvāttasyāsya phale- 'pi guṇatvam |
yaccidaṃ pārārthyeṇāpi śeṣatvaṃ prādhānyaṃ coktam, idamartha- lakṣaṇaṃ vastumātraspeṇaivagantavyam |
mā bhūt aṣṭavāṃśena vikṛtau phalapuruṣayorapi atideśā- siddhāntāvirodhaḥ |
tasmādetāvatkārya eva vakṣyamāṇaprapañca- śeṣatvaviṣayasaṃkṣepa iti siddham |
’ jaiministu jaiministasya śeṣatvasya uktadoṣatvāt pārārthyameva śeṣatvaṃ ityabhipretya karmaṇāmapi pārārthyāt śeṣatvamāha |
pumān karma ca paśau dyāvādeya matabhedataḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- yadyapi pārārthyamaṅgatvaṃ tathāpi na yāgāde- rlakṣaṇatā, samānapadaśrutyā yāgādeva bhāvābhyatvena tasya svagorviśeṣaṇa vihitatvābhāvāt |
ākṣepatve'pi vā bhramapramāsādhāraṇyeṣṭasādhanajñāna- syaiva kāraṇatayā iṣṭasādhanatvasiddhau pramāṇābhāvācca |
svargākāmapadasya tu ‘parakrīkāmaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt’ itivat kartṛparatvādinā'pyupapatterna bhāṣyaparatvāvaśya- katā |
ata eva vrīhyāderyasya āruṇyāderguṇasya ava- ghātādeḥ saṃskārasya copakārakatvadarśanācchepatvam |
prokṣa- ṇādisaṃskārasya tu liṅgenāṅgatvasaṃbhave'pi śrutivākyābhyā- maṅgamapi tadaṅgatvena upakārakatvasya śeṣatvopapatti- riti teṣāmeva lakṣyatvam |
iti prāpte, nopakārakatvaṃ śeṣa- tvam, godohanadayanayanāderapi prāyanavājinayāgāllā- patteḥ |
apakārakasya tu tadapa- kārasyaiveṣṭatvena uddeśyatā, na tu tasyeti na tadarthe'pyapa- kārake śeṣatvavyavahāraḥ |
tathā hi yadyapi vidheḥ svarūpayogyatayaiva pravṛttyanukūlaṃ liṅā''dyavagamyate, tathāpi kadā cidapi pravṛttyabhāve vidhirvaiyarthyāpatteḥ avaśyaṃ kadā cit tathā bhavitavyam |
tathā ceṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ vinā tadasaṃbhavāt tasya ca bādhakāmāve amatvādyogāt iṣṭasādhanatvaṃ tāvadāgasya vidhivalādavagamyate |
iṣṭaviśeṣa- sādhanatvaṃ ca svargākāmādipadamabhivyāhārāditi yāgasya svargātvasiddheḥ |
bhoktā ca utsargato vidhivaśāt kāmanāvāt ātmane- padavaśācca kartavyaṃ |
puruṣaḥ punaḥ kartṛtvādinā yāgā- yuddeśyakakartṛkārakatvāt vākyādeva tadaṅgamityavivādameva |
upakāralakṣaṇa- śeṣatvābhiprāyeṇa dravyādideva śeṣatvamityavadhāra- ṇyā bādarimaṃta pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā karmādiṣvapi śeṣatvamasti pārārthyalakṣaṇatvāt iti jaiminimaṃta siddhāntitaṃ prathame vyākhyāne |
dvitīye tu bādarimaṃtamapi siddhāntamaṅgīkṛtya dravyādiṣu śeṣatvameveti niyamya karmādiṣu śeṣatvaṃ śeṣitvaṃ ceti |
ādhānādisaṃskārāṇāṃ agnicayanaprakaraṇe śrutasya jvala- davṛkṣagrāgrādyatasya kāmyasāme: |

10|2|13|47-17. mīko. pṛ. 1480 ‘kṛṣṇalacarau bhakṣāṇāṃ na bādha:’ ityatra draṣṭavyam |
