pratyakṣa- pānumānaṃ mṛtānuṣṭhānādityasya bādhyante yathāsarvaṃ ṣaḍbhi- rapi pramāṇai: pramāṇabhāsa: ; śrutyā smṛti: ; ātideśīta- smṛtyā anāsavītasmṛti: ; apārthyā dṛṣṭārthā, śruti- prabhavayā liṅgādiprabhavā arthavādaprabhavā ca, smṛtyā'pi ācāra: ; so'pi abhiyuktasadācāreṇa, saṃdigdhadharma- dipena, durbalāśrayaṃ balavadāśrayeṇa, upasaṃhārasamupakramasthena, atyantadṛṣṭārthe niyamadṛṣṭārthena, ārādupakārakatvaṃ sāmavā- yitvatvena, anekārthavidhānaṃ ekārthavidhānena, aneka
tathā - śrutyādiṣu dvābhyāṃ pramāṇabhyām, ekaḥ śeṣaḥ dvayoḥ śeṣiṇoḥ viniyujyate tatra durbalatvena bādhaḥ iti 5 medāḥ |
evaṃ ekasmin śeṣiṇi dvayoḥ śeṣayoḥ pramāṇadvayena viniyoge prabalatvena durbalasya bādhaḥ iti 5 militvā 10 pṛ. 134, aprāpta-bādhabhedāḥ 7 śāstrīyāḥ |
1 śrutyā śrutiḥ asaṃdigdhayā saṃdigdhā, 3 liṅgena liṅgam, 4 vākyena vākyam, 5 prakaraṇena prakaraṇam, 6 krameṇa kramaḥ, 7 samākhyāyā samākhyā |
ete ca sapta śeṣaśeṣibhedena dviguṇā bhavanti |
atra śrutiliṅgādīnāṃ bādhānāṃ pañcadaśabhedatvāt tattanmūlakasmṛtiviṣaye'pi 15 eva medā bhavanti |

pṛ. 140, aprāptabādhabhedāḥ śāstrīyāḥ smṛtyācārasaṃbaddhāḥ ṣaṭ, ātmasmṛtyā anātmasmṛtiḥ bādhyate, avigītasmṛtyā vigītasmṛtiḥ, adṛṣṭārthasmṛtyā dṛṣṭārthā smṛtiḥ, āsācāāreṇa anāsācāraḥ, avigītā-cāreṇa vigītācāraḥ, adṛṣṭārthena ācāreṇa dṛṣṭārtha ācāraḥ |
bāla, pṛ. 139. bādhabhedanirūpaṇam ( te ca medāḥ 559 bhavanti ) |
yatra atideśā-mānyaśāstrādijanite jñāne aṃśe sarvaviṣaye vā 'mithyedaṃ'
yatra tu liṅgādau śrutikalpanāpratibandhāt jñānotpattireva pratibadhyate asau aprāptabādhaḥ iti |
anayormadhye pūrvo miśraḥ : 'prameyā-pahāralakṣaṇo bādhaḥ' ityādi vyavahṛtaḥ |
[1] nityaṃ naimittikene, yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'pañcadaśa sāmidhenīranubrūyāt' iti nityaṃ pāñca
pāṭhena mukhyakramatvāde tadudāharaṇaṃ 'prakṛtau tu svaśabdatvāt' ityadhikaraṇe (5|1|8|16) uktam|
abhīṣomīyanirvāpaḥ ājyanirvāpottaraṃ mukhyakramāt prāptaḥ auṣadhanirvāpatvena ājyanirvāpāt prāk pāṭhastathaiva kāryaḥ iti|
mukhya- krameṇa pravṛttikramatvāde 'avadānābhighāraṇāsādana- ṣānupūrvye pravṛttyā syāt' ityadhikaraṇe (5|1|2|4) uktam|
sāṃnāyyadharmā hi pūrve pravṛttāḥ paścādāgneyadharmāḥ, pradānaṃ tu āgneyasya prathamam, paścāt sāṃnāyyasya tataḥ sviṣṭakṛdavadānam|
prayājaśeṣābhighāraṇaṃ vedyāmāsādanaṃ tu sāṃnāyyasya pūrvaṃ pravṛttikramāt prāptam, mukhyakramāttu āgneyasya pūrvaṃ kāryamiti |

evaṃ pañcadaśānāṃ bādhānāṃ madhye arthena pāṭhabādhaḥ, pāṭhena sthānabādhaḥ, pāṭhena mukhya- bādhaḥ, mukhyena pravṛttibādha ityeteṣāṃ caturṇāṃ bādhabhedānā- mudāharaṇāni catvāri caturbhirdhikaraṇeṣu viśeṣata udāhṛtā- nyuktāni|
ādyabādhabhedodāharaṇaṃ ca 'kramakopa'rthaśabdā- bhyām' iti jaimininaiva kṛtvācintayopanibaddhamuktam |
itareṣāṃ tu daśānāṃ bādhabhedānāmudāharaṇāni anupalabdham pañcame noktāni asābhibhraṃśitaṃ |
śrutyādiṣu ca śruti- liṅgādivat sajātīyānāmnāpi anyonyabādhaḥ śrutyoḥ, arthayoḥ, sthānayoḥ, mukhyayoḥ, pravṛttyośca ityevaṃvidhāḥ udāharaṇasaṃbhavāt pañcame na cintitāḥ |

pāṭhostu vidhi- mantragatayormantragato balavān ityuktaṃ 'mantrastu virodhe syāt' ityadhikaraṇe (5|1|9|16) agnīṣomīyanirvāpaṇaṃ prāk paṭhitam, paścādāgneyabrāhmaṇam, mantrakāṇḍe tu prāgā- gneya yājyānuvākyāyugalam, tato'gnīṣomīyasya, tatra mantrapāṭhakrameṇa vidhipāṭhakramabādhāt āgneyaḥ pūrvamagneyaḥ paścādāgnīṣomīyaḥ iti|
te ete ṣoḍaśa bādhabhedāḥ pūrvoktairdvipaṣṭisthaiḥ bādhabhedaiḥ saha aṣṭasaptatiḥ aprāpta- bādhabhedāḥ siddhāḥ |
yathā- 'audumbarī spṛṣṭvodgāyet' iti śrutyā 'audumbarī sarvā veṣṭa- yitavyā' iti smṛtiḥ |
yathā- apavādaprayogarūpa ācāraḥ 'tasmād brāhmaṇena na mlecchitavai' iti niṣedharūpayā śrutyā |
samānapravarāṃ caiva tyaktvā cāndrā- yaṇaṃ caret |

'game nu nau janitā daṃpatī kardaivastvā savitā viśvarūpaḥ' ityekam, 'ā yāhīndra pathibhirīḻitaibhiḥ' ityaparaṃ mantrarūpam, vājasaneyake 'sucau vyūhati, prācīṃ juhuṃ pratīcīmupabhṛtam' iti sucyūhanavidhiviākyaśeṣarūpam 'tasmāt samānā- deva puruṣādāccāyaśca jāyate, uta tṛtīye saṃgacchā- mahe, caturthe saṃgacchāmahe' iti tṛtīyam|
sūryāyāḥ paśya rūpāṇi tāni brahmānu- śṛṇvanti |
sūryāyā vadhuvadhvāḥ āśāsana- viśasanavikartanākhya - vastrayadhāraṇaviṣayaśrautamantrāṅgena 'sūryāvide vadhuvadhūṃ dadyāt' iti smṛteḥ ekavastradhāra- ṇāyāḥ bādhaḥ |
yathā yavavarāhadhikaraṇe (11|4|8-9) 'yadā vā anyā oṣadhayo mlāyante athaite modamānā ivottiṣṭhanti' ityevadāliṅgena priyaṅguṣu yavaśabdaprayogarūpa ācāro bādhyate |
evaṃ śrutismṛtyācārasaṃbandhāḥ pañca bādhabhedāḥ pūrvoktaiḥ aṣṭasaptatisaṃkhyeḥ bādhabhedaiḥ saha vyaśītiḥ aprāptabādhabhedāḥ siddhāḥ |
tathā [1] āsamasmṛtyā anāsasmṛtirbādhyate, yathā 'nātmānaṃ ghātayet' iti manvādismṛtyā 'kedāra pāteya- dehaṃ' iti pākhaṇḍyādismṛtiḥ |
[2] tathā avigīta- smṛtyā vigītasmṛtirbādhyate, yathā- 'na stenaḥ syāt' ityanayā 'tathaiva saptame bhakte bhaktāni ṣaḍanaśatā|
[3] adṛṣṭā- rthasmṛtyā dṛṣṭārthasmṛtirbādhyate, yathā- 'na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt' ityanayā 'jighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsīyāt' ityātma- rakṣaṇādiśrārthā |
bādhyate, yathā- pīlvadhikaraṇe (11|3|15 śā.) uktaṃ vṛkṣa- viṣayapīlupadaprayogarūpeṇa hastiviṣayasalleccharūpānā- saprayogarūpācāraḥ iti |
[5] tathā avigītā- cāreṇa vigītācāro bādhyate, yathā- dākṣiṇātyānāṃ māṃsa- bhakṣaṇavarjanācāraḥ prācyādīnāṃ ca māṃsabhakṣaṇācāraḥ |
tatrābhābhyāṃ ācārābhyāṃ śrutyanumānaṃ sāmānyata eva syāt dākṣiṇātyaprācyādyupapadakalpanāyāḥ holakādhi- karaṇanyāyena (11|3|16-23) nirastatvāt |
tataśca ki vikalpaḥ uta anyatarenātyantarabādhaḥ; vādhe'pi kena kasya iti vīkṣāyāṃ lobhādimūlakatvena bhakṣaṇācārasya vigītasya asaṃbhavyalobhādimūlakena avigītena varjanā- cāreṇa bādhaḥ |

[6] tathā adṛṣṭārthena ācāreṇa dṛṣṭārthaḥ ācāro bādhyate, yathā- vasantotsavācā- reṇa 'apivā kāraṇāgrahaṇe prayuktānye pratīyan' iti varṇake (11|3|17 śā.) śrutikalpito'dṛṣṭārthena tatsamānakālīnasya yasya kasya vit dṛṣṭārthasyācārasya bādhaḥ |
tadete ṣaṭ smṛtyācārasaṃbandhāḥ pūrvoktaiḥ vyaśītisaṃkhyerbādhabhedaiḥ saha ekonanavatiḥ bādhabhedāḥ siddhāḥ |
tathā ainyā itivat tṛtīyādiprabhavayā smṛtyā liṅgā- disamākhyāntaprabhavā bādhyate |

yathā 'putraṃ pratigṛhṇīyana niveśanena madhye vyāhṛtibhirhutvā' ityādyayā homādīti- kartavyatāyuktaputrapratigrahādiviṣayatvāt vidhiśrutistṛtīyā- śrutiprabhavayā smṛtyā 'na śeṣo agre anyajātasmṛti' ityādiḥ śeṣaḥ aparyantaṃ anyopādidatta nāsti ityarthatvena dattakaputraniṣedhaliṅgatvān tatprabhavā 'yasya ye bījino jātāstasya te netarasya tu' ityādyayā iti |
tena ete'pi pañcadaśa bhedāḥ śeṣasamavāye, pañcadaśa ca śeṣisamavāye iti triṃśat |
tataścaite pūrvoktaiḥ ekona- navatibādhabhedaiḥ saha ekonaviṃśatyadhikaṃ śataṃ aprāptabādha- medāḥ siddhāḥ |

[1] tathā vidhiprabhavayā smṛtyā arthavādaprabhavā sā bādhyate, yathā- 'mā gamanāgāmaditi vadhiṣṭa' itividhiprabhavayā 'gāṃ na hanyāt' ityanayā 'tadyadevāde' manuṣyarāja āgate asmin vā'rhati, ukṣāṇaṃ vā vehataṃ vā kṣadante' ityarthavādaprabhavā 'mahoṣaṃ vā mahājaṃ vā śrotriyāyopakalpayet' iti |
[2] tathā saṃdigdhama- saṃdigdhena, yathā- śarkarājanaṃ kena iti saṃdigdhaṃ ghṛta- stutyā |
[3] tathā durbalaśrārthaṃ balavadarthena bādhyate, yathā- durbalakramāśrayaṃ 'vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti' iti vedavākyaṃ balavatpadārthaśrayeṇa 'kṣute ānāmet' iti smṛtivākyena |
[4] tathā upasaṃhārasya upakramena, yathā- 'uccairṛcā' ityādyupasaṃhārasya ṛgādipadaṃ vedopa- krameṇa |
[5] tathā atyantādṛṣṭārtha niyamādṛṣṭārthena, yathā- avaghāte ājyasāṃnāyyārthatvamauṣadhārthatvena |
[7] anekārthavidhānaṃ alpārthavidhānena bādhyate, yathā- 'dadhnā juhoti' ityādī viśiṣṭavidhiguṇavidhinā |
[8] tathā anekārthatvaṃ ekārthatvena bādhyate, yathā- ākṛtyadhikaraṇe (11|1|30-35 varṇaka 2) |
[9] tathā anekaśabdatvaṃ ekaśabdatvena bādhyate, yathā- vyākaraṇādhikaraṇe (11|1|24-29) |

[10] bahuvācaḥ alpavācena bādhyate, yathā- aśtrapratigrahe'ṣṭeḥ prati- grahītṛviṣayatve 'vadaṇāya' iti caturthyāḥ pañcamyarthatvam, 'anayat' ityasya ca pratigrahāryatvam 'sa svāṃ devatāṃ' iti ca tacchabdasya aprādhānyānnirdiṣṭavarṇaparāmīrśatvam, dātṛtve ca varuṇasyadevatātvāt devatāśabdayogaḥ iti bahuvādhaḥ |
[11] tathā vedāntarotpannaṃ vedāntaravihitatvena bādhyate, yathā- āghāne sāmavedotpannaṃ vāravantīyādi uccaistvena prāptaṃ yajurvedavihitatvena upāṃśutvaprāpyā |
[12] tathā paraśākhāvihitaṃ svaśākhāvihitana bādhyate, yathā- udita- homādi anuditahomādinā |
[13] anārambhādhītaṃ prākaraṇikena bādhyate, yathā- anārambhādhītaṃ sāmadaśayaṃ pādadvayena |
nanu iha miśritatvādau upasaṃhāraiveṇa prakṛtau anārambhādhīta
aprāptāt yaccandratayāgena vidhirhīkṛto vārtikamate, tena jyotiṣṭome agnibidhinā prakaraṇādhītena bādhitaḥ |
'yūpāntarāṇi mātrāṇi yūpāntarāṇi bhavanti' ityanāramyavādāḥ vikṛtīḥ abhirahitāḥ gacchati iti |
[14] tathā prayogavacanaśca codakāśrayeṇa bādhyate, yathā- śyene prākṛtāṅgeṣu udāttaḥ kartṛtvaṃ codakamāptena nāntvikakṛtvatvena |
[15] tathā devatāśrayaṃ dravyāśrayeṇa bādhyate, yathā- aindrapuroḍāśe devatāsāmānyāt sānāyyavidhyantaḥ syāt, sa tu dravya- sāmānyāt pravṛtteneyavidhyante bādhyate |
[16] paścādāpnātaṃ pūrvāpnātaṃ, yathā- adhvarakalpāyāṃ āgnā- vaiṣṇavadvādaśakapālasya aindrāgdhikāratvāt āmāvāsya- tantreṇa sarakhatyāṃ ājyamāgāyāṃ prāptaṃ paurṇamāsatantram |
[ 48 ] tathā tathā anuprakṣeṇa abhyāhāro bādhyate, yathā- 'yā te ame raṃjāsayā' ityādau |
[ 49 ] tathā klṛptyā rūḍhyā yogo bādhyate, yathā- 'rayakāraḥ' iti |
[ 50 ] tathā anyatra yogena rūḍhiḥ bādhyate, yathā- prokṣaṇīśabde |
[ 52 ] tathā klṛptayogena satkāranimittatvaṃ bādhyate, yathā- prokṣaṇīśabde eva |
niruḍhesu tu guṇavidhitvenaṃ nāmadheyatvaṃ bādhyate somādiṣu |
pūrvoktaiḥ ekonaviṃśatyadhikaśatasaṅkhyaiḥ aprāptabādha- bhedaiḥ saha ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaṃ śataṃ aprāptabādhabhedāḥ siddhāḥ |
tathā pūrvoktāḥ ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ śataṃ prāptabādhabhedāḥ, ete ca ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaṃ śataṃ aprāptabādhabhedāḥ, militvā śatadvayaṃ dvicatvāriṃśacca bādhabhedā bhavanti |
eteṣāmapi ca sarveṣāṃ bādhabhedānāṃ ānarthakyapratighāte viparītau bādho bhavati, tena sarve'pi hyeṣyūpamādhyāḥ santaḥ catvāri śatāni caturaśītiśca saṃbhāvyante |
tathayā 'vrīhīnavahanti' ityatra vrīhimātrāvaghātaprāptikā śrutiḥ prakaraṇena bādhyate |
dyenādau ca upamānānarthakyāt gauṇyā matvarthalakṣaṇayā bādhyate |

na kevalaṃ tātīyapramāṇameva āna- rthakyapratighātena bādhyate, kintu dvitīyapramāṇamapi yathā abhyuditeṣṭau 'ye svaviṣṭhāḥ, ye'gniṣṭhāḥ' ityanayorvākyayoḥ anekārthopadānāt vākyamedāpatteḥ guṇena karmabhedasya prasaktasya 'saha śrapayati' iti vidhānārthakyāt bādhaḥ |
śrutyādīnāṃ ca ānarthakyabhāve'pi uttaro- ttareṇa anyathā'nupapattyādihakṛtena pūrvapūrvasya bādho bhavati |

tathayā liṅgena śrutivāce tāvat, 'suveṇāvadyati' 'svadhitinā- 'vadyati' iti śuvādikareḥ śeṣaḥ śrutvā drāvadāne itarādadāne vā anekatra śeṣiṇi prāptaḥ; liṅgena drāva- vadāne eva niyamanāt śeṣayante bādhyate |
smin śeṣiṇi drāvadānādau śrutyaiva suvaḥ karaṇāttaraṃ ca anekaśeṣaḥ prāptaḥ, tatra liṅgena suvameva nityacchatā karaṇāttaraṃ śrautamapi bādhyate |
vākyena liṅgācce 'devasya tvā' iti mantre savitrādidevatāprakāśanasāmarthyaṃ tamarśaṃ savitrādau viniyuñjānaṃ vākyena prakṛtādidevatā- nivāpe viniyuñjānaṃ bādhyate |

paśau ca 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre ityādyāramāghārayati' ityādhārayateḥ pūrvādhāra- viṣayatā hiraṇyagarbhamantraliṅgāt ārādhakasya uttarādhāre ' indra ūrdhvo'dhvare ' iti mantrajanyāniyamādṛṣṭasya klṛptatvāt vadviṣyatāniścaye tatsamabhivyāhārātmakāt vākyāt liṅgaṃ bādhyate iti daśame ( 10|3|12|13-17 ) sthitam |

prakaraṇena vākyāvacye dyene 'nivītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' iti vihitaṃ nivītaṃ tātīyavedivarhi- stadmarmanyāyena ( 3|7|115-5 ) vākyāt aṅgaprabhā- nārthaṃ prakṛtaṃ syenaprakaraṇatā pradhānamātrārthe bhavati |
ata eva daśame ( 10|4|1|1-2 varṇakaṃ 1 ) tadreṣu aiṣṭikeṣu codakaprāptamupavītaṃ bhinnaviṣayaṃ iti nārihahoma- bādhasamuccayācintāviṣayaḥ iti vakṣyate |
nanu evaṃ nivītaṃ ajñāntare'pi na syāt, kintu tātīyahavirbhedenyāya- vaiṣamyam |
saumikadīkṣādakṣiṇavat pradhānārthameva sat kartṛdvārā prayogadvayāt prasaṅgadādvāntareṣu upakāri- vyuti iti na tadarthamapi vākyamāyāsādinīyam |
pradhāna- haviṣi tu vedivarhiṣorāsāditena aṅgahavisādite bhavati, iti tadarthamapi vākyasya pṛthagāyāsena bhāvyam, iti tātīyanyāyavaidhavyamiti |
krameṇa prakaraṇavākye 'darvi- nāmāsi' iti mantre āgneyādiṣvapi viniyuñjānaṃ praka- raṇaṃ upāṃśuyājamātre viniyuñjānaṃ yathāsaṃkhyamānakrameṇa bādhyate |
ayaṃ cāspaṣṭaliṅgaḥ asyārthasyābhidhāyakaḥ; itya- jñānāt kathaṃ prakaraṇaviṣaya iti vācyam |
samārakhyā kramavāce jyotiṣṭome varapotānāmityādināṃ saṃnidhānāt sarvanāyavyavasthā kartṛtve prāpte samārakhyā vyavasthā |
caturśītyadhikaśatacatuṣṭayasaṃkhyaiḥ saha caturdaśādhikāni pañca śatāni bādhabhedā bhavanti |
tathā pratyakṣaḥ śrutyādibhiḥ ānumānikānāṃ śrutyādīnāṃ bādhaḥ; yathā- śyenādau 'śaramayaṃ barhiḥ' iti pratyakṣaśrutyā 'barhiṣi havīṃṣyāsādayati ' ityanumānikaśruteḥ |
tathā ānumānikaiḥ śrutyādibhiḥ ānumānikānāṃ teṣāṃ bādhaḥ; yathā- paśau anumeyeḥ prayājādiviniyojakaiḥ śrutyādibhiḥ paśupuroḍāśe tadvi- niyojakānāṃ ānumānikānāṃ śrutyādīnām |
tathā ānumānikānāṃ śrutyādīnāṃ pratyakṣa- liṅgādibhirbādhaḥ; yathā- kṛṣṇaleṣu sāmarthyena 'vrīhī- navahanti' ityatideśānumitaśruteḥ |
pūrvoktaiḥ caturdaśādhika- pañcaśatabādhabhedaiḥ saha ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ śatapañcakaṃ bādha- bhedāḥ bhavanti |
'ye ke'pi tatra tatra syurvādhā nyāya- sahasragāḥ |
' pramāṇāmiva ca nyāyānāmapi anyonyaṃ tatra bādhya- bādhakabhāvo bhavati, taṃ vākyabhedanirūpaṇaprayojanāntaraṃ nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ |
' vā. 313|14 pṛ. 859. bādhayogyatādhikaraṇaṃ mīko. pṛ. 2942 ityatra balābaladhikaraṇe draṣṭavyam |
bhā. 313|14, vā. pṛ. 858. mīko. pṛ. 2942 ityatra balābaladhikaraṇe draṣṭavyaḥ |
taddhi bādhakaṃ bhavati yadavādhamāna- maprayojanaṃ bhavati |
' bādhabādhe bādhyasya nirapavādatvāt ' iti nyāyena āśrayakṛtabalābalasya punarujjīvanādapi na mlecchaprasiddhārthagrahaṇasiddhiḥ |
bādhitabādhasya bādhakabādhena bādhyasya sujñāna- tvāt yāni hi śrutibādhyairliṅgādibhiḥ bādhyante tāni śrutyā bādhyantetarām |
yat tatra tatra ucyate idamanena bādhyate ( iti tadittham ) pratyakṣaṇa anumānaṃ yathā sattamau'yamityādinā bāhyārthaviṣayapratyakṣeṇa nirālambanānu- mānam, mṛgatṛṣṇādipratyayāt |
śrutyā smṛtiḥ- yathā 'audu- mbarī spaṣṭodgāyet ' iti śrutyā 'audumbarī sarvā vedyavitanyā ' iti smṛtiḥ |
āsasmṛtā anāsasmṛtiḥ- āsatya manvādeḥ avigītatvā 'nātmānaṃ ghātayet prājñaḥ' ityādyayā smṛtyā 'kedāre pātayedeham' ityādyanāptārakhaṇḍyā- disṛtiḥ |
avigītasmṛtyā vigītasmṛtiḥ- 'bhāryāśratalo viprasya' ityādyāsmṛtipi 'yacchyate dvijatīnāṃ śudrā- dāropasaṃgrahaḥ |
na tanmama matam' iti yājñavalkyadi- smṛtibhiḥ |
adṛṣṭārthayā smṛtyā dṛṣṭārthā- 'na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt' ityādisṛtyā 'jighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsīyāt' ityātmarakṣaṇāyā |

śrutiprama- vayā liṅgādibhavā- 'putraṃ pratibhadhīyan vandhūnāya rāje nivedha niveśayasya madhye vyāhṛtibhirhutvā pratigṛhṇīyāt ' ( vasiṣṭhasmṛtiḥ 1|56 ) ityādyā homādītikartavyatā- yuktaputrapratigrahādividhayatvādiprabhavayā 'na śeṣo ame anyajātamsti' ityādeḥ dattakaputraniṣedhādi liṅkatvāt tadbhavavā |

śrutiprabhavayā smṛtyā arthavādamavavā smṛtiḥ- ' tadyathā manuṣvarāja āgate'yasmin vāhiti uṣmāṇaṃ vā vedhataṃ vā kṣadante ' ityādyarthavādaprabhavā 'mahoṃśaṃ vā mahājaṃ vā śrotriyāyopakalpayet ' ityādyā 'gāmanāgāmaditi
vadhiṣṭa' ityādidhiśrutiprabhavayā 'gobrāhmaṇalāmammāṃsi nocchiṣṭho na padā spṛṣṭo |
smṛtyā ācāraḥ— 'sūryādidhe vadhūvastraṃ dadyāt' ityādismṛtyā vivāhacaturthe'hani vadhūvastrapra- dānādyācāraḥ |
abhiyuktataraṇa abhiyuktacāraḥ— vṛddhavyavahārābhiyuktānāmapi mlecchānāṃ hastyādī palvādi- śabdayogācāraḥ |
saṃdigdhaṃ asaṃdigdhena— 'aktāḥ śarkarāḥ' iti saṃdigdhaṃ asaṃdigdhena ghṛtasattvane |
durbalāśrayaṃ bala- vadāśrayeṇa — durbalāśrayaṃ 'vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti' iti vedavākyaṃ balavadarthāśrayeṇa śrutādinimittāccamana- vākyena |
upakramasthena upasaṃhārastham— upasaṃhārasthaṃ ṛgādipadaṃ upakramasthena vedapadena |
atyantādṛṣṭārthaṃ niyamādṛṣṭārthena — sāṃnāyyayoḥ atyantādṛṣṭārthaṃ ava- ghātādi auṣadhe niyamādṛṣṭārthena avaghātādinā |
ārā- dupakārakatvaṃ sāmavāyikatvena— paśupuroḍāśasya ārādu- pakāritvaṃ saṃnipatyopakāritvena |
anekārthavidhānaṃ ekārtha- vidhānena— 'darśanā juhoti' iti viśiṣṭavidhipakṣe viśeṣaṇa- viśeṣarūpānikārthavidhānaṃ guṇavidhipakṣe ekārthavidhānena |
anekaśabdārthatvaṃ ekaśabdārthatvena— ekasya arthasya aneka- gotryādidiśabdatvaṃ ekagośabdatvena |

bahudhādhaḥ alpa- bādhena— pratigrahīturvihitaḥ iti pakṣe varaṇayeti caturthyāḥ pañcamyarthatvena, 'aśvamanayat' iti nayateśca pratigṛhā- tyarthatvena kalpanāt 'sa svāṃ devatāṃ' iti ca tacchabdasya aprāmāṇyanirdiṣṭavarūpaparamarśilāt dātṛtve ca varuṇasya devatātvābhāvena devatāśabdasya avivakṣitārtha- tvāt bahudhādhaḥ, dāturitiḥ iti pakṣe pratigrahītā- mātrasya dāne kalpyatvāt alpabādhena |
vedāntarotpannaṃ vedāntaravihitena— sāmavedaupanvarantītyādeḥ upāṃśutvaṃ yajurvedavihitena uccaistvarūpeṇa |
nityaṃ naimittiken— nityaṃ sāmi- dhenīpādyadayaṃ vaiśyanimittena sāsadadhyena |
kṛtvarthaṃ puruṣārthena— nityaṃ pāścadayaṃ naimittiken sāsa-
bhā. 3|3|14 pṛ. 858-862. mīko. pṛ. 2942 ityatra balā- balādhikaraṇe draṣṭavyaḥ |
bārhaspatyatu vṛhatīviśārapaḍaktyoreva prathamanena saṃpādite, rauravadhīājyasāmnorgānaṃ jyotiṣṭome |
ṭupa. 6|1| 7|28. bārhadgiraṃ brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārthurdabhaṃ rājanyasya, rāyovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' ayaṃ kartutaḥ vācanikavyavastheti |
bāla. pṛ. 18-19. bārha- dgiraṃ brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārthurdabhaṃ rājanyasya, rāyovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti naimittikameva na nityam, dvādaśāhe |
vi.10|4|3. bārhaspatyacaturthaḥ kāmyaḥ paśuḥ carakautrāmaṇyā iti satyāpādaḥ |
drāmyāṃ viśeṣaṇamyāṃ viśiṣṭaḥ taddhitārtho vidhīyate, nopa- sarjanam |
idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ haviḥ, prātaśca, mādhyaṃdine ca tṛtīyasavanaṃ ca adhvarakalpyāyām |
bhā. 11|2|4|15. bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ kṣitipṛṣṭhe dakṣiṇā' iyaṃ pañcamī aveṣṭiḥ rājasūye |
bhāṭṭa. 11|4|3. 'yadi brāhmaṇo yajeta, bārhaspatyaṃ madhye''hutimāhuti hutvā''dhirayet' ( idamaveṣṭi ) |
bhā. 11|4|3|8. bārhaspatyasya āgneyavikārasya dharmāḥ pūrva kāryāḥ, sarasvatyājyasya upāṃśuyājavikārasya dharmāḥ paścāt, prayogavacanāt codakasya balavattvāt, adhvarakalpyām |
12|4|2|3-4. bārhaspatyadigrahaḥ bṛhaspativādau upadiṣṭaḥ: ātideśikānāṃ aindrāvāyavādigrahāṇāṃ samuccayaḥ |
bārhaspatyacaruḥ prathamabhāvinaḥ āgneyasya vikāraḥ, sārasvatājyaṃ ca paścādbhāvinḥ upāṃśuyājavikāra iti antaraṅgatvāt adhvarakalpyāyāṃ pūrvaṃ bārhaspatyacaru- nirvapaḥ paścāt sārasvatājyadharmāḥ |
bārhaspatyacarurnivāpāt pūrvaṃ āgneyavvanirvapātḥ tato bārhaspatyacarunirvāpaḥ vaikṛtamukhyakramamanurāhat adhvara- kalpyāyām |
sāhasī. 164. bālāpraśatabhāgo'pi na kalpyo niṣprabhā- ṇakaḥ |
bāhyārthasadbhāvaḥ nirālambanavādanirāsena aupa- tikasattve eva bhāṣye uktaḥ |

yadā yānyetāni trayīvicchinnaṃ parigṛhītāni kiñcit‌miśradhamaikañjupha- lāyāpātitāni lokopasaṃgrahalābhapūjādijanaparāṇi strīviparītāsaṃbaddhadharmādiprakhyānamānopamānārthāpatti- prāyayuktimalopenibandhāni sāṃkhyayogapāñcarātrapāśupatākhya- anyaparigṛhītadharmādharmanibandhanani viṣacikitsāsāvī- karaṇodghāṭanonmādanādisamarthakatipayadharmādidhiśruti- siddhinidarśanatvena ahiṃsāsatyavacanadamadānayādiśruti- smṛtisaṃvāditokāryagandhavāsitījvikāprāyārthāntopade- śīni yāni ca bāhyatarāṇi mlecchācāramiśrabhojanā- caraṇanibandhanani teṣāāmevaitacchutivirodheturdarśanamātmana-
' brāhmaṇakṣatriyapraṇītatvāviśeṣaṇa vā mānavādivadeva śruti- mūlatvamāśritya sacetaso'pi śrutivihitaḥ saha vikalpameva pratipadyeran |
' tatra śraddhāmātramevaikaṃ vyavasthā nimittam, sarveṣāṃ khapita- pitāmahādicaritānuyāyitvāt |
yaiśca mānavādivyatīnā- mapyutpannavedaśākhāmūlatvamabhyupagataṃ tān prati sutarāṃ śākyādibhirapi śakyaṃ tanmūlatvameva vaktum |
tataśca yāvat kiñcit kiyantamapi kālaṃ kaścit ādiyamāṇaṃ prasiddhaṃ gatama, tatpratyakṣaśāstrāvisaṃvāde'pi uttantrāśā- mūlatvāsthānamanubhavatastathyatā pratimāyāt |
pāratantryaṃ tāva- deṣāṃ sarvamamāṇapuruviśeṣapraṇītatvāccaiva pratipannaṃ śabda- kṛtakatvādipratipādanādaśca pārśvasthairapi jñāyate |
vedamūlatvaṃ punaste tulyakakṣamūlatvākṣameva lajjayā ca mātāpitṛdveṣiduṣṭaputravat nābhyupagacchanti |
śākyādica- nāni tu katipayadamanādāvevacanavat sarvāṇyeva samasta- caturdaśavidyāsthānaviruddhāni trayīmārganyativiruddhā- caraṇaiśca buddhādibhiḥ praṇītāni |
trayībāhyebhyastathyavarṇa- niravasitaprāyebhyo vyāmuhyemyaḥ samarpitānīti na vedamūla- tvena saṃbhāvyante |
svadharmātikrameṇa ca yena kṣatriyeṇa satā pravattyapratigraho pratipanno sa dharmaviplutamupadekṣyatīti kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ |
buddhādeḥ punarayameva vyatikramo- 'laṅkārabuddhī syāt : yenaivamāha 'kalikaluṣakṛtāni yāni loke mayi nipatantu vimucyatāṃ tu lokaḥ |

sa kila lokahitārtha kṣatriyadharmamatikramya brāhmaṇavṛttaṃ pravattuṃ pratipādya pratiṣedhātikramasamarthairbrāhmaṇairanuśiṣṭhaṃ dharme brāhmaṇajananuśāsaddhamaipīḍāmayamātmano'ṅgīkṛtya parā- nugrahaṃ kṛtavānityevavidhaireva stūyate tadanuśiṣṭhānusāri- ṇaśca sarva evaṃ śrutismṛtivihitadharmātikrameṇa vyavaharanto viruddhatvāttvena jñāyante |
' na hyeṣāṃ pūrvoktena nyāyena śruti- pratibaddhānāṃ svamūlaśrutyanumānasāmarthyamasti |
yasmin saṃni- hite dṛṣṭe nāsti mūlāntarānumā ||
eta eva ca yeṣāṃ vāṅmātreṇāpi nārcanam |
' etadīyā granthā eva ca manvādibhiḥ parihārya- tvenoktāḥ |
sarvāstā niṣphalāḥ proktāstamoniṣṭhā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
' tasmādayaṃ prati trayībāhyamevajātīyakaṃ prāmāṇyanānapekṣyaṃ syāditi siddham |
evaṃ tarhi saugatāyāgamā- tho'pi kaścidahiṃsādiḥ sarvadarśanaiḥ pātibhiḥ anuṣṭhīyate eva kaiścit iti so'pi mahājanaparigṛhītaḥ syāt |
bidā: 2973 buddhe nyāyena śraddhāpādāya śailodaniprabhṛtibhirupanibaddhaḥ āho svayaṃdṛṣṭa eveti |
sanā. dha. pra. pṛ. 246. bidāḥ : pañcāvacinaḥ |
yathā cile garte varta- mānāyā godhāyā vibhajanaṃ vibhājakadharmeṇa nirdeśo na saṃbhavati, tasyā adṛṣṭatvāt, evamajñātaparasiddhāntasya tadūpaṇāya pravṛttirbhavetītyevaṃ vivakṣāyāmasya pravṛttiriti |
atra godhāpadaṃ bilanivāsināṃ sarpādīnāmupalakṣaṇaṃ jñeya- miti |
vyākhyāto'yaṃ nyāyaḥ ślokena, tadyathā- "khalvāṭo divaseśvarasya kiraṇaiḥ saṃtā- pito mastake, vāñchan deśamanātapaṃ vidhivaśācchilpasya mūlaṃ gataḥ |
tatrāpyasya mahāphalena pattā bhayaṃ saśabdaṃ śiraḥ, prāyo gacchati yatra bhāgyaharahitastatra yāntyā- padaḥ ||
anavabuddhārthe pravṛtti- raśakyeti yatra vivakṣā tatrāyaṃ pravartate |
iti nyāyena mātṛ- rūpaparāce'pi 'bījādyoninirbalīsya' iti nyāyena mātṛ- brāhmaṇamātreṇa kṣetribrāhmaṇena vā putre brāhmaṇasiddheḥ kathaṃ durśinatā ityāśaṅkā |
su. pṛ. 62. bīje bīje avahananamanyatra āvṛttiḥ nānātrījeṣṭho rājasūye |
bījaṃ vinā nāṅkuro jāyate, aṅkuraṃ vinā ca bījotpattiriti |
evaṃ yatra parasparakāryakāraṇabhāva- statrāyaṃ nyāyaḥ pravartate |
tathā ca bījajātīyaṃ pratya- ṅkurajātīyam, aṅkurajātīyaṃ ca prati bījajātīyaṃ na kāraṇam |
ato bījāṅkurapravāhānāditvā ca yadījaṃ prati yadaṅkurasya kāraṇatvaṃ tadaṅkuraṃ prati tadījasya na kāraṇatvato nānyonyāśrayaḥ |
evaṃ ca prāmāṇikatvāt gṛhyate, yatra ca prāmāṇikatvaṃ tatra nānāditvakalpaneti |
prāmāṇikapravāhasyaiva anāditvakalpanā, nānyasyeti siddhāntāt sūcitaṃ ca |
tathā ca śārīrakabhāṣye 'tatkṛtadharmādharmanimittaṃ śarīratvamiti cet, śarīra- saṃbandhasya dharmādharmayostatkṛtatvasya cetaretarāśrayatvaprasaṅgā- danyaparamparevaiṣā kalpanā' iti |
'ātmanaḥ śarīrasaṃbandhe jāte dharmādharmotpattiḥ, tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ saṃvandharūpajanmametya- nyonyāśrayādekasyāsiddhyā dvitīyasyāsiddheḥ' syāditi pariharati- netyādinā |
pūrvadehakarmaṇa etadehasaṃbandhotpattiḥ, pūrvadehasya tatpūrvadehakarmaṇaḥ, tadehasaṃbandhotpattiḥ tatpūrvadehakṛtakarmaṇa iti bījāṅkura- vadanāditvānna doṣa ityata āha- anyeti |

na hi bījādaṅkurastato bījāntaraṃ ca yathā pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate, tathā ātmano dehasaṃbandhaḥ pūrvakarmakṛtaḥ pratyakṣaḥ, nāpyastye kaścidāgamaḥ; pratyuta 'asaṅgo hi' ityādiśrutiḥ sarvakartṛtvaṃ vārayatīti bhāvaḥ' iti ānandagiriḥ |
sāhasī. 217. \ bījābhāve kutaḥ phalam' iti nyāyena advaitatvamamatano viśadayati |
upadeśasāhasī. padya. 1919 rāmatīrthe; 'bījābhāve phalābhāvaḥ' iti nyāyena śokamohākāraṇajñānasya nivṛttau ātmanaḥ janmādi nahi bhavet iti viniścayaḥ vedavidām |
tatra kramaṃ vinaiva kecit tatprakaraṇāḥ caturdaśa mantrāḥ grāhyāḥ, na ādita eva |
yathā bījāt vṛkṣo bhavati, vṛkṣāt bījamiti |
buddhādivatsāṃ asaṃbhavanamūlanāṃ prāmāṇyasaṃbhāvanā api naiva bhavati |
ṛju. pṛ. 60. buddhiḥ nirākārā tu no buddhiḥ ākāravān bāhyorthaḥ |
sā ca arthe jñāte sati śatatālikkaphānumānāt anumeyā |
ghaṭaḥ viṣayatāsaṃbandhena śanaviśiṣṭaḥ, svarūpasaṃbandhena jñātātvat iti |
1|15|5 pṛ. 33. na cāryahetutā buddhiḥ ātmākāramātramanubhavantī jāyate ityuktaṃ śūnyavāde |
vā. 1|4|123 pṛ. 358. na ca vyavahāraṃ vinā parabuddhiranumātuṃ śakyate |
ṛju. pṛ. 16. na hi ajñāte arthaṃ kaścit buddhimupalabhate |
bhā. 1|15|5 pṛ. 32. buddhyā viṣayīkṛtasya bādhaḥ saṃbhavati |
viṣayaprakāśanaṃ phalam, buddhiḥ karaṇam, vyāpāraścātra buddherjanyameva nānyaḥ |
yadi janmāntarameva janayati tasya tatra janmaiva vyāpāraḥ |
bhā. 1|15|5 pṛ. 34. pūrvabuddheḥ kṣaṇikatvaṃ svarūpeṇa nāśe'pi saṃskāradvārā anapāyaḥ |
bhā. 8|1|17|34. buddhikarmaṇī na pratyakṣe tasmānna te pratyabhijñāyate |
ṛju. pṛ. 247. buddhipūrvakārī tāvat kartṛmeva nādhyavasyati na ca prayatate |
abuddhipūrvakāriṇā tu ajñātavastunā puṃsā yadṛcchayā prayatnākhye vyāpāre kṛte'pi vastuniṣpatti- naikāntāddhavati |
su. 3|7 pṛ. 13. buddhipūrvakārī puruṣaḥ na ca puruṣārtharahitaṃ vyāpāraṃ vacanaśatenāpi ukto'nutiṣṭhati |
vā. 2|1|12 pṛ. 383. 'budhanvānāgneyaḥ kāryaḥ' ityatra taddhitānte āgneyapade upasarganībhūto devatāvācako'gniśabdaḥ budha- nbacchabdena viśeṣaṃ nārhati |
āgneyaḥ ājyabhāgaḥ, budhanvān budhadhātughaṭitamantrayuktaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ |
pavamāneṣṭiṣu ājyabhāgadevau na saguṇau, tena agreḥ budhanvān iti viśeṣaṇaṃ na saṃbhavati |
('agni stomena vardhaya' iti bhāṣye, paraṃtu taisaṃ., ṛsaṃ., atra 'bodhaya' ityeva ) |
pavamāneṣṭiṣu ājyabhāgayoḥ : 'budhanvānāgneyaḥ kāryaḥ', pāvakavān saumyaḥ ' iti śrūyate |
tatra tyāgādiṣu budha- nbān agniḥ, pāvakavān somaśca abhidhātāḥ saguṇaḥ |
'budhanvate'gnaya idaṃ na mama' ' budhanvāngiridaṃ havi- rjuṣata ' iti, tathā ' pāvakavate somāyedaṃ na mama ' ' pāvakavān soma idaṃ havirajuṣata ' iti |
pavamānavat, yathā pavamāneṣṭiṣu pavamānādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭo'gniśabda ucyate tadvat iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
mantraviśeṣanirdeśāt mantraviśeṣasya nirdeśo'yaṃ budhanvānāgneyaḥ kārya ityādiḥ |
' agni stomena vodhaya samidhāno amaryam ' ityādiḥ mantraḥ budhadhātumatatvāt budhanvān ucyate |
tathā ca mantranirdeśo'yaṃ na devatā- nirdeśaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. bubhukṣamāṇāḥ ke cit śrīrājakasya bhojana- mācaritavantaḥ |
bhā. 1|3|14 pṛ. 186. bubhukṣitaḥ kiṃ dvikareṇa bhuṅkte iti nyāyaḥ |
yathā 'jāgarti loko jvalati pradīpaḥ sajīvanaḥ paśyati kautukaṃ me |
kṣaṇikamātraṃ kuru kānta dhairyaṃ bubhukṣitaḥ kiṃ dvikareṇa bhuṅkte ' iti |
sāhasī. 641. bubhukṣitaṃ kiṃ karoti pāpaṃ ( daridraḥ kiṃ na kurute) iti nyāyaḥ |
sāhasī. 643, 644. bubhukṣitaṃ na pratibhāti kiñciditi nyāyaḥ |
uktaṃ ca- 'jāgarti loko jvalati pradīpaḥ sajīvanaḥ paśyatu kautukaṃ te |
kṣaṇikamātraṃ na karomi dhairyaṃ bubhukṣitaṃ na pratibhāti kiñcit ' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 34. bṛhasyaśabdaḥ bṛhacchabdārtha gamayati ' sarasvatī devanido nirvahaya prajñā viśvasya bṛhasya māyinaḥ ' ityatra |
ratna. 10|5|25|85. bṛhadādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ viśvajiti naikratra niveśaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|30. bṛhaddharmāḥ citrādisuto nivaddhāḥ bṛhati bhaveyuḥ, na rayaṃtare |
' upavatī rathatarapṛṣṭhasya pratipat kuryāt agravatīṃ bṛhatpṛṣṭhasya ' |
' prayujo vāco agriyaḥ ' iti amiya- catī ṛk pratipat |
vi. 10|5|16. bṛhadrathataraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati ' iti bṛhatsāmakaṃ na rathatarasāmakamiti |
naiva tatra bṛhat nimittaṃ bhavati rathataraṃ vā |
mā. 6|1|19, bṛhadrathatarābhyāṃ anyatareṇa pṛṣṭhaṃ sādhitaṃ jyotiṣṭome |
10|6|124, bṛhadrathatarayoḥ ekasmin karmaṇi vikalpaḥ; ekārtha- tvāt |
10|6| 314-5. mīko. pṛ. 1550 'gavāmayane pṛṣṭhe paṣṭhe'' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
bṛhadrathatarayoḥ saṃsave, gosave, apacitau, pṛṣṭhastotra eva samuccitya niveśaḥ |
tatra vyastayorapi kriyamāṇayoḥ sāhityaṃ na vidhya- dhyate |
ekaṃ sāma kiñcit stotramabhinirvartayiṣyati dvitī- yamapi aparam |
pradhānopakārapekṣaṃ sāhityamiti samasta- saṃyogo na virudhyate |
yatra parasparasyopakārayogo bhavati tatraitadeva nyāyyam, yena kriyādvayena ārambhameṇa mantreṇāvasānena vā yogaḥ tena sahitayoḥ, na pṛthakdāḥ |
te ca śaktayutaḥ sahite pṛṣṭhaṃ saṃskartum |
bhā. 10|6|8|25. bṛhadrathatarayoḥ svobhayantarāpramyanena saṃpāditakukumoreva gānaṃ ( jyotiṣṭome ) |
9|2|6| 25-28. mīko. pṛ. 1822 'jyotiṣṭome bṛhadrathata- rayoḥ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
sāmaśabdastu sāmānyavācī gānamātre vartate, na tu gāna- viśiṣṭhāyāmuci |
vi. 9|2|1. bṛhadrathatarabhayasāmake kratau rathatarādidharmāṇāṃ prakṛtivad vyavasthā |
' saṃsava ume kuryāt, gosava ume kuryāt, apavitrāvatyekāhe ume bṛhadrathatare kuryāt ' iti śrūyate |
santi tu prakṛtau bṛha- drmāṃ rathataradharmāśca |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kimubhayasāmani ubhayadharmāḥ kartavyāḥ athavā
tathā ca vakṣyati (bhāṣyakāraḥ-) ‘sāmnā'pi dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ ca kriyate’ iti |
api ca stobhā- ścoccaistvadādyaśca sāmni guṇabhūtāḥ |
aṇanā- nyāyo'pi (3|1|612) nāsti, stomānāmuccai- stavādīnāṃ ca parasparanirākāṅkṣatvāt |
yattu ‘sāmnā'pi dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ ca’ iti ṛgakṣarābhivyaktyā dṛṣṭam, yena punaradṛṣṭārthaṃ stutimutpādayati tenādṛṣṭam |
tasmānna saṃkaro yukto na tvevaṃ prokṣa- ṇādiṣu |
soma — yadi kāryasādhanaprayuktā dharmāḥ tadā rathaṃtaravṛhatoḥ ekakāryatvāt taddharmasaṃkaraḥ syādityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ |
vacanaṃ cātra ‘rathaṃtaraṃ bṛhada vā pṛṣṭhaṃ kāryam’ ityevaṃrūpamiti mīmāṃsakapravādaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- rathaṃtara- bṛhatorekāryatvāt dharmāṇāmavibhāgaḥ saṃkaraḥ syāditi |
bhāṭṭa — jyotiṣṭome ‘pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate’ ityanena paṭ pṛṣṭhastotrāṇi vihitāni |
tatra bṛhadrathaṃtarasāmabhyoḥ ‘bṛhadā rathaṃtaraṃ vā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati’ iti vacanā- dvikalpaḥ |
tathā ca niyatāni catvārītyādi citrādhikaraṇe kaustubhe spaṣṭam |
kecicca bṛhatpuraskāreṇa ‘bṛhat prastūyamāne samudraṃ manasā dhyāyet, uccairgaiyam’ ityādyāḥ |
yatrāpi sāmnaḥ śeṣitvameva, na tu nimittatvaṃ uccaistvadi- prāyapāṭhāt |
te kimubhayatrāpi saṃkīrṇā uta vyavasthitā iti cintāyām, satyapi stomabhede tajjanyatvāt lāgha- vādekajātīyasyaiva kalpanādekapūrvasādhanībhūtatvena dharmā- ṇāmavaghātādivat saṃkaraḥ |
na hyanayoḥ prayājānuyājavat samuccayaḥ yenādṛṣṭe'jñātatvābhāvaka syāt |
ata eva vikalpa- vacanasyāpyadṛṣṭeva eva tātparyamityapi suvacam |
ata eva rathantarasya ‘abhi tvā śūra’ ityasyāmutpannatvena āvāhanādiprakārasya ca bhede'pi na praveśaḥ |
na hi ṛgyathemede'pi sāmnaḥ akṣarābhivyaktatā bhidyate |
ata eva keṣucinmeṣu ratha- ntarastopādāna keṣucit bṛhat iti pratiniyatanirdeśādya- ntaratvādidhivyayā dharmavyavasthetyapyāstām |

na caivamapi rathaṃtarādīteḥ ṛgakṣarasya dṛṣṭārthatve'pi stobhākṣarasyatvasya adṛṣṭārthatvāt tada- dṛṣṭośca gītibhedena medāt tattatpūrvasādhanatva- lakṣaṇayā dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtau na sāṃkaryam, kaṇvarathaṃtarasya bṛhadyaṃtarasthānāpannatvena tattatstobhāśritagītyaṃgaprākṛta- stobhāśritagītyaṃśajanyādṛṣṭaheva hiraṇyagarbhamantranyāyena kalpanāt tatrāpi dharmaprāpyapattiriti vācyam |

na ca tathāpi sāmadvayajanyaniyamā- dṛṣṭamedāt tanniyamādṛṣṭasādhanatvasya ca taddharmavidhā- vuddeśyatāvacchedakatvāt kaṇvarathaṃtare ca hiraṇyagarbhamantra- nyāyena tadbhedabhāvāt sāṃkaryādanāpattiriti vācyam |
tajjanyatve'pi vā dṛṣṭaprayojanatvaivākṣarābhivyaktyadeḥ puraḥ- sphūrtikatvāt sādhanatvadharmaprayojakatvena niyamādṛṣṭasya tatraprayo- jakatvābhāvāt |
iti prāpte, satyapi stotrajanyavyāpyatve atrāntarakāryabhedāt vyavasthāsiddhiḥ |

tadvāpyavaijātyaṃ vā na tāvat pratiguṇābhidhānavyakti- viśrāntam, dvādaśastotratvānupapatteḥ ; api tu tatta- stotraguṇābhidhānavyakteiṣu vyāsajyavṛtti, tāsāṃ ca na yogapadyaṃ kṣaṇikatvāt kramikatvāt |

taiśca sakala- guṇasamūhālambanātmikā tattajjātīyastotratvācchinnā abhidhānavyakteirekā utpadyate ityavaśyaṃ vācyam, tatra ca vijātīyastotrajanakatvācchandakatvā saṃskāre'pi vaijātyā- vaśyaṃbhāvāt, dīkṣaṇīyāvāḍniyamanyāyena tattatsaṃskāra- samūhaprayuktā eva tattaddharmā iti na prakṛtau sāṃkaryam |

kaṇvarathaṃtare ca hiraṇyagarbhamantranyāyena tattatsaṃskārasamūha- dvayajanakatvaiva ṛgantarajanyatadaśadaśasaṃkhyākaguṇābhidhāna- vyaktividhānāt tattatsaṃskārasamūhaprayuktadharmaprāpyapatti- riti sarvamanākulam |
tathā ca keṣu cidahaḥsu rathaṃtaraṃ keṣu cit bṛhat |
bhā. 10|6|14-5. bṛhadyartha- tarasāmnoreva prakṛtau aṅgatvena vidhānaṃ na tu tayordvayoḥ |
tayoḥ prathamena enā bṛhatī dve kakubhī ca saṃpadyante, tāsu bṛhad gātavyam |
ṛsaṃ, sarvānu- kramaṇyāṃ hi kākubhaḥ pragāyaḥ kakup-satobṛhatībhyāṃ sthita paṅktiriti vaktuṃ śakyam, paraṃtu kakup uṣṇig- jātīyā na bṛhatījātīyā iti |
ke.) vi. 9|16, bṛhatsāma jyotiṣṭome pṛṣṭhastotre rathaṃtareṇa saha vikalpitam |
7|13, bṛhatsāma ‘tvāmiddhi havā- mahe’ ityetasyāṃ yonau utpannam |
10|1424, bṛha- tsāma viśvajiti ṣaḍahāt ‘viśvajitsarvapṛṣṭhaḥ’ iti sarvaśabdāt prāptam |
kiṃ prākṛtīnāṃ triṣṭubgatīnāma- kṣarālopaṃ kṛtvā gāyatrī tadahaḥ kartavyam, uta utpatti- gāyatrīṇāṃ dāśatayībhyaḥ āgamaṃ kṛtveti |
gāyatrīṣu śrūyamāṇasu gāyatrīmetadaharbhavati iti prākṛtīnāṃ triṣṭu- bjagatīnāmavacchedo'kṣarālopaḥ kartavyaḥ |
yadi anyāsāmṛcāmāgamanaḥ kriyeta, prākṛtaḥ pratyayo bādhyate |
kathaṃ jñāyate ? anyatirekā- caturviṃśatisyameva na vyabhicarati |
ka: punarviyau viśeṣa: ? vidhī śabdārthena vyavahāro bhavati |
yathā loke amī piṣṭapiṇḍā: siṃhā: kriyantāmiti, vede'pi 'pṛṣṭhairupatiṣṭhate' iti |
na ca tatra siṃhaśabda: pratikṛtivacano dṛṣṭa ityanyatrāpi prati- kṛtikavacano vijñāyate, pṛṣṭhaśabdo vā pṛṣṭhāsādhanamantravacana:, na ca lakṣaṇayā prayoge śabdārtha: paricchidyate |
yatkā- ram, svārtha eva vartamāno'rthāntaraṃ lakṣayati |
bhāṣyam— 'agniṃ citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta' 'vājapeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' iti |
tatra saṃdeha: kimaṅgaprayojanasaṃbandha eṣa uta kālārtha: saṃyoga iti |
śrutilagṇāviśe ye ca śrutinyāyā, na lakṣaṇā |
ṭup— yadi vājapeya: pārārthyanocaryeta, triprakāra-yā''pi śrutvā hrīyate |
kālavidhikarūpo hi śabda:, citvā cayaneḍabhinivṛtte iti |
ṭup— aṅgāṅgitve hi bṛhaspatisava: karmāntaram, tasyāpūrvāntaram, dharmalakṣyatvaṃ ca |
tasmādedhamādidoṣa-parihārāya miśritasya bṛhaspatisavasya vājapeyena kāle lakṣyate |
avivṛtti-śvet kathaṃ kālo'sya vidhīyate ? yadi 'bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' ityanena viparivṛtti:, tatastatraiva kṣīṇatvāt kāla-vidhi: |
tatra pradhānakālatvādjñānāṃ pradhānakatve prāpte vacanāt vājapeyena sāṅgena bṛhaspatisavavarjitena kṛtvā tata idaṃ kartavyamiti |
na ca karmāntaraṃ yuktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ hi tathā bhavet |
tatprakriyā ca bādhyeta, na ca dūragataṃ prati |
kāla: śakya upādātum, kāle karma hi coyate |
evamiha ktvāsvārthatvāt kāla-vidhi: iti pratyayajñānāt saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu-- 'vājapeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' ityādiṣu sama-vāye aṅgāṅgitvāvalakṣaṇe codanā syāt vājapeyādisayoga-syārthavattvāt |
bhāṭṭa— 'agniṃ citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta' 'vāja-peyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yajeta' ityabhivājapeyakaraṇe śrutam |
tasya ca phalā-pekṣayāṇāṃ prakaraṇādinā agnivājapeyāṅgaṃ avivādameva iti tattathāyuktaṃ tatkarmāntaram |
samāpte'pi bṛhaspati-savāyatirekādviśeṣavājapeyādiprayoge taduttarañca idaṃ phalānukūlayogyatāyā: paramāpūrvaniṣṭhāyā: jananārthaṃ na virupyate |

' na ca atra ('darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvā somena yajeta' ityatra) bṛhaspatisavanyāyena somadharmakamarkaphalakaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti śakyaṃ vaktum, somaśabdasya bṛhaspatisavaśabdavat nāmatvābhāvena dharmātideśakatvā-bhāvāt |
satrāṇāṃ phalavattvāt aphale'yaṃ pṛthuśamanīye: bṛhaspatisavanayena satrāṅgam, (iti pūrvapakṣe) |

bṛhaspatisavasya vājapeyāṅgatve-'pi svakāle vasante kartavyabṛhaspatisavatvāt pūrvameva śaradi vājapeyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa tasyāthaṃ paramāpūrvamutpadyate, utpannaṃ ca paramāpūrva bṛhaspatisavena paścāt phalamuccīkriyate yathā tathā ādhānamātrādeva agnayo niṣpadyante pavamānahavi-bhistu teṣāṃ phalavattvasaṃpādanāmātra iti pūrvapakṣa: |

na ca sthāpakatvam, bṛhaspatisavavat pavamāneṣṭyā ādhānaprayogabahivarbhāve'pi tadaṣṭu ādhāna-karaṇakabhāvanāhavirbhāvasya aśrutatvena sthāpakatvakalpanānupa-patte: (bṛhaspatisava: vājapeyaprayogabahivarbhūta:, vājapeya-karaṇakabhāvanāhavirbhāvasya śrutatvāt ca bṛhaspatisavasya sthāpakatvakalpanāpyupapatti: 'tadvat na' iti vyatirekopa-mānte) |
bṛhaspatisavavarjitena sāṅgena apūrve kṛtvā tata: idaṃ (bṛhaspatisvarūpaṃ karma) kartavyam |
vailva: yūpa: agnīṣomīye paśau brahmavarcasakāmena kartavya: |
bhā. 3|6|1|10, 'vailvaṃ annādya-kāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt' iti phalavidhi: |
bauddhā: jñānasya prāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ aprāmāṇyaṃ tu svata iti vadanti |
1|1|12 pṛ. 14. baudvai: jñānasaṃtānasya ātmatvābhyupagamāt tasya ca adravyatvena aparimāṇapakṣo'pi saṃbhavati |

kalpataru. 2|1|12 brasū. bauddhādibhi: paramāṇvādyātmakakāraṇamyupagamāt śarīrasaṃtānādyātmakakalpanācca tadātiriktakāraṇādiniṣedha: kriyate |

bhā. 11|2|10|15. brahmā ṛtvik āghāne udgātrā saha vikalpyate kalpasūtrānusāreṇa |
tasya puruṣākhyaḥ brāhmaṇācchaṃsī, amīt, potā ceti |
prathamagaṇasyoyam, pūrṇā dakṣiṇā dvādaśa gāḥ labhate |
athavā amā- vāsyāyāṃ vedikaraṇaṃ pūrvaiyuḥ vacanenopadiṣṭam |

10|2|16|11. mīko. pṛ. 1481 'kṛṣṇalacarau yugapadudghṛttāḥ' 0 ityatra draṣṭa- vyam |
itarebhya ṛtvigbhyastu na kimapi śāstrīyaṃ deyam,
vi. 10|1|18. brahmaṇaḥ parihāraḥ sarvabhakṣāṇāṃ puruṣāntarebhyo'panīya śata- kṛṣṇalacarau |
10|2|16|19-20. mīko. pṛ. 1482 'kṛṣṇalacarau sarve śeṣabhakṣāḥ 0' ityatra draṣṭavyam |

10|2|16| 21. brahmaṇo'pi jagatsṛṣṭau kālāhṛṣṭādisāpekṣatvam, vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyena sāpekṣatvāt iti nyāyāt |
parākramaḥ. 53|2. brahmaṇaḥ ṛtvijaḥ abhyurdghṛtāhutīnāṃ prayogeṣu prasaktaṃ vaikalyaṃ samādhātuṃ vedatrayādhyayanamapekṣitvam |
vi. 6|3|144. brahmaṇaḥ (brāhmaṇasya) gṛhṇe brāh- maṇyasyaḥ rājasūye |
brahmādiṣveva ṣoḍaśasu saptadaśasu vā ṛtvik- śabdasya niyamaḥ |
brahmabhāgo na dakṣiṇā, dakṣiṇāyavayo hi saḥ |
brahmayajamānau dakṣiṇata āsāte karmaṇaḥ kriya- māṇasya |
brahmavaraṇaṃ jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikesu karmasu dāśikaṃ codakaprāptaṃ saumikena prasaṅgasiddhameva |
mā. 12|1|1 36-39, brahmavaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭārtham, tat saumikenaiva kṛta- syāt na kartavyam |
paurṇamāsyāṃ praṇītāpraṇayanāt pūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kartavyābhāvāt apraṇayatvāpi amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvaiyurvedikaraṇāṅgabhūtānujñā- dānāya asatyeva praṇītāpraṇayanātpūrve brahmaṇaḥ pravṛttiḥ |
idaṃ ca pūrvaparigrahe'pi brahmaṇāsya asti pakṣe |
uttara- parigrahātme brahmaṇāsye pūrveyuḥ prasavedānāya brahmaṇaḥ pravṛttyasaṃbhavāt iti dhyeyam |
na ca pareyuḥ havi- rāsādottarakāle ājhātāyā vedeḥ pūrvaiyuṣkarūpe sati
tadantāpakarṣanyāyāt tatpūrvasya brahmavaraṇasyāpi apakarṣa- vaśyabhāvāt amāvāsyāyāṃ abhraṣṭasyaiva brahmaṇo varaṇaṃ iti vācyam |
pañcame 'tathā'pūrvam' (5|1|16| 29) ityatra vedyapakarṣe tadantāpakarṣo nāsti, kintu śrutamātrāpakarṣaḥ iti vyavasthāpitatvāt |

satyam, na tadantāpakarṣaḥ tathāpi sāṅgasya vedikaraṇasya apakarṣān brahmavaraṇasya apakarṣaprayogārhakartṛsaṃskāratayā brahmakartṛka- sarvaprayogāṅgatvāt brahmakartṛkaprasavatayā brahmakartṛka- prasavavat prasaṅgātbrahmavaraṇasyāpi apakarṣaḥ |
soma. 12|1|18. brahmavaraṇaṃ somājñeṣṭiṣvadiṣu kartavyaṃ na veti vicāraḥ |
yasyaiva ca pravacanaṃ sa eva tacchīlaḥ taddharmaḥ tatsādhukārī vā bhavati, na kṣatriyavaiśyau |
su. pṛ. 131. brahmavidāṃ eṣa niścayaḥ, yadupalabhyate tadasat, yatropalabhyate tat tattvamiti |
'brahmā aśvamedhe yajeta' iti yo lobhāt patitayājanamajñīkṛtya yājayiṣyati tadapekṣaṃ vidhānam, na tu tadvidhānāt yathā'nupapattyā yājanaṃ itarasyāpi vihitamiti kalpyate |
vā. 3|4|10|28. brahmā dvādaśāhāni, 'pūrveyorvedyervādyena hatvā' atra puruṣārthaḥ : upasaṃhāravidhiḥ |
aṣṭācatvāriṃśad varṣāṇi vedabrahmacaryacaraṇaṃ 'jātaputraḥ kṛṣṇakedo'dhīnādhīta' ityanena viruddham |
apuṃstvaṃ pracadya- ntaśca (ke cit) aṣṭācatvāriṃśad varṣāṇi vedabrahmacaryaṃ caritavantaḥ |
aṣṭā- catvāriṃśad vedabrahmacaryacaraṇasya smṛtāveva pakṣāntara- vikalpopanibandhanādāśramantaraviṣayatvasaṃbhavāt virodhā- bhāvaḥ |
sudhā. (pṛ. 168) -- yo'lpena kālena bahun vedānadhyetuṃ samarthaḥ, taṃ prati bahuvedapakṣaḥ |
asamarthe prati alpavedapakṣaḥ iti sāmarthyamadhikṛtya, gārhasthyāśramāyogayaṃ prati bahuvedapakṣaḥ tadyogyaṃ prati alpavedapakṣaḥ iti āśramayogatvamaṅgīkṛtya apekṣya etat manunā ucyate ityarthaḥ |
tadarthikaṃ pādikaṃ vā grahaṇā- ntikameva vā |
varṣasaṃkhyāpakṣe tu āśramayoga- tvāpekṣā iti viveko''sītyate |

vā. (pṛ. 192) - gautamenāpi 'dvādaśavarṣāṇyekevedabrahmacaryaṃ caret' iti prathama- kalpaṃ āyugāhasthyāpratipatyarthamuktvā dvitīyakalpe 'dvādaśa prativedaṃ vā sarveṣu' iti aṣṭācatvāriṃśatparigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ |
gṛhasthatvaṃ na śakyanti kartum, teṣāmayaṃ vidhiḥ |

yāni ca prati- dinaprayujyamānaṛksāmayajurbrāhmaṇakalpavyākhyānādvijasya- nimittāni phalāni katvadhikṛtapuruṣebhyaḥ anyānyarthakya- prasaṅgāt vyāvṛttāni japadhyānamātrādhikṛtabrāhmaṇapari- vrājakaviṣayatvena avatiṣṭhante tānyapi svādhyāyavidhāna- bhūyastvena bhūyiṣṭhāni bhaviṣyanti iti prativedabrahmacaryo- deśaḥ |

yo vā kaścit medhāvitayā śīghrameva vedacatu- ṣṭayamapyadhītya yathoppattikāle tadarthajñānābhiprāyo apara- tyajan 'grahaṇāntaṃ vā' ityetatkāśrayaṇaṃ gṛhastho bhavet taṃ prati dvādaśāṣṭācatvāriṃśadvarṣapakṣau anenaiva smaraṇena pūrva- pakṣīkṛtau iti nātīva śrutiviruddhatvena udāhartavyau |
yadi tu kaścidaśakto nādhīte sakalaṃ agnihotradarśapūrṇa- māsamātraṃ kathañcidgacchati na tasya tatrānadhikāraḥ |
brahmacāriṇā māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayitavyamityukte darva- gatamāpi lepaṃ varjayanti |
tatra yāvadapi māṃsasamātraṃ viditaṃ bhavati tasyāpi doṣaḥ na ileṣmaprakopādi kiñcid dṛṣṭamapekṣate |
brahmacāriṇaḥ avakīrṇine 'sa gardabhaṃ paśumālabheta' iti vihito gardabhaḥ; sa ca laukike'gnī |
brahmacāriṇā madhu māṃsaṃ ca pratiṣidhyate 'madhu māṃsaṃ ca varjayet' iti |
brahmayajñe evaṃ ṛtvijaḥ sāmādhyayanavidhiḥ phala- viśeṣārthe |

brahmasātri ālabhate' (vājapeye prājāpatyān paśūn prakṛtya śrūyate idam) iti karmāntaraṃ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
1|2|6|25-28 varṇaka 4. mīko. pṛ. 1547 'gavāmayane dvayordvayoḥ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |

yadā karoti tadā pratiṣidhyate na hantavya iti |
